en: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.
She danced with wild abandon.
Never abandon your principles for temporary gain.
cn: 船员不得不弃离沉船。
她纵情狂舞。
切勿为一时利益放弃原则。

en: Her ability to solve complex problems impressed the team.
The law requires proof of financial ability to start a business.
His athletic ability earned him a scholarship.
cn: 她解决复杂问题的能力让团队印象深刻。
法律要求提供创业的财务资质证明。
他的运动才能为他赢得了奖学金。

en: She is able to solve complex problems quickly.
The law makes it clear who is able to vote.
Despite his injury, he remained able to work.
cn: 她能迅速解决复杂问题。
法律明确了谁有资格投票。
尽管受伤，他仍能工作。

definitions.definition: 不规则的（如生物学特征）

en: The abnormal weather patterns caused crop failures.
His abnormal behavior raised concerns among his friends.
The test results showed abnormal cell growth.
cn: 反常的天气模式导致农作物歉收。
他的异常行为引发了朋友们的担忧。
检测结果显示细胞生长异常。

definitions.definition: /prep. 在（船、飞机、火车等）上；登（交通工具）

en: All passengers must be aboard the train by 8:00 AM.
The captain welcomed us aboard with a smile.
She felt a thrill as the plane lifted off the ground, finally aboard her first flight.
cn: 所有乘客须在上午8点前登车。
船长微笑着欢迎我们登船。
当飞机离地时，她感到一阵激动——她终于登上了人生首次航班。

en: She told me a story about her childhood.
There were books scattered about the room.
The meeting will start at about 3 PM.
cn: 她给我讲了一个关于她童年的故事。
房间里四处散落着书本。
会议将在下午3点左右开始。

en: The moon hangs above the horizon.
Her score was above average.
See the examples mentioned above.
cn: 月亮悬在地平线上方。
她的分数高于平均水平。
参见上文提到的例子。

en: She studied abroad for two years.
Rumors of his resignation spread abroad quickly.
The company plans to expand its business abroad.
cn: 她在国外留学了两年。
他辞职的传闻迅速传开。
该公司计划向海外拓展业务。

en: His absence from the meeting was noted by everyone.
The absence of evidence made the case difficult to solve.
She stared out the window, lost in absence of mind.
cn: 他缺席会议的情况被所有人注意到了。
证据的缺乏使得案件难以解决。
她望着窗外，心不在焉。

definitions.definition: 使缺席（正式用法，如 "to absent oneself"）

en: She was absent from school due to illness.
The manager absented himself from the meeting.
An absent look in his eyes suggested he wasn’t listening.
cn: 她因生病未到校。
经理故意未出席会议。
他眼神游离，显然没在听。

definitions.definition: 绝对的；完全的（不受限制或条件约束）
专制的（权力不受制约的）
绝对事物（哲学或数学中的终极概念）

en: The dictator ruled with absolute power.
In mathematics, zero is the absolute minimum.
Her trust in him was absolute.
cn: 这位独裁者以绝对权力统治。
在数学中，零是绝对最小值。
她对他的信任是毫无保留的。

definitions.definition: 完全地，绝对地（强调肯定或同意）

en: The project was absolutely successful.
"Will you join us?" "Absolutely!"
She trusted him absolutely.
cn: 这个项目绝对成功了。
“你会加入我们吗？”“当然！”
她完全信任他。

en: Plants absorb sunlight to produce energy.
She was so absorbed in the book that she missed her stop.
The sponge quickly absorbed the spilled water.
cn: 植物吸收阳光以产生能量。
她全神贯注地读书，以至于坐过了站。
海绵迅速吸干了洒出的水。

en: The concept of love is too abstract to define easily.
She wrote an abstract of her research paper.
Scientists abstract data from experiments to form theories.
cn: “爱”的概念过于抽象，难以简单定义。
她为研究论文撰写了摘要。
科学家从实验中提取数据以形成理论。

en: The region is abundant in natural resources.
She has an abundant imagination.
The harvest was abundant this year.
cn: 该地区自然资源丰富。
她拥有丰富的想象力。
今年收成丰盈。

en: The politician was accused of abusing his power for personal gain.
Verbal abuse can have long-lasting psychological effects.
The system is designed to prevent the abuse of sensitive data.
cn: 这位政治家被指控滥用职权谋取私利。
言语辱骂可能造成长期心理伤害。
该系统旨在防止敏感数据被滥用。

en: She pursued an academic career in physics.
The debate was too academic for practical applications.
Many academics attended the international conference.
cn: 她从事物理学学术研究。
这场辩论过于理论化，缺乏实际应用价值。
许多学者出席了这场国际会议。

definitions.definition: 学院；研究院；学会（指高等教育或专业研究机构）
（特定领域的）权威机构或团体

en: She graduated from the Royal Academy of Music.
The National Academy of Sciences published a groundbreaking report.
His theories were rejected by the mainstream academic academy.
cn: 她毕业于皇家音乐学院。
美国国家科学院发表了一份突破性报告。
他的理论被主流学术界否决。

en: The car can accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in 6 seconds.
Climate change is accelerating at an alarming rate.
The new policy aims to accelerate economic recovery.
cn: 这辆车可在6秒内从0加速至60英里/小时。
气候变化正以惊人速度加剧。
新政策旨在加速经济复苏。

en: The car's acceleration from 0 to 60 mph was impressive.
Technological advancement has led to an acceleration in global communication.
In physics, acceleration is defined as the rate of change of velocity.
cn: 这辆车从0加速到60英里的表现令人印象深刻。
技术进步推动了全球通信的加速发展。
在物理学中，加速度被定义为速度的变化率。

en: She has a strong French accent.
The word "record" changes meaning depending on which syllable you accent.
He accented his speech with gestures to make his point clear.
cn: 她有浓厚的法国口音。
“record”一词的意义取决于重读音节。
他用动作强调演讲内容，使观点更清晰。

en: She decided to accept the job offer despite the long commute.
The theory was widely accepted by scientists.
He struggled to accept the reality of his failure.
cn: 她决定接受这份工作，尽管通勤时间很长。
这一理论被科学家们广泛认可。
他难以接受自己失败的现实。

en: The proposal was deemed acceptable by the committee.
Her grades were acceptable, but not outstanding.
This solution is acceptable under current circumstances.
cn: 委员会认为该提案是可接受的。
她的成绩尚可，但并不出色。
在当前情况下，这一解决方案是可行的。

en: Her acceptance of the award moved the audience.
The bank confirmed the acceptance of the draft.
Cultural acceptance requires open-mindedness.
cn: 她接受奖项的举动感动了在场观众。
银行确认了汇票的承兑。
文化包容需要开放的心态。

definitions.definition: 进入；使用权；接触的机会

en: The building has wheelchair access.
Students need a password to access the online library.
She was denied access to the confidential files.
cn: 这座大楼设有轮椅通道。
学生需密码才能访问在线图书馆。
她被拒绝接触机密文件。

definitions.definition: 附件；配件（如服装配饰或电子设备附加部件）

en: She bought a matching handbag as an accessory for her dress.
The suspect was charged as an accessory to the crime.
The camera comes with several accessory lenses.
cn: 她买了一个搭配的手包作为裙子的配饰。
该嫌疑人被指控为犯罪从犯。
这款相机附带多个辅助镜头。

en: She broke her leg in a car accident.
The discovery was made by accident.
Accidents will happen in any workplace.
cn: 她在车祸中摔断了腿。
这一发现是偶然获得的。
任何工作场所都可能发生意外。

definitions.definition: 偶然事件；非本质属性（音乐术语中指临时升降记号）

en: The discovery of penicillin was purely accidental.
She played an accidental note during the concert.
Their meeting was accidental, but it changed both their lives.
cn: 青霉素的发现纯属偶然。
她在音乐会上弹错了一个音。
他们的相遇是偶然的，却改变了彼此的人生。

definitions.definition: 容纳；提供住宿；适应；调解

en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
She accommodated her schedule to meet the deadline.
The lens accommodates to focus on near objects.
cn: 这家酒店可容纳多达500名客人。
她调整了日程以适应截止时间。
晶状体调节以聚焦近处物体。

definitions.definition: 住所，住宿（提供居住的空间或服务）
适应，调节（行为或生理上的调整）

en: The hotel offers luxury accommodation for business travelers.
The lens of the eye changes shape for accommodation to near objects.
Cultural accommodation is essential for immigrants in a new country.
cn: 酒店为商务旅客提供豪华住宿。
眼睛的晶状体通过变形调节以看清近处物体。
文化适应对移民在新国家的生活至关重要。

en: She asked her friend to accompany her to the concert.
The pianist will accompany the singer on stage.
Heavy rain often accompanies strong winds in typhoons.
cn: 她请朋友陪她一起去音乐会。
钢琴家将为台上的歌手伴奏。
台风中，大雨常伴随强风而来。

en: She worked hard to accomplish her mission.
The team accomplished the project ahead of schedule.
His dedication accomplished a remarkable transformation.
cn: 她努力完成了自己的任务。
团队提前完成了项目。
他的投入实现了显著的转变。

definitions.definition: 给予（权力、地位等）；使一致

en: The two nations signed a peace accord after years of conflict.
Her actions do not accord with her words.
The committee accorded him the highest honor for his contributions.
cn: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平协议。
她的言行不一。
委员会因他的贡献授予他最高荣誉。

en: The project was completed in accordance with the client's specifications.
His actions were not in accordance with company policy.
The judge ruled in accordance with the law.
cn: 该项目按照客户的要求完成。
他的行为不符合公司政策。
法官依法作出了裁决。

en: The rules have changed, and we must act accordingly.
She prepared thoroughly for the exam; accordingly, she passed with ease.
The budget was cut, and accordingly, several projects were postponed.
cn: 规则已变，我们必须相应调整行动。
她为考试做了充分准备，因此轻松通过。
预算被削减，因此多个项目被推迟。

en: She checked her bank account online.
Can you account for the missing funds?
His account of the accident was detailed.
cn: 她在网上查看了银行账户。
你能解释资金缺失的原因吗？
他对事故的描述非常详细。

definitions.definition: 积累，堆积（指逐渐增加数量或规模）
累积，积聚（指自然或被动增长）

en: Dust tends to accumulate in unused rooms.
He accumulated a fortune through wise investments.
Stress can accumulate if not managed properly.
cn: 灰尘容易在无人使用的房间里堆积。
他通过明智的投资积累了财富。
压力若不妥善处理会不断累积。

en: The experiment requires a high level of accuracy.
Her accuracy in translating technical terms impressed the team.
The sniper’s accuracy was unmatched in the field.
cn: 实验需要极高的精确度。
她对技术术语的精准翻译令团队印象深刻。
这名狙击手的精准度在战场上无可匹敌。

en: The scientist needs accurate data to validate the theory.
This watch is accurate to within one second per year.
Her accurate description helped the police identify the suspect.
cn: 科学家需要准确的数据来验证理论。
这块手表的年误差在一秒以内。
她精确的描述帮助警方锁定了嫌疑人。

en: She accused him of stealing her ideas.
The report accuses the government of ignoring climate change.
He was wrongly accused of the crime.
cn: 她指控他窃取她的创意。
报告指责政府忽视气候变化。
他被错误地指控犯下该罪。

en: It takes time to accustom your eyes to the darkness.
She tried to accustom her dog to being alone.
Travelers must accustom themselves to local customs.
cn: 你的眼睛需要时间适应黑暗。
她试图让她的狗习惯独处。
旅行者必须让自己适应当地习俗。

en: She was accustomed to waking up early.
His accustomed cheerfulness vanished under stress.
The team is accustomed to working under tight deadlines.
cn: 她习惯了早起。
他惯常的乐观在压力下消失了。
这个团队习惯了在紧迫的期限内工作。

en: She had a dull ache in her lower back after gardening.
My heart aches when I think of those lost memories.
He ached to see his family after years abroad.
cn: 她在园艺后感到下背部隐隐作痛。
每当想起逝去的回忆，我的心就隐隐作痛。
在国外多年后，他渴望见到家人。

en: She worked hard to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
The team achieved a remarkable victory against all odds.
Early humans achieved mastery of fire, transforming their survival.
cn: 她努力实现了成为医生的梦想。
这支队伍克服万难取得了非凡的胜利。
早期人类掌握了火的使用，彻底改变了生存方式。

definitions.definition: （通过努力获得的）成绩或奖励

en: Winning the award was her greatest achievement.
The project’s achievement surprised everyone.
His academic achievements earned him a scholarship.
cn: 获得该奖项是她最大的成就。
该项目的完成令所有人惊讶。
他的学术成绩为他赢得了奖学金。

en: The lemon juice tastes strongly acidic.
Sulfuric acid is highly corrosive.
His acid remarks hurt her feelings.
cn: 柠檬汁尝起来非常酸。
硫酸具有强腐蚀性。
他尖刻的言论伤了她的感情。

en: She's an old acquaintance from college.
I have some acquaintance with French literature.
He nodded to me as a mere acquaintance.
cn: 她是大学时代的一个旧相识。
我对法国文学略有了解。
他向我点头示意，仅维持泛泛之交的礼节。

definitions.definition: 获得，取得（通过努力或自然过程）

en: She acquired fluency in French after living in Paris for five years.
The museum acquired a rare painting from the 17th century.
Bad habits are easier to acquire than to discard.
cn: 她在巴黎居住五年后习得了流利的法语。
博物馆获得了一幅17世纪的稀有画作。
坏习惯比好习惯更容易养成。

definitions.definition: 英亩（土地面积单位，约4047平方米）

en: The farm covers about 50 acres of land.
An acre is roughly the size of a football field.
They bought two acres to build their dream house.
cn: 这座农场占地约50英亩。
一英亩大约相当于一个足球场的面积。
他们买了两英亩地来建造梦想中的房子。

en: She walked across the bridge slowly.
There’s a pharmacy just across the street.
He reached across the table to grab the salt.
cn: 她缓缓走过桥。
街对面就有一家药店。
他伸手越过桌子去拿盐。

en: She acted in a famous Broadway play last year.
The new act will protect endangered species.
He’s just acting tough to hide his fear.
cn: 她去年在一部著名的百老汇戏剧中演出。
这项新法案将保护濒危物种。
他只是在假装坚强以掩饰恐惧。

en: His quick action saved the child from drowning.
The chemical action produces heat.
She filed an action against the company for discrimination.
cn: 他的迅速行动救了溺水的孩子。
这一化学反应会产生热量。
她以歧视为由对公司提起诉讼。

en: She maintains an active lifestyle by hiking and swimming weekly.
The chemical remains active even at low temperatures.
He was an active in the environmental movement.
cn: 她通过每周徒步和游泳保持活跃的生活方式。
这种化学物质即使在低温下仍保持活性。
他是环保运动中的积极分子。

definitions.definition: （特定领域的）活动类型（如商业活动）

en: The volcano showed signs of activity after decades of silence.
Classroom activities should engage students creatively.
Her high level of activity makes her a successful entrepreneur.
cn: 火山在沉寂数十年后显现出活动迹象。
课堂活动应激发学生的创造力。
她的高度活跃性使她成为成功的企业家。

definitions.definition: 演员（尤指职业戏剧或电影演员）

en: He is a famous actor in Hollywood.
Every actor must understand the script deeply.
She was the main actor in the project’s success.
cn: 他是好莱坞著名演员。
每位演员都必须深入理解剧本。
她是项目成功的主要推动者。

en: The actress delivered a powerful monologue on stage.
She became a famous actress after her breakthrough role in the indie film.
The young actress was nominated for an Academy Award.
cn: 这位女演员在舞台上呈现了一段强有力的独白。
她在独立电影中的突破性角色后成为知名女演员。
这位年轻女演员获得了奥斯卡奖提名。

definitions.definition: 真实的，实际的（与理论或假设相对）
现行的，当前的（用于强调）

en: The actual cost was higher than the estimate.
She described the actual events of that night.
In actual fact, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
cn: 实际成本比预估更高。
她描述了当晚的真实事件。
事实上，项目提前完成了。

definitions.definition: 实际上，事实上（用于强调或修正陈述）

en: The plan sounds simple, but actually it's quite complex.
Did you actually meet the president?
He claims to be busy, but actually he just avoids responsibility.
cn: 这个计划听起来简单，但实际上非常复杂。
你竟然真的见到了总统？
他声称很忙，实则是在逃避责任。

definitions.definition: 尖锐的；剧烈的（疼痛、疾病等）

en: She felt an acute pain in her chest.
Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
The triangle has two acute angles.
cn: 她感到胸口一阵剧痛。
狗拥有敏锐的嗅觉。
这个三角形有两个锐角。

en: She saw an ad for the job online.
The company placed an ad in the local newspaper.
Click the ad to learn more about the product.
cn: 她在网上看到了这份工作的广告。
该公司在本地报纸上刊登了一则广告。
点击广告以了解更多产品信息。

en: The novel was adapted into a popular film.
It takes time to adapt to a new culture.
The species adapted to survive in extreme heat.
cn: 这部小说被改编成了一部热门电影。
适应新文化需要时间。
该物种通过适应在极端高温中存活。

en: Add sugar to the coffee and stir well.
The new evidence adds weight to his argument.
If you add 5 and 3, you get 8.
cn: 往咖啡里加糖并搅拌均匀。
新证据使他的论点更有说服力。
5加3等于8。

en: The teacher wrote the addition problem on the board.
The new wing is a recent addition to the museum.
Fresh herbs are a great addition to any dish.
cn: 老师在黑板上写下了这道加法题。
新侧厅是博物馆最近扩建的部分。
新鲜香草是任何菜肴的绝佳点缀。

en: The hotel charges an additional fee for late check-out.
She provided additional evidence to support her claim.
Additional resources will be allocated to the project next month.
cn: 酒店对延迟退房收取额外费用。
她提供了更多证据来支持她的主张。
下个月将为该项目分配更多资源。

definitions.definition: 写地址；向…讲话；处理（问题）

en: Please write your address clearly on the envelope.
The president will address the nation tonight.
We need to address this issue immediately.
cn: 请在信封上写清你的地址。
总统将于今晚向全国发表讲话。
我们需要立即处理这个问题。

en: The hotel provided adequate facilities for the conference.
His performance was adequate but not outstanding.
Ensure your diet includes adequate nutrients.
cn: 酒店为会议提供了足够的设施。
他的表现尚可，但并不出色。
确保饮食中含有充足的营养。

definitions.definition: 形容词（用于描述或修饰名词的词语）

en: "Happy" is an adjective that describes a feeling.
She used vivid adjectives to paint a picture with words.
In "the blue sky," "blue" functions as an adjective.
cn: “happy”是描述感受的形容词。
她运用生动的形容词以文字描绘画面。
在“蓝色的天空”中，“blue”是形容词。

en: She adjusted the mirror to see the road clearly.
It took him weeks to adjust to the new climate.
The mechanic adjusted the engine for better performance.
cn: 她调整后视镜以看清道路。
他花了数周才适应新气候。
机械师调试引擎以提升性能。

definitions.definition: 管理，行政（尤指政府或企业的运作）

en: The school administration introduced a new policy on campus safety.
The Obama administration focused on healthcare reform.
Efficient administration is key to a company's success.
cn: 学校管理层出台了一项新的校园安全政策。
奥巴马政府曾专注于医疗改革。
高效的管理是企业成功的关键。

en: She admires his courage to speak up for justice.
I couldn't help but admire the sunset over the ocean.
"I admire your confidence," he said with a sarcastic smile.
cn: 她钦佩他敢于为正义发声的勇气。
我情不自禁地欣赏起海上的日落。
“我真羡慕你的自信，”他带着嘲讽的笑容说道。

en: The museum charges a small fee for admission.
His silence was interpreted as an admission of guilt.
She gained admission to the prestigious university.
cn: 博物馆收取少量入场费。
他的沉默被视为认罪。
她获得了这所名牌大学的录取资格。

definitions.definition: 准许进入（某场所或组织）

en: She refused to admit her mistake.
This ticket admits two people to the museum.
The rules admit of no exceptions.
cn: 她拒绝承认错误。
这张票允许两人进入博物馆。
这些规则不容许任何例外。

en: They decided to adopt a child from overseas.
The company plans to adopt new AI technologies.
The committee adopted the proposal unanimously.
cn: 他们决定从海外收养一个孩子。
该公司计划采用新的人工智能技术。
委员会一致通过了该提案。

en: In many countries, you are legally an adult at 18.
The film contains adult themes unsuitable for children.
She handled the situation with adult responsibility.
cn: 在许多国家，18岁即为法律意义上的成年人。
这部电影包含不适合儿童的成人主题。
她以成年人的责任感处理了这一情况。

en: The troops advanced toward the enemy camp.
She advanced her career by taking on new challenges.
The company offered an advance payment for the project.
cn: 部队向敌军营地推进。
她通过接受新挑战推动了职业发展。
公司为该项目提供了预付款。

en: She enrolled in an advanced mathematics course.
The disease was detected at an advanced stage.
Their technology is far more advanced than ours.
cn: 她报名了一门高等数学课程。
这种疾病在晚期才被发现。
他们的技术远比我们的先进。

en: Her fluency in three languages gave her an advantage in the job interview.
The team took full advantage of their opponent's weak defense.
He missed three match points but finally won on his fourth advantage.
cn: 她在求职面试中因精通三种语言而占据优势。
该队充分利用了对手薄弱的防守。
他浪费了三个赛点，最终在第四个局点时获胜。

en: She embarked on a solo adventure across the Amazon.
The book recounts his adventures in the Arctic.
They adventured into the abandoned castle at midnight.
cn: 她开始了独自穿越亚马逊的冒险。
这本书记述了他在北极的奇遇。
他们在午夜冒险进入了废弃城堡。

definitions.definition: 副词（用于修饰动词、形容词、其他副词或整个句子，表示时间、地点、程度、方式等）

en: She speaks English fluently.
He arrived quite early.
Unfortunately, the event was canceled.
cn: 她说英语很流利。
他到得相当早。
不幸的是，活动被取消了。

definitions.definition: 广告（公开宣传商品、服务或活动）
宣传，推广（广义的传播行为）

en: The advertisement on TV convinced me to buy the new shampoo.
Social media has changed the way companies create advertisements.
Her job is to design advertisements for eco-friendly products.
cn: 电视广告说服我购买了新洗发水。
社交媒体改变了企业制作广告的方式。
她的工作是为环保产品设计广告。

en: She gave me excellent advice on career planning.
The lawyer will send legal advice to the client.
Ignoring his doctor’s advice led to worse health.
cn: 她为我的职业规划提供了极好的建议。
律师将向客户发送法律通知。
忽视医生的忠告导致健康状况恶化。

en: It is advisable to book tickets in advance during peak season.
Wearing a helmet while cycling is always advisable.
The doctor said it would be advisable to reduce sugar intake.
cn: 旺季时提前订票是明智的。
骑自行车时戴头盔总是可取的。
医生建议减少糖分摄入是合理的。

en: The lawyer advised her client to sign the contract.
I’d advise against traveling during the storm.
He advises for a major tech company.
cn: 律师建议她的客户签署合同。
我建议不要在暴风雨期间出行。
他为一家大型科技公司提供咨询。

definitions.definition: 飞机（英国英语，美国英语常用 airplane）

en: The aeroplane took off smoothly despite the strong winds.
She prefers the term "aeroplane" over "airplane" as it sounds more classic.
The museum displays the first aeroplane to cross the English Channel.
cn: 尽管风很大，飞机仍平稳起飞。
她更喜欢用“aeroplane”而非“airplane”，因前者更显古典。
博物馆展出了第一架飞越英吉利海峡的飞机。

definitions.definition: 事务；事件（尤指需要处理或关注的事）

en: The minister handled the diplomatic affair with tact.
Their affair lasted for several years before being discovered.
Organizing the festival is a complex affair.
cn: 这位部长巧妙处理了外交事务。
他们的婚外情持续了数年才被发现。
筹办节日是件复杂的事。

definitions.definition: 假装；装作（特定情感或状态）

en: The drought will affect crop production.
She affected a British accent to impress her friends.
His speech deeply affected the audience.
cn: 干旱将影响农作物产量。
她假装英国口音来打动朋友。
他的演讲深深打动了听众。

definitions.definition: 喜爱，感情（对人或物的温柔情感）
疾病，病状（古义或医学语境）

en: She has a deep affection for her childhood home.
His affection was evident in the small gifts he gave.
The patient showed signs of pulmonary affection.
cn: 她对童年故居怀有深厚的感情。
他赠送的小礼物显露出他的爱意。
患者表现出肺部病变的迹象。

definitions.definition: 买得起；承担得起（费用、时间等）

en: She can't afford a new car right now.
The window affords a beautiful view of the garden.
We must afford everyone equal opportunities.
cn: 她目前买不起新车。
这扇窗户提供了花园的美景。
我们必须给予每个人平等的机会。

en: She was afraid to walk alone at night.
Don’t be afraid to ask questions.
He’s afraid of losing his job.
cn: 她害怕夜晚独自走路。
不要害怕提问。
他担心失去工作。

en: The African elephant is the largest land animal.
She studies African history at university.
Many African countries have rich cultural traditions.
cn: 非洲象是最大的陆地动物。
她在大学研究非洲历史。
许多非洲国家拥有丰富的文化传统。

en: She left the room after the meeting ended.
After all these years, he still remembers her smile.
The dog ran after the ball enthusiastically.
cn: 会议结束后，她离开了房间。
这么多年过去，他依然记得她的笑容。
狗兴奋地追着球跑。

definitions.definition: 下午（正午至傍晚的时间段）

en: She takes a nap every afternoon.
The meeting is scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.
The sunlight in the afternoon was golden and warm.
cn: 她每天下午都会小睡一会儿。
会议定于明天下午举行。
午后的阳光金黄而温暖。

en: She left the party shortly afterward.
He finished his homework and went to bed afterward.
The meeting was boring, but we had fun afterward.
cn: 她不久后离开了聚会。
他做完作业后就去睡觉了。
会议很无聊，但之后我们玩得很开心。

en: She tried again and succeeded.
It might rain, but again, it might not.
He stood up and sat down again.
cn: 她再次尝试并成功了。
可能会下雨，但也可能不会。
他站起来又坐下了。

en: She leaned against the wall, exhausted.
The law was passed against strong opposition.
The ship sailed against the wind.
cn: 她疲惫地靠在墙上。
这项法律在强烈反对声中通过。
船逆风航行。

en: Her wisdom comes with age.
The digital age has transformed communication.
Fine wine ages well in proper conditions.
cn: 她的智慧随着年龄增长而来。
数字时代改变了沟通方式。
优质葡萄酒在适当条件下会陈化得更好。

en: She works for a government agency.
The new drug is testing the agency of the immune system.
The advertising agency won an award for its campaign.
cn: 她在一家政府机构工作。
这种新药正在测试免疫系统的能动性。
这家广告公司因其宣传活动获奖。

en: The real estate agent helped us find a perfect house.
Soap is a cleaning agent that removes dirt effectively.
Secret agents operate undercover to gather intelligence.
cn: 房产中介帮我们找到了理想的房子。
肥皂是一种能有效去污的清洁剂。
特工通过隐蔽行动收集情报。

en: His aggressive attitude often leads to conflicts.
She took an aggressive approach to solving the problem.
The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign.
cn: 他好斗的态度常引发冲突。
她以积极主动的方式解决问题。
公司发起了一场强势的营销活动。

definitions.definition: 以前，以往（用于表示过去的时间）

en: She left the company three years ago.
The train departed ten minutes ago.
Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.
cn: 她三年前离开了公司。
火车十分钟前开走了。
恐龙生活在数百万年前。

definitions.definition: 极度痛苦（身体或精神上的）

en: She screamed in agony as the pain overwhelmed her.
The team endured the agony of defeat in the final match.
His face reflected the agony of making an impossible choice.
cn: 痛苦席卷全身时，她发出了撕心裂肺的尖叫。
队伍在决赛中承受了失败的煎熬。
他的脸上写满了做出艰难抉择的痛苦。

en: We finally agreed on the terms of the contract.
She agreed to help me with the project.
The climate data agrees with the scientists' predictions.
cn: 我们最终就合同条款达成一致。
她同意协助我完成这个项目。
气候数据与科学家的预测相符。

en: The two companies signed a trade agreement.
There was broad agreement on the new policy.
His actions are not in agreement with his words.
cn: 两家公司签署了贸易协议。
对新政策达成了广泛共识。
他的言行不一。

en: Modern agriculture relies heavily on technology.
She studied sustainable agriculture in college.
The region's economy is based on agriculture.
cn: 现代农业高度依赖技术。
她在大学攻读可持续农业。
该地区经济以农业为基础。

en: The finish line is just 100 meters ahead.
She planned ahead to avoid last-minute stress.
Look ahead when driving to anticipate dangers.
cn: 终点线就在前方100米处。
她提前规划以避免临时压力。
开车时向前看以预判危险。

en: The nurse rushed to aid the injured man.
Visual aids can enhance classroom learning.
Developed countries often provide aid to poorer nations.
cn: 护士急忙救助那名受伤的男子。
视觉教具能提升课堂学习效果。
发达国家常向较贫穷国家提供援助。

en: Her aim is to become a doctor.
He aimed the camera at the sunset.
We must aim for excellence in our work.
cn: 她的目标是成为一名医生。
他将相机对准日落。
我们必须以卓越为目标开展工作。

en: The fresh air in the mountains cleared my mind.
She aired her grievances during the meeting.
The kite soared high in the air.
cn: 山间的清新空气让我头脑清醒。
她在会议上公开表达了不满。
风筝在空中高高翱翔。

definitions.definition: 航空器（包括飞机、直升机等）
飞行器（广义指任何能在空中飞行的机械装置）

en: The new aircraft can fly at twice the speed of sound.
Military aircraft are often equipped with advanced radar systems.
The museum displays historic aircraft from the early 20th century.
cn: 新型航空器的飞行速度可达音速的两倍。
军用飞行器通常配备先进的雷达系统。
博物馆展出了20世纪初的航空器历史藏品。

en: The airline offers direct flights to Tokyo.
Check the airline's website for baggage policies.
The new airline route connects two major cities.
cn: 这家航空公司提供直飞东京的航班。
查阅航空公司官网了解行李政策。
新航线连接了两座主要城市。

en: The airplane soared above the clouds.
She boarded an airplane for her first international trip.
Modern airplanes are designed for fuel efficiency.
cn: 飞机在云层上方翱翔。
她登上飞机，开启首次国际旅行。
现代飞机设计注重燃油效率。

definitions.definition: 机场（供飞机起降、停放及乘客登机的场所）

en: The new airport will reduce traffic congestion in the city center.
Passengers must arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
The airport was closed due to heavy fog.
cn: 新机场将缓解市中心的交通拥堵。
乘客须在起飞前两小时抵达机场。
机场因大雾关闭。

en: The fire alarm woke everyone at midnight.
She felt a sudden alarm when the lights went out.
The government alarmed the public with the new virus data.
cn: 火灾警报在午夜惊醒了所有人。
灯光熄灭时，她突然感到一阵惊慌。
政府公布的新病毒数据引发了公众恐慌。

en: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol completely.
This sanitizer contains 70% isopropyl alcohol.
Ancient Egyptians used alcohol as a solvent for perfumes.
cn: 医生建议他彻底戒酒。
这款消毒剂含70%异丙醇。
古埃及人用酒精作为香水的溶剂。

en: The twins look so alike that even their parents sometimes confuse them.
Great minds think alike, but fools seldom differ.
The teacher treated all students alike, regardless of their backgrounds.
cn: 这对双胞胎长得如此相像，连他们的父母有时也会弄混。
英雄所见略同，而愚者鲜有分歧。（谚语）
老师平等对待所有学生，不论其背景。

en: The doctors worked hard to keep the patient alive.
The city streets are alive with music during the festival.
She felt truly alive when she traveled to new places.
cn: 医生们努力让病人活下来。
节日期间，城市街道因音乐而充满生机。
当她去新地方旅行时，才感到真正充满活力。

en: All students must submit their assignments by Friday.
She was all smiles after hearing the good news.
Is that all you want to say?
cn: 所有学生必须在周五前提交作业。
听到好消息后，她满脸笑容。
这就是你想说的全部吗？

en: The teacher allowed us to leave early.
This ticket allows two people to enter.
She didn’t allow herself to cry.
cn: 老师允许我们提前离开。
这张票允许两人入场。
她不许自己哭出来。

definitions.definition: 合金（两种或多种金属的混合物）
将（金属）熔合成合金；掺杂（以改变性质）

en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
The gold was alloyed with silver to increase its hardness.
His happiness was alloyed with a hint of sadness.
cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。
黄金中掺入银以提高硬度。
他的快乐中掺杂着一丝忧伤。

en: She almost missed the train because of traffic.
The project is almost finished, just needing final touches.
His voice was so quiet I almost couldn't hear him.
cn: 她因为堵车差点错过火车。
项目已接近完成，只需最后收尾。
他的声音轻得我几乎听不见。

en: She prefers to work alone in the quiet library.
The old man lived alone in a small cottage by the sea.
Alone in the dark, he finally faced his deepest fears.
cn: 她更喜欢独自在安静的图书馆工作。
老人独自住在海边的小屋里。
独自处在黑暗中，他终于直面内心最深的恐惧。

en: We walked along the riverbank at sunset.
She brought her friends along to the party.
The project is coming along well.
cn: 我们在日落时分沿着河岸散步。
她带着朋友们一起参加了聚会。
项目进展顺利。

en: She read the poem aloud to the class.
He dared not say his thoughts aloud.
The audience laughed aloud at the joke.
cn: 她向全班大声朗读了这首诗。
他不敢公开说出自己的想法。
观众被笑话逗得放声大笑。

en: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
Children learn the alphabet before reading.
This book is the alphabet of economics.
cn: 英语字母表有26个字母。
孩子们在阅读前先学习字母表。
这本书是经济学的入门指南。

definitions.definition: 已经（表示动作或状态在某个时间点前完成）

en: She had already left when I arrived.
The tickets were already sold out by noon.
He's already finished his homework.
cn: 我到的时候她已经离开了。
中午前票就已售罄。
他早就做完作业了。

en: She speaks English and also knows French.
The package includes a guidebook and also a map.
He apologized and also offered to help.
cn: 她会说英语，也懂法语。
包裹里有一本指南，还有一张地图。
他道了歉，还主动提出帮忙。

en: The tailor altered the dress to fit her perfectly.
His perspective altered after traveling abroad.
The software allows users to alter the settings easily.
cn: 裁缝修改了裙子，使其完全合身。
出国旅行后，他的观点发生了变化。
该软件允许用户轻松调整设置。

definitions.definition: 可供选择的事物；替代方案

en: We need to find an alternative route due to the road closure.
She prefers alternative medicine like acupuncture.
The company is exploring alternatives to plastic packaging.
cn: 因道路封闭，我们需要另寻一条路线。
她更青睐针灸等替代疗法。
该公司正在探索塑料包装的替代方案。

definitions.definition: 尽管，虽然（用于引出让步状语从句）

en: Although it rained, we went hiking.
She smiled although she was tired.
Although small, the room felt cozy.
cn: 尽管下雨了，我们还是去徒步了。
她虽然很累，但仍保持着微笑。
房间虽小，却显得很舒适。

en: The airplane reached an altitude of 10,000 meters.
Her academic achievements put her at the altitude of excellence.
Mountain climbers must adapt to high altitudes.
cn: 飞机飞行高度达到一万米。
她的学术成就使她跻身卓越之列。
登山者必须适应高海拔环境。

en: The idea is altogether wrong.
Altogether, the project was a success.
There were ten people altogether at the meeting.
cn: 这个想法完全错了。
总而言之，这个项目是成功的。
会议上总共有十人。

definitions.definition: 铝（一种轻质、银白色的金属元素，符号为 Al，原子序数为 13）

en: Aluminium is widely used in packaging due to its lightweight and corrosion-resistant properties.
The frame of the modern bicycle is made entirely of aluminium alloy.
Recycling aluminium requires only 5% of the energy needed to produce it from raw materials.
cn: 铝因其轻质和耐腐蚀的特性被广泛应用于包装行业。
这辆现代自行车的车架完全由铝合金制成。
回收铝所需的能量仅占从原材料生产铝所需能量的 5%。

en: She always arrives 10 minutes early.
The sun always rises in the east.
He always forgets to turn off the lights.
cn: 她总是提前10分钟到达。
太阳永远从东方升起。
他老是忘记关灯。

en: The magician's tricks never fail to amaze the audience.
She was amazed by the sudden beauty of the sunset.
cn: 魔术师的表演总能令观众惊叹不已。
日落的突然之美让她感到震撼。

definitions.definition: 雄心，抱负（强烈的成功欲望）

en: Her ambition to become a scientist drove her to study day and night.
The project fulfilled his lifelong ambition.
Without ambition, one’s potential remains dormant.
cn: 她成为科学家的抱负驱使她日夜学习。
这个项目实现了他毕生的追求。
没有雄心，人的潜力将永远沉睡。

definitions.definition: 救护车（用于紧急医疗运输的车辆）

en: The ambulance arrived within minutes after the accident.
She works as a paramedic on a night-shift ambulance.
The siren of the ambulance alerted pedestrians to make way.
cn: 事故发生后，救护车几分钟内就赶到了。
她是一名救护车夜班急救员。
救护车的警笛声提醒行人让路。

en: She is proud of her American heritage.
The American economy shows strong growth this year.
Many American traditions blend influences from diverse cultures.
cn: 她为自己的美国血统感到自豪。
美国经济今年呈现强劲增长。
许多美国传统融合了多元文化的影响。

definitions.definition: 为…所共有（表示群体关系）

en: She found her keys among the books on the table.
The secret was shared among the team members.
Among all the candidates, he was the most qualified.
cn: 她在桌上的书堆里找到了钥匙。
这个秘密在团队成员间共享。
在所有候选人中，他是最符合条件的。

definitions.definition: 在……之中（与 among 同义，但更古旧或正式）

en: She found peace amongst the ancient trees.
The tradition persists amongst certain tribes.
He stood amongst the crowd, unnoticed.
cn: 她在古树丛中找到了宁静。
这一传统在某些部落中依然延续。
他站在人群中，无人察觉。

en: The total amount of donations exceeded our expectations.
His remarks amount to a refusal.
Small savings can amount to a large sum over time.
cn: 捐赠总额超出了我们的预期。
他的言论相当于拒绝。
小额储蓄长期累积可成为一大笔钱。

en: The current flowing through the circuit is 5 amperes.
One ampere is defined as the constant current that produces a force of 2×10⁻⁷ newton per meter between two parallel conductors.
This fuse is rated for 10 amperes of current.
cn: 电路中流过的电流为5安培。
安培被定义为在两个平行导线之间产生2×10⁻⁷牛顿/米作用力的恒定电流。
这根保险丝的额定电流为10安培。

definitions.definition: 放大（声音、信号等）；增强（效果或情感）

en: The microphone can amplify even the faintest sounds.
She used statistics to amplify her argument.
The writer amplified the short story into a novel.
cn: 这台麦克风能放大最微弱的声音。
她用统计数据来增强论点的说服力。
作者将短篇故事扩展成了一部长篇小说。

en: The clown’s antics amused the children.
She amused herself by reading novels during the flight.
His sarcastic remarks were meant to amuse, but they offended some.
cn: 小丑的滑稽动作逗乐了孩子们。
她在飞行途中通过读小说消遣。
他的讽刺言论本为逗趣，却冒犯了某些人。

en: Scientists analyse the data to find patterns.
The teacher asked us to analyse the poem line by line.
This tool helps analyse complex financial reports.
cn: 科学家分析数据以寻找规律。
老师让我们逐行分析这首诗。
这个工具用于解析复杂的财务报告。

definitions.definition: 分析（对事物的组成部分进行系统性研究）
解析（数学或逻辑中的分解过程）

en: The lab conducted a detailed analysis of the water samples.
His analysis of the poem revealed hidden metaphors.
In mathematics, Fourier analysis breaks down complex waves into simpler components.
cn: 实验室对水样进行了详细分析。
他对这首诗的分析揭示了隐含的隐喻。
数学中，傅里叶分析将复杂波形分解为更简单的成分。

definitions.definition: （动植物）原种；（机器、思想等的）原型

en: My ancestors came from a small village in Ireland.
This fossil may be the ancestor of modern birds.
The invention is considered the ancestor of all smartphones.
cn: 我的祖先来自爱尔兰的一个小村庄。
这块化石可能是现代鸟类的祖先。
这项发明被视为所有智能手机的原型。

definitions.definition: 抛锚固定；使稳固；担任主持人

en: The ship dropped anchor in the bay.
She anchored the news program for a decade.
His faith anchored him during the crisis.
cn: 船只在海湾抛锚。
她担任该新闻节目主持人十年。
他的信念在危机中给了他支撑。

definitions.definition: 古代人（尤指古埃及/希腊/罗马人）

en: The archaeologists discovered an ancient temple buried under the sand.
In ancient times, people believed the Earth was flat.
This manuscript contains wisdom from the ancients.
cn: 考古学家发现了一座埋在沙下的古老神庙。
在古代，人们认为地球是平的。
这份手稿记载了古人的智慧。

en: She bought apples and oranges.
He finished his work and went home.
Two and two make four.
cn: 她买了苹果和橙子。
他完成工作后回家了。
二加二等于四。

en: The painting depicts an angel with golden wings.
She has the patience of an angel with her students.
According to the Bible, an angel appeared to Mary.
cn: 这幅画描绘了一位长着金色翅膀的天使。
她对学生有着天使般的耐心。
据《圣经》记载，一位天使曾向玛丽亚显现。

en: She couldn't hide her anger when she saw the broken vase.
His rude comments angered the entire audience.
The protest was fueled by public anger over corruption.
cn: 看到破碎的花瓶时，她无法掩饰怒火。
他粗鲁的言论激怒了全场观众。
这场抗议源于公众对腐败的愤慨。

en: The two lines intersect at a right angle.
Let’s approach the problem from a different angle.
He angled his boat toward the deeper water.
cn: 两条线以直角相交。
让我们从不同角度处理这个问题。
他将船斜向驶向更深的水域。

en: She was angry when her project was criticized without reason.
The angry sky warned of an approaching storm.
His knee became angry and swollen after the fall.
cn: 她因项目被无故批评而愤怒。
阴沉愤怒的天空预示着暴风雨将至。
摔倒后，他的膝盖红肿发炎。

definitions.definition: 动物（区别于植物或人类）

en: The zoo houses over 500 species of animals.
His cruelty revealed the animal within him.
Plants and animals depend on each other for survival.
cn: 动物园里有500多种动物。
他的残忍暴露了他内心的兽性。
植物和动物相互依存以维持生存。

en: She twisted her ankle while hiking.
The bracelet hung loosely around her ankle.
Ankle injuries are common in basketball.
cn: 她在徒步时扭伤了脚踝。
手链松松地挂在她脚踝上。
脚踝受伤在篮球运动中很常见。

en: The mayor will announce the new policy tomorrow.
The host announced the winner with excitement.
The company announced a merger with its competitor.
cn: 市长将于明日宣布新政策。
主持人激动地宣布了获胜者。
该公司宣布与竞争对手合并。

en: The radio announcer spoke clearly during the live broadcast.
She worked as a stadium announcer for major sports events.
The announcer’s voice echoed through the train station.
cn: 电台播音员在直播中口齿清晰。
她曾担任大型体育赛事的现场播报员。
播音员的声音在火车站内回荡。

en: The constant noise began to annoy the neighbors.
Don’t annoy the bees or they might sting you.
His habit of interrupting people is truly annoying.
cn: 持续的噪音开始惹恼邻居。
别招惹蜜蜂，否则它们可能蜇你。
他打断别人的习惯实在令人厌烦。

en: The company holds an annual meeting to review its performance.
She subscribes to a gardening annual for plant care tips.
The festival is an annual event that attracts thousands of visitors.
cn: 公司每年召开会议回顾业绩。
她订阅了一本园艺年刊以获取植物养护建议。
这个节日是一年一度的活动，吸引了数千名游客。

en: She finished her coffee and asked for another.
This pen doesn't work – try another one.
He's moving to another city next month.
cn: 她喝完咖啡后又要了一杯。
这支笔坏了，试试另一支吧。
他下个月要搬到另一个城市去。

en: She didn't give me a clear answer.
Can you answer the phone, please?
The answer to the math problem is 42.
cn: 她没有给我明确的答复。
你能接一下电话吗？
这道数学题的答案是42。

en: The ant carried a crumb twice its size.
Ant colonies exhibit highly organized social behavior.
She observed the ants marching in a straight line.
cn: 蚂蚁搬运了一块比它体型大两倍的面包屑。
蚂蚁群落展现出高度组织化的社会行为。
她观察到蚂蚁排成直线行进。

en: The team tried to anticipate potential problems before launching the project.
She anticipated his request by preparing the documents in advance.
Economists anticipate a rise in inflation next year.
cn: 团队在启动项目前试图预判潜在问题。
她提前准备好文件，预见到了他的需求。
经济学家预计明年通胀会上升。

definitions.definition: 焦虑，忧虑（强烈的紧张或不安情绪）
渴望，热望（古义，现代较少用）

en: Her anxiety about the exam kept her awake all night.
The uncertainty of the future filled him with quiet anxiety.
In medieval texts, "anxiety" sometimes referred to a longing for divine connection.
cn: 她对考试的焦虑让她整夜未眠。
未来的不确定性让他陷入无声的忧虑。
在中世纪文献中，“anxiety”偶指对神性联结的渴慕。

en: She felt anxious before her job interview.
The anxious parents waited for news of their missing child.
His anxious tone revealed his hidden fears.
cn: 她在面试前感到焦虑。
焦急的父母等待着失踪孩子的消息。
他不安的语气暴露了内心的恐惧。

definitions.definition: 略微；丝毫（用于否定句或疑问句）

en: You can choose any book from the shelf.
Is there any milk left in the fridge?
She didn't show any interest in the proposal.
cn: 你可以从书架上任选一本书。
冰箱里还有牛奶吗？
她对这项提议毫无兴趣。

definitions.definition: 任何人（用于疑问句、否定句或条件句）
重要人物（用于肯定句，常含讽刺意味）

en: Does anybody know the answer?
I didn't see anybody in the room.
If he thinks he's anybody, he's mistaken.
cn: 有人知道答案吗？
我没看见房间里有任何人。
如果他认为自己是个大人物，那他就错了。

definitions.definition: 无论如何，不管怎样（表示强调或总结）

en: Anyhow, let's finish the task by noon.
He piled the books anyhow on the shelf.
Anyhow, it's not your fault.
cn: 无论如何，我们中午前完成任务。
他把书胡乱堆在架子上。
总之，这不是你的错。

definitions.definition: 重要人物（用于疑问句或否定句，如 "Is anyone there?"）

en: Anyone can join the workshop if they're interested.
Is anyone responsible for this project?
She didn't tell anyone about her decision.
cn: 任何感兴趣的人都可以加入这个工作坊。
有人负责这个项目吗？
她没有把自己的决定告诉任何人。

definitions.definition: 任何事物（用于否定句、疑问句或条件句）

en: You can ask me anything.
Is there anything left in the fridge?
She wouldn’t trade it for anything.
cn: 你可以问我任何问题。
冰箱里还有东西吗？
她绝不会用这东西交换任何其他事物。

definitions.definition: 无论如何（用于强调或转换话题）

en: I don’t agree with you, but I’ll help anyway.
It was raining, but we went out anyway.
Anyway, let’s get back to the main topic.
cn: 我不同意你的观点，但无论如何我会帮忙。
当时在下雨，但我们还是出门了。
总之，我们回到正题吧。

en: You can sit anywhere you like.
Is there anywhere quiet to study here?
She could be anywhere in the world right now.
cn: 你可以坐在任何你喜欢的地方。
这里有安静的地方可以学习吗？
她现在可能在世界上的任何一个地方。

definitions.definition: 分离的（仅用于表语，如 "feel apart"）

en: The two buildings stand 50 meters apart.
She tore the paper apart angrily.
Their opinions are worlds apart.
cn: 两栋建筑相距50米。
她愤怒地把纸撕成碎片。
他们的观点天差地别。

en: She rents a small apartment downtown.
The apartment has a beautiful view of the park.
They converted the old house into three apartments.
cn: 她在市中心租了一间小公寓。
这套公寓能俯瞰公园的美景。
他们将老房子改造成三套公寓。

en: She apologized for being late.
He refused to apologize for his mistake.
The company apologized publicly after the scandal.
cn: 她为迟到道歉。
他拒绝为自己的错误道歉。
丑闻后，该公司公开致歉。

definitions.definition: 道歉；正式的辩解或辩护

en: She made a sincere apology for her mistake.
His speech was an apology for free speech.
The company issued a public apology after the scandal.
cn: 她为她的错误真诚道歉。
他的演讲是对言论自由的辩护。
丑闻发生后，公司发表了公开致歉。

definitions.definition: 器械，设备（指用于特定目的的复杂工具或机器）
机构，组织（尤指政府或官僚体系中的）

en: The laboratory purchased new apparatus for DNA analysis.
The state apparatus responded slowly to the crisis.
The firefighter’s breathing apparatus saved his life.
cn: 实验室购置了新的DNA分析设备。
国家机构对危机的反应迟缓。
消防员的呼吸装置救了他的命。

en: The solution to the problem was apparent after careful analysis.
Her apparent indifference hid a deep concern.
The stars are apparent in the night sky.
cn: 仔细分析后，问题的解决方案显而易见。
她表面上的冷漠隐藏着深切的关心。
星星在夜空中清晰可见。

en: The charity made an appeal for donations.
She decided to appeal the court’s decision.
His idea has great appeal to young audiences.
cn: 该慈善机构呼吁捐款。
她决定对法庭判决提出上诉。
他的想法对年轻观众很有吸引力。

en: A faint light appeared on the horizon.
She appears to be unhappy with the decision.
The solution will appear if you wait patiently.
cn: 地平线上出现了一道微弱的光。
她似乎对这个决定不太满意。
耐心等待，解决方案自会显现。

en: Her elegant appearance caught everyone's attention.
The sudden appearance of the sun lifted our spirits.
He made a brief appearance at the party before leaving.
cn: 她优雅的外表吸引了所有人的注意。
太阳的突然出现振奋了我们的精神。
他在派对上短暂露面后就离开了。

en: The walk gave me a good appetite.
She has an insatiable appetite for adventure.
Spicy food can stimulate your appetite.
cn: 散步让我胃口大开。
她对冒险有着永不满足的渴望。
辛辣食物能刺激食欲。

en: She packed an apple in her lunchbox.
The apple tree blossomed in spring.
This pie is made with Granny Smith apples.
cn: 她在午餐盒里装了一个苹果。
苹果树在春天开花。
这个派是用青苹果做的。

definitions.definition: 器具，装置（尤指家用电器）
应用，适用（古义，现较少用）

en: The store sells a wide range of kitchen appliances, from blenders to microwaves.
Modern medical appliances have significantly improved patient care.
The appliance of this theory requires careful consideration.
cn: 这家商店出售各种厨房电器，从搅拌机到微波炉。
现代医疗设备极大地改善了患者护理。
这一理论的应用需要仔细考量。（古义例句）

en: This rule is not applicable to overseas students.
The theory is widely applicable in social sciences.
Ensure the software is applicable to your operating system.
cn: 这条规则不适用于留学生。
该理论在社会科学中广泛适用。
确保该软件兼容你的操作系统。

en: She submitted an application for the scholarship.
This technology has practical applications in medicine.
The application of the ointment should be gentle.
cn: 她提交了奖学金申请。
该技术在医学上有实际应用。
涂抹药膏时应轻柔。

en: She applied sunscreen before going to the beach.
This law applies to all citizens equally.
He applied for a scholarship at Harvard.
cn: 她去海滩前涂抹了防晒霜。
这项法律平等适用于所有公民。
他申请了哈佛大学的奖学金。

en: The board will appoint a new CEO next week.
We need to appoint a time for the meeting.
She was appointed ambassador to France.
cn: 董事会将于下周任命新任首席执行官。
我们需要约定会议时间。
她被任命为驻法国大使。

en: I have a dental appointment at 3 PM.
Her appointment as CEO surprised everyone.
The doctor’s office requires appointments in advance.
cn: 我下午三点有个牙科预约。
她被任命为CEO的消息令所有人惊讶。
这家诊所需要提前预约。

en: We deeply appreciate your timely help.
The property has appreciated by 20% in five years.
She appreciates fine art and often visits galleries.
cn: 我们非常感激您的及时帮助。
该房产五年内增值了20%。
她欣赏艺术，常去画廊参观。

en: The plane is now approaching the runway.
We need a new approach to solve this problem.
She approached the topic with caution.
cn: 飞机正在接近跑道。
我们需要新方法来解决这个问题。
她谨慎地着手处理这一话题。

en: The teacher used appropriate examples to explain the concept.
The government appropriated funds for the new hospital.
His casual clothes were not appropriate for the formal event.
cn: 老师用恰当的例子解释了这个概念。
政府为新建医院拨出了专项资金。
他的休闲着装不适合这场正式活动。

en: The project cannot proceed without official approval.
She nodded in approval of his decision.
The new policy gained widespread public approval.
cn: 该项目未经正式批准不得推进。
她点头赞同他的决定。
新政策获得了广泛的公众支持。

definitions.definition: 赞成（常与 of 连用）

en: The committee approved the new policy unanimously.
She doesn’t approve of his lifestyle.
The FDA approved the drug after rigorous testing.
cn: 委员会一致通过了新政策。
她不认同他的生活方式。
美国食品药品监督管理局在严格测试后批准了该药物。

en: The approximate cost of the project is $50,000.
Scientists approximate the age of the fossil to be 10,000 years.
Her description was only approximate, but it helped us locate the area.
cn: 该项目成本约为5万美元。
科学家推测该化石年龄接近1万年。
她的描述只是大致准确，但帮助我们锁定了区域。

en: The project will take approximately three months to complete.
The temperature is approximately 25 degrees Celsius.
The population of the city is approximately 1.2 million.
cn: 这个项目大约需要三个月完成。
温度大约为25摄氏度。
该城市人口约为120万。

en: Cherry blossoms usually bloom in April.
The conference is scheduled for April 15th.
April showers bring May flowers.
cn: 樱花通常在四月盛开。
会议定于4月15日举行。
四月雨带来五月花（谚语：先苦后甜）。

en: The Arabian Peninsula is rich in oil reserves.
She owns a purebred Arabian horse.
Arabian culture has influenced many regions through trade.
cn: 阿拉伯半岛石油储量丰富。
她拥有一匹纯种阿拉伯马。
阿拉伯文化通过贸易影响了众多地区。

en: The decision seemed completely arbitrary.
Arbitrary rules often frustrate creativity.
The king exercised arbitrary power over his subjects.
cn: 这一决定显得完全武断。
专断的规则常扼杀创造力。
国王对臣民行使专制权力。

en: The cathedral is a masterpiece of Gothic architecture.
Modern architecture often prioritizes sustainability.
The software’s architecture allows for easy upgrades.
cn: 这座大教堂是哥特式建筑的杰作。
现代建筑常以可持续性为核心。
该软件的体系结构便于升级。

en: The picnic area is shaded by tall trees.
She specializes in the area of environmental law.
Calculate the area of the rectangle in square meters.
cn: 野餐区被高大的树木遮蔽。
她专攻环境法领域。
以平方米为单位计算这个矩形的面积。

en: They often argue about politics.
The lawyer argued the case persuasively.
She argued that the policy was unfair.
cn: 他们经常争论政治问题。
律师有力地论证了案件。
她主张该政策不公平。

en: His argument against the policy was well-researched.
They had a heated argument about politics.
The lawyer presented a strong argument in court.
cn: 他对该政策的反对论点研究充分。
他们就政治问题发生了激烈争论。
律师在法庭上提出了有力的论据。

definitions.definition: 出现，发生（尤指问题或情况）

en: New challenges may arise during the project.
He arose early to watch the sunrise.
A dispute arose over the ownership of the land.
cn: 项目中可能出现新的挑战。
他早早起床去看日出。
关于土地所有权的问题引发了争执。

definitions.definition: 算术（数学分支，研究数字的基本运算）

en: Children learn basic arithmetic in primary school.
The arithmetic mean of 4 and 6 is 5.
His arithmetic skills helped him solve the problem quickly.
cn: 孩子们在小学学习基础算术。
4和6的算术平均数是5。
他的算术能力帮助他快速解决了问题。

en: She broke her arm while skating.
The country is arming its borders.
The museum displays medieval arms and armor.
cn: 她在滑冰时摔断了手臂。
该国正在武装其边境。
博物馆展出了中世纪的武器和盔甲。

en: The army was deployed to maintain peace in the region.
She faced an army of reporters after the announcement.
Ants work like a tiny but highly organized army.
cn: 军队被部署到该地区维护和平。
声明发布后，她面对一大群记者。
蚂蚁像一支微小但高度组织化的军队般工作。

en: She tied a scarf around her neck.
The children ran around the playground.
It costs around $20.
cn: 她在脖子上围了一条围巾。
孩子们在操场上跑来跑去。
这大约值20美元。

en: The speech aroused strong emotions in the audience.
The smell of coffee aroused him from his deep sleep.
Her research aroused interest in environmental issues.
cn: 演讲激起了听众强烈的情绪。
咖啡的气味将他从沉睡中唤醒。
她的研究引发了人们对环境问题的关注。

en: She helped arrange the flowers for the wedding.
We need to arrange a meeting to discuss the project.
The books are arranged alphabetically by author.
cn: 她帮忙为婚礼布置花束。
我们需要安排一次会议讨论这个项目。
这些书按作者姓氏字母顺序排列。

en: The flower arrangement on the table was exquisite.
This piano arrangement of the symphony is innovative.
They reached a mutual arrangement about the schedule.
cn: 桌上的插花布置非常精美。
这首交响曲的钢琴改编版很有创新性。
他们就日程达成了共同协议。

他敏锐地意识到了其中的风险。

en: She walked away without saying goodbye.
The birds flew away from the storm.
The team won three away games this season.
cn: 她一言不发地离开了。

该队本赛季赢得了三场客场比赛。

en: The earthquake left an awful scene of destruction.
She felt awful after forgetting her best friend's birthday.
That's an awful lot of work for one person!
cn: 地震后留下一片可怕的废墟。
她因忘记挚友生日而感到非常糟糕。
对一个人来说，这工作量也太大了！

definitions.definition: 糟糕地（古旧或讽刺用法）

en: The coffee was awfully bitter this morning.
She's awfully talented at playing the piano.
"You're awfully quiet today," he remarked.
cn: 今早的咖啡苦得离谱。
她钢琴弹得极其出色。

The handle is awkward to grip.
She gave an awkward apology.
cn: 他在正式晚宴上感到局促不安。
这个把手很难握持。

cn: 他用一把锋利的斧头劈柴。
公司决定裁撤业绩不佳的部门。
石器时代的工具包括燧石制成的简易斧头。

definitions.definition: 轴；轴线（数学、物理中的中心线或旋转线）
坐标轴（图表中的参考线）

cn: 地球每24小时绕地轴旋转一周。

德国、意大利和日本在二战期间组成轴心国。

en: The baby is sleeping peacefully in the crib.

cn: 婴儿在摇篮里安静地睡着。

她开着一辆淡蓝色的敞篷车。

en: She leaned against the back of the chair.
The back door leads to the garden.
He promised to back my proposal in the meeting.
cn: 她靠在椅背上。
后门通向花园。
他承诺在会议上支持我的提案。

definitions.definition: 背景（指环境、经历或幕后情况）

The negotiations took place against a background of political tension.
cn: 群山为村庄构成了美丽的背景。
她有计算机科学的专业背景。
谈判在政治紧张的氛围下进行。

The country's technology was backward compared to its neighbors.
She glanced backward over her shoulder before leaving.
cn: 他向后退了一步避开水坑。
该国的技术相较于邻国较为落后。
离开前，她回头瞥了一眼。

definitions.definition: 细菌（复数形式，单数为 bacterium）

The lab is studying antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
Bacteria multiply rapidly in warm environments.
cn: 某些细菌对人类消化有益。
实验室正在研究抗药性细菌。
细菌在温暖环境中快速繁殖。

definitions.definition: 质量差的；有害的；糟糕的

en: The milk smells bad; it must be expired.
Stealing is a bad behavior.
He had a bad day at work.
cn: 牛奶闻起来坏了，肯定过期了。
偷窃是不道德的行为。
他今天工作不顺。

en: The car was badly damaged in the accident.
She wanted the job badly, but didn’t get it.
He plays the piano badly but with enthusiasm.
cn: 事故中这辆车严重受损。
她非常想要这份工作，但未能如愿。
他钢琴弹得很糟，但充满热情。

en: Badminton requires agility and precise hand-eye coordination.
She won a gold medal in mixed doubles badminton at the Olympics.
The shuttlecock used in badminton has sixteen feathers fixed in a cork base.
cn: 羽毛球运动需要敏捷性和精准的手眼协调能力。
她在奥运会羽毛球混合双打项目中赢得了金牌。
羽毛球运动中使用的毽球有十六根羽毛固定在软木底座上。

en: She packed her lunch in a paper bag.
The hunter managed to bag a deer.
Don't forget your gym bag after class.
cn: 她把午餐装进了纸袋。
猎人成功捕获了一头鹿。
下课后别忘了你的健身包。

definitions.definition: 行李（尤指旅行时携带的箱包物品）

en: The airline allows each passenger to check two pieces of baggage.
She carried the emotional baggage of her past relationships.
Custom officers inspected his baggage at the border.
cn: 该航空公司允许每位乘客托运两件行李。
她背负着过去恋情的情感包袱。
海关官员在边境检查了他的行李。

en: She bakes fresh bread every morning.
The clay needs to bake in the sun for two days.
It's so hot outside, I feel like I'm baking!
cn: 她每天早晨烤新鲜面包。
黏土需在阳光下晒两天。
外面太热了，我感觉像在被烘烤！

en: She walked carefully to maintain her balance on the icy path.
The company’s financial balance showed a profit this quarter.
He tried to balance work and family life.
cn: 她在结冰的小路上小心行走以保持平衡。
公司本季度的财务余额显示盈利。
他努力在工作和家庭生活之间取得平衡。

en: The children played with a red ball in the park.
She wore a stunning gown to the royal ball.
He balled the clay into a perfect sphere.
cn: 孩子们在公园里玩一个红色的球。
她穿着华丽的礼服参加皇家舞会。
他把黏土捏成一个完美的球体。

Hot air balloons floated over the valley at dawn.
Company debts ballooned after the failed expansion.
cn: 孩子将气球放飞到空中。
黎明时分，热气球飘荡在山谷上空。
公司债务在扩张失败后激增。

en: She peeled the banana and handed it to the child.
Banana plants thrive in tropical climates.
The smoothie was made with frozen bananas and almond milk.
cn: 她剥开香蕉，递给孩子。
香蕉树在热带气候中生长茂盛。
这款冰沙由冷冻香蕉和杏仁奶制成。

The band played their new single at the concert.
They banded together to protest the new law.
cn: 她用橡皮筋扎起头发。
乐队在音乐会上演奏了新单曲。
他们联合起来抗议新法规。

She banged the table in anger.
Her straight bangs perfectly framed her face.
cn: 门砰的一声关上了。
她愤怒地猛拍桌子。
她的齐刘海完美修饰了脸型。

en: She works at a bank in downtown London.
The children played on the grassy bank of the river.
He decided to bank his savings instead of keeping cash at home.
cn: 她在伦敦市中心的一家银行工作。
孩子们在长满青草的河岸上玩耍。

cn: 抗议者举着写有“为所有人争取正义”的横幅。
该公司的新产品成为行业创新的代表。
她赢得了冠军，使今年成为她职业生涯的标志性一年。

definitions.definition: 酒吧；条状物；障碍；法庭围栏

The law bars discrimination based on gender.
cn: 他在酒吧点了一杯酒。
窗户装有铁条以保安全。

cn: 理发师精心修剪了他的胡须。

她为狗狗修剪了毛发以度过夏天。

她向治疗师袒露心声。

cn: 狗对着陌生人大声吠叫。

从根本上说（表示本质或基础）

cn: 她术后几乎无法忍受疼痛。

cn: 狮子常被称为万兽之王。

cn: 她在跳蚤市场的一个摊位卖手工珠宝。
他走进投票间投下选票。
派对上的拍照亭大受欢迎。

en: The river forms a natural border between the two countries.
Her dress was bordered with delicate lace.
The park borders the university campus to the east.
cn: 这条河流构成了两国之间的天然边界。
她的裙子镶着精致的蕾丝边。
公园东侧与大学校园接壤。

definitions.definition: 令人厌烦的人或事；孔洞

en: The lecture bored the students to tears.
They used a drill to bore a hole in the wall.
He’s such a bore with his endless golf stories.
cn: 这场讲座让学生们无聊到流泪。
他们用钻头在墙上打了个孔。
他那些没完没了的高尔夫故事真让人厌烦。

en: She was born in Paris in 1990.
He is a born musician with perfect pitch.
The responsibility must be born by the whole team.
cn: 她1990年出生于巴黎。
他是个有绝对音感的天生音乐家。
这一责任必须由整个团队承担。

en: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
Many languages borrow words from English.
He borrowed heavily from classical philosophy in his thesis.
cn: 我能借你的笔用一下吗？
许多语言从英语中借用词汇。
他的论文大量借鉴了古典哲学思想。

en: She held the letter close to her bosom.
He is a bosom friend I can trust with my secrets.
The valley lay bosomed among the mountains.
cn: 她将信紧紧贴在胸前。
他是可以托付秘密的挚友。
山谷被群山环抱。

en: She asked her boss for a raise.
He loves bossing people around.
The project boss ensured everything ran smoothly.
cn: 她向老板提出加薪请求。
他喜欢对人发号施令。
项目负责人确保一切顺利进行。

en: Both candidates presented strong arguments.
She held the bag in both hands.
Both of us agreed to the plan.
cn: 两位候选人都提出了有力的论点。
她用双手提着包。
我们双方都同意了该计划。

en: Don't bother your sister while she's studying.
It bothers me when people are late.
He didn't even bother to reply.
cn: 你姐姐学习时别打扰她。
人们迟到会让我很烦恼。
他连回复都懒得费心。

en: She filled the bottle with fresh lemonade.
This wine is best enjoyed when bottled young.
He recycled all the glass bottles after the party.
cn: 她将瓶子装满新鲜的柠檬水。
这款葡萄酒适合年轻时装瓶饮用。
派对后他回收了所有玻璃瓶。

en: The ship sank to the bottom of the ocean.
She found her keys at the bottom of her bag.
His name was at the bottom of the list.
cn: 船只沉到了海底。
她在包的最底下找到了钥匙。
他的名字在名单末尾。

definitions.definition: 树枝（尤指粗大的主枝或分叉枝）

en: The owl perched on a sturdy bough, scanning the forest floor.
Snow clung to every bough of the pine tree after the storm.
He carved his initials into the bough of the old oak.
cn: 猫头鹰停在一根粗壮的树枝上，扫视着森林地面。
暴风雪后，松树的每根枝条都覆满了积雪。
他将自己名字的首字母刻在那棵老橡树的粗枝上。

en: The ball bounced off the wall and landed in the garden.
Her energy and bounce made her a great team leader.
The bank bounced his check due to insufficient funds.
cn: 球从墙上弹起，落进了花园。
她的活力和干劲使她成为优秀的团队领导。
银行因资金不足退回了他的支票。

definitions.definition: 受约束的；必然的；准备前往（某地）的

en: The athlete bounded over the hurdle with ease.
Our research is bound by ethical guidelines.
She's bound for Tokyo next week.
cn: 运动员轻松跃过跨栏。
我们的研究受伦理准则约束。
她下周将前往东京。

en: The river forms a natural boundary between the two countries.
Scientists are pushing the boundaries of quantum computing.
Respect personal boundaries in professional relationships.
cn: 这条河流是两国之间的天然边界。
科学家们正在突破量子计算的界限。
在职业关系中尊重个人界限。

en: She tied the ribbon into a neat bow.
The violinist adjusted the bow before playing.
People bow to show respect in some cultures.
cn: 她把丝带系成一个整齐的蝴蝶结。
小提琴手在演奏前调整了琴弓。
在某些文化中，人们通过鞠躬表示尊敬。

en: She served the soup in a ceramic bowl.
He bowled a perfect game last night.
The valley is shaped like a giant bowl.
cn: 她用陶瓷碗盛汤。
他昨晚打出了一场完美的保龄球比赛。
这个山谷呈巨大的碗状。

en: She packed the books into a cardboard box.
We reserved a box at the theater.
He learned to box at the local gym.
cn: 她把书装进纸箱。
我们预定了剧院的包厢。
他在当地健身房学习拳击。

en: The boy is playing football in the park.
He's just a boy trying to figure out life.
"Good job, boy!" the coach patted his shoulder.
cn: 男孩正在公园里踢足球。
他只是个试图弄懂生活的年轻人。
“干得好，小伙子！”教练拍了拍他的肩膀。

en: The human brain is highly complex.
She has a brilliant brain for mathematics.
cn: 人类大脑极为复杂。
她拥有数学方面的卓越智慧。

en: She slammed on the brakes to avoid hitting the deer.
The economic crisis acted as a brake on company expansion.
Ferns and bracken grew thickly in the damp brake.
cn: 她猛踩刹车以避免撞到鹿。
经济危机成为公司扩张的阻碍。
蕨类植物在潮湿的灌木丛中茂密生长。

en: The bird built its nest on a high branch of the oak tree.
The company plans to open a new branch in Shanghai next year.
The river branches into two smaller streams near the village.
cn: 这只鸟在橡树的高枝上筑巢。
该公司计划明年在上海开设一家新分部。
这条河在村庄附近分岔成两条小溪。

en: This brand is known for its eco-friendly products.
The cattle were branded with the ranch's symbol.
His past mistakes branded him as unreliable.
cn: 这个品牌以环保产品著称。
牛群被打上牧场的烙印标记。
他过去的错误让他被贴上了不可靠的标签。

definitions.definition: 白兰地（一种由葡萄酒或其他水果酒蒸馏制成的烈酒）

en: He sipped a glass of aged brandy after dinner.
Brandy is often used in cooking to enhance flavors.
The cellar stored barrels of fine French brandy.
cn: 晚餐后，他啜饮了一杯陈年白兰地。
白兰地常被用于烹饪以提升风味。
酒窖里存放着数桶优质法国白兰地。

en: The doorknob was made of polished brass.
He plays trumpet in the brass section of the orchestra.
She had the brass to ask for a promotion after only one month.
cn: 门把手由抛光的黄铜制成。
他在管弦乐队的铜管乐器组演奏小号。
她竟有脸在工作仅一个月后就要求升职。

en: She was brave enough to speak out against injustice.
Firefighters brave dangerous conditions to save lives.
His brave actions inspired the whole team.
cn: 她勇敢地站出来反对不公。
消防员冒着危险拯救生命。
他的勇敢行为激励了整个团队。

en: She baked fresh bread every morning.
Bread and butter is his only income.
The scientist argued that art is the bread of the soul.
cn: 她每天早晨都烤新鲜面包。
卖面包黄油是他唯一的收入来源。
那位科学家认为艺术是灵魂的食粮。

definitions.definition: 宽度；广度（指物理或抽象范围的广泛性）

en: The river's breadth makes it difficult to cross.
His research covers an impressive breadth of topics.
We need to consider the breadth of implications before deciding.
cn: 这条河的宽度使其难以横渡。
他的研究涵盖了令人印象深刻的主题广度。
决策前需考虑影响的广泛性。

en: The vase will break if you drop it.
Let's take a break after two hours of work.
He didn't mean to break the rules.
cn: 如果你掉落花瓶，它会破碎。
工作两小时后我们休息一下吧。
他并非有意违反规则。

en: She prefers oatmeal for breakfast.
We breakfasted on fresh croissants by the Seine.
Skipping breakfast may affect your concentration.
cn: 她早餐喜欢喝燕麦粥。
我们在塞纳河边吃着新鲜牛角面包当早餐。
不吃早餐可能会影响注意力。

en: She held the baby close to her breast.
Chicken breast is a good source of lean protein.
He breasted the waves with determination.
cn: 她把婴儿紧抱在胸前。
鸡胸肉是优质瘦肉蛋白的来源。
他坚定地迎浪前行。

en: She took a deep breath before diving into the water.
The cold morning air carried the breath of pine trees.
His breath fogged up the window as he leaned closer.
cn: 她深吸一口气，然后潜入水中。
寒冷的晨风裹挟着松树的气息。
他凑近时，呼出的气让窗户蒙上了雾。

en: She closed her eyes and began to breathe deeply.
The doctor told him to breathe into the machine.
Don't breathe a word of this to anyone.
cn: 她闭上眼睛，开始深呼吸。
医生让他对着机器呼气。
这件事对谁都不要透露一个字。

en: Farmers breed cattle for high-quality meat.
Polar bears breed in the Arctic regions.
His lies will only breed distrust.
cn: 农民饲养牛以获取优质肉类。
北极熊在北极地区繁殖。
他的谎言只会滋生不信任。

en: A cool breeze rustled the leaves of the palm trees.
She breezed through the exam without any difficulty.
The curtains billowed in the afternoon breeze.
cn: 清凉的微风吹拂着棕榈树叶沙沙作响。
她轻松通过了考试，毫无压力。
窗帘在午后的微风中鼓动飘荡。

en: The house was built with red bricks.
He bricked up the old fireplace.
She handed me a brick of frozen spinach.
cn: 这座房子用红砖建造。
他用砖砌封了旧壁炉。
她递给我一块冷冻菠菜砖。

en: The Golden Gate Bridge is an iconic landmark in San Francisco.
We need to bridge the communication gap between departments.
He won three rounds of bridge at the club last night.
cn: 金门大桥是旧金山的地标性建筑。
我们需要弥合部门间的沟通鸿沟。
昨晚他在俱乐部赢了三局桥牌。

en: The meeting was deliberately kept brief.
She wrote a brief for the legal team.
The president was briefed on the security situation.
cn: 会议被刻意安排得很简短。
她为法律团队撰写了一份案情摘要。
总统听取了安全局势的简要汇报。

en: The bright sun lit up the entire valley.
She is one of the brightest students in her class.
His face brightened when he heard the good news.
cn: 明亮的阳光照亮了整个山谷。
她是班上最聪明的学生之一。
听到好消息时，他的脸上焕发出光彩。

en: She opened the curtains to brighten the room.
His smile brightened my day.
The sky brightened after the storm.
cn: 她拉开窗帘让房间变亮。
他的笑容让我一整天都心情愉快。
暴风雨过后，天空放晴了。

en: The stars were brilliant in the night sky.
She gave a brilliant performance in the competition.
His brilliant idea solved the problem instantly.
cn: 夜空中的星星璀璨夺目。
她在比赛中表现卓越。
他绝妙的主意立刻解决了问题。

en: The teacup was filled to the brim with fragrant jasmine tea.
She tilted her hat's brim to shield her eyes from the sun.
The river brimmed over after days of heavy rain.
cn: 茶杯里装满了芬芳的茉莉花茶，几乎溢出来。
她轻轻压低帽檐，遮挡刺眼的阳光。
连日暴雨后，河水漫过了堤岸。

en: Could you bring me a glass of water?
The new policy will bring significant changes.
Her speech brought tears to everyone's eyes.
cn: 你能给我带杯水吗？
新政策将带来重大变化。
她的演讲让所有人潸然泪下。

en: She walked at a brisk pace to catch the train.
The brisk morning air woke him up instantly.
He brisked up the meeting with a few jokes.
cn: 她步伐轻快地赶火车。
清晨清新的空气立刻让他清醒过来。
他用几个笑话让会议活跃起来。

en: The boar's bristles stood upright when it sensed danger.
She bristled at the unfair criticism.
Use a brush with stiff bristles to clean the grill.
cn: 野猪察觉危险时，鬃毛直立。
她对不公的批评感到愤怒。
用硬毛刷清洁烤架。

en: The British Museum houses artifacts from all over the world.
She has a distinct British accent.
The British are known for their love of tea.
cn: 大英博物馆收藏了来自全球的文物。
她有明显的英国口音。
英国人以其对茶的热爱而闻名。

en: The brittle branches snapped under the weight of the snow.
Her laughter was brittle, masking nervousness.
Old photographs become brittle with age.
cn: 脆弱的树枝在积雪重压下断裂。
她的笑声尖利，掩饰着紧张。
老照片随时间变得脆弱易损。

en: The river is too broad to swim across.
She has a broad knowledge of art history.
cn: 这条河太宽，游不过去。
她对艺术史有广泛的了解。

en: The radio station broadcasts news every hour.
She broadcast her opinions on social media.
The concert will be broadcast live worldwide.
cn: 这家电台每小时播报新闻。
她在社交媒体上公开表达观点。
这场音乐会将全球直播。

en: The broken vase lay in pieces on the floor.
She spoke in broken English, mixing words from her native language.
After the argument, their friendship felt irreparably broken.
cn: 破碎的花瓶碎片散落在地板上。
她用不流利的英语说话，夹杂着母语词汇。
争吵后，他们的友谊似乎无法挽回地破裂了。

en: The statue was cast in bronze over 200 years ago.
Her hair had a warm bronze tint under the sunlight.
He won a bronze medal in the Olympic Games.
cn: 这座雕像于200多年前用青铜铸造。
阳光下，她的头发泛着温暖的古铜色光泽。
他在奥运会上获得了一枚铜牌。

definitions.definition: （鸟类或昆虫的）一窝幼崽；一家的孩子们

en: The hen guarded her brood fiercely.
He brooded over the mistake for weeks.
A brood of children played in the yard.
cn: 母鸡凶狠地守护着她的一窝小鸡。
他为那个错误郁郁沉思了好几周。
一大家孩子在院子里玩耍。

definitions.definition: 容忍，忍受（常用于否定句）

en: The children played by the brook, skipping stones across the water.
She would brook no criticism of her decision.
A narrow brook winds through the forest, its sound soothing.
cn: 孩子们在小溪边玩耍，打水漂。
她不容忍任何人批评她的决定。
一条狭窄的小溪蜿蜒穿过森林，流水声令人平静。

en: She swept the floor with a wooden broom.
Bright yellow broom flowers covered the hillside.
He broomed the fallen leaves into a pile.
cn: 她用一把木扫帚打扫地板。
金黄色的金雀花铺满了山坡。
他把落叶扫成一堆。

en: He is my elder brother.
The monks addressed each other as brother.
We stand together as brothers in this struggle.
cn: 他是我的哥哥。
僧侣们以“兄弟”互称。
我们如兄弟般并肩奋斗。

en: She raised her brow in surprise.
The hiker stood at the brow of the hill, gazing at the valley below.
His furrowed brow showed deep concentration.
cn: 她惊讶地挑了挑眉毛。
徒步者站在山脊边缘，凝视下方的山谷。
他皱起的眉头显示出高度专注。

en: She wore a brown leather jacket.
The toast browned perfectly in the oven.
Brown is a common color for autumn leaves.
cn: 她穿了一件棕色皮夹克。
吐司在烤箱里烤成了完美的棕色。
棕色是秋叶的常见颜色。

en: She got a bruise on her knee after falling off the bike.
Handle the peaches gently to avoid bruising them.
His harsh words bruised her self-confidence.
cn: 她骑车摔倒后膝盖上有一块淤青。
轻拿轻放桃子，避免碰伤。
他刻薄的话语挫伤了她的自信心。

en: She dipped the brush into the paint.
A cat brushed against my leg.
We walked through a brush of wildflowers.
cn: 她把画笔浸入颜料中。
一只猫轻轻蹭过我的腿。
我们穿过一片野花丛。

en: The dictator ruled his country with brute force.
She was shocked by the brute honesty of his words.
The movie portrays nature as a brute antagonist.
cn: 这位独裁者以暴力统治他的国家。
他话语中赤裸的诚实让她震惊。
这部电影将自然描绘成野蛮的反派。

en: The children blew soap bubbles in the park.
The pot began to bubble as the water boiled.
His promises turned out to be just a bubble.
cn: 孩子们在公园里吹肥皂泡。
水沸腾时，锅开始冒泡。
他的承诺最终只是一场空。

definitions.definition: 用桶装运；急速移动（非正式）

en: She filled the bucket with water from the well.
The construction worker carried a bucket of cement.
He bucketed down the hill on his bike.
cn: 她用水井把桶装满水。
建筑工人提着一桶水泥。
他骑着自行车飞速冲下山坡。

en: The rose bush is covered in tiny buds.
Trees begin to bud in early spring.
Her talent for painting budded at a young age.
cn: 玫瑰丛上满是小小的花蕾。
树木在早春时节开始发芽。
她的绘画天赋在年幼时便已萌芽。

en: They plan to build a new school in the village.
Regular exercise helps build muscle strength.
Her slim build makes her a perfect dancer.
cn: 他们计划在村里建一所新学校。
定期锻炼有助于增强肌肉力量。
她纤细的体型使她成为出色的舞者。

en: The new office building has a modern design.
She studied building construction at university.
The building of the bridge took three years.
cn: 这座新办公楼设计现代。
她在大学学习建筑施工。
这座桥的建造耗时三年。

definitions.definition: 球茎（植物的地下贮藏器官）

en: Tulip bulbs should be planted in autumn.
She replaced the broken bulb in the lamp.
The chef used fresh fennel bulbs for the salad.
cn: 郁金香球茎需在秋季种植。
她更换了台灯里损坏的灯泡。
厨师用新鲜茴香球茎制作沙拉。

en: The bulk of the work was completed in just two days.
Buying in bulk can save you a lot of money.
The mountain bulked large against the evening sky.
cn: 这项工作的大部分在两天内就完成了。
批量购买能省不少钱。
暮色中，山峦显得格外巍峨。

definitions.definition: 公牛；雄性动物（如象、鲸等）

en: The farmer keeps a fierce bull in the pasture.
Investors turned bullish after the economic report.
He tried to bull his way through the crowd.
cn: 农夫在牧场养了一头凶猛的公牛。
经济报告发布后，投资者转为看涨。
他试图强行挤过人群。

en: The bullet ricocheted off the wall.
She highlighted the key points with bullet symbols.
The detective found a spent bullet at the crime scene.
cn: 子弹从墙上反弹。
她用圆点符号标出重点。
侦探在犯罪现场发现一枚用过的弹头。

definitions.definition: 一束，一串（如花朵、钥匙等）

en: She held a bunch of fresh lavender.
A bunch of kids were playing in the park.
He bunched the wires together with a rubber band.
cn: 她拿着一束新鲜的薰衣草。
一群孩子在公园里玩耍。
他用橡皮筋把电线捆成一束。

en: She tied the letters into a bundle with a ribbon.
The software comes bundled with free tutorials.
They bundled the kids into the car and drove off.
cn: 她用丝带把信件扎成一捆。
该软件附带免费教程捆绑销售。
他们匆忙把孩子塞进车里开走了。

en: The donkey struggled under the heavy burden of firewood.
She didn’t want to burden her family with her financial problems.
The burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
cn: 驴子艰难地驮着沉重的柴火。
她不想让家庭为她的财务问题烦恼。
举证责任在控方。

definitions.definition: 局；处；机构（如政府部门的分支机构）

en: She left the documents on her bureau.
cn: 她把文件留在了办公桌上。

en: The campfire will burn all night.
Be careful not to burn your fingers on the hot pan.
She suffered a minor burn while cooking.
cn: 篝火将整夜燃烧。
小心别被热锅烫伤手指。
她在做饭时受了轻微烫伤。

en: The balloon burst when it touched the thorn.
A burst of laughter came from the next room.
The dam burst after days of heavy rain.
cn: 气球碰到荆棘时突然爆裂。
隔壁传来一阵突然的笑声。
连日暴雨后，大坝决堤了。

en: They will bury the time capsule under the oak tree.
She tried to bury her sadness by working overtime.
Ancient cities were often buried by volcanic ash.
cn: 他们会把时间胶囊埋在橡树下。
她试图通过加班来忘却悲伤。
古城常被火山灰掩埋。

en: She takes the bus to work every morning.
The school buses the children from nearby villages.
The bus was delayed due to heavy traffic.
cn: 她每天早晨乘公交车上班。
学校用巴士接送附近村庄的孩子们。
公交车因交通拥堵而延误。

definitions.definition: （澳大利亚或非洲的）荒野地带

en: The rabbit hid in the thick bush.
He spent years exploring the Australian bush.
They bushed the fence with branches to block the wind.
cn: 兔子藏在茂密的灌木丛中。
他在澳大利亚荒野中探索了多年。
他们用树枝填充篱笆以阻挡寒风。

en: She runs a successful business in downtown.
The main business of the meeting was budget planning.
He combines creativity with sharp business acumen.
cn: 她在市中心经营一家成功的企业。
会议的主要事务是预算规划。
他将创造力与敏锐的商业头脑相结合。

definitions.definition: 使忙于（常见搭配：busy oneself with）

en: The café is always busy during lunch hours.
She busied herself with organizing the bookshelf.
His mind was too busy with worries to focus.
cn: 这家咖啡馆午餐时段总是很忙碌。
她忙着整理书架。
他心事重重，无法集中注意力。

en: She wanted to go, but it was raining.
Everyone but John attended the meeting.
He is but a child in this field.
cn: 她想出门，但当时正在下雨。
除约翰外所有人都参加了会议。
在这个领域里他仅仅是个新手。

en: The butcher sharpened his knives before opening the shop.
The film depicted the brutal butchering of innocent civilians.
He completely butchered the piano piece during the audition.
cn: 屠夫开店前磨好了刀。
这部电影描绘了对无辜平民的残酷屠杀。
试演时他把这首钢琴曲弹得一团糟。

en: She spread butter on the toast.
The recipe calls for unsalted butter.
He buttered the pan before frying eggs.
cn: 她在吐司上涂了黄油。
这个食谱需要无盐黄油。
他煎蛋前在锅里涂了黄油。

en: A butterfly landed softly on the flower.
She won the gold medal in the 100m butterfly.
The garden was full of colorful butterflies.
cn: 一只蝴蝶轻轻落在花朵上。
她在100米蝶泳比赛中获得金牌。
花园里飞舞着五彩斑斓的蝴蝶。

en: She fastened the top button of her coat.
Press the red button to start the machine.
His shirt was missing a button.
cn: 她扣上了外套最上面的纽扣。
按下红色按钮启动机器。
他的衬衫少了一颗纽扣。

en: She decided to buy a new laptop.
Happiness can't be bought with money.
That car was a great buy for the price.
cn: 她决定买一台新笔记本电脑。
幸福无法用金钱换取。
那辆车性价比很高。

definitions.definition: 在...旁边；通过（某种方式）；由（某人完成）；到（某时）之前

en: She stood by the window, watching the rain.
The book was written by a famous historian.
Please finish the work by Friday.
cn: 她站在窗边，望着雨。
这本书由一位著名历史学家撰写。
请在周五之前完成这项工作。

en: She grows organic cabbage in her backyard.
The soup is made with fresh cabbage and carrots.
cn: 她在后院种植有机卷心菜。
这道汤用新鲜的卷心菜和胡萝卜制成。

definitions.definition: 小屋（尤指简陋的木质结构）；船舱；机舱

en: They built a log cabin in the woods.
The pilot announced turbulence from the cabin.
She booked a cabin with a porthole view.
cn: 他们在森林里搭了一间木屋。
飞行员从机舱内播报了颠簸预警。
她预订了一间带舷窗视野的船舱。

definitions.definition: 内阁（政府高层官员组成的决策机构）
橱柜（带抽屉或门的储物家具）

en: The prime minister held a meeting with her cabinet.
He stored the porcelain in a glass-fronted cabinet.
The antique cabinet was carved from oak.
cn: 首相与内阁成员召开会议。
他将瓷器存放在玻璃门橱柜中。
这个古董橱柜由橡木雕刻而成。

en: The bridge is supported by steel cables.
They cabled the news to headquarters.
Fiber-optic cables transmit data at high speed.
cn: 这座桥由钢缆支撑。
他们向总部发送了电报。
光纤电缆能高速传输数据。

en: She works at a small cafe near the train station.
Let's meet at the cafe for breakfast tomorrow.
The cafe serves excellent espresso and pastries.
cn: 她在火车站附近的一家小咖啡馆工作。
我们明天在咖啡馆见面吃早餐吧。
这家咖啡馆提供上乘的浓缩咖啡和糕点。

definitions.definition: 自助餐厅（顾客自取食物的餐饮场所）

en: The university cafeteria offers a variety of healthy options.
We grabbed lunch at the hospital cafeteria.
The cafeteria was crowded during the lunch rush.
cn: 这所大学的自助餐厅提供多种健康选择。
我们在医院自助餐厅吃了午饭。
午餐高峰期时自助餐厅人满为患。

en: The bird fluttered inside its golden cage.
She felt caged by societal expectations.
The zoo built larger cages for the tigers.
cn: 鸟儿在金色的笼中扑腾。
她感觉被社会期望束缚。
动物园为老虎建造了更大的笼舍。

en: She baked a chocolate cake for the party.
The mud had caked on his boots after the hike.
The miners found a cake of gold in the riverbed.
cn: 她为聚会烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
徒步后，泥块在他的靴子上结成了硬壳。
矿工在河床中发现了一块天然金块。

en: Scientists calculated the distance between the Earth and the Moon.
We need to calculate the risks before investing.
She calculated that the project would take three months.
cn: 科学家计算了地球与月球之间的距离。
投资前我们需要评估风险。
她估算这个项目需要三个月完成。

en: The engineer made a precise calculation of the bridge's load capacity.
Her decision was based on cold calculation rather than emotion.
A simple calculation shows that the project is not profitable.
cn: 工程师精确计算了桥梁的承重能力。
她的决定出于冷静权衡，而非情感。
简单估算表明该项目无利可图。

en: She used a calculator to solve the complex equation.
The accountant is a human calculator with numbers.
Early calculators required manual input of each digit.
cn: 她用计算器解开了那个复杂的方程。
这位会计师是个活生生的“人肉计算器”。
早期的计算器需要手动输入每一位数字。

en: The calendar on her wall showed a full schedule for December.
Ancient civilizations developed lunar calendars to track farming seasons.
Don’t forget to calendar the team meeting for next Monday.
cn: 她墙上的日历显示十二月的日程已排满。
古代文明发明阴历来追踪农耕季节。
别忘了将团队会议列入下周一日程。

en: She called his name three times.
I'll call you tomorrow morning.
The doctor paid a house call.
cn: 她喊了他的名字三次。
我明早给你打电话。
医生进行了上门诊疗。

en: The lake was calm under the moonlight.
She took a deep breath to calm her nerves.
His calm demeanor reassured the team.
cn: 湖面在月光下平静如镜。
她深呼吸以平复紧张情绪。
他镇定的举止让团队安心。

en: The Bedouin guided his camel across the vast desert.
Engineers used a camel to refloat the sunken ship.
Camel milk is a staple food in some arid regions.
cn: 贝都因人牵着骆驼穿越广袤的沙漠。
工程师利用浮船箱打捞沉船。
骆驼奶是某些干旱地区的主食。

en: She pointed the camera at the sunset.
The interview was filmed in a studio camera.
Modern cameras often have automatic focus.
cn: 她将相机对准日落。
采访在电视摄影棚录制。
现代相机通常配备自动对焦功能。

definitions.definition: 营地；阵营；刻意夸张的风格（尤指艺术或行为）

en: We set up camp by the lake at dusk.
Her fashion sense is deliberately camp and theatrical.
The political debate divided voters into two opposing camps.
cn: 黄昏时我们在湖边扎营。
她的穿衣风格刻意夸张，充满戏剧性。
这场政治辩论将选民分成了两个对立的阵营。

definitions.definition: 运动（有组织的活动，如政治或社会运动）

en: She led a campaign to protect endangered species.
The general planned a winter campaign against the enemy.
Many celebrities campaigned for climate change awareness.
cn: 她发起了一场保护濒危物种的运动。
将军策划了一场针对敌人的冬季战役。
许多名人为提高气候变化意识发起活动。

en: The new library will be built on the east side of the campus.
Campus life offers students many opportunities for personal growth.
The protest spread across the entire campus within hours.
cn: 新图书馆将建在校园的东侧。
校园生活为学生提供了许多个人成长的机会。
抗议活动在几小时内蔓延至整个校园。

definitions.definition: 能，可以（表示能力或许可）

en: She can speak four languages fluently.
He opened a can of beans for dinner.
They can the fresh fish to preserve it.
cn: 她能流利地说四种语言。
他开了一罐豆子当晚餐。
他们把新鲜鱼装罐保存。

en: She is a proud Canadian who loves hockey.
Canadian maple syrup is famous worldwide.
The Canadian government announced new immigration policies.
cn: 她是一个热爱冰球的骄傲加拿大人。
加拿大枫糖浆全球闻名。
加拿大政府宣布了新的移民政策。

en: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
The plant transports nutrients through its vascular canals.
They dug a small canal to divert water to the fields.
cn: 巴拿马运河连接大西洋与太平洋。
植物通过维管输送养分。
他们挖了一条小水渠将水引向农田。

en: The concert was canceled due to heavy rain.
She canceled her subscription to the magazine.
The system allows you to cancel the operation within 10 seconds.
cn: 音乐会因大雨取消。
她注销了杂志订阅。
该系统允许你在10秒内撤销操作。

definitions.definition: [天文] 巨蟹座（大写首字母）

en: Early detection significantly improves cancer survival rates.
Corruption is a cancer that erodes public trust.
The sun enters Cancer in late June.
cn: 早期发现极大提高癌症存活率。
腐败是侵蚀公众信任的痼疾。
太阳在六月下旬进入巨蟹座。

en: She is the most qualified candidate for the job.
All candidates must submit their applications by Friday.
The candidate outlined his policies during the debate.
cn: 她是该职位最合格的候选人。
所有申请者必须在周五前提交材料。
这位候选人在辩论中阐述了他的政策。

en: She lit a candle to brighten the room.
The candle flickered in the gentle breeze.
Ancient people used candles for both light and timekeeping.
cn: 她点燃一支蜡烛照亮房间。
烛火在微风中摇曳。
古人用蜡烛既照明又计时。

en: She offered me a piece of strawberry-flavored candy.
The fruit is candied to preserve it for longer.
His speech was full of candy-coated promises.
cn: 她给了我一颗草莓味的糖果。
水果被糖渍以延长保存时间。
他的演讲充满了糖衣包裹的承诺。

en: The castle walls were destroyed by cannon fire.
He scored a cannon in the pool game, hitting three balls in a row.
The truck cannoned into the barrier at full speed.
cn: 城堡的城墙被炮火摧毁。
他在台球比赛中打出连击，连续击中三球。
卡车全速撞上了护栏。

definitions.definition: 独木舟（一种狭长的轻便小船，通常用单根树干挖空制成）

en: They paddled the canoe across the lake at dawn.
The indigenous people carved canoes from giant tree trunks.
Canoeing is a popular summer activity in this region.
cn: 他们在黎明时分划独木舟穿过湖泊。
原住民用巨大的树干雕刻独木舟。
划独木舟是该地区夏季的热门活动。

en: The students lined up at the canteen for lunch.
He filled his canteen with fresh water before the hike.
The factory built a new canteen for its employees.
cn: 学生们在食堂排队吃午餐。
徒步前，他把水壶灌满了清水。
工厂为员工新建了一个食堂。

en: The artist painted on a large canvas.
The tent is made of waterproof canvas.
We need to canvas the neighborhood for opinions.
cn: 艺术家在一块大画布上作画。
帐篷由防水帆布制成。
我们需要在社区内详细征集意见。

en: She wore a red cap to protect her hair from the sun.
The bottle cap rolled under the table.
The government will cap carbon emissions next year.
cn: 她戴了一顶红帽子防晒护发。
瓶盖滚到了桌子底下。
政府将于明年设定碳排放上限。

en: She is a capable leader who handles crises calmly.
The team proved capable of completing the project ahead of schedule.
This tool is capable of precise measurements.
cn: 她是一位能干的领导者，能冷静处理危机。
团队证明了自己有能力提前完成项目。
该工具可进行精确测量。

en: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000.
She demonstrated a remarkable capacity for leadership.
He was acting in his capacity as a legal advisor.
cn: 这座体育场可容纳5万人。
她展现出卓越的领导才能。
他以法律顾问的身份行事。

en: Beijing is the capital of China.
The company raised enough capital to expand its business.
Murder is a capital crime in some countries.
cn: 北京是中国的首都。
该公司筹集了足够资本以扩展业务。
在某些国家，谋杀是死罪。

en: The captain steered the ship through the storm.
She was elected captain of the basketball team.
The airline captain announced a delay due to fog.
cn: 船长驾驶船只穿越风暴。
她当选为篮球队队长。
机长因大雾宣布航班延误。

en: The soldiers were held captive for three years.
She was a captive audience, enthralled by his stories.
The captive market had no choice but to pay high prices.
cn: 这些士兵被囚禁了三年。
她是被迷住的听众，对他的故事着迷不已。
受控的市场别无选择，只能支付高价。

definitions.definition: 捕获；夺取；记录（影像、声音等）

en: The photographer managed to capture the rare moment of the eagle diving.
The army planned a night operation to capture the enemy's stronghold.
This device can capture sound waves with high accuracy.
cn: 摄影师成功抓拍到了鹰俯冲的罕见瞬间。
军队计划夜间行动夺取敌方据点。
该设备能高精度记录声波。

en: She parked her car in the garage.
The train's dining car serves hot meals.
We took a streetcar to the museum.
cn: 她把车停进了车库。
火车的餐车供应热食。
我们乘坐有轨电车去了博物馆。

en: Diamonds are a crystalline form of pure carbon.
The carbon cycle is essential for life on Earth.
She made a carbon copy of the document for her records.
cn: 钻石是纯碳的结晶形态。
碳循环对地球生命至关重要。
她为存档制作了一份文件的复写副本。

en: She sent me a birthday card with a lovely message.
He shuffled the deck of cards before dealing.
The recipe is printed on the back of the card.
cn: 她寄给我一张写有温馨祝福的生日贺卡。
发牌前，他洗了洗那副扑克牌。
食谱印在卡片的背面。

definitions.definition: 在意；愿意（后接从句或不定式）

en: She cares deeply about environmental issues.
Handle the vase with care—it’s fragile.
Would you care to join us for dinner?
cn: 她非常关心环境问题。
小心拿这个花瓶，它很易碎。
你愿意和我们共进晚餐吗？

en: She pursued a career in medicine for over a decade.
The car careered down the hill uncontrollably.
His academic career began with a humble teaching assistant position.
cn: 她从事医学事业已逾十年。
汽车失控地冲下山坡。
他的学术生涯始于一份普通的助教工作。

en: Be careful when crossing the road.
She gave a careful answer to avoid misunderstanding.
The artist is careful with every brushstroke.
cn: 过马路时要小心。
她给出了谨慎的回答以避免误解。
这位艺术家对每一笔都细致入微。

en: His careless mistake cost the company thousands.
She gave a careless shrug and walked away.
The artist’s careless strokes somehow created a beautiful effect.
cn: 他的粗心错误让公司损失了数千元。
她随意地耸了耸肩便离开了。
画家随意的笔触意外营造出美妙的效果。

en: The ship was carrying a cargo of bananas.
Air cargo services are faster but more expensive.
They unloaded the cargo at the port before dawn.
cn: 这艘船运载着一批香蕉货物。
空运服务更快但更昂贵。
他们在黎明前将货物卸在港口。

en: The carpenter skillfully crafted a wooden chair.
My grandfather was a carpenter who built our family house.
She hired a carpenter to repair the antique wardrobe.
cn: 木匠熟练地制作了一把木椅。
我的祖父是木匠，他建造了我们家的房子。
她雇了一位木匠来修复古董衣柜。

en: The living room has a thick red carpet.
They decided to carpet the entire hallway.
Autumn leaves carpeted the forest floor.
cn: 客厅铺着厚厚的红色地毯。
他们决定给整个走廊铺上地毯。
秋叶如地毯般覆盖了森林地面。

definitions.definition: 车辆（尤指马车或火车车厢）

en: The royal carriage was drawn by six white horses.
The price includes carriage to your nearest station.
Adjust the printer carriage to align the paper.
cn: 皇家马车由六匹白马牵引。
费用包含运至您最近车站的运费。
调整打印机滑架以对齐纸张。

en: The airline is a major carrier of international cargo.
Mosquitoes can be carriers of deadly diseases.
The fiber optic cable acts as a carrier for high-speed data.
cn: 这家航空公司是国际货运的主要承运商。
蚊子可能是致命疾病的传播媒介。
光纤电缆是高速数据的传输载体。

definitions.definition: 胡萝卜（植物或食用根茎）
（比喻）奖励或诱惑（如“carrot and stick”政策中的“胡萝卜”）

en: She chopped fresh carrots for the soup.
The company uses a carrot-and-stick approach to motivate employees.
Wild carrots have thinner roots than cultivated varieties.
cn: 她为汤切了新鲜的胡萝卜。
公司采用“胡萝卜加大棒”的策略激励员工。
野生胡萝卜的根比栽培品种更细。

en: She carries a heavy backpack to school every day.
This bridge can carry up to 50 tons of weight.
His voice carries well in the concert hall.
cn: 她每天背着沉重的书包去上学。
这座桥可承重50吨。
他的声音在音乐厅里传得很远。

definitions.definition: （马拉或手推的）两轮车；购物车；运货马车

en: The farmer loaded hay onto the wooden cart.
She pushed the shopping cart through the supermarket aisle.
They had to cart all the equipment up the mountain by hand.
cn: 农民将干草装上了木制马车。
她推着购物车穿过超市货架通道。
他们不得不徒手将所有设备搬运上山。

definitions.definition: 雕刻（用工具切割材料以形成特定形状）

en: The artist carved a beautiful statue from marble.
Would you like me to carve the turkey?
Glaciers carve valleys over thousands of years.
cn: 艺术家用大理石雕刻出一尊美丽的雕像。
需要我来切火鸡肉吗？
冰川用数千年时间侵蚀出山谷。

en: The detective solved the case within a week.
She packed her books in a wooden case.
In any case, we should prepare for the worst.
cn: 侦探在一周内破获了此案。
她把书装进了一个木箱里。
无论如何，我们都应做最坏的打算。

en: She paid for the book in cash.
The store doesn't accept credit cards, only cash.
He cashed his paycheck at the bank.
cn: 她用现金支付了这本书。
这家商店不接受信用卡，只收现金。
