cn: 她在学习中国书法。
这家餐厅提供地道的中国菜。
许多中国传统可追溯至数千年前。

definitions.definition: 巧克力（一种由可可豆制成的甜食）

en: She gifted me a box of handmade chocolates.
The walls were painted in warm chocolate brown.
Hot chocolate is my favorite winter drink.
cn: 她送了我一盒手工巧克力。
墙面涂成了温暖的巧克力棕色。
热巧克力是我最爱的冬季饮品。

en: She made a careful choice between the two job offers.
This store sells choice cuts of meat.
Freedom of choice is a basic human right.
cn: 她在两个工作邀约间做出了谨慎选择。
这家店出售上等肉块。
选择自由是基本人权。

definitions.definition: 窒息；阻塞装置（如汽车阻风门）

en: The smoke made her choke and cough violently.
He choked on a piece of bread during dinner.
The mechanic adjusted the choke to start the cold engine.
cn: 浓烟使她窒息并剧烈咳嗽。
晚餐时他被一块面包噎住了。
机械师调整了阻风门以启动冷发动机。

en: You can choose any book from the shelf.
She chose to study abroad despite the challenges.
We must choose between speed and accuracy.
cn: 你可以从书架上任选一本书。
尽管面临挑战，她仍选择出国留学。
我们必须在速度与准确性之间做出抉择。

en: He used an axe to chop the log into firewood.
Add some chopped onions to the soup.
This restaurant serves the best pork chops in town.
cn: 他用斧头把圆木劈成柴火。
往汤里加些切碎的洋葱。
这家餐厅供应全镇最美味的猪排。

definitions.definition: 基督徒（信仰耶稣基督的人）

en: She became a Christian after years of spiritual searching.
Christian values emphasize love and forgiveness.
The Christian community organized a charity event.
cn: 经过多年心灵探索后，她成为了一名基督徒。
基督教价值观强调爱与宽恕。
基督教社区组织了一场慈善活动。

definitions.definition: 圣诞节（基督教纪念耶稣诞生的节日）
圣诞节期间（12月24日至1月6日）

en: We decorate the tree together every Christmas.
Christmas is a time for family and generosity.
The word "Christmas" first appeared in Old English as "Cristes mæsse".
cn: 每年圣诞节我们一起装饰圣诞树。
圣诞节是家人团聚与慷慨施予的时刻。
“Christmas”一词最初以“Cristes mæsse”的形式出现在古英语中。

definitions.definition: 教堂；礼拜仪式；教会组织

en: The medieval church was the center of village life.
They married in a small country church.
The Church plays an active role in social welfare.
cn: 这座中世纪教堂曾是村落的中心。
他们在一座乡村小教堂结婚。
教会组织在社会福利中发挥积极作用。

en: He lit a cigarette and took a deep puff.
The smell of cigarette smoke lingered in the room.
She decided to quit smoking cigarettes for health reasons.
cn: 他点燃一支香烟，深深吸了一口。
房间里残留着香烟的气味。
出于健康考虑，她决定戒烟。

en: The old cinema downtown still shows classic films.
She studied cinema at university, focusing on French New Wave.
Streaming platforms are changing how we experience cinema.
cn: 市中心的老电影院仍放映经典电影。
她在大学学习电影艺术，专攻法国新浪潮。
流媒体平台正在改变我们体验电影的方式。

en: She drew a perfect circle on the paper.
The birds circled above the lake.
The discussion kept circling back to the same topic.
cn: 她在纸上画了一个完美的圆。
鸟儿在湖面上空盘旋。
讨论反复回到同一个话题。

en: The race car completed the circuit in under two minutes.
A short circuit caused the power outage.
Judges used to travel on circuit to hear cases.
cn: 赛车在两分钟内跑完了环形赛道。
短路导致了停电。
法官曾巡回各地审理案件。

en: The moon follows a circular orbit around the Earth.
The debate became circular, with no new points being made.
They distributed a circular to announce the meeting.
cn: 月球沿环形轨道绕地球运行。
争论陷入循环，毫无新意。
他们分发传单通知会议。

en: Blood circulates through the body to deliver oxygen.
The news circulated quickly on social media.
Fans help circulate air in the room.
cn: 血液在体内循环以输送氧气。
这则消息在社交媒体上迅速传播。
风扇使房间内的空气流通。

en: The circumference of the Earth is approximately 40,075 kilometers.
She measured the circumference of the tree trunk with a tape.
The ancient map marked the circumference of the known world.
cn: 地球的周长约为40,075公里。
她用卷尺测量了树干的周长。
这幅古地图标注了已知世界的边界。

definitions.definition: 环境；情况（指影响事件的外部条件）
细节；事件（尤指附带或次要的）

en: Under no circumstances should you open the door to strangers.
The project’s success depended on unforeseen circumstances.
She described the circumstances leading to the accident.
cn: 任何情况下都不应给陌生人开门。
项目的成功取决于不可预见的因素。
她描述了导致事故的细节经过。

definitions.definition: 公民（享有某国法律权利与义务的成员）

en: Every citizen has the right to vote in democratic countries.
She became a proud citizen after passing the naturalization test.
The museum offers free admission to local citizens on Sundays.
cn: 民主国家的每位公民都有投票权。
通过入籍考试后，她成为了一名自豪的公民。
该博物馆每周日对本地市民免费开放。

definitions.definition: 城市，都市（大型人类聚居地）

en: New York is a bustling city that never sleeps.
The entire city celebrated the team's victory.
Ancient Rome was the first city to reach one million inhabitants.
cn: 纽约是一座永不沉睡的繁华都市。
全市居民为球队的胜利欢呼。
古罗马是首个人口突破百万的城市。

definitions.definition: 公民的；民用的（与军事或宗教相对）

en: Voting is a civil right protected by law.
Despite their disagreement, they kept the conversation civil.
The engineer switched from military to civil projects.
cn: 投票是受法律保护的公民权利。
尽管存在分歧，他们的对话仍保持礼貌。
这名工程师从军事项目转向了民用项目。

definitions.definition: 文明（指人类社会发展的先进阶段或特定文化群体）
文明社会（与原始或野蛮状态相对）

en: The ancient Maya civilization made remarkable advances in astronomy.
Clean water access is a sign of modern civilization.
Some argue that technology alone does not define civilization.
cn: 古代玛雅文明在天文学上取得了非凡的成就。
清洁饮水是现代文明的标志之一。
有人认为单凭技术不足以定义文明。

definitions.definition: 改善行为举止；使有教养

en: The missionaries aimed to civilize the indigenous tribes by introducing Western education and customs.
It is often said that travel helps to civilize the mind and broaden perspectives.
The government launched programs to civilize the overcrowded urban areas, improving sanitation and infrastructure.
cn: 传教士试图通过引入西方教育和习俗来教化土著部落。
人们常说旅行有助于陶冶心智、开阔视野。
政府启动了计划以改善过度拥挤的都市区域，提升卫生和基础设施水平。

en: She claims to have seen the missing documents.
The insurance company rejected his claim for damages.
Indigenous people have a strong claim to these lands.
cn: 她声称见过丢失的文件。
保险公司拒绝了他的赔偿索赔。
原住民对这些土地拥有强烈的主权主张。

definitions.definition: 拍手声；突然的响声（如雷声）

en: The audience began to clap after the performance.
A loud clap of thunder woke me up at midnight.
She gave him a friendly clap on the shoulder.
cn: 表演结束后，观众开始鼓掌。
半夜一声响雷把我惊醒。
她友好地拍了拍他的肩膀。

en: The professor used diagrams to clarify the complex theory.
Adding lemon juice helps clarify the broth.
Could you clarify your statement? I’m still confused.
cn: 教授用图表阐明了这一复杂理论。
加入柠檬汁可使高汤变得清澈。
你能澄清一下你的说法吗？我仍感到困惑。

en: She fastened the clasp of her necklace.
He reached out to clasp her hand tightly.
The child clasped the teddy bear in a hug.
cn: 她扣上了项链的搭扣。
他伸出手紧紧握住她的手。
孩子紧紧抱住泰迪熊。

en: She joined a yoga class to improve her flexibility.
The novel critiques the struggles of the working class.
His elegant manners show true class.
cn: 她参加了瑜伽课以提高柔韧性。
这部小说批判了工人阶级的困境。
他优雅的举止展现了真正的风度。

definitions.definition: 古典的（指艺术、音乐或文学等传统、经典的风格）
经典的（具有持久价值或权威性）

en: Beethoven's symphonies are central to the classical music repertoire.
She prefers classical architecture over modern designs.
The professor gave a lecture on classical Greek philosophy.
cn: 贝多芬的交响曲是古典音乐曲目的核心。
相较于现代设计，她更偏爱古典建筑风格。
教授做了一场关于古典希腊哲学的讲座。

en: The classification of organisms is fundamental to biology.
This document has a confidential classification.
The library uses a decimal system for book classification.
cn: 生物分类是生物学的基础。
这份文件属于机密级别。
该图书馆采用十进制图书分类法。

en: Scientists classify plants based on their genetic traits.
The document was classified as top secret.
Librarians classify books by the Dewey Decimal System.
cn: 科学家根据基因特征对植物进行分类。
该文件被列为绝密。
图书管理员按杜威十进制系统对书籍分类。

en: My classmate helped me with the math problem.
We organized a reunion for our elementary school classmates.
She became my closest classmate during the semester.
cn: 我的同班同学帮我解决了数学题。
我们为小学同学组织了聚会。
这学期她成了我最亲密的同班同学。

en: The students quietly entered the classroom.
The classroom was equipped with smart boards.
She decorated her classroom with colorful posters.
cn: 学生们安静地走进教室。
这间教室配备了智能白板。
她用彩色海报装饰了自己的教室。

en: The eagle gripped its prey with sharp claws.
She clawed at the door in desperation.
The lobster’s claw snapped shut.
cn: 鹰用利爪紧紧抓住猎物。
她绝望地用指甲抓挠门。
龙虾的钳子啪地合上了。

en: The potter shaped the clay into a delicate vase.
His hands were covered with wet clay after working in the studio.
The sculptor believes that every block of clay has a spirit inside.
cn: 陶匠将黏土塑成一只精美的花瓶。
在工作室劳作后，他的双手沾满了湿黏土。
雕塑家认为每一块黏土内部都有灵魂。

en: She keeps her room spotlessly clean.
Clean the windows before the guests arrive.
This fabric cleans easily with water.
cn: 她的房间保持得一尘不染。
在客人到来前把窗户擦干净。
这种布料用水就能轻松洗净。

en: The water in the lake is crystal clear.
She cleared her throat before speaking.
The sky cleared after the heavy rain.
cn: 湖水清澈见底。
她发言前清了清嗓子。
大雨过后，天空放晴了。

en: She spoke clearly so everyone could understand.
The instructions were clearly written on the label.
This is clearly a mistake that needs to be fixed.
cn: 她说话清晰，让所有人都能听懂。
说明清楚地写在标签上。
这显然是一个需要修正的错误。

en: She works as a clerk in a law firm.
The hotel clerk checked us in efficiently.
Medieval clerks were often responsible for copying manuscripts.
cn: 她在一家律师事务所担任文员。
酒店前台职员高效地为我们办理了入住。
中世纪的文书常负责抄写手稿。

en: She found a clever solution to the math problem.
The magician's clever tricks amazed the audience.
His clever reply left everyone speechless.
cn: 她找到了一个巧妙的数学问题解法。
魔术师机灵的戏法让观众惊叹。
他机智的回答让所有人哑口无言。

en: The eagle nested on the edge of the cliff.
Waves crashed against the base of the cliff.
Hikers were warned not to approach the unstable cliff.
cn: 鹰在悬崖边缘筑巢。
海浪拍打着悬崖底部。
徒步者被警告不要靠近不稳定的悬崖。

definitions.definition: 气候（某地区的长期天气模式）

en: The Mediterranean climate is perfect for growing olives.
The political climate has become increasingly polarized.
Climate change is a global issue that requires immediate action.
cn: 地中海气候非常适合种植橄榄。
政治氛围日益两极分化。
气候变化是需要立即行动的全球性问题。

en: She learned to climb rocks at age six.
The temperature climbed to 40°C by noon.
His rapid climb to fame surprised everyone.
cn: 她六岁时学会了攀岩。
正午时气温升至40摄氏度。
他迅速成名让所有人惊讶。

en: She wrapped her cloak tightly against the wind.
The spy cloaked his true identity with a fake passport.
Their kindness was just a cloak for malicious intentions.
cn: 她裹紧斗篷抵御寒风。
间谍用假护照掩盖真实身份。
他们的善意只是恶意意图的伪装。

definitions.definition: 记录（时间）；达到（特定时间或速度）

en: The church clock struck midnight.
She clocked her best running time this year.
The project was clocked at 150 hours of work.
cn: 教堂的钟敲响了午夜十二点。
她创下了今年跑步的最佳成绩。
该项目记录的工作时间为150小时。

en: Please close the window before leaving.
They have a close friendship despite living far apart.
The detective examined the case with close attention.
cn: 离开前请关上窗户。
尽管相隔甚远，他们仍保持着亲密的友谊。
侦探以严密的注意力调查此案。

en: The two concepts are closely related.
She listened closely to the instructions.
The detective examined the evidence closely.
cn: 这两个概念密切相关。
她仔细聆听了指示。
侦探严密检查了证据。

definitions.definition: （特定用途的）一块布（如桌布、抹布）

en: She wiped the table with a damp cloth.
This cloth is made from organic cotton.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of the cloth.
cn: 她用一块湿布擦了桌子。
这块布料由有机棉制成。
魔术师从布中变出一只兔子。

en: She hurried to clothe the child before the storm.
The trees are clothed in vibrant leaves each spring.
His speech was clothed in diplomatic language.
cn: 她匆忙给孩子穿好衣服以防暴风雨。
每年春天树木都披上鲜艳的叶子。
他的演讲裹着外交辞令的外衣。

definitions.definition: 衣物，服装（泛指身上穿着的衣物）

en: She folded her clothes neatly and put them in the drawer.
The charity collects used clothes for refugees.
His clothes were soaked after walking in the rain.
cn: 她将衣服整齐叠好放进抽屉。
该慈善机构为难民募集旧衣物。
雨中行走后，他的衣服全湿透了。

en: She donated all her old clothing to charity.
The store specializes in outdoor clothing and gear.
Lightweight clothing is recommended for tropical climates.
cn: 她将所有旧衣物捐给了慈善机构。
这家店专营户外服装和装备。
建议在热带气候下穿着轻便衣物。

en: The sky was filled with dark clouds before the storm.
Her eyes clouded with tears as she listened to the sad news.
The controversy has clouded his reputation.
cn: 暴风雨来临前，天空布满了乌云。
听到悲伤的消息，她的双眼因泪水而模糊。
争议使他的声誉蒙上了阴影。

en: The sky turned cloudy in the afternoon.
The water in the pond looks cloudy after the storm.
His memories of the event are still cloudy.
cn: 下午天空转阴。
暴风雨后，池塘里的水显得浑浊。
他对那件事的记忆依然模糊。

en: He joined a local book club to meet new friends.
The hunter used a wooden club to defend himself.
We clubbed together to buy a gift for the teacher.
cn: 他加入了本地读书俱乐部以结识新朋友。
猎人用木棍自卫。
我们凑钱给老师买了礼物。

en: The detective found a crucial clue at the crime scene.
Her diary might clue us in to her disappearance.
The map had no clues to locate the hidden treasure.
cn: 侦探在犯罪现场发现了关键线索。
她的日记可能为我们提供她失踪的线索。
地图上没有提示能定位隐藏的宝藏。

en: He dropped the vase with a clumsy gesture.
The device’s clumsy design made it frustrating to use.
Her apology was clumsy but sincere.
cn: 他笨手笨脚地打翻了花瓶。
这个装置设计粗糙，用起来令人恼火。
她的道歉虽笨拙却很真诚。

definitions.definition: 教练；长途汽车；四轮马车

en: She hired a coach to improve her tennis skills.
We took a coach to travel across the country.
The professor coached the team through the research project.
cn: 她聘请了一位教练来提高网球技术。
我们乘坐长途汽车穿越全国。
教授指导团队完成了研究项目。

en: The steam engine was fueled by coal.
Miners risk their lives to extract coal underground.
The artist coal-ed the wood to create charcoal sketches.
cn: 蒸汽机以煤为燃料。
矿工们冒着生命危险在地下采煤。
艺术家将木头炭化以制作木炭素描。

en: The coarse fabric irritated her skin.
His coarse jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
Sandpaper is deliberately made coarse for grinding.
cn: 粗糙的布料刺激了她的皮肤。
他粗俗的笑话让所有人不适。
砂纸特意做得粗糙以便打磨。

en: The ship sailed along the rugged coast.
He turned off the engine and let the car coast downhill.
Coastal erosion threatens these villages.
cn: 船只沿着崎岖的海岸航行。
他关闭引擎，让车惯性滑下山坡。
海岸侵蚀威胁着这些村庄。

en: She wore a woolen coat to brave the cold wind.
The table was coated with a layer of dust.
Apply a second coat of paint for better coverage.
cn: 她穿了一件羊毛外套抵御寒风。
桌子上覆盖了一层灰尘。
涂第二层油漆以获得更好的覆盖效果。

definitions.definition: 竖起（耳朵或帽子）；扳动（枪的）击铁

en: The cock crowed at dawn.
Turn the cock to stop the water flow.
He cocked his hat at a jaunty angle.
cn: 公鸡在黎明时分啼叫。
拧紧龙头以停止水流。
他把帽子歪戴成俏皮的角度。

en: The programmer wrote a new code to fix the bug.
Ancient civilizations used symbols as a secret code.
The penal code defines criminal offenses.
cn: 程序员编写了一段新代码来修复漏洞。
古代文明用符号作为秘密密码。
刑法典规定了犯罪行为。

definitions.definition: 咖啡（一种由咖啡豆制成的饮料或植物）

en: She starts her day with a cup of black coffee.
The coffee beans are grown in tropical regions.
This café serves the best espresso in town.
cn: 她每天以一杯黑咖啡开始新的一天。
咖啡豆生长在热带地区。
这家咖啡馆提供镇上最好的浓缩咖啡。

en: The snake coiled around the branch.
She kept a coil of rope in the garage.
The wire springs back when coiled tightly.
cn: 蛇盘绕在树枝上。
她在车库里放了一卷绳子。
金属丝紧密卷曲后会弹回原状。

definitions.definition: 铸造（货币）；创造（新词或短语）

en: She inserted a coin into the vending machine.
The government decided to coin new commemorative coins.
Shakespeare coined many words still used today.
cn: 她将一枚硬币投入自动售货机。
政府决定铸造新的纪念币。
莎士比亚创造了许多至今仍在使用的词汇。

en: The cold wind made her shiver.
He gave me a cold stare.
She caught a cold after walking in the rain.
cn: 刺骨的寒风让她瑟瑟发抖。
他冷冷地瞪了我一眼。
她在雨中行走后感冒了。

en: The old building collapsed during the earthquake.
The company collapsed due to financial mismanagement.
She collapsed from exhaustion after the marathon.
cn: 那座旧建筑在地震中倒塌了。
该公司因财务管理不善而倒闭。
她在马拉松赛后因精疲力竭而虚脱。

definitions.definition: 衣领；项圈；动物颈部毛圈
抓住衣领；逮捕；拦住（口语）

en: He straightened his collar before the interview.
The dog’s collar has a name tag.
Police collared the suspect near the station.
cn: 面试前他整理了一下衣领。
狗的项圈上挂着名牌。

根据证据，我们可以断定该理论是正确的。
经过数月谈判，条约最终达成。

en: The experiment's conclusion supported the initial hypothesis.
They reached a conclusion after hours of negotiation.
The novel's conclusion left readers in tears.
cn: 实验结论支持了最初的假设。
经过数小时谈判，他们达成了协议。
小说的结局让读者落泪。

definitions.definition: 具体的；实在的；混凝土制的

en: The sidewalk is made of concrete.
She gave a concrete example to explain her theory.
The workers will concrete the foundation tomorrow.
cn: 这条人行道由混凝土制成。
她用一个具体的例子来解释她的理论。
工人们明天将用混凝土浇筑地基。

en: The UN issued a statement to condemn the violent acts.
The court condemned him to life imprisonment.
Poor sanitation condemned the village to repeated epidemics.
cn: 联合国发表声明谴责暴力行为。
法庭判处他无期徒刑。
恶劣的卫生条件使该村屡遭疫情肆虐。

en: The cold air caused the steam to condense into water droplets.
She condensed the 200-page report into a 10-page summary.
The galaxy’s gas clouds slowly condense to form new stars.
cn: 冷空气使水蒸气凝结成水滴。
她将200页的报告压缩成10页的摘要。
星系的气体云逐渐凝聚，形成新的恒星。

definitions.definition: 使适应；决定（某事物的性质）

en: The patient's condition improved after surgery.
Hard work is a necessary condition for success.
The experiment conditioned the rats to fear light.
cn: 手术后，患者的健康状况有所改善。
努力是成功的必要条件。
该实验使老鼠对光产生了条件性恐惧。

en: The teacher will conduct the students to the museum.
Copper conducts electricity efficiently.
His professional conduct impressed the committee.
cn: 老师将带领学生们去博物馆。
铜能高效导电。
他的职业行为给委员会留下了深刻印象。

definitions.definition: （乐队）指挥；导体；（公共汽车）售票员

en: The conductor raised his baton, and the orchestra began to play.
Copper is an excellent conductor of electricity.
The bus conductor announced the next stop.
cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，乐团开始演奏。
铜是电的优良导体。
公交车售票员报出了下一站的站名。

en: The annual tech conference attracts innovators worldwide.
She presented her research at an international conference.
The Ivy League is a prestigious athletic conference.
cn: 年度科技会议吸引了全球的创新者。
她在一次国际会议上展示了她的研究。
常春藤联盟是一个著名的体育联合会。

en: He refused to confess his mistake despite the evidence.
In Catholicism, believers confess their sins to a priest.
She finally confessed to stealing the necklace.
cn: 尽管证据确凿，他拒绝承认错误。
在天主教中，信徒向神父忏悔罪过。
她最终承认偷了项链。

en: She spoke with confidence during the presentation.
His confidence in the team inspired everyone.
The information was shared in strict confidence.
cn: 她在演讲中充满自信。
他对团队的信任鼓舞了所有人。
该信息被严格保密（古义残留）。

en: She gave a confident presentation despite her nervousness.
His confident tone convinced everyone of his plan.
True leaders are confident yet humble.
cn: 尽管紧张，她仍做出了自信的演讲。
他自信的语气让所有人都相信了他的计划。
真正的领导者自信而谦逊。

en: The study was confined to adults over 30.
The prisoners are kept within the confines of the jail.
Don't confine your learning to classroom lectures.
cn: 这项研究仅限于30岁以上的成年人。
囚犯被关押在监狱的范围内。
不要将你的学习局限于课堂讲授。

definitions.definition: 批准（宗教仪式中的职位或权利）

en: The experiment confirmed the theory.
The bishop will confirm the new members next Sunday.
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
cn: 实验证实了这一理论。
主教将于下周日为新成员施坚信礼。
请于周五前确认是否出席。

en: The conflict between the two countries lasted for decades.
Her actions conflict with her words.
Resolving inner conflicts is key to mental health.
cn: 两国间的冲突持续了数十年。
她的言行不一。
解决内心矛盾是心理健康的关键。

en: The complicated instructions confused the new students.
Don't confuse the two concepts—they are fundamentally different.
His sudden change of mood confused everyone at the meeting.
cn: 复杂的说明让新生感到困惑。
不要混淆这两个概念，它们有本质区别。
他情绪的突然转变让与会者都摸不着头脑。

en: The sudden change caused great confusion among the staff.
Her answers only added to the confusion.
The room was in a state of confusion after the party.
cn: 突然的变动让员工们陷入极大困惑。
她的回答反而加剧了混乱。
派对结束后，房间里一片狼藉。

en: She called to congratulate me on my promotion.
The team gathered to congratulate their captain on the victory.
We congratulated the newlyweds with a toast.
cn: 她打电话祝贺我升职。
全队聚在一起向队长祝贺胜利。
我们举杯向新婚夫妇道贺。

definitions.definition: 祝贺，庆贺（表达喜悦或赞美的正式用语）

en: She received countless congratulations on her promotion.
The team exchanged congratulations after winning the championship.
A simple "congratulations" can mean a lot to someone who worked hard.
cn: 她收到了无数对她升职的祝贺。
队伍夺冠后互相道贺。
一句简单的“恭喜”对努力过的人意义重大。

en: The bill was passed by the U.S. Congress after months of debate.
Scientists from 50 countries attended the international congress on climate change.
The annual congress of the labor union will vote on new policies next week.
cn: 这项法案经美国国会数月辩论后获得通过。
来自50个国家的科学家参加了这场关于气候变化的国际会议。
工会年度代表大会将于下周投票表决新政策。

en: "And" is a coordinating conjunction in English.
The conjunction of warm weather and rain created perfect conditions for mushrooms.
Astronomers observed a rare conjunction of Jupiter and Saturn.
cn: “and”是英语中的并列连词。
温暖天气与雨水的结合为蘑菇生长创造了理想条件。
天文学家观测到木星与土星的罕见合相。

en: The bridge connects the two villages.
She quickly connected the idea to her own experience.
Ensure the printer is properly connected to the computer.
cn: 这座桥连接了两个村庄。
她迅速将这个想法与自身经历联系起来。
确保打印机与电脑正确连接。

definitions.definition: 连接；关联（物理或抽象关系）

en: The internet connection was unstable during the storm.
She has valuable connections in the publishing industry.
Scientists found a connection between sleep and memory.
cn: 暴风雨期间网络连接不稳定。
她在出版业有宝贵的人脉。
科学家发现了睡眠与记忆之间的关联。

en: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
She struggled to conquer her fear of public speaking.
Modern medicine has conquered many deadly diseases.
cn: 诺曼人于1066年征服英格兰。
她努力克服对公开演讲的恐惧。
现代医学已攻克许多致命疾病。

en: The Norman Conquest of England changed the course of history.
Her kindness was a conquest over his stubborn heart.
Scientific conquests often begin with unanswered questions.
cn: 诺曼征服英格兰改变了历史进程。
她的善良征服了他固执的心。
科学上的突破常始于未解之谜。

en: His conscience prevented him from lying.
She acted against her conscience by keeping the money.
A clear conscience is a soft pillow.
cn: 他的良心使他无法说谎。
她违背良心留下了那笔钱。
问心无愧，高枕无忧。（谚语）

en: She was conscious of every sound in the dark room.
He made a conscious effort to improve his posture.
The patient became conscious minutes after the surgery.
cn: 她清醒地察觉到黑暗房间里每一个声响。
他刻意努力改善自己的姿势。
病人在手术后几分钟恢复了意识。

en: The patient regained consciousness after the surgery.
Environmental consciousness is growing among young people.
His writings explore the nature of human consciousness.
cn: 手术后，患者恢复了意识。
年轻人的环保意识正在增强。
他的著作探讨了人类意识的本质。

en: She nodded to show her consent.
The patient must consent to the surgery.
Silence does not imply consent.
cn: 她点头表示同意。
患者必须同意接受手术。
沉默不意味着同意。

definitions.definition: 结果，后果（由特定行为或事件引发）
重要性，重大意义（正式用法）

en: The economic consequences of the pandemic were severe.
His discovery was of great consequence to the scientific community.
She didn’t consider the consequences before acting.
cn: 新冠大流行的经济后果十分严重。
他的发现对科学界意义重大。
她行动前未考虑后果。

definitions.definition: 因此，所以（表示结果或推论）

en: The road was icy; consequently, many accidents occurred.
She studied diligently and consequently passed the exam with ease.
The company ignored market trends, consequently losing its competitive edge.
cn: 道路结冰，因此发生了多起事故。
她勤奋学习，所以轻松通过了考试。
该公司忽视了市场趋势，因而失去了竞争优势。

en: Wildlife conservation is crucial for maintaining biodiversity.
The law of energy conservation states that energy cannot be created or destroyed.
The museum focuses on the conservation of ancient artifacts.
cn: 野生动物保护对维持生物多样性至关重要。
能量守恒定律指出能量既不能被创造也不能被消灭。
该博物馆致力于古器物的保护工作。

definitions.definition: 保守主义者；保守派成员

en: His conservative views opposed radical social changes.
The party's conservative wing resisted the reform.
She dressed in a conservative style for the interview.
cn: 他的保守观点反对激进的社会变革。
该党的保守派抵制改革。
她面试时穿着风格保守。

en: Please consider my proposal before making a decision.
She is considered an expert in her field.
We need to consider all possible outcomes.
cn: 请在决定前考虑我的提议。
她被视为该领域的专家。
我们需要权衡所有可能的结果。

definitions.definition: 相当大（或多）的；值得考虑的

en: She has a considerable amount of experience in the field.
The project required a considerable investment of time.
There was a considerable difference between the two versions.
cn: 她在该领域拥有相当丰富的经验。
该项目需要投入大量时间。
两个版本之间存在显著差异。

en: She is always considerate of her colleagues' feelings.
It was considerate of you to bring an umbrella for me.
A considerate leader listens to team members' opinions.
cn: 她总是体谅同事的感受。
你为我带伞真是考虑周到。
体贴的领导者会倾听团队成员的意见。

en: After careful consideration, she accepted the job offer.
He showed no consideration for others' feelings.
Cost is an important consideration in this project.
cn: 经过慎重考虑，她接受了这份工作。
他毫不顾及他人的感受。
成本是该项目的重要考量因素。

definitions.definition: 由…组成（与 of 连用）
在于，存在于（与 in 连用）

en: The cake consists of flour, eggs, and sugar.
True leadership consists in inspiring others.
The committee consists of ten members.
cn: 这块蛋糕由面粉、鸡蛋和糖制成。
真正的领导力在于激励他人。
委员会由十名成员组成。

en: Her arguments were logically consistent.
He is consistent in his daily exercise routine.
The data shows consistent growth over the years.
cn: 她的论点逻辑上一致。
他坚持每日锻炼，始终如一。
数据显示多年来的持续增长。

en: The constant rain made the roads flood.
Speed of light is a fundamental constant in physics.
Her constant support helped me through difficult times.
cn: 持续的降雨导致道路积水。
光速是物理学中的基本常数。
她始终如一的支持帮我度过了艰难时期。

definitions.definition: 宪法（国家或组织的根本法律文件）
构成，组成（事物的基本结构或成分）
体质，体格（人的生理或心理状态）

en: The U.S. Constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
The constitution of this alloy makes it resistant to heat.
Regular exercise improves physical constitution.
cn: 美国宪法保障言论自由。
这种合金的组成使其耐高温。
规律锻炼能增强体质。

definitions.definition: 建造，构造（物理或抽象事物）
构想，概念（心理学或哲学中的理论模型）

en: The bridge was constructed in just two years.
Her argument is based on a flawed theoretical construct.
Children learn to construct sentences step by step.
cn: 这座桥仅用两年时间建成。
她的论点建立在一个有缺陷的理论模型上。
孩子们逐步学习造句。

definitions.definition: 建造，建筑（指过程或行业）
解释，理解（对文本或法律的解读）

en: The construction of the bridge took three years.
Her interpretation is a possible construction of the law.
The new museum is a steel-and-glass construction.
cn: 这座桥的建造耗时三年。
她的解读是对该法律的一种合理理解。
新博物馆是一座钢架玻璃结构的建筑。

en: She consulted a lawyer before signing the contract.
The team will consult with experts to solve the problem.
He always consults his notes before giving a speech.
cn: 她在签署合同前咨询了律师。
团队将与专家商议以解决问题。
他演讲前总会参考笔记。

definitions.definition: 消耗（资源、时间等）；吃/喝；使沉迷

en: The factory consumes 200 tons of coal monthly.
She was consumed by guilt after the accident.
The fire quickly consumed the wooden house.
cn: 这家工厂每月消耗200吨煤。
事故后，她被愧疚感吞噬。
大火迅速烧毁了木屋。

definitions.definition: 消耗，消费（尤指资源、能量或商品）
（旧）肺结核（因疾病消耗身体而得名）

en: The government aims to reduce energy consumption by 20%.
In the 19th century, consumption was a leading cause of death.
Excessive consumption of sugary drinks harms health.
cn: 政府计划将能源消耗降低20%。
19世纪时，肺结核是主要致死疾病之一。
过量饮用含糖饮料危害健康。

en: Avoid direct contact with the chemical.
She contacted the manager to discuss the project.
The two surfaces are in constant contact.
cn: 避免直接接触该化学品。
她联系了经理讨论项目。
这两个表面持续接触。

en: This box can contain up to 20 books.
She struggled to contain her excitement.
The report contains critical data about climate change.
cn: 这个盒子最多能装20本书。
她努力抑制内心的激动。
报告包含了关于气候变化的关键数据。

en: The glass container is labeled "fragile".
Shipping containers revolutionized global trade.
She reused the plastic container for storing rice.
cn: 玻璃容器上标有“易碎”字样。
集装箱彻底改变了全球贸易。
她重复利用塑料容器来储存大米。

en: Shakespeare and Cervantes were contemporary writers.
This museum focuses on contemporary art.
She is respected by her contemporaries in the field.
cn: 莎士比亚和塞万提斯是同时代的作家。
这家博物馆专注于当代艺术。
她受到该领域同龄人的尊敬。

en: She looked at him with undisguised contempt.
The judge held the protester in contempt of court.
His contempt for petty rules often got him into trouble.
cn: 她毫不掩饰地轻蔑地看着他。
法官裁定抗议者藐视法庭。
他对琐碎规则的蔑视常让他惹上麻烦。

en: She seemed content with her modest life.
The content of the book is highly technical.
A simple meal contented the hungry travelers.
cn: 她似乎对简朴的生活感到满足。
这本书的内容专业性很强。
一顿简单的饭就让饥饿的旅人们心满意足。

en: She won the poetry contest with her original composition.
The election results were hotly contested by the opposition.
The legal team will contest the patent infringement claim.
cn: 她在诗歌比赛中以原创作品获胜。
反对党对选举结果提出激烈质疑。
法律团队将对专利侵权指控提出抗辩。

definitions.definition: 自制的，克制的（行为或道德层面）

en: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
She was praised for being continent in her spending habits.
The continent shelves are rich in marine resources.
cn: 非洲是世界第二大洲。
她因克制的消费习惯受到称赞。
大陆架富含海洋资源。

definitions.definition: 连续的，频繁的（强调重复性，可能有短暂间隔）
持续的，不间断的（古旧用法，现多用 continuous）

en: The continual noise from construction site disturbed the neighborhood.
She made continual efforts to improve her coding skills.
Continual interruptions made the meeting inefficient.
cn: 建筑工地的持续噪音扰乱了整个街区。
她不断努力提升编程技能。
频繁的打断使得会议效率低下。

en: The rain will continue until tomorrow.
She decided to continue her studies abroad.
Press any key to continue the installation.
cn: 雨将持续到明天。
她决定继续在国外深造。
按任意键继续安装。

en: The rain continued in a continuous downpour all day.
The machine emits a continuous humming sound.
Her continuous efforts finally led to success.
cn: 雨水持续不断地倾泻了一整天。
这台机器发出持续的嗡嗡声。
她不懈的努力最终带来了成功。

definitions.definition: 签订合同；感染（疾病）；收缩

en: They signed a contract to build the new bridge.
Cold air causes metals to contract.
She contracted pneumonia during her trip.
cn: 他们签订了一份建造新桥的合同。
冷空气会导致金属收缩。
她在旅途中感染了肺炎。

definitions.definition: 矛盾（指陈述、观点或行为之间的对立）

en: His actions are in direct contradiction to his words.
The lawyer exposed a contradiction in the witness's testimony.
Life is full of contradictions, and that's what makes it interesting.
cn: 他的行为与言论直接矛盾。
律师揭露了证人证词中的矛盾之处。
生活充满矛盾，而这正是其有趣之处。

en: His actions were contrary to his words.
The ship sailed in a direction contrary to the wind.
She holds a contrary opinion on the issue.
cn: 他的言行不一。
船逆风航行。
她对这个问题持相反意见。

en: The contrast between light and shadow creates a dramatic effect.
She contrasted his optimism with her own cautious approach.
The data contrasts sharply with earlier findings.
cn: 光影对比营造出戏剧性效果。
她用自己谨慎的态度对比了他的乐观。
该数据与早先发现形成鲜明对比。

definitions.definition: 促成；投稿（常与 to 连用）

en: She contributed generously to the charity.
Fresh air contributes to good health.
He contributes articles to scientific journals.
cn: 她慷慨地向慈善机构捐款。
新鲜空气有助于健康。
他向科学期刊投稿。

en: The pilot struggled to control the plane during the storm.
Remote control devices have revolutionized home entertainment.
She took a deep breath to control her anger.
cn: 飞行员在暴风雨中艰难控制飞机。
遥控设备彻底改变了家庭娱乐方式。
她深吸一口气以抑制怒火。

en: Online shopping is valued for its convenience.
The hotel offers conveniences like free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour gym.
He chose the apartment for its convenience to public transport.
cn: 线上购物因其便利性而受到重视。
这家酒店提供免费Wi-Fi和24小时健身房等便利设施。
他选择这间公寓是因为它靠近公共交通，十分方便。

en: The hotel is convenient for the airport.
Online shopping is a convenient way to buy groceries.
Let’s find a convenient time to meet.
cn: 这家酒店去机场很方便。
网购是购买杂货的便捷方式。
我们找个合适的时间见面吧。

en: The annual tech convention attracts innovators worldwide.
Wearing black to funerals is a social convention in many cultures.
The Geneva Convention establishes rules for wartime conduct.
cn: 年度科技大会吸引了全球创新者。
葬礼穿黑衣是许多文化中的社会习俗。
《日内瓦公约》制定了战时行为准则。

en: She prefers conventional medicine over alternative therapies.
The army used conventional weapons in the exercise.
His views on marriage are quite conventional.
cn: 她更倾向于传统医学而非替代疗法。
军队在演习中使用了常规武器。
他对婚姻的看法相当传统。

en: We had a long conversation about climate change.
Her conversation skills make her a great negotiator.
The book captures the casual conversations of everyday life.
cn: 我们进行了一场关于气候变化的长时间对话。
她的交谈技巧使她成为出色的谈判者。
这本书捕捉了日常生活中的随意交谈。

en: Some people thrive under pressure; conversely, others perform poorly.
The drug may cure the disease, but conversely, it could cause severe side effects.
Southern summers are humid; conversely, the winters are dry.
cn: 有人在压力下表现出色，反之，另一些人则表现不佳。
这种药可能治愈疾病，但反过来也可能引发严重副作用。
南方的夏季潮湿，相反，冬季则干燥。

definitions.definition: 转变，转换（如信仰、用途、形式的改变）

en: His conversion to Buddhism surprised his family.
The conversion of the warehouse into apartments took two years.
Use this tool for PDF to Word conversion.
cn: 他皈依佛教的决定让家人惊讶。

Trust is at the core of any healthy relationship.

吃苹果前先去核。

The teacher corrected my pronunciation.
Please correct the typos in this document.
cn: 你的答案是正确的。
老师纠正了我的发音。

校正，调整（如数据、文本等）

该项目的预估费用是多少？

Many city dwellers dream of owning a countryside cottage.
cn: 他们在湖边租了一间迷人的小屋度过夏天。

cn: 她在会议中努力忍住咳嗽。

cn: 她年轻时能游过整个湖。
请问能把盐递给我吗？

节日期间游客挤满了街道。

definitions.definition: 为…加冕；表彰；使圆满结束

en: The queen wore a golden crown encrusted with jewels.
He was crowned champion after a thrilling final match.
The project was crowned with success after years of hard work.
cn: 女王戴着一顶镶满宝石的金王冠。
在一场激动人心的决赛后，他被加冕为冠军。
经过多年努力，这个项目圆满成功。

en: The country exports crude oil to neighboring nations.
His crude manners offended the guests at the party.
The artist's early sketches were crude but full of potential.
cn: 该国向邻国出口原油。
他粗鲁的举止冒犯了派对上的客人。
这位艺术家的早期草图虽粗糙，却充满潜力。

en: The cruel king executed his enemies without mercy.
It was cruel of her to mock his disability.
Nature can be cruel to animals in winter.
cn: 残忍的国王毫不留情地处决了他的敌人。
她嘲笑他的残疾，实在冷酷。
自然界在冬季可能对动物很残酷。

en: The machine can crush rocks into fine powder.
The rebellion was brutally crushed by the government.
She had a crush on her math teacher in high school.
cn: 这台机器能把石头碾成细粉。
叛乱被政府残酷镇压。
她高中时暗恋过数学老师。

en: The bread crust was perfectly golden and crisp.
Earth's crust is thinner under the oceans.
The wound began to crust over after a few days.
cn: 面包外皮金黄酥脆。
地壳在海洋下方较薄。
几天后伤口开始结痂。

en: The baby cried all night.
"Watch out!" he cried suddenly.
Her speech ended with a cry for justice.
cn: 婴儿整夜哭泣。
“小心！”他突然喊道。
她的演讲以一句正义的呼声结束。

definitions.definition: 水晶（指透明石英或装饰品）

en: Snowflakes are a form of crystal with unique hexagonal patterns.
She wore a necklace made of pure crystal.
The lake’s water was crystal clear in the morning light.
cn: 雪花是一种具有独特六边形图案的晶体。
她戴了一条纯水晶制成的项链。
晨光下，湖水清澈晶莹。

definitions.definition: 使成立方体；将……切成小方块

en: The child stacked the wooden cubes to build a tower.
Cube the potatoes before boiling them.
The volume of a cube is calculated by raising its side length to the third power.
cn: 孩子将木制立方体堆叠成一座塔。
将土豆切成小方块后再煮。
立方体的体积是边长的三次方。

en: The room has a cubic shape with equal length, width, and height.
The artist created a sculpture with intricate cubic patterns.
In algebra, a cubic equation involves variables raised to the third power.
cn: 这个房间呈立方体形状，长、宽、高相等。
艺术家制作了一件带有复杂立方体图案的雕塑。
在代数中，三次方程涉及变量的三次方。

definitions.definition: 黄瓜（一种长形、绿色、多汁的蔬菜）

en: She added sliced cucumber to her salad for extra crunch.
Cucumbers are mostly water, making them very hydrating.
The farmer grew cucumbers vertically to save space.
cn: 她在沙拉里加了黄瓜片以增加脆感。
黄瓜大部分是水分，因此非常解渴。
这位农民垂直种植黄瓜以节省空间。

en: Farmers cultivate the land to grow crops.
She cultivated a love of music through daily practice.
The program aims to cultivate leadership skills in young people.
cn: 农民耕种土地以种植作物。
她通过每日练习培养了对音乐的热爱。
该项目旨在培养年轻人的领导力。

definitions.definition: 文化（特定社会或群体的习俗、信仰、艺术等）
培养（微生物或细胞的培育过程）
培育（微生物或细胞）；培养（技能或品质）

en: Japanese culture values harmony and respect.
The scientist cultured bacteria in a petri dish.
Travel broadens one’s understanding of different cultures.
cn: 日本文化重视和谐与尊重。
科学家在培养皿中培育细菌。
旅行拓宽人们对不同文化的理解。

en: The fox is known for its cunning nature.
She used cunning to win the negotiation.
His cunning plan backfired in the end.
cn: 狐狸以狡猾的天性闻名。
她靠诡计赢得了谈判。
他狡猾的计划最终适得其反。

en: She poured tea into a porcelain cup.
The team won the championship cup last year.
Cup your hands to drink from the stream.
cn: 她将茶倒入瓷杯中。
这支队伍去年赢得了冠军奖杯。
双手捧成杯状从溪流中喝水。

en: She stored the china in the antique cupboard.
The sugar is in the cupboard above the sink.
He built a custom cupboard for the kitchen.
cn: 她把瓷器存放在古董橱柜里。
糖在水槽上方的橱柜里。
他为厨房定制了一个橱柜。

en: Scientists are working to find a cure for cancer.
Time cured her grief after the loss.
This new policy aims to cure social inequality.
cn: 科学家正致力于寻找治愈癌症的方法。
时间治愈了她失去亲人后的悲伤。
这项新政策旨在解决社会不平等问题。

en: Children have a natural curiosity about the world.
The museum's cabinet of curiosities fascinated visitors.
Scientific progress often begins with simple curiosity.
cn: 孩子们对世界有着天然的好奇心。
博物馆的奇珍柜让参观者着迷。
科学进步常始于单纯的好奇心。

en: The cat was curious about the new toy in the room.
She has a curious habit of collecting antique keys.
His curious mind led him to study astrophysics.
cn: 猫对房间里新出现的玩具感到好奇。
她有个奇怪的癖好：收集古董钥匙。
他的求知欲促使他研究天体物理学。

en: Her hair fell in natural curls over her shoulders.
The cat curled up by the fireplace.
He carefully curled the ribbon around the gift box.
cn: 她的头发自然卷曲垂落在肩上。
猫咪蜷缩在壁炉旁。
他小心地将丝带卷绕在礼物盒上。

en: The current situation requires immediate action.
Strong ocean currents can affect ship navigation.
This wire carries an electric current of 10 amps.
cn: 当前形势需要立即采取行动。
强烈的洋流会影响船舶航行。
这根导线承载10安培的电流。

en: The witch cast a curse on the village.
He cursed under his breath when he dropped the glass.
Gambling became a curse to his family.
cn: 女巫对村庄施了诅咒。
杯子摔碎时，他低声咒骂了一句。
赌博成了他家族的祸根。

en: She drew the curtains to block the sunlight.
The play began as the curtain rose slowly.
A curtain of fog hid the mountains from view.
cn: 她拉上窗帘遮挡阳光。
幕布缓缓升起，戏剧开场。
雾幕遮蔽了群山。

en: The road makes a sharp curve to the left.
She used a ruler to draw a smooth curve.
The tree branches curved under the weight of the snow.
cn: 道路向左急转弯。
她用尺子画了一条平滑的曲线。
树枝因积雪的重量而弯曲。

en: She placed a cushion behind her back for support.
The thick grass cushioned his fall.
His savings acted as a financial cushion during unemployment.
cn: 她在背后放了一个垫子作为支撑。
茂密的草减轻了他跌倒的冲击。
他的储蓄在失业期间起到了经济缓冲的作用。

en: It's a local custom to celebrate harvest with dancing.
We appreciate your continued custom over the years.
She ordered a custom dress for the wedding.
cn: 用舞蹈庆祝丰收是当地习俗。
我们感谢您多年来的持续惠顾。
她为婚礼订做了一条裙子。

definitions.definition: 顾客，客户（购买商品或服务的人）

en: The store offers discounts to loyal customers.
She's a regular customer at the local coffee shop.
Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
cn: 这家商店为忠实顾客提供折扣。
她是这家咖啡店的常客。
顾客满意度是我们的首要任务。

en: She cut the apple into thin slices.
The government plans to cut taxes next year.
This dress has a very flattering cut.
cn: 她把苹果切成薄片。
政府计划明年减税。
这条裙子的剪裁非常显身材。

en: The seasons follow a natural cycle.
She cycles to work every day.
The washing machine is stuck in a rinse cycle.
cn: 季节遵循自然循环。
她每天骑自行车上班。
洗衣机卡在了漂洗循环中。

en: She checks her email daily.
The Daily News reported the event.
Daily exercise improves overall health.
cn: 她每天查看电子邮件。
《每日新闻》报道了该事件。
每日锻炼能提升整体健康。

en: She bought fresh milk at the local dairy.
Vegan diets exclude all dairy products.
His family has run a dairy farm for generations.
cn: 她在本地乳品店买了新鲜牛奶。
纯素饮食不含任何乳制品。
他的家族世代经营奶牛场。

en: The beavers built a dam across the stream.
The government plans to dam the river for hydroelectric power.
She tried to dam her tears during the speech.
cn: 海狸在溪流上筑了一道水坝。
政府计划在河上筑坝以开发水电。
演讲时她努力抑制泪水。

en: The storm caused severe damage to the crops.
Smoking can damage your lungs over time.
The court awarded him $5,000 in damages.
cn: 风暴对庄稼造成了严重损害。
吸烟会逐渐损害你的肺部。
法院判给他5000美元赔偿金。

definitions.definition: 使潮湿；抑制（情绪、活动等）

en: The damp weather made the walls moldy.
She used a cloth to damp the dust before sweeping.
His criticism damped our enthusiasm.
cn: 潮湿的天气使墙壁发霉。
她用布先沾湿灰尘再清扫。
他的批评打击了我们的热情。

en: She loves to dance to classical music.
The school organized a dance for the students.
Leaves danced in the autumn wind.
cn: 她喜欢随着古典音乐跳舞。
学校为学生组织了一场舞会。
树叶在秋风中翩翩起舞。

en: The hikers were unaware of the danger ahead.
Smoking poses a serious danger to public health.
The suspect was charged with causing danger to life.
cn: 徒步者未意识到前方的危险。
吸烟对公共健康构成严重威胁。
嫌疑人被指控危害他人生命。

definitions.definition: 危险的，可能造成伤害的
（人或行为）有威胁的，令人不安的

en: The chemical leak created a dangerous situation for the neighborhood.
His reckless driving is becoming increasingly dangerous.
Climbing without proper equipment is highly dangerous.
cn: 化学品泄漏对社区造成了危险局面。
他鲁莽的驾驶行为越来越危险。
无适当装备攀爬极其危险。

en: She dared to speak up against the unfair policy.
"I dare you to jump into the lake!" he said with a grin.
It takes courage to dare the unknown.
cn: 她敢于发声反对不公正的政策。
“我赌你不敢跳进湖里！”他咧嘴笑着说。
挑战未知需要勇气。

en: His daring rescue of the child impressed everyone.
The project requires both creativity and daring.
She gave him a daring smile before jumping off the cliff.
cn: 他勇敢救出孩子的行为打动了所有人。
这个项目需要创造力与冒险精神。
她在跳下悬崖前给了他一个大胆的微笑。

en: The room was pitch dark after the power outage.
She prefers dark chocolate to milk chocolate.
Fear of the dark is common in children.
cn: 停电后房间一片漆黑。
她更喜欢黑巧克力而非牛奶巧克力。
怕黑在儿童中很常见。

definitions.definition: 心爱的人，亲爱的（用于称呼亲密的人）

en: She whispered, "Goodnight, darling."
The darling puppy won everyone's heart.
He's the darling of the media for his witty remarks.
cn: 她轻声说：“晚安，亲爱的。”
那只可爱的小狗赢得了所有人的心。
他因机智言论成为媒体宠儿。

en: She dashed across the street to catch the bus.
Add a dash of salt to the soup for flavor.
The waves dashed against the rocks, sending spray into the air.
cn: 她冲过马路去赶公交车。
往汤里加少许盐调味。
海浪拍打着岩石，水花四溅。

definitions.definition: 数据（事实或统计信息的集合）

en: The research team analyzed the data from the climate sensors.
Personal data should be protected under privacy laws.
The model predicts future trends based on historical data.
cn: 研究团队分析了气候传感器的数据。
个人数据应受隐私法保护。
该模型根据历史数据预测未来趋势。

definitions.definition: 注明日期；确定年代；约会

en: The letter was dated January 15th.
They’ve been dating for six months.
This artifact dates back to the Bronze Age.
cn: 这封信的日期是1月15日。
他们已经约会六个月了。
这件文物可追溯至青铜时代。

en: She is the youngest daughter in the family.
The king's daughter inherited the throne.
Her daughter just started elementary school.
cn: 她是家里最小的女儿。
国王的女儿继承了王位。
她的女儿刚上小学。

definitions.definition: 破晓；开始出现，逐渐明白

en: The first light of dawn painted the sky in hues of pink and gold.
A new era of technology is about to dawn.
It suddenly dawned on her that she had forgotten her keys.
cn: 黎明的第一缕曙光将天空染成粉金色。
一个崭新的科技时代即将来临。
她突然意识到自己忘了带钥匙。

definitions.definition: 时期，时代（如 in my day）

en: She spends her day reading and gardening.
The days are longer in summer.
In his day, people traveled by horse.
cn: 她的一天在阅读和园艺中度过。
夏季的白天更长。
在他那个时代，人们骑马出行。

en: The room was filled with soft daylight.
The investigation brought the scandal into daylight.
Plants need adequate daylight to grow.
cn: 房间里洒满柔和的日光。
调查将丑闻公之于众。
植物需要充足的日光才能生长。

en: The flowers in the vase are dead.
He felt dead inside after the loss.
The phone's battery is completely dead.
cn: 花瓶里的花已经枯萎。
失去后，他内心感到麻木。
手机电池彻底没电了。

en: The snake's venom is deadly to humans.
She was deadly serious about her decision.
The two cars collided with deadly force.
cn: 这种蛇的毒液对人类是致命的。
她对这一决定极其认真。
两辆车以致命的冲击力相撞。

en: The deaf child communicates through sign language.
He turned a deaf ear to all warnings.
Deaf awareness campaigns promote inclusivity.
cn: 这个聋哑儿童通过手语交流。
他对所有警告充耳不闻。
聋人意识倡导活动推动社会包容性。

definitions.definition: 处理；应对（与 with 连用）

en: They made a deal to share the profits equally.
She knows how to deal with difficult customers.
The teacher dealt the worksheets to the class.
cn: 他们达成协议，平分利润。
她懂得如何应对难缠的顾客。
老师将作业纸分发给全班。

en: She kept the letters from her dear grandmother.
The necklace was too dear for me to buy.
"Dear Sir," he began the formal letter.
cn: 她保存着亲爱的祖母的来信。
这条项链太贵了，我买不起。
“尊敬的先生，”他以正式信函的开头写道。

en: The death of the ancient language saddened linguists.
She faced death with remarkable courage.
The accident resulted in three deaths.
cn: 这种古老语言的消亡让语言学家感到悲伤。
她以非凡的勇气面对死亡。
事故导致三人死亡。

en: The candidates will debate on national television tonight.
She debated whether to accept the job offer.
The issue sparked a heated debate among scientists.
cn: 候选人今晚将在全国电视节目中进行辩论。
她仔细考虑是否接受这份工作邀请。
该问题引发了科学家们的激烈讨论。

en: He struggled to pay off his student debt.
I owe you a debt of gratitude for your help.
National debt has become a global economic issue.
cn: 他艰难地偿还学生贷款。
我欠你一份人情，感谢你的帮助。
国债已成为全球经济问题。

en: The invention revolutionized the industry in the last decade.
She plans to achieve financial independence within a decade.
The city's population grew rapidly during the first decade of the 21st century.
cn: 这项发明在过去十年彻底改变了该行业。
她计划在十年内实现财务自由。
21世纪的前十年，该市人口快速增长。

en: The abandoned house showed signs of decay.
Sugar can cause tooth decay if not cleaned properly.
Ancient civilizations often rose and decayed over centuries.
cn: 这座废弃的房屋显露出腐烂的痕迹。
如果不及时清洁，糖分会导致牙齿蛀蚀。
古代文明常在数百年间兴起又衰败。

en: His deceit was uncovered when the forged documents were examined.
She used deceit to gain their trust, then stole their money.
The politician’s career was ruined by a web of lies and deceit.
cn: 他的欺骗行为在伪造文件被检查时暴露了。
她用诡计取得他们的信任，然后偷走了他们的钱。
这位政治家的职业生涯因谎言与欺骗的罗网而毁于一旦。

en: He tried to deceive the public with false promises.
Appearances can often deceive.
She deceived herself into thinking he would change.
cn: 他试图用虚假承诺欺骗公众。
外表常常具有欺骗性。
她自欺欺人地以为他会改变。

definitions.definition: 十二月（公历第十二个月）

en: Christmas is celebrated on the 25th of December.
December marks the end of the fiscal year in many companies.
The weather in December is usually cold in the northern hemisphere.
cn: 圣诞节在12月25日庆祝。
十二月是许多公司财年的结束。
北半球的十二月通常很寒冷。

en: She wore a decent dress to the formal event.
The food was decent, though not exceptional.
He’s a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
cn: 她穿了一件得体的裙子参加正式活动。
食物还不错，尽管不算出色。
他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

en: She couldn't decide between the two job offers.
The judge will decide the case next week.
Let's put it to a vote and decide democratically.
cn: 她在两份工作邀约间难以抉择。
法官将于下周对此案作出裁决。
我们投票以民主方式决定吧。

en: The committee reached a unanimous decision after hours of debate.
She acted with remarkable decision in the crisis.
Making a career decision requires careful consideration.
cn: 委员会经过数小时辩论后达成一致决定。
她在危机中表现得极其果断。
职业选择需要慎重考虑。

definitions.definition: 甲板（船或飞机的露天平台）
装饰；打扮（非正式用法，如 "deck out"）

en: The crew gathered on the deck to watch the sunset.
She shuffled the deck before dealing the cards.
They decked the hall with lights for the party.
cn: 船员们聚集在甲板上观看日落。
她发牌前先洗了洗牌。
他们用灯光装饰大厅以准备派对。

en: The president declared a state of emergency.
You must declare all taxable income at customs.
The committee declared against the proposed policy.
cn: 总统宣布进入紧急状态。
你必须在海关申报所有应税收入。
委员会表态反对提议的政策。

en: She decorated the room with fresh flowers for the party.
The soldier was decorated for bravery in battle.
They decorated the Christmas tree with colorful lights.
cn: 她为派对用鲜花装饰了房间。
这名士兵因战斗中的英勇表现被授予勋章。
他们用彩灯装饰了圣诞树。

en: The government plans to decrease taxes next year.
A steady decrease in temperature was recorded overnight.
Regular exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
cn: 政府计划明年减税。
夜间气温持续下降。
定期锻炼可降低心脏病风险。

definitions.definition: 推论，演绎（通过逻辑推理得出结论）

en: From the evidence, we can deduce that the suspect was left-handed.
Sherlock Holmes deduced the murderer's identity by observing tiny details.
The scientist deduced a new theory from experimental data.
cn: 根据证据，我们可以推断嫌疑人是左撇子。
福尔摩斯通过观察细微线索推断出凶手身份。
科学家从实验数据中推导出新理论。

definitions.definition: 行为，行动（尤指英勇或高尚的）
契约，法律文件（尤指房产转让）

en: His brave deed saved the child from drowning.
The deed to the house was signed and notarized.
Kind deeds often go unnoticed, but they matter.
cn: 他的英勇行为拯救了溺水的孩子。
房产契约已签署并公证。
善行常被忽视，但它们很重要。

en: The divers explored the deep ocean trenches.
Her love for poetry comes from a deep appreciation of language.
He sighed deeply after hearing the news.
cn: 潜水员探索了深邃的海沟。
她对诗歌的热爱源于对语言的深刻理解。
听到消息后，他深深地叹了口气。

en: The diver used weights to deepen his descent.
Their conversation helped deepen their friendship.
The shadows deepen as the sun sets.
cn: 潜水员用配重加快下潜深度。
他们的交谈让友谊更加深厚。
日落时阴影渐浓。

en: The deer gracefully leaped over the fallen log.
Deer populations are thriving in this protected forest.
In winter, deer often come closer to human settlements in search of food.
cn: 鹿轻盈地跃过倒下的树干。
这片受保护的森林中鹿群繁盛。
冬季时，鹿常会靠近人类居住区觅食。

en: The army defeated the invaders after a long battle.
She refused to accept defeat and tried again.
Overconfidence can lead to defeat.
cn: 军队在长期战斗后击败了入侵者。
她拒绝接受失败，再次尝试。
过度自信可能导致失败。

en: The manufacturer recalled the product due to a defect in the design.
He defected to a rival company last year.
Her attention to detail helps her spot even the smallest defect.
cn: 制造商因设计缺陷召回产品。
他去年叛逃到了竞争对手公司。
她对细节的关注使她能发现最微小的瑕疵。

definitions.definition: 防御，防护；防御手段，防御物

en: The castle's strong walls provided an excellent defence against the invading army.
The lawyer presented a compelling defence for his client.
Their team's defence is the best in the league.
cn: 城堡坚固的城墙为抵御入侵军队提供了极好的防御。
律师为他的当事人进行了令人信服的辩护。
他们队伍的防守是联赛中最好的。

en: The soldiers defended the castle against the invaders.
She defended her thesis with strong evidence.
This vaccine helps defend the body from infections.
cn: 士兵们守卫城堡抵御入侵者。
她用有力证据为论文辩护。
这种疫苗帮助身体防御感染。

en: The dictionary defines "altruism" as selfless concern for others.
Scientists are working to define the boundaries of the black hole.
Her leadership style defines clarity and decisiveness.
cn: 词典将“利他主义”定义为无私关心他人。
科学家正努力划定黑洞的边界。
她的领导风格以清晰果断为特色。

en: She gave a definite answer without hesitation.
The experiment produced definite results.
We need a definite plan before starting the project.
cn: 她毫不犹豫地给出了明确答复。
实验得出了确切的结果。
在启动项目前，我们需要一个明确的计划。

en: She definitely wants to join the project.
This is definitely the best solution.
The meeting will definitely start at 9 AM.
cn: 她明确想加入这个项目。
这无疑是最佳解决方案。
会议肯定会在上午9点开始。

definitions.definition: 定义（对词语或概念的精确解释）
清晰度（图像或声音的细节表现）

en: The dictionary provides a clear definition of the term.
High-definition TVs display images with exceptional detail.
Her speech lacked definition, leaving the audience confused.
cn: 词典给出了该术语的明确定义。
高清电视能呈现细节丰富的图像。
她的演讲定义模糊，让听众感到困惑。

en: She holds a master's degree in environmental science.
The temperature dropped by ten degrees overnight.
His honesty varies in degree depending on the situation.
cn: 她拥有环境科学硕士学位。
气温一夜之间下降了十度。
他的诚实程度因情境而异。

en: Heavy traffic caused a significant delay.
Don’t delay submitting your application.
The project was delayed due to funding issues.
cn: 交通拥堵造成了严重延误。
不要拖延提交申请。
该项目因资金问题被推迟。

en: Press Delete to remove the selected file.
The editor decided to delete the controversial paragraph.
Deleted items are moved to the Recycle Bin temporarily.
cn: 按删除键移除选中的文件。
编辑决定删去有争议的段落。
被删除的项目会暂时移至回收站。

definitions.definition: 代表团（一组被委派的人员）

en: The delegation from Japan arrived for the climate summit.
Effective delegation improves team productivity.
She accepted the delegation of managerial duties.
cn: 日本代表团抵达参加气候峰会。
有效授权能提升团队效率。
她接受了管理职责的委托。

en: The delicate porcelain vase shattered when it fell.
Negotiating the contract required delicate handling.
Her skin was so delicate that sunlight easily burned it.
cn: 那只精致的瓷花瓶掉落时摔碎了。
谈判合同需要谨慎处理。
她的皮肤非常娇嫩，阳光一晒就会灼伤。

en: The cake was so delicious that everyone asked for a second slice.
She shared a delicious piece of gossip with us.
The aroma of freshly baked bread is absolutely delicious.
cn: 这块蛋糕太美味了，每个人都要求再来一块。
她跟我们分享了一个有趣的八卦。
新鲜出炉的面包香气令人陶醉。

en: The children's laughter filled the room with delight.
She was delighted by the unexpected gift.
Cooking is a constant delight to him.
cn: 孩子们的欢笑让房间充满喜悦。
意外的礼物让她欣喜不已。
烹饪总能带给他持续的快乐。

definitions.definition: 解救，释放（古义/宗教语境）

en: The courier will deliver the package by noon.
She delivered a powerful speech on climate change.
The hero delivered the villagers from the dragon's terror.
cn: 快递员将在中午前送达包裹。
她就气候变化发表了强有力的演讲。
英雄将村民从恶龙的恐惧中解救出来。

en: The postal service guarantees next-day delivery for urgent packages.
She practiced her speech to improve her delivery.
The hospital has a special ward for emergency deliveries.
cn: 邮政服务保证次日送达紧急包裹。
她反复练习演讲以提升表达效果。
医院设有紧急分娩专用病房。

en: The workers demanded higher wages.
There is a growing demand for renewable energy.
She demanded an explanation for the delay.
cn: 工人们要求加薪。
对可再生能源的需求日益增长。
她要求对延误作出解释。

en: Ancient Athens is often called the birthplace of democracy.
The country transitioned from a monarchy to a democracy in the 20th century.
True democracy requires active participation from citizens.
cn: 古希腊雅典常被称为民主的发源地。
该国在20世纪从君主制过渡为民主制。
真正的民主需要公民的积极参与。

en: The country has a democratic government elected by the people.
She believes in democratic principles like freedom of speech.
The school promotes a democratic approach to decision-making.
cn: 这个国家有一个由人民选举产生的民主政府。
她信奉言论自由等民主原则。
学校倡导民主决策的方式。

definitions.definition: 证明；展示（通过证据或行动）

en: The scientist demonstrated the theory with a simple experiment.
Thousands gathered to demonstrate against the new law.
Her smile demonstrated her relief.
cn: 科学家用一个简单实验证明了该理论。
数千人聚集示威反对新法律。
她的笑容显示出她的放松。

definitions.definition: （信息或文字）难理解的；晦涩的

en: The dense forest blocked sunlight from reaching the ground.
Her essay was so dense that I had to read it three times.
Tokyo is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.
cn: 茂密的森林阻挡了阳光照射到地面。
她的文章过于晦涩，我不得不读了三遍。
东京是世界上人口密度最高的城市之一。

en: The density of the forest made it difficult to walk through.
Scientists measure the density of a substance to understand its properties.
Population density is higher in urban areas than in rural ones.
cn: 森林的茂密使得穿行变得困难。
科学家通过测量物质的密度来理解其特性。
城市地区的人口密度高于农村。

en: The suspect denied all charges against him.
She was denied entry to the country due to invalid documents.
He can't deny the fact that he benefited from the system.
cn: 被告否认了所有对他的指控。
她因证件无效被拒绝入境。
他无法否认自己从该制度中获益的事实。

en: The train will depart from platform 3 at 6 PM.
His speech departed from the main topic frequently.
We departed in silence, each lost in thought.
cn: 列车将于下午6点从3号站台出发。
他的演讲频繁偏离主题。
我们默默离开，各自陷入沉思。

definitions.definition: （政府、企业等的）部门；科系（大学）

en: She works in the marketing department of a tech company.
The university has a renowned physics department.
The French department of Hauts-de-Seine is near Paris.
cn: 她在一家科技公司的市场部工作。
这所大学拥有著名的物理系。
上塞纳省是法国靠近巴黎的行政区。

en: The train's departure was delayed by 30 minutes.
His new theory is a radical departure from tradition.
We said our goodbyes at the departure gate.
cn: 火车出发时间延误了30分钟。
他的新理论是对传统的彻底背离。
我们在登机口道别。

definitions.definition: 取决于（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: Children depend on their parents for support.
The success of the project depends on teamwork.
The decision depends entirely on your answer.
cn: 孩子依赖父母的抚养。
项目的成功取决于团队合作。
决定完全取决于你的答复。

definitions.definition: 受抚养者，依赖他人生活的人

en: Children are usually dependent on their parents for financial support.
The country aims to reduce its dependent relationship on fossil fuels.
She listed her two grandchildren as dependents on her tax form.
cn: 儿童通常在经济上依赖父母。
该国致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖关系。
她在税表中将两个孙辈列为受抚养人。

en: She deposited her savings in a high-interest account.
The river deposits layers of silt during floods.
A security deposit is required before moving in.
cn: 她将存款存入一个高利息账户。
洪水期间，河流会沉积层层淤泥。
入住前需支付押金。

en: The bad news depressed her for days.
Depress the lever to start the machine.
Rising inflation may further depress the economy.
cn: 这个坏消息让她消沉了好几天。
按下操纵杆启动机器。
通胀上升可能加剧经济萧条。

en: The depth of the ocean is still largely unexplored.
Her poem shows a remarkable depth of emotion.
Measure the depth of the shelf before installing it.
cn: 海洋的深度仍大部分未被探索。
她的诗歌展现了非凡的情感深度。
安装前先测量搁板的纵深。

definitions.definition: 获得，源自（从某事物中取得或推论）
起源，衍生（常与 from 连用）

en: Many English words derive from Latin.
She derived great pleasure from reading.
The theory derives its name from the scientist who proposed it.
cn: 许多英语词汇源自拉丁语。
她从阅读中获得极大乐趣。
该理论以其提出者的名字命名。

en: The airplane began to descend toward the runway.
His mood descended into gloom after the bad news.
She descended the stairs slowly, holding the railing.
cn: 飞机开始向跑道下降。
听到坏消息后，他的情绪陷入低落。
她扶着栏杆，缓缓走下楼梯。

en: She asked him to describe the accident in detail.
The artist described a circle on the canvas with quick strokes.
The term "Renaissance" describes a period of cultural rebirth in Europe.
cn: 她让他详细描述事故经过。
艺术家用快速笔触在画布上勾勒出一个圆形。
“文艺复兴”一词描述了欧洲文化复兴的时期。

definitions.definition: 类型，种类（如“of every description”指“各式各样的”）

en: Her description of the event was incredibly detailed.
The museum has artifacts of every description.
The police asked for a description of the suspect.
cn: 她对事件的描述极其详尽。
博物馆收藏了各式各样的文物。
警方要求提供嫌疑人的体貌特征。

en: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
Soldiers who desert their posts during war face severe penalties.
Many plants have adapted to survive in the desert.
cn: 撒哈拉是世界上最大的炎热沙漠。
战争期间擅离职守的士兵将面临严厉惩罚。
许多植物已进化出在沙漠中生存的能力。

definitions.definition: 应得，值得（指因行为、品质或成就而获得回报或惩罚）

en: She worked hard and deserves a promotion.
His rude behavior deserves an apology.
This ancient temple deserves to be preserved.
cn: 她努力工作，理应得到晋升。
他的粗鲁行为应该道歉。
这座古庙值得保护。

en: The architect presented a bold design for the new museum.
She designs sustainable clothing using recycled materials.
The course teaches the basic principles of graphic design.
cn: 建筑师为新博物馆提交了一个大胆的设计方案。
她利用回收材料设计可持续服装。
这门课程教授平面设计的基本原则。

definitions.definition: 值得拥有的；合意的；性感的
令人向往的事物（罕见用法）

en: The house has many desirable features, such as a large garden.
She wore a desirable red dress to the party.
Job security is highly desirable in uncertain economic times.
cn: 这栋房子有许多诱人的特点，比如大花园。
她穿了一条令人心动的红色连衣裙参加派对。
在经济不稳定时期，工作保障非常令人向往。

en: She has a burning desire to travel the world.
The novel explores human desires and fears.
He desired nothing more than her happiness.
cn: 她怀有周游世界的炽热愿望。
这部小说探讨了人类的欲望与恐惧。
他唯一渴望的是她的幸福。

en: She left her glasses on the desk.
Please check in at the front desk.
The teacher’s desk was covered with papers.
cn: 她把眼镜忘在了书桌上。
请在前台办理登记。
老师的办公桌上堆满了文件。

en: She sank into despair after losing her job.
Never despair, even in the darkest hour.
His voice trembled with quiet despair.
cn: 失业后，她陷入绝望。
即使在最黑暗的时刻，也绝不要绝望。
他的声音因无声的绝望而颤抖。

en: The refugees were in desperate need of food and water.
He made a desperate attempt to save the drowning child.
Her voice sounded desperate when she called for help.
cn: 难民们极度需要食物和水。
他孤注一掷地试图救起溺水的孩子。
她呼救时声音里透着绝望。

en: She despised his cowardice.
The artist despised commercial compromises.
Don't despise small beginnings.
cn: 她鄙视他的懦弱。
这位艺术家蔑视商业妥协。
勿因起点渺小而轻视。

definitions.definition: 尽管，不管（表示让步关系）
轻蔑，侮辱（古旧用法，现代罕见）

en: She persevered despite the difficulties.
Despite the rain, the event was well-attended.
He helped me despite our past disagreements.
cn: 她不顾困难坚持了下来。
尽管下雨，活动仍有很多人参加。
尽管我们过去有分歧，他还是帮助了我。

en: The train's final destination is Paris.
Hard work is the destination of success.
After years of research, she reached her destination: a cure for the disease.
cn: 这列火车的终点站是巴黎。
努力是成功的必由之路。
经过多年研究，她实现了目标：找到治愈这种疾病的方法。

definitions.definition: 消灭（抽象事物，如希望、计划）

en: The hurricane destroyed the entire coastal village.
His betrayal destroyed her trust in relationships.
The government plans to destroy all stockpiles of chemical weapons.
cn: 飓风摧毁了整个沿海村庄。
他的背叛彻底摧毁了她对人际关系的信任。
政府计划销毁所有化学武器库存。

en: The hurricane caused widespread destruction along the coast.
Overuse of pesticides leads to the destruction of soil fertility.
The documentary exposed the destruction of ancient artifacts by looters.
cn: 飓风在沿海地区造成了大规模破坏。
过度使用杀虫剂会导致土壤肥力被彻底破坏。
这部纪录片揭露了掠夺者对古代文物的毁坏行为。

en: She explained the plan in great detail.
The report details the causes of the accident.
Pay attention to the small details in the contract.
cn: 她详细解释了计划。
报告详述了事故原因。
注意合同中的细小条款。

definitions.definition: 发现，察觉（隐藏或细微的事物）

en: The test can detect early signs of cancer.
The radar detected an unknown object approaching.
She detected a hint of sarcasm in his voice.
cn: 该检测能发现癌症的早期迹象。
雷达探测到一个不明物体正在接近。
她察觉到他语气中的一丝讽刺。

en: Early detection of cancer significantly improves survival rates.
The device uses infrared technology for motion detection.
Her keen detection of the error saved the project from failure.
cn: 癌症的早期检测极大提高存活率。
该设备利用红外技术进行运动探测。
她敏锐地发现了错误，避免了项目失败。

en: Her determination to succeed impressed everyone.
The court’s determination will affect future cases.
With sheer determination, he finished the marathon despite his injury.
cn: 她成功的决心令所有人印象深刻。
法院的裁定将影响未来的案件。
凭借纯粹的毅力，他带伤完成了马拉松。

en: The jury will determine the outcome of the case.
Her advice determined me to pursue further studies.
The contract determines automatically after five years.
cn: 陪审团将决定案件的结果。
她的建议使我下定决心继续深造。
该合同五年后自动终止。

en: The company plans to develop a new software next year.
Children develop quickly in their early years.
The photograph will develop in about ten minutes.
cn: 公司计划明年开发一款新软件。
儿童在幼年时期成长迅速。
照片大约十分钟后显影完成。

en: The rapid development of technology has changed our lives.
This land is reserved for commercial development.
Early childhood development is crucial for future learning.
cn: 科技的快速发展改变了我们的生活。
这片土地预留作商业开发用途。
幼儿早期发展对未来的学习至关重要。

definitions.definition: 装置；设备（如电子设备或机械工具）
方法；策略（尤指巧妙的设计或计划）

en: The new device can detect air pollution in real time.
She used a clever device to solve the puzzle.
Marketing devices like slogans are essential for brand recognition.
cn: 这款新设备能实时检测空气污染。
她用了一个巧妙的方法解开谜题。
口号等营销策略对品牌认知至关重要。

en: The painter depicted the devil with horns and a tail.
Don’t blame the devil for your bad choices.
Her little brother is a devil who hides her shoes.
cn: 画家将魔鬼描绘成有角和尾巴的形象。
不要为自己的错误选择怪罪魔鬼。
她弟弟是个藏她鞋子的淘气鬼。

en: She devised a clever strategy to win the competition.
The engineer devised a new method to recycle plastic.
The property was left to him by devise.
cn: 她设计了一个聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
这位工程师发明了一种回收塑料的新方法。
这笔财产是通过遗赠留给他的。

en: She decided to devote her life to medical research.
The museum devotes a section to local artists.
He devoted every weekend to volunteering at the shelter.
cn: 她决定毕生致力于医学研究。
博物馆专设一个展区介绍本地艺术家。
他将每个周末都用于在收容所做志愿者。

definitions.definition: 露水（空气中水蒸气在低温物体表面凝结成的小水滴）

en: The grass was sparkling with morning dew.
Dew forms when the temperature drops at night.
She wiped the dew off the car windshield.
cn: 晨露点缀着草地，闪闪发光。
夜间气温下降时，露水便形成了。
她擦去了汽车挡风玻璃上的露水。

en: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
This app helps you diagram complex processes easily.
The manual includes a wiring diagram for the device.
cn: 老师画了一张图表来解释水循环。
这个应用能帮你轻松用图表表示复杂流程。
手册中包含该设备的接线图。

en: She adjusted the dial on the radio to find a clearer station.
The old telephone required users to dial each number manually.
The sundial's dial was marked with Roman numerals.
cn: 她调节收音机的旋钮以找到更清晰的频道。
老式电话需要用户手动拨号。
日晷的表盘上标有罗马数字。

definitions.definition: 方言（某地区或群体的特有语言变体）
行话（特定领域的术语或表达方式）

en: The local dialect has unique words not found in standard English.
Linguists study dialects to understand cultural diversity.
Technical fields often develop their own dialects.
cn: 当地方言含有标准英语中没有的独特词汇。
语言学家研究方言以理解文化多样性。
技术领域常发展出自身的行话体系。

en: The novel uses dialog to reveal the characters' personalities.
A constructive dialog between the two countries is essential for peace.
The play's witty dialog kept the audience engaged.
cn: 这部小说通过对话展现人物性格。
两国间的建设性对话对和平至关重要。
剧中机智的对白让观众全神贯注。

definitions.definition: 直径（几何学中通过圆心的直线长度）
直径长度（泛指圆形或圆柱体的宽度）

en: The diameter of the Earth is about 12,742 kilometers.
Measure the diameter of the pipe before buying a replacement.
In his experiment, he calculated the diameter of each droplet.
cn: 地球的直径约为12,742公里。
购买替换件前，先测量管道的直径。
实验中，他计算了每个液滴的直径。

en: She wore a necklace set with a brilliant diamond.
The playing card suit of diamonds is represented by a red rhombus.
Diamond blades are used to cut through hard materials.
cn: 她戴了一条镶有璀璨钻石的项链。
扑克牌中的“方块”花色以红色菱形表示。
金刚石刀片用于切割坚硬材料。

en: She keeps a diary to record her thoughts.
The explorer's diary revealed unknown details of the journey.
I bought a leather-bound diary for the new year.
cn: 她坚持写日记来记录自己的想法。
探险家的日志揭示了旅程中不为人知的细节。
我为新年买了一本皮面记事簿。

en: The manager dictated a letter to his assistant.
No one has the right to dictate how others should live.
The treaty was dictated by the victorious nations.
cn: 经理向助理口述了一封信。
无人有权命令他人该如何生活。
条约由战胜国强加制定。

definitions.definition: 听写（口述内容由他人记录）

en: The teacher gave a French dictation to test our spelling.
He resented the constant dictation of his boss.
Dictation software converts spoken words into text.
cn: 老师进行了法语听写来测试我们的拼写。
他厌恶老板不断的发号施令。
听写软件将口语转换为文字。

en: She checked the dictionary for the meaning of "serendipity".
This medical dictionary covers terms from ancient to modern practices.
A good dictionary is a writer's best friend.
cn: 她查字典寻找“serendipity”的含义。
这本医学词典涵盖从古代到现代的术语。
一本好词典是作家最好的朋友。

en: Flowers die without water.
He rolled the die and got a six.
Ancient languages never truly die; they evolve.
cn: 花朵缺水便会凋零。
他掷出骰子，得到六点。
古老的语言从未真正消亡，而是不断演变。

en: The two theories differ in their approach to the problem.
We differ on how to interpret the data.
Cultural values may differ significantly across regions.
cn: 这两种理论在解决问题的方法上有所不同。
我们对数据的解读方式存在分歧。
文化价值观可能因地区差异而显著不同。

en: The main difference between the two models is the battery life.
She calculated the difference between the two numbers quickly.
Cultural differences can lead to misunderstandings if not addressed properly.
cn: 两款机型的主要区别在于电池续航。
她迅速算出了两个数字的差额。
文化差异若处理不当，可能导致误解。

en: The two sisters have completely different personalities.
She chose a different path from her peers.
His approach to problem-solving is refreshingly different.
cn: 这对姐妹的性格截然不同。
她选择了一条与同龄人不同的道路。
他解决问题的方式与众不同，令人耳目一新。

en: The exam questions were extremely difficult.
She can be difficult when she's tired.
Solving this puzzle is more difficult than it looks.
cn: 考试题目极其困难。
她疲惫时会变得难以相处。
解开这个谜题比看起来更难。

en: She overcame the difficulty with determination.
The math problem posed a great difficulty for the students.
Financial difficulties forced him to change his plans.
cn: 她凭借决心克服了困难。
这道数学题对学生来说是个大难题。
经济困境迫使他改变了计划。

en: The dog loves to dig holes in the backyard.
Archaeologists will dig at this site next month.
I really dig this new jazz album.
cn: 这只狗喜欢在后院挖洞。
考古学家下月将在此遗址挖掘。
我非常喜欢这张新爵士专辑。

definitions.definition: 消化（食物）；理解吸收（信息）

en: It takes hours for the body to digest a heavy meal.
She paused to digest the shocking news.
The magazine publishes a monthly digest of research papers.
cn: 身体需要数小时消化一顿大餐。
她停下来试图理解这个令人震惊的消息。
该杂志每月发布研究论文摘要。

definitions.definition: 数字的；数码的（与模拟信号相对）
手指的；趾的（古义，现少用）

en: The camera captures images in digital format.
Ancient cultures used digital counting methods.
She prefers digital books over printed ones.
cn: 这台相机以数字格式捕捉图像。
古代文化曾用手指计数。
比起纸质书，她更喜欢电子书。

definitions.definition: 细致认真的（强调持续专注）

en: She is a diligent student who always completes her assignments ahead of time.
The team made diligent efforts to ensure the project's accuracy.
His diligent research laid the foundation for the breakthrough.
cn: 她是个勤奋的学生，总提前完成作业。
团队细致努力以确保项目精确性。
他刻苦的研究为突破奠定了基础。

en: The room was too dim to read without a lamp.
Her memories of childhood had dimmed over time.
He dimmed the lights to create a cozy atmosphere.
cn: 房间太暗，不开灯无法阅读。
她对童年的记忆随时间流逝变得模糊。
他调暗灯光以营造舒适的氛围。

en: The model calculates the fourth dimension of spacetime.
The room’s dimensions are 5 meters by 4 meters.
Her research adds a new dimension to the debate.
cn: 该模型计算了时空的第四维度。
房间的尺寸是5米乘4米。
她的研究为辩论增添了新的视角。

en: We usually have dinner at 7 p.m.
The company hosted a formal dinner for its clients.
Sunday dinner is a special tradition in our family.
cn: 我们通常晚上7点吃晚餐。
公司为客户举办了一场正式晚宴。
周日正餐是我们家的特殊传统。

en: She dipped her fingers in the water to test the temperature.
The road dips sharply after the bridge.
This spicy dip pairs well with tortilla chips.
cn: 她将手指浸入水中试探温度。
过桥后路面陡然下降。
这款辣味蘸酱与玉米片很配。

en: The manager directed the team to focus on customer feedback.
She gave me a direct answer without hesitation.
This road directs travelers to the historic center.
cn: 经理指导团队专注于客户反馈。
她毫不犹豫地给了我一个直率的回答。
这条路将游客引向历史中心。

en: The hikers lost their direction in the dense forest.
Follow the teacher's directions carefully during the experiment.
Her direction of the film won critical acclaim.
cn: 徒步者在茂密的森林中迷失了方向。
实验时请仔细遵循老师的指导。
她对这部电影的导演工作赢得了评论界的赞誉。

en: She looked directly at me during the speech.
The manager will contact you directly after the meeting.
He left directly after dinner.
cn: 她在演讲时直视着我。
会议结束后经理会直接联系你。
他吃完晚饭立即离开了。

en: The director announced a new project at the meeting.
She is the creative director of a fashion magazine.
The film director won an award for best screenplay.
cn: 董事在会议上宣布了一个新项目。
她是一家时尚杂志的创意总监。
这位电影导演获得了最佳剧本奖。

en: The children came home covered in dirt after playing in the garden.
She refused to spread dirt about her colleagues.
The car’s windshield was splattered with dirt from the muddy road.
cn: 孩子们在花园玩耍后，满身泥土地回家了。
她拒绝散布同事的丑闻。
挡风玻璃上溅满了泥路上的污垢。

en: The children came home with dirty hands after playing in the garden.
He told a dirty joke at the party, making everyone uncomfortable.
Pollution has dirtied the river, killing most of the fish.
cn: 孩子们在花园玩耍后，双手脏兮兮地回了家。
他在聚会上讲了个下流笑话，让所有人感到不适。
污染弄脏了河流，导致大部分鱼类死亡。

en: The accident disabled him permanently.
You can disable the firewall in the settings.
The virus disables the computer's main functions.
cn: 这场事故使他终身残疾。
你可以在设置中禁用防火墙。
病毒会破坏电脑的主要功能。

en: His lack of experience was a major disadvantage in the job interview.
The new tax policy may disadvantage small businesses.
Being short can be a disadvantage in basketball, but not always.
cn: 他缺乏经验，这在面试中是一个主要劣势。
新税收政策可能使小企业处于不利地位。
个子矮在篮球中可能是不利条件，但并非绝对。

definitions.definition: （食物、气候等）不适合，引起不适

en: They disagree on how to solve the problem.
Spicy food disagrees with my stomach.
The committee disagreed with the proposed budget.
cn: 他们对解决问题的方法持不同意见。
辛辣食物让我的胃不舒服。
委员会反对提出的预算方案。

en: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
Her smile disappeared when she heard the news.
The magician made the coin disappear.
cn: 太阳消失在云层后。
听到消息后，她的笑容消失了。
魔术师让硬币消失了。

definitions.definition: 使失望；使破灭（希望、计划等）

en: The movie's ending disappointed many fans.
She didn't want to disappoint her parents by dropping out.
The weather disappointed our picnic plans.
cn: 这部电影的结局让许多粉丝失望。
她不想因辍学让父母失望。
天气让我们的野餐计划泡汤了。

en: The earthquake was a natural disaster that devastated the region.
His career ended in disaster after the scandal.
Losing her passport was a personal disaster during the trip.
cn: 这场地震是一场摧毁该地区的自然灾害。
丑闻之后，他的职业生涯以惨败告终。
旅行中丢失护照对她来说是个人不幸。

en: The surgeon replaced her damaged spinal disk with an artificial one.
Save the document to the disk before shutting down the computer.
Ancient Greeks used bronze disks for athletic competitions.
cn: 外科医生用人工椎间盘替换了她受损的椎间盘。
关闭电脑前将文档保存到磁盘。
古希腊人用青铜圆盘进行体育竞赛。

definitions.definition: 被丢弃的物品；（纸牌游戏中）弃牌

en: She decided to discard the old magazines to make space.
In poker, you must discard two cards before drawing new ones.
The company discarded its outdated policies to embrace innovation.
cn: 她决定丢弃旧杂志以腾出空间。
扑克游戏中，你必须弃掉两张牌才能补新牌。
公司摒弃了过时的政策以拥抱创新。

definitions.definition: 释放；排出；解雇；履行（职责）

en: The factory was fined for illegally discharging waste into the river.
The soldier received an honorable discharge after 10 years of service.
The battery can discharge quickly in cold weather.
cn: 这家工厂因非法向河流排放废物被罚款。
这名士兵服役10年后光荣退伍。
这种电池在寒冷天气下会快速放电。

en: The school emphasizes strict discipline in classrooms.
She disciplined herself to study two hours daily.
Psychology is a discipline that explores human behavior.
cn: 这所学校注重课堂纪律。
她严格要求自己每天学习两小时。
心理学是研究人类行为的学科。

en: The journalist refused to disclose her sources.
The report disclosed serious financial irregularities.
He disclosed the package carefully, revealing a rare book.
cn: 这名记者拒绝透露她的消息来源。
报告揭露了严重的财务违规行为。
他小心地拆开包裹，露出一本珍贵的书。

en: The coach never discourages his players, even after a loss.
High taxes may discourage investment in small businesses.
She discouraged me from taking the risky job.
cn: 教练从不打击队员，即使输球后也是如此。
高税率可能阻碍对小企业的投资。
她劝我不要接受那份高风险的工作。

definitions.definition: 发现（未被知晓的事物或真相）
首次观察到或认识到（科学、地理等领域的现象）

en: Columbus discovered America in 1492.
Scientists discovered a new species in the rainforest.
She discovered her passion for music at age five.
cn: 哥伦布于1492年发现了美洲。
科学家在雨林中发现了一个新物种。
她在五岁时发现了自己对音乐的热爱。

en: The discovery of penicillin revolutionized medicine.
Her research led to a major scientific discovery.
The explorers documented their discoveries in detailed journals.
cn: 青霉素的发现彻底改变了医学。
她的研究带来了一项重大科学发现。
探险家们在日记中详细记录了他们的发现。

en: We need to discuss the project timeline in detail.
The book discusses the impact of climate change on coastal cities.
Let’s discuss your ideas before making a decision.
cn: 我们需要详细讨论项目时间表。
这本书探讨了气候变化对沿海城市的影响。
在做出决定前，我们先讨论你的想法。

en: The committee held a lengthy discussion about the new policy.
His essay includes a detailed discussion of climate change impacts.
Let’s table this discussion until we have more data.
cn: 委员会就新政策进行了长时间讨论。
他的论文包含对气候变化影响的详细论述。
我们暂缓讨论，待数据更充分后再议。

en: The vaccine eradicated the deadly disease.
Pollution is a disease of modern industrialization.
She studies rare genetic diseases.
cn: 疫苗消灭了这种致命疾病。
污染是现代工业化的弊病。
她研究罕见的遗传性疾病。

en: He wore a disguise to avoid being recognized.
Her smile disguised the sadness she felt.
The spy’s disguise was almost perfect.
cn: 他戴着伪装以避免被认出。
她的笑容掩饰了内心的悲伤。
那名间谍的伪装几乎天衣无缝。

en: The smell of rotten eggs filled the room with disgust.
His cruel behavior disgusted everyone around him.
She couldn't hide her disgust at the unfair decision.
cn: 腐烂鸡蛋的气味让房间里充满厌恶感。
他的残忍行为令周围所有人感到恶心。
她无法掩饰对这一不公正决定的愤慨。

en: She placed the salad in a ceramic dish.
This restaurant serves the best seafood dishes in town.
He dished out compliments to everyone at the party.
cn: 她把沙拉盛放在陶瓷盘里。
这家餐厅提供镇上最棒的海鲜菜肴。
他在派对上对每个人都慷慨赞美。

definitions.definition: 使蒙受耻辱；侮辱；拒付（票据）

en: He would rather die than live in dishonor.
The soldier was dismissed for dishonoring the uniform.
The company dishonored the contract by failing to make payment.
cn: 他宁死也不愿忍辱偷生。
这名士兵因玷污军装荣誉而被开除。
该公司未能付款，违背了合同。

en: She dislikes the taste of cilantro.
His dislike for loud noises is well-known.
I dislike it when people interrupt me.
cn: 她讨厌香菜的味道。
他对噪音的反感众所周知。
我讨厌被人打断。

en: The manager decided to dismiss the employee for repeated tardiness.
The judge dismissed the case due to lack of evidence.
She quickly dismissed the idea as impractical.
cn: 经理因员工屡次迟到决定解雇他。
法官因证据不足驳回此案。
她迅速否定了这个不切实际的想法。

en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
Genetic factors may disorder the immune system.
She was diagnosed with an eating disorder.
cn: 派对结束后，房间一片狼藉。
遗传因素可能导致免疫系统紊乱。
她被诊断出患有饮食失调症。

en: The museum will display the ancient artifacts next month.
Her calmness displayed great courage in the crisis.
The computer display suddenly went black.
cn: 博物馆将于下月展出这些古代文物。
她的冷静在危机中展现出极大的勇气。
电脑显示器突然黑屏了。

en: The city improved its waste disposal system.
He has full disposal of the company's resources.
Proper disposal of chemicals prevents pollution.
cn: 该市改进了垃圾处理系统。
他拥有公司资源的完全支配权。
化学品的妥善处置能防止污染。

en: She disposed the chairs in a semicircle for the meeting.
The factory must dispose of chemical waste safely.
His cheerful manner disposed everyone to trust him.
cn: 她将椅子摆成半圆形以便开会。
工厂必须安全处理化学废料。
他开朗的举止让大家都愿意信任他。

en: His rude behavior did not displease her as much as she had expected.
I have no wish to displease my best friend.
The decision is likely to displease environmental activists.
cn: 他的粗鲁行为并没有像她预期的那样让她非常不悦。
我无意惹我最好的朋友生气。
这个决定很可能会让环保活动人士感到不满。

en: The border dispute between the two countries lasted for decades.
Scientists dispute the validity of the new theory.
They disputed over the best solution to the problem.
cn: 两国间的边界争端持续了数十年。
科学家们对新理论的有效性提出质疑。
他们就问题的最佳解决方案争论不休。

en: Salt dissolves easily in water.
The committee voted to dissolve the partnership.
Her anger seemed to dissolve into laughter.
cn: 盐易溶于水。
委员会投票决定解除合作关系。
她的怒气似乎化为了笑声。

en: The distance between the two cities is 200 kilometers.
Over time, a emotional distance grew between them.
She tried to distance herself from the controversy.
cn: 两座城市之间的距离是200公里。
随着时间的推移，他们之间产生了情感隔阂。
她试图让自己远离这场争议。

en: The mountains appeared as a distant blue haze.
She gave him a distant smile, devoid of warmth.
Memories of that day now seem distant and unreal.
cn: 群山如一抹遥远的蓝色雾霭。
她对他疏离地笑了笑，毫无温度。
那天的记忆如今显得遥远而不真实。

en: The two species have distinct color patterns.
Her voice was distinct even in the noisy crowd.
The law makes a distinct difference between these cases.
cn: 这两种物种有截然不同的颜色图案。
即使在嘈杂的人群中，她的声音也清晰可辨。
法律对这些案例作了明确区分。

en: The distinction between these two theories is subtle but significant.
She graduated with distinction in molecular biology.
His work lacks distinction and fails to stand out.
cn: 这两种理论之间的差异微妙但重要。
她以分子生物学领域的卓越成绩毕业。
他的作品缺乏特色，难以脱颖而出。

en: It's hard to distinguish the twins because they look so alike.
His talent for painting distinguished him from his peers.
The scientist distinguished between the two chemical compounds.
cn: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，很难区分。
他的绘画天赋使他在同龄人中脱颖而出。
科学家区分了这两种化合物。

en: The ship sent out a distress signal when the engine failed.
Financial distress forced him to sell his house.
Seeing her pet in pain caused her great distress.
cn: 船只引擎故障时发出了求救信号。
经济困境迫使他卖掉房子。
看到宠物受苦让她非常痛苦。

en: The teacher will distribute the exam papers to the students.
This species is widely distributed across tropical regions.
The charity aims to distribute food to homeless people.
cn: 老师会把考卷分发给学生。
该物种广泛分布于热带地区。
该慈善机构致力于向无家可归者分发食物。

definitions.definition: 分布（空间或统计上的排列）

en: The distribution of food to the refugees was well-organized.
This map shows the global distribution of rainfall.
The company expanded its distribution channels to reach rural areas.
cn: 向难民分发食物的过程井然有序。
这张地图展示了全球降雨量的分布。
该公司扩展了销售网络以覆盖农村地区。

en: The city is divided into ten administrative districts.
This school district has excellent resources.
The historic district attracts many tourists.
cn: 这座城市被划分为十个行政区。
这个学区拥有优质资源。
历史街区吸引了大量游客。

definitions.definition: 打扰，干扰（正常状态或活动）

en: Please do not disturb the sleeping baby.
The news disturbed her deeply.
Strong winds disturbed the surface of the lake.
cn: 请勿打扰正在睡觉的婴儿。
这消息让她深感不安。
强风搅乱了湖面。

definitions.definition: 抛弃；丢弃；紧急迫降（飞机）

en: The farmer dug a ditch to drain water from the field.
He decided to ditch his old car and buy a new one.
The pilot had to ditch the plane in the ocean due to engine failure.
cn: 农民挖了一条沟渠来排干田里的水。
他决定抛弃旧车，买一辆新的。
由于引擎故障，飞行员不得不在海上迫降。

en: The eagle made a steep dive to catch its prey.
She loves to dive into the deep end of the pool.
Stock prices took a dive after the news broke.
cn: 鹰俯冲而下捕捉猎物。
她喜欢跳进泳池的深水区。
消息传出后股价暴跌。

definitions.definition: （人或事物）由不同部分组成的

en: The city is known for its diverse cultural heritage.
A diverse range of opinions was expressed during the meeting.
The ecosystem thrives because of its diverse species.
cn: 这座城市以其多元的文化遗产闻名。
会议上表达了多种不同的观点。
该生态系统因物种多样而繁荣。

en: The river divides the city into two parts.
Opinions divide sharply on this issue.
The Great Divide refers to cultural differences between generations.
cn: 这条河将城市分成两部分。
在这个问题上意见分歧严重。
“大分水岭”指代代际间的文化差异。

en: The river forms a natural division between the two countries.
There was a sharp division of opinion among committee members.
She works in the marketing division of a multinational company.
cn: 这条河流是两国之间的天然分界线。
委员会成员间存在尖锐的意见分歧。
她在某跨国公司的市场部门工作。

en: They decided to file for divorce after years of unhappiness.
The artist divorced himself from traditional styles.
The scandal led to a divorce between the two political allies.
cn: 在多年不幸福后，他们决定申请离婚。
这位艺术家脱离了传统风格。
这场丑闻导致两位政治盟友分道扬镳。

definitions.definition: （助动词，用于疑问句、否定句或强调）

en: What do you want to do this weekend?
She does her homework every evening.
Do be careful with that glass!
cn: 你这周末想做什么？
她每晚都做作业。
务必小心那个玻璃杯！（强调语气）

en: The ship slowly approached the dock.
The company docked his salary for being late.
Seagulls gathered near the fishing dock.
cn: 船只缓缓驶向码头。
公司因他迟到扣除了工资。
海鸥聚集在渔港附近。

en: She visited the doctor for a routine check-up.
He earned a doctorate in philosophy.
Someone doctored the photo to fake evidence.
cn: 她去看医生做例行检查。
他获得了哲学博士学位。
有人篡改了照片伪造证据。

en: Please submit the document by email.
The film documents the life of endangered species.
A passport is a crucial travel document.
cn: 请通过电子邮件提交该文件。
这部纪录片记录了濒危物种的生活。
护照是重要的旅行证件。

en: The dog barked at the mail carrier.
She adopted a rescue dog last month.
Stop dogging me—I need some space!
cn: 那只狗对着邮递员吠叫。
她上个月收养了一只流浪狗。
别跟着我了，我需要点空间！（非正式用法）

definitions.definition: 美元（美国等国家的货币单位）
元（其他国家的货币单位，如加拿大元、澳大利亚元）

en: The book costs 20 dollars.
Canada's currency is called the Canadian dollar.
The dollar strengthened against the euro today.
cn: 这本书售价20美元。
加拿大的货币被称为加拿大元。
今日美元对欧元汇率走强。

en: She prefers domestic chores to office work.
The company focuses on both domestic and international markets.
In the 19th century, many wealthy families employed domestics.
cn: 她更喜欢家务而非办公室工作。
该公司同时关注国内和国际市场。
19世纪时，许多富裕家庭雇佣家仆。

en: The donkey carried heavy loads up the mountain.
He's as stubborn as a donkey when it comes to changing his mind.
Donkeys are known for their endurance in harsh climates.
cn: 驴子驮着重物上山。
要他改变主意时，他倔得像头驴。
驴以在恶劣气候下的耐力著称。

en: She knocked on the door but no one answered.
The cat scratched at the door to be let in.
Opportunity knocks at every man's door once.
cn: 她敲了门，但无人应答。
猫抓挠着门想让人放它进去。
机遇之门会敲响每个人的生命一次。

definitions.definition: （非正式）宿舍（dormitory 的缩写形式）

en: She decorated her dorm with fairy lights.
The dorm rules prohibit overnight guests.
Campus life starts with moving into a dorm.
cn: 她把宿舍装饰了串灯。
宿舍规定禁止留宿访客。
校园生活从搬进宿舍开始。

definitions.definition: 集体宿舍（尤指学校或机构的住宿楼）

en: The university built a new dormitory for international students.
Each dormitory room accommodates four students with shared facilities.
The monastery's dormitory was designed for silence and contemplation.
cn: 大学为国际学生新建了一栋宿舍楼。
每间宿舍容纳四名学生，配有共用设施。
修道院的宿舍旨在保持安静与冥想氛围。

en: The doctor prescribed a daily dose of antibiotics.
Be careful not to overdose on painkillers.
The vaccine requires two doses for full immunity.
cn: 医生开了一剂每日服用的抗生素。
注意不要过量服用止痛药。
这种疫苗需要接种两剂才能获得完全免疫。

en: She drew a red dot on the map.
The sky was dotted with stars.
Don't forget to dot the letter 'i'.
cn: 她在地图上画了一个红点。
夜空中繁星点点。
别忘了在字母“i”上打点。

en: She ordered a double espresso to stay awake.
The actor will double as both director and producer.
His salary doubled after the promotion.
cn: 她点了一杯双份浓缩咖啡来提神。
这位演员将同时兼任导演和制片人。
升职后他的工资翻了一番。

en: She had no doubt about his honesty.
I doubt we'll arrive on time in this traffic.
His theory casts doubt on traditional beliefs.
cn: 她毫不怀疑他的诚实。
我怀疑在这种交通状况下我们能准时到达。
他的理论动摇了传统观念。

en: The weather looks doubtful for our picnic tomorrow.
She gave him a doubtful glance after hearing his excuse.
