The results of the experiment are still doubtful.
cn: 明天的野餐天气看起来不太乐观。
听完他的借口后，她投去怀疑的一瞥。
实验的结果仍不确定。

en: She was doubtless the best candidate for the job.
The results will doubtless surprise many people.
His honesty is doubtless, but his methods are questionable.
cn: 她无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。
结果肯定会让许多人惊讶。
他的诚实无可置疑，但方法值得商榷。

en: She walked down the stairs slowly.
He felt down after hearing the bad news.
The bird's nest was lined with soft down.
cn: 她缓缓走下楼梯。
听到坏消息后，他情绪低落。
鸟巢里垫着柔软的绒毛。

en: She ran downstairs to answer the door.
The downstairs bathroom needs cleaning.
We heard loud noises from the downstairs neighbors.
cn: 她跑下楼去应门。
楼下的浴室需要打扫。
我们听到楼下邻居传来的吵闹声。

en: The bird flew downward to its nest.
The company's profits show a downward trend this year.
She pointed downward at the map to indicate the river's path.
cn: 这只鸟向下飞回巢中。
公司利润今年呈下降趋势。
她向下指着地图，标出河流的路径。

en: She bought a dozen roses for her mother’s birthday.
Dozens of students gathered in the hall for the lecture.
The baker sells cookies by the dozen.
cn: 她为母亲的生日买了一打玫瑰。
数十名学生聚集在大厅听讲座。
这家面包店按打卖饼干。

en: She made several revisions to the first draft of her novel.
The military drafted him during the war.
Open the window to create a draft and cool the room.
cn: 她修改了小说初稿的多处内容。
战争期间军队征召了他。
打开窗户通风让房间凉快些。

definitions.definition: 拖拽；缓慢而费力地移动
拖拽的动作；阻力；枯燥乏味的事物

en: The fishermen dragged the net ashore.
High heels are a drag to walk in for long.
The meeting dragged on for three hours.
cn: 渔民们把渔网拖上岸。
长时间穿高跟鞋走路很累人。
会议拖拖拉拉开了三个小时。

definitions.definition: 龙（神话中的巨型爬行生物）
严厉或凶悍的人（比喻义）

en: The knight fought the dragon to rescue the princess.
Her boss is a real dragon when deadlines approach.
Chinese dragons are often symbols of power and good luck.
cn: 骑士为拯救公主与恶龙搏斗。
截止日临近时，她的老板活像一条恶龙。
中国龙常是权力与好运的象征。

en: The plumber fixed the clogged drain.
Constant work drains her energy.
They drained the swamp to build a road.
cn: 水管工修好了堵塞的排水管。
持续的工作消耗她的精力。
他们排干沼泽以修建道路。

en: She studied drama at the Royal Academy of Arts.
The meeting turned into a public drama.
His life was full of drama and emotional turmoil.
cn: 她在皇家艺术学院学习戏剧。
这场会议演变成了一场公开的戏剧性事件。
他的生活充满戏剧性和情感波折。

en: The play's dramatic ending left the audience in tears.
She made a dramatic gesture to emphasize her point.
The landscape underwent dramatic changes after the volcanic eruption.
cn: 戏剧的震撼结局让观众落泪。
她做了个夸张的手势来强调自己的观点。
火山喷发后，这片地貌发生了翻天覆地的变化。

definitions.definition: 平局；抽签；吸引人的事物

en: She loves to draw landscapes with charcoal.
The game ended in a 2-2 draw.
His speech drew applause from the crowd.
cn: 她喜欢用木炭画风景。
比赛以2比2的平局结束。
他的演讲吸引了观众的掌声。

definitions.definition: 制图员；开票人（法律/金融术语）

en: She kept her jewelry in the top drawer of the dresser.
As a skilled drawer, he specialized in architectural sketches.
The drawer of the cheque must ensure sufficient funds.
cn: 她的首饰存放在梳妆台最上层的抽屉里。
作为一名熟练的制图员，他专攻建筑草图。
支票的开票人必须确保资金充足。

en: She showed me a beautiful drawing of a sunset.
The lottery drawing will be held tomorrow.
His drawing skills improved after taking classes.
cn: 她给我看了一幅美丽的日落素描。
抽奖活动将于明天举行。
参加课程后，他的绘画技巧提高了。

en: She lives in constant dread of losing her job.
The villagers dread the coming of the storm season.
His dread was palpable as he entered the dark room.
cn: 她始终生活在失去工作的恐惧中。
村民们对风暴季节的到来感到恐惧。
他走进黑暗房间时的恐惧感显而易见。

en: She had a vivid dream about flying.
He dreams of becoming a scientist.
The project is the culmination of years of dreaming and hard work.
cn: 她做了一个关于飞翔的生动梦境。
他梦想成为一名科学家。
这个项目是多年梦想与努力的结晶。

en: She wore a blue dress to the party.
He helped dress his younger sister before school.
The chef dressed the salad with olive oil.
cn: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙参加派对。
他帮妹妹穿好衣服去上学。
厨师用橄榄油拌沙拉。

definitions.definition: 漂流；缓慢移动；放任自流

en: The boat began to drift downstream with the current.
His speech had a noticeable drift away from the main topic.
Snowdrifts blocked the road after the storm.
cn: 小船开始随水流向下游漂去。
他的演讲明显偏离了主题。
暴风雪后，积雪堆阻塞了道路。

en: The dentist used a small drill to remove the decay.
Soldiers must drill regularly to maintain combat readiness.
She drilled the multiplication tables with her students.
cn: 牙医用小钻头清除蛀牙部分。
士兵必须定期操练以保持战备状态。
她带领学生反复练习乘法表。

en: She drinks herbal tea every morning.
The cocktail is a popular summer drink.
He never drinks alcohol at parties.
cn: 她每天早晨喝花草茶。
这款鸡尾酒是夏季热门饮品。
他在聚会上从不饮酒。

definitions.definition: 水滴；滴落声；无聊/乏味的人

en: The faucet keeps dripping all night.
She added a drip of honey to her tea.
Don’t be such a drip—join the fun!
cn: 水龙头整夜都在滴水。
她在茶里加了一滴蜂蜜。
别这么无趣，一起来玩吧！

en: She drives to work every day.
The coach's speech drove the team to victory.
Install the software on your D: drive.
cn: 她每天开车上班。
教练的演讲激励队伍走向胜利。
将软件安装到D盘。

en: The taxi driver knew the fastest route to the airport.
Make sure to update your printer driver regularly.
He swung his driver perfectly, sending the ball over 300 yards.
cn: 出租车司机知道去机场的最快路线。
务必定期更新打印机驱动程序。
他完美挥动高尔夫球杆，将球击出300码外。

en: A drop of rain fell on her hand.
He decided to drop the course.
Temperatures will drop sharply tonight.
cn: 一滴雨落在她手上。
他决定放弃这门课程。
今晚气温将骤降。

en: The crops failed due to prolonged drought.
California faced a severe drought for five consecutive years.
There's a drought of new ideas in the current research field.
cn: 农作物因长期干旱而歉收。
加利福尼亚连续五年遭遇严重干旱。
当前研究领域缺乏新思路。

definitions.definition: 使淹死；淹没（声音、情感等）

en: She fell into the river and nearly drowned.
The loud music drowned out their conversation.
He drowned his sorrows in alcohol after the loss.
cn: 她掉进河里，差点淹死。
嘈杂的音乐声盖过了他们的谈话。
失去后，他用酒精麻痹自己的悲伤。

definitions.definition: 使服麻醉药；掺麻醉药于

en: The doctor prescribed a new drug for my allergy.
Many countries have strict laws against drug abuse.
They found he had been drugged with sleeping pills.
cn: 医生为我的过敏开了一种新药。
许多国家对药物滥用有严格法律。
他们发现他被掺了安眠药。

en: She played the drum with incredible rhythm.
The rain drummed against the window all night.
He kept drumming his fingers on the table impatiently.
cn: 她以惊人的节奏感打鼓。
雨整夜敲打着窗户。
他不耐烦地用手指连续敲击桌子。

en: He was too drunk to walk straight.
The bar refused to serve the drunk.
Her speech became slurred when she got drunk.
cn: 他醉得走不直路了。
酒吧拒绝为那名醉汉服务。
她喝醉时说话变得含糊不清。

en: The desert air is extremely dry.
She used a towel to dry her hair.
Leave the paint to dry overnight.
cn: 沙漠的空气极其干燥。
她用毛巾擦干头发。
让油漆晾干一整夜。

definitions.definition: 迅速低头（躲避）；躲避（责任等）

en: The duck swam gracefully across the pond.
He had to duck to avoid the low-hanging branch.
She accused him of ducking his responsibilities.
cn: 鸭子优雅地游过池塘。
他不得不低头避开低垂的树枝。
她指责他逃避责任。

definitions.definition: 应得之物（常用复数 dues）

en: The rent is due on the first of each month.
She finally received the recognition due to her.
Members must pay their dues by the end of the year.
cn: 每月首日需支付租金。
她终于得到了应得的认可。
会员须在年底前缴纳会费。

en: The knife is too dull to cut the tomato.
His dull expression showed no interest in the lecture.
Repetitive tasks can dull your creativity.
cn: 这把刀太钝了，切不动番茄。
他呆滞的表情显示出对讲座毫无兴趣。
重复性工作会消磨你的创造力。

en: The injury left him temporarily dumb.
That was a dumb mistake to make.
She remained dumb despite the accusations.
cn: 受伤让他暂时失语。
犯这种错误太蠢了。
面对指控，她保持沉默。

definitions.definition: 垃圾场；脏乱的地方；转储（计算机术语）

en: They dumped the waste into the river.
The stock market crashed, and investors dumped their shares.
My computer saves a memory dump when it crashes.
cn: 他们将废物倾倒进河里。
股市暴跌，投资者抛售股票。
我的电脑崩溃时会保存内存转储文件。

en: This fabric is highly durable and resistant to wear.
Their friendship proved durable despite the distance.
The company specializes in durable goods like refrigerators and washing machines.
cn: 这种面料非常耐用，抗磨损。
尽管相隔遥远，他们的友谊依然持久。
该公司专营冰箱和洗衣机等耐用品。

en: The duration of the movie is two and a half hours.
He studied the effects of sleep deprivation over a long duration.
The contract specifies the duration of employment.
cn: 这部电影的时长是两个半小时。
他研究了长期睡眠不足的影响。
合同明确了雇佣的期限。

en: She kept a diary during her trip to Japan.
During the meeting, no one mentioned the budget issue.
The cafe is closed during the holidays.
cn: 她在日本旅行期间坚持写日记。
会议期间无人提及预算问题。
这家咖啡馆在假期期间歇业。

definitions.definition: 黄昏，傍晚（日落后的微光时段）

en: The streetlights flickered on at dusk.
Her eyes were the color of dusk.
We walked home in the soft dusk.
cn: 黄昏时分，街灯零星亮起。
她的双眸如暮色般深邃。
我们在柔和的暮色中漫步回家。

en: The sunlight revealed dust floating in the air.
She dusted the shelves every morning.
The baker dusted the cake with powdered sugar.
cn: 阳光照出空气中漂浮的灰尘。
她每天早晨擦拭架子上的灰尘。
面包师在蛋糕上撒了一层糖粉。

en: It is every citizen's duty to obey the law.
She performed her duties as a nurse with dedication.
The government raised import duties on luxury goods.
cn: 遵守法律是每位公民的义务。
她以奉献精神履行护士职责。
政府提高了奢侈品的进口关税。

en: The cottage was a humble dwelling nestled in the woods.
Tribal dwellings often reflect their connection to nature.
The law protects the right to safe dwelling.
cn: 这座小屋是林中一处简陋的住所。
部落居所常体现其与自然的联系。
法律保障安全居住的权利。

en: She used natural plants to dye the fabric blue.
This synthetic dye is more vibrant than traditional ones.
The ancient art of tie-dye involves folding and dyeing cloth.
cn: 她用天然植物将布料染成蓝色。
这种合成染料比传统染料更鲜艳。
古老的扎染工艺需要折叠并染色布料。

en: The dying man whispered his last words to his family.
Traditional crafts are a dying art in the modern world.
She held his hand during the final moments of his dying.
cn: 垂死的男子向家人低声说出遗言。
传统工艺在现代社会中是一门濒临消失的艺术。
在他生命的最后时刻，她握着他的手。

en: The dynamic balance of the ecosystem is fragile.
She has a dynamic personality that inspires others.
Market dynamics are constantly changing.
cn: 生态系统的动态平衡非常脆弱。
她充满活力的个性激励着他人。
市场动力因素在不断变化。

en: Each student received a certificate.
She held a basket in each hand.
The tickets cost $20 each.
cn: 每位学生都收到了一份证书。
她两只手各提着一个篮子。
票价每张20美元。

definitions.definition: 激烈的，强烈的（古义，现较少用）

en: She was eager to start her new job.
The team showed eager determination to win.
His eager questions revealed his curiosity.
cn: 她热切地期待着开始新工作。
队伍表现出强烈的求胜决心。
他急切的提问显露出好奇心。

definitions.definition: 鹰（尤指体型较大的猛禽）
（高尔夫）老鹰球（低于标准杆两杆）

en: The eagle soared high above the mountains.
He scored an eagle on the 15th hole.
The national emblem features a golden eagle.
cn: 鹰在群山上空翱翔。
他在第15洞打出了老鹰球。
国徽上饰有一只金雕。

en: She whispered something in his ear.
Wheat ears swayed gently in the wind.
He has a keen ear for classical music.
cn: 她在他的耳边低语。
麦穗在风中轻轻摇曳。
他对古典音乐有敏锐的鉴赏力。

en: The early bird catches the worm.
She arrived early to secure a good seat.
In early spring, the flowers begin to bloom.
cn: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
她提早到达以占个好座位。
初春时节，花朵开始绽放。

en: She works hard to earn a living.
His honesty earned him great respect.
It takes years to earn a doctorate degree.
cn: 她努力工作以谋生。
他的诚实为他赢得了极大尊重。
获得博士学位需要多年时间。

en: She gave an earnest promise to finish the project on time.
His earnest efforts finally paid off.
The child's earnest expression showed he wasn't joking.
cn: 她郑重承诺会按时完成项目。
他的认真努力最终得到了回报。
孩子认真的表情表明他不是在开玩笑。

definitions.definition: 陆地；地面（与天空或海洋相对）

en: The Earth orbits the Sun once every 365 days.
She planted the seeds deep in the earth.
After weeks at sea, we were glad to feel solid earth beneath our feet.
cn: 地球每365天绕太阳公转一周。
她把种子深埋在泥土里。
在海上漂泊数周后，我们很高兴能踩到坚实的陆地。

en: The earthquake caused massive destruction in the city.
Scientists monitor fault lines to predict earthquakes.
The political scandal was an earthquake for the government.
cn: 地震对城市造成了大规模破坏。
科学家监测断层线以预测地震。
这场政治丑闻对政府而言是一场大地震（喻重大冲击）。

en: She completed the task with effortless ease.
The medicine helped ease his chronic pain.
His calm voice eased the tension in the room.
cn: 她毫不费力地完成了任务。
药物缓解了他的慢性疼痛。
他平静的声音缓和了房间里的紧张气氛。

en: She solved the puzzle easily.
This could easily be the best performance of the year.
The door opens easily with a slight push.
cn: 她轻松解开了这个谜题。
这很可能是今年最精彩的演出。
轻轻一推，门就开了。

en: The sun rises in the east.
She lives on the east coast of Australia.
Trade between East and West flourished in the 15th century.
cn: 太阳从东方升起。
她居住在澳大利亚东海岸。
东西方贸易在15世纪蓬勃发展。

en: The eastern part of the country has a milder climate.
An eastern wind brought rain to the coastal areas.
She studies Eastern philosophy at university.
cn: 该国东部气候更为温和。
东风为沿海地区带来了降雨。
她在大学研究东方哲学。

definitions.definition: 小心地；缓慢地（非正式用法）

en: The exam was surprisingly easy.
She leads an easy life in the countryside.
Easy! Don’t drop the vase.
cn: 这次考试出乎意料地简单。
她在乡下过着轻松的生活。
小心！别把花瓶摔了。

en: I eat an apple every morning.
The acid will eat through the metal over time.
Let’s eat out tonight.
cn: 我每天早上吃一个苹果。
酸会逐渐腐蚀金属。
今晚我们出去吃饭吧。

definitions.definition: 发出回声；重复（他人的话或行为）

en: Her laughter echoed through the empty hallway.
The article merely echoes the government’s official stance.
Ancient Greek myths often describe mountains producing echoes.
cn: 她的笑声在空荡的走廊中回荡。
这篇文章只是重复了政府的官方立场。
古希腊神话常描述山峦产生回声的现象。

en: The government introduced new economic reforms to boost growth.
Solar energy is an economic alternative to fossil fuels.
Her economic use of time impressed her colleagues.
cn: 政府推出新的经济改革以促进增长。
太阳能是化石燃料的一种经济替代方案。
她对时间的高效利用令同事印象深刻。

definitions.definition: 经济的；节约的（指高效利用资源）

en: She drives an economical car that consumes less fuel.
The recipe is economical, using simple ingredients to create a delicious meal.
The government promotes economical energy use to reduce costs.
cn: 她开一辆省油的经济型汽车。
这个食谱很实惠，用简单的食材做出美味的一餐。
政府提倡节约能源以降低成本。

definitions.definition: 经济（一个国家或地区的财富和生产系统）

en: The country's economy relies heavily on tourism.
She practices economy by recycling old clothes.
A carpool system is an economy of time and fuel.
cn: 该国的经济严重依赖旅游业。
她通过回收旧衣物践行节约。
拼车系统是一种时间和燃料的节约。

en: The knife's edge gleamed in the sunlight.
She edged her way through the crowded room.
His creativity gave him an edge in the competition.
cn: 刀刃在阳光下闪烁。
她侧身挤过拥挤的房间。
他的创造力让他在竞争中占据优势。

definitions.definition: 版本（指书籍、报纸等的特定发行形式）
版次（同一作品的多次出版中的某一次）

en: The first edition of the novel sold out within a week.
She collects rare editions of 19th-century poetry.
The digital edition includes interactive features.
cn: 这本小说的首版在一周内售罄。
她收藏19世纪诗歌的稀有版本。
电子版包含交互功能。

definitions.definition: 编辑（负责内容修改或出版的人）

en: The editor revised the manuscript for clarity.
She works as a film editor in Hollywood.
The newspaper editor decided to run the controversial story.
cn: 编辑修改了手稿以提高清晰度。
她在好莱坞担任电影剪辑师。
报纸编辑决定刊登这篇有争议的报道。

en: Parents play a crucial role in educating their children about moral values.
The program aims to educate farmers on sustainable practices.
Dolphins can be educated to perform complex tasks.
cn: 父母在教育孩子道德价值观方面起着关键作用。
该项目旨在教育农民可持续农业实践。
海豚可通过训练完成复杂任务。

en: Early childhood education is crucial for cognitive development.
She pursued higher education in environmental science.
The government invests in public education to reduce inequality.
cn: 幼儿教育对认知发展至关重要。
她接受了环境科学的高等教育。
政府投资公共教育以减少不平等。

en: The new policy had an immediate effect on the economy.
She effected a change in the company's culture through persistent efforts.
The special effects in the movie were breathtaking.
cn: 这项新政策对经济产生了立竿见影的影响。
她通过持续努力实现了公司文化的变革。
这部电影的特效令人叹为观止。

definitions.definition: 有效的；产生预期结果的
实际的；事实上的（法律或军事等语境）

en: The new policy proved highly effective in reducing pollution.
She is the effective leader of the organization, though not officially appointed.
Vitamin C is effective against common colds when taken regularly.
cn: 这项新政策在减少污染方面非常有效。
她是该组织实际上的领导者，尽管未被正式任命。
定期服用维生素C对预防感冒有效。

en: The new software improved the efficiency of data processing.
Energy efficiency is crucial for sustainable development.
His efficiency at work earned him a promotion.
cn: 新软件提高了数据处理的效率。
能源效率对可持续发展至关重要。
他高效的工作表现使他获得了晋升。

en: The new software is highly efficient in processing large datasets.
Solar panels have become more efficient over the past decade.
An efficient workflow saves both time and resources.
cn: 这款新软件处理大型数据集非常高效。
过去十年间，太阳能电池板的效能显著提升。
高效的工作流程能节省时间和资源。

en: She succeeded through sheer effort and determination.
The project required a joint effort from all team members.
He made an effort to arrive on time despite the traffic.
cn: 她完全依靠努力和决心取得了成功。
该项目需要全体团队成员的共同努力。
尽管交通拥堵，他仍尽力准时到达。

definitions.definition: 怂恿，煽动（非正式用法，如 "egg someone on"）

en: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
The fish lays thousands of eggs at a time.
Don't egg him on—he's already too excited.
cn: 她煮了一个鸡蛋当早餐。
这种鱼一次产下数千颗卵。
别怂恿他了，他已经够兴奋了。

en: She has eight cats in her apartment.
The meeting starts at eight o'clock sharp.
Eight out of ten participants completed the survey.
cn: 她的公寓里有八只猫。
会议八点整开始。
十名参与者中有八人完成了调查。

en: She turned eighteen last week.
The class has eighteen students.
Page eighteen contains the key diagram.
cn: 她上周满十八岁了。
这个班有十八名学生。
第十八页是关键图表所在。

en: She finished eighth in the marathon.
Cut the cake into eighths for equal sharing.
The eighth chapter discusses medieval architecture.
cn: 她在马拉松比赛中获得第八名。
将蛋糕切成八等份以便公平分配。
第八章探讨中世纪建筑。

en: She celebrated her eighty birthday with a grand party.
The temperature soared to eighty degrees Fahrenheit.
Eighty percent of the participants agreed with the proposal.
cn: 她以盛大的派对庆祝八十岁生日。
温度飙升至华氏八十度。
百分之八十的参与者赞同该提案。

en: You can choose either option.
She doesn’t like coffee, and I don’t either.
Either we leave now, or we miss the train.
cn: 你可以选择任意一个选项。
她不喜欢咖啡，我也不喜欢。
我们要么现在离开，要么错过火车。

en: She wore an elaborate gown to the ball.
The scientist elaborated on her research findings.
The chef elaborated a simple recipe into a gourmet dish.
cn: 她穿着一件精致的礼服参加舞会。
科学家详细阐述了她的研究发现。
主厨将一道简单的食谱精心加工成了美食。

en: The elastic band snapped when stretched too far.
Her schedule is elastic enough to accommodate last-minute changes.
This fabric has high elastic recovery.
cn: 橡皮筋拉伸过度时断裂了。
她的日程安排很灵活，可以适应临时变动。
这种面料弹性回复性极佳。

en: She rested her elbows on the table while thinking.
The pipe has a sharp elbow to change direction.
He elbowed his way through the crowded bus.
cn: 她思考时把双肘撑在桌上。
这根管子有一个急弯用于改变方向。
他在拥挤的公交车上用肘推挤着前进。

en: She sought advice from the village elders.
The elder brother took responsibility for the family.
This tradition is respected by elder generations.
cn: 她向村里的长者们寻求建议。
哥哥承担起了家庭的责任。
这一传统受到老一辈人的尊重。

en: Citizens will elect a new mayor next month.
She is the elect representative of the committee.
The board elected to postpone the decision.
cn: 下月市民将选举新市长。
她是委员会当选代表。
董事会选择推迟决议。

definitions.definition: 选举（正式投票选择候选人）

en: The presidential election will be held next November.
Her election to the board surprised many analysts.
Fair election procedures are vital for democracy.
cn: 总统选举将于明年十一月举行。
她当选董事会成员令许多分析师意外。
公正的选举程序对民主至关重要。

definitions.definition: 令人激动的；高度刺激的

en: The electric fan stopped working due to a power outage.
Her performance created an electric atmosphere in the concert hall.
Electric vehicles are becoming more popular as a sustainable alternative.
cn: 电风扇因停电停止运转。
她的表演在音乐厅营造出激动人心的氛围。
电动汽车作为可持续替代品正日益普及。

definitions.definition: 令人激动的；紧张的（引申义）

en: The electrical wiring in the old house needs replacement.
Her performance had an electrical effect on the audience.
Always turn off the power before handling electrical equipment.
cn: 这栋老房子的电线需要更换。
她的表演让观众感到震撼。
操作电器前务必切断电源。

en: The city was plunged into darkness due to a failure in the electricity supply.
Her performance on stage was full of electricity.
Static electricity can make your hair stand on end.
cn: 由于电力供应故障，整座城市陷入黑暗。
她的舞台表演充满感染力。
静电会让你的头发竖起来。

definitions.definition: 电子（带负电的亚原子粒子）
电子技术相关产物（如 electron microscope）

en: An electron carries a negative charge.
The electron microscope reveals atomic structures.
Electrons orbit the nucleus in specific energy levels.
cn: 电子携带负电荷。
电子显微镜能显示原子结构。
电子在特定能级绕原子核运动。

en: The electronic devices in this lab are highly sensitive.
She studies electronic engineering at university.
Modern cars rely heavily on electronic systems.
cn: 实验室里的电子设备非常灵敏。
她在大学学习电子工程。
现代汽车高度依赖电子系统。

definitions.definition: 电子学（研究电子行为的科学分支）
电子设备（复数形式，指电子器件或系统）

en: She majored in electronics and now designs circuit boards.
Modern cars rely heavily on advanced electronics.
The lab is equipped with the latest electronics for testing.
cn: 她主修电子学，现在设计电路板。
现代汽车高度依赖先进的电子设备。
实验室配备了最新的电子测试设备。

en: Carbon is a key element in organic compounds.
Honesty is an essential element of a healthy relationship.
The hikers struggled against the elements during the storm.
cn: 碳是有机化合物的关键元素。
诚实是健康关系的基本要素。
徒步者在暴风雨中与恶劣天气搏斗。

en: The book covers elementary principles of physics.
She teaches at an elementary school in Tokyo.
The solution is elementary if you understand the core concept.
cn: 这本书涵盖了物理学的基本原理。
她在东京的一所小学任教。
如果你理解核心概念，解决方法很简单。

definitions.definition: 大象（大型长鼻哺乳动物）
象征庞大或笨重的事物

en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up a branch.
Managing this project is like moving an elephant.
She collects miniature elephant figurines.
cn: 大象用鼻子卷起一根树枝。
管理这个项目就像搬动一头大象（比喻任务艰巨）。
她收集大象造型的小雕像。

en: The glass elevator offers a panoramic view of the city.
The pilot adjusted the elevator to control the aircraft's pitch.
This historic building installed its first electric elevator in 1923.
cn: 玻璃电梯可全景俯瞰城市。
飞行员调节升降舵以控制飞机俯仰。
这座历史建筑于1923年安装了首部电动电梯。

en: She turned eleven last week.
There are eleven players on a football team.
The clock struck eleven as we finished dinner.
cn: 她上周满十一岁。
足球队有十一名球员。
我们吃完晚餐时，钟敲了十一下。

definitions.definition: 第十一个（人或物）；十一分之一

en: She finished in eleventh place in the race.
The eleventh chapter discusses climate change in detail.
Only one eleventh of the original population remained.
cn: 她在比赛中获得了第十一名。
第十一章详细讨论了气候变化。
仅有原人口的十一分之一留存下来。

en: The vaccine helped eliminate smallpox worldwide.
We need to eliminate unnecessary expenses.
The team was eliminated in the first round.
cn: 疫苗帮助全球消灭了天花。
我们必须削减不必要的开支。
该队在第一轮就被淘汰了。

en: The elimination of plastic waste is crucial for environmental protection.
She celebrated her team's victory in the elimination round.
The kidneys play a key role in the elimination of toxins.
cn: 消除塑料垃圾对环境保护至关重要。
她庆祝团队在淘汰赛中获胜。
肾脏在毒素排泄中起关键作用。

en: Would you like anything else to drink?
Hurry up, else we'll miss the train.
She chose the red dress because all else looked dull.
cn: 您还想喝点别的吗？
快点，否则我们要错过火车了。
她选了红裙子，因为其他都显得暗淡。

en: The answer must be found elsewhere.
She decided to look for opportunities elsewhere.
This species is native to Asia but has been introduced elsewhere.
cn: 答案必须在别处寻找。
她决定去别处寻找机会。
该物种原产于亚洲，但已被引入其他地区。

en: His clumsy apology only served to embarrass her further.
Too many rules can embarrass creativity.
She was embarrassed by her lack of preparation.
cn: 他笨拙的道歉反而让她更尴尬。
过多的规则会阻碍创造力。
她因准备不足而感到窘迫。

definitions.definition: 拥抱；欣然接受（观点、信仰等）

en: She embraced her child tightly before leaving.
The company embraced new technologies to improve efficiency.
His speech embraced the ideals of equality and justice.
cn: 她离开前紧紧拥抱了孩子。
该公司采用新技术以提高效率。
他的演讲包含了平等与正义的理念。

definitions.definition: 浮现，出现（从隐蔽或不可见状态）

en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
New evidence emerged during the trial.
She emerged as a leader after the crisis.
cn: 太阳从云层后浮现。
审判期间出现了新证据。
危机后，她脱颖而出成为领导者。

definitions.definition: （作定语）应急的，紧急的（如 emergency exit）

en: The hospital has a special ward for emergency cases.
In an emergency, dial 911 immediately.
She kept a flashlight in her bag for emergencies.
cn: 医院设有急诊病房处理紧急病例。
遇到紧急情况，请立即拨打911。
她包里常备手电筒以防突发状况。

definitions.definition: 发出（光、热、声音等）；排放（气体、物质）

en: The fireflies emit a soft green light at night.
Factories must reduce the amount of CO2 they emit.
The radio tower emits signals continuously.
cn: 萤火虫在夜晚发出柔和的绿光。
工厂必须减少二氧化碳的排放量。
无线电塔持续发射信号。

definitions.definition: 情感，情绪（如喜悦、愤怒、悲伤等）
（艺术或表演中的）感染力，激情

en: Her voice trembled with emotion as she spoke about her childhood.
The film captures the raw emotion of human struggle.
He struggled to control his emotions during the debate.
cn: 她谈起童年时，声音因情绪激动而颤抖。
这部电影捕捉了人类抗争的原始情感。
他在辩论中努力控制自己的情绪。

en: She gave an emotional speech at the ceremony.
He is too emotional to make rational decisions.
The movie’s ending was deeply emotional.
cn: 她在仪式上发表了感人的演讲。
他太情绪化，无法做出理性决定。
这部电影的结局令人动容。

en: The emperor wore a golden crown adorned with jewels.
Historians debated whether the emperor truly had divine authority.
The decree was issued directly by the emperor himself.
cn: 皇帝戴着一顶镶有宝石的金冠。
历史学家们争论这位君主是否真的拥有神权。
此项法令由皇帝本人直接颁布。

en: The teacher placed special emphasis on critical thinking skills.
In this sentence, the emphasis falls on the first syllable of "important".
His speech lacked emphasis, making it hard to follow his main point.
cn: 老师特别强调了批判性思维的重要性。
这个句子中，重音落在“important”的第一个音节上。
他的演讲缺乏重点，让人难以抓住核心论点。

definitions.definition: 使突出（如通过语调或视觉手段）

en: The teacher emphasized the importance of punctuation.
His red tie emphasized the formal tone of his outfit.
The report emphasizes the need for immediate action.
cn: 老师强调了标点符号的重要性。
他的红色领带突出了着装的正式感。
报告着重指出需要立即采取行动。

en: The Roman Empire once dominated the Mediterranean world.
She built a fashion empire from a single boutique.
His empire over the company began to crumble after the scandal.
cn: 罗马帝国曾统治地中海世界。
她从一家小店建立起时尚帝国。
丑闻后，他对公司的绝对控制开始瓦解。

en: The company plans to employ 50 new staff this year.
She employed all her skills to solve the problem.
He has been in the employ of the bank for a decade.
cn: 该公司计划今年雇用50名新员工。
她动用全部技能解决了这个问题。
他受雇于这家银行已十年。

en: The company provides health insurance for every employee.
She has been a loyal employee for over a decade.
New employees must complete onboarding training.
cn: 该公司为每位雇员提供健康保险。
她已是一名忠诚雇员超过十年。
新员工必须完成入职培训。

en: The employer offered health benefits to all full-time staff.
She sued her former employer for unfair dismissal.
Small employers often struggle with rising labor costs.
cn: 雇主为所有全职员工提供健康福利。
她因不公正解雇起诉前雇主。
小型雇主常因劳动力成本上涨而艰难维持。

en: She found employment at a local school after graduation.
The government aims to reduce youth unemployment.
His employment of metaphors made the speech vivid.
cn: 毕业后，她在当地一所学校找到了工作。
政府计划降低青年失业率。
他对隐喻的运用让演讲生动起来。

en: The bottle is completely empty.
She emptied her bag onto the table.
The stadium emptied quickly after the concert.
cn: 瓶子完全空了。
她把包里的东西全倒在桌上。
音乐会结束后，体育场很快空无一人。

en: The scholarship enabled her to attend university.
Press this button to enable the Wi-Fi connection.
His encouragement enabled my confidence to grow.
cn: 奖学金使她得以进入大学。
按下此按钮以启用Wi-Fi连接。
他的鼓励让我的信心得以增强。

en: The garden was enclosed by a high brick wall.
Please find the documents enclosed with this letter.
Farmers often enclose their fields to protect crops.
cn: 花园被一堵高砖墙围了起来。
请查收随信附上的文件。
农民常围起田地以保护庄稼。

definitions.definition: 偶然遇到；遭遇（尤指意外或不愉快的事）

en: She encountered an old friend at the airport.
The explorers encountered fierce storms during their voyage.
His proposal encountered strong opposition from the committee.
cn: 她在机场偶遇了一位老友。
探险家们在航行中遭遇了猛烈的风暴。
他的提案遭到了委员会的强烈反对。

en: The teacher encouraged her students to ask questions.
Good weather encourages outdoor activities.
His success encouraged others to pursue their dreams.
cn: 老师鼓励学生提问。
好天气促进户外活动。
他的成功激励了他人追寻梦想。

en: The book has a surprising end.
We must end this discussion now.
She tied a knot at the end of the rope.
cn: 这本书有一个出乎意料的结局。
我们现在必须结束这场讨论。
她在绳子的末端打了个结。

en: The movie has a surprising ending.
Verbs change their endings to show tense.
She wrote a happy ending to her novel.
cn: 这部电影有一个出乎意料的结局。
动词通过词尾变化表示时态。
她为小说写了一个圆满的结尾。

definitions.definition: 循环的；重复的（如 endless loop）

en: The desert seemed endless under the scorching sun.
Her patience with the noisy children was nearly endless.
The video played in an endless loop, annoying everyone in the room.
cn: 灼热阳光下，沙漠仿佛无边无际。
她对吵闹孩子们的耐心几乎无穷无尽。
视频无限循环播放，惹恼了房间里所有人。

en: She endured years of hardship to achieve her dream.
Ancient traditions still endure in this village.
The material can endure extreme temperatures.
cn: 她忍受多年艰辛以实现梦想。
古老的习俗在这个村庄依然延续。
这种材料能承受极端温度。

en: He regarded criticism as a personal enemy.
The two nations became enemies after the border dispute.
Pride is the enemy of progress.
cn: 他将批评视为个人仇敌。
两国因边境争端成为敌对国家。
骄傲是进步的大敌。

en: Solar panels convert sunlight into usable energy.
She tackled the project with incredible energy and enthusiasm.
The law of conservation of energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed.
cn: 太阳能板将阳光转化为可用能量。
她以惊人的活力和热情投入该项目。
能量守恒定律指出，能量不能被创造或消灭。

en: The police are tasked to enforce traffic laws.
Strict penalties help enforce compliance with regulations.
Parents should not enforce their opinions on children.
cn: 警方负责执行交通法规。
严厉的惩罚有助于强制遵守规章。
父母不应将自己的观点强加给孩子。

definitions.definition: 参与；从事（与 in 连用）

en: The teacher tried to engage all students in the discussion.
His speech engaged the audience from the very beginning.
She decided to engage a lawyer for the legal case.
cn: 老师试图让所有学生参与讨论。
他的演讲一开始就吸引了观众。
她决定为这起法律案件聘请律师。

definitions.definition: 发动机，引擎（将能量转化为机械力的装置）

en: The car's engine roared to life.
James Watt improved the steam engine in the 18th century.
The fire engine rushed to the scene with sirens blaring.
cn: 汽车的引擎轰鸣着启动。
詹姆斯·瓦特在18世纪改良了蒸汽机。
消防车鸣着警笛冲向现场。

en: She works as a civil engineer, designing bridges.
He managed to engineer a successful business deal.
The team engineered a solution to reduce energy waste.
cn: 她是一名土木工程师，负责设计桥梁。
他精心策划了一笔成功的商业交易。
团队设计出一个减少能源浪费的方案。

definitions.definition: 设计、建造或维护工程系统的实践

en: She studied civil engineering at MIT.
The project requires advanced engineering solutions.
His approach blends creativity with precision engineering.
cn: 她在麻省理工学院学习土木工程。
该项目需要先进的工程技术方案。
他的方法将创造力与精密工程相结合。

en: English is the official language of many countries.
She speaks English with a British accent.
The history of English spans over 1,500 years.
cn: 英语是许多国家的官方语言。
她讲英语带英国口音。
英语的历史跨越了1500多年。

en: The Englishman wore a tweed jacket and carried an umbrella.
An Englishman's home is his castle.
He spoke like a true Englishman, with a crisp accent.
cn: 这位英格兰人穿着粗花呢夹克，带着一把伞。
英格兰人的家就是他的城堡（谚语：强调家庭隐私权）。
他说话带着纯正的英格兰口音，干脆利落。

en: She enjoys reading novels in her free time.
Citizens in this country enjoy free healthcare.
Did you enjoy the concert last night?
cn: 她闲暇时喜欢读小说。
该国民众享有免费医疗。
你喜欢昨晚的音乐会吗？

definitions.definition: 扩大；扩展（物理或抽象范围）
详述；展开（常与介词 on/upon 连用）

en: The company plans to enlarge its production capacity next year.
Could you enlarge on your proposal during the meeting?
The microscope enlarges the image by 100 times.
cn: 该公司计划明年扩大生产能力。
你能在会议上详细说明你的提案吗？
这台显微镜将图像放大100倍。

en: The elephant was truly enormous, towering over the trees.
She faced an enormous challenge in her new role.
The project required an enormous amount of time and resources.
cn: 大象体型极为庞大，高耸于树林之上。
她在新角色中面临巨大挑战。
该项目需要耗费大量的时间和资源。

en: We have enough food for the trip.
She didn’t study enough for the exam.
Enough is enough—let’s stop arguing.
cn: 我们为旅程准备了足够的食物。
她为考试复习得不够充分。
适可而止吧，我们别再争吵了。

definitions.definition: 确保，保证（某事发生或为真）
保护，使安全（古义，现较少用）

en: Double-check the data to ensure accuracy.
The contract ensures fair treatment for all employees.
Vaccination helps ensure community immunity.
cn: 反复核对数据以确保准确性。
该合同保障所有员工受到公平对待。
疫苗接种有助于确保群体免疫。

en: She knocked before entering the room.
He decided to enter the competition.
Press "Tab" to enter the data.
cn: 她敲门后进入房间。
他决定参加比赛。
按“Tab”键输入数据。

en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
She refused to entertain the idea of moving abroad.
Hotels must prioritize how they entertain their guests.
cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏逗乐了孩子们。
她拒绝考虑移居国外的想法。
酒店必须优先考虑如何招待客人。

definitions.definition: （对某活动或主题的）强烈兴趣

en: Her enthusiasm for science inspired her students.
The team played with great enthusiasm despite the rain.
His sudden enthusiasm for gardening surprised everyone.
cn: 她对科学的热情激励了她的学生。
尽管下雨，球队仍以极大热情投入比赛。
他对园艺突然产生的强烈兴趣让所有人惊讶。

en: She gave an enthusiastic speech that inspired the audience.
He is enthusiastic about learning new languages.
The team received enthusiastic support from their fans.
cn: 她发表了热情洋溢的演讲，鼓舞了听众。
他对学习新语言充满热情。
球队得到了粉丝们的热烈支持。

en: She spent the entire day reading the novel.
The project requires your entire attention.
The vase remained entire despite the earthquake.
cn: 她花了一整天读这本小说。
这个项目需要你全身心投入。
尽管经历了地震，花瓶依然完好无损。

en: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.
She entitled her memoir "Breaking Boundaries".
The law entitles workers to paid leave.
cn: 凭此券可免费领取一杯饮料。
她将回忆录取名为《打破边界》。
该法律赋予员工带薪休假的权利。

en: The museum entrance was crowded with tourists.
Her singing voice entranced the audience.
A hidden entrance led to the secret garden.
cn: 博物馆入口挤满了游客。
她的歌声令观众着迷。
一道隐蔽的入口通向秘密花园。

definitions.definition: 条目（如词典、表格中的记录）

en: The museum's main entry is decorated with marble columns.
Each dictionary entry includes pronunciation and etymology.
Her film entry won the Best Short Documentary award.
cn: 博物馆的主入口装饰着大理石柱。
词典中的每个条目都包含发音和词源信息。
她的参赛影片赢得了最佳短纪录片奖。

en: She sealed the letter in a yellow envelope.
The virus has a protective protein envelope.
The artist drew the envelope of the sound waves.
cn: 她将信装入黄色信封封好。
该病毒有一层保护性蛋白质包膜。
艺术家绘制了声波的包络线。

definitions.definition: 环境（自然或社会条件的总和）

en: The company aims to reduce its impact on the environment.
Children thrive in a supportive learning environment.
Polar bears are highly sensitive to changes in their Arctic environment.
cn: 该公司致力于减少对环境的影响。
儿童在支持性的学习环境中茁壮成长。
北极熊对北极环境的变化极为敏感。

en: She couldn't hide her envy when she saw his new car.
His success made him the object of envy among his peers.
I envy your ability to stay calm under pressure.
cn: 当她看到他的新车时，无法掩饰自己的嫉妒。
他的成功使他成为同龄人羡慕的对象。
我羡慕你在压力下保持冷静的能力。

en: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.
The two teams scored an equal number of goals.
His talent equals that of any professional musician.
cn: 人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等。
两队得分相同。
他的才华可与任何专业音乐家比肩。

en: The constitution guarantees equality before the law.
Solving this equation requires understanding the equality of both sides.
Gender equality remains a global challenge.
cn: 宪法保障法律面前的平等。
解此方程需理解两边的等式关系。
性别平等仍是全球性挑战。

en: The teacher wrote a quadratic equation on the blackboard.
Balancing work and life is a difficult equation for many professionals.
The chemical equation shows the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen.
cn: 老师在黑板上写了一个二次方程。
对许多职场人来说，平衡工作与生活是一道难题。
这个化学方程式展示了氢与氧的反应。

en: The laboratory is equipped with advanced microscopes.
His training equipped him to handle emergencies.
They spent a fortune to equip the expedition.
cn: 实验室配备了先进的显微镜。
他的训练使他具备处理紧急情况的能力。
他们花费巨资为探险队配备物资。

definitions.definition: 设备，器材（指完成特定任务所需的工具或装置）
配备，装备（抽象意义上的资源或能力）

en: The laboratory purchased new equipment for genetic research.
His knowledge and experience are his best equipment for the job.
The soldiers checked their equipment before the mission.
cn: 实验室为基因研究购置了新设备。
他的知识和经验是胜任这份工作的最佳装备。
士兵们在任务前检查了装备。

en: The two chemicals are equivalent in potency.
She found no equivalent for the word in her native language.
Silence is sometimes equivalent to agreement.
cn: 这两种化学物质的效力是等同的。
她在母语中找不到这个词的对应表达。
沉默有时等同于同意。

en: The invention of the internet marked the beginning of a new era.
The Jurassic era was dominated by dinosaurs.
Her leadership ushered in an era of prosperity.
cn: 互联网的发明标志着一个新时代的开始。
侏罗纪纪元的霸主是恐龙。
她的领导开创了一个繁荣的时期。

en: The flagpole stands erect in the square.
They plan to erect a monument to honor the heroes.
The cat's ears became erect when it heard the noise.
cn: 旗杆笔直地矗立在广场上。
他们计划建立一座纪念碑以纪念英雄。
猫听到声响时竖起了耳朵。

en: The document contains several spelling errors.
The margin of error in this experiment is less than 1%.
Human error was blamed for the accident.
cn: 这份文件有几处拼写错误。
该实验的误差范围小于1%。
事故归咎于人为失误。

en: The prisoner escaped through a hidden tunnel.
Reading is her escape from reality.
The gas is escaping from the pipe.
cn: 囚犯通过一条隐蔽的隧道逃脱。
阅读是她逃避现实的方式。
气体正从管道中泄漏。

definitions.definition: 特别地，尤其（强调突出某事物）
专门地（指特定目的或对象）

en: She loves flowers, especially roses.
This tool is designed especially for left-handed users.
The speech was moving, especially the final paragraph.
cn: 她喜欢花，尤其是玫瑰。
这个工具是专门为左撇子设计的。
演讲很动人，特别是最后一段。

en: She wrote an essay on environmental ethics.
He decided to essay a new cooking technique.
The book includes a humorous essay about city life.
cn: 她写了一篇关于环境伦理的短文。
他决定尝试一种新的烹饪技巧。
这本书收录了一篇关于城市生活的幽默随笔。

en: Water is essential for all living organisms.
The essential ingredients of this recipe are flour and eggs.
Time management is an essential skill in modern workplaces.
cn: 水是所有生物生存的必需品。
这道食谱的必要成分是面粉和鸡蛋。
时间管理是现代职场中的必备技能。

definitions.definition: 建立，设立（机构、系统或规则）

en: The company plans to establish a new branch in Tokyo.
His research established a link between diet and heart disease.
The treaty established lasting peace between the two nations.
cn: 该公司计划在东京设立新分部。
他的研究证实了饮食与心脏病的关联。
该条约确立了两国间的持久和平。

en: The new research establishment will focus on renewable energy.
He criticized the political establishment for resisting change.
The establishment of the school took over five years.
cn: 这家新研究机构将专注于可再生能源。
他批评政治当权派抗拒变革。
这所学校的建立耗时五年多。

en: The contractor will estimate the cost of the renovation.
Her estimate of the situation proved accurate.
Can you give a rough estimate of how long the project will take?
cn: 承包商将估算翻修费用。
她对形势的评估被证明是准确的。
你能粗略估计一下项目需要多久吗？

en: European culture has a rich history.
She is a European citizen.
The conference attracted many European scholars.
cn: 欧洲文化拥有丰富的历史。
她是一名欧洲公民。
这次会议吸引了众多欧洲学者。

en: Teachers need to evaluate students' progress objectively.
The algorithm evaluates thousands of data points per second.
We will evaluate the proposal based on cost and feasibility.
cn: 教师需要客观评估学生的进步。
该算法每秒计算数千个数据点。
我们将根据成本和可行性评估该提案。

en: The sun will evaporate the water on the pavement.
His confidence seemed to evaporate during the interview.
Salt can be harvested by evaporating seawater.
cn: 阳光会蒸发路面上的水。
面试中，他的信心似乎逐渐消失了。
通过蒸发海水可以获取盐。

en: On the eve of the election, tensions ran high.
We decorated the house on Christmas Eve.
The treaty was signed on the eve of war.
cn: 选举前夕，紧张情绪高涨。
我们在圣诞夜装饰了房子。
条约在战争前夕签署。

en: The table surface is perfectly even.
She didn't even apologize for being late.
The teams are now even with three points each.
cn: 桌面完全平坦。
她甚至没有为迟到道歉。
两队现在平分，各得三分。

definitions.definition: 傍晚，黄昏（日落到入睡前的时间段）

en: The sky turned orange in the evening.
We're hosting an evening of classical music.
She enjoys a quiet walk every evening.
cn: 傍晚时分，天空变成了橙色。
我们将举办一场古典音乐晚会。
她喜欢每天傍晚安静地散步。

en: The concert was the biggest social event of the year.
She won a gold medal in the track and field events.
Unexpected events forced us to change our plans.
cn: 这场音乐会是今年最盛大的社交活动。
她在田径比赛中赢得了金牌。
意外事件迫使我们改变了计划。

en: After years of hard work, she eventually became a renowned scientist.
The storm caused delays, but we eventually arrived safely.
All the small decisions you make will eventually shape your future.
cn: 经过多年努力，她最终成为了一位著名科学家。
暴风雨导致延误，但我们终于安全抵达。
你做出的所有小决定终将塑造你的未来。

definitions.definition: （用于比较级或最高级后）以往任何时候

en: Have you ever been to Paris?
This is the most beautiful sunset I’ve ever seen.
She works harder than ever before.
cn: 你去过巴黎吗？
这是我见过最美的日落。
她比以往任何时候都更努力。

en: Every student must submit the assignment by Friday.
She checks every detail before signing the contract.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
cn: 每位学生必须在周五前提交作业。
她签署合同前会核对每一个细节。
黑暗中总有一线光明。（谚语）

en: Everybody deserves respect.
The teacher asked everybody to be quiet.
When the lights went out, everybody screamed.
cn: 每个人都值得尊重。
老师要求所有人保持安静。
灯熄灭时，所有人都尖叫起来。

en: She wore her everyday clothes to the casual gathering.
These are just everyday problems that everyone faces.
The book turns everyday experiences into poetic reflections.
cn: 她穿着日常便服参加了这次非正式聚会。
这些不过是每个人都会遇到的平常问题。
这本书将日常经历转化为诗意的思考。

en: Everyone deserves equal opportunities.
The teacher asked everyone to submit their homework by Friday.
When the fire alarm rang, everyone evacuated the building calmly.
cn: 每个人都应享有平等的机会。
老师要求所有人周五前提交作业。
火警响起时，所有人冷静地撤离了大楼。

en: She means everything to me.
Everything in the store is on sale today.
He checked everything twice before submitting.
cn: 她是我的一切。
今天店里所有商品都在打折。
提交前他把所有内容检查了两遍。

en: Snowflakes fell everywhere, covering the entire town.
Her kindness is recognized everywhere she goes.
With smartphones, information is available everywhere.
cn: 雪花四处飘落，覆盖了整个小镇。
她的善良在她所到之处皆受认可。
有了智能手机，信息随处可得。

en: The fingerprints provided crucial evidence in the case.
Her smile evidenced her relief.
There is no evidence to support this theory.
cn: 指纹为案件提供了关键证据。
她的笑容表明她如释重负。
没有证据支持这一理论。

en: The fingerprints were evident on the glass.
Her happiness was evident in her smile.
There is no evident solution to this problem.
cn: 玻璃上的指纹清晰可见。
她的笑容明显流露出幸福。
这个问题没有显而易见的解决方法。

en: The villain's evil plan threatened the entire city.
She believes no one is born inherently evil.
The documentary exposed the evil of child labor.
cn: 反派的邪恶计划威胁了整个城市。
她认为没有人天生邪恶。
这部纪录片揭露了童工的罪恶。

en: The theory of evolution explains the diversity of life.
Language is a product of cultural evolution.
The dancers performed a complex evolution across the stage.
cn: 进化论解释了生命的多样性。
语言是文化演变的产物。
舞者在舞台上完成了复杂的队形变换。

en: The company's strategy continues to evolve with market trends.
Darwin observed how species evolve over generations.
We must evolve our methods to meet new challenges.
cn: 公司的策略随着市场趋势不断演变。
达尔文观察了物种如何代代进化。
我们必须改进方法以应对新挑战。

definitions.definition: 强求，索取（如金钱、承诺等）

en: The scientist needs exact measurements for the experiment.
The landlord exacted a high rent from the tenants.
Her memory of the event was exact, down to the smallest detail.
cn: 科学家需要精确的测量数据来完成实验。
房东向租户索要高额租金。
她对事件的记忆分毫不差，连最微小的细节都记得。

en: The meeting starts at exactly 9:00 AM.
"So you mean we need to redo the report?" "Exactly."
She followed the instructions exactly to avoid mistakes.
cn: 会议在上午9点整开始。
“所以你的意思是我们需要重写报告？”“正是。”
她严格遵循说明以避免出错。

en: Don't exaggerate the difficulties; they're manageable.
His claims were clearly exaggerated to attract attention.
She tends to exaggerate when telling stories.
cn: 别夸大困难，它们是可以解决的。
他的说法明显夸大其词，以博取关注。
她讲故事时总爱添油加醋。

definitions.definition: 考试；测验（examination 的缩写形式）

en: She passed the final exam with flying colors.
The math exam was harder than expected.
He stayed up all night cramming for the biology exam.
cn: 她以优异成绩通过了期末考试。
数学考试比预想的更难。
他熬夜突击复习生物考试。

en: The final examination covers all topics studied this semester.
A thorough examination of the data revealed inconsistencies.
The doctor recommended a routine physical examination.
cn: 期末考试涵盖本学期所有学习内容。
对数据的详细检查发现了矛盾之处。
医生建议进行一次常规体检。

en: The doctor will examine your injury carefully.
Students must examine all evidence before drawing conclusions.
The committee examined the proposal for potential risks.
cn: 医生会仔细检查你的伤势。
学生在得出结论前必须审查所有证据。
委员会审查了该提案的潜在风险。

en: This experiment is a classic example of Newton's laws.
She sets a good example for her younger siblings.
The teacher provided several examples to clarify the concept.
cn: 这个实验是牛顿定律的经典范例。
她为弟妹树立了良好的榜样。
老师提供了几个例子来阐明这一概念。

en: The project's costs may exceed the initial budget.
Her performance exceeded all our expectations.
Speed limits are set to ensure drivers do not exceed safe velocities.
cn: 该项目成本可能超出初始预算。
她的表现远超我们所有人的预期。
限速是为了确保驾驶员不超过安全速度。

definitions.definition: 极其；非常（用于强调程度）

en: The weather was exceedingly hot last summer.
She played the violin exceedingly well.
This task is exceedingly difficult for beginners.
cn: 去年夏天天气极其炎热。
她的小提琴演奏得极为出色。
对初学者来说，这项任务非常困难。

en: She received an excellent grade on her research paper.
The restaurant is known for its excellent service.
His performance was excellent, surpassing all expectations.
cn: 她的研究报告获得了优异的成绩。
这家餐厅以出色的服务闻名。
他的表现极为出色，超出了所有人的预期。

en: Everyone attended the meeting except John.
The museum is open daily except Mondays.
She would have passed the exam except for the last question.
cn: 除约翰外，所有人都参加了会议。
博物馆每日开放，周一除外。
若非最后一道题，她本可通过考试。

en: Everyone passed the exam, with the exception of two students.
The judge overruled the defense's exception to the evidence.
This rule applies to all cases without exception.
cn: 除两名学生外，其他人都通过了考试。
法官驳回了辩方对证据的异议。
此规则无一例外适用于所有情况。

en: The company warned against excess consumption of energy.
She trimmed the excess fabric from the dress.
His excess enthusiasm sometimes annoys others.
cn: 公司警告避免能源的过度消耗。
她剪去了裙子上多余的布料。
他过度的热情有时会惹人厌烦。

en: Excessive sugar consumption can lead to health problems.
She apologized for her excessive enthusiasm during the meeting.
The government imposed fines for excessive noise pollution.
cn: 过量摄入糖分会导致健康问题。
她为自己在会议中过度的热情道歉。
政府对过度的噪音污染处以罚款。

en: They exchanged gifts at the Christmas party.
The stock exchange crashed due to economic instability.
Can I exchange dollars for euros here?
cn: 他们在圣诞派对上互赠礼物。
由于经济不稳定，股市暴跌。
这里可以将美元兑换成欧元吗？

definitions.definition: （物理）使（原子或粒子）处于激发态

en: The concert excited the crowd with its energetic performance.
Scientists use lasers to excite electrons to higher energy levels.
Her innovative ideas always excite discussions in the team.
cn: 音乐会以充满活力的表演点燃了观众的热情。
科学家用激光激发电子至更高能级。
她的创新想法总能激发团队讨论。

definitions.definition: （excite的现在分词形式）使激动，激发

en: The roller coaster ride was incredibly exciting.
She gave an exciting speech that inspired the audience.
The discovery of a new species is always exciting for scientists.
cn: 过山车之旅令人无比兴奋。
她做了一场激动人心的演讲，鼓舞了听众。
新物种的发现对科学家来说总是令人振奋的。

en: She exclaimed in delight when she saw the surprise.
"That's impossible!" he exclaimed angrily.
The crowd exclaimed as the fireworks lit up the sky.
cn: 她看到惊喜时高兴地叫了起来。
“这不可能！”他愤怒地喊道。
烟花点亮夜空时，人群发出惊叹。

definitions.definition: 排除；拒绝接纳；将…关在门外

en: The policy excludes students with low attendance.
She felt excluded from the conversation.
The price excludes taxes and fees.
cn: 该政策将出勤率低的学生排除在外。
她感到自己被排除在谈话之外。
此价格不含税费。

en: This room is exclusively for VIP guests.
She works exclusively with organic materials.
The offer is available exclusively online.
cn: 这个房间仅供贵宾使用。
她只使用有机材料进行创作。
该优惠仅限线上购买。

en: We went on an excursion to the nearby mountains last weekend.
His lecture included an excursion into quantum physics.
The school organizes annual excursions for students.
cn: 上周末我们去了附近山区短途旅行。
他的讲座短暂探讨了量子物理学。
学校每年为学生组织远足活动。

en: Please excuse my late arrival.
He made a lame excuse for skipping class.
Fatigue is no excuse for poor work.
cn: 请原谅我的迟到。
他为逃课编了个蹩脚的借口。
疲劳不能成为工作马虎的理由。

en: The software will execute the command immediately.
The court ordered to execute the prisoner at dawn.
The contract was executed in the presence of witnesses.
cn: 该软件将立即执行命令。
法庭下令在黎明时分处决囚犯。
合同在见证人面前签署生效。

en: She was promoted to chief executive officer last year.
The executive committee will meet tomorrow.
His executive skills made the project successful.
cn: 她去年晋升为首席执行官。
执行委员会将于明日召开会议。
他的执行能力确保了项目的成功。

en: Regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
She exercises her right to vote in every election.
The teacher assigned grammar exercises for homework.
cn: 定期锻炼有益身心健康。
她在每次选举中都行使投票权。
老师布置了语法练习作为家庭作业。

definitions.definition: 施加（力量、影响等）；努力行使（权威、能力等）

en: She had to exert all her strength to move the heavy box.
The government exerted its authority to maintain order.
Don’t exert yourself too much during recovery.
cn: 她必须使出全力才能搬动那个沉重的箱子。
政府行使权威以维持秩序。
恢复期间不要过度劳累。

en: The long hike exhausted all of us.
Car exhaust contributes to air pollution.
She felt emotionally exhausted after the debate.
cn: 长时间的徒步让我们筋疲力尽。
汽车尾气加剧空气污染。
辩论后她感到精神透支。

en: The museum will exhibit rare fossils next month.
Her paintings were the highlight of the exhibit.
The lawyer exhibited new evidence in court.
cn: 博物馆下月将展出稀有化石。
她的画作是展览的亮点。
律师在法庭上提交了新证据。

en: The museum is hosting an exhibition of modern art.
Her piano performance was a remarkable exhibition of talent.
The science exhibition attracted thousands of visitors.
cn: 博物馆正在举办一场现代艺术展览。
她的钢琴演奏是一次才华的出色展现。
这场科学展览吸引了数千名参观者。

en: Do aliens exist in the universe?
The old castle has existed for over 500 years.
Happiness exists in small daily moments.
cn: 宇宙中存在外星人吗？
这座古堡已存在了五百多年。
幸福存在于日常的小瞬间中。

en: The existence of life on other planets remains unproven.
Her existence in the small town felt lonely and meaningless.
The philosopher questioned the very nature of human existence.
cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍未被证实。
她在这个小镇的生活孤独而乏味。
这位哲学家质疑人类存在的本质。

en: The emergency exit is marked with a green light.
She exited the room without saying a word.
Press ESC to exit the program.
cn: 紧急出口用绿灯标识。
她一言不发地离开了房间。
按ESC键退出程序。

definitions.definition: 扩大，扩展（物理或抽象范围）

en: The company plans to expand its operations to Asia next year.
Heat causes metals to expand.
Could you expand on your proposal in the meeting?
cn: 该公司计划明年将业务扩展至亚洲。
热量会导致金属膨胀。
你能在会议上详细阐述你的提案吗？

definitions.definition: 扩张；扩展（物理或抽象范围的增大）
膨胀（气体或物体的体积增大）

en: The rapid expansion of the universe was confirmed by astronomers.
The company plans an expansion into Asian markets next year.
Heat causes the expansion of metal.
cn: 天文学家证实了宇宙的快速膨胀。
该公司计划明年向亚洲市场扩张。
热量导致金属膨胀。

definitions.definition: 认为（某事会发生或属实）

en: We expect the project to be completed by Friday.
She expected a promotion after years of hard work.
Don't expect miracles from this new policy.
cn: 我们预计项目将在周五前完成。
多年辛勤工作后，她期待升职。
不要对这项新政策抱有过高期望。

en: Her performance exceeded all expectations.
The project failed to meet financial expectations.
In probability theory, expectation is a key concept.
cn: 她的表现超出了所有人的预期。
该项目未达到财务预期。
概率论中，期望值是一个核心概念。

en: The company will cover all travel expenses.
Don't expense personal purchases to the company account.
Cutting unnecessary expenses is key to financial health.
cn: 公司将承担所有差旅费用。
不要将个人消费计入公司账户。
减少不必要的开支是财务健康的关键。

en: The hotel was too expensive for our budget.
Winning the war came at an expensive human cost.
She avoided expensive restaurants to save money.
cn: 这家酒店超出了我们的预算。
赢得这场战争付出了巨大的人员代价。
为了省钱，她避开了高档餐厅。

en: Her experience in teaching spans over 20 years.
Traveling allows you to experience different cultures.
The accident was a terrifying experience for everyone involved.
cn: 她的教学经验超过20年。
旅行让你体验不同的文化。
这次事故对所有参与者来说都是一次可怕的经历。

en: The experiment confirmed the theory.
She experimented with different materials.
Children learn by experiment.
cn: 实验验证了该理论。
她尝试了多种材料。
儿童通过实践学习。

en: The drug is still in the experimental stage.
She took an experimental approach to teaching.
The band's new sound is highly experimental.
cn: 这种药物仍处于实验阶段。
她采用了一种实验性的教学方法。
乐队的新风格极具实验性。

en: She is an expert in marine biology.
His expert hands repaired the watch swiftly.
The report was reviewed by a panel of experts.
cn: 她是海洋生物学领域的专家。
他熟练的双手迅速修好了手表。
该报告由专家小组审核。

en: Can you explain how this machine works?
She tried to explain her absence, but no one believed her.
The teacher used diagrams to explain the concept.
cn: 你能解释这台机器的工作原理吗？
她试图为自己的缺席辩解，但没人相信。
老师用图表来解释这个概念。

en: His explanation of the theory was crystal clear.
She offered no explanation for her sudden departure.
The manual includes a detailed explanation of each function.
cn: 他对该理论的解释非常清晰。
她对突然离开未作任何解释。
手册包含对每个功能的详细说明。

en: The bomb could explode at any moment.
The crowd exploded into cheers when the team scored.
His theory was exploded by new evidence.
cn: 炸弹随时可能爆炸。
球队得分时，人群爆发出欢呼声。
新证据推翻了他的理论。

en: The novel recounts his exploits during the war.
Solar energy is a clean resource waiting to be exploited.
Some companies exploit workers by paying unfair wages.
cn: 这部小说记述了他在战争中的英勇事迹。
太阳能是待开发的清洁资源。
有些公司通过支付不公工资剥削工人。

en: Scientists explore the deep ocean to discover new species.
She loves to explore different cultures through travel.
The book explores the themes of identity and belonging.
cn: 科学家探索深海以发现新物种。
她喜欢通过旅行探究不同文化。
这本书深入探讨了身份与归属的主题。

en: The explosion shook the entire building.
Her sudden explosion of laughter surprised everyone.
The invention led to an explosion of technological advancements.
cn: 爆炸震动了整栋大楼。
她突然爆发的大笑让所有人惊讶。
这项发明引发了技术进步的迅猛发展。

en: The explosive device was safely defused by the bomb squad.
His explosive temper often startled his colleagues.
The volcano's explosive eruption covered the town in ash.
cn: 拆弹小组安全拆除了该爆炸装置。
他暴躁的脾气常让同事猝不及防。
火山爆发性的喷发使小镇被火山灰覆盖。

definitions.definition: 出口，输出（商品、服务或数据）

en: China exports electronics to global markets.
The company's main export is renewable energy technology.
Data export requires user authorization.
cn: 中国向全球市场出口电子产品。
该公司的主要出口商品是可再生能源技术。
数据输出需要用户授权。

en: The journalist exposed the corruption scandal.
Children should be exposed to diverse cultures early.
Prolonged exposure to sunlight can damage your skin.
cn: 记者揭露了这起腐败丑闻。
儿童应尽早接触多元文化。
长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

en: Prolonged exposure to sunlight can cause skin damage.
The journalist risked her life for the exposure of corruption.
Adjust the camera settings for a longer exposure time.
cn: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。
这名记者为揭露腐败冒着生命危险。
调整相机设置以延长曝光时间。

en: She struggled to express her feelings in words.
The package was sent by express delivery.
His express wish was to keep the matter private.
cn: 她难以用语言表达自己的感受。
包裹通过快递寄出。
他明确表示希望此事保密。

en: Her facial expression revealed her disappointment.
Freedom of expression is a fundamental human right.
The equation is a complex mathematical expression.
cn: 她的表情透露出失望。
言论自由是一项基本人权。
这个等式是一个复杂的数学表达式。

definitions.definition: 延长（时间或空间）；扩展（范围或用途）

en: The company plans to extend its operations to Asia.
She extended her hand to greet the guest.
The deadline has been extended by two weeks.
cn: 该公司计划将业务扩展到亚洲。
她伸出手迎接客人。
截止日期延长了两周。

definitions.definition: 延伸；扩展部分（如建筑、时间等）

en: The extension of the subway line will reduce traffic congestion.
Please dial extension 205 for customer service.
The file won't open because it's missing the .pdf extension.
cn: 地铁线路的延伸将缓解交通拥堵。
请拨打分机号205联系客服。
文件无法打开，因为它缺少.pdf扩展名。

en: The farm has extensive fields of wheat.
She conducted extensive research on climate change.
The museum offers extensive collections of ancient artifacts.
cn: 农场拥有广阔的小麦田。
她对气候变化进行了广泛的研究。
该博物馆藏有大量古代文物。

en: The extent of the damage surprised everyone.
She tested the extent of his patience.
The forest covers an extent of 500 square miles.
cn: 损坏的程度让所有人震惊。
她试探了他耐心的限度。
这片森林占地500平方英里。

en: The exterior walls of the house were painted white.
She maintained a calm exterior despite feeling nervous.
The car's exterior shows no signs of damage.
cn: 房子的外墙被漆成了白色。
尽管内心紧张，她保持着平静的外表。
这辆车的外表没有损坏痕迹。

en: The external walls of the building are painted white.
External factors like weather can affect crop growth.
The company focuses on both internal and external communication.
cn: 建筑物的外墙被漆成白色。
天气等外部因素会影响作物生长。
该公司注重内部与外部的双向沟通。

en: She ordered an extra-large pizza for the party.
The hotel charges extra for room service.
He worked extra hard to meet the deadline.
cn: 她为聚会点了一份超大号披萨。
这家酒店对客房服务额外收费。
他格外努力地工作以赶上截止日期。

en: She showed extraordinary courage in the face of danger.
The scientist made an extraordinary discovery.
His memory is extraordinary—he can recall every detail.
cn: 她在危险面前表现出非凡的勇气。
这位科学家做出了惊人的发现。
他的记忆力非凡，能记住每个细节。

en: She took extreme measures to protect her privacy.
The weather reached an extreme of 45°C last summer.
His opinions are often at the opposite extreme of mine.
cn: 她采取了极端措施来保护隐私。
去年夏季气温达到了45摄氏度的极端高温。
他的观点常与我的截然相反。

en: The weather was extremely hot this summer.
She worked extremely hard to achieve her goals.
This material is extremely durable under pressure.
cn: 今年夏天天气极其炎热。
她为实现目标付出了极大努力。
这种材料在压力下极其耐用。

en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement.
The detective eyed the suspicious package carefully.
Through a child's eyes, the world is full of wonders.
cn: 她的眼睛因兴奋而闪闪发光。
侦探仔细审视着可疑的包裹。
在孩子的眼中，世界充满奇迹。

en: His eyesight deteriorated after years of working in dim light.
Eagles have exceptional eyesight to spot prey from great distances.
Regular eye exams help maintain good eyesight.
cn: 多年在昏暗光线下工作后，他的视力下降了。
鹰拥有极佳的视力，能从远处发现猎物。
定期检查有助于保持良好视力。

en: Aesop's fables teach moral lessons through animal characters.
His excuse was a mere fable, full of contradictions.
She fabled a world where trees could speak.
cn: 《伊索寓言》通过动物角色传递道德教训。
他的借口纯属虚构，漏洞百出。
她虚构了一个树木会说话的世界。

en: The dress is made of fine silk fabric.
The fabric of society depends on mutual trust.
This fabric softens after washing.
cn: 这条裙子由优质丝绸面料制成。
社会的结构依赖于相互信任。
这种布料洗后会变柔软。

en: She wiped the sweat from her face after the run.
The building faces south to get more sunlight.
We must face the reality of climate change.
cn: 跑步后，她擦去脸上的汗水。
这栋建筑朝南以获得更多阳光。
我们必须正视气候变化的现实。

definitions.definition: 设施；设备（如公共设施、医疗设施）
天赋；才能（指轻松完成某事的能力）

en: The hotel offers excellent sports facilities.
She has a facility for learning languages.
The new laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
cn: 这家酒店提供出色的体育设施。
她有学习语言的天赋。
新实验室配备了最先进的设备。

en: The experiment confirmed the scientific fact.
She presented facts to support her argument.
In fact, the situation was more complex than we thought.
cn: 实验证实了这一科学事实。
她列举事实来支持自己的论点。
事实上，情况比我们想象的更复杂。

en: Time is a critical factor in this experiment.
We need to factor in the cost of materials.
cn: 时间是该实验的关键因素。
我们需要将材料成本纳入考量。

definitions.definition: （比喻）大量生产某物的地方或系统

en: The car factory employs over 3,000 workers.
Silicon Valley is a factory of innovation.
The old textile factory was converted into apartments.
cn: 这家汽车工厂雇佣了3000多名工人。
硅谷是创新的“工厂”。
旧纺织厂被改造成了公寓。

definitions.definition: 天赋，能力（尤指心智或身体的特殊能力）

en: She joined the faculty of Harvard Law School last year.
cn: 她去年加入了哈佛法学院的教职团队。

en: The sunlight faded behind the mountains.
Over time, the red curtains faded to pink.
Her smile faded as she heard the bad news.
cn: 阳光逐渐消失在山后。
随着时间的推移，红色窗帘褪成了粉色。
听到坏消息时，她的笑容消失了。

definitions.definition: 华氏温度（温标单位，符号°F）

en: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit.
The weather forecast predicts 75°F tomorrow.
Fahrenheit and Celsius are two common temperature scales.
cn: 水在212华氏度时沸腾。
天气预报说明天气温为75华氏度。
华氏度和摄氏度是两种常用的温标。

en: He tried to fix the engine but failed.
The company failed to meet its annual targets.
Her courage never fails to inspire me.
cn: 他试图修理引擎，但失败了。
该公司未能达成年度目标。
她的勇气总能激励我。

en: His project ended in failure due to poor planning.
The power failure lasted for six hours.
The company declared failure after years of losses.
cn: 他的项目因计划不周而以失败告终。
停电持续了六小时。
该公司在多年亏损后宣布破产。

en: The sound of the violin grew faint in the distance.
She felt dizzy and nearly fainted.
There was a faint smell of roses in the room.
cn: 小提琴的声音在远处逐渐变得微弱。
她感到头晕，几乎昏过去。
房间里有一丝淡淡的玫瑰香气。

en: The judge made a fair decision.
She has fair hair and blue eyes.
We visited the annual book fair last weekend.
cn: 法官作出了公正的裁决。
她有一头金发和蓝色的眼睛。
上周末我们参观了年度书展。

en: The teacher graded the exams fairly.
The movie was fairly entertaining, though not outstanding.
He explained the rules fairly clearly.
cn: 老师公平地批改了试卷。
这部电影还算有趣，但并不出色。
他相当清楚地解释了规则。

en: She has great faith in her team's ability.
The ceremony is central to their faith.
He acted in good faith, unaware of the deception.
cn: 她对团队的能力充满信心。
这一仪式是他们信仰的核心。
他本着诚信行事，未察觉欺骗。

en: The dog remained faithful to its owner until the end.
Her translation is a faithful reproduction of the original text.
He has been a faithful employee for over 20 years.
cn: 这只狗对主人至死不渝。

en: Leaves fall from the trees in November.

cn: 十一月树叶从树上飘落。
她在结冰的人行道上滑倒了。

en: The witness gave false testimony under pressure.
Her smile was warm, but her words felt false.
The antique vase turned out to be a false replica.
cn: 证人在压力下作了伪证。
她的笑容温暖，但话语显得虚伪。
这个古董花瓶原来是件赝品。

en: Her scientific breakthroughs brought her international fame.
The actor struggled to handle the pressures of sudden fame.
In ancient Rome, poets sought fame through epic works.
cn: 她的科学突破为她赢得了国际声誉。
这位演员难以应对突然成名的压力。
在古罗马，诗人通过史诗作品追求声名。

en: Her face looks familiar, but I can't recall her name.
He spoke in a familiar tone, as if we were old friends.
The café regulars are all familiars to the owner.
cn: 她的脸很熟悉，但我想不起名字。
他用随意的语气说话，仿佛我们是老友。
这家咖啡馆的常客都是老板的熟人。

definitions.definition: 家庭（由父母和子女组成的群体）
家族（有血缘或婚姻关系的群体）

en: She comes from a large family with six siblings.
The tiger belongs to the cat family.
Family support is crucial during difficult times.
cn: 她来自一个有六个兄弟姐妹的大家庭。
老虎属于猫科动物。
家人的支持在困难时期至关重要。

en: The prolonged drought led to a devastating famine in the region.
During the war, many cities suffered from coal famine.
Scientists warn of a potential water famine in the next decade.
cn: 持续干旱导致该地区爆发毁灭性饥荒。
战争期间，许多城市遭遇煤炭短缺。
科学家警告未来十年可能出现水资源危机。

definitions.definition: （非正式）极好的，非常令人满意的

en: Shakespeare is one of the most famous writers in history.
The restaurant is famous for its spicy noodles.
"I'll finish this project by tomorrow," he said—famous last words!
cn: 莎士比亚是历史上最著名的作家之一。
这家餐厅以辣味面条闻名。

en: She waved a bamboo fan to cool herself.
The scandal fanned public anger.
He's a huge fan of classical music.
cn: 她摇着竹扇纳凉。
丑闻煽动了公众的愤怒。
他是古典音乐的狂热爱好者。

en: She had a fancy for vintage cars.
The cake was decorated with fancy patterns.
Do you fancy going to the cinema tonight?
cn: 她对古董车情有独钟。
蛋糕装饰着精美的花纹。
你想今晚去看电影吗？

en: The mountains look far in the hazy weather.
She has traveled far beyond her hometown.
This theory is far more convincing than the previous one.
cn: 雾气中群山显得遥远。
她的足迹远至故乡之外。
该理论远比先前的更有说服力。

en: The bus fare has increased by 20% this year.
The restaurant offers traditional Scottish fare.
How did you fare in the interview?
cn: 今年公交车费上涨了20%。
这家餐厅提供传统的苏格兰食物。
你面试进展如何？

en: She waved farewell to her friends at the station.
"Farewell, my dear," he whispered before leaving.
The farewell party lasted until midnight.
cn: 她在车站向朋友们挥手告别。
“再会了，亲爱的。”他离开前轻声说道。
告别派对持续到午夜。

en: They grow organic vegetables on their family farm.
He decided to farm trout in the mountain streams.
Many people farmed this land before it became a nature reserve.
cn: 他们在家庭农场种植有机蔬菜。
他决定在山间溪流养殖鳟鱼。
这片土地成为自然保护区前，许多人曾在此耕作。

definitions.definition: （特定领域的）经营者（如 dairy farmer 奶农）

en: The farmer grows organic vegetables on his land.
She is a successful sheep farmer in New Zealand.
Solar farmers contribute to renewable energy production.
cn: 这位农民在他的土地上种植有机蔬菜。
她是新西兰一位成功的牧羊人。
太阳能农场主为可再生能源生产做出贡献。

en: The mountain peak is farther than it appears.
She walked farther into the forest, searching for the lost path.
We need to push the project farther to meet the deadline.
cn: 那座山峰比看起来更远。
她向森林深处走去，寻找迷失的小路。
我们需要进一步推进项目以赶上截止日期。

en: She always keeps up with the latest fashion.
He fashioned a toy boat from a piece of wood.
The story is told in a poetic fashion.
cn: 她始终紧跟最新时尚。
他用一块木头手工制作了一个玩具船。
故事以诗意的风格讲述。

This café is a fashionable spot for young artists.
In the 1920s, short haircuts became fashionable for women.
cn: 她总是穿着时髦的衣服。
这家咖啡馆是年轻艺术家们的潮流聚集地。

en: The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
She held fast to the rope during the storm.
He decided to fast for religious reasons.
cn: 猎豹是陆地上最快的动物。
暴风雨中她紧紧抓住绳子。
他因宗教原因决定斋戒。

en: Fasten your seatbelt before driving.
She used a pin to fasten the torn fabric.
The door won’t fasten properly due to a broken latch.
cn: 开车前请系好安全带。
她用别针固定撕破的布料。
门闩坏了，门无法扣紧。

His fatal mistake cost the company millions.
In Greek mythology, the Fates controlled fatal destinies.
cn: 这场事故导致三名乘客丧生。
他的致命错误让公司损失了数百万。
希腊神话中，命运女神掌控着注定的结局。

definitions.definition: 结局，最终结果（尤指灾难性的）

en: They believed it was fate that brought them together.
The ship met its fate in a violent storm.
She accepted her fate with quiet dignity.
cn: 他们相信是命运让他们相遇。
那艘船在暴风雨中遭遇了毁灭。
她以沉默的尊严接受了命运的安排。

definitions.definition: 成为…的父亲；创立（思想、理论等）

en: He is the father of three children.
Freud is often called the father of psychoanalysis.
She inherited her artistic talent from her father.
cn: 他是三个孩子的父亲。
弗洛伊德常被称为精神分析学之父。
她的艺术天赋遗传自父亲。

en: My father-in-law taught me how to fish last summer.
She has a close relationship with her father-in-law.

cn: 去年夏天，我的岳父教我钓鱼。
她与公公关系亲密。
在某些文化中，公公在家庭决策中起关键作用。

Mental fatigue can affect your decision-making ability.

cn: 士兵们在长途行军后因疲劳倒下。
精神疲劳会影响你的决策能力。
重复性工作让她身心俱疲。

The San Andreas Fault is a major geological feature.
cn: 事故是由机械故障引起的。
她总是挑剔我的工作。
圣安德烈亚斯断层是重要的地质构造。

The manufacturer recalled the faulty products.
cn: 故障线路导致停电。
他的论点基于错误的推理。
制造商召回了有缺陷的产品。

The weather favoured our outdoor event.
Could you do me a favour and pass the salt?
cn: 她总是偏爱她最小的孩子。
天气有利于我们的户外活动。
你能帮我递一下盐吗？

cn: 天气条件有利于野餐。
他对这本新书给予了好评。

definitions.definition: 最喜爱的；特别受喜爱的
最喜爱的人（或物）；受宠的人；夺冠热门

The novel Pride and Prejudice is a perennial favourite among readers.
She was always the teacher's favourite because of her enthusiasm in class.
cn: 你一年中最喜欢的季节是哪个？
小说《傲慢与偏见》是读者们长期以来的最爱。

Don't fear failure—it's part of growth.
The villagers lived in fear of the approaching storm.
cn: 她对蜘蛛有极深的恐惧。
不要害怕失败，它是成长的一部分。
村民们对即将到来的风暴感到惶恐不安。

He was fearful of failing the exam.
cn: 听到声响时，她害怕地看了他一眼。
这场风暴的景象令人恐惧。

cn: 这个计划听起来可行，但我们需要更多数据来确认。

在周五前完成这个项目可行吗？

en: The wedding feast lasted until midnight.
They feasted on lobster and champagne.
The art exhibition was a visual feast.
cn: 婚宴持续到午夜。
他们尽情享用龙虾和香槟。
这场艺术展是一场视觉盛宴。

She carefully feathered the edges of her painting.
Rowers learn to feather their oars to reduce wind resistance.
cn: 孔雀展开了它鲜艳的羽毛。

cn: 我的生日在二月。
二月是一年中天数最少的月份。

cn: 请帮我拿一杯水好吗？
这幅画在拍卖会上售得一百多万美元。

cn: 很少有人理解这个问题的复杂性。
她的朋友不多，但都非常忠诚。

definitions.definition: 纤维（天然或人造的细丝状物质）
纤维质（食物中的膳食纤维）

cn: 棉花是一种广泛用于纺织的天然纤维。

The shortstop fielded the ball cleanly.
cn: 牛群在绿色的田野上安静地吃草。

cn: 她以一次巴黎之旅庆祝了自己的十五岁生日。

只有五分之一的学生通过了考试。
贝多芬的《第五交响曲》具有标志性意义。

The book contains fifty short stories.
Fifty percent of the participants agreed with the proposal.
cn: 她举办了一场盛大的派对庆祝五十岁生日。

cn: 两个男孩因为一个玩具打了起来。

cn: 她将玻璃杯装满水。

她用手机拍摄了事件全过程。

cn: 净水器能去除自来水中的杂质。

definitions.definition: 认为；感到（某事真实或存在）
发现物（尤指有价值或有趣的事物）
