I find his attitude quite refreshing.
The archaeological find rewrote history books.
cn: 她终于在沙发下找到了钥匙。
我认为他的态度令人耳目一新。
这次考古发现改写了历史教科书。

en: The research team published their findings in a scientific journal.
The court's finding was based on new evidence.
Her findings about ancient pottery surprised archaeologists.
cn: 研究团队将他们的发现发表在科学期刊上。
法庭的裁决依据了新证据。
她对古代陶器的发现令考古学家惊讶。

definitions.definition: 美好的；高质量的；纤细的

en: She wore a fine silk dress to the party.
The weather is fine today, perfect for a picnic.
He was fined $100 for speeding.
cn: 她穿了一件精美的丝绸礼服参加派对。
今天天气晴朗，非常适合野餐。
他因超速被罚款100美元。

en: She wore a silver ring on her index finger.
Don't finger the pages of the book with dirty hands.
The machine has a rotating finger to guide the fabric.
cn: 她的食指戴着一枚银戒指。
别用脏手翻书页。
这台机器有一个旋转的指状装置来引导布料。

en: She will finish her thesis by next week.
The race finishes at the park entrance.
The table has a smooth walnut finish.
cn: 她将在下周完成论文。
比赛终点设在公园入口。
这张桌子有光滑的胡桃木饰面。

en: The campfire kept us warm throughout the night.
She was fired for repeatedly violating company policies.
His speech fired the audience with enthusiasm.
cn: 篝火让我们整晚保持温暖。
她因屡次违反公司规定被解雇。
他的演讲激发了听众的热情。

en: The fireman rushed into the burning building to save the child.
In the 19th century, a fireman's job on trains was to feed coal into the engine.
Modern firemen undergo rigorous training to handle chemical fires.
cn: 消防员冲进燃烧的建筑物救出孩子。
19世纪时，火车司炉工的工作是给引擎添煤。
现代消防员需接受严格训练以应对化学品火灾。

en: The ground was firm after the rain.
She gave a firm handshake to show her confidence.
The law firm specializes in intellectual property cases.
cn: 雨后地面变得坚实。
她用力握手以显示自信。
这家律师事务所专攻知识产权案件。

en: She won first prize in the competition.
First, let me introduce myself.
This is the first time I've visited Paris.
cn: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。
首先，请允许我自我介绍。
这是我第一次到访巴黎。

en: The river is full of colorful fish.
He loves to fish on weekends.
We had grilled fish for dinner.
cn: 这条河里有许多色彩斑斓的鱼。
他喜欢在周末钓鱼。
我们晚餐吃了烤鱼。

en: The fisherman cast his net at dawn.
This village relies on fishermen for its economy.
The old fisherman told stories of the sea.
cn: 渔民在黎明时分撒网。
这个村庄的经济依赖渔民。
老渔夫讲述着大海的故事。

definitions.definition: 拳头；手（尤指握紧的状态）

en: He raised his fist in anger.
She fisted her hand to stop it from shaking.
The boxer fisted the punching bag relentlessly.
cn: 他愤怒地举起拳头。
她握紧拳头以止住颤抖。
拳击手不停地用拳头击打沙袋。

definitions.definition: 合身；发作（如疾病或情绪）

en: She stays fit by running every morning.
The key doesn't fit the lock.
He had a sudden fit of laughter.
cn: 她每天早晨跑步以保持健康。
这把钥匙打不开锁。
他突然大笑起来。

en: She has five cats and three dogs.
The meeting starts at five o'clock sharp.
Five is considered a lucky number in some cultures.
cn: 她养了五只猫和三只狗。
会议五点整开始。
在某些文化中，五被视为幸运数字。

en: She used glue to fix the broken vase.
The mechanic will fix my car tomorrow.
We're in a real fix without the map.
cn: 她用胶水修复了破碎的花瓶。
机械师明天会修理我的车。
没有地图，我们真的陷入困境了。

en: The national flag fluttered in the wind.
She flagged the important emails for later review.
His energy began to flag after hours of hiking.
cn: 国旗在风中飘扬。
她标记了重要邮件以备后续查阅。
徒步数小时后，他的体力开始下降。

en: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
Her cheeks flamed with embarrassment.
The protest flamed into a violent conflict.
cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
她因尴尬而满脸通红。
抗议演变成了激烈的冲突。

definitions.definition: 燃烧；突然发怒；突然爆发

en: The flare of the match lit up her face.
Tempers flared during the debate.
The ship launched a distress flare.
cn: 火柴的亮光照亮了她的脸。
辩论中情绪突然激动起来。
船只发射了一枚求救信号弹。

en: A flash of lightning lit up the night sky.
She flashed a smile at the audience.
The memory came back to him in a flash.
cn: 一道闪电照亮了夜空。
她向观众快速露出微笑。
那段记忆瞬间浮现在他脑海中。

en: The land here is very flat, perfect for cycling.
She moved into a small flat in London last year.
The soda tastes flat because it’s been open too long.
cn: 这片土地非常平坦，适合骑行。
她去年搬进了伦敦的一间小公寓。
这汽水没气了，因为开得太久。

en: This soup lacks flavour; it needs more herbs.
The festival is full of local flavours.
She flavoured the tea with a slice of lemon.
cn: 这汤没什么味道，需要多加香草。
这个节日充满了地方特色。
她用一片柠檬给茶调味。

en: The naval fleet assembled at the harbor.
She has a fleet mind that grasps concepts quickly.
Clouds fleeted across the sky before the storm.
cn: 海军舰队在港口集结。
她思维敏捷，能迅速理解概念。
暴风雨前，云层在天空中疾驰而过。

en: The wound exposed the flesh beneath the skin.
She added spices to flesh out the flavor of the stew.
The peach's flesh was sweet and juicy.
cn: 伤口暴露了皮下的血肉。
她加入香料来充实炖菜的风味。
桃子的果肉香甜多汁。

en: The yoga mat is made of flexible material for easy storage.
A flexible schedule allows employees to balance work and life.
His flexible approach solved the conflict creatively.
cn: 瑜伽垫采用柔韧材质，便于收纳。
弹性工作时间让员工能平衡工作与生活。
他灵活的方式创造性地化解了冲突。

en: The bird's flight was graceful against the sunset.
She booked a flight to Paris for the weekend.
The thief took flight when he heard the alarm.
cn: 鸟儿在夕阳下的飞行姿态优美。
她预订了周末飞往巴黎的航班。
小偷听到警报声后迅速逃跑了。

en: The leaves float gently on the pond.
The company plans to float shares next month.
We watched the parade float decorated with flowers.
cn: 树叶轻轻漂浮在池塘上。
公司计划下月发行股票。
我们观看了装饰鲜花的游行彩车。

en: A flock of birds suddenly took flight from the trees.
Tourists flock to this museum every summer.
She sorted through a flock of new emails.
cn: 一群鸟突然从树上飞起。
每年夏天游客都会涌向这座博物馆。
她快速浏览了一大堆新邮件。

en: The heavy rain caused a severe flood in the valley.
Social media was flooded with complaints after the announcement.
Sunlight flooded the room as she opened the curtains.
cn: 暴雨导致山谷爆发严重洪水。
公告发布后，社交媒体上充斥着投诉。
她拉开窗帘，阳光倾泻进房间。

definitions.definition: 地板；楼层；（海洋、森林等的）底部；最低限度
铺地板；击倒；（非正式）难倒

en: The cat slept on the wooden floor.
Her office is on the fifth floor.
The government set a price floor for agricultural products.
cn: 猫睡在木地板上。
她的办公室在五楼。
政府为农产品设定了价格下限。

en: She sifted the flour before mixing it with eggs.
The baker floured the dough to prevent sticking.
Whole wheat flour contains more nutrients than white flour.
cn: 她在面粉中加入鸡蛋前先过筛。
面包师在面团上撒粉以防粘连。
全麦面粉比白面粉含有更多营养。

en: The arts began to flourish during the Renaissance.
She flourished the letter triumphantly.
The manuscript was full of elaborate flourishes.
cn: 文艺复兴时期艺术开始繁荣。
她得意地挥舞着信件。
手稿上满是华丽的装饰笔迹。

en: The river flows gently through the valley.
Her ideas flowed freely during the brainstorming session.
We need to control the flow of traffic during rush hour.
cn: 河水缓缓流过山谷。
头脑风暴时她的想法自由涌现。
我们需要控制高峰时段的交通流量。

en: The cherry trees flower in April.
She wore a crown of fresh flowers.
His talent flowered under her guidance.
cn: 樱花树在四月开花。
她戴着一顶鲜花编成的花冠。
在她的指导下，他的才华得以绽放。

en: She stayed home because she caught the flu.
The flu vaccine is updated annually.
His fever suggests it might be more than just a cold—possibly the flu.
cn: 她因患流感而待在家中。
流感疫苗每年更新。
他的高烧表明这可能不止是感冒，而是流感。

definitions.definition: 流利的（语言表达流畅自如）
流畅的（动作或过程连贯自然）

en: She is fluent in three languages.
The dancer's movements were fluent and graceful.
His fluent speech impressed the audience.
cn: 她能流利使用三种语言。
舞者的动作流畅而优雅。
他流利的演讲打动了听众。

en: Water is a fluid that takes the shape of its container.
Her fluid movements impressed the dance judges.
The situation remains fluid, so we need to stay flexible.
cn: 水是一种会随容器形状改变的流体。
她流畅的舞姿打动了舞蹈评委。
局势仍不稳定，我们必须保持灵活。

definitions.definition: 脸红；潮红；一阵强烈情感

en: She felt a flush of embarrassment when she realized her mistake.
The toilet won't flush properly.
Make sure the edges are flush with the wall.
cn: 她意识到错误时，脸上泛起一阵尴尬的红晕。
马桶冲水不畅。
确保边缘与墙面齐平。

en: Birds can fly high in the sky.
We'll fly to Paris next week.
A fly landed on my sandwich.
cn: 鸟儿能在高空飞翔。
我们下周将乘飞机去巴黎。
一只苍蝇停在我的三明治上。

en: The camera automatically adjusts its focus.
She needs to focus on her studies.
The debate became the focus of public attention.
cn: 相机自动调节焦距。
她需要集中精力学习。
这场辩论成为公众关注的焦点。

en: The morning fog obscured the view of the mountains.
Her explanation only fogged the issue further.
After the surgery, he experienced mental fog for weeks.
cn: 晨雾遮蔽了群山的视野。
她的解释反而让问题更加模糊不清。
手术后，他经历了数周的思维混沌。

en: She carefully folded the letter before putting it in the envelope.
The map had deep folds from being stored in a pocket.
The Himalayas were formed by the fold of tectonic plates.
cn: 她将信仔细折好，放入信封。
地图因长期放在口袋里而有了深深的折痕。
喜马拉雅山脉由板块褶皱形成。

definitions.definition: 人们（泛指某一群体或文化中的成员）
民间音乐（folk music 的简称）
民间的（如 folk art 民间艺术）

en: The folk gathered in the village square for the annual harvest festival.
cn: 村民聚集在村庄广场参加一年一度的丰收节。

en: The dog will follow you home if you give it food.
Please follow the instructions carefully.
His argument was hard to follow.
cn: 如果你给这只狗食物，它会跟着你回家。
请仔细遵循说明。
他的论点难以理解。

en: The following chapter discusses climate change.
She has a large following on Instagram.
Following the meeting, decisions were finalized.
cn: 下一章将讨论气候变化。
她在 Instagram 上拥有大量粉丝。
会议结束后，决议最终确定。

definitions.definition: 天真的，不切实际的（古义/罕用）

en: She gave him a fond smile as he left.
He has a fond memory of his childhood in the countryside.
Don’t be too fond of unrealistic dreams.
cn: 当他离开时，她给了他一个深情的微笑。
他对乡村童年有着美好的回忆。
别太沉迷于不切实际的幻想。（保留古义痕迹）

en: Fresh food is essential for a healthy diet.
The supermarket sells organic food at higher prices.
Food shortages became a serious problem during the war.
cn: 新鲜食物是健康饮食的关键。
这家超市以较高价格出售有机食品。
战争期间食物短缺成为严重问题。

en: Don't act like a fool in public.
He fooled everyone with his disguise.
She was only fooling when she said she'd quit.
cn: 不要在公共场合表现得像个傻瓜。
他用伪装骗过了所有人。
她说要辞职时只是在开玩笑。

en: It was foolish of him to trust a stranger with his money.
Her foolish laughter annoyed everyone in the library.
The idea seemed foolish at first, but it actually worked.
cn: 他把钱交给陌生人保管，真是愚蠢。
她傻傻的笑声惹恼了图书馆里的所有人。
这个想法起初显得荒谬，但确实奏效了。

en: She hurt her foot while hiking.
The table is three feet long.
Footnotes appear at the foot of the page.
cn: 她在徒步时伤到了脚。
这张桌子长三英尺。
脚注出现在页面底部。

definitions.definition: 足球（英式用法，指用脚踢的球类运动）
美式橄榄球（美式用法，指手持椭圆球的竞技运动）

en: He plays football every weekend with his friends.
American football is known for its intense physical contact.
The school built a new field for both soccer and football.
cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
美式橄榄球以激烈的身体对抗著称。
学校新建了一个兼作英式足球和美式橄榄球的场地。

en: The hallway echoed with the heavy footsteps of the guard.
She decided to follow in her mother’s footsteps and become a doctor.
Fresh footsteps in the snow led us to the hidden cabin.
cn: 走廊里回荡着守卫沉重的脚步声。
她决定追随母亲的脚步，成为一名医生。
雪地上新鲜的足迹将我们引向隐蔽的小屋。

definitions.definition: 因为（古用法或诗歌用语）

en: This gift is for you.
She apologized for being late.
The abbreviation "e.g." stands for "exempli gratia".
cn: 这份礼物是给你的。
她为迟到道歉。
缩写"e.g."代表"exempli gratia"（例如）。

en: The law forbids smoking in public places.
Her injury forbids her from running the marathon.
I forbid you to leave the house after midnight.
cn: 法律禁止在公共场所吸烟。
她的伤势使她无法参加马拉松。
我禁止你午夜后离开房子。

en: The police used force to disperse the crowd.
She forced herself to smile despite the pain.
The force of his argument convinced the committee.
cn: 警方使用武力驱散人群。
尽管痛苦，她强迫自己微笑。
他论证的说服力打动了委员会。

en: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain tomorrow.
Economists forecast a rise in inflation next year.
She accurately forecast the outcome of the election.
cn: 天气预报显示明天有大雨。
经济学家预测明年通胀率将上升。
她准确预测了选举结果。

en: She wiped sweat from her forehead after the run.
A deep wrinkle appeared on his forehead when he frowned.
The baby had a small birthmark on his forehead.
cn: 跑步后，她擦去前额的汗水。
他皱眉时，前额出现一道深深的皱纹。
婴儿的前额有一小块胎记。

en: She has a foreign accent that is hard to place.
The company specializes in foreign trade.
The concept of privacy is not foreign to their culture.
cn: 她的外国口音难以辨认具体来源。
这家公司专营对外贸易。
隐私的概念在他们的文化中并不陌生。

en: The small town rarely sees any foreigners.
As a foreigner, he struggled with local customs.
The law protects the rights of foreign investors.
cn: 这个小城镇很少见到外国人。
作为外来者，他难以适应当地习俗。
这项法律保护外国投资者的权利。

en: She is one of the foremost experts in neuroscience.
Safety must be foremost in our minds during the experiment.
The captain stood foremost on the deck, guiding the ship.
cn: 她是神经科学领域最重要的专家之一。
实验中，安全必须是我们最先考虑的事项。
船长站在甲板最前方指挥船只。

en: The Amazon rainforest is the largest tropical forest in the world.
They decided to forest the barren hills to prevent soil erosion.
The ancient forest was filled with towering oaks and murmuring streams.
cn: 亚马逊雨林是世界上最大的热带森林。
他们决定在荒山上植树以防止水土流失。
古老的森林里长满参天橡树，溪流潺潺。

en: The legend says the treasure will remain hidden forever.
She promised to love him forever.
The stars seem to shine forever in the night sky.
cn: 传说宝藏将永远隐藏。
她承诺永远爱他。
繁星仿佛在夜空中永恒闪耀。

en: Don't forget to call your mother.
I forgot where I put my keys.
She never forgets a face.
cn: 别忘了给你妈妈打电话。
我忘记钥匙放哪儿了。
她从来不会忘记别人的长相。

en: She decided to forgive him for his harsh words.
The king forgave the prisoner’s debts as an act of mercy.
Learning to forgive yourself is crucial for mental peace.
cn: 她决定原谅他的刻薄言辞。
国王赦免了囚犯的债务，以示仁慈。
学会自我宽恕对内心平静至关重要。

en: She picked up the salad with a fork.
The road forks ahead; take the left path.
The river forks into two smaller streams.
cn: 她用叉子吃沙拉。
前方道路分岔，请走左边。
这条河分叉成两条小溪。

en: The artist shaped the clay into a beautiful form.
Please fill out this application form before the deadline.
Ice forms when water freezes.
cn: 艺术家将黏土塑造成美丽的形状。
请在截止日期前填写这份申请表。
水结冰时形成冰。

en: The invitation requires formal attire.
His apology was formal but insincere.
The agreement is only a formal recognition of cooperation.
cn: 邀请函要求着正装出席。
他的道歉很正式，但缺乏诚意。
该协议仅是合作的形式性认可。

en: The formation of ice crystals requires specific temperature conditions.
The geese flew in a perfect V formation.
This rock formation dates back to the Jurassic period.
cn: 冰晶的形成需要特定的温度条件。
雁群以完美的V字形编队飞行。
该岩层可追溯至侏罗纪时期。

en: She met her former teacher at the reunion.
Of the two options, I prefer the former.
The factory was converted from its former use as a warehouse.
cn: 她在同学会上遇见了从前的老师。
在两个选项中，我更喜欢前者。
这座工厂由原来的仓库改造而成。

en: The chemical formula for water is H₂O.
She has a winning formula for success in business.
"How do you do?" is a formal greeting formula.
cn: 水的化学分子式是H₂O。
她有一套成功的商业准则。
“您好吗？”是一种正式的问候惯用语。

definitions.definition: 向前；向外（指空间或时间上的移动）

en: The knight rode forth into the unknown forest.
From that moment forth, she vowed to change her life.
The flowers burst forth in spring.
cn: 骑士策马向前，进入未知的森林。
从那一刻起，她发誓要改变自己的人生。
花朵在春天绽放。

en: I'll be on vacation for a fortnight starting next Monday.
The project deadline is in a fortnight, so we need to hurry.
In Shakespeare's plays, characters often use "fortnight" to measure time.
cn: 从下周一开始，我将休假两周。
项目截止日期在两星期后，我们必须加快进度。
在莎士比亚的戏剧中，角色常用“两星期”来计量时间。

en: She was fortunate to escape the accident unharmed.
The timing of his investment proved fortunate.
How fortunate we are to have such supportive friends!
cn: 她幸运地在事故中毫发无伤。
他的投资时机被证明非常幸运。
拥有如此支持我们的朋友是多么幸运！

en: Fortunately, the weather cleared up for our picnic.
He was late, but fortunately the meeting hadn’t started.
Fortunately, no one was injured in the accident.
cn: 幸好天气放晴，我们的野餐得以进行。
他迟到了，但幸运的是会议还未开始。
万幸的是，事故中无人受伤。

en: She made a fortune by investing in technology stocks.
Fortune favors the bold.
It was his good fortune to find a job right after graduation.
cn: 她通过投资科技股积累了财富。
好运眷顾勇者。（谚语）
他毕业后立刻找到工作，实属幸运。

en: She ran forty miles in a week.
The temperature dropped to forty degrees.
Forty students attended the lecture.
cn: 她一周跑了四十英里。
温度降到了四十度。
四十名学生参加了讲座。

en: She leaned forward to hear the whisper.
The project is moving forward smoothly.
Please forward this email to the team.
cn: 她向前倾身去听低语。
项目正在顺利推进。
请将这封邮件转发给团队。

definitions.definition: 以…为基础（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: The university was founded in 1636.
Her argument is founded on solid evidence.
They plan to found a new tech startup next year.
cn: 这所大学成立于1636年。
她的论点基于确凿证据。
他们计划明年创立一家新的科技公司。

en: The earthquake damaged the foundation of the building.
She works for a charitable foundation.
The foundation of the university dates back to 1636.
cn: 地震损坏了建筑物的地基。
她为一家慈善基金会工作。
该大学的创立可追溯至1636年。

en: The fountain in the park sparkled under the sunlight.
Ancient Greeks believed the Muses were the fountain of inspiration.
She drank from a small mountain fountain during the hike.
cn: 公园里的喷泉在阳光下闪闪发光。
古希腊人认为缪斯女神是灵感的源泉。
徒步时，她饮用了山间的一处小泉水。

en: She has four cats and two dogs.
The chair has four legs.
Four quarters make a whole.
cn: 她养了四只猫和两只狗。
这把椅子有四条腿。
四个四分之一构成一个整体。

en: She celebrated her fourteenth birthday last week.
The team scored fourteen points in the first quarter.
Fourteen students volunteered for the science project.
cn: 她上周庆祝了她的十四岁生日。
球队在第一节得了十四分。
十四名学生自愿参加了这个科学项目。

en: She finished fourth in the race.
Cut the cake into fourths for equal sharing.
The fourth chapter discusses climate change.
cn: 她在比赛中获得第四名。
将蛋糕切成四等份以便公平分配。
第四章探讨气候变化。

en: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Don't let his smile fool you—he's an old fox.
She managed to fox the guards and escape.
cn: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳过了懒狗。
别被他的笑容欺骗，他是个老狐狸。
她成功迷惑了守卫并逃脱。

en: The glass shattered into tiny fractions.
Only a fraction of the students passed the exam.
cn: 玻璃碎成了许多小碎片。
只有一小部分学生通过了考试。

en: The vase shattered into tiny fragments.
His memory of the event was only a fragment.
Over time, the rock fragmented due to erosion.
cn: 花瓶碎裂成无数小碎片。
他对事件的记忆只是零散的片段。
随着时间的推移，岩石因侵蚀而破碎。

en: The artist chose a wooden frame for her painting.
He framed his question carefully to avoid confusion.
The documentary frames the issue from a historical perspective.
cn: 艺术家为她的画选择了木制画框。
他仔细措辞问题以避免混淆。
这部纪录片从历史角度构建了该问题的框架。

en: The steel framework of the building ensures its stability.
This research provides a framework for future studies.
The legal framework needs updating to address digital privacy.
cn: 建筑物的钢框架确保了其稳固性。
此项研究为未来课题提供了理论框架。
法律体系需更新以应对数字隐私问题。

en: She gave a frank answer without hesitation.
The letter was franked with an official seal.
Frank discussions are essential for teamwork.
cn: 她毫不犹豫地给出了坦率的回答。
信件盖了官方邮戳免邮费寄出。
坦诚的讨论对团队合作至关重要。

en: The bird was finally set free after weeks in captivity.
Students can access the library resources for free.
She values her free time above all else.
cn: 这只鸟被关押数周后终于获释。
学生可免费使用图书馆资源。
她最珍视自己的自由时间。

definitions.definition: 自由（不受约束或控制的状态）
自由权（法律或道德赋予的权利）

en: The prisoners fought for their freedom.
Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right.
She values the freedom to express herself creatively.
cn: 囚徒们为自由而战。
言论自由是一项基本人权。
她珍视自由表达创意的权利。

en: Birds fly freely in the sky.
She freely shared her ideas with the team.
The wine flowed freely at the party.
cn: 鸟儿在天空中自由飞翔。
她毫无保留地与团队分享了想法。
派对上葡萄酒源源不断地供应。

definitions.definition: 冻结；凝固；因寒冷而僵硬
使冻结；暂停（活动、计划等）

en: The lake will freeze if the temperature drops below zero.
The government decided to freeze all foreign aid programs.
She froze in fear when she saw the shadow.
cn: 如果气温降至零下，湖水会结冰。
政府决定暂停所有对外援助项目。
看到影子时，她吓得僵在原地。

en: The ship carries freight across the Atlantic.
Air freight costs more than sea transport.
They freighted the goods by train.
cn: 这艘船运送货物横跨大西洋。
空运费用高于海运。
他们通过铁路运输货物。

definitions.definition: 法国的；法国人的；法语的

en: She speaks fluent French.
French cuisine is famous worldwide.
The French team won the championship.
cn: 她法语说得很流利。
法国菜闻名全球。
法国队赢得了冠军。

definitions.definition: （物理）频率（单位时间内周期性事件发生的次数）

en: The frequency of earthquakes in this region has increased recently.
This radio station broadcasts at a frequency of 98.5 MHz.
High-frequency words are essential for language learners.
cn: 该地区地震发生的频率近期有所上升。
该电台以98.5兆赫的频率广播。
高频词汇对语言学习者至关重要。

en: She makes frequent trips to Paris for work.
The cafe was frequented by artists and writers.
Frequent exercise improves overall health.
cn: 她因工作频繁前往巴黎。
这家咖啡馆曾是艺术家和作家的常聚之地。
经常锻炼能提升整体健康水平。

en: She visits her grandparents frequently.
Errors occur more frequently under pressure.
The bus runs frequently during rush hours.
cn: 她经常去看望祖父母。
压力下错误更频繁地出现。
高峰时段公交车班次频繁。

en: The bakery sells fresh bread every morning.
She opened the window to let in some fresh air.
After a short nap, he felt fresh and ready to work again.
cn: 这家面包店每天早晨出售新鲜面包。
她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
小睡片刻后，他感到精神焕发，准备继续工作。

en: Oil reduces friction between moving parts.
There was constant friction between the two departments.
Static friction prevents the box from sliding.
cn: 润滑油减少运动部件间的摩擦。
两个部门间矛盾不断。
静摩擦力阻止箱子滑动。

en: We’re meeting for lunch next Friday.
Friday is my favorite day of the week.
The project deadline is Friday at noon.
cn: 我们下周五共进午餐。
星期五是我一周中最喜欢的一天。
项目截止时间是周五中午。

en: She opened the fridge to grab a bottle of milk.
Modern fridges are much more energy-efficient than older models.
Don't forget to put the leftovers back in the fridge.
cn: 她打开冰箱拿了一瓶牛奶。
现代冰箱比老款节能得多。
别忘了把剩菜放回冰箱。

en: A true friend stands by you in difficult times.
She friended him on social media last week.
The dog has been his loyal friend for years.
cn: 真正的朋友会在困难时支持你。
她上周在社交媒体上加了他为好友。
这只狗多年来一直是他忠诚的伙伴。

definitions.definition: 支持的，有利的（如环境、政策等）

en: She gave me a friendly smile when I entered the room.
The software has a user-friendly interface.
The new policy created a friendly environment for small businesses.
cn: 我走进房间时，她向我友好地微笑。
该软件拥有用户友好的界面。
新政策为小企业创造了有利的环境。

en: Their friendship lasted through many challenges.
True friendship is based on trust and respect.
She values the friendship between her colleagues.
cn: 他们的友谊历经许多挑战依然坚固。
真正的友谊建立在信任与尊重之上。
她珍视同事之间的友情。

en: The sudden noise frightened the birds away.
She didn't mean to frighten you with her joke.
Horror movies often frighten children more than adults.
cn: 突然的声响把鸟群吓飞了。
她并非有意用玩笑吓唬你。
恐怖片对孩子的惊吓通常甚于成人。

en: The frog jumped into the pond with a splash.
She wore leather boots with metal frogs for decoration.
Scientists study frogs to understand ecosystem health.
cn: 青蛙扑通一声跳进了池塘。
她穿着带金属蹄垫装饰的皮靴。
科学家通过研究青蛙来评估生态系统健康。

definitions.definition: 表示起点、来源或原因（如时间、地点、材料的来源）

en: She returned from Paris yesterday.
This poem is quoted from Shakespeare.
The statue is made from recycled metal.
cn: 她昨天从巴黎回来。
这首诗引自莎士比亚。
这座雕像由回收金属制成。

en: The hotel faces the ocean front.
She sat in the front row of the classroom.
The soldiers were sent to the front during the war.
cn: 酒店正对海滨。
她坐在教室的第一排。
战争期间，士兵们被派往前线。

definitions.definition: 边界，边疆（尤指两国或文明与荒野之间的地带）

en: The pioneers crossed the frontier into uncharted territory.
AI technology is pushing the frontiers of medical research.
The castle guarded the frontier between the two kingdoms.
cn: 拓荒者越过边疆，进入未知地域。
人工智能技术正推动医学研究的前沿发展。
这座城堡守卫着两国之间的边界。

en: The grass was white with frost in the early morning.
She forgot to cover the plants, and they were frosted overnight.
His breath frosted the window pane as he peered outside.
cn: 清晨的草上覆满了白霜。
她忘记给植物遮盖，它们一夜之间被霜冻坏了。
他朝外看时，呼出的气在窗玻璃上结了一层霜。

definitions.definition: 皱眉（表示不满、困惑或专注）

en: She frowned when she saw the messy room.
His frown deepened as he read the bad news.
A slight frown appeared on her forehead during the debate.
cn: 她看到凌乱的房间时皱起了眉。
他读到坏消息时眉头皱得更紧了。
辩论时她额间闪过一丝蹙眉。

en: Apples and oranges are common fruits in the market.
Hard work will eventually bear fruit.
The tree began to fruit after three years.
cn: 苹果和橙子是市场上常见的水果。
努力终将结出成果。
这棵树三年后开始结果。

en: The apple tree was especially fruitful this year.
Their collaboration proved to be a fruitful partnership.
The scientist made fruitful use of laboratory resources.
cn: 今年这棵苹果树果实格外丰硕。
他们的合作被证明是富有成效的伙伴关系。
这位科学家充分利用了实验室资源。

en: She fried the eggs in olive oil.
The fish fry attracted hundreds of visitors.
Tiny fries swam in the shallow stream.
cn: 她用橄榄油煎了鸡蛋。
炸鱼活动吸引了数百名游客。
小鱼苗在浅溪中游动。

en: The airplane stopped to refuel before crossing the ocean.
His harsh words only fueled the argument.
Renewable fuels are essential for reducing carbon emissions.
cn: 飞机在越洋前停下来补充燃料。
他的激烈言辞让争论升级。
可再生燃料对减少碳排放至关重要。

definitions.definition: 实现（承诺、目标等）；履行（义务）

en: She worked hard to fulfil her dream of becoming a doctor.
The product must fulfil safety standards before sale.
His actions did not fulfil the terms of the contract.
cn: 她努力奋斗，实现了成为医生的梦想。
该产品必须满足安全标准才能上市。
他的行为未履行合同条款。

en: The glass is full of water.
She gave a full account of the incident.
I'm too full to eat dessert.
cn: 玻璃杯装满了水。
她完整地叙述了事件经过。
我吃得太饱，吃不下甜点了。

en: We had so much fun at the beach yesterday.
Her funny jokes made the party more fun.
Learning English can be hard work but also great fun.
cn: 昨天我们在海滩玩得非常开心。
她有趣的笑话让派对更有乐趣。
学习英语可能是艰苦的工作，但也充满乐趣。

en: The primary function of the heart is to pump blood.
This program will not function without proper input.
In math, a linear function has a constant rate of change.
cn: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。
没有正确输入，该程序无法运行。
数学中，线性函数的变化率是恒定的。

en: The government allocated funds for education.
She started a fund to support local artists.
The project is funded by private donations.
cn: 政府为教育拨付了资金。
她设立了一项基金以支持本地艺术家。
该项目由私人捐款资助。

definitions.definition: 基础的；根本的；至关重要的

en: The fundamental principles of physics apply universally.
Respect is fundamental to a healthy relationship.
She lacks a fundamental understanding of the topic.
cn: 物理学的基本原理普遍适用。
尊重是健康关系的基石。
她对该主题缺乏根本性的理解。

definitions.definition: 葬礼的；出殡的（如 funeral procession 送葬队伍）

en: The whole village attended the funeral to pay their respects.
Her funeral was a quiet, private ceremony.
The funeral procession moved slowly through the streets.
cn: 全村人参加了葬礼以表达哀悼。
她的葬礼是一场安静而私密的仪式。
送葬队伍缓缓穿过街道。

en: The comedian told a funny story that made everyone laugh.
There's something funny about this old photograph—I can't figure out where it was taken.
Her funny accent was a mix of British and Australian.
cn: 这位喜剧演员讲了个有趣的故事，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
这张老照片有些奇怪，我搞不清是在哪儿拍的。
她滑稽的口音夹杂着英式和澳式英语。

definitions.definition: 用毛皮覆盖；使生苔（罕见用法）

en: The rabbit's fur is soft and white.
She wore a coat trimmed with fox fur.
The trapper traded furs for supplies.
cn: 兔子的毛又软又白。
她穿了一件镶有狐狸毛的大衣。
猎人用毛皮换取补给品。

definitions.definition: 激烈的，猛烈的（如动作或自然现象）

en: He was furious when he discovered the broken window.
The debate turned into a furious exchange of accusations.
The ship battled through furious waves during the storm.
cn: 他发现窗户被打破时暴跳如雷。
辩论演变成激烈的相互指责。
船只在暴风雨中与汹涌的波涛搏斗。

definitions.definition: 熔炉；火炉（用于高温加热或冶炼的封闭设备）

en: The steel is melted in a blast furnace.
Her cheeks felt like a furnace after running.
Ancient glassmakers used clay furnaces.
cn: 钢铁在高炉中熔化。
跑步后她的脸颊滚烫如火炉。
古代玻璃工匠使用黏土熔炉。

definitions.definition: 提供（设备或物品）；布置（房间）

en: The apartment is furnished with modern appliances.
They furnished the expedition with necessary supplies.
Her testimony furnished crucial evidence for the case.
cn: 这间公寓配备了现代化家电。
他们为探险队提供了必要物资。
她的证词为案件提供了关键证据。

definitions.definition: 家具（指可移动的室内陈设物品，如桌子、椅子等）

en: The antique furniture adds charm to the room.
They invested in high-quality office furniture.
Modern furniture often prioritizes minimalism.
cn: 这件古董家具为房间增添了魅力。
他们投资购买了高品质的办公家具。
现代家具常以极简风格为优先。

definitions.definition: 更远的；更多的；进一步的

en: We need to investigate further before making a decision.
The library is further away than the supermarket.
This project aims to further scientific research in renewable energy.
cn: 我们需要进一步调查后再做决定。
图书馆比超市更远。
该项目旨在推动可再生能源的科学研究。

definitions.definition: 此外；而且（用于补充或强调前文）

en: The plan is inefficient; furthermore, it’s too expensive.
She excels in academics, and furthermore, she’s a talented musician.
The data is incomplete; furthermore, the methodology is flawed.
cn: 该计划效率低下，而且成本过高。
她学业优异，此外还是一位有才华的音乐家。
数据不完整，此外研究方法也存在缺陷。

en: The future of renewable energy looks promising.
She dreams of a future where all people live in harmony.
In English, the future tense can be formed with "will" or "going to".
cn: 可再生能源的未来前景光明。
她梦想一个人人和谐共处的未来。
英语中，将来时态可用“will”或“going to”构成。

en: The company reported a net gain of $2 million last quarter.
cn: 该公司上季度净利润为200万美元。

definitions.definition: （剧院中票价最低的）顶层楼座

en: The modern art gallery showcases avant-garde paintings.
Spectators in the gallery cheered loudly during the match.
Her apartment has a long gallery lined with bookshelves.
cn: 这座现代艺术画廊展出了先锋派画作。
比赛期间，看台上的观众高声欢呼。
她的公寓有一条长长的走廊，两侧摆满书架。

definitions.definition: 加仑（液量单位，英制约4.546升，美制约3.785升）

en: The car's fuel tank can hold up to 12 gallons.
A gallon of milk costs about $3.50 in the U.S.
British and American gallons differ by nearly 1 liter.
cn: 这辆车的油箱可容纳12加仑燃油。
在美国，一加仑牛奶售价约3.5美元。
英制与美制加仑相差近1升。

definitions.definition: 勇敢的；乐于尝试的（非正式）

en: The children invented a new game with sticks and stones.
She's always game for a challenge.
Illegal gaming dens were shut down by the police.
cn: 孩子们用木棍和石头发明了新游戏。
她总是乐于接受挑战。
非法赌场被警方取缔。

definitions.definition: 团伙；一群有共同目标的人（常含贬义）
一群朋友或同事（中性或非正式）

en: The police arrested members of a drug-dealing gang.
She went out with her gang from the office.
Protesters began to gang together near the square.
cn: 警方逮捕了一个贩毒团伙的成员。
她和办公室的朋友们一起出去了。
抗议者开始在广场附近聚集。

en: The hikers crossed a narrow gap between the cliffs.
cn: 徒步者穿过了悬崖间的一道狭窄缝隙。

en: He parked his car in the garage.
The vintage car is being restored at a local garage.
She forgot to garage the bicycle before the storm.
cn: 他将车停进了车库。
这辆古董车正在当地修理厂翻新。
暴风雨前，她忘了把自行车停进车棚。

en: The street was littered with garbage after the festival.
Don't listen to his garbage—he has no idea what he's talking about.
The app automatically deletes garbage files to save storage space.
cn: 节日过后，街上堆满了垃圾。
别听他的废话，他根本不知所云。
该应用会自动删除垃圾文件以节省存储空间。

en: She spends weekends planting flowers in her small garden.
The castle is surrounded by a magnificent formal garden.
He retired to garden and read books.
cn: 她周末在小花园里种花。
城堡周围环绕着宏伟的规整花园。
他退休后以园艺和读书为乐。

en: The gardener planted roses along the fence.
She hired a gardener to maintain her vegetable patch.
My grandfather was a passionate gardener all his life.
cn: 园丁沿着篱笆种下了玫瑰。
她雇了一名园丁来打理她的菜园。
我的祖父一生都是个热忱的园艺爱好者。

definitions.definition: 气体；天然气；汽油（美式口语）

en: Oxygen is a colorless gas essential for life.
The car's tank was almost empty, so we stopped to gas up.
During WWI, soldiers suffered horrific injuries from gas attacks.
cn: 氧气是维持生命必需的无色气体。
油箱快空了，我们停车加了油。
一战期间，士兵因毒气攻击遭受了可怕的伤害。

definitions.definition: 空虚的，不切实际的（引申义）

en: The experiment studied the behavior of gaseous molecules under high pressure.
His argument was too gaseous, lacking concrete evidence.
Water becomes gaseous at 100°C under standard conditions.
cn: 实验研究了高压下气体分子的行为。

这条裙子的腰部有精致的衣褶。

cn: 燃油表显示油箱几乎空了。

cn: 春天花园里充满了鲜艳的色彩。

definitions.definition: 凝视，注视（长时间固定地看）

cn: 她凝望星空数小时，陷入沉思。
他强烈的目光让她感到不安。

en: The general opinion supports the new policy.

This is a general guide, not a detailed manual.
cn: 普遍意见支持这项新政策。
服役多年后，她被提升为将军。

Some animals generate offspring rapidly in favorable conditions.
cn: 风力涡轮机通过风能发电。
这次讨论催生了许多创新想法。
某些动物在适宜环境下繁殖迅速。

definitions.definition: 产生，生成（如电力、热量等）

cn: 医院配有备用发电机以防停电。
她是创新想法的多产创造者。
风力涡轮机是电力发生器。

en: She is known for her generous donations to charity.
The chef served a generous portion of pasta.
His generous spirit made him popular among friends.
cn: 她以对慈善事业的慷慨捐赠闻名。
厨师端上了一份分量十足的意大利面。
他慷慨的性情让他在朋友中很受欢迎。

cn: 莫扎特幼年便展现出音乐天赋。
她拥有解决复杂问题的天赋。

definitions.definition: 使温和；驯服（古义或专业用法）

这匹马经过多年耐心训练已变得温顺。

definitions.definition: 绅士（指彬彬有礼、有教养的男子）
（尊称）先生（用于正式场合或称呼陌生男性）

The slope descends gently into the valley.

cn: 她轻轻拍了拍小狗的头。
山坡平缓地延伸至山谷。

She has a genuine passion for helping others.
His apology sounded genuine and heartfelt.
cn: 博物馆确认这幅画是梵高的真迹。
她对帮助他人抱有真诚的热情。
他的道歉听起来真挚而诚恳。

definitions.definition: 地理学（研究地球自然与人文特征的学科）
地形，地貌（某地区的自然特征）

Ancient maps reflect early understandings of geography.
cn: 她主修地理学以研究气候模式。
该地区的地形包含山脉与湖泊。
古地图反映了早期对地理的认知。

definitions.definition: 几何学（数学分支，研究空间与图形关系）
几何形状（物体的空间结构或排列方式）

The artist used complex geometry to design the sculpture.
Ancient Egyptians applied geometry to build pyramids.
cn: 她擅长几何学，尤其是角度计算。
艺术家运用复杂的几何形状设计雕塑。
古埃及人应用几何学建造金字塔。

en: Wash your hands to kill harmful germs.
Wheat germ is rich in vitamins.
The germ of this idea came from an old notebook.
cn: 洗手以杀死有害细菌。
小麦胚芽富含维生素。
这个想法的雏形源自一本旧笔记。

en: She is studying German literature at university.
The German team won the championship.
Do you speak German?
cn: 她在大学学习德国文学。
德国队赢得了冠军。
你会说德语吗？

His speech was full of dramatic gestures.
The manager gestured for the team to gather around.
cn: 她举起双手以示歉意。
他的演讲充满夸张的手势。
经理示意团队集合。

I don't get what you're trying to say.
We should get there before sunset.
cn: 她经过多年努力终于获得了理想工作。
我不明白你想表达什么。
我们应在日落前到达那里。

definitions.definition: 鬼魂般出没；无声地移动

She felt a ghost of a smile on her lips.
cn: 据说这栋老房子里有鬼魂出没。
他像幽灵一样无声地穿过走廊。

cn: 小麦是制作面包的常见谷物。

The design achieves a perfect happiness of form and function.
cn: 真正的幸福源于内心。
她脸上洋溢的幸福无可否认。
这一设计实现了形式与功能的完美统一。

definitions.definition: 感到或表现出快乐或满足的
（用于祝福）快乐的（如 Happy Birthday）

en: She felt genuinely happy after receiving the good news.
Wishing you a happy and prosperous new year!
The children’s happy laughter filled the playground.
cn: 收到好消息后，她由衷地感到快乐。
祝你新年快乐，万事如意！
孩子们快乐的笑声充满了操场。

definitions.definition: 港口，海港；避难所，安全处
庇护，藏匿；怀有（情感或想法）

en: The fishing boat returned to the harbour before the storm.
It is illegal to harbour a fugitive.
She harboured a secret admiration for him for many years.
cn: 渔船在风暴前返回了港口。
窝藏逃犯是违法的。
多年来，她一直暗地里仰慕着他。

en: The diamond is one of the hardest natural materials.
She worked hard to pass the exam.
His hard expression showed no mercy.
cn: 钻石是最坚硬的天然材料之一。
她努力学习以通过考试。
他严厉的表情毫无宽容之意。

definitions.definition: 变硬；变得坚强；变得冷酷

en: The clay will harden when exposed to air.
Years of hardship hardened her resolve.
His expression hardened as he heard the bad news.
cn: 黏土暴露在空气中会变硬。
多年的艰辛使她的决心更加坚定。
听到坏消息时，他的表情变得冷酷。

en: She could hardly believe her eyes.
He hardly ever eats junk food.
The room was so dark I could hardly see anything.
cn: 她几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。
他几乎从不吃垃圾食品。
房间太暗，我几乎什么也看不见。

definitions.definition: 艰难，困苦（指生活或处境中的困难）

en: The war brought immense hardship to civilians.
She endured years of financial hardship to support her family.
Overcoming hardship builds resilience.
cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的苦难。
她忍受了多年的经济困难来养家。
克服艰难能培养韧性。

definitions.definition: 硬件（计算机的物理组件）
五金制品（如工具、锁具等）

en: The store sells farming hardware like shovels and rakes.
Modern computers require both powerful hardware and efficient software.
He specializes in designing embedded hardware systems.
cn: 这家商店出售铲子和耙子等农用五金器具。
现代计算机需要强大的硬件和高效的软件。
他专注于设计嵌入式硬件系统。

definitions.definition: 飞奔，疾跑（古义或文学用法）

en: The hare darted across the field at incredible speed.
In folklore, the tortoise famously races the hare.
He hared off down the street before I could stop him.
cn: 野兔以惊人的速度窜过田野。
寓言中，乌龟与野兔的赛跑闻名遐迩。
我还来不及阻止，他已沿街飞奔而去。

en: The storm caused significant harm to the coastal villages.
Smoking can harm your lungs over time.
His harsh words did more harm than good.
cn: 风暴对沿海村庄造成了严重破坏。
吸烟会逐渐损害你的肺部。
他刻薄的言辞弊大于利。

en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
The chemical leak had harmful effects on the local ecosystem.
Excessive screen time can be harmful to children's eyesight.
cn: 吸烟对健康有害。
化学物质泄漏对当地生态系统造成了有害影响。
过度使用电子屏幕可能损害儿童视力。

en: The harmony between colors in this painting is breathtaking.
They sang in perfect harmony during the choir performance.
Social harmony requires mutual understanding and respect.
cn: 这幅画中色彩的和谐令人惊叹。
合唱表演中，他们的歌声完美和鸣。
社会和谐需要相互理解与尊重。

definitions.definition: 马具；安全带； harness（控制或利用自然力的）装置
给…套上马具； harness（利用自然力或资源）

en: The farmer harnessed the horses to the plow.
Solar panels harness energy from the sun.
Rock climbers always check their safety harness.
cn: 农夫给马套上犁具。
太阳能板利用太阳的能量。
攀岩者总会检查安全带。

en: The fabric felt harsh against her skin.
His harsh criticism made her lose confidence.
The desert climate is harsh for most plants.
cn: 这种布料摸起来很扎皮肤。
他严厉的批评让她失去了信心。
沙漠气候对大多数植物来说过于严酷。

en: Farmers celebrate the harvest with a festival.
Scientists harvest stem cells for research.
The apple harvest was smaller this year due to drought.
cn: 农民们用节日庆祝丰收。
科学家采集干细胞用于研究。
由于干旱，今年的苹果收成减少。

en: She left in haste without saying goodbye.
Haste makes waste, as the old proverb goes.
The letter was written with undue haste.
cn: 她匆忙离开，未及道别。
古谚有云：欲速则不达。
这封信写得过于仓促。

en: She hastened to finish her report before the deadline.
The doctor hastened to the emergency room.
His words hastened the decision-making process.
cn: 她加紧在截止日期前完成报告。
医生急忙赶往急诊室。
他的话加速了决策进程。

en: She made a hasty decision without considering the consequences.
The hasty retreat of the soldiers left their equipment behind.
Avoid hasty judgments; take time to analyze the situation.
cn: 她草率地做了决定，没有考虑后果。
士兵们匆忙撤退，落下了装备。
避免仓促判断，花时间分析情况。

definitions.definition: 帽子（有檐的头部遮盖物）

en: She tipped her hat to greet the passerby.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of his silk hat.
Always wear a sun hat in strong daylight.
cn: 她轻触帽檐向路人致意。
魔术师从丝绸礼帽中拽出一只兔子。
强烈日光下务必佩戴遮阳帽。

en: The eggs will hatch in about two weeks.
They hatched a plan to escape the prison.
She climbed through the hatch into the ship’s hold.
cn: 这些蛋大约两周后孵化。
他们策划了一个越狱计划。
她从舱口爬进船舱。

en: His eyes were full of hate.
I hate it when people lie.
The speech incited racial hate.
cn: 他的眼神充满仇恨。
我讨厌别人说谎。
这场演讲煽动了种族仇恨。

en: His hateful remarks shocked everyone at the meeting.
The graffiti was a hateful act of vandalism.
She gave him a hateful glare before turning away.
cn: 他的恶毒言论震惊了与会所有人。
涂鸦是一种充满仇恨的破坏行为。
她憎恶地瞪了他一眼，然后转身离开。

en: His speech was full of hatred toward injustice.
Years of conflict deepened the hatred between the two communities.
She looked at him with pure hatred in her eyes.
cn: 他的言论充满了对不公正的憎恨。
多年的冲突加深了两个社区间的仇恨。
她看着他，眼中带着纯粹的厌恶。

definitions.definition: 经历；遭受（如 have a cold）
助动词（用于完成时态，如 have done）

en: I have a book about ancient history.
She has had this car for ten years.
They have just finished the project.
cn: 我有一本关于古代历史的书。
她拥有这辆车已经十年了。
他们刚刚完成了这个项目。

en: The hawk circled high above the field, searching for prey.
Street vendors hawk souvenirs to tourists near the monument.
She hawked loudly to clear her throat before speaking.
cn: 鹰在田野上空盘旋，搜寻猎物。
小贩在纪念碑附近向游客兜售纪念品。
她大声清嗓，然后开始讲话。

definitions.definition: 干草（晒干的草，用于喂养动物或铺垫）

en: The farmer piled the hay in the barn for winter feed.
Cows prefer fresh grass to dried hay.
We spread hay on the floor of the rabbit cage.
cn: 农夫将干草堆在谷仓中作为冬季饲料。
奶牛更喜欢鲜草而非干草。
我们在兔笼底部铺了干草。

en: Climbing without proper equipment is a serious hazard.
The chemical plant poses environmental hazards.
He hazarded all his savings on the investment.
cn: 不佩戴专业装备攀岩极其危险。
这家化工厂存在环境隐患。
他把全部积蓄押注在这项投资上。

definitions.definition: 他（指代男性或性别未指定的单数第三人称）

en: He opened the door quietly.
Is he coming to the meeting tomorrow?
Everyone laughed when he told the joke.
cn: 他轻轻地打开了门。
他明天会来参加会议吗？
他讲笑话时大家都笑了。

en: She nodded her head in agreement.
The company is headed by a young CEO.
We’re heading to the beach this weekend.
cn: 她点头表示同意。
这家公司由一位年轻的CEO领导。
我们本周末要去海滩。

definitions.definition: （比喻）令人头疼的问题或麻烦

en: She took aspirin to relieve her headache.
The budget deficit is a real headache for the government.
Loud noises always give me a headache.
cn: 她服用了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
预算赤字是政府真正头疼的问题。
噪音总是让我头痛。

en: The chapter heading was printed in bold.
The ship changed its heading to avoid the storm.
He scored with a brilliant heading from the corner kick.
cn: 章节标题以粗体印刷。
船只改变航向以避开风暴。
他通过角球的一记精彩头球破门得分。

en: The scandal made headlines worldwide.
She headlines the new environmental campaign.
The newspaper headlined the story "Crisis in the Capital".
cn: 这起丑闻登上了全球头条。
她为新的环保活动担任头条人物。
报纸以“首都危机”为标题报道了该事件。

en: The headmaster announced a new school policy during assembly.
She met with the headmaster to discuss her son's progress.
Our headmaster encourages students to participate in sports.
cn: 校长在集会上宣布了新校规。
她与校长会面讨论儿子的学业进展。
我们的校长鼓励学生参与体育活动。

en: The company's headquarters are located in New York.
The general issued orders from the military headquarters.
Protesters gathered outside the police headquarters.
cn: 该公司总部位于纽约。
将军从军事司令部下达了命令。
抗议者聚集在警察总部门外。

definitions.definition: /vi. 治愈，痊愈（指身体或情感上的恢复）

en: Time can heal most wounds.
The therapist helped her heal from trauma.
Their apology began to heal the rift between the two families.
cn: 时间能治愈大多数伤痛。
心理治疗师帮助她从创伤中恢复。
他们的道歉开始弥合两家人之间的裂痕。

en: Regular exercise is essential for maintaining good health.
The health of the economy depends on consumer confidence.
She dedicated her life to improving public health.
cn: 定期锻炼对保持健康至关重要。
经济繁荣取决于消费者信心。
她毕生致力于改善公共健康。

en: She maintains a healthy diet with plenty of vegetables.
The company reported healthy profits this quarter.
Regular exercise is key to a healthy lifestyle.
cn: 她坚持富含蔬菜的健康饮食。
该公司本季度利润可观。
规律运动是健康生活的关键。

en: The books were piled in a heap on the floor.
She heaped praise on her team for their hard work.
A heap of broken toys lay in the corner.
cn: 书籍杂乱地堆在地板上。
她对团队的辛勤工作大加赞扬。
一堆破损的玩具堆在角落。

en: Can you hear the birds singing outside?
I heard that she moved to Paris last year.
The judge refused to hear the case due to lack of evidence.
cn: 你能听到外面鸟儿的歌声吗？
我听说她去年搬去了巴黎。
法官因证据不足拒绝审理此案。

en: Her heart raced as she stepped onto the stage.
The heart of the city is its bustling market square.
He played the ace of hearts and won the trick.
cn: 她走上舞台时心跳加速。
这座城市的中心是熙熙攘攘的市场广场。
他打出红心A，赢下了这一墩。

en: The heat of the sun made the sand too hot to walk on.
She heated the soup in the microwave.
His words only added heat to the argument.
cn: 太阳的高温让沙子烫得无法行走。
她用微波炉加热了汤。
他的话让争论更加激烈。

en: The heating system broke down during the snowstorm.
She placed the metal rod in the heating furnace.
This room has electric heating for winter.
cn: 暴风雪期间供暖系统瘫痪了。
她把金属棒放入加热炉中。
这间屋子冬季用电暖气供暖。

definitions.definition: 天堂（宗教或神话中的神圣居所）
极乐之地；美好境界（比喻用法）

en: The stars shone brightly in the night heaven.
She felt like she was in heaven after tasting the dessert.
Ancient myths often depict heaven as a place of eternal peace.
cn: 夜空中繁星闪烁。
尝到甜点时，她仿佛置身天堂。
古代神话常将天堂描绘为永恒宁静之地。

en: The old man walked heavily due to his injured leg.
The company invested heavily in renewable energy.
She sighed heavily after hearing the bad news.
cn: 老人因腿伤步履沉重。
该公司在可再生能源领域投入巨资。
听到坏消息后，她重重地叹了口气。

en: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
Heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
She felt a heavy sadness after the news.
cn: 这个箱子太重了，我抬不动。
暴雨导致城市内涝。
听到消息后，她感到沉重的悲伤。

en: The garden was bordered by a thick hedge.
Investors often hedge their bets to reduce losses.
Politicians tend to hedge when asked direct questions.
cn: 花园周围有一道茂密的树篱。
投资者常通过对冲来降低损失。
政客被直接提问时往往含糊其辞。

definitions.definition: 脚后跟；鞋或袜的后跟部分
给（鞋）装后跟；用脚后跟触碰

en: She scraped her heel on the rough pavement.
The cobbler will heel these shoes with durable rubber.
The sailboat heeled sharply in the strong wind.
cn: 她的脚后跟被粗糙的人行道擦伤了。
鞋匠将为这双鞋装上耐磨的橡胶后跟。
帆船在强风中剧烈倾斜。

en: The height of the mountain is 8,848 meters.
She reached the height of her career at age 30.
The plane climbed to a height of 10,000 feet.
cn: 这座山的高度是8,848米。
她在30岁时达到了职业生涯的巅峰。
飞机爬升至10,000英尺的高度。

definitions.definition: 继承人（法律或传统意义上的财产、头衔继承者）

en: The prince is the heir to the throne.
She was named sole heir in her father's will.
As the eldest son, he became the heir of the family estate.
cn: 这位王子是王位的继承人。
她在父亲的遗嘱中被指定为唯一继承人。
作为长子，他成为了家族财产的继承人。

definitions.definition: 直升机（一种通过旋翼产生升力和推进力的航空器）

en: The helicopter landed on the hospital rooftop.
Rescue teams used helicopters to evacuate flood victims.
The sound of approaching helicopters echoed through the valley.
cn: 直升机降落在医院楼顶。
救援队用直升机疏散洪水受灾者。
逼近的直升机声在山谷中回荡。

definitions.definition: 地狱；阴间；极痛苦的境况

en: The ancient texts describe hell as a fiery abyss.
She went through hell after losing her job.
Oh hell, I forgot my keys again!
cn: 古籍将地狱描述为燃烧的深渊。
失业后，她经历了极大的痛苦。
见鬼！我又忘带钥匙了！

en: Hello! How are you today?
She gave me a cheerful hello.
Hello? Can anyone hear me?
cn: 你好！今天过得如何？
她愉快地向我打了招呼。
喂？有人能听到吗？

en: The knight wore a polished steel helmet into battle.
Always fasten your helmet strap when riding a motorcycle.
The firefighter’s helmet protected him from falling debris.
cn: 骑士戴着一顶抛光的钢制头盔上战场。
骑摩托车时务必系好头盔带。
消防员的头盔保护他免受坠落碎片的伤害。

en: Can you help me carry this box?
Her advice was a great help to me.
The medicine might help with your headache.
cn: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？
她的建议对我帮助很大。
这种药可能缓解你的头痛。

en: She gave me some helpful advice on my project.
The app is helpful for learning new vocabulary.
He’s always helpful to his neighbors.
cn: 她为我的项目提供了一些有用的建议。
这款应用对学习新词汇很有帮助。
他总是乐于帮助邻居。

en: The stranded hikers felt helpless in the storm.
Without tools, he was helpless to repair the engine.
Her helpless laughter made everyone smile.
cn: 被困的徒步者在暴风雨中感到无助。
没有工具，他无法修理发动机。
她情不自禁的笑声感染了所有人。

en: The hen laid an egg every morning.
Farmers keep hens for both eggs and meat.
A rooster crowed, and the hens scattered.
cn: 这只母鸡每天早晨下一个蛋。
农民饲养母鸡以获取蛋和肉。
公鸡啼叫，母鸡四散。

definitions.definition: 因此，由此（表示结果或推论）
从此，今后（表示时间或空间上的距离）

en: The road was blocked; hence we took a detour.
She will leave a month hence.
The agreement expires two years hence.
cn: 道路被封锁了，因此我们绕道而行。
她将于一个月后离开。
该协议两年后失效。

definitions.definition: 她（女性第三人称单数宾格）
她的（所有格形式，相当于 her + noun）

en: I gave her the book yesterday.
Her smile lights up the room.
They invited her to join the committee.
cn: 我昨天把书给了她。
她的笑容照亮了整个房间。
他们邀请她加入委员会。

definitions.definition: 兽群；人群（通常指无组织的群体）

en: A herd of elephants crossed the river slowly.
The shepherd herded the sheep into the pen.
Tourists were herded through the museum without time to pause.
cn: 一群大象缓慢地渡过了河流。
牧羊人将羊群赶入围栏。
游客被匆忙带过博物馆，无暇驻足。

en: Come here and look at this picture.
The book you need is right here on the shelf.
Here, we celebrate diversity and inclusion.
cn: 来这里看看这张照片。
你要的书就在书架上。
在这里，我们颂扬多样性与包容性。

definitions.definition: 英雄（指勇敢或品德高尚的人）
男主角（文学或影视作品中的主要男性角色）

en: The firefighter was hailed as a hero for saving the child.
The hero of the novel sacrifices himself to save the kingdom.
Ancient Greeks believed heroes were demigods.
cn: 这位消防员因救出孩子而被誉为英雄。
小说的男主角为拯救王国而牺牲自己。
古希腊人认为英雄是半神。

en: His heroic actions saved the child from the burning building.
The team made a heroic effort to finish the project on time.
The poem describes the heroic deeds of ancient warriors.
cn: 他的英勇行为将孩子从燃烧的建筑物中救出。
团队付出了巨大努力以按时完成项目。
这首诗描述了古代战士的英雄事迹。

en: She became a national heroine after saving the child from the fire.
The novel’s heroine struggles against societal expectations.
Marie Curie is a heroine in the field of science.
cn: 她从火场中救出孩子后成为全国闻名的女英雄。
小说中的女主角与社会期望抗争。
居里夫人是科学领域的杰出女性。

en: The book is hers, not mine.
Hers was the only proposal accepted.
Those keys must be hers.
cn: 这本书是她的，不是我的。
她的提议是唯一被采纳的。
那些钥匙一定是她的。

en: She taught herself to play the piano.
The manager herself approved the project.
She looked at herself in the mirror.
cn: 她自学了弹钢琴。
经理本人批准了这个项目。
她看着镜子里的自己。

en: She hesitated before answering the difficult question.
The speaker hesitated, searching for the right words.
Don’t hesitate to ask for help if you need it.
cn: 她在回答这个难题前犹豫了一下。
演讲者停顿片刻，寻找合适的词语。
如果需要帮助，请毫不犹豫地提出来。

definitions.definition: 用于打招呼的问候语（相当于“你好”或“嗨”）

en: Hi! How are you doing today?
She waved and said, "Hi, everyone!"
Just a quick hi before my meeting starts.
cn: 嗨！你今天过得怎么样？
她挥手说道：“大家好！”
开会前简单打个招呼。

en: She hid the key under the doormat.
The rabbit hides in the bushes when scared.
The boots are made of buffalo hide.
cn: 她把钥匙藏在门垫下。
兔子受惊时会躲在灌木丛中。
这双靴子由水牛皮制成。

en: The plane flew at a high altitude.
She holds a high position in the company.
The stock price reached a new high yesterday.
cn: 飞机在高空飞行。
她在公司担任高级职位。
昨日股价创下新高。

definitions.definition: 赞许地；高标准地（表示评价）

en: She speaks highly of her mentor.
This is a highly effective solution.
The project was highly successful.
cn: 她高度评价她的导师。
这是一个非常有效的解决方案。
该项目极为成功。

en: The highway connects two major cities.
Education is a highway to better opportunities.
Trucks are not allowed on this scenic highway.
cn: 这条公路连接了两座主要城市。
教育是通往更好机会的途径。
这条景观公路禁止卡车通行。

en: The village is nestled at the foot of a green hill.
Cycling up that steep hill was exhausting.
Ancient tribes often built settlements on hills for defense.
cn: 村庄坐落在翠绿的小山脚下。
骑自行车爬上那个陡坡非常累人。
古代部落常在山丘上建立聚落以利防御。

en: The cottage was built on a steep hillside.
Wildflowers covered the sunny hillside in spring.
Landslides often occur after heavy rain on bare hillsides.
cn: 小屋建在陡峭的山坡上。
春天野花遍布阳光照耀的山腰。
裸露的山坡在大雨后常发生滑坡。

definitions.definition: 他（第三人称单数男性宾格）

en: She gave him a book.
I haven't seen him for weeks.
The teacher asked him to answer the question.
cn: 她给了他一本书。
我已经好几周没见到他了。
老师让他回答这个问题。

definitions.definition: 他自己（反身代词，强调男性或性别中性主体）

en: He taught himself to play the piano.
The CEO himself announced the news.
John looked at himself in the mirror.
cn: 他自学了弹钢琴。
首席执行官本人宣布了这一消息。
约翰看着镜中的自己。

en: She dropped a hint about the surprise party.
His smile hinted at a secret.
The teacher gave a hint to solve the puzzle.
cn: 她透露了一点关于惊喜派对的线索。
他的微笑暗示着一个秘密。
老师给出了解开谜题的提示。

en: The company decided to hire more staff for the busy season.
We need to hire a car for our trip next week.
The hire of the equipment costs $50 per day.
cn: 公司决定在旺季雇用更多员工。
我们下周旅行需要租一辆车。
设备的租金是每天50美元。

en: He forgot his keys on the table.
The cat licked his paws.
His opinion matters greatly to the team.
cn: 他把钥匙忘在桌上了。
猫咪舔了舔它的爪子。
他的意见对团队非常重要。

en: This museum houses many historical artifacts from the Ming Dynasty.
cn: 这座博物馆收藏了许多明代的历史文物。

definitions.definition: 历史（对过去事件的研究或记录）
经历，发展过程（如个人或事物的历史）

en: She studied European history at university.
The building has a long and fascinating history.
History often repeats itself if we fail to learn from it.
cn: 她在大学学习欧洲历史。
这座建筑有一段漫长而迷人的历史。
若不吸取教训，历史常会重演。

definitions.definition: 击打；成功（作品、歌曲等）；讽刺

en: The boxer hit his opponent with a powerful right hook.
Her new song quickly hit the top of the charts.
We hit a major problem during the project.
cn: 拳击手以一记有力的右勾拳击中对手。
她的新歌迅速登上排行榜榜首。
我们在项目中遇到了一个重大问题。

en: Gardening is her favorite hobby.
He turned his hobby of photography into a career.
Collecting stamps is a common hobby among children.
cn: 园艺是她最爱的爱好。
他将摄影爱好发展成了职业。
集邮是孩子们常见的消遣。

en: She held the baby gently in her arms.
This bottle can hold up to two liters of water.
The ship's cargo hold was filled with supplies.
cn: 她轻轻地将婴儿抱在怀中。
这个瓶子最多能装两升水。
船的货舱里堆满了补给品。

en: The rabbit disappeared into a deep hole.
There’s a hole in your argument.
She drilled a small hole in the wall.
cn: 兔子钻进了深洞里。
你的论点中存在漏洞。
她在墙上钻了一个小孔。

en: We spent our holiday hiking in the mountains.
Christmas is a public holiday in many countries.
She’s holidaying in Spain this summer.
cn: 我们在山区徒步度假。
圣诞节是许多国家的公共假日。
她今年夏天在西班牙度假。

definitions.definition: 空的，中空的；空洞的，虚伪的

en: The tree trunk was hollow after years of decay.
His promises rang hollow without action.
They hollowed out a pumpkin for Halloween.
cn: 多年腐烂后，树干变成了中空。
他的承诺没有行动支撑，显得空洞。
他们挖空南瓜做万圣节装饰。

en: The holy book is revered by millions.
She led a holy life dedicated to prayer.
The ground was considered holy by ancient tribes.
cn: 这本圣书被数百万人尊崇。
她过着虔诚祈祷的圣洁生活。
这片土地被古代部落视为神圣之地。

en: She returned home after a long trip.
Home cooking always tastes better.
The team played their first home game of the season.
cn: 长途旅行后，她回到了家。
家常菜总是更美味。
球队进行了本赛季的首场主场比赛。

en: She gave an honest answer without hesitation.
Honest communication builds trust in relationships.
The shopkeeper is known for being honest with his customers.
cn: 她毫不犹豫地给出了诚实的回答。
真诚的沟通能建立人际关系中的信任。
这位店主以对顾客诚实著称。

en: Honesty is the best policy in both personal and professional relationships.
The garden was dotted with purple honesty flowers in spring.
Her honesty about the mistake earned her everyone’s trust.
cn: 诚实是人际和职场关系中的上策。
春天里，花园点缀着紫色的香雪球花。
她对错误的坦诚赢得了所有人的信任。

en: The bees store honey in the hive.
She added a spoonful of honey to her tea.
"Good morning, honey!" he said to his daughter.
cn: 蜜蜂将蜂蜜储存在蜂巢中。
她在茶里加了一勺蜂蜜。
“早上好，宝贝！”他对女儿说道。

definitions.definition: 蜜月（新婚后的旅行或假期）

en: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.
The honeymoon phase of their relationship ended quickly.
Many couples choose to honeymoon in tropical destinations.
cn: 他们去巴厘岛度蜜月。
他们关系的蜜月期很快结束了。
许多夫妇选择去热带地区度蜜月。

definitions.definition: 荣誉，光荣；名誉，面子；尊敬，敬意；道德准则，气节
尊敬，向…致敬；表彰，给…以荣誉；信守，执行（承诺）

en: It is a great honour to receive this award.
He was honoured for his bravery in the rescue.
They fought to defend the honour of their family.
cn: 获得这个奖项是极大的荣誉。
他因在救援中的勇敢行为而受到表彰。
他们为捍卫家族的名誉而斗争。

definitions.definition: 可敬的，值得钦佩的；品行高洁的

en: He is an honourable man who always keeps his promises.
It is honourable to admit your mistakes and learn from them.
She received an honourable mention in the national writing competition.
cn: 他是一个信守承诺的可敬之人。
承认错误并从中学习是值得敬佩的。
她在全国写作比赛中获得了荣誉提名。

en: He hung his coat on the hook by the door.
The fisherman hooked a large salmon.
The movie's plot hooked the audience from the start.
cn: 他将外套挂在门边的钩子上。
渔民钓到一条大鲑鱼。
这部电影的情节从一开始就吸引了观众。

en: She never gave up hope despite the difficulties.
We hope to visit Paris next summer.
His words brought a glimmer of hope to the team.
cn: 尽管困难重重，她从未放弃希望。
我们盼望明年夏天去巴黎旅行。
他的话给团队带来了一丝希望。

en: She gave him a hopeful smile before the interview.
The team remains hopeful about winning the championship.
As a young hopeful, he moved to Hollywood to pursue acting.
cn: 面试前，她给了他一个充满希望的微笑。
这支队伍对赢得冠军仍抱有希望。
作为一名怀揣梦想的年轻人，他搬到好莱坞追求演艺事业。

en: The situation seemed hopeless after the storm destroyed the village.
She felt hopeless when her application was rejected for the third time.
He's a hopeless cook—even boiling water is a challenge for him.
cn: 风暴摧毁村庄后，局势似乎毫无希望。
第三次申请被拒时，她感到绝望。
他是个糟糕的厨师——连烧开水都是挑战。

en: The sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky orange.
Travel broadens your horizons and challenges your perspectives.
Scientists are pushing the horizons of quantum computing.
cn: 太阳沉入地平线，将天空染成橙色。
旅行能拓宽视野并挑战你的认知。
科学家正在拓展量子计算的边界。

definitions.definition: 水平的；与地平线平行的

en: The picture should be hung on a horizontal line.
The drone flew in a perfectly horizontal path.
The table must be horizontal for accurate measurements.
cn: 这幅画应挂在水平线上。
无人机以完全水平的路线飞行。
桌子必须保持水平以确保测量准确。

definitions.definition: 角（动物头上的坚硬生长物）

en: The bull lowered its horns and charged.
She played a tune on the French horn.
The driver honked the horn impatiently.
cn: 公牛低下角冲了过来。
她用圆号演奏了一首曲子。
司机不耐烦地按响了喇叭。

definitions.definition: 恐怖，恐惧；令人恐惧的事物
（因可怕事物引起的）厌恶，憎恶

en: She watched the horror movie with her hands covering her eyes.
The villagers fled in horror when the volcano erupted.
His crimes were beyond comprehension, a true horror of human nature.
cn: 她捂着眼睛看完了那部恐怖片。
火山喷发时，村民们惊恐地逃离。
他的罪行超乎想象，是人性的真实恐怖。

en: The knight mounted his horse and rode into battle.
She has been taking horse riding lessons since childhood.
The carousel features beautifully painted wooden horses.
cn: 骑士跨上战马，冲向战场。
她从小就开始学习马术课程。
旋转木马上装饰着彩绘的木马。

definitions.definition: 马力（功率单位，1马力约等于745.7瓦）

en: This car's engine produces 300 horsepower.
She has the intellectual horsepower to solve complex problems.
The new policy aims to boost the economic horsepower of the region.
cn: 这辆车的发动机可输出300马力。
她拥有解决复杂问题的强大脑力。
新政策旨在提升该地区的经济驱动力。

en: She was rushed to the hospital after the accident.
The medieval hospital provided shelter for pilgrims.
Modern hospitals are equipped with advanced technology.
cn: 事故发生后，她被紧急送往医院。
中世纪的慈善院为朝圣者提供庇护。
现代医院配备了先进技术。

definitions.definition: 主人；主办方；大量（人或物）

en: She will host the annual conference next month.
The host greeted each guest warmly.
A host of tiny insects invaded the garden.
cn: 她将于下月主办年度会议。
主人热情问候每位客人。
一大群小昆虫入侵了花园。

definitions.definition: 女主人；女主持人；空姐（飞机上女性服务员）

en: The hostess greeted every guest with a warm smile.
She worked as a flight hostess for over a decade.
The TV show’s hostess skillfully guided the discussion.
cn: 女主人以温暖的微笑迎接每位客人。
她担任空姐工作超过十年。
节目女主持人娴熟地引导了讨论。

en: The hostile crowd threw stones at the police.
Plants struggle to survive in hostile environments.
His hostile attitude made teamwork impossible.
cn: 敌对的人群向警察投掷石块。
植物在恶劣环境中艰难生存。
他的敌对态度使团队合作无法进行。

en: The soup is too hot to drink right now.
Be careful with the chili sauce—it's extremely hot.
That new song is getting hot on social media.
cn: 这汤现在太烫了，没法喝。
小心辣椒酱，它非常辣。
那首新歌在社交媒体上正火。

en: The historic hotel overlooks the Seine River.
We booked a boutique hotel for our anniversary.
Hotel staff are trained to handle emergencies.
cn: 这座历史悠久的酒店俯瞰塞纳河。
我们为周年纪念预订了一家精品酒店。
酒店员工接受过应急处理培训。

definitions.definition: 固定时间点（如办公时间）

en: The meeting lasted for an hour.
Please arrive within business hours.
She exercises half an hour every morning.
cn: 会议持续了一小时。
请在营业时间内到达。
她每天早晨锻炼半小时。

en: They bought a house near the river.
The opera house was filled to capacity.
The museum houses a collection of ancient artifacts.
cn: 他们在河边买了一栋房子。
歌剧院座无虚席。
该博物馆藏有一批古代文物。

definitions.definition: 家庭；户（指同住一个住所的人）

en: The average household size in the city has decreased over the past decade.
She is responsible for managing household expenses.
This detergent is designed for household use.
cn: 过去十年，该市的平均家庭规模有所缩小。
她负责管理家庭开支。
这种洗涤剂专为家庭使用设计。

definitions.definition: 家庭主妇（已婚女性，负责家务管理）
（古义）女管家；节俭的家庭管理者

en: She chose to be a housewife after marriage.
The Victorian housewife was expected to manage the household efficiently.
Modern housewives often balance childcare and part-time work.
cn: 她婚后选择成为家庭主妇。
维多利亚时代的家庭主妇被要求高效管理家务。
现代家庭主妇常兼顾育儿与兼职工作。

definitions.definition: 如何，怎样（表示方式或方法）
如何（引导从句，表示方式或状态）

en: How did you solve this problem?
How beautiful the sunset is!
She explained how the machine works.
cn: 你是如何解决这个问题的？
这日落多么美丽啊！
她解释了这台机器的工作原理。

definitions.definition: 无论如何（强调程度或方式）

en: She was tired; however, she finished the project.
However you solve it, just make sure it's correct.
The plan seems perfect. However, risks still exist.
cn: 她很累，但仍完成了项目。
无论你如何解决，确保正确即可。
计划看似完美，然而风险依然存在。

en: The huge elephant calmly walked through the savannah.
She felt a huge sense of relief after finishing the exam.
The project requires a huge amount of resources.
cn: 这只巨大的大象平静地走过草原。
考试结束后，她感到如释重负。
该项目需要耗费大量资源。

en: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity.
The robot displayed almost human-like emotions.
Human error caused the system to crash.
cn: 人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等。
这个机器人表现出近乎人类的情感。
人为错误导致系统崩溃。

en: Despite his success, he remained humble.
The defeat humbled the arrogant team.
She comes from a humble background.
cn: 尽管成功了，他依然谦逊。
这次失败让那支傲慢的队伍学会了谦卑。
她出身卑微。

en: The humid weather made her hair curl uncontrollably.
Tropical forests are known for their humid climate.
A humidifier can help relieve dry skin in winter.
cn: 潮湿的天气让她的头发卷得难以打理。
热带森林以潮湿的气候著称。
加湿器能缓解冬季皮肤干燥。

en: His humorous remarks lightened the mood of the meeting.
The book is full of humorous anecdotes about travel.
She has a witty and humorous way of storytelling.
cn: 他幽默的发言缓解了会议紧张的气氛。
这本书充满了关于旅行的幽默轶事。
她的讲述方式机智而风趣。

en: His speech was full of self-deprecating humour.
She humoured her child by pretending to laugh at his silly joke.
The film balances dark humour with social commentary.
cn: 他的演讲充满了自嘲的幽默。
她迁就孩子，假装被他无聊的笑话逗笑。
这部电影将黑色幽默与社会评论巧妙结合。

en: The ancient manuscript is over a hundred years old.
She scored a perfect hundred in the math test.
Hundreds of people attended the charity event.
cn: 这份古老的手稿已有一百多年历史。
她在数学考试中得了满分一百分。
数百人参加了这场慈善活动。

en: The refugees faced extreme hunger after days without food.
She hungered for recognition in her field.
His hunger drove him to steal a loaf of bread.
cn: 难民们多日未进食，面临极度饥饿。
她渴望在自己领域获得认可。
饥饿驱使他偷了一条面包。

en: The refugees were hungry and exhausted after days of walking.
She has a hungry mind that constantly seeks new challenges.
The soil looked hungry for rain after months of drought.
cn: 难民们连续行走多日后饥肠辘辘、精疲力竭。
她有一颗渴望新知、不断追求挑战的心。
干旱数月后，土壤显得干渴难耐。

en: The wolves hunt in packs at night.
She is hunting for a new apartment in the city.
The treasure hunt attracted hundreds of participants.
cn: 狼群在夜间集体狩猎。
她正在城里寻找新公寓。
这次寻宝活动吸引了数百人参加。

en: Don't hurry, we have plenty of time.
She hurried to catch the last train.
The noise was just the hurry of the city.
cn: 别着急，我们时间很充裕。
她匆忙赶去搭乘末班火车。
这喧嚣不过是城市的匆忙罢了。

en: The fall hurt his knee badly.
Her harsh words hurt his feelings.
Time heals all hurts.
cn: 跌倒严重伤到了他的膝盖。
她刻薄的话语伤害了他的感情。
时间会治愈一切伤痛。

en: She introduced her husband at the party.
Farmers must husband their crops wisely.
He husbanded his savings to buy a house.
cn: 她在派对上介绍了她的丈夫。
农民必须明智地管理庄稼。
他节俭存钱以购买房屋。

en: The fisherman lived in a small hut by the river.
During the storm, we took shelter in a wooden hut.
The mountain climbers built a snow hut for the night.
cn: 渔夫住在河边的一间小棚屋里。
暴风雨期间，我们在一间木棚屋里躲避。
登山者们搭了一座雪屋过夜。

en: Hydrogen is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe.
Water molecules consist of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
The hydrogen fuel cell converts chemical energy into electricity.
cn: 氢是宇宙中最轻且最丰富的元素。
水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。
氢燃料电池将化学能转化为电能。

en: The pond was covered with a thin layer of ice.
She iced the champagne before the party.
His voice had an edge of ice when he spoke.
cn: 池塘表面结了一层薄冰。
她在派对前冰镇了香槟。
他说话时声音带着冰冷的锋芒。

en: The children happily licked their ice-cream cones.
She prefers vanilla ice-cream over chocolate.
This shop serves artisanal ice-cream made with local ingredients.
cn: 孩子们开心地舔着蛋筒冰淇淋。
比起巧克力味，她更爱香草冰淇淋。
这家店售卖用本地食材制作的手工冰淇淋。

en: She had a brilliant idea for the project.
The idea of freedom is deeply rooted in their culture.
His ideas about education challenged traditional methods.
cn: 她对这个项目有个绝妙的主意。
自由的观念深深植根于他们的文化中。
他关于教育的理念挑战了传统方法。

en: She is the ideal candidate for the job.
The trip was far from ideal due to the bad weather.
His ideals of justice inspired many people.
cn: 她是这份工作的理想人选。
由于天气恶劣，这次旅行远非理想。
他的正义理想激励了许多人。

en: The two signatures are virtually identical.
Identical twins share 100% of their genetic material.
The equation remains identical after transformation.
cn: 这两份签名几乎一模一样。
同卵双胞胎的基因完全相同。
该方程变换后仍保持恒等。

en: The witness could not identify the suspect in the lineup.
Many readers identify with the protagonist’s struggles.
Scientists use DNA to identify species accurately.
cn: 目击者无法在列队中指认嫌疑人。
许多读者对主角的挣扎感同身受。
科学家通过DNA精准鉴定物种。

definitions.definition: 习语；成语（特定语言中具有独特含义的固定短语）

en: "Break a leg" is an English idiom meaning "good luck."
Shakespeare's works are rich in poetic idioms.
Translating idioms requires understanding cultural context.
cn: “Break a leg”是英语习语，意为“祝好运”。
莎士比亚的作品充满诗意的语言风格。
翻译习语需要理解文化背景。

definitions.definition: 闲置的；懒惰的；无意义的

en: The factory machines stood idle during the strike.
She grew tired of his idle promises.
Don't idle away your youth; pursue meaningful goals.
cn: 罢工期间，工厂的机器闲置着。
她厌倦了他空洞的承诺。
别虚度青春，去追求有意义的目标。

en: If it rains, we will stay indoors.
I wonder if she will come to the party.
If he apologized, I might forgive him.
cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。
我想知道她是否会来参加派对。
如果他道歉，我可能会原谅他。

en: He was ignorant of the basic rules of physics.
It's ignorant to judge a culture without understanding it.
Her ignorant comments revealed a lack of education.
cn: 他对物理学的基本规则一无所知。
在不了解一种文化的情况下对其妄加评判是愚昧的。
她无知的言论暴露出教育的缺失。

en: She chose to ignore his rude comments.
The government cannot ignore the public's demands.
Ignoring warning signs may lead to accidents.
cn: 她选择无视他粗鲁的评论。
政府不能忽视民众的诉求。
无视警告标志可能导致事故。

en: She fell ill after the long journey.
The policy had many ill effects on the economy.
He suffers from a chronic ill.
cn: 长途旅行后她病倒了。
该政策对经济产生了许多不良影响。
他患有一种慢性疾病。

en: It is illegal to park here after 6 PM.
The company faced fines for illegal dumping of waste.
Crossing the border without a passport is considered illegal.
cn: 下午6点后在此停车是违法的。
该公司因非法倾倒垃圾面临罚款。
无护照越境被视为非法行为。

definitions.definition: 疾病；身体或心理的不健康状态

en: Her illness prevented her from attending the meeting.
Chronic illness requires long-term care.
Mental illness should be treated with the same urgency as physical illness.
cn: 她的病情使她无法参加会议。
慢性疾病需要长期护理。
心理疾病应像身体疾病一样得到紧急救治。

en: The diagram illustrates the process of photosynthesis.
She illustrated her talk with real-life examples.
The book is beautifully illustrated with watercolor paintings.
cn: 这张图阐释了光合作用的过程。
她用真实案例生动说明了演讲内容。
这本书配有精美的水彩画插图。

definitions.definition: （用实例或图表等进行的）说明，例证

en: The book contains beautiful illustrations of medieval castles.
Her explanation was a perfect illustration of the theory.
The professor used a diagram as an illustration of the chemical process.
cn: 这本书包含中世纪城堡的精美插图。
她的解释是该理论的完美例证。
教授用图表来说明这一化学过程。

en: The artist carved an image of a goddess from marble.
Companies spend millions to improve their public image.
She could still image her grandmother’s voice clearly.
cn: 艺术家用大理石雕刻了一座女神像。
企业花费数百万改善公众形象。
她仍能清晰地想象出祖母的声音。

en: The child has an imaginary friend.
The story is set in an imaginary world.
Her fears were purely imaginary.
cn: 这个孩子有一个想象中的朋友。
这个故事发生在一个虚构的世界里。
她的恐惧完全是想象出来的。

en: Children often have vivid imaginations.
The novel is a product of pure imagination.
She used her imagination to solve the problem creatively.
cn: 孩子们通常拥有生动的想象力。
这部小说是纯粹想象的产物。
她运用想象力创造性地解决了问题。

en: Close your eyes and imagine a peaceful beach.
It's hard to imagine life without the internet.
She imagines herself as a future scientist.
cn: 闭上眼睛，想象一片宁静的海滩。
难以想象没有互联网的生活。
她将自己设想为未来的科学家。

en: Parrots can imitate human speech with remarkable accuracy.
The designer imitated the vintage style in her new collection.
Children often imitate their parents' gestures unconsciously.
cn: 鹦鹉能以惊人的准确性模仿人类语言。
设计师在新系列中仿制了复古风格。
儿童常无意识地模仿父母的动作。

en: The government took immediate action to address the crisis.
She is my immediate superior at work.
The vaccine showed immediate effects.
cn: 政府立即采取行动应对危机。
她是我的直属上司。
疫苗效果立竿见影。

definitions.definition: 直接地（指时间或空间上的接近）

en: She responded immediately to the emergency call.
The hotel is immediately opposite the train station.
He left the room immediately after the meeting.
cn: 她立即回应了紧急呼叫。
酒店正对着火车站。
会议一结束，他立刻离开了房间。

definitions.definition: （程度或强度）无限的，难以衡量的

en: The Grand Canyon is an immense natural wonder.
She felt immense gratitude for their help.
The project required an immense amount of time.
cn: 大峡谷是巨大的自然奇观。
她对他们的帮助感到无限感激。
该项目需要耗费巨量时间。

definitions.definition: 移民（指移入某国定居的外来者）

en: She is an immigrant from Mexico who now works as a teacher.
The city has a large population of immigrants seeking better opportunities.
Immigrant communities often preserve their cultural traditions.
cn: 她是一名来自墨西哥的移民，现在是一名教师。
这座城市有大量寻求更好机会的移民。
移民社区常保留自己的文化传统。

en: The new policy will impact small businesses significantly.
The meteor's impact left a massive crater.
Social media has a profound impact on modern communication.
cn: 这项新政策将对小企业产生重大影响。
陨石的撞击留下了一个巨大的坑洞。
社交媒体对现代交流有深远影响。

definitions.definition: 渴望的（常用于否定句，如 "impatient for change"）

en: She grew impatient after waiting for two hours.
He was impatient to start his new project.
The impatient crowd began to shout.
cn: 等待两小时后，她变得不耐烦。
他迫不及待地想开始新项目。
焦躁的人群开始叫喊。

en: His smile carried an implication of mockery.
The report examined the legal implications of the new policy.
She denied any implication in the scandal.
cn: 他的微笑带着嘲弄的意味。
该报告分析了新政策的法律影响。
她否认与丑闻有任何牵连。

en: His silence implied agreement.
The data implies a correlation between the variables.
Freedom does not imply the absence of responsibility.
cn: 他的沉默暗示了同意。
数据表明变量间存在关联。
自由并不意味着没有责任。

en: The country imports oil from the Middle East.
His words carried great import during the meeting.
The software allows users to import data from Excel.
cn: 该国从中东进口石油。
他的发言在会议中极具重要性。
该软件支持用户从Excel导入数据。

en: The importance of education cannot be overstated.
She held a position of great importance in the company.
The discovery has little practical importance.
cn: 教育的重要性再怎么强调也不为过。
她在公司担任要职。
这一发现实际意义不大。

en: Clean water is important for human survival.
She holds an important position in the company.
It’s important to proofread your work before submission.
cn: 清洁的水对人类生存至关重要。
她在公司担任要职。
提交前校对工作很重要。

definitions.definition: 利用；打扰（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: The government imposed a new tax on luxury goods.
Don't impose your opinions on others.
She didn't want to impose on their hospitality.
cn: 政府对奢侈品征收了新税。
不要将你的观点强加于人。
她不想打扰他们的热情款待。

en: Climbing Mount Everest without training is impossible.
The noise from the construction site made sleep impossible.
Her stubborn attitude made compromise seem impossible.
cn: 未经训练攀登珠穆朗玛峰是不可能的。
建筑工地的噪音让人无法入睡。
她固执的态度让妥协看起来难以实现。

en: Her speech impressed the audience deeply.
The king used a ring to impress his seal on the document.
The teacher’s words made an impress on his young mind.
cn: 她的演讲给观众留下深刻印象。
国王用戒指在文件上盖印。
老师的话在他年幼的心灵上刻下印记。

en: Her speech left a deep impression on the audience.
The fossil shows clear impressions of ancient leaves.
He does a hilarious impression of the president.
cn: 她的演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。
化石上留有古代叶子的清晰印痕。
他对总统的模仿滑稽极了。

definitions.definition: 令人印象深刻的；给人以强烈感受的

en: The view from the mountaintop was truly impressive.
She gave an impressive speech that moved the audience.
The team's impressive performance secured their victory.
cn: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。
她的演讲打动人心，令人印象深刻。
团队出色的表现为他们锁定了胜局。

en: The king could imprison anyone without trial.
Fear can imprison the mind more than physical walls.
The activists were imprisoned for protesting unjust laws.
cn: 国王可不经审判监禁任何人。
恐惧对心灵的束缚胜过实体高墙。
活动家因抗议不公正法律被关押。

en: She took a course to improve her communication skills.
The weather is expected to improve by tomorrow.
This new software significantly improves processing speed.
cn: 她参加了课程以提高沟通能力。
预计明天天气会好转。
这款新软件显著提升了处理速度。

en: The new software brought significant improvement to our workflow.
She showed great improvement in her language skills after studying abroad.
Continuous improvement is key to staying competitive in the market.
cn: 新软件为我们的工作流程带来了显著改进。
留学后，她的语言能力有了很大提升。
持续改进是保持市场竞争力的关键。

en: She is in her office now.
This hairstyle is totally in this year.
Come in and sit down.
cn: 她现在在办公室里。
这种发型今年非常流行。
进来坐吧。

en: The screen measures 24 inches diagonally.
She inched her way through the narrow tunnel.
He grew an inch taller this year.
cn: 屏幕对角线长度为24英寸。
她在狭窄的隧道中缓慢前行。
他今年长高了一英寸。

definitions.definition: 事件（尤指不寻常或冲突性的事件）

en: The police reported a minor incident at the park.
Stress is often incident to high-pressure jobs.
The court ruled the evidence was incident to the main case.
cn: 警方报告公园发生了一起小事件。
压力常伴随高压工作而来。
法庭裁定该证据是主案的附带内容。

definitions.definition: （使）倾斜；倾向于（某种观点或行为）

en: The road inclines steeply at this point.
She inclines toward a minimalist lifestyle.
The telescope is set at a 30-degree incline.
cn: 道路在此处急剧倾斜。
她倾向于极简主义的生活方式。
望远镜被设置在30度的倾斜角上。

en: The package includes a free user manual.
Please include your contact details in the email.
The tour price doesn’t include meals.
cn: 这个套装包含一份免费用户手册。
请在邮件中附上您的联系方式。
旅行费用不含餐食。

definitions.definition: 收入，收益（个人或企业通过劳动、投资等获得的经济回报）

en: His monthly income barely covers living expenses.
Tourism is the main source of income for the island.
Tax deductions can significantly affect net income.
cn: 他的月收入勉强支付生活开销。
旅游业是该岛的主要收入来源。
税收减免会显著影响净收入。

en: The answer marked on your paper is incorrect.
It would be incorrect to ignore their cultural traditions.
The system flagged the transaction as incorrect.
cn: 你试卷上标注的答案是错误的。
忽视他们的文化传统是不妥当的。
系统将该交易标记为异常。

en: The company plans to increase production by 20% next year.
A steady increase in temperature was observed over the decade.
Regular exercise can increase your energy levels.
cn: 公司计划明年将产量提高20%。
过去十年间观测到气温持续上升。
规律锻炼能提升你的精力水平。

en: The weather is becoming increasingly cold.
She relied increasingly on her friends for support.
Technology plays an increasingly important role in education.
cn: 天气变得越来越冷。
她越来越依赖朋友的支持。
技术在教育中扮演着越来越重要的角色。

definitions.definition: 确实，的确（用于强调肯定）

en: The results were indeed surprising.
"Do you agree?" "Indeed I do."
It was cold, indeed almost freezing.
cn: 结果确实令人惊讶。
"你同意吗？""当然同意。"
天气很冷，甚至接近冰点。

en: The project timeline remains indefinite due to funding issues.
She gave an indefinite answer, leaving us confused.
Some verbs can take indefinite objects, like "eat" or "read".
cn: 由于资金问题，项目时间表仍不明确。
她给出了模糊的答复，让我们感到困惑。
有些动词可接无明确指代的对象，如“吃”或“读”。

en: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
Financial independence is crucial for young adults.
The declaration asserted the colony's right to independence.
cn: 印度于1947年脱离英国获得独立。
经济自主对年轻人至关重要。
这份宣言申明了殖民地独立的权利。

en: She has always been financially independent.
The country became independent in 1947.
He runs an independent bookstore downtown.
cn: 她一直经济独立。
该国于1947年独立。
他在市中心经营一家独立书店。

en: The book includes a detailed index at the back.
The Dow Jones Index fell by 2% today.
Librarians index new publications every month.
cn: 这本书末尾附有详细的索引。
道琼斯指数今日下跌2%。
图书馆员每月为新出版物编目。

en: She studied Indian classical dance for years.
The museum exhibits artifacts of Native American Indian tribes.
Indian cuisine is known for its rich spices.
cn: 她学习了多年印度古典舞蹈。
博物馆展出了美洲印第安部落的文物。
印度菜以香料丰富著称。

en: The dark clouds indicate rain.
She indicated her agreement with a nod.
The thermometer indicates a sudden drop in temperature.
cn: 乌云预示着要下雨。
她点头表示同意。
温度计显示气温骤降。

en: Dark clouds are often an indication of rain.
The doctor checked for indications of infection.
His frown gave no indication of his true feelings.
cn: 乌云常是下雨的征兆。
医生检查了感染的迹象。
他的皱眉未透露真实情绪。

en: She was indifferent to his apologies.
The food was decent but indifferent.
Switzerland remained indifferent during the war.
cn: 她对她的道歉无动于衷。
食物尚可，但很普通。
瑞士在战争中保持中立。

definitions.definition: 愤怒的，愤慨的（尤指因不公或侮辱）

en: She was indignant at the unfair treatment.
His indignant reply shocked everyone.
The crowd grew indignant when the speaker ignored their questions.
cn: 她对不公平的待遇感到愤慨。
他愤怒的回应让所有人震惊。
当演讲者无视听众提问时，人群变得愤怒。

en: The manager gave an indirect answer to avoid conflict.
We took an indirect route to escape the traffic.
His indirect criticism made her uncomfortable.
cn: 经理给出了一个间接的回答以避免冲突。
我们绕了条迂回路线以避开拥堵。
他拐弯抹角的批评让她感到不适。

definitions.definition: 责无旁贷的（古义，现已少用）

en: Clean water is indispensable for human survival.
Her expertise made her indispensable to the team.
In modern society, smartphones have become indispensable tools.
cn: 清洁的水是人类生存的必需品。
她的专业知识使她在团队中不可或缺。
在现代社会，智能手机已成为必不可少的工具。

en: Each individual has the right to privacy.
The teacher gave individual attention to struggling students.
Her style is highly individual and recognizable.
cn: 每个人都有隐私权。
老师为学习困难的学生提供个别指导。
她的风格极具个人特色且易于辨认。

en: She prefers to stay indoors during winter.
The cat ran indoors when it started raining.
Indoor plants need less sunlight than outdoor ones.
cn: 她冬天更喜欢待在室内。
下雨时，猫跑进了屋里。
室内植物比室外植物需要更少的阳光。

en: The city is known for its industrial heritage.
Industrial waste must be properly managed.
Japan became an industrial powerhouse after WWII.
cn: 这座城市以其工业遗产闻名。
工业废料必须妥善处理。
二战后日本成为工业强国。

definitions.definition: 使工业化；将…组织成工业部门

en: The government has plans to industrialize the rural region to boost economic growth.
Many developing countries began to industrialize rapidly in the late 20th century.
The process to industrialize the production of food has revolutionized what we eat.
cn: 政府计划使该农村地区工业化以促进经济增长。
许多发展中国家在20世纪末开始快速实现工业化。
使食品生产工业化的过程彻底改变了我们的饮食。

definitions.definition: 工业；产业（生产制造领域）
勤奋；勤劳（持续努力的状态）

en: The automobile industry is a major part of the country's economy.
She succeeded through sheer industry and determination.
Renewable energy industries are growing rapidly worldwide.
cn: 汽车工业是该国经济的重要组成部分。
她的成功全靠勤奋和决心。
全球可再生能源产业正在快速发展。

en: The old machine is inefficient and wastes energy.
Inefficient management led to the company's decline.
She criticized the inefficient use of resources.
cn: 这台旧机器效率低下且浪费能源。
低效的管理导致了公司的衰落。
她批评了资源的低效利用。

definitions.definition: 不可避免的；必然发生的

en: The rise of AI seems inevitable in modern society.
His failure was inevitable due to lack of preparation.
Change is the only inevitable thing in life.
cn: 人工智能的崛起在现代社会中似乎不可避免。
由于准备不足，他的失败是必然的。
变化是生命中唯一必然的事。

en: The store offers stylish yet inexpensive clothing.
Traveling by bus is usually more inexpensive than flying.
She found an inexpensive solution to the problem.
cn: 这家商店提供时尚且价格低廉的服装。
乘巴士旅行通常比坐飞机更经济。
她找到了一个成本低廉的解决方案。

en: The infant smiled at her mother.
Infant mortality rates have declined significantly.
The project is still in its infant stage.
cn: 婴儿对着母亲微笑。
婴儿死亡率已显著下降。
该项目仍处于初期阶段。

definitions.definition: 影响（情绪、思想等），使沾染（不良特质）

en: The virus can infect humans through direct contact.
Her laughter infected the whole room with joy.
Avoid using infected needles to prevent disease spread.
cn: 该病毒可通过直接接触传染人类。
她的笑声让整个房间充满欢乐。
避免使用受污染的针头以防疾病传播。

definitions.definition: 推断，推论（基于证据或逻辑得出结论）

en: From his silence, I inferred that he disagreed.
The study infers a link between sleep and memory.
You can't infer guilt from a lack of response.
cn: 从他的沉默中，我推断他不同意。
该研究推论出睡眠与记忆间的关联。
不能仅凭缺乏回应就推断有罪。

en: The quality of this product is inferior to that of the premium version.
She refused to accept an inferior position in the company.
Some cultures mistakenly consider women inferior to men.
cn: 此产品的质量低于高级版本。
她拒绝接受公司中的下级职位。
某些文化错误地认为女性低于男性。

en: The universe is believed to be infinite.
She showed infinite patience with the children.
The possibilities are infinite when creativity is unleashed.
cn: 宇宙被认为是无限的。
她对孩子们表现出极大的耐心。
当创造力被释放时，可能性是无穷的。

en: Social media has a huge influence on teenagers' opinions.
Her work was strongly influenced by Japanese art.
He used his influence to get the policy changed.
cn: 社交媒体对青少年的观点有巨大影响。
她的作品深受日本艺术影响。
他利用自己的影响力促使政策改变。

en: Her research was highly influential in shaping public policy.
The book became one of the most influential works of the 20th century.
Social media has made young people more influential than ever.
cn: 她的研究对公共政策的制定产生了深远影响。
这本书成为20世纪最具影响力的著作之一。
社交媒体让年轻人的影响力空前增强。

definitions.definition: 赋予…特征；影响（正式用法）

en: The teacher will inform the students about the schedule change.
His work is deeply informed by classical philosophy.
Please inform me immediately if any issues arise.
cn: 老师将通知学生日程变更。
他的作品深受古典哲学影响。
如有问题请立即告知我。

en: The website provides useful information about climate change.
She refused to disclose any further information.
The study analyzed information from over 10,000 participants.
cn: 该网站提供有关气候变化的有用信息。
她拒绝透露更多信息。
该研究分析了来自1万多名参与者的数据。

en: Polar bears inhabit the Arctic region.
The island is mainly inhabited by fishermen.
Rare birds inhabit this forest.
cn: 北极熊栖息于北极地区。
这座岛上的居民主要是渔民。
这片森林是稀有鸟类的栖息地。

en: The island has fewer than a thousand inhabitants.
Urban inhabitants often face higher living costs.
The cave was once home to ancient inhabitants.
cn: 这座岛的居民不足一千人。
城市居民通常面临更高的生活成本。
这个洞穴曾是古代居民的居所。

definitions.definition: 经遗传获得（特征、疾病等）

en: She will inherit the family estate after her father's retirement.
Some diseases can be inherited from parents.
The new CEO inherited a company in financial crisis.
cn: 她将在父亲退休后继承家族房产。
某些疾病可能由父母遗传。
新任CEO接手了一家陷入财务危机的公司。

en: The initial stage of the project requires careful planning.
She signed the document with her initials.
The team initialed each page to confirm approval.
cn: 项目的初始阶段需要周密规划。
她用姓名首字母签署了文件。
团队在每页签上首字母以示确认。

en: The nurse gave him an injection to reduce the fever.
The company needs a quick injection of capital to survive.
Injection molding is widely used in plastic manufacturing.
cn: 护士给他打了一针退烧药。
公司需要快速注入资金才能生存。
注塑成型技术广泛应用于塑料制造。

en: The accident injured three passengers.
False rumors can injure a person's reputation.
He felt deeply injured by her harsh words.
cn: 事故导致三名乘客受伤。
虚假谣言可能损害一个人的名誉。
她尖锐的言辞让他感到深受伤害。

definitions.definition: 伤害，损伤（身体或情感上的）

en: The athlete suffered a serious injury during the match.
Emotional injury can be harder to heal than physical wounds.
The company was sued for personal injury caused by defective products.
cn: 这名运动员在比赛中受了重伤。
情感创伤可能比身体伤害更难愈合。
该公司因产品缺陷导致的人身伤害被起诉。

en: The contract must be signed in ink.
Octopuses release ink to escape predators.
She inked a beautiful calligraphy design.
cn: 合同必须用墨水签署。
章鱼释放墨汁以躲避捕食者。
她用墨水绘制了一幅漂亮的书法作品。

definitions.definition: 小旅馆，客栈（尤指乡村或路边的）

en: We stayed at a cozy inn by the lake during our trip.
The old inn has been serving travelers since the 18th century.
He stopped at an inn to rest his horse.
cn: 旅行中我们住在湖边一家舒适的客栈。
这家老旅馆自18世纪起就一直为旅客服务。
他在一家小旅馆停下让马休息。

en: The inner walls of the house were painted white.
She struggled to express her inner feelings.
The inner circle of the organization makes all major decisions.
cn: 房子的内墙被刷成了白色。
她难以表达内心的感受。
该组织的核心圈子负责所有重大决策。

definitions.definition: 天真无邪的人（尤指儿童）

en: The jury found him innocent of all charges.
She gave an innocent smile, unaware of the conflict.
The story is told through the eyes of an innocent.
cn: 陪审团裁定他所有罪名不成立。
她天真地笑了笑，未察觉冲突。
故事通过一个天真孩童的视角展开。

en: The system requires manual input of the parameters.
Her input during the meeting was highly valuable.
Sensors automatically input data to the central server.
cn: 系统需要手动输入参数。
她在会议中提出的意见极具价值。
传感器自动将数据输入中央服务器。

en: She called to inquire about the job vacancy.
The committee will inquire into the allegations.
"Where are we going?" he inquired politely.
cn: 她打电话询问职位空缺情况。
委员会将调查这些指控。
“我们去哪儿？”他礼貌地问道。

en: The police launched an inquiry into the accident.
His inquiry about the project deadline was met with silence.
Scientific inquiry relies on evidence and experimentation.
cn: 警方对事故展开调查。
他对项目截止日期的询问没有得到回应。
科学探究依赖于证据和实验。

en: The scientist studied the behavior of a rare insect species.
He felt like an insect under the scrutiny of the crowd.
Ants and bees are highly organized social insects.
cn: 科学家研究了一种稀有昆虫的行为。
在众人的审视下，他觉得自己渺小如虫。
蚂蚁和蜜蜂是高度组织化的社会性昆虫。

en: Please insert the key into the lock.
The magazine includes an insert with coupons.
You can insert a hyperlink in the document.
cn: 请将钥匙插入锁中。
杂志附有一张优惠券插页。
你可以在文档中插入超链接。

en: She left her keys inside the car.
The inside of the box was lined with velvet.
He knows the system from the inside.
cn: 她把钥匙落在车里了。
盒子内部衬着天鹅绒。
他深谙该系统的内部运作。
