en: She insisted on paying for the meal.
The doctor insisted that he quit smoking.
Despite the evidence, he insisted on his innocence.
cn: 她坚持要付这顿饭的钱。
医生坚决要求他戒烟。
尽管有证据，他仍坚称自己无罪。

en: The mechanic will inspect the car engine for any faults.
Health officials inspect restaurants to ensure hygiene standards.
She inspected the document carefully before signing.
cn: 机械师将检查汽车发动机是否有故障。
卫生官员视察餐厅以确保卫生标准。
她在签字前仔细审阅了文件。

en: The mechanic performed a thorough inspection of the car engine.
The building failed the safety inspection due to faulty wiring.
Regular inspections ensure food quality in restaurants.
cn: 机械师对汽车发动机进行了彻底检查。
该建筑因线路问题未通过安全检查。
定期检查保障餐厅食品质量。

en: The coach's speech inspired the team to win the championship.
The sunset over the ocean inspired her to write a poem.
Ancient philosophers believed gods inspired dreams.
cn: 教练的演讲激励队伍赢得了冠军。
海上的日落启发她写了一首诗。
古代哲学家认为神灵赋予了梦境灵感。

en: The technician will install the software tomorrow.
The bishop was installed in a grand ceremony.
They hired a team to install solar panels on the roof.
cn: 技术人员明天将安装该软件。
主教在盛大仪式中正式就职。
他们雇了一个团队在屋顶安装太阳能板。

en: The installation of the software took only five minutes.
Her art installation explores themes of memory and loss.
The formal installation of the new president will be held next week.
cn: 软件安装仅需五分钟。
她的艺术装置作品探讨记忆与失去的主题。
新总统的就职仪式将于下周举行。

en: This is a classic instance of cultural misunderstanding.
She instanced several cases to support her argument.
In this instance, we must act quickly.
cn: 这是文化误解的典型例子。
她列举了几个案例来支持自己的观点。
在这种情况下，我们必须迅速行动。

en: She felt instant relief after drinking the medicine.
The decision was made in an instant.
Instant coffee is convenient but lacks flavor.
cn: 服药后她立刻感到缓解。
决定在瞬间作出。
速溶咖啡方便但风味不足。

en: The app responds instantly to user commands.
She recognized him instantly despite the disguise.
The pain vanished instantly after taking the medicine.
cn: 这款应用会立即响应用户指令。
尽管他伪装了，她还是一眼认出了他。
服药后疼痛瞬间消失。

en: She chose tea instead of coffee.
The meeting was canceled, so we worked remotely instead.
If you lack butter, use oil instead.
cn: 她选了茶而不是咖啡。
会议取消，于是我们改为远程工作。
如果没有黄油，就用油代替。

en: Birds migrate by instinct.
Her instinct told her to avoid the dark alley.
The instinct for survival is strong in all animals.
cn: 鸟类靠本能迁徙。
她的直觉告诉她避开那条暗巷。
所有动物都有强烈的生存本能。

en: She works at a research institute focused on climate change.
The government plans to institute new policies to reduce pollution.
The institute was founded in 1901 to promote scientific education.
cn: 她在一家专注于气候变化的研究所工作。
政府计划制定新政策以减少污染。
该学院成立于1901年，旨在推动科学教育。

definitions.definition: 机构（如学校、医院等正式组织）
制度；惯例（长期建立的社会规范）

en: Harvard University is a prestigious institution of higher learning.
Democracy is a political institution that values citizen participation.
The institution of new safety protocols took three months.
cn: 哈佛大学是一所享誉盛名的高等教育机构。
民主是一种重视公民参与的政治制度。
新安全规程的设立耗时三个月。

definitions.definition: 指示；命令（正式或权威性要求）

en: The professor will instruct the students in advanced physics.
The manual instructs users to unplug the device before cleaning.
She was instructed to deliver the documents by noon.
cn: 教授将指导学生进修高等物理。
说明书指示用户在清洁前拔掉设备电源。
她接到指示必须在中午前送达文件。

definitions.definition: 指导；教学（具体指示或知识传授）

en: The manual provides clear instructions for assembly.
She followed the doctor's instructions carefully.
The CPU executes millions of instructions per second.
cn: 手册提供了清晰的组装指导。
她严格遵守医生的指示。
CPU每秒执行数百万条指令。

definitions.definition: 工具；仪器（用于科学或技术目的的设备）
乐器（用于演奏音乐的设备）
手段；媒介（达成目的的方式）

en: The microscope is an essential instrument for biologists.
She plays three musical instruments fluently.
Diplomacy is a powerful instrument of peace.
cn: 显微镜是生物学家的必备仪器。
她能熟练演奏三种乐器。
外交是维护和平的有力手段。

en: The evidence was deemed insufficient for a conviction.
His income is insufficient to cover basic expenses.
The team failed due to insufficient preparation.
cn: 证据被认为不足以定罪。
他的收入不足以支付基本开销。
团队因准备不足而失败。

en: His comment was a direct insult to her intelligence.
She felt deeply insulted by his rude behavior.
Never insult someone just to win an argument.
cn: 他的评论是对她智力的直接侮辱。
她因他的粗鲁行为感到深受冒犯。
永远不要为了赢得争论而侮辱他人。

definitions.definition: 保险（针对风险的经济保障制度）

en: She renewed her car insurance before the old policy expired.
Wearing a helmet is an insurance against head injuries.
The company offers health insurance to all full-time employees.
cn: 她在旧保单到期前续了车险。
佩戴头盔是预防头部受伤的安全措施。
该公司为所有全职员工提供健康保险。

en: She decided to insure her house against natural disasters.
Regular exercise can help insure good health.
The contract insures that both parties fulfill their obligations.
cn: 她决定为房屋投保以防范自然灾害。
定期锻炼有助于确保健康。
该合同确保双方履行义务。

en: She enjoys intellectual challenges like solving complex puzzles.
The conference attracted many leading intellectuals from around the world.
His approach to the problem was highly intellectual.
cn: 她喜欢解决复杂谜题这类智力挑战。
这场会议吸引了全球许多顶尖知识分子。
他处理这一问题的方式极具理性。

en: His intelligence and quick thinking saved the team.
The agency specializes in gathering military intelligence.
Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.
cn: 他的智慧和快速反应拯救了团队。
该机构专门收集军事情报。
人工智能正在改变许多行业。

en: She is highly intelligent and excels in problem-solving.
The new AI system is more intelligent than previous versions.
His intelligent questions revealed a deep understanding of the topic.
cn: 她非常聪明，擅长解决问题。
新的人工智能系统比之前的版本更智能。
他提出的睿智问题显示出对该主题的深刻理解。

en: She intends to study abroad next year.
The dark clouds intend rain.
How do you intend to solve this problem?
cn: 她打算明年出国留学。
乌云预示着要下雨。
你计划如何解决这个问题？

definitions.definition: 强烈的，极度的（指程度或情感）
紧张的，专注的（指状态或态度）

en: The intense sunlight made the sand too hot to walk on.
She has an intense passion for classical music.
His intense gaze made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
cn: 强烈的阳光让沙子烫得无法行走。
她对古典音乐怀有炽热的热爱。
他专注的凝视让房间里的人都不自在。

en: The intensity of the storm caused widespread damage.
She spoke with an intensity that captivated the audience.
Adjust the light intensity to reduce eye strain.
cn: 风暴的强度造成了广泛的破坏。
她讲话的强烈情感吸引了听众。
调节光线强度以减轻眼睛疲劳。

en: The hospital provides intensive care for critically ill patients.
She took an intensive Spanish course before her trip.
Intensive farming methods can harm the environment.
cn: 医院为重症患者提供强化护理。
她在旅行前参加了西班牙语强化课程。
集约化农业可能对环境造成危害。

en: She announced her intention to run for office.
The surgeon monitored the wound’s intention carefully.
His good intentions were misunderstood as interference.
cn: 她宣布了参选的意图。
外科医生密切观察伤口的愈合情况。
他的善意被误解为干涉。

en: The damage was clearly intentional, not an accident.
In criminal law, intentional acts carry heavier penalties.
She gave me an intentional smile before leaving.
cn: 破坏显然是故意的，而非意外。
刑法中，蓄意行为的处罚更重。
离开前，她刻意对我笑了笑。

en: The interaction between the teacher and students was lively during the debate.
Scientists study the interaction of particles in quantum physics.
Good social interaction skills are essential for teamwork.
cn: 辩论中师生互动热烈。
科学家研究量子物理中粒子的相互作用。
良好的社交互动技能对团队协作至关重要。

en: She has a keen interest in astronomy.
The bank offers a 5% interest rate on savings.
This project might interest potential investors.
cn: 她对天文学有浓厚的兴趣。
该银行提供5%的储蓄利率。
这个项目可能会吸引潜在投资者。

definitions.definition: 令人关注的，有吸引力的

en: The book contains many interesting facts about ancient cultures.
She has an interesting perspective on modern art.
The documentary was so interesting that I watched it twice.
cn: 这本书包含许多关于古代文化的有趣事实。
她对现代艺术有一个引人关注的观点。
这部纪录片太有趣了，我看了两遍。

definitions.definition: 妨碍，干扰（物理或抽象过程）

en: Don't interfere in matters that don't concern you.
The noise interfered with my concentration.
The two radio signals interfere, causing static.
cn: 不要干涉与你无关的事。
噪音干扰了我的注意力。
两个无线电信号相互干扰，产生杂音。

definitions.definition: 干涉，干扰（指介入或阻碍行为）
（物理）干涉（光波、声波等的叠加现象）

en: The noise caused interference with my concentration.
Light interference creates colorful patterns in soap bubbles.
The government denied any interference in the election.
cn: 噪音干扰了我的注意力。
光的干涉在肥皂泡上形成彩色图案。
政府否认对选举有任何干预。

en: The interior of the house was painted white.
She specializes in interior design.
The expedition explored the interior of the continent.
cn: 房子的内部被刷成了白色。
她专攻室内设计。
探险队考察了大陆的内陆地区。

en: She teaches intermediate French classes.
The UN acted as an intermediate in the peace talks.
Olive oil is an intermediate between fruit juice and vegetable oil.
cn: 她教授中级法语课程。
联合国在和平谈判中充当调解者。
橄榄油是果汁和植物油之间的中间产物。

en: The doctor checked for internal bleeding.
The company’s internal policies are strictly confidential.
The minister handles internal affairs of the country.
cn: 医生检查了是否有内出血。
公司的内部政策是严格保密的。
这位部长负责国家的内政事务。

en: The UN is an international organization dedicated to maintaining peace.
She won a gold medal in an international chess competition.
The company has offices in over 30 international locations.
cn: 联合国是一个致力于维护和平的国际组织。
她在国际象棋比赛中赢得了金牌。
该公司在30多个国际地区设有办事处。

en: The judge must interpret the law fairly.
She interpreted for the diplomat during the meeting.
His silence was interpreted as disapproval.
cn: 法官必须公正地解释法律。
她在会议中为外交官做口译。
他的沉默被解读为反对。

definitions.definition: 解释，阐明（对文本、行为等的理解）

en: His interpretation of the poem revealed hidden layers of meaning.
The violinist’s interpretation of the concerto was deeply emotional.
Legal documents often require careful interpretation to avoid misunderstandings.
cn: 他对这首诗的解读揭示了隐藏的多层含义。
小提琴家对协奏曲的演绎充满深情。
法律文件通常需要仔细解读以避免误解。

definitions.definition: 口译员（尤指职业的即时语言转换者）
解释者（对复杂信息进行说明的人或工具）

en: The UN interpreter translated the speech in real time.
Python acts as an interpreter for computer code.
She served as an interpreter between the two cultures.
cn: 联合国口译员实时翻译了演讲内容。
Python 充当计算机代码的解释器。
她成为两种文化之间的诠释者。

en: Please don’t interrupt me while I’m speaking.
The storm interrupted the power supply for hours.
He kept interrupting with irrelevant questions.
cn: 我说话时请不要打断我。
暴风雨中断了供电数小时。
他不断插嘴提出无关问题。

en: The loud noise caused an interruption in the meeting.
Power interruptions are common during storms.
She apologized for the interruption and continued her speech.
cn: 噪音打断了会议进程。
暴风雨期间停电很常见。
她为打断致歉，随后继续演讲。

definitions.definition: 间隔，间隙（时间或空间上的）

en: There was a long interval between the two acts of the play.
The runners started at five-minute intervals.
A perfect fifth is a musical interval with a specific frequency ratio.
cn: 戏剧两幕之间有很长的间隔。
跑步者每隔五分钟出发一批。
纯五度是具有特定频率比例的音程。

en: She has an interview for a teaching job tomorrow.
The journalist interviewed the president about climate change.
The book includes interviews with famous scientists.
cn: 她明天有一场教师职位的面试。
记者就气候变化问题采访了总统。
这本书收录了多位著名科学家的访谈。

en: They shared an intimate conversation by the fireplace.
The author intimates a deeper meaning behind the simple plot.
Her diary contained intimate details of her life.
cn: 他们在壁炉旁进行了一次亲密的交谈。
作者暗示了这个简单情节背后的深层含义。
她的日记记载了私密的生活细节。

en: She walked into the room quietly.
The project turned into a huge success.
He translated the poem into three languages.
cn: 她静静地走进房间。
这个项目最终取得了巨大成功。
他把这首诗翻译成了三种语言。

en: She introduced me to her colleagues at the party.
The company plans to introduce a new product line next year.
The professor introduced a groundbreaking theory in his lecture.
cn: 她在聚会上把我介绍给她的同事。
公司计划明年引入一条新的产品线。
教授在讲座中提出了一项开创性理论。

en: The book's introduction provides a clear overview of the main arguments.
She made a brief introduction before the speaker began.
The symphony opens with a slow introduction.
cn: 这本书的导论清晰概述了主要论点。
在演讲者开始前，她做了简短的介绍。
这首交响乐以一段缓慢的前奏开始。

en: The army decided to invade at dawn.
Tourists invade the small town every summer.
Don’t invade her privacy by reading her diary.
cn: 军队决定在黎明时分发动入侵。
每年夏天游客涌入这座小镇。
不要偷看她的日记侵犯她的隐私。

definitions.definition: 入侵，侵略（指军事或大规模强行进入）
侵扰，干扰（指对权利、隐私等的侵犯）

en: The invasion of the country sparked international condemnation.
Privacy invasion by social media is a growing concern.
The garden was overrun by an invasion of weeds.
cn: 该国遭到的入侵引发了国际社会的谴责。
社交媒体对隐私的侵扰日益引发担忧。
花园被杂草的肆虐所侵占。

definitions.definition: 发明；创造（新设备、方法等）

en: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb in 1879.
She invented an excuse to avoid the meeting.
The ancient Chinese invented paper over 2,000 years ago.
cn: 托马斯·爱迪生于1879年发明了电灯泡。
她编了个借口逃避会议。
中国古人在两千多年前发明了造纸术。

definitions.definition: 发明（指新设备、方法或过程的创造）
虚构（指编造的故事或谎言）

en: The invention of the telephone revolutionized communication.
His alibi was pure invention to avoid suspicion.
Many great inventions arise from simple ideas.
cn: 电话的发明彻底改变了通信方式。
他的不在场证明纯属虚构，只为逃避怀疑。
许多伟大的发明源于简单的想法。

en: Thomas Edison is celebrated as the inventor of the light bulb.
The young inventor showcased her robotic prototype at the science fair.
Every great inventor faces failures before achieving success.
cn: 托马斯·爱迪生被誉为电灯泡的发明者。
这位年轻的发明家在科学博览会上展示了她的机器人原型。
每位伟大的发明家在成功前都经历过失败。

definitions.definition: 投资（常与 in 连用）

en: She decided to invest her savings in renewable energy.
The king invested him with the title of Duke.
It's wise to invest in education early in life.
cn: 她决定将积蓄投资于可再生能源。
国王授予他公爵头衔。
年轻时投资教育是明智之举。

en: The police will investigate the crime scene thoroughly.
Scientists investigate the effects of climate change on coral reefs.
Journalists must investigate facts before publishing news.
cn: 警方将彻底调查犯罪现场。
科学家研究气候变化对珊瑚礁的影响。
记者发布新闻前必须核查事实。

definitions.definition: 调查，侦查（系统性研究或审查）
科学研究（学术或科学领域的详细分析）

en: The police launched an investigation into the fraud case.
Her research involves the investigation of marine ecosystems.
A thorough investigation revealed new evidence.
cn: 警方对诈骗案展开调查。
她的研究涉及对海洋生态系统的科学考察。
彻底调查后发现了新证据。

definitions.definition: 投资（金钱、时间、资源的投入以获取回报）
投资物（如股票、房地产等）

en: The company plans to increase its investment in renewable energy.
Education is the best investment for future success.
His investments in stocks yielded high returns last year.
cn: 该公司计划增加对可再生能源的投资。
教育是对未来成功的最佳投资。
他去年在股票上的投资获得了高回报。

definitions.definition: （统计、经济等）未被记录的；无形的

en: The spy used an invisible ink to write secret messages.
Microbes are invisible to the naked eye.
Tourism brings both visible and invisible benefits to the local economy.
cn: 间谍用隐形墨水书写密信。
微生物肉眼不可见。
旅游业为当地经济带来有形和无形的好处。

en: She received an invitation to the royal wedding.
The open door was an invitation to explore.
His speech ended with an invitation for questions.
cn: 她收到了一张皇家婚礼的邀请函。
敞开的门仿佛是对探索的无声诱惑。
他的演讲以邀请提问结束。

definitions.definition: 邀请；招致（某种反应或行为）

en: She invited me to her birthday party.
The open window invites a cool breeze.
His speech invited criticism from the audience.
cn: 她邀请我参加她的生日派对。
敞开的窗户引来一阵凉风。
他的演讲招致了观众的批评。

en: The project will involve multiple departments.
Don't involve me in your personal disputes.
Learning a language involves consistent practice.
cn: 该项目将涉及多个部门。
别把我卷入你的私人纠纷。
学习语言需要持续练习。

en: She turned her gaze inward to reflect on her emotions.
The door opens inward, so push gently.
His inward focus made him seem distant.
cn: 她将目光转向内心，反思自己的情绪。
门是向内开的，请轻推。
他对内在的关注让他显得疏离。

en: The bridge is reinforced with iron beams.
She ironed her shirt before the meeting.
Iron deficiency can cause health problems.
cn: 这座桥梁用铁梁加固。
她在会议前熨烫了衬衫。
缺铁可能导致健康问题。

definitions.definition: 不规则的；不整齐的；不合常规的

en: The coastline is irregular, with many small bays and peninsulas.
His attendance at work has been highly irregular this month.
The army recruited irregulars to supplement their forces.
cn: 海岸线曲折不规则，遍布小海湾和半岛。
他这个月的出勤情况极不稳定。
军队征募非正规军以补充兵力。

en: The island is famous for its volcanic landscapes.
They built a tiny island in the middle of the lake.
Iceland is called the "island of fire and ice".
cn: 这座岛屿以火山地貌闻名。
他们在湖心建造了一座人工小岛。
冰岛被称为"冰与火之岛"。

en: The scientist isolated the virus for further study.
Remote villages can feel extremely isolated in winter.
Patients with contagious diseases must be isolated.
cn: 科学家分离出病毒以进一步研究。
冬季时，偏远村庄会显得格外孤立。
传染病患者必须被隔离。

definitions.definition: 问题；争议；发行物（如期刊）

en: The magazine issues a new edition every month.
Pollution is a critical issue in urban areas.
Blood issued from the wound.
cn: 这本杂志每月发行一期。
污染是城市地区的重大问题。
鲜血从伤口流出。

definitions.definition: 它（指代无生命物体、动物或抽象概念）
用于指代不明性别的婴儿或未知身份的人

en: The book is on the table, but it is covered in dust.
The baby smiled when it saw its mother.
It is raining heavily outside.
cn: 这本书在桌上，但它覆满了灰尘。
婴儿看到母亲时笑了起来。
外面正下着大雨。

definitions.definition: 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的

en: She loves Italian cuisine, especially pasta and risotto.
He is fluent in Italian after living in Rome for five years.
The Italian team won the championship with outstanding teamwork.
cn: 她热爱意大利菜，尤其是意面和烩饭。
他在罗马生活五年后，意大利语已十分流利。
意大利队凭借出色的团队合作赢得了冠军。

definitions.definition: 项目；条款；一件商品（或物品）
同样地（用于列举，古用法）

en: Please check each item on the list carefully.
The first item on the agenda is the budget discussion.
cn: 请仔细核对清单上的每一项。
议程的第一项是预算讨论。

en: The cat licked its paws.
The tree lost its leaves in autumn.
The robot adjusted its speed automatically.
cn: 猫舔了它的爪子。
树在秋天掉光了它的叶子。
机器人自动调节了它的速度。

definitions.definition: 它自己（反身代词，强调主语或宾语的同一性）

en: The cat washed itself in the sunlight.
The device turns itself off after 10 minutes.
The problem resolved itself over time.
cn: 猫在阳光下给自己洗澡。
该设备会在10分钟后自动关闭。
问题随着时间自行解决了。

en: He wore a leather jacket to the concert.
The book's jacket had a striking design.
The pipe was wrapped in a protective jacket.
cn: 他穿了一件皮夹克去音乐会。
这本书的护封设计很醒目。
管道包裹着保护套。

en: He was sentenced to three years in jail.
The protesters were jailed for disturbing the peace.
The old jail has been turned into a museum.
cn: 他被判处三年监禁。
抗议者因扰乱治安被拘留。
这座旧监狱已被改造成博物馆。

en: She spread strawberry jam on her toast.
The traffic jam lasted for two hours.
Don’t jam all the clothes into one suitcase.
cn: 她在吐司上涂了草莓酱。
交通堵塞持续了两小时。
别把所有衣服硬塞进一个行李箱。

en: She will start her new job in January.
January is often the coldest month in this region.
The project deadline was extended to late January.
cn: 她将于一月开始新工作。
一月通常是该地区最冷的月份。
项目截止日期被延至一月底。

definitions.definition: 日本的；日本人的；日语的

en: She is studying Japanese culture and language.
The restaurant serves authentic Japanese cuisine.
Many Japanese traditions originate from ancient Shinto practices.
cn: 她正在研究日本文化和语言。
这家餐厅提供地道的日本料理。
许多日本传统源于古代神道教习俗。

en: She stored the cookies in a glass jar.
The loud noise jarred my nerves.
Their opinions jar with each other.
cn: 她把饼干存放在玻璃罐里。
刺耳的噪音让我心神不宁。
他们的观点相互冲突。

en: He clenched his jaw in determination.
The mechanic tightened the vise's jaw.
Stop jawing and get to work!
cn: 他咬紧牙关，下定决心。
机械师拧紧了虎钳的钳口。
别废话了，赶紧干活！

definitions.definition: 爵士乐（一种起源于美国黑人社区的音乐风格）

en: The bar downtown plays live jazz every Friday night.
cn: 市中心那家酒吧每周五晚上都有现场爵士乐演出。

definitions.definition: 嫉妒的（因害怕失去而愤恨）

en: She felt jealous when she saw her boyfriend talking to another girl.
The company is jealous of its trade secrets.
His jealous nature ruined their relationship.
cn: 她看到男友和另一个女孩说话时感到嫉妒。
这家公司对自己的商业机密严防死守。
他的猜忌天性毁了他们的关系。

en: The fighter jet soared across the sky at supersonic speed.
Water jetted out from the broken pipe, flooding the street.
She wore a necklace made of polished jet.
cn: 战斗机以超音速划过天空。
水从破裂的管道中喷出，淹没了街道。
她戴着一串打磨光滑的黑玉项链。

en: She wore a diamond jewel on her necklace.
His daughter is the jewel of his life.
The museum displayed ancient jewels from the royal family.
cn: 她项链上镶着一颗钻石珠宝。
女儿是他生命中的珍宝。
博物馆展出了皇室家族的古代珠宝。

en: She celebrates both Christmas and Hanukkah because of her Jewish heritage.
The museum exhibits artifacts from Jewish communities in medieval Europe.
His research focuses on Jewish philosophy in the 20th century.
cn: 她因犹太血统同时庆祝圣诞节和光明节。
该博物馆展出了中世纪欧洲犹太社区的文物。
他的研究聚焦于20世纪的犹太哲学。

en: She got a new job in a tech company.
He jobbed out the construction work to local contractors.
Finishing this report is my top priority job today.
cn: 她在一家科技公司找到了新工作。
他将建筑工程外包给了当地承包商。
完成这份报告是我今天的首要任务。

en: She decided to join the environmental club.
The two rivers join near the coastal city.
Use glue to join the broken pieces.
cn: 她决定加入环保俱乐部。
这两条河流在沿海城市附近交汇。
用胶水粘合断裂的碎片。

en: The doctor examined his knee joint after the injury.
They made a joint decision to start the project.
The carpenter used glue to joint the two pieces of wood.
cn: 医生在受伤后检查了他的膝关节。
他们共同决定启动这个项目。
木匠用胶水将两块木头接合在一起。

en: He told a funny joke at the party.
Don’t take it seriously—I was just joking.
Her jokes always lighten the mood.
cn: 他在聚会上讲了个有趣的笑话。
别当真，我只是在开玩笑。
她的玩笑总能活跃气氛。

en: The children were in a jolly mood after the party.
She jollied him into helping with the chores.
His jolly laughter filled the room.
cn: 孩子们在派对后心情愉快。
她哄得他帮忙做家务。
他爽朗的笑声充满了房间。

en: She kept a journal during her travels.
The research was published in a scientific journal.
The accountant updated the sales journal.
cn: 她在旅行期间坚持写日志。
这项研究发表在科学期刊上。
会计更新了销售流水账。

en: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new policy.
She aspired to become an investigative journalist.
The journalist’s article exposed corruption in the local government.
cn: 这名记者就新政策采访了市长。
她立志成为一名调查记者。
这位记者的文章揭露了地方政府的腐败。

en: The journey through the mountains took three days.
She journaled about her spiritual journey.
They journeyed across the desert by camel.
cn: 穿越群山的旅程花了三天时间。
她记录了自己的心灵历程。
他们骑着骆驼穿越沙漠。

en: Her face lit up with joy when she saw the surprise.
The children shouted for joy at the sight of the ice cream truck.
cn: 她的脸上因惊喜而焕发喜悦。
孩子们看到冰淇淋车时高兴得大叫。

en: The children's laughter made the atmosphere truly joyful.
She gave a joyful performance that moved the audience.
Spring is a joyful season of renewal.
cn: 孩子们的欢笑让氛围充满快乐。
她的表演充满喜悦，打动了观众。
春天是万物复苏的喜悦季节。

en: The judge sentenced the criminal to ten years in prison.
It's not fair to judge a book by its cover.
She will judge the competition based on creativity and skill.
cn: 法官判处罪犯十年监禁。
以貌取人是不公平的。
她将根据创意和技巧来评判比赛。

definitions.definition: 判断；裁决（法律或正式决定）

en: The court's judgement was finally delivered after months of deliberation.
She showed excellent judgement in choosing her business partners.
His harsh judgement of her work discouraged her creativity.
cn: 法院的裁决在数月审议后终于公布。
她在选择商业伙伴时展现出卓越的判断力。
他对她作品的苛刻评价打击了她的创造力。

en: She squeezed fresh orange juice for breakfast.
The steak was served with its natural juices.
He juiced the carrots to make a healthy drink.
cn: 她榨了新鲜橙汁当早餐。
牛排配着原汁端上桌。
他把胡萝卜榨汁做成健康饮品。

definitions.definition: 七月（格里高利历的第七个月份）

en: My birthday is in July.
July is usually the hottest month of the year.
The festival takes place every July.
cn: 我的生日在七月。
七月通常是一年中最热的月份。
这个节日每年七月举行。

en: The cat can jump onto the high wall.
Stock prices jumped after the announcement.
She skipped and jumped along the path.
cn: 这只猫能跳到高墙上。
公告发布后股价暴涨。
她沿着小路蹦蹦跳跳。

en: Schools usually close in late June.
We’re getting married next June.
June is the perfect time to visit the countryside.
cn: 学校通常在六月下旬放假。
我们明年六月结婚。
六月是游览乡村的最佳时节。

definitions.definition: 混乱复杂的环境（比喻义）

en: The explorers hacked their way through the dense jungle.
The city was a jungle of neon signs and crowded streets.
Corporate culture can sometimes feel like a jungle.
cn: 探险者在茂密的丛林中开辟道路。
这座城市是霓虹招牌和拥挤街道的丛林。
企业文化有时让人感觉像一片弱肉强食的丛林。

definitions.definition: 年少者；晚辈；低年级学生

en: She is three years junior to her brother.
He joined the company as a junior analyst.
The juniors organized a welcome party for the freshmen.
cn: 她比哥哥小三岁。
他以初级分析师的身份加入公司。
低年级学生为新生组织了欢迎会。

en: The jury reached a unanimous verdict after three days of deliberation.
She served on the jury for a high-profile criminal case.
The film won the special jury prize at the festival.
cn: 陪审团经过三天审议后达成一致裁决。
她在一起备受关注的刑事案件中担任陪审员。
这部电影获得了电影节的评审团特别奖。

en: The judge made a just decision.
She arrived just in time for the meeting.
It's just a small mistake; don't worry.
cn: 法官作出了公正的裁决。
她刚好准时赶到会议。
这只是个小错误，别担心。

en: The judge is known for his strict sense of justice.
The protesters demanded justice for the victims.
The justice system should treat everyone equally.
cn: 这位法官以严格的正义感闻名。
抗议者为受害者声张正义。
司法体系应平等对待每个人。

definitions.definition: 证明…正当（或有理）；为…辩护
【排版】调整（文本）对齐（如两端对齐）

en: The data does not justify such drastic measures.
She struggled to justify her decision to quit the job.
The text is fully justified on both sides.
cn: 这些数据不足以证明如此极端的措施是合理的。
她难以为自己辞职的决定辩解。
这段文字两端对齐。

definitions.definition: （价格）低廉的；锋利的（古义或方言）

en: She has a keen eye for detail.
The children were keen to start the adventure.
This knife has a keen edge.
cn: 她对细节有敏锐的洞察力。
孩子们迫不及待地想要开始冒险。
这把刀的刀刃非常锋利。（古义用法）

en: She keeps her room tidy.
Keep going, you're almost there!
The castle was once a royal keep.
cn: 她保持房间整洁。
继续前进，你快到了！
这座城堡曾是皇家要塞。

definitions.definition: 看守人；保管人（如博物馆、动物园的专职人员）
值得保留的事物（如“a real keeper”指珍贵的人或物）

en: The zookeeper feeds the lions twice a day.
He made a brilliant save as the team's keeper.
This vintage watch is a real keeper.
cn: 动物园管理员每天喂两次狮子。
作为守门员，他完成了一次精彩的扑救。
这块古董手表值得永久珍藏。

definitions.definition: 水壶（用于烧水的金属容器）
（地质学）壶穴（冰川形成的圆形洼地）

en: The kettle whistled when the water boiled.
She poured hot water from the kettle into the teapot.
Glacial kettles are common in this region.
cn: 水烧开时，水壶发出鸣笛声。
她将热水从水壶倒入茶壶。
该地区常见冰川壶穴。

definitions.definition: 钥匙；关键；答案；键（键盘/乐器）

en: She turned the key and opened the door.
Time management is the key to success.
He keyed in the password carefully.
cn: 她转动钥匙，打开了门。
时间管理是成功的关键。
他仔细地输入了密码。

definitions.definition: 键盘（乐器或计算机的输入设备）

en: She practiced scales on the piano keyboard for hours.
He keyboarded the report quickly despite the noisy office.
The ergonomic keyboard reduces wrist strain.
cn: 她在钢琴键盘上练习音阶数小时。
尽管办公室嘈杂，他仍快速用键盘输入了报告。
这款符合人体工学的键盘能减轻手腕压力。

en: He kicked the ball into the net.
She gave the door an angry kick.
I get a kick out of solving puzzles.
cn: 他将球踢进球网。
她生气地踢了一脚门。
我从解谜中获得乐趣。

en: She's just a kid, don't be too hard on her.
Stop kidding me—I know you're not serious.
The farmer raised goats and their kids.
cn: 她还只是个孩子，别对她太严厉。
别开玩笑了，我知道你不是认真的。
农夫饲养山羊和它们的小崽。

en: The hunter killed a wild boar with a single shot.
Too much stress can kill your motivation.
The committee decided to kill the controversial proposal.
cn: 猎人一枪击杀了一头野猪。
过度压力会扼杀你的动力。
委员会决定否决这项有争议的提案。

definitions.definition: 千克，公斤（国际单位制中的质量基本单位）

en: The package weighs exactly one kilogram.
Scientists use kilograms to measure mass in experiments.
A liter of water has a mass of about one kilogram at room temperature.
cn: 这个包裹正好重一公斤。
科学家用千克作为实验中的质量单位。
在室温下，一升水的质量约为一公斤。

definitions.definition: 千米，公里（长度单位，等于1000米）

en: The marathon is 42.195 kilometers long.
Light travels approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
The mountain peak rises 3 kilometers above sea level.
cn: 马拉松全长42.195公里。
光速约为每秒30万千米。
这座山峰海拔3千米。

en: She has a kind heart and always helps strangers.
This kind of plant only grows in tropical climates.
Be kind to yourself when facing failures.
cn: 她心地善良，总是帮助陌生人。
这种植物只生长在热带气候中。
面对失败时，对自己宽容些。

en: Her kindness to stray animals moved everyone in the neighborhood.
Small acts of kindness can brighten someone's day.
He thanked them for their kindness during his illness.
cn: 她对流浪动物的善意感动了整个社区的人。
微小的善举能点亮他人的一天。
他感谢他们在他生病期间的关怀。

definitions.definition: （某领域）巨头，王者（如 "the king of pop"）

en: The king addressed his people from the palace balcony.
Elvis Presley is often called the King of Rock and Roll.
In chess, protecting your king is the ultimate goal.
cn: 国王从宫殿阳台上向民众发表讲话。
埃尔维斯·普雷斯利常被称为摇滚之王。
国际象棋中，保护国王是终极目标。

definitions.definition: 王国（由国王或女王统治的国家）
（生物分类学中的）界（如动物界、植物界）

en: The United Kingdom consists of four countries.
Lions are often called the kings of the animal kingdom.
Medieval kingdoms relied heavily on agriculture.
cn: 联合王国由四个国家组成。
狮子常被称为动物界的王者。
中世纪的王国高度依赖农业。

en: She gave him a gentle kiss on the forehead.
The breeze kissed the surface of the lake.
In many cultures, a kiss symbolizes love or respect.
cn: 她轻轻吻了他的额头。
微风轻拂过湖面。
在许多文化中，吻象征爱或敬意。

definitions.definition: 厨房（用于烹饪和储存食物的房间）

en: She baked a cake in the kitchen.
The kitchen was filled with the smell of garlic.
Modern kitchens often have stainless steel appliances.
cn: 她在厨房里烤了一个蛋糕。
厨房里弥漫着大蒜的香气。
现代厨房通常配备不锈钢电器。

definitions.definition: 使用空头支票诈骗；使（物价等）上升

en: The children flew a colorful kite at the beach.
A red kite circled high above the field.
He was arrested for kiting checks between banks.
cn: 孩子们在海边放了一只色彩斑斓的风筝。
一只红鸢在田野上空盘旋。
他因在银行间空头支票诈骗被捕。

en: She fell and scraped her knee.
He kneed the attacker in the stomach.
The baby crawled on hands and knees.
cn: 她摔倒擦伤了膝盖。
他用膝盖顶撞攻击者的腹部。
婴儿用双手和膝盖爬行。

en: She knelt down to pray in the quiet chapel.
The knight knelt before the queen to swear loyalty.
He knelt to tie his shoelaces, ignoring the muddy ground.
cn: 她跪在小教堂里安静地祈祷。
骑士跪在女王面前宣誓效忠。
他跪在泥泞的地上系鞋带，毫不在意。

en: He sharpened the knife before slicing the vegetables.
The detective found a bloody knife at the crime scene.
Be careful not to knife yourself while opening the package.
cn: 他在切蔬菜前磨了刀。
侦探在犯罪现场发现了一把带血的刀。
拆包裹时小心别割伤自己。

definitions.definition: 编织（用针线或机器将线或纱制成衣物）
紧密结合；愈合（如骨折后）

en: She learned to knit scarves for her family.
The broken bones knit together faster than expected.
Shared experiences knit the community closely.
cn: 她学会了为家人织围巾。
骨折的愈合速度比预期更快。
共同的经历使社区紧密联结。

en: She turned the knob to open the door.
The cabinet has brass knobs for decoration.
cn: 她转动把手打开了门。
橱柜配有黄铜旋钮作为装饰。

en: She knocked gently on the door before entering.
The sudden knock startled everyone in the room.
I heard three distinct knocks coming from the attic.
cn: 她进门前轻轻敲了敲门。
突然的敲门声吓到了房间里所有人。
我听到阁楼传来三下清晰的敲击声。

en: She tied the rope in a tight knot.
The traffic was a knot of cars and buses.
His stomach knotted with anxiety.
cn: 她把绳子打了个紧紧的结。
交通堵成了汽车和公交车的死结。
他的胃因焦虑而揪紧。

en: She knows how to solve this problem.
Do you know the answer?
I’ve known him since childhood.
cn: 她知道如何解决这个问题。
你知道答案吗？
我从小就认识他。

en: Scientific knowledge continues to advance rapidly.
She has a deep knowledge of medieval history.
The book provides practical knowledge for beginners.
cn: 科学知识持续快速发展。
她对中世纪历史有深厚的学识。
这本书为初学者提供实用知识。

definitions.definition: 拉布拉多犬（Labrador retriever 的缩写）

en: She spent all night in the lab analyzing the data.
The tech company built a new AI lab in Berlin.
His black Lab loves playing fetch at the park.
cn: 她整晚待在实验室分析数据。
这家科技公司在柏林新建了一个人工智能实验室。
他的黑色拉布拉多犬喜欢在公园玩接球游戏。

en: The bottle has a label with ingredients listed.
She was unfairly labeled as a troublemaker.
Always check the care label before washing clothes.
cn: 瓶子上贴有成分标签。
她被不公平地归类为麻烦制造者。
洗涤衣物前务必查看护理标签。

definitions.definition: 实验室（用于科学研究或实验的场所）
制药厂（尤指生产药品的设施）

en: The new drug was tested in a high-security laboratory.
She spends long hours in the laboratory analyzing soil samples.
The university invested millions to upgrade its chemistry laboratory.
cn: 这种新药在一个高安全性实验室中进行了测试。
她长时间待在实验室里分析土壤样本。
该大学投资数百万升级化学实验室。

en: Manual labour is essential for building infrastructure.
She laboured for years to perfect her craft.
The party promised to protect workers' labour rights.
cn: 体力劳动对基础设施建设至关重要。
她多年来苦心钻研以精进技艺。
该政党承诺保障劳动者的权利。

definitions.definition: 用花边装饰；系紧（鞋带等）

en: Her wedding dress was trimmed with delicate lace.
He stopped to lace up his muddy boots.
The antique tablecloth features handmade Venetian lace.
cn: 她的婚纱饰有精美的蕾丝花边。
他停下来系紧沾满泥巴的靴子。
这条古董桌布以手工威尼斯蕾丝为特色。

en: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
She lacks confidence in public speaking.
There is no lack of opportunities in this field.
cn: 该项目因资金不足而失败。
她在公开演讲中缺乏自信。
这一领域并不缺乏机会。

en: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
Hard work is the ladder to success.
Her stockings laddered when she caught them on a nail.
cn: 他爬上梯子修理屋顶。
努力是通往成功的阶梯。
她的长袜钩到钉子后抽丝了。

definitions.definition: 女士，夫人（对女性的尊称）

en: The lady greeted her guests with a warm smile.
She was appointed a Lady of the British Empire for her charitable work.
In medieval times, a lady often managed the household while the lord was away.
cn: 这位女士以温暖的微笑迎接客人。
她因慈善工作被授予大英帝国女爵勋章。
中世纪时，领主外出时，女领主常负责管理家务。

en: The slow hiker began to lag behind the group.
There's a time lag between data collection and analysis.
Economic growth tends to lag during recessions.
cn: 那位慢速的徒步者开始落后于队伍。
数据收集与分析之间存在时间差。
经济衰退期间，增长往往会滞后。

en: We went fishing on the tranquil lake at dawn.
Lake Superior is the largest freshwater lake in the world by surface area.
The children skipped stones across the glassy surface of the lake.
cn: 我们在黎明时分去宁静的湖上钓鱼。
苏必利尔湖是世界表面积最大的淡水湖。
孩子们在如镜的湖面上打水漂。

en: The shepherd carried the lost lamb back to its mother.
She cooked rosemary lamb for the dinner party.
Despite his fierce appearance, he's a real lamb at heart.
cn: 牧羊人把迷路的小羊羔送回了母羊身边。
她为晚宴烹制了迷迭香烤羔羊肉。
尽管外表凶悍，他内心其实非常温顺。

definitions.definition: （借口、解释等）站不住脚的，无说服力的

en: The lame dog struggled to climb the stairs.
His apology sounded lame and insincere.
The accident lamed her permanently.
cn: 那只跛脚的狗艰难地爬楼梯。
他的道歉听起来站不住脚且缺乏诚意。
那次事故使她终身残疾。

en: She switched on the lamp to read her book.
The old oil lamp flickered in the wind.
His ideas lamped the path to scientific discovery.
cn: 她打开灯阅读书籍。
那盏旧油灯在风中闪烁不定。
他的思想照亮了科学发现之路。（诗用语）

en: The plane will land in ten minutes.
This fertile land produces abundant crops.
She dreams of owning land in the countryside.
cn: 飞机将在十分钟后降落。
这片肥沃的土地出产丰富的农作物。
她梦想在乡村拥有自己的土地。

en: The airplane made a smooth landing despite the storm.
She waited for me at the landing between the two flights of stairs.
The lunar landing was a historic achievement for mankind.
cn: 尽管有暴风雨，飞机仍平稳着陆。
她在两段楼梯间的平台处等我。
登月是人类的历史性成就。

en: The landlady raised the rent by 10% this year.
She became a landlady after inheriting her family's estate.
Our landlady is very strict about noise after 10 PM.
cn: 女房东今年将租金提高了10%。
继承家族地产后，她成为了一名女地主。
我们的女房东对晚上10点后的噪音非常严格。

en: The landlord raised the rent by 10% this year.
Medieval landlords often held judicial power over their tenants.
She complained to the landlord about the broken heater.
cn: 房东今年将租金提高了10%。
中世纪的领主常对佃户行使司法权。
她向房东投诉暖气坏了。

en: The car swerved into the opposite lane.
She lives in a quiet lane behind the market.
The runner stayed in his lane throughout the race.
cn: 车辆突然驶入对向车道。
她住在市场后一条安静的小巷里。
这名选手全程保持在自己的跑道分道内。

definitions.definition: 语言（人类交流的符号系统）
表达方式（如肢体语言、编程语言）

en: English is a global language of business.
Body language can reveal true emotions.
Python is a programming language known for its simplicity.
cn: 英语是国际商务的通用语言。
肢体语言能泄露真实情绪。
Python是一种以简洁著称的编程语言。

en: The paper lantern glowed softly in the garden.
Sailors relied on the lighthouse lantern to navigate safely.
She carried a lantern to light her path through the forest.
cn: 纸灯笼在花园里柔和地发光。
水手们依靠灯塔的灯光安全航行。
她提着一盏灯笼照亮穿越森林的小路。

definitions.definition: 大腿上部（坐姿时）；(跑道的)一圈；重叠部分

en: The cat curled up on her lap.
He finished the race three laps ahead.
Waves lapped gently against the boat.
cn: 猫蜷缩在她的膝上。
他以领先三圈的成绩完成比赛。
波浪轻轻拍打着小船。

en: She lives in a large house with a beautiful garden.
The project requires a large amount of funding.
His influence on the field is large and lasting.
cn: 她住在一栋带漂亮花园的大房子里。
该项目需要大量资金。
他在该领域的影响广泛而持久。

en: The success of the project was largely due to teamwork.
The region is largely covered by forests.
His arguments were largely ignored by the committee.
cn: 该项目的成功主要归功于团队合作。
该地区大部分被森林覆盖。
他的论点很大程度上被委员会忽视了。

definitions.definition: 激光（通过受激辐射产生的高强度光束）
激光器（产生激光的装置）

en: The surgeon used a laser to remove the tumor precisely.
Laser pointers are banned in some public places for safety reasons.
This cutting-edge laser technology can transmit data at incredible speeds.
cn: 外科医生用激光精准切除了肿瘤。
出于安全考虑，激光笔在某些公共场所被禁止使用。
这项尖端激光技术能以惊人速度传输数据。

en: This is the last page of the book.
The meeting lasted for three hours.
She was the last to leave the room.
cn: 这是这本书的最后一页。
会议持续了三个小时。
她是最后一个离开房间的人。

en: She apologized for being late to the meeting.
The late scientist’s work revolutionized the field.
Flowers bloomed late this year due to the cold spring.
cn: 她为开会迟到道歉。
这位已故科学家的研究彻底改变了该领域。
由于春季寒冷，今年花开得晚。

en: Have you seen any good movies lately?
She seems tired lately, maybe because of work pressure.
Lately, the weather has been unpredictable.
cn: 你最近看过什么好电影吗？
她近来显得疲惫，可能是工作压力所致。
最近天气一直难以预测。

en: She arrived later than expected.
We can discuss this matter later.
The later chapters of the book are more philosophical.
cn: 她比预期到得更晚。
我们可以稍后再讨论这件事。
这本书的后几章更具哲学性。

definitions.definition: 拉丁语（古罗马语言）；拉丁人

en: Latin is the root of many modern European languages.
She studied Latin literature in college.
The festival celebrates Latin music and dance.
cn: 拉丁语是许多现代欧洲语言的根源。
她在大学学习了拉丁文学。
这个节日庆祝拉丁音乐与舞蹈。

en: Between tea and coffee, I prefer the latter.
The latter half of the film was more exciting.
John and Mary arrived together; the latter was carrying a gift.
cn: 在茶和咖啡之间，我更喜欢后者。
电影的后半部分更精彩。
约翰和玛丽一起来了，后者带了一份礼物。

en: She couldn't help but laugh at his joke.
His loud laugh echoed through the room.
Laughing together strengthens friendships.
cn: 她忍不住被他的笑话逗笑了。
他响亮的笑声在房间里回荡。
一起欢笑能增进友谊。

en: Her contagious laughter filled the room.
The children burst into laughter at the clown’s antics.
There was a moment of awkward silence before nervous laughter broke out.
cn: 她的笑声富有感染力，充满了整个房间。
小丑的滑稽动作让孩子们爆发出一阵笑声。
尴尬的沉默后，响起了紧张的笑声。

en: The company will launch a new product next month.
NASA successfully launched the spacecraft into orbit.
The ceremony marked the launch of the luxury cruise ship.
cn: 该公司下月将发布一款新产品。
美国宇航局成功将航天器发射入轨。
仪式标志着这艘豪华游轮的下水。

en: She sorted the laundry into whites and colors before washing.
The hotel offers same-day laundry service for guests.
He forgot to pick up his laundry from the cleaner's.
cn: 她在洗衣前将衣物按白色和彩色分类。
酒店为客人提供当日洗衣服务。
他忘了去洗衣店取回衣物。

en: The lavatory on this floor is currently out of order.
cn: 这层的厕所目前无法使用。

definitions.definition: 法律（由权威制定的规则体系）
规律（自然或科学中的普遍原则）

en: Breaking the law may result in severe penalties.
Newton's laws of motion are fundamental to physics.
The company operates within the law.
cn: 违反法律可能导致严厉的惩罚。
牛顿运动定律是物理学的基础。
这家公司在法律框架内运营。

en: The children are playing on the lawn.
She mows the lawn every weekend.
The hotel has a beautiful lawn by the lake.
cn: 孩子们正在草坪上玩耍。
她每周末修剪草坪。
酒店湖边有一片美丽的草坪。

en: She hired a lawyer to handle the contract dispute.
The lawyer presented compelling evidence in court.
Becoming a lawyer requires years of rigorous study.
cn: 她聘请了一位律师处理合同纠纷。
律师在法庭上提出了有力的证据。
成为一名律师需要多年刻苦学习。

en: She lay the book on the table gently.
The hen lays eggs every morning.
His explanation was clear even to lay audiences.
cn: 她轻轻地把书放在桌上。
这只母鸡每天早晨下蛋。
他的解释连外行听众也能听懂。

en: The cake has a thick layer of chocolate frosting.
She carefully layered the clothes in her suitcase.
The archaeologist uncovered a layer of ancient pottery.
cn: 蛋糕上有一层厚厚的巧克力糖霜。
她将衣服分层叠放在行李箱中。
考古学家发掘出一层古代陶器。

definitions.definition: 布局；安排；设计（尤指平面或空间的规划）

en: The magazine's layout is clean and modern.
She sketched a rough layout of the office space.
The website layout needs to be more user-friendly.
cn: 这本杂志的版面设计简洁而现代。
她画了一张办公室空间的粗略布局图。
这个网页布局需要更加用户友好。

definitions.definition: 缓慢的，懒散的（如动作或节奏）

en: He was too lazy to clean his room.
The cat stretched in a lazy arc under the sunlight.
A lazy river meandered through the valley.
cn: 他懒得打扫房间。
那只猫在阳光下懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰。
一条水流缓慢的河蜿蜒穿过山谷。

en: She will lead the team to complete the project.
The guide leads visitors through the museum.
Lead pipes were commonly used in ancient Rome.
cn: 她将带领团队完成项目。
导游引导游客参观博物馆。
铅管在古罗马被广泛使用。

en: She was elected leader of the opposition party.
The runner maintained his position as the leader throughout the race.
A good leader inspires others to take initiative.
cn: 她被选为反对党领袖。
这位跑步者在整场比赛中保持领先。
优秀的领导者能激励他人主动行动。

en: Her leadership inspired the team to achieve the impossible.
The company lacks strong leadership during the crisis.
Effective leadership requires both vision and empathy.
cn: 她的领导力激励团队完成了不可能的任务。
危机期间，该公司缺乏强有力的领导层。
高效的领导力需要远见与同理心。

en: She holds a leading position in the company.
The leading candidate is expected to win the election.
His research is in the leading edge of technology.
cn: 她在公司担任领导职位。
领先的候选人有望赢得选举。
他的研究处于技术前沿。

definitions.definition: 叶子（植物的扁平绿色部分）

en: The maple leaf turns red in autumn.
She carefully turned the leaf of the ancient manuscript.
The trees are just beginning to leaf out after winter.
cn: 枫叶在秋天变红。
她轻轻翻动古籍的书页。
树木在冬季过后刚刚开始长出新叶。

en: The two companies formed a league to promote sustainable energy.
She plays tennis in a junior league.
Their skills put them in a different league altogether.
cn: 两家公司结成联盟以推广可持续能源。
她在青少年联赛中打网球。
他们的技术使其完全处于不同水平。

en: The roof has a leak after the heavy rain.
Confidential documents leaked to the press.
Water leaked slowly from the cracked pipe.
cn: 大雨后屋顶出现了漏点。
机密文件泄露给了媒体。
水从裂缝的管道中缓缓渗出。

en: She leaned against the wall, exhausted.
The athlete has a lean and muscular build.
The company adopted a lean management approach.
cn: 她疲惫地靠在墙上。
这位运动员身材精瘦且肌肉发达。
该公司采用了精简管理模式。

en: The deer leaped over the fence effortlessly.
Her heart leaped with joy when she heard the news.
The company's profits took a huge leap last quarter.
cn: 鹿轻松跃过围栏。
听到消息时，她的心因喜悦而狂跳。
该公司上季度利润大幅增长。

en: Children learn languages more easily than adults.
She learned about the accident from the news.
He is learning to play the piano.
cn: 儿童比成年人更容易学习语言。
她从新闻中得知了这起事故。
他正在学习弹钢琴。

definitions.definition: 学术性的（指著作或领域）

en: She is a learned professor who has published dozens of papers.
The book is written in a learned style, full of technical terms.
His learned opinions on history are highly respected.
cn: 她是一位博学的教授，已发表数十篇论文。
这本书以学术风格写成，充满专业术语。
他关于历史的渊博观点备受尊敬。

en: Continuous learning is essential for career growth.
Her research contributes to machine learning advancements.
Traditional learning methods are evolving with technology.
cn: 持续学习对职业发展至关重要。
她的研究推动了机器学习的进步。
传统学习方法正随技术发展而革新。

en: This is the least expensive option in the store.
She wasn't least bit surprised by the news.
Of all the candidates, he contributed least to the project.
cn: 这是店里最便宜的选项。
她对这消息丝毫不感到惊讶。
在所有候选人中，他对项目的贡献最少。

definitions.definition: 用皮革覆盖；鞭打（古旧用法）

en: The jacket is made of genuine leather.
Ancient Egyptians used leather for writing scrolls.
He leathered the ball across the field with a powerful kick.
cn: 这件夹克是真皮制成的。
古埃及人用皮革制作书写卷轴。
他一记猛踢将球抽过球场。（古旧用法）

en: She will leave for Paris tomorrow.
Don't leave your keys on the table.
He requested a leave of absence.
cn: 她明天将动身前往巴黎。

cn: 当地政府宣布了支持小型企业的新政策。
她更喜欢购买本地农产品以减少环境影响。
作为当地人，他知道这座城市里所有不为人知的好地方。

definitions.definition: 确定…的位置；将…安置在（某处）

en: The app can locate the nearest gas station.
The company decided to locate its headquarters in Berlin.
Archaeologists are trying to locate the ancient ruins.
cn: 这款应用能定位最近的加油站。
公司决定将总部设在柏林。
考古学家正试图确定古遗址的位置。

en: The exact location of the treasure remains unknown.
The film crew moved to a remote location for shooting.
This app helps you share your live location with friends.
cn: 宝藏的具体位置仍未知。
剧组转移到偏远地区进行拍摄。
这款应用可帮助你实时共享位置给朋友。

en: She turned the key and heard the lock click.
The ship passed through the canal lock smoothly.
His hair fell in messy locks over his forehead.
cn: 她转动钥匙，听到锁咔嗒一声。
船只平稳地通过了运河船闸。
他的头发乱蓬蓬地垂在额前。

en: The steam locomotive revolutionized transportation in the 19th century.
Locomotive power is essential for heavy freight trains.
Cheetahs have remarkable locomotive abilities.
cn: 蒸汽机车在19世纪彻底改变了交通运输。
机车动力对重型货运列车至关重要。
猎豹拥有非凡的运动能力。

definitions.definition: 小屋；门房；分会所（如共济会）
暂住；正式提出（投诉等）；固定（某物）

en: We stayed at a hunting lodge in the mountains.
The bullet lodged in the wall, narrowly missing him.
He decided to lodge a complaint with the manager.
cn: 我们住在山间的一处狩猎小屋。
子弹嵌进墙壁，险些击中他。
他决定向经理正式投诉。

en: The cabin was built from pine logs.
The captain entered the details in the ship's log.
The system automatically logs all user activity.
cn: 小屋由松木原木搭建而成。
船长将细节录入航海日志。
系统自动记录所有用户活动。

definitions.definition: 逻辑；逻辑学；合理的推理

en: His argument lacks basic logic.
The detective used pure logic to solve the case.
Programming requires both creativity and logic.
cn: 他的论点缺乏基本逻辑。
侦探仅凭逻辑推理破解了案件。
编程需要创造力与逻辑兼备。

en: His argument was clear and logical.
It's logical to assume she'll be promoted.
The detective used logical reasoning to solve the case.
cn: 他的论点清晰且合乎逻辑。
认为她会升职是合理的推断。
侦探用逻辑推理破解了案件。

en: She felt lonely after moving to a new city.
The cabin stood in a lonely valley.
His lonely childhood shaped his introverted personality.
cn: 搬到一个新城市后，她感到孤独。
小屋坐落在一个人迹罕至的山谷中。
他孤独的童年塑造了他内向的性格。

en: The river is too long to cross by swimming.
She longed for a chance to travel abroad.
How long will the meeting last?
cn: 这条河太长，无法游泳横渡。
她渴望有机会出国旅行。
会议要开多久？

en: She looked out the window and sighed.
The old house has a mysterious look.
Look before you leap.
cn: 她望着窗外叹了口气。
这座老房子有种神秘的外观。
三思而后行。（谚语）

en: She tied the rope into a loop.
The program runs in an endless loop.
The road loops around the mountain.
cn: 她把绳子打成一个环。
程序陷入无限循环。
这条路环绕着山蜿蜒而行。

en: The screw became loose after months of vibration.
She wore a loose dress to stay comfortable in the heat.
The hunter decided to loose the arrow at dawn.
cn: 螺丝因数月震动变松了。
她穿着宽松连衣裙以在酷热中保持舒适。
猎人决定在黎明时分射出箭矢。

en: She loosened the knot carefully.
The government plans to loosen immigration rules.
His grip loosened as he fell asleep.
cn: 她小心地解开了绳结。
政府计划放宽移民政策。
他睡着时，手松开了。

en: The lord of the castle granted lands to his loyal knights.
"Good Lord!" she exclaimed when she saw the accident.
In medieval times, to lord over others was a sign of nobility.
cn: 城堡领主将土地赐予忠诚的骑士。
“天啊！”看到事故时她惊呼道。
中世纪时，支配他人是贵族身份的象征。

definitions.definition: 卡车；货运汽车（主要用于英式英语）
（铁路上运送重物的）平板四轮车

en: The delivery was delayed because the lorry had broken down on the motorway.
He drives a heavy goods lorry for a living.
The army used lorries to transport supplies to the base.
cn: 由于卡车在高速公路上抛锚，送货被延迟了。
他以驾驶重型货物卡车为生。
军队用卡车将补给品运送到基地。

en: Don't lose your keys again.
Our team never loses hope.
She hates to lose arguments.
cn: 别再弄丢你的钥匙了。
我们的团队从不放弃希望。
她讨厌在争论中落败。

en: The loss of her passport caused a delay.
The team faced three losses in a row.
Grief is a natural response to loss.
cn: 她的护照丢失导致了延误。
这支队伍遭遇了三连败。
悲伤是对失去的自然反应。

en: She bought a lot of books at the sale.
They drew lots to decide who would go first.
The vacant lot will be turned into a park.
cn: 她在促销时买了很多书。
他们抽签决定谁先出发。
这块空地将被改造成公园。

en: The music was so loud that the neighbors complained.
She wore a loud dress covered in bright flowers.
His loud laughter echoed through the hallway.
cn: 音乐声太大，邻居们抱怨不已。
她穿了一条印满鲜艳花朵的扎眼连衣裙。
他响亮的笑声在走廊里回荡。

definitions.definition: 扩音器，扬声器（将电信号转换为声音的设备）

en: The loudspeaker announced the arrival of the next train.
She tested the loudspeaker by playing a short melody.
Protesters used loudspeakers to amplify their voices.
cn: 扩音器播报了下一班列车的到站信息。
她通过播放一段旋律测试扬声器。
抗议者用扩音器放大他们的声音。

en: She expressed her love for music through piano performances.
True love requires understanding and patience.
They fell in love at first sight during the trip.
cn: 她通过钢琴演奏表达对音乐的热爱。
真爱需要理解与耐心。
他们在旅途中一见钟情。

en: She wore a lovely dress to the party.
The garden looks lovely in spring.
What a lovely surprise to see you here!
cn: 她穿了一条漂亮的裙子参加派对。
春天时花园看起来非常美丽。
在这里见到你真是令人愉快的惊喜！

definitions.definition: 爱好者（如艺术、音乐的狂热爱好者）

en: He wrote a letter to his secret lover.
She is a passionate lover of classical music.
The novel depicts a tragic love story between two young lovers.
cn: 他给秘密恋人写了一封信。
她是一位狂热的古典音乐爱好者。
小说描绘了一对年轻恋人的悲剧爱情故事。

en: The airplane flew at a low altitude.
Her voice was so low that I could barely hear her.
The company's profits hit a new low this year.
cn: 飞机在低空飞行。
她的声音很轻，我几乎听不见。
公司利润今年跌至新低。

en: The lower shelf is easier for children to reach.
He lowered his voice to avoid being overheard.
Temperatures will lower significantly tonight.
cn: 较低的架子更容易让孩子们够到。
他压低声音以防被偷听。
今晚气温将明显下降。

en: The dog remained loyal to its owner until the end.
She is a loyal supporter of environmental causes.
Despite the challenges, he stayed loyal to his principles.
cn: 这只狗对主人忠诚至死。
她是环保事业的坚定支持者。
尽管面临挑战，他仍坚守自己的原则。

definitions.definition: （对组织、原则或人的）忠实行为

en: His loyalty to the company never wavered, even during difficult times.
Dogs are often praised for their unconditional loyalty to their owners.
She questioned the loyalty of friends who left when she needed them most.
cn: 他对公司的忠诚从未动摇，即使在困难时期。
狗常因对主人无条件的忠诚而受到称赞。
她质疑那些在她最需要时离开的朋友的忠诚。

definitions.definition: 运气（尤指偶然的机遇或成功）

en: She attributed her success to pure luck.
With any luck, we'll arrive before dark.
Bad luck seems to follow him everywhere.
cn: 她将成功归因于纯粹的运气。
如果运气好，我们能在天黑前到达。
厄运似乎如影随形地跟着他。

definitions.definition: 带来好运的（如 lucky charm）

en: She was lucky to find a parking spot in the crowded city.
This rabbit’s foot is my lucky charm.
It’s lucky that we brought umbrellas—it just started raining!
cn: 她在拥挤的城市里幸运地找到了停车位。
这只兔脚是我的幸运物。
幸好我们带了伞——突然下雨了！

definitions.definition: 行李（尤指旅行时携带的箱包等物品）

en: Please ensure your luggage is properly labeled before checking in.
The airline allows each passenger one piece of carry-on luggage.
We stored our luggage at the station while exploring the city.
cn: 请在托运前确保行李贴好标签。
该航空公司允许每位乘客携带一件随身行李。
我们在游览城市时将行李存放在车站。

en: The truck was loaded with fresh lumber for construction.
A bear lumbered through the forest, shaking the undergrowth.
Her tiny apartment was lumbered with old furniture.
cn: 卡车上装满了用于建筑的新木材。
一只熊笨重地穿过森林，摇晃着灌木丛。
她的小公寓堆满了旧家具。

definitions.definition: 将…归并在一起；笨重地移动

en: She found a lump of clay in the garden.
The doctor checked the lump on his neck.
They lumped all the expenses into one bill.
cn: 她在花园里发现了一块黏土。
医生检查了他脖子上的肿块。
他们将所有费用合并到一张账单里。

en: Let's meet for lunch at noon.
She packed a healthy lunch for her son.
We lunched at a cozy café downtown.
cn: 我们中午一起吃午餐吧。
她给儿子准备了一份健康的午餐。
我们在市中心一家舒适的咖啡馆吃了午餐。

en: Smoking can severely damage your lungs.
The doctor listened to her lungs with a stethoscope.
Dolphins have powerful lungs for diving deep underwater.
cn: 吸烟会严重损害你的肺部。
医生用听诊器检查她的肺部。
海豚拥有强健的肺以适应深潜。

en: She lives in a world of luxury and comfort.
The hotel offers luxury accommodations with ocean views.
For some, time is the ultimate luxury.
cn: 她生活在奢华舒适的世界中。
这家酒店提供带海景的豪华住宿。
对某些人而言，时间才是终极奢侈品。

en: The factory uses advanced machines to assemble cars.
She learned how to machine metal parts with precision.
The human body is often compared to a biological machine.
cn: 这家工厂用先进机器组装汽车。
她学会了如何精密加工金属零件。
人体常被比作生物机器。

en: The dog went mad after being left alone for days.
She was mad at him for forgetting their anniversary.
The crowd went mad when the band started playing.
cn: 这只狗被独自留下数日后发狂了。
她因他忘记周年纪念日而愤怒。
乐队开始演奏时，人群陷入狂热。

definitions.definition: 夫人，女士（对女性的尊称，尤指正式场合）

en: "Excuse me, madam, your table is ready."
"The madam of the brothel was a formidable woman."
"Madam President will address the nation tonight."
cn: “夫人，您的餐桌已准备好。”
“妓院的老鸨是个厉害角色。”
“总统女士将于今晚向全国发表讲话。”

en: She bought a fashion magazine at the airport.
The soldiers were ordered to guard the ammunition magazine.
This online magazine covers global environmental issues.
cn: 她在机场买了一本时尚杂志。
士兵们奉命守卫弹药库。
这份在线期刊涵盖全球环境议题。

en: The fairy used magic to turn the pumpkin into a carriage.
His performance was pure magic, leaving the audience in awe.
Many ancient cultures believed in the magic of herbal remedies.
cn: 仙女用魔法把南瓜变成了马车。
他的表演充满魔力，让观众惊叹不已。
许多古代文化相信草药疗法的神奇力量。

definitions.definition: 磁铁；有吸引力的人或物

en: The magnet attracted all the iron filings nearby.
Her charisma made her a magnet for admirers.
Scientists use powerful magnets in MRI machines.
cn: 磁铁吸住了附近所有的铁屑。
她的魅力使她成为仰慕者的焦点。
科学家在核磁共振仪中使用强磁体。

en: The magnetic field of the Earth protects us from solar radiation.
She has a magnetic personality that draws people to her.
The artist used magnetic letters to create the installation.
cn: 地球的磁场保护我们免受太阳辐射。
她有一种吸引人的魅力人格。
艺术家用磁性字母创作了这件装置作品。

en: The palace is a magnificent example of Baroque architecture.
She gave a magnificent performance at the concert.
The view from the mountain top was truly magnificent.
cn: 这座宫殿是巴洛克建筑的宏伟典范。
她在音乐会上表现出色。
从山顶看到的景色实在壮丽。

en: The maid cleaned the rooms before the guests arrived.
In medieval tales, the knight often rescues a fair maid.
She worked as a maid to support her family.
cn: 女仆在客人到来前打扫了房间。
中世纪故事中，骑士常拯救美丽的少女。
她做女仆来养家。

en: She checked her mail every morning.
Please mail this package to the customer.
The invention of email changed traditional mail services.
cn: 她每天早晨查看邮件。
请将这个包裹邮寄给客户。
电子邮件的发明改变了传统邮政服务。

definitions.definition: （输送水、煤气等的）总管，主管道

en: The main reason for his success was hard work.
Turn off the water at the main before repairing the pipe.
She played the main role in the school play.
cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
修理管道前，先关闭总阀门。
她在校园剧中担任主角。

en: The team consists mainly of young engineers.
She is mainly responsible for project coordination.
The festival attracts visitors mainly from Europe.
cn: 团队主要由年轻工程师组成。
她主要负责项目协调工作。
这个节日吸引的游客主要来自欧洲。

definitions.definition: 大陆（与岛屿或半岛相对的主要陆地部分）

en: The island is connected to the mainland by a bridge.
Most of the country's population lives on the mainland.
The storm caused flooding in both the mainland and coastal areas.
cn: 这座岛屿通过一座桥梁与大陆相连。
该国大部分人口居住在大陆上。
风暴在大陆和沿海地区均引发了洪水。

en: Regular exercise helps maintain good health.
The team works hard to maintain the equipment.
She maintains that the policy is unfair.
cn: 定期锻炼有助于保持健康。
团队努力维护设备。
她坚持认为该政策不公。

definitions.definition: 维护，保养（保持设备或状态的行动）
维持，保持（持续某种状态或条件）

en: Regular maintenance of your car can prevent major breakdowns.
The government focuses on the maintenance of public order.
His job involves the maintenance of historical records.
cn: 定期保养车辆可避免严重故障。
政府致力于维持公共秩序。
他的工作包括维护历史档案。

en: She chose psychology as her major in college.
The major factor in their success was teamwork.
He was promoted to the rank of major last year.
cn: 她在大学主修心理学。
他们成功的主要因素是团队合作。
他去年晋升为少校。

definitions.definition: 多数，大多数（指数量或比例上的优势）

en: The majority of voters supported the new policy.
She inherited the estate after reaching the age of majority.
A two-thirds majority is required to pass the amendment.
cn: 大多数选民支持这项新政策。
她在达到法定成年年龄后继承了遗产。
通过该修正案需要三分之二多数票。

en: She made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
The news made him very happy.
This car is a popular make in Europe.
cn: 她用黏土制作了一件精美的雕塑。
这个消息让他非常开心。
这款车是欧洲的热门品牌。

en: The male lion protects the pride.
This flower has both male and female parts.
The study compared male and female responses.
cn: 雄性狮子保护狮群。
这种花同时有雄性和雌性部分。
该研究对比了男性和女性的反应。

definitions.definition: 配备人员（如 man a station）

en: The man offered his seat to the elderly woman.
Early man used tools made of stone.
We need to man the rescue boats quickly.
cn: 这位男士将座位让给了年长的女性。
早期人类使用石器工具。
我们需要迅速为救援船配备人员。

en: She manages a team of 20 employees.
Can you manage the project alone?
Despite the injury, he managed to finish the race.
cn: 她管理着一个20人的团队。
你能独自处理这个项目吗？
尽管受伤，他仍坚持完成了比赛。

en: Effective management requires both leadership and communication skills.
The company's top management announced a new sustainability initiative.
Time management is crucial for balancing work and personal life.
cn: 高效管理需要领导力与沟通技巧。
公司高层管理层宣布了一项新的可持续发展计划。
时间管理对平衡工作与生活至关重要。

definitions.definition: 管理者，经理（负责组织或团队运作的人）
经纪人（如艺人、运动员的代理人）

en: She was promoted to senior manager last year.
The project manager coordinates tasks between teams.
His manager negotiated a better contract for him.
cn: 她去年晋升为高级经理。
项目经理协调团队间的任务。
他的经纪人为他谈下了更优的合同。

en: Mankind has always sought to explore the unknown.
The invention of writing marked a turning point for mankind.
Early laws often prioritized the rights of mankind over womankind.
cn: 人类始终渴望探索未知。
文字的发明是人类历史的转折点。
早期法律常优先保障男性而非女性的权利。

definitions.definition: 具有男子气概的；勇敢的

en: He showed a manly courage in facing the challenge.
The decor was simple and manly, with dark wood furniture.
She admired his manly determination to protect his family.
cn: 他在面对挑战时展现了男子汉的勇气。
装潢简约而阳刚，配有深色木制家具。
她钦佩他保护家人的男子气概。

en: She answered in a calm manner.
The artist’s manner is influenced by Renaissance techniques.
It’s bad manners to interrupt others.
cn: 她以平静的态度回答。
这位艺术家的风格受文艺复兴技法影响。
打断他人是不礼貌的行为。

en: The mechanic referred to the car's manual for troubleshooting.
Manual labor is still essential in many industries.
She prefers manual calculations over using a computer.
cn: 机械师参考汽车手册进行故障排查。
体力劳动在许多行业仍是必需的。
比起电脑计算，她更喜欢手工计算。

en: The company manufactures electronic components for global markets.
Local manufacture of vaccines has reduced dependency on imports.
These goods are of poor manufacture and break easily.
cn: 这家公司为全球市场生产电子元件。
疫苗的本地生产降低了对进口的依赖。
这些商品制造工艺差，容易损坏。

en: The car manufacturer recalled thousands of vehicles due to a safety issue.
Local manufacturers are struggling with rising material costs.
This company is a leading manufacturer of solar panels.
cn: 这家汽车制造商因安全问题召回数千辆汽车。
本地生产商正面临材料成本上涨的困境。
该公司是太阳能电池板的领先制造商。

en: Many students attended the lecture.
She has many friends from different countries.
How many apples are left in the basket?
cn: 许多学生参加了讲座。
她有许多来自不同国家的朋友。
篮子里还剩多少个苹果？

en: She unfolded the map to find the nearest gas station.
The scientist mapped the human genome in 2001.
His speech mapped out a clear plan for the project.
cn: 她展开地图寻找最近的加油站。
科学家于2001年绘制了人类基因组图谱。
他的演讲为项目规划了清晰的路线。

definitions.definition: 大理石；玻璃弹珠；雕刻品

en: The floor was paved with white marble.
He collected colorful marbles as a child.
Her marble heart showed no mercy.
cn: 地板铺着白色大理石。
他小时候收集彩色玻璃弹珠。
她冷酷的心毫无怜悯。

en: The soldiers will march through the city at dawn.
March is often windy in this region.
Protesters marched to demand climate action.
cn: 士兵们将在黎明时分列队穿过城市。
这个地区的三月常常多风。

这家公司的利润空间非常微薄。

Marine biology studies organisms in the ocean.

en: The teacher used a red pen to mark the errors.

He got full marks in the final exam.
cn: 老师用红笔标出了错误。
这一事件标志着一个新时代的开始。

她在一家科技公司从事数字营销工作。

艺术与技术的结合创造出惊艳的设计。
她研究中世纪欧洲的婚姻史。

en: She has been married for ten years.
They got married in a small chapel.
Married life requires mutual understanding.
cn: 她已结婚十年。
他们在一座小教堂结了婚。
婚姻生活需要相互理解。

en: They decided to marry after dating for five years.
The priest will marry the couple next Sunday.
Her dream is to marry someone who shares her passion for art.
cn: 他们交往五年后决定结婚。
牧师将在下周日为这对新人主持婚礼。
她的梦想是嫁给一个同样热爱艺术的人。

en: The view from the mountaintop was absolutely marvelous.
She did a marvelous job organizing the event.
The children's performance was nothing short of marvelous.
cn: 从山顶看到的景色简直令人惊叹。
她把活动组织得棒极了。
孩子们的表演堪称精彩绝伦。

definitions.definition: 马克思主义（以卡尔·马克思思想为基础的社会、政治及经济理论体系）

en: Marxism profoundly influenced global political movements in the 20th century.
She studied Marxism to understand critiques of capitalism.
Some modern scholars reinterpret Marxism in the context of digital economies.
cn: 马克思主义深刻影响了20世纪的全球政治运动。
她研究马克思主义以理解对资本主义的批判。
部分现代学者在数字经济背景下重新诠释马克思主义。

definitions.definition: 马克思主义者（拥护马克思理论的人）
马克思主义的（与马克思理论相关的）

en: As a Marxist, she analyzes social issues through the lens of class struggle.
The university offers a course on Marxist philosophy.
His interpretation of history is deeply influenced by Marxist theory.
cn: 作为一名马克思主义者，她通过阶级斗争的视角分析社会问题。
这所大学开设了马克思主义哲学课程。
他对历史的解读深受马克思主义理论影响。

en: The thief wore a mask to avoid being recognized.
She used humor to mask her nervousness.
Apply a clay mask once a week for healthy skin.
cn: 小偷戴着面具以免被认出。
她用幽默掩饰紧张。
每周敷一次泥膜以保持皮肤健康。

en: The mountain rose as a dark mass against the sky.
She attended mass every Sunday.
The protesters formed a mass demonstration.
cn: 山峰如一团黑影耸立在天空下。
她每周日参加弥撒。
抗议者发起了大规模示威。

en: She is a master of classical piano.
It takes years to master a foreign language.
The dog obeyed its master without hesitation.
cn: 她是古典钢琴大师。
掌握一门外语需要多年时间。
这只狗毫不犹豫地听从主人的命令。

definitions.definition: 杰作（尤指艺术或文学领域的最高成就）
典范（比喻某领域最出色的代表）

en: The Mona Lisa is widely regarded as Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece.
Her latest novel is a masterpiece of modern literature.
The chef’s signature dish was a culinary masterpiece.
cn: 《蒙娜丽莎》被公认为达·芬奇的杰作。
她的最新小说是现代文学的典范之作。
这位主厨的招牌菜堪称烹饪杰作。

en: She wiped her shoes on the mat before entering.
The cat loves to sleep on the bamboo mat.
His hair was matted with mud after the hike.
cn: 进门前，她在垫子上擦了擦鞋。
这只猫喜欢睡在竹席上。
徒步后，他的头发被泥土缠结成团。

en: The tennis match was intense.
Her skills match the job requirements perfectly.
He struck a match to light the candle.
cn: 这场网球比赛非常激烈。
她的技能完全符合职位要求。
他划了一根火柴点燃蜡烛。

en: He's been my loyal mate through thick and thin.
The zookeepers are trying to mate the pandas.
Checkmate! Your king has no escape.
cn: 他是我同甘共苦的忠实伙伴。
饲养员正尝试让熊猫交配。
将军！你的王无路可逃。（国际象棋术语，源自波斯语 shah mat“国王被困”）

definitions.definition: 物质的；重要的；实质性的

en: The building's structure uses sustainable materials.
Her research provided material evidence for the theory.
He collected material for his new novel.
cn: 这座建筑的结构采用了可持续材料。
她的研究为该理论提供了实质性的证据。
他为新小说搜集了素材。

definitions.definition: 唯物主义（哲学理论，认为物质是现实的基础）
物质主义（过度追求物质财富的价值观）

en: His materialism blinds him to the importance of spiritual growth.
Dialectical materialism is a core concept in Marxist philosophy.
The novel critiques the materialism of modern society.
cn: 他的物质主义使他忽视了精神成长的重要性。
辩证唯物主义是马克思主义哲学的核心概念。
这部小说批判了现代社会的物质至上风气。

en: She has a mathematical mind and excels in solving complex equations.
The robot's movements were calculated with mathematical precision.
His approach to the problem was purely mathematical.
cn: 她拥有数学头脑，擅长解决复杂方程。
机器人的动作以数学般的精确度计算而成。
他处理问题的方式完全是数学化的。

definitions.definition: 数学（研究数量、结构、空间等抽象概念的学科）

en: She excels in mathematics and hopes to become a theoretical physicist.
Ancient Greeks considered mathematics the language of the universe.
The beauty of mathematics lies in its logical consistency.
cn: 她在数学上表现优异，希望成为理论物理学家。
古希腊人认为数学是宇宙的语言。
数学之美在于其逻辑的一致性。

definitions.definition: 数学（英国英语拼写，等同于美式 "math"）

en: She excels in maths and physics.
The maths problem was too complex for primary students.
British schools prioritise maths literacy.
cn: 她在数学和物理方面表现优异。
这道数学题对小学生来说太复杂了。
英国学校将数学素养列为重点。

en: The universe is made up of matter and energy.
It doesn't matter if you're late.
This legal matter requires careful attention.
cn: 宇宙由物质和能量构成。
你迟到也没关系。
这项法律事务需要谨慎处理。

en: The cheese needs time to mature.
She showed a mature attitude toward the criticism.
His skills matured through years of practice.
cn: 奶酪需要时间成熟。
她对批评表现出成熟的态度。
他的技艺经过多年练习趋于完善。

en: The temperature reached a maximum of 38°C yesterday.
The car has a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
We need to maximize efficiency to achieve the maximum output.
cn: 昨日气温达到了38摄氏度的最高值。
这辆车的最高时速为200公里。
我们需要最大化效率以实现最高产出。

definitions.definition: 可能（表示可能性或推测）

en: It may rain tomorrow.
May I borrow your pen?
The results may vary depending on the conditions.
cn: 明天可能会下雨。
我可以借你的笔吗？
结果可能因条件不同而变化。

definitions.definition: 可能，也许（表示不确定性或推测）

en: Maybe we should leave early to avoid traffic.
She said maybe to the invitation, but didn't confirm.
"Will it rain tomorrow?" "Maybe, check the forecast later."
cn: 也许我们应该早点出发避开拥堵。
她对邀请说了“可能”，但未确认。
“明天会下雨吗？”“可能，晚点看天气预报吧。”

definitions.definition: 市长（城镇或城市的最高民选官员）

en: The mayor announced a new policy to reduce traffic congestion.
She was elected mayor of the city by a large majority.

cn: 市长宣布了一项减少交通拥堵的新政策。
她以高票当选为该市市长。
市长办公室位于历史悠久的市政厅内。

en: She gave me a book.
Can you hear me?
This gift is for me.
cn: 她给了我一本书。
你能听到我吗？
这份礼物是给我的。

definitions.definition: 草地，牧场（尤指用于割草或放牧的低洼湿润草地）

en: The cows grazed peacefully in the meadow.
Wildflowers bloomed across the meadow after the rain.
They picnicked by the stream that bordered the meadow.
cn: 奶牛在草地上安静地吃草。
雨后，野花遍开整片草地。
他们在草地边缘的小溪旁野餐。

燕麦片是健康的早餐选择。
这座古老的磨坊将小麦磨成精细的粉末。

What do you mean by that remark?
cn: 她吝啬到不愿分享甜点。

你说这话是什么意思？

Art gives meaning to human experiences.
cn: 这个古老符号的含义仍不明确。

艺术赋予人类经历以意义。

她缺乏出国旅行的财力。
外交常是解决冲突的最佳手段。

The repair will take an hour—would you like to wait or come back in the meantime?

她喝完了咖啡，与此同时他查看了邮件。
修理需要一小时，您想等待还是在此期间回来？

The main course will take 20 minutes to prepare. Meanwhile, enjoy some appetizers.

主菜需要20分钟准备，在此期间请享用开胃菜。

His performance felt mechanical, lacking emotional depth.
She has a mechanical understanding of the rules, but no creativity.
cn: 工厂使用机械臂组装汽车。
他的表演显得呆板，缺乏情感深度。

cn: 牛顿用运动定律彻底改变了力学。

cn: 她在事故后得到了出色的医疗护理。

cn: 空气是声波的传播介质。

This product meets all safety requirements.
She won three gold medals at the swim meet.
cn: 我们明天在咖啡馆见面吧。
该产品符合所有安全要求。
她在游泳比赛中赢得了三枚金牌。

The river is formed by the meeting of two smaller streams.
cn: 董事会将讨论明年的预算。
他们在咖啡馆的相遇仿佛是命运的安排。
这条河由两条小溪汇流而成。

definitions.definition: 甜瓜（尤指西瓜、哈密瓜等葫芦科植物的果实）

Her stern expression melted into a smile when she saw the puppy.
Dark chocolate melts smoothly in your mouth.
cn: 气温升高，积雪开始融化。
看到小狗时，她严厉的表情融化成微笑。
黑巧克力在口中丝滑融化。

The accident left him with no feeling in his lower members.
Each member of the team has a specific role.
cn: 她是该环保组织的创始成员。
事故导致他下肢失去知觉。

definitions.definition: 纪念物；纪念碑；纪念仪式

en: The statue serves as a memorial to the war heroes.
She attended a memorial service for her late teacher.
The museum is a living memorial to the city's history.
cn: 这座雕像是战争英雄的纪念碑。
她参加了已故老师的追悼会。
这座博物馆是对城市历史的生动纪念。

My laptop has 16GB of memory for multitasking.
cn: 她最早的记忆是掉进河里。

There’s no visible mend on the repaired vase.
cn: 他学会了缝补自己的衣服。
术后患者恢复得很快。
修复后的花瓶上看不出修补痕迹。

She has exceptional mental arithmetic skills.
cn: 定期锻炼有益于身心健康。
她拥有非凡的心算能力。

cn: 她在邮件中忘了提到这次会议。
文章未提及这一争议。
他在比赛中获得了荣誉提名。

【计算机】菜单（程序中的功能列表）

危机中，他们祈求神的怜悯。

The lake was once called a mere in old maps.
His apology was a mere formality, lacking sincerity.
cn: 她写第一部小说时不过是个孩子。
这座湖在古地图上曾被称为“mere”。

The difference is merely a matter of style.

cn: 她写第一部小说时不过是个孩子。
区别仅仅在于风格。

"Merry and bright" is a classic holiday phrase.
cn: 孩子们在雪中玩耍，快乐无比。
一杯酒下肚，他感到微醺惬意。
“欢乐明亮”是经典的节日用语。

en: The kids left the room in a mess.
He's trying to fix the mess caused by the misunderstanding.
Don't mess with the settings if you're not sure.
cn: 孩子们把房间弄得一团糟。
他正试图解决误会造成的麻烦。
如果不确定，别乱动设置。

en: She left a message on his voicemail.
The satellite can message data back to Earth.
His speech carried a powerful message of hope.
cn: 她在他的语音信箱留了一条信息。
卫星能将数据传回地球。
他的演讲传递了强烈的希望讯息。

definitions.definition: 信使，使者；传递信息的人或物

en: The messenger delivered the urgent letter to the king.
Email has replaced traditional messengers in many businesses.
In biology, RNA acts as a messenger carrying genetic instructions.
cn: 信使将紧急信件递交给国王。
在许多企业中，电子邮件已取代传统信使。
在生物学中，RNA 作为传递遗传指令的信使。

definitions.definition: 金属（具有光泽、导电性和延展性的物质）

en: Iron is a common metal used in construction.
The band is known for its aggressive metal music.
Gold is a precious metal with high economic value.
cn: 铁是建筑中常用的金属。
这支乐队以激烈的金属乐闻名。
黄金是具有高经济价值的贵金属。

definitions.definition: 计量器；仪表（如 gas meter 煤气表）
韵律；格律（诗歌中的节奏单位）

en: The electricity meter needs to be checked monthly.
Shakespeare often used iambic meter in his sonnets.
The system meters water usage automatically.
cn: 电表需每月检查一次。
莎士比亚的十四行诗常用抑扬格律。
该系统自动计量用水量。

en: The scientist developed a new method to analyze the data.
Her teaching method emphasizes student participation.
We need a more efficient method to solve this problem.
cn: 这位科学家开发了一种分析数据的新方法。
她的教学法注重学生参与。
我们需要更高效的方法来解决这个问题。

definitions.definition: 米（国际单位制长度单位）

en: The room is five metres long.
Shakespeare often used iambic metre in his sonnets.
The scientist recorded the distance in metres.
cn: 房间长五米。
莎士比亚的十四行诗常用抑扬格韵律。
科学家以米为单位记录距离。

en: Most countries use the metric system for scientific measurements.
Customer satisfaction is a key metric for our business success.
The poem follows a strict metric pattern.
cn: 大多数国家在科学测量中使用公制系统。
客户满意度是我们业务成功的关键指标。
这首诗遵循严格的格律模式。

en: Early microcomputers were often sold in kit form to electronics hobbyists.
The invention of the microprocessor was pivotal to the development of the microcomputer.
This portable device is essentially a powerful microcomputer in a compact form factor.
cn: 早期的微型计算机通常以套件形式出售给电子爱好者。
微处理器的发明对微型计算机的发展至关重要。
这款便携设备本质上是一款外形紧凑的功能强大的微型计算机。

definitions.definition: 麦克风，扩音器（用于转换声音为电信号的设备）

en: She spoke into the microphone, her voice echoing through the hall.
The singer adjusted the microphone stand before starting the performance.
Wireless microphones are widely used in modern conferences.
cn: 她对着麦克风讲话，声音回荡在整个大厅里。
歌手在开始表演前调整了麦克风支架。
无线麦克风在现代会议中被广泛使用。

definitions.definition: 显微镜（光学仪器，用于观察微小物体）

en: The scientist used a microscope to examine the bacteria.
Modern microscopes can magnify objects up to 1000 times.
Students learned how to adjust the focus of the microscope in lab class.
cn: 科学家用显微镜观察细菌。
现代显微镜可将物体放大至1000倍。
学生们在实验课上学习如何调节显微镜焦距。

en: We agreed to meet at midday for lunch.
The sun is strongest around midday.
The clock struck midday as the ceremony began.
cn: 我们约定中午见面吃午餐。
正午时分阳光最强烈。
仪式开始时，钟声敲响正午十二点。

en: She sat in the middle row of the theater.
The middle chapters of the book are the most exciting.
He ranked in the middle of his class.
cn: 她坐在剧院的中间一排。
这本书的中间几章最精彩。
他在班级中排名中等。

definitions.definition: 黑暗或隐秘的象征（比喻义）

en: The clock struck midnight, and the party reached its peak.
She worked tirelessly until midnight to finish the project.
The novel explores the moral midnight of human nature.
cn: 钟声敲响午夜，派对达到高潮。
她孜孜不倦地工作到午夜，以完成项目。
这部小说探讨了人性中的道德至暗时刻。

definitions.definition: 中间，中部（指空间或时间的中心位置）

en: She stood calm in the midst of chaos.
A spark of hope emerged in the midst of despair.
The tower rose tall in the midst of the city.
cn: 她在混乱中保持镇定。
绝望中出现了一丝希望。
高塔矗立在城市中心。

definitions.definition: 可能（表示可能性或推测）

en: He pushed the rock with all his might.
She might arrive late due to the traffic.
The might of the ancient empire was unmatched.
cn: 他用尽全力推那块石头。
由于交通堵塞，她可能会迟到。
这个古老帝国的力量无可匹敌。

en: The mild weather made the hike enjoyable.
She has a mild temperament and rarely gets angry.
The sauce has a mild flavor, suitable for children.
cn: 温和的天气让徒步旅行很愉快。
她性格温和，很少生气。
这种酱汁味道清淡，适合儿童食用。

definitions.definition: （非正式）长距离或大量（如 "miles ahead" 表示遥遥领先）

en: The next gas station is 5 miles away.
She finished the race miles ahead of her competitors.
Ancient Roman roads were marked with milestones every thousand paces.
cn: 下一个加油站在5英里外。
她以远超对手的优势完成比赛。
古罗马道路每隔千步设有里程碑。

en: The country increased its military budget by 10% this year.
He comes from a long line of military officers.
Military training emphasizes discipline and teamwork.
cn: 该国今年将军费预算提高了10%。
他出身于军人世家。
军事训练强调纪律与团队合作。

en: She poured milk into her coffee.
Cows need to be milked twice a day.
He tried to milk his fame for financial gain.
cn: 她将牛奶倒入咖啡中。
奶牛每天需要挤两次奶。
他试图利用自己的名声谋取经济利益。

en: The old water mill still grinds wheat into flour.
She works at a steel mill outside the city.
The machine mills metal parts with precision.
cn: 这座老水磨坊仍在将小麦磨成面粉。
她在城外的一家钢铁厂工作。
这台机器能精密铣削金属零件。

definitions.definition: 毫米（千分之一米，公制长度单位）

en: The tolerance for this component is within 0.1 millimetres.
A human hair is approximately 0.05 millimetres thick.
The artist used a brush with millimetre precision.
cn: 该零件的公差在0.1毫米以内。
人类头发的厚度约为0.05毫米。
艺术家使用了毫米级精度的画笔。

en: The lottery prize reached ten million dollars.
She has a million ideas for the project.
Microscopic organisms can number in the millions per drop of water.
cn: 彩票奖金高达一千万美元。
她对这项目有无数个点子。
每滴水中的微生物数量可达数百万。

en: She has a brilliant mind for mathematics.
Would you mind closing the window?
He minds his grandmother on weekends.
cn: 她拥有杰出的数学头脑。
你介意关下窗户吗？
他周末照料祖母。

en: The coal mine has been operational for over a century.
This book is mine, not yours.
They mined the coastline to prevent enemy ships from approaching.
cn: 这座煤矿已运营超过一个世纪。
这本书是我的，不是你的。
他们在海岸线布雷以阻止敌舰靠近。

en: The miner spent eight hours a day extracting coal underground.
Modern miners use advanced equipment to ensure safety.
Her grandfather was a gold miner in Australia during the 19th century.
cn: 这名矿工每天花八小时在地下采煤。
现代矿工使用先进设备保障安全。
她的祖父是19世纪澳大利亚的一名金矿工。

definitions.definition: 矿物（自然形成的无机固体物质，具有特定化学成分和晶体结构）

en: The geologist identified a rare mineral in the rock sample.
Mineral deposits in this region are rich in copper.
She drinks mineral water for its health benefits.
cn: 地质学家在岩石样本中发现了一种稀有矿物。
该地区的矿藏富含铜。
她饮用矿泉水以获取健康益处。

en: The temperature reached a minimum of -10°C last night.
You need a minimum of 8 hours of sleep for optimal health.
The company operates with minimum staff on weekends.
cn: 昨晚气温降至最低零下10摄氏度。
保持最佳健康状态至少需要8小时睡眠。
公司在周末以最少人员运营。

definitions.definition: 服侍；协助（古义或宗教语境）

en: The health minister announced new policies.
She ministers to the needs of the poor.
In medieval times, a minister often served the king.
cn: 卫生部长宣布了新政策。
她致力于满足穷人的需求。
中世纪时，大臣常为国王服务。

definitions.definition: （政府的）部；部长职位；神职人员的职责

en: She works in the Ministry of Education.
His ministry focused on helping the poor.
The ministry announced new policies yesterday.
cn: 她在教育部工作。
他的神职工作以帮助穷人为重心。
该部门昨日宣布了新政策。

en: She suffered minor injuries in the accident.
In most countries, a minor cannot sign legal contracts.
He decided to minor in psychology alongside his business degree.
cn: 她在事故中受了轻伤。
在多数国家，未成年人不能签署法律合同。
他决定在商科学位之外辅修心理学。

en: The law protects the rights of ethnic minorities.
Only a minority of students voted against the proposal.
Women in leadership roles are still a minority in many industries.
cn: 法律保护少数民族的权利。
只有少数学生投票反对该提案。
在许多行业中，女性担任领导角色仍是少数。

en: Ten minus four equals six.
The temperature dropped to minus five degrees.
His plan has both pluses and minuses.
cn: 十减四等于六。
气温降至零下五度。
他的计划有利有弊。

en: Wait a minute, I need to check my schedule.
The scientist observed minute changes under the microscope.
The secretary took minutes during the meeting.
cn: 稍等，我需要查一下日程。
科学家在显微镜下观察到微小的变化。
秘书在会议中做了记录。

definitions.definition: 奇迹（超自然或非凡事件）

en: The recovery of the patient was considered a medical miracle.
It's a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
Her talent for painting is nothing short of a miracle.
cn: 病人的康复被视为医学奇迹。
事故中无人受伤，真是奇迹。
她的绘画天赋简直不可思议。

definitions.definition: 镜子；反射面；真实的反映

en: She glanced at her reflection in the mirror.
The lake mirrored the surrounding mountains perfectly.
His actions mirror his father's habits.
cn: 她瞥了一眼镜中的自己。
湖面完美映照出周围的群山。
他的行为模仿了他父亲的习惯。

en: The refugees lived in miserable conditions after the war.
She felt miserable when her pet dog passed away.
The hotel room was small and miserable, with broken furniture.
cn: 战争结束后，难民们生活在悲惨的环境中。
她的宠物狗去世时，她感到非常痛苦。
酒店房间狭小而简陋，家具都是破损的。

en: The advertisement misleads consumers about the product's benefits.
His vague instructions misled us into taking the wrong path.
Fake news can easily mislead people who don't verify sources.
cn: 这则广告误导消费者对产品功效的认知。
他含糊的指引误导我们走错了路。
假新闻很容易误导不核实信源的人。

definitions.definition: 错过；失误；小姐（未婚女性称谓）

en: She narrowly missed the bus.
I miss my family when traveling abroad.
The archer’s first shot was a miss.
cn: 她差点没赶上公交车。
在国外旅行时，我想念家人。
射箭手的第一箭未中靶。

en: The missile was launched from a hidden location.
Ancient Romans used missiles like javelins in warfare.
The defense system intercepted the incoming missile.
cn: 导弹从隐蔽地点发射。
古罗马人在战争中使用了标枪等投射武器。
防御系统拦截了来袭导弹。

en: The missing document was found in the archive.
She reported her son missing to the police.
There’s a sense of something missing in his explanation.
cn: 缺失的文件在档案室被找到了。
她向警方报告儿子失踪。
他的解释中总让人觉得缺了点什么。

definitions.definition: 任务；使命（尤指军事、宗教或人道主义性质）

en: The astronauts completed their mission to repair the satellite.
She joined a medical mission to provide aid in remote areas.
His life's mission is to promote environmental awareness.
cn: 宇航员完成了修复卫星的任务。
她加入了一支医疗代表团，为偏远地区提供援助。
他一生的使命是提升环保意识。

en: The morning mist hung low over the valley.
Her eyes misted with tears as she told the story.
The mountains were barely visible through the mist.
cn: 清晨的薄雾笼罩着山谷。
她讲述故事时，泪水模糊了双眼。
群山在雾中若隐若现。

en: It's easy to make a mistake when you're tired.
She mistook his silence for disapproval.
The teacher pointed out a spelling mistake in my essay.
cn: 疲劳时容易犯错。
她误将他的沉默当作反对。
老师指出了我作文中的拼写错误。

definitions.definition: 先生（对男性的礼貌称呼，缩写为 Mr.）

en: Excuse me, mister, do you know the way to the station?
He's just a regular mister, nothing special about him.
"Mister, can you help me with my homework?" the boy asked.
cn: 打扰一下，先生，您知道去车站的路吗？
他不过是个普通人，没什么特别的。
“先生，您能帮我做作业吗？”男孩问道。

definitions.definition: 女主人；主妇；女性统治者

en: She was the mistress of a large estate.
In the 18th century, many wealthy men had a wife and a mistress.
The school hired a new mistress to teach French.
cn: 她曾是一座大庄园的女主人。
18世纪时，许多富有的男性既有妻子也有情妇。
学校聘请了一位新的女教师教授法语。

en: Don’t misunderstand me—I fully support your idea.
His silence was misunderstood as agreement.
Cultural differences often lead people to misunderstand each other.
cn: 别误会，我完全支持你的想法。
他的沉默被误解为同意。
文化差异常导致人们彼此误解。

en: Mix the flour and water to make dough.
This song is a mix of jazz and electronic music.
Oil and water don't mix easily.
cn: 将面粉和水混合成面团。
这首歌是爵士与电子乐的混音。
油和水不易混合。

en: The cake batter is a smooth mixture of flour, eggs, and sugar.
His music is a unique mixture of jazz and electronic elements.
The chemist analyzed the chemical mixture under a microscope.
cn: 蛋糕面糊是面粉、鸡蛋和糖的均匀混合物。
他的音乐融合了爵士与电子元素的独特风格。
化学家在显微镜下分析了这种化学混合剂。

en: The patient let out a faint moan of pain.
She moaned about the unfair treatment at work.
The wind moaned through the cracks in the old house.
cn: 病人发出一声微弱的痛苦呻吟。
她抱怨工作中的不公平待遇。
风从老房子的缝隙中呜咽而过。

definitions.definition: 移动电话（英式英语常用）；动态雕塑

en: The mobile library serves remote villages every week.
She hung a colorful mobile above the baby’s crib.
My mobile battery dies too quickly.
cn: 流动图书馆每周为偏远村庄提供服务。
她在婴儿床上方挂了一个彩色动态雕塑。
我的手机电池耗电太快。

en: The device operates in two modes: manual and automatic.
Short skirts were the mode in the 1960s.
Dorian mode is commonly used in jazz music.
cn: 该设备有两种操作模式：手动和自动。
短裙是20世纪60年代的流行风格。
多利亚调式常用于爵士乐中。

en: She built a detailed model of the Eiffel Tower.
His dedication made him a model employee.
The designer will model the new collection at the fashion show.
cn: 她制作了一个精细的埃菲尔铁塔模型。
他的敬业精神使他成为模范员工。
设计师将在时装秀上展示新系列服装。

en: She holds moderate views on economic reform.
The teacher moderated the debate between students.
Exercise in moderate amounts is beneficial to health.
cn: 她对经济改革持温和观点。
老师主持了学生间的辩论。
适度运动有益健康。

en: Modern technology has transformed communication.
She prefers modern art to classical paintings.
The building combines modern design with eco-friendly materials.
cn: 现代科技彻底改变了沟通方式。
相较于古典绘画，她更偏爱现代艺术。
这座建筑将现代设计与环保材料相结合。

en: She gave a modest smile when praised for her achievement.
The house is modest in size but well-designed.
He lives on a modest income despite his fame.
cn: 当她因成就受到表扬时，她谦虚地笑了笑。
这房子面积不大，但设计精良。
尽管有名气，他仍靠微薄的收入生活。

definitions.definition: 修改；调整（部分内容或形式）

en: The software allows users to modify images easily.
He modified his tone to sound more polite.
The recipe was modified to reduce sugar content.
cn: 该软件允许用户轻松修改图片。
他缓和了语气，显得更礼貌。
食谱经过调整以减少糖分。

en: The cake was perfectly moist and fluffy.
Keep the soil moist but not waterlogged.
Her eyes grew moist as she listened to the story.
cn: 蛋糕湿润松软，恰到好处。
保持土壤湿润，但不要积水。
听着故事，她的眼睛湿润了。

en: The soil retains moisture well, making it ideal for gardening.
High moisture levels in the air can cause mold growth.
This cream helps lock in moisture and keep your skin hydrated.
cn: 土壤保水性良好，非常适合园艺。
空气中湿度过高可能导致霉菌滋生。
这款面霜有助于锁住水分，保持肌肤水润。

definitions.definition: 分子（化学中最小的独立单位，保留物质化学性质）
微小颗粒（泛指极小的物质单位）

en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
The scientist observed the movement of molecules under the microscope.
Even a tiny molecule can trigger significant chemical reactions.
cn: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。
科学家在显微镜下观察了分子的运动。
即使是一个微小分子也能引发重大的化学反应。

definitions.definition: 重要性（如 "a matter of great moment"）

en: Wait a moment, I'll be right back.
This discovery was of great moment in scientific history.
She paused for a moment before answering.
cn: 稍等片刻，我马上回来。
这一发现在科学史上意义重大。
她停顿了一下才回答。

en: We have a meeting scheduled for Monday morning.
She always feels tired on Mondays.
The museum is closed on Mondays.
cn: 我们计划在周一上午开会。
她每到周一就感到疲惫。
这家博物馆每逢周一闭馆。

definitions.definition: 货币，金钱（用于交换商品或服务的通用媒介）
财富，资产（广义的经济资源）

en: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop.
Time is more valuable than money in some situations.
The government plans to invest more money in renewable energy.
cn: 她存够了买新笔记本电脑的钱。
在某些情况下，时间比金钱更宝贵。
政府计划向可再生能源投入更多资金。

en: The teacher appointed her as the class monitor.
Scientists monitor air quality in real time.
The baby’s heartbeat is monitored by a machine.
cn: 老师任命她为班长。
科学家实时监测空气质量。
婴儿的心跳由一台机器监控。

en: The monkey swung from branch to branch effortlessly.
Stop monkeying around with the tools!
Her laugh sounded like a little monkey’s chatter.
cn: 猴子轻松地在树枝间荡来荡去。
别瞎摆弄那些工具了！
她的笑声像小猴子的吱吱叫。

en: The project will be completed within a month.
February is the shortest month of the year.
She pays her rent on the first day of each month.
cn: 该项目将在一个月内完成。
二月是一年中最短的月份。
她每月第一天支付房租。

en: The magazine is published monthly.
She receives a monthly salary of $3,000.
This monthly tracks climate change data.
cn: 这本杂志每月出版一期。
她每月薪水为3000美元。
这份月刊追踪气候变化数据。

definitions.definition: 纪念碑；历史遗迹；不朽的成就

en: The ancient monument was carefully preserved by the local government.
Her scientific breakthrough stands as a monument to human ingenuity.
The statue serves as a monument to those who lost their lives in the war.
cn: 这座古代遗迹受到当地政府的精心保护。
她的科学突破是人类智慧的丰碑。
这座雕像是献给战争死难者的纪念碑。

definitions.definition: （语法）语气（如陈述语气、虚拟语气）

en: She was in a cheerful mood after receiving the good news.
The subjunctive mood is used to express hypothetical situations.
His sudden change of mood confused everyone in the room.
cn: 收到好消息后，她心情愉快。
虚拟语气用于表达假设情况。
他情绪的突然转变让房间里的人都感到困惑。

definitions.definition: （文学或比喻）月光或月亮状物
