en: The full moon illuminated the silent village.
Jupiter has at least 79 known moons.
Her pendant was shaped like a crescent moon.
cn: 满月照亮了寂静的村庄。
木星拥有至少79颗已知卫星。
她的吊坠呈新月形状。

en: The moral of the story is to always tell the truth.
She faced a moral dilemma about reporting the error.
His actions were legal but not necessarily moral.
cn: 这个故事的寓意是要永远诚实。
她在是否报告错误的问题上面临道德困境。
他的行为合法但不一定合乎道德。

definitions.definition: 更多的；更大的（数量或程度）

en: She wants more time to finish the project.
This book is more interesting than the last one.
Could I have some more coffee, please?
cn: 她需要更多时间来完成这个项目。
这本书比上一本更有趣。
请再给我一些咖啡好吗？

definitions.definition: 此外；而且（用于补充或强调前文）

en: The plan is inefficient; moreover, it’s too expensive.
She has the qualifications for the job, and moreover, she has relevant experience.
The data is outdated. Moreover, the methodology was flawed.
cn: 该计划效率低下，而且成本过高。
她具备该职位的资质，此外还有相关经验。
数据已过时，而且研究方法存在缺陷。

definitions.definition: 早晨，上午（日出至正午的时间段）

en: The birds sing loudly every morning.
She prefers to exercise in the cool morning air.
Morning sunlight filtered through the curtains.
cn: 每天早晨鸟儿都会大声歌唱。
她更喜欢在凉爽的晨间空气中锻炼。
晨光透过窗帘洒落进来。

en: All human beings are mortal.
The wound proved mortal, and he died within hours.
In Greek myths, gods often fell in love with mortals.
cn: 凡人皆有一死。
这处伤是致命的，他在几小时内便去世了。
希腊神话中，诸神常与凡人相恋。

en: The mosquito buzzed around my ear all night.
Mosquito nets are essential in malaria-prone areas.
Scientists are developing new ways to control mosquito populations.
cn: 那只蚊子整晚在我耳边嗡嗡作响。
蚊帐在疟疾高发地区是必需品。
科学家正在研发控制蚊虫数量的新方法。

en: She ate the most cake at the party.
This is the most interesting book I've ever read.
Most of the students passed the exam.
cn: 她在派对上吃了最多的蛋糕。
这是我读过最有趣的书。
大多数学生通过了考试。

en: The audience was mostly teenagers.
She mostly eats vegetarian food.
The work is mostly done by machines.
cn: 观众大部分是青少年。
她主要吃素食。
这项工作主要由机器完成。

en: She is a loving mother to three children.
The cat mothered her kittens with great care.
Mother’s Day is celebrated worldwide.
cn: 她是一位养育三个孩子的慈爱母亲。
这只猫像母亲般悉心照料她的幼崽。
母亲节是全球性的庆祝节日。

definitions.definition: 提议，动议（法律/会议场景）

en: The constant motion of the ocean waves is hypnotic.
She motioned for me to sit down quietly.
The committee passed the motion unanimously.
cn: 海浪持续的运动令人着迷。
她示意我安静地坐下。
委员会一致通过了该动议。

en: The teacher's praise motivated the students to work harder.
A desire for change motivated her to start a new business.
Financial rewards are not the only way to motivate employees.
cn: 老师的表扬激励学生们更加努力。
对改变的渴望促使她创办了新企业。
金钱奖励并非激励员工的唯一方式。

en: The police could not establish a motive for the crime.
His motive in helping her was purely selfish.
The motive power of the engine comes from electricity.
cn: 警方无法确定犯罪的动机。
他帮助她的动机完全是自私的。
这台发动机的动力来源是电力。

en: The electric motor hummed quietly.
She motored along the coastal highway.
Motor vehicles must pass emissions tests.
cn: 电动马达轻声嗡鸣。
她驾车沿海岸公路行驶。
机动车辆须通过排放检测。

definitions.definition: 塑造；用模具制作；发霉；影响

en: The artist used a plaster mould to create the sculpture.
Bread can easily develop mould if left in a damp place.
His character was moulded by his experiences during the war.
cn: 艺术家使用了一个石膏模具来创作雕塑。
面包如果放在潮湿的地方很容易发霉。
他的性格是由战争期间的经历塑造的。

en: They mounted a campaign to protect the environment.
The camera was mounted on a tripod.
We reached the summit of the mount at dawn.
cn: 他们发起了一场保护环境的运动。
相机被安装在三脚架上。
我们在黎明时分登上了山顶。

en: The Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.
She faced a mountain of paperwork after the holiday.
Ancient people believed gods lived on sacred mountains.
cn: 喜马拉雅山脉是世界上最高的山脉。
假期后，她面对堆积如山的文件工作。
古人认为神明居住在神圣的山上。

en: The whole nation mourned the passing of the beloved leader.
She still mourns for her childhood friend decades later.
The dove's call sounded like it was mourning.
cn: 整个国家为这位深受爱戴的领袖的逝世哀悼。
数十年后，她仍在为儿时的朋友感到悲伤。
鸽子的鸣叫声听起来像在哀泣。

en: The cat chased the mouse around the kitchen.
Move the mouse to click the icon.
She moused through the archives for hidden documents.
cn: 猫在厨房里追着老鼠跑。
移动鼠标点击图标。
她悄悄在档案中搜寻隐藏文件。

en: She covered her mouth to stifle a laugh.
The river mouth is where freshwater meets the sea.
He mouthed the words "thank you" across the room.
cn: 她捂住嘴忍住笑声。
河口是淡水与海水交汇之处。
他在房间另一头用口型无声地说“谢谢”。

en: She took a mouthful of coffee before answering.
"Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis" is quite a mouthful!
The baby spat out the first mouthful of solid food.
cn: 她喝了一口咖啡才回答。
“超微粒硅酸盐火山尘肺”这个词真拗口！
婴儿把第一口固体食物吐了出来。

en: Please move the chair to the corner.
Her speech moved the audience to tears.
The new job is a big move for his career.
cn: 请把椅子移到角落。
她的演讲让观众感动落泪。
这份新工作是他职业生涯的重要一步。

en: The dance performance showcased graceful movements.
The Civil Rights Movement changed American society.
The symphony's final movement is intensely emotional.
cn: 舞蹈表演展现了优雅的动作。
民权运动改变了美国社会。
交响曲的终章情感极为强烈。

en: The movie won three Academy Awards.
We watched a horror movie last night.
Streaming platforms have changed how people watch movies.
cn: 这部电影赢得了三项奥斯卡奖。
我们昨晚看了一部恐怖片。
流媒体平台改变了人们的观影方式。

en: She doesn't talk much in meetings.
There wasn't much food left after the party.
I feel much better after taking the medicine.
cn: 她在会议上很少发言。
派对结束后没剩下多少食物。
服药后我感觉好多了。

en: The children played happily in the mud after the rain.
Her boots were covered in thick mud from the hike.
The artist used mud to create natural pigments for painting.
cn: 雨后，孩子们在泥浆里开心地玩耍。
她的靴子上沾满了徒步时留下的厚泥。
这位艺术家用泥土制作天然颜料作画。

definitions.definition: 使沾上泥；使浑浊；使混乱

en: The path became muddy after the heavy rain.
His explanation only muddied the issue further.
The river water looked muddy due to erosion.
cn: 大雨过后，小路变得泥泞不堪。
他的解释反而让问题更加混乱。
因土壤侵蚀，河水显得浑浊。

en: She drank her coffee from a ceramic mug.
The thief tried to mug the tourist in the alley.
He has such an expressive mug in photos.
cn: 她用陶瓷马克杯喝咖啡。
小偷试图在小巷里抢劫游客。
他在照片中的表情非常丰富。

en: She faces multiple challenges in her new role.
The device has multiple functions in a single unit.
cn: 她在新岗位上面临多重挑战。
该设备集多种功能于一体。

en: To calculate the area, multiply the length by the width.
Rabbits multiply rapidly if left unchecked.
The company aims to multiply its profits within five years.
cn: 计算面积时，将长度乘以宽度。
兔子若不加以控制，会迅速繁殖。
该公司计划在五年内实现利润倍增。

en: He was convicted of murder in the first degree.
The journalist uncovered a political murder plot.
Don't let him sing—he'll murder that beautiful melody!
cn: 他被判一级谋杀罪。
记者揭露了一起政治谋杀阴谋。
别让他唱，他会糟蹋那首美妙的旋律！

en: The police are searching for the murderer who escaped last night.
In the novel, the murderer was finally revealed in the last chapter.
He was convicted as a murderer after a lengthy trial.
cn: 警方正在追捕昨晚逃脱的凶手。
小说中，凶手在最后一章才被揭露。
经过漫长审判，他被定罪为谋杀犯。

en: Regular exercise builds strong muscles.
He muscled his way through the crowd.
The heart is a vital muscle that never stops working.
cn: 定期锻炼能增强肌肉。
他用力挤过人群。
心脏是永不停止工作的关键肌肉。

en: The Louvre is the most visited museum in the world.
She donated her art collection to the local museum.
The museum's interactive exhibits engage children effectively.
cn: 卢浮宫是世界上参观人数最多的博物馆。
她将自己的艺术收藏捐赠给了当地博物馆。
博物馆的互动展品能有效吸引孩子们的参与。

definitions.definition: 蘑菇；伞菌；迅速增长的事物

en: Wild mushrooms can be poisonous if misidentified.
The tech industry mushroomed in the early 21st century.
She loves to mushroom in the forest after rain.
cn: 误食野生蘑菇可能中毒。
21世纪初科技行业迅速扩张。
她喜欢雨后去森林采蘑菇。

en: She studies classical music at the conservatory.
The music of the waterfall soothed his mind.
Can you read sheet music?
cn: 她在音乐学院学习古典音乐。
瀑布的声响如音乐般抚慰了他的心灵。
你能识乐谱吗？

en: She has a musical voice that captivates everyone.
We went to see a Broadway musical last night.
The musical instruments were carefully arranged on the stage.
cn: 她有一副悦耳的嗓音，令人着迷。
昨晚我们去看了百老汇音乐剧。
乐器被精心排列在舞台上。

en: The musician played a haunting melody on the violin.
She aspired to become a professional musician since childhood.
The jazz musician improvised brilliantly during the concert.
cn: 这位音乐家用小提琴演奏了一段萦绕心头的旋律。
她自幼立志成为一名职业音乐家。
这位爵士音乐家在音乐会上即兴发挥得淋漓尽致。

definitions.definition: 必须（表示必要性或强烈建议）
必不可少的事物（如 "a must-see film"）

en: You must finish your homework before playing.
This exhibition is a must for art lovers.
He must be tired after working 12 hours straight.
cn: 你必须写完作业才能玩。
这个展览是艺术爱好者的必看项目。
他连续工作12小时后一定很累了。

en: The violinist used a mute to soften the instrument's tone.
He remained mute during the entire interrogation.
Please mute your microphone when not speaking.
cn: 小提琴手用弱音器使琴音变得柔和。
整个审讯过程中他保持沉默。
不发言时请将麦克风静音。

en: She muttered under her breath about the unfair rules.
The old man muttered a prayer before eating.
His mutter was barely audible over the noise.
cn: 她低声抱怨不公平的规定。
老人吃饭前低声念了祷词。
在嘈杂声中，他的嘀咕几乎听不见。

en: Roast mutton was a staple at medieval feasts.
She prefers mutton over lamb for its richer flavor.
The stew uses tender mutton and fresh herbs.
cn: 烤羊肉是中世纪宴会的主菜。
她喜欢羊肉胜过羔羊肉，因其风味更浓郁。
这道炖菜用了嫩羊肉和新鲜香草。

en: Their mutual respect strengthened their partnership.
The project was a mutual effort between two departments.
We have mutual friends in this small town.
cn: 他们彼此的尊重巩固了他们的合作关系。
这个项目是两个部门共同努力的结果。
在这个小镇上，我们有共同的朋友。

definitions.definition: 我的（第一人称所有格形式）

en: This is my favorite book.
My dog always barks at strangers.
She borrowed my pen without asking.
cn: 这是我最喜欢的书。
我的狗总是对陌生人叫。
她没问我就借走了我的笔。

definitions.definition: 我自己（反身代词，强调主语或宾语与自身的关系）

en: I taught myself how to play the guitar.
I need to remind myself to call her tomorrow.
The manager himself/myself will handle the complaint.
cn: 我自学了吉他。
我需要提醒自己明天给她打电话。
经理本人/我本人将处理投诉。

en: The ancient temple had a mysterious aura that fascinated archaeologists.
She gave him a mysterious smile without explanation.
The disappearance of the ship remains a mysterious event.
cn: 这座古庙有一种吸引考古学家的神秘氛围。
她对他露出一个神秘的微笑，未作解释。
船只的消失仍是一桩谜案。

definitions.definition: 神秘，谜团（难以理解或解释的事物）
（宗教）奥秘（特指基督教中超越人类理解的教义）

en: The origin of the ancient ruins remains a mystery.
The ceremony was part of the Eleusinian mysteries.
She has an air of mystery that intrigues people.
cn: 这座古代遗迹的起源仍是个谜。
该仪式是厄琉西斯秘仪的一部分。
她身上有种吸引人的神秘气质。

definitions.definition: 钉牢；抓住（机会）；揭露（罪行）

en: She painted her nails bright red.
He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wood.
The detective finally nailed the suspect with solid evidence.
cn: 她把指甲涂成了亮红色。
他用锤子把钉子钉进木头。
侦探最终用确凿证据抓住了嫌疑人。

definitions.definition: 赤裸裸的；直白的（比喻义）

en: The child ran naked through the sprinklers.
Her naked emotions shocked the audience.
The tree stood naked against the winter sky.
cn: 孩子光着身子在洒水器间奔跑。
她赤裸的情感让观众震惊。
光秃的树矗立在冬日的天空下。

en: Her name is inscribed on the monument.
The scientist named the new species after her mentor.
He made a name for himself in the tech industry.
cn: 她的名字刻在纪念碑上。
这位科学家以导师的名字为新物种命名。
他在科技行业赢得了声誉。

definitions.definition: 即，也就是（用于具体列举或说明）

en: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah, and Lisa.
The menu offers local specialties, namely seafood and wild mushrooms.
He has one hobby, namely collecting vintage stamps.
cn: 提到了三名学生，即约翰、莎拉和丽莎。
菜单提供本地特色菜，也就是海鲜和野生菌。
他有一个爱好，即收集老邮票。

en: She took a quick nap after lunch.
The baby napped peacefully in the crib.
A short nap can boost your productivity.
cn: 她午饭后小睡了一会儿。
婴儿在婴儿床上安静地打着盹。
小睡片刻能提高工作效率。

en: The path was too narrow for two people to walk side by side.
We need to narrow our focus to the key issues.
Her eyes narrowed as she examined the document.
cn: 这条小路太窄，无法容纳两人并肩而行。
我们需要将注意力集中在关键问题上。
她眯起眼睛仔细查看文件。

en: The kitchen was left in a nasty mess after the party.
She gave him a nasty look when he interrupted her.
The weather turned nasty, with heavy rain and strong winds.
cn: 派对后厨房变得一片狼藉。
他打断她时，她投去一个恶狠狠的眼神。
天气骤变，暴雨狂风交加。

en: The United Nations promotes peace among nations.
The Navajo Nation has its own laws and government.
A nation’s culture reflects its history and values.
cn: 联合国促进国家间的和平。
纳瓦霍部落联盟拥有自己的法律和政府。
一个民族的文化反映其历史与价值观。

en: The national anthem played before the sports event.
She is a French national working in Japan.
Protecting national security is a top priority.
cn: 体育赛事开始前奏响了国歌。
她是一名在日本工作的法国公民。
维护国家安全是首要任务。

en: She holds dual nationality in Canada and France.
The festival celebrates the rich nationality of the region.
His nationality was questioned due to unclear documentation.
cn: 她拥有加拿大和法国的双重国籍。
这个节日展现了该地区丰富的民族特色。
由于文件不清晰，他的国籍受到质疑。

en: She is a native speaker of French.
The plant is native to South America.
His native intelligence impressed everyone.
cn: 她是法语母语者。
这种植物原产于南美洲。
他与生俱来的智慧令所有人印象深刻。

definitions.definition: 有天赋的人（非正式用法）

en: She has a natural talent for music.
This park preserves the natural beauty of the area.
It's natural to feel nervous before a performance.
cn: 她拥有音乐天赋。
这座公园保留了该地区的自然美景。
演出前感到紧张是人之常情。

en: Plants grow naturally in this fertile soil.
She was naturally gifted in music.
Naturally, you'll need to confirm your attendance.
cn: 植物在这片肥沃的土壤中自然生长。
她在音乐方面天赋异禀。
当然，你需要确认是否出席。

definitions.definition: 自然（指物质世界及其现象）
本性，天性（人或事物的固有特质）

en: The beauty of nature inspires many artists.
It's human nature to seek companionship.
The chemical behaves differently in nature than in labs.
cn: 自然之美激励着许多艺术家。
寻求陪伴是人的天性。
这种化学物质在自然环境中的表现与实验室中不同。

definitions.definition: 顽皮的，淘气的（尤指儿童）

en: The teacher scolded the naughty boy for drawing on his desk.
Her dog gave her a naughty look before stealing the cookie.
It's just a naughty joke, don't take it seriously.
cn: 老师批评了那个淘气的男孩，因为他在课桌上画画。
她的狗偷饼干前，调皮地看了她一眼。
这只是个无伤大雅的玩笑，别当真。

en: The naval fleet conducted exercises in the Pacific.
She wore a uniform with naval insignia.
The country invested heavily in naval defense.
cn: 海军舰队在太平洋进行了演习。
她穿着带有海军徽章的制服。
该国在海军防御上投入了大量资金。

en: Modern ships rely on satellite systems for precise navigation.
Early explorers used the stars for ocean navigation.
The app provides real-time navigation for drivers.
cn: 现代船舶依赖卫星系统实现精准导航。
早期的探险家依靠星星进行海洋航行。
这款应用为驾驶员提供实时导航。

en: The navy conducted joint exercises with allied forces.
She wore a dress in classic navy.
Ancient Rome relied heavily on its navy for trade and defense.
cn: 海军与盟军进行了联合演习。
她穿了一条经典海军蓝的裙子。
古罗马极度依赖其海军进行贸易和防御。

en: The train station is quite near the hotel.
She came near to winning the race.
Don't go near the edge of the cliff.
cn: 火车站离酒店很近。
她差点赢得比赛。
不要靠近悬崖边缘。

en: There's a grocery store nearby.
She lives nearby and often visits us.
The explosion was heard by people nearby.
cn: 附近有一家杂货店。
她住在附近，经常来看我们。
附近的人们听到了爆炸声。

en: She nearly missed the train because of traffic.
The project is nearly finished after months of work.
They are nearly related, sharing the same grandparents.
cn: 她因为堵车差点错过火车。
经过数月工作，项目已接近完成。
他们关系很近，拥有共同的祖父母。

en: She keeps her desk neat and organized.
He made a neat fold in the paper.
I prefer my whiskey neat, without ice.
cn: 她的书桌保持得整洁有序。
他在纸上折出了一个整齐的折痕。
我喜欢纯饮威士忌，不加冰。

definitions.definition: 必需地（用于否定句，表示“不一定”）

en: Success doesn't necessarily come from hard work alone.
The plan will necessarily involve some risks.
Expensive food isn't necessarily better.
cn: 成功未必仅源于努力。
该计划必然伴随一定风险。
昂贵的食物不一定更好。

definitions.definition: 必需品（常用复数形式 necessaries）

en: Sleep is necessary for good health.
She packed the necessaries for her trip.
It’s necessary to check the facts before reporting.
cn: 睡眠对健康是必要的。
她打包了旅行的必需品。
报道前核实事实是必要的。

definitions.definition: 必然性（哲学或逻辑概念）

en: Clean water is a basic necessity of life.
The necessity of vaccination became clear during the pandemic.
Logical necessity dictates that all humans are mortal.
cn: 清洁水是生活的基本必需品。
疫情期间，接种疫苗的必要性变得显而易见。
逻辑必然性决定了人类终有一死。

definitions.definition: 脖子；衣领；狭窄部分（如瓶颈）
搂住脖子亲吻；缩小…的宽度

en: She wore a scarf around her neck to keep warm.
The bottle has a narrow neck that makes pouring difficult.
They necked under the stars like teenagers.
cn: 她围着围巾保暖脖子。
这个瓶子的瓶颈很窄，倒起来很费劲。
他们像青少年一样在星空下拥吻。

en: She wore a pearl necklace to the gala.
The antique gold necklace was a family heirloom.
He gifted her a handmade glass bead necklace.
cn: 她在晚宴上戴了一条珍珠项链。
这条古董金项链是家族传家宝。
他送给她一条手工制作的玻璃珠项链。

en: There is an urgent need for clean water in the disaster area.
You need to submit the report by Friday.
His kindness met her emotional needs.
cn: 灾区急需清洁用水。
你必须在周五前提交报告。
他的善意满足了她的情感需求。

en: She threaded the needle with steady hands.
The compass needle points north.
His sarcastic remarks needled her into anger.
cn: 她稳稳地将线穿过针眼。
指南针的指针指向北方。
他讽刺的话语激怒了她。

en: The document was full of needless repetitions.
She avoided needless conflicts at work.
His elaborate explanation proved needless—we already understood.
cn: 这份文件充斥着不必要的重复内容。
她在工作中避免了无谓的冲突。
他详尽的解释被证明是多余的，我们早就明白了。

en: She gave a negative answer to the proposal.
The battery has a negative terminal and a positive one.
Constant criticism can have a negative impact on confidence.
cn: 她对提议给出了否定答复。
电池有一个负极和一个正极。
持续的批评会对自信心产生负面影响。

en: She neglected her studies during the holidays.
The old house showed signs of neglect.
Never neglect the importance of small details.
cn: 她在假期里荒废了学业。
这栋老房子显露出被忽视的痕迹。
切勿忽视小细节的重要性。

definitions.definition: （过时或冒犯性用语）黑人（源自西班牙语/葡萄牙语，历史上用于指代非洲裔人群）

en: The term "negro" was once commonly used in official documents.
Modern language guidelines discourage the use of "negro" due to its offensive connotations.
In Spanish, "negro" simply means the color black without negative implications.
cn: 中文翻译："negro"一词曾普遍用于官方文件。
中文翻译：现代语言规范因其冒犯性含义不鼓励使用"negro"。
中文翻译：在西班牙语中，"negro"仅表示黑色，无负面含义。

en: My neighbour waters my plants when I'm on vacation.
Canada neighbours the United States to the north.
A good neighbour is better than a distant friend.
cn: 我度假时邻居会帮我浇花。
加拿大与美国北部接壤。
远亲不如近邻。

en: The new café has become a popular spot in the neighbourhood.
A strong sense of belonging defines our neighbourhood.
The project aims to improve safety in urban neighbourhoods.
cn: 这家新咖啡馆已成为社区的热门地点。
强烈的归属感是我们社区的特色。
该项目旨在提升城市社区的安全性。

definitions.definition: 也不（用于否定句后引出另一否定内容）

en: Neither answer is correct.
She didn't call, neither did she text.
"I don't like coffee." "Neither do I."
cn: 两个答案都不对。
她没打电话，也没发短信。
“我不喜欢咖啡。”“我也不喜欢。”

en: My nephew just started his first year at university.
She gifted her nephew a handmade sweater for Christmas.
In some cultures, the term "nephew" may include cousins.
cn: 我的侄子刚进入大学一年级。
她为外甥织了一件毛衣作为圣诞礼物。
在某些文化中，“nephew”一词可能涵盖堂表兄弟的子辈。

definitions.definition: 使鼓起勇气（常用短语：nerve oneself）

en: The optic nerve carries visual signals to the brain.
It took all her nerve to speak in front of the crowd.
He nerved himself to ask for a promotion.
cn: 视神经将视觉信号传递到大脑。
她鼓起全部勇气才在人群前发言。
他鼓起勇气要求升职。

en: She felt nervous before her speech.
The nervous system controls body functions.
His nervous laughter revealed his anxiety.
cn: 她在演讲前感到紧张。
神经系统控制身体机能。
他不安的笑声暴露了焦虑。

definitions.definition: 巢，窝；舒适的地方；藏匿处

en: The bird built a nest high in the oak tree.
The software uses nested loops to process data.
She found a cozy nest of blankets on the sofa.
cn: 这只鸟在橡树高处筑了一个巢。
该软件使用嵌套循环处理数据。
她在沙发上发现了一个用毯子堆成的舒适小窝。

en: The fisherman cast his net into the sea.
Our company netted $1 million last year.
The basketball swooshed through the net.
cn: 渔民将渔网撒入海中。
我们公司去年净赚100万美元。
篮球唰地穿过篮网。

definitions.definition: 网络（由相互连接的节点或部分组成的系统）
人际关系网；业务联系网
将多台计算机或其他设备连接成网络

en: The internet is a global network of computers.
She built a strong professional network during her career.
The office computers are networked for file sharing.
cn: 互联网是一个全球性的计算机网络。
她在职业生涯中建立了强大的人脉网络。
办公室的电脑联网以实现文件共享。

en: Switzerland remained neutral during both World Wars.
The scientist tested the substance with a neutral pH.
Her tone was deliberately neutral to avoid controversy.
cn: 瑞士在两次世界大战中均保持中立。
科学家测试了pH值中性的物质。
她的语气刻意保持中立，以避免争议。

en: She never drinks coffee after 5 PM.
I will never forget your kindness.
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
cn: 她下午五点后从不喝咖啡。
我绝不会忘记你的善意。
我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

en: The weather was terrible; nevertheless, we had a great time.
She was exhausted; nevertheless, she finished the project on time.
The plan has risks. Nevertheless, it's worth trying.
cn: 天气很糟糕，但我们依然玩得很开心。
她筋疲力尽，但仍按时完成了项目。
这个计划有风险，但值得一试。

en: She bought a new dress for the party.
This concept is completely new to me.
The new version of the software has fewer bugs.
cn: 她为派对买了一条新裙子。
这个概念对我来说完全陌生。
软件的新版本漏洞更少。

en: The newly elected president gave an inspiring speech.
She looked at the world with newly awakened curiosity.
The apartment was newly furnished with modern pieces.
cn: 新当选的总统发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。
她以新觉醒的好奇心观察世界。
这套公寓新配备了现代家具。

en: The news about the election spread quickly.
She watches the news every evening.
Do you have any news from your brother?
cn: 关于选举的新闻迅速传播。
她每晚都看新闻。
你有你兄弟的消息吗？

en: She reads the newspaper every morning with her coffee.
The newspaper published an exclusive interview with the mayor.
Old newspapers can be recycled into packaging materials.
cn: 她每天早晨边喝咖啡边读报纸。
该报刊登了对市长的独家专访。
旧报纸可回收制成包装材料。

en: The next train arrives at 9:15 AM.
She finished her coffee and next checked her emails.
Turn left at the next intersection.
cn: 下一班火车将在上午9:15到达。
她喝完咖啡，然后查看了邮件。
在下一个路口左转。

en: She gave me a nice smile when I entered the room.
The chef made a nice distinction between the two spices.
We had a nice time at the beach yesterday.
cn: 我走进房间时，她对我友好地笑了笑。
厨师精准区分了这两种香料。
昨天我们在海滩度过了愉快的时光。

en: My niece just started her first year at university.
She loves baking cookies with her little niece.
His niece inherited his artistic talent.
cn: 我的侄女刚上大学一年级。
她喜欢和她的小外甥女一起烤饼干。
他的外甥女继承了他的艺术天赋。

en: The stars shine brightly at night.
She prefers to work late into the night.
The temperature drops quickly after night falls.
cn: 夜晚星星闪烁。
她喜欢工作到深夜。
夜幕降临后气温骤降。

en: She has nine cats in her apartment.
The meeting starts at nine o'clock sharp.
Nine out of ten doctors recommend this method.
cn: 她的公寓里有九只猫。
会议九点整开始。
十位医生中有九位推荐这种方法。

en: She celebrated her nineteenth birthday last week.
The train departs at nineteen minutes past the hour.
Nineteen students passed the advanced exam.
cn: 她上周庆祝了她的十九岁生日。
火车在每个钟点的十九分时发车。
十九名学生通过了高级考试。

en: She lived to be ninety years old.
The temperature reached ninety degrees today.
Ninety percent of the students passed the exam.
cn: 她活到了九十岁。
今天气温达到了九十度。
百分之九十的学生通过了考试。

en: She finished in ninth place in the race.
The ninth chapter of the book is the most challenging.
Cut the cake into ninths so everyone gets an equal share.
cn: 她在比赛中获得第九名。
这本书的第九章是最难的。
将蛋糕切成九等份，这样每人分到的量相同。

definitions.definition: 氮（一种无色无味的化学元素，符号N，原子序数7）

en: Nitrogen is essential for plant growth.
The atmosphere consists of about 78% nitrogen.
Liquid nitrogen is used to preserve biological samples.
cn: 氮是植物生长必需的元素。
大气中约78%是氮气。
液氮用于保存生物样本。

definitions.definition: 不，没有（用于否定回答或陈述）

en: "No, I don't agree with that proposal."
"There is no water left in the bottle."
"The committee voted with 5 yeses and 2 nos."
cn: 不，我不同意那个提议。
瓶子里没有水了。
委员会投票结果为5票赞成、2票反对。

en: She was born into a noble family with a long history.
His noble actions inspired everyone around him.
The castle stood on a noble hill, overlooking the valley.
cn: 她出身于一个历史悠久的贵族家庭。
他高尚的行为激励了周围的人。
城堡矗立在一座宏伟的山丘上，俯瞰山谷。

en: Nobody knows the answer to this question.
She felt like a nobody in the crowded city.
The room was empty—nobody had arrived yet.
cn: 没有人知道这个问题的答案。
在这座拥挤的城市里，她觉得自己是个无名小卒。
房间里空无一人——还没人到场。

definitions.definition: 点头（表示同意、问候或示意）

en: She gave a slight nod to acknowledge his presence.
The professor nodded in approval during the student's presentation.
A nod is often enough to seal an agreement in some cultures.
cn: 她轻轻点头示意注意到他的存在。
学生在汇报时，教授赞许地点了点头。
在某些文化中，点头便足以达成协议。

en: The construction noise made it impossible to concentrate.
She noised the scandal around the office.
White noise helps some people sleep better.
cn: 施工噪音让人无法集中注意力。
她在办公室里散布了这桩丑闻。
白噪音能帮助一些人睡得更好。

definitions.definition: （颜色、图案等）过分鲜艳的，花哨的

en: The classroom became noisy after the teacher left.
She wore a noisy dress with bright patterns.
The noisy fan kept me awake all night.
cn: 老师离开后，教室变得喧闹起来。
她穿了一条图案鲜艳、花里胡哨的裙子。
吵闹的风扇让我整夜无法入睡。

en: None of the students finished the assignment on time.
She wanted none of his excuses.
The food was none too fresh, but we ate it anyway.
cn: 没有一个学生按时完成作业。
她不想听他的任何借口。
食物一点也不新鲜，但我们还是吃了。

definitions.definition: 无意义的话或行为；荒谬的想法

en: Don't listen to him—he's talking nonsense.
The policy was criticized as bureaucratic nonsense.
She dismissed the rumor as complete nonsense.
cn: 别听他的，他在胡说八道。
该政策被批为官僚主义的荒谬之举。
她认为这个谣言纯属无稽之谈。

definitions.definition: 正午，中午（太阳位于天空最高点的时刻）

en: We agreed to meet at noon sharp.
The sun casts almost no shadow at noon.
By noon, the temperature had risen to 30°C.
cn: 我们约定正午准时见面。
正午时分，太阳几乎不会投下影子。
到中午时，气温已升至30摄氏度。

definitions.definition: 也不（用于否定句后引出另一否定项）

en: She neither smiled nor spoke.
The device has no buttons nor touchscreen.
He can't swim, nor can his brother.
cn: 她既不笑也不说话。
该设备既无按钮也无触屏。
他不会游泳，他弟弟也不会。

en: Her temperature is back to normal.
The factory operates under normal conditions.
He just wants to live a normal life.
cn: 她的体温恢复了正常。
工厂在标准条件下运行。
他只想过平凡的生活。

en: She normally leaves work at 6 p.m.
The system functions normally under these conditions.
Normally, I wouldn’t agree, but this case is special.
cn: 她通常下午六点下班。
在此条件下，系统运行正常。
通常我不会同意，但这次例外。

en: The wind blew fiercely from the north.
She lives in the north of Canada.
The compass needle always points north.
cn: 寒风从北方猛烈吹来。
她住在加拿大北部。
指南针的指针总指向北方。

en: The wind is blowing from the northeast today.
They traveled northeast to reach the coastal town.
Hokkaido is in the northeast of Japan.
cn: 今天刮的是东北风。
他们向东北方向行进，抵达了海滨小镇。
北海道位于日本的东北地区。

en: The northern lights are a spectacular natural phenomenon.
She moved to a small town in northern Canada.
A cold northern wind blew across the plains.
cn: 北极光是一种壮观的自然现象。
她搬到了加拿大北部的一个小镇。
寒冷的北风掠过平原。

en: The wind is blowing from the northwest today.
They traveled northwest to reach the mountains.
Seattle is a major city in the northwest of the United States.
cn: 今天刮的是西北风。
他们向西北行进以抵达山区。
西雅图是美国西北部的主要城市。

definitions.definition: 鼻子；嗅觉；前端突出部分

en: She wrinkled her nose at the strange smell.
The ship nosed its way through the ice.
He has a keen nose for business opportunities.
cn: 她闻到怪味时皱起了鼻子。
船谨慎地破冰航行。
他对商机有着敏锐的嗅觉。

definitions.definition: 不（用于否定动词、形容词或其他副词）

en: She is not ready for the exam.
This answer is not correct.
They did not notice the warning sign.
cn: 她还没准备好考试。
这个答案不正确。
他们没有注意到警告标志。

en: She took detailed notes during the lecture.
The musician played a high-pitched note.
Please note the changes in the schedule.
cn: 她在讲座中做了详细笔记。
音乐家弹奏了一个高音符。
请注意日程表的变动。

definitions.definition: 笔记本（用于书写或记录的装订纸张）
笔记本电脑（便携式计算机的非正式名称）

en: She scribbled the phone number in her notebook.
The scientist carried a field notebook to document observations.
My new notebook has a battery life of 10 hours.
cn: 她在笔记本上匆匆记下了电话号码。
这位科学家带着野外记录本以记录观察结果。
我的新笔记本电脑电池续航达10小时。

en: There is nothing left in the fridge.
She said nothing about the incident.
His opinion means nothing to me.
cn: 冰箱里什么也没剩。
她对这件事只字未提。
他的看法对我毫无意义。

en: The school posted a notice about the upcoming holiday.
Did you notice the strange noise last night?
She gave me two weeks' notice before resigning.
cn: 学校张贴了关于即将到来的假期的通知。
你注意到昨晚的奇怪声响了吗？
她在辞职前提前两周通知了我。

definitions.definition: 显而易见的，值得注意的

en: The stain on his shirt was noticeable even from a distance.
There has been a noticeable improvement in her pronunciation.
The lack of lighting made the path less noticeable at night.
cn: 他衬衫上的污渍即使从远处看也很明显。
她的发音有了明显进步。
光线不足使这条小路在夜晚不易被察觉。

definitions.definition: 名词（表示人、事物、地点或抽象概念的词类）

en: "The word 'book' is a countable noun."
"In Latin, every noun has a gender."
"She struggled to identify abstract nouns in the text."
cn: “book”是一个可数名词。
在拉丁语中，每个名词都有性别。
她难以识别文中的抽象名词。

en: She published her first novel at the age of 25.
The design is novel yet functional.
His approach to teaching is completely novel.
cn: 她在25岁时出版了第一部小说。
这个设计新颖且实用。
他的教学方法完全别出心裁。

definitions.definition: 十一月（公历第十一个月）

en: The election is scheduled for the first Tuesday of November.
November in this region brings crisp air and golden leaves.
Her birthday falls on November 15th.
cn: 选举定于十一月的第一个星期二举行。
这里的十一月空气清冽，树叶金黄。
她的生日是十一月十五日。

en: She is busy now and can't answer the phone.
Now that you mention it, I do remember the incident.
The project must be finished now, not tomorrow.
cn: 她现在很忙，没法接电话。
既然你提到这件事，我确实想起来了。
这个项目必须现在完成，不能拖到明天。

definitions.definition: 现今，当今（指与过去对比的现在时段）

en: Nowadays, people rely heavily on smartphones.
The pollution problem is more serious nowadays than in the past.
Nowadays, remote work has become a common practice.
cn: 当今人们高度依赖智能手机。
现今的污染问题比过去更严重。
如今远程办公已成为普遍现象。

definitions.definition: 不存在的地方；未知的地方

en: The missing book was nowhere to be found.
His ideas came from nowhere, surprising everyone.
She felt stuck in a nowhere job with no future.
cn: 那本丢失的书无处可寻。
他的想法凭空出现，让所有人惊讶。
她觉得自己困在一份毫无前途的工作中。

en: The nuclear reactor provides clean energy for the city.
Scientists study nuclear fusion to replicate the sun's energy process.
The treaty aims to reduce the threat of nuclear war.
cn: 这座核反应堆为城市提供清洁能源。
科学家研究核聚变以模拟太阳的能量产生过程。
该条约旨在降低核战争威胁。

definitions.definition: 核心，中心（如原子核、细胞核）
起点，基础（抽象概念的核心部分）

en: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
This idea formed the nucleus of their new theory.
The cell nucleus controls genetic activity.
cn: 原子核由质子和中子组成。
这一观点构成了他们新理论的基础。
细胞核控制遗传活动。

definitions.definition: 令人讨厌的人或事物；麻烦

en: The noisy construction work became a nuisance to the neighborhood.
Mosquitoes are a nuisance during summer evenings.
Don’t make a nuisance of yourself at the party.
cn: 嘈杂的施工成了附近居民的烦心事。
蚊子是夏夜里的讨厌鬼。
别在聚会上惹人厌。

en: The number of participants increased to 200.
Please number the pages before submitting.
She felt a number of conflicting emotions.
cn: 参与人数增加到了200人。
提交前请为页码编号。
她感到多种矛盾的情绪。

en: The library contains numerous books on ancient history.
She has received numerous awards for her scientific research.
Numerous studies have confirmed the benefits of exercise.
cn: 图书馆藏有大量关于古代历史的书籍。
她因科学研究获得了许多奖项。
大量研究证实了锻炼的好处。

en: She trained for three years to become a nurse.
The mother nursed her baby while reading a book.
He carefully nursed the injured bird back to health.
cn: 她接受了三年培训成为一名护士。
这位母亲一边读书一边给婴儿喂奶。
他精心照料这只受伤的鸟直至康复。

en: She dropped her son at the nursery before work.
The botanical garden has a nursery for rare plants.
His childhood was spent in the nursery of a wealthy family.
cn: 她上班前把儿子送到了托儿所。
植物园设有珍稀植物苗圃。
他的童年在一个富裕家庭的育儿室度过。

en: Squirrels store nuts for the winter.
Tighten the nut with a wrench.
He’s a complete nut about football.
cn: 松鼠为冬天储存坚果。
用扳手拧紧螺母。
他是个十足的足球疯子。

definitions.definition: 尼龙（一种合成纤维材料）
尼龙制品（如袜子、绳索等）

en: She wore a dress made of nylon.
Nylon ropes are stronger than natural fiber ones.
The invention of nylon revolutionized the textile industry.
cn: 她穿了一条尼龙材质的连衣裙。
尼龙绳比天然纤维绳更结实。
尼龙的发明彻底改变了纺织业。

en: The old oak tree in the village square has stood for over 300 years.
This table is made of solid oak, giving it a rustic charm.
Acorns from the oak provide food for many forest animals.
cn: 村广场上的老橡树已屹立了三百余年。
这张桌子由实心橡木制成，散发着质朴的魅力。
橡树的果实为许多森林动物提供食物。

en: He dipped the oar into the water and rowed steadily.
The fisherman lost an oar in the storm.
Each rower must synchronize their oar strokes.
cn: 他将桨划入水中，平稳地划船。
渔夫在暴风雨中丢失了一支桨。
每位划桨者必须同步划桨动作。

en: Soldiers must obey orders without question.
The dog obeyed immediately when its owner whistled.
Laws exist to be obeyed, not ignored.
cn: 士兵必须无条件服从命令。
主人一吹口哨，狗立刻听话了。
法律的存在是为了被遵守，而非忽视。

en: The strange object in the sky turned out to be a weather balloon.
She objected to the proposal on ethical grounds.
In the sentence "I see the cat," "the cat" is the direct object.
cn: 天空中那个奇怪的物体原来是一个气象气球。
她基于道德理由反对这项提案。
在句子“我看见猫”中，“猫”是直接宾语。

en: She raised an objection to the proposed changes.
The lawyer’s objection was overruled by the judge.
His main objection was the lack of evidence.
cn: 她对提议的修改提出了反对。
律师的抗议被法官驳回。
他的主要异议是缺乏证据。

en: The main objective of this project is to reduce costs.
Scientists must remain objective when analyzing data.
Her performance review included both subjective and objective assessments.
cn: 该项目的主要目标是降低成本。
科学家分析数据时必须保持客观。
她的绩效评估包含主观和客观评价。

definitions.definition: 迫使，要求（法律或道德义务）
施恩惠于，帮助（出于善意）

en: The law obliges companies to pay taxes.
She obliged me with a loan when I was in trouble.
I'd be happy to oblige if you need help.
cn: 法律强制企业纳税。
我陷入困境时，她慷慨借款相助。
如需帮助，我乐意效劳。

en: The scientist recorded her observations in a notebook.
His witty observation made everyone laugh.
Close observation of animal behavior reveals fascinating patterns.
cn: 科学家将她的观察记录在笔记本中。
他机智的评论逗笑了所有人。
对动物行为的密切观察揭示了迷人的模式。

en: Scientists observe the behavior of ants to understand their social structure.
Drivers must observe traffic rules for safety.
"The sky looks unusually clear tonight," he observed.
cn: 科学家观察蚂蚁行为以理解其社会结构。
驾驶员必须遵守交通规则以确保安全。
“今晚天空异常晴朗，”他评论道。

en: The scientist remained a silent observer during the experiment.
UN observers were sent to monitor the ceasefire.
As an artist, she trained herself to be a keen observer of human behavior.
cn: 科学家在实验中始终保持沉默观察。
联合国观察员被派去监督停火协议。
作为艺术家，她训练自己成为人类行为的敏锐观察者。

en: The fallen tree was an obstacle to traffic.
Lack of funding is the main obstacle to the project.
She overcame every obstacle with determination.
cn: 倒下的树成了交通障碍。
资金短缺是该项目的主要阻碍。
她以决心克服了每一个困难。

definitions.definition: 获得，得到（通过努力或请求）

en: She managed to obtain a rare copy of the book.
This custom still obtains in some rural areas.
The data was obtained through rigorous experiments.
cn: 她成功获得了这本书的珍本。
这一习俗仍在部分农村地区流行。
数据是通过严谨的实验获得的。

en: The solution to the problem was obvious once he explained it.
Her disappointment was obvious from her facial expression.
It's obvious that regular exercise improves health.
cn: 一旦他解释后，问题的解决方案就显而易见了。
她的失望从表情中一目了然。
定期锻炼有益健康，这是显而易见的。

en: She was obviously nervous during the speech.
The answer is obviously wrong.
He obviously didn't read the instructions.
cn: 她在演讲时明显很紧张。
这个答案显然是错的。
他显然没看说明书。

en: The wedding was a joyous occasion for everyone.
She took the occasion to announce her new project.
His rude behavior occasioned many complaints.
cn: 这场婚礼对所有人来说都是欢乐的时刻。
她借此机会宣布了自己的新项目。
他的粗鲁行为引发了许多抱怨。

en: She enjoys an occasional glass of wine with dinner.
The room was decorated with occasional balloons for the celebration.
He works as an occasional consultant for the company.
cn: 她偶尔喜欢在晚餐时喝一杯葡萄酒。
房间里零星点缀着为庆祝准备的气球。
他偶尔为这家公司担任顾问。

en: She occasionally visits her grandparents on weekends.
The old camera works fine, but it occasionally jams.
He is strict but occasionally shows a sense of humor.
cn: 她偶尔在周末去看望祖父母。
这台旧相机运作良好，但偶尔会卡住。
他很严格，但偶尔会流露出幽默感。

en: Teaching is her chosen occupation.
The building was under enemy occupation during the war.
Gardening is a relaxing occupation for retirees.
cn: 教学是她选择的职业。
战争期间这栋建筑被敌军占领。
园艺是退休人士的休闲活动。

en: The army decided to occupy the strategic town.
Her work occupies most of her time.
He occupied himself with reading during the flight.
cn: 军队决定占领这个战略重镇。
她的工作占据了她大部分时间。
他在飞行期间以阅读消磨时间。

definitions.definition: 被想到（常与 to 连用）

en: The accident occurred at midnight.
A brilliant idea occurred to her while showering.
Errors may occur if the system is overloaded.
cn: 事故发生在午夜。
洗澡时她突然想到一个绝妙的主意。
系统超载时可能出现错误。

definitions.definition: （尤指意外或不寻常的）出现，发生

en: The frequent occurrence of earthquakes in this region worries the locals.
Such a strange occurrence has never been recorded before.
The software logs every occurrence of an error for debugging.
cn: 该地区频繁的地震事件让当地人忧心忡忡。
如此异常的现象此前从未被记录过。
该软件会记录每次错误的发生以便调试。

definitions.definition: 海洋（指地球上的广阔咸水体）
大量，广阔（比喻用法，如 an ocean of time）

en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
She felt an ocean of gratitude for their help.
Ancient maps often depicted monsters at the edge of the ocean.
cn: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。
她对他们的帮助心怀无尽的感激。
古地图常在海洋边缘绘制怪物形象。

definitions.definition: 十月（现代公历的第十个月份）

en: The leaves turn golden in October.
Oktoberfest actually starts in late September.
October's birthstone is the opal.
cn: 十月的树叶会变成金黄色。
啤酒节实际上始于九月下旬。
十月的诞生石是蛋白石。

definitions.definition: 临时的，零散的（如 odd jobs）

en: She gave him an odd look when he started singing in the library.
The houses on this street are numbered with odd numbers on the left.
He does odd jobs like gardening and pet-sitting to earn extra money.
cn: 当他开始在图书馆唱歌时，她奇怪地看了他一眼。
这条街的房子左侧标着奇数门牌号。
他靠做园艺和照看宠物之类的零工赚外快。

definitions.definition: 气味（尤指强烈或特殊的气味，可指香味或臭味）

en: The odour of fresh bread filled the bakery.
A strange odour came from the abandoned house.
The chemical leaves a persistent odour on fabrics.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫着面包店。
废弃的房屋里传来一股怪味。
这种化学品会在织物上留下持久气味。

definitions.definition: 表示所属、来源、材料、部分等关系

en: The cover of the book is torn.
She drank a cup of tea.
The city of Paris is known for its art.
cn: 这本书的封面破了。
她喝了一杯茶。
巴黎市以其艺术闻名。

en: She turned off the lights before leaving.
The sale is 20% off all items.
The milk smells off.
cn: 她离开前关了灯。
全部商品八折出售。
这牛奶闻起来不新鲜了。

en: His rude comments offended many attendees.
The design offends against basic principles of aesthetics.
She didn't mean to offend you with her joke.
cn: 他的粗鲁言论冒犯了许多与会者。
该设计违背了美学的基本原则。
她并非有意用玩笑冒犯你。

en: She offered me a cup of tea when I arrived.
The company made a generous offer for the startup.
He declined the job offer to pursue further studies.
cn: 我到访时，她给我端了一杯茶。
该公司为这家初创企业提出了慷慨的收购报价。
他拒绝了工作录取通知，选择继续深造。

definitions.definition: 办公室；办事处；官职；职责

en: She works in a busy office downtown.
He was elected to the office of mayor last year.
It’s my office to ensure safety protocols are followed.
cn: 她在市中心一间繁忙的办公室工作。
他去年当选市长职位。
我的职责是确保安全规程被遵守。

en: She was promoted to the rank of senior officer last year.
The police officer directed traffic during the parade.
The company will officer the new branch with experienced managers.
cn: 她去年晋升为高级军官。
游行期间，这名警官指挥了交通。
公司将派遣经验丰富的经理管理新分部。

en: The official statement will be released tomorrow.
She is a high-ranking official in the ministry.
Wearing a suit makes the occasion feel more official.
cn: 官方声明将于明日发布。
她是该部门的一名高级官员。
穿西装会让场合显得更正式。

en: She often visits her grandparents on weekends.
Mistakes are often the best teachers.
He often forgets to bring his lunch to work.
cn: 她经常在周末看望祖父母。
错误往往是最好的老师。
他时常忘记带午餐上班。

definitions.definition: 表示惊讶、感叹、回应或停顿的语气词

en: Oh, I didn't see you there!
Oh... I'm not sure about that.
Oh! That's amazing!
cn: 哦，我刚才没看到你！
呃…我对这事不太确定。
哇！太棒了！

en: She drizzled olive oil over the salad.
The engine needs regular oil changes.
They drilled for oil in the desert.
cn: 她在沙拉上淋了橄榄油。
发动机需要定期更换机油。
他们在沙漠中钻探石油。

definitions.definition: /adv. 好的；可以的（表示同意或认可）

en: She gave an okay to the project proposal.
"Are you okay?" he asked with concern.
The system check returned an okay status.
cn: 她批准了该项目提案。
“你还好吗？”他关切地问道。
系统检查返回了正常状态。

definitions.definition: 陈旧的；熟悉的（如 old friend）

en: This castle is over 500 years old.
She gave away her old clothes to charity.
He's an old hand at woodworking.
cn: 这座城堡有五百多年的历史。
她把旧衣服捐给了慈善机构。
他是木工活的老手。

en: The editor decided to omit the controversial paragraph.
Please do not omit any details in your report.
She accidentally omitted his name from the guest list.
cn: 编辑决定删去有争议的段落。
请不要在报告中遗漏任何细节。
她不小心将他的名字从宾客名单中漏掉了。

en: The book is on the table.
She turned on the light.
The project is still on schedule.
cn: 书在桌子上。
她打开了灯。
项目仍按计划进行。

en: I visited Paris once.
Once you understand the rules, the game becomes easy.
She was once a famous singer.
cn: 我曾去过巴黎一次。
一旦你理解了规则，游戏就变得简单。
她曾经是位著名歌手。

en: She is the one who solved the problem.
All team members worked as one.
One apple is left on the table.
cn: 她是解决问题的那个人。
所有团队成员齐心协力。
桌上剩下一个苹果。

definitions.definition: 自己，自身（强调个体独立性或反身动作的承受者）

en: One should learn to rely on oneself.
Talking to oneself can be a sign of stress.
The key to happiness is being true to oneself.
cn: 人应学会依靠自己。
自言自语可能是压力大的表现。
幸福的关键在于忠于自我。

en: She chopped the onion finely for the soup.
The recipe calls for one red onion.
His eyes watered while peeling the onion.
cn: 她将洋葱切碎用于煮汤。
食谱要求用一颗红洋葱。
他剥洋葱时流泪了。

en: She is the only person who knows the truth.
He only smiled without answering.
This offer is valid for only 24 hours.
cn: 她是唯一知道真相的人。
他只是笑了笑，没有回答。
此优惠仅在24小时内有效。

definitions.definition: 到...之上（表示移动或位置）

en: The cat jumped onto the table.
The artist painted directly onto the canvas.
This function is both one-to-one and onto.
cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
艺术家直接在画布上作画。
该函数既是单射又是满射。

en: She left the window open to let in fresh air.
The museum will open a new exhibition next month.
His open-minded attitude impressed everyone.
cn: 她让窗户开着以通风。
博物馆下月将开放新展览。
他开放的态度令所有人印象深刻。

en: She noticed a small opening in the fence.
The opening ceremony of the Olympics was spectacular.
There’s an opening for a manager in our department.
cn: 她注意到围栏上有个小缺口。
奥运会开幕式非常壮观。
我们部门有一个经理职位的空缺。

definitions.definition: 歌剧（一种融合音乐、戏剧与舞台艺术的表演形式）

en: La Traviata is one of Verdi's most famous operas.
The Sydney Opera House hosts over 1,500 performances annually.
She trained for years to sing opera professionally.
cn: 《茶花女》是威尔第最著名的歌剧之一。
悉尼歌剧院每年举办逾1500场演出。
她为成为专业歌剧演员接受了多年训练。

en: The machine operates smoothly under high pressure.
Surgeons must operate with extreme precision.
The company operates in over 30 countries.
cn: 这台机器在高压下运行平稳。
外科医生必须以极高的精确度进行手术。
该公司在30多个国家开展业务。

en: The patient recovered quickly after the operation.
The factory resumed operation following the power outage.
The military operation was executed with precision.
cn: 患者手术后恢复迅速。
工厂在停电后恢复了运转。
此次军事行动执行精准。

definitions.definition: 操作的；运作的（与系统、机器或组织的实际功能相关）
可使用的；可运行的（指设备或系统处于可用状态）

en: The new system is now fully operational.
Operational costs have been reduced by 20%.
The airport resumed operational services after the storm.
cn: 新系统现已全面投入运行。
运营成本降低了20%。
暴风雨过后，机场恢复了运营服务。

en: The operator controls the factory machinery with precision.
Call the operator if you need an outside line.
The "plus" sign is a mathematical operator.
cn: 操作员精准控制工厂机器。
如需外线，请呼叫接线员。
“加号”是一种数学运算符。

en: In my opinion, the plan needs further discussion.
The doctor’s opinion confirmed our suspicions.
Public opinion strongly supports the new policy.
cn: 我认为这个计划需要进一步讨论。
医生的诊断证实了我们的怀疑。
公众舆论强烈支持这项新政策。

en: He defeated his opponent in the chess match.
The senator’s opponents criticized the new policy.
Opponent teams often struggle against their defense.
cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
参议院的反对者们批评了新政策。
对手球队常难以突破他们的防守。

en: She seized the opportunity to study abroad.
The job fair provided many opportunities for graduates.
Missing this opportunity might cost you dearly.
cn: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。
招聘会为毕业生提供了许多机会。
错过这次机会可能会让你付出巨大代价。

en: The protesters oppose the new law.
His ideas directly oppose mine.
We must oppose injustice with courage.
cn: 抗议者反对这项新法律。
他的观点与我的直接对立。
我们必须勇敢对抗不公。

en: The two sisters have opposite personalities.
Black is the opposite of white.
He sat on the opposite side of the table.
cn: 这对姐妹性格截然相反。
黑色是白色的对立色。
他坐在桌子的另一侧。

definitions.definition: 压迫，压制（以权威或武力不公平地控制）
使心情沉重，使压抑（情感上的压迫感）

en: The dictator used the army to oppress political dissent.
The gloomy weather oppressed her spirits.
Laws should protect citizens, not oppress them.
cn: 独裁者动用军队镇压政治异见。
阴郁的天气让她的情绪低落。
法律应保护公民，而非压迫他们。

en: The microscope uses optical lenses to magnify tiny objects.
Optical illusions can trick our brains into seeing things differently.
She works in an optical shop, helping customers choose eyeglasses.
cn: 显微镜利用光学透镜放大微小物体。
视觉错觉会欺骗大脑，让我们看到不同的景象。
她在眼镜店工作，帮助顾客挑选眼镜。

definitions.definition: 乐观的；抱有乐观态度的

en: Despite the challenges, she remained optimistic about the project.
His optimistic outlook often inspires his teammates.
The report ended on an optimistic note, predicting economic recovery.
cn: 尽管面临挑战，她仍对项目保持乐观。
他乐观的态度常常激励队友。
报告以乐观的基调结尾，预测经济将复苏。

en: You have the option to accept or decline the offer.
The software provides multiple language options.
He bought a call option on Tesla stocks.
cn: 你有接受或拒绝该提议的选择权。
该软件提供多语言选项。
他购买了特斯拉股票的看涨期权。

en: Wearing a tie is optional for the event.
The course includes optional modules on advanced topics.
She chose the optional insurance coverage for her car.
cn: 活动中系领带是可选的。
该课程包含关于高级主题的选修模块。
她为爱车选择了非强制性的保险项目。

en: Would you like tea or coffee?
Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
Is it a bird or a plane?
cn: 你想要茶还是咖啡？
快点，否则你会错过公交车。
那是一只鸟还是一架飞机？

en: The professor gave an oral exam instead of a written one.
Good oral hygiene prevents dental diseases.
Many indigenous cultures rely on oral traditions to preserve history.
cn: 教授进行了一场口试而非笔试。
良好的口腔卫生能预防牙齿疾病。
许多原住民文化依靠口头传统来保存历史。

en: She peeled the orange and shared its segments.
The sunset painted the sky in vibrant orange.
His tie was a bold shade of orange.
cn: 她剥开橙子，分出了果瓣。
夕阳将天空染成鲜艳的橙色。
他的领带是醒目的橙色调。

definitions.definition: 轨道（天体或人造卫星的运行路径）

en: The satellite entered a stable orbit around Earth.
The company expanded its orbit to include Asian markets.
Electrons orbit the nucleus at high speed.
cn: 卫星进入了稳定的地球轨道。
该公司将业务范围扩展至亚洲市场。
电子以高速绕原子核运行。

definitions.definition: 管弦乐队；乐池（剧场中乐队演奏的区域）

en: The orchestra played a stunning symphony.
She has been a violinist in the orchestra for ten years.
The conductor raised his baton, and the orchestra fell silent.
cn: 管弦乐队演奏了一曲震撼的交响乐。
她担任该管弦乐队的小提琴手已十年。
指挥举起指挥棒，乐队随即安静下来。

en: The teacher asked the students to line up in order of height.
The general gave an order to retreat immediately.
I'd like to order a coffee and a croissant.
cn: 老师让学生按身高顺序排队。
将军下令立即撤退。
我想点一杯咖啡和一个牛角面包。

definitions.definition: （医院或军队的）勤务兵，护理员

en: The books were arranged in an orderly manner on the shelf.
The orderly assisted the doctor during the medical procedure.
She kept her notes orderly by color-coding them.
cn: 书籍整齐地排列在书架上。
护理员在手术过程中协助医生。
她用颜色分类使笔记井井有条。

en: She wore an ordinary dress to the party.
The meal was nothing out of the ordinary.
In the ordinary course of events, we would meet monthly.
cn: 她穿了一条普通的裙子去参加派对。
这顿饭没什么特别之处。
按照惯例，我们每月会见面一次。

definitions.definition: 矿石（含金属的天然矿物）

en: The miners extracted iron ore from the mountain.
This region is rich in copper ore deposits.
Processing raw ore requires specialized equipment.
cn: 矿工从山中开采铁矿石。
该地区富含铜矿矿床。
加工原矿石需要专用设备。

definitions.definition: 器官（生物体的功能单位）
机构（社会或政治组织的组成部分）

en: The heart is a vital organ in the human body.
The newspaper acts as an organ of political propaganda.
Bach composed magnificent works for the organ.
cn: 心脏是人体重要器官。
该报纸充当政治宣传机构。
巴赫为管风琴创作了宏伟的作品。

definitions.definition: 有机的（与生物体或生命过程相关）
有机的（指天然、无人工合成的，如农业或化学）
系统的、整体的（指组织或结构）

en: Organic farming avoids synthetic pesticides.
The company promotes an organic growth strategy.
Music is an organic part of human culture.
cn: 有机农业避免使用合成农药。
该公司推行有机增长策略。
音乐是人类文化中不可分割的一部分。

definitions.definition: 生物体（具有独立生命功能的个体，如动植物、微生物）
有机体系（泛指结构或功能复杂的整体）

en: The human body is a complex organism composed of trillions of cells.
Coral reefs support a diverse organism community.
Some view cities as living organisms that evolve over time.
cn: 人体是由数万亿细胞组成的复杂生物体。
珊瑚礁维系着多样化的生物群落。
有些人将城市视为随时间演变的生命有机体。

definitions.definition: 组织（指有结构的团体或系统）
组织行为（协调安排的过程）

en: The United Nations is a global organization dedicated to maintaining peace.
Good time organization is key to completing the project efficiently.
The human body has a complex organization of cells and tissues.
cn: 联合国是一个致力于维护和平的全球性组织。
良好的时间安排是高效完成项目的关键。
人体拥有复杂的细胞与组织结构。

en: She helped organize the community clean-up event.
The files are organized alphabetically for easy access.
Workers decided to organize a union to protect their rights.
cn: 她协助组织了社区清洁活动。
文件按字母顺序排列以便查阅。
工人们决定成立工会以维护自身权益。

definitions.definition: 东方的；亚洲的（尤指东亚）
（旧用法）东方人（可能具冒犯性）

en: The museum has a gallery dedicated to oriental art.
This spice is commonly used in oriental cuisine.
cn: 博物馆设有东方艺术专题展厅。
这种香料常见于东方菜肴。

en: The origin of this tradition dates back to ancient times.
Her family is of humble origin.
Scientists are still debating the origin of the universe.
cn: 这一传统的起源可追溯至古代。
她的家庭出身卑微。
科学家仍在争论宇宙的起源。

en: The original manuscript was lost in the 19th century.
She has a very original approach to problem-solving.
This painting is a copy; the original hangs in the Louvre.
cn: 这份原始手稿在19世纪遗失了。
她解决问题的办法极具独创性。
这幅画是复制品，原作藏于卢浮宫。

en: The Christmas tree was covered with sparkling ornaments.
She ornamented her essay with poetic quotations.
The architect believed that function should precede ornament.
cn: 圣诞树上挂满了闪闪发光的装饰品。
她用诗意的引文为文章增色。
建筑师认为功能应优先于装饰。

definitions.definition: 孤儿的；无母体的（如技术术语 orphan file）

en: The war left thousands of children orphaned.
She volunteers at an orphanage to help orphans.
The orphan file needs to be reassigned to a project.
cn: 战争导致数千名儿童成为孤儿。
她在孤儿院做志愿者，帮助孤儿们。
这个孤立文件需要重新分配到项目中。

en: She prefers the other dress.
One of the twins is tall, and the other is short.
Do you have any other questions?
cn: 她更喜欢另一条裙子。
双胞胎中一个高，另一个矮。
你还有其他问题吗？

en: You must leave now; otherwise, you'll miss the train.
The room is small but otherwise comfortable.
His answer was unexpected, but not otherwise remarkable.
cn: 你必须现在出发，否则会错过火车。
房间虽小，但其他方面很舒适。
他的回答出人意料，但除此之外并不特别。

definitions.definition: 可能（表示推测，古旧用法）

en: You ought to apologize for your mistake.
He ought to be home by now.
They ought not to ignore the warnings.
cn: 你应当为错误道歉。
他现在应该到家了。
他们不该忽视这些警告。

en: Add an ounce of sugar to the mixture.
He didn't have an ounce of courage left.
The recipe calls for two ounces of chocolate.
cn: 在混合物中加入一盎司糖。
他没有丝毫勇气了。
食谱需要两盎司巧克力。

definitions.definition: 我们的（第一人称复数所有格）

en: Our team won the championship.
She is our English teacher.
Our planet needs protection.
cn: 我们的团队赢得了冠军。
她是我们的英语老师。
我们的星球需要保护。

definitions.definition: 我们的（东西或人）；属于我们的

en: The victory is ours.
Their house is bigger than ours.
Is this pen yours or ours?
cn: 胜利属于我们。
他们的房子比我们的大。
这支笔是你的还是我们的？

definitions.definition: 我们自己（反身代词，强调主语或宾语的同一性）

en: We must take care of ourselves.
We built the treehouse ourselves.
Let's remind ourselves of the rules.
cn: 我们必须照顾好自己。
我们自己搭建了树屋。
让我们提醒自己这些规则。

en: The cat ran out of the room when the door opened.
Her secret was out after the newspaper report.
He's been out of work for six months.
cn: 门开时，猫跑出了房间。
新闻报道后，她的秘密曝光了。
他已失业六个月。

en: The outcome of the experiment surprised everyone.
We are still waiting for the final outcome of the negotiations.
A positive outcome depends on your efforts.
cn: 实验的结果让所有人感到惊讶。
我们仍在等待谈判的最终结果。
积极的结果取决于你的努力。

definitions.definition: 户外活动（常用复数形式 outdoors）

en: We prefer outdoor activities like hiking and camping.
The restaurant has an outdoor seating area with a garden view.
Children should spend more time outdoors for better health.
cn: 我们更喜欢徒步和露营等户外活动。
这家餐厅设有能看到花园的露天用餐区。
孩子们应该多花时间在户外以促进健康。

en: We love eating outdoors in summer.
The sound of birds is one of the joys of the outdoors.
She prefers exercising outdoors rather than in a gym.
cn: 夏天我们喜欢在户外用餐。
鸟鸣声是户外的乐趣之一。
她更喜欢在户外而非健身房锻炼。

en: The outer layer of the skin protects against UV rays.
The spacecraft left the Earth's outer atmosphere.
She prefers the outer suburbs for their quietness.
cn: 皮肤的外层能抵御紫外线。
航天器离开了地球的外层大气。
她更喜欢远郊的宁静。

en: The river needs an outlet to prevent flooding.
Painting became her creative outlet during stressful times.
We bought these shoes at a designer outlet.
cn: 河流需要排水口以防止泛滥。
绘画成为她压力时期的创作宣泄方式。
我们在品牌折扣店买了这双鞋。

en: The artist sketched the outline of the mountain before adding details.
Please submit an outline of your proposal by Friday.
The report outlines the main challenges facing the industry.
cn: 艺术家先勾勒出山的轮廓，再添加细节。
请在周五前提交你的提案大纲。
报告概述了该行业面临的主要挑战。

en: She has a positive outlook on life.
The economic outlook for next year remains uncertain.
The hotel room had a beautiful outlook over the mountains.
cn: 她对生活持乐观态度。
明年的经济前景仍不明朗。
酒店房间拥有优美的山景视野。

en: The factory's daily output reached 500 units.
The program will output the results to a file.
High creative output requires focused effort.
cn: 工厂的日产量达到500件。
程序将把结果输出到文件。
高创意产出需要专注投入。

en: From the outset, the project faced unexpected challenges.
She made her intentions clear at the outset of the meeting.
The rules were established at the very outset to avoid confusion.
cn: 项目从一开始就面临意外挑战。
会议一开始她就表明了意图。
规则在一开始就制定好了，以避免混乱。

en: The cat is waiting outside the door.
She prefers to sit on the outside of the group.
His behavior was completely outside the norm.
cn: 猫在门外等着。
她更喜欢坐在人群的外围。
他的行为完全超出了常规。

definitions.definition: 杰出的；显著的（指人或成就）
未解决的；未偿付的（指问题或债务）

en: She received an award for her outstanding contributions to science.
The company has several outstanding debts to pay.
His performance was outstanding despite the difficult conditions.
cn: 她因对科学的杰出贡献而获奖。
这家公司有几笔未偿付的债务。
尽管条件艰苦，他的表现依然出色。

en: The ship set sail outward bound for distant lands.
Her outward calm hid inner turmoil.
The door opens outward, not inward.
cn: 船只启航，驶向远方的陆地。
她外表的平静掩盖了内心的动荡。
这门向外开，而非向内。

en: The window opens outwards to allow better ventilation.
He pushed the door outwards with all his strength.
Her confidence was projected outwards through her calm demeanor.
cn: 窗户向外打开以便更好地通风。
他用尽全力将门向外推。
她的自信通过冷静的举止向外展现。

en: She baked bread in the oven for breakfast.
Modern ovens often have digital temperature controls.
The pottery needs to dry before going into the oven.
cn: 她用烤箱烤了面包当早餐。
现代烤箱通常配有数字温控系统。
陶器需晾干后再放入窑炉烧制。

en: The plane flew over the mountains.
She turned over the page carefully.
The meeting is over by 5 PM.
cn: 飞机飞越了群山。
她小心地翻过这一页。
会议将在下午5点前结束。

en: The overall performance of the team improved significantly.
She wore overalls while painting the house.
Overall, the project was a success despite minor issues.
cn: 团队的整体表现显著提升。
她粉刷房子时穿着工装裤。
尽管有些小问题，项目总体上是成功的。

definitions.definition: 大衣；外套（尤指穿在外层的厚外套）

en: He wore a heavy overcoat to brace against the winter wind.
The detective’s overcoat concealed his holstered pistol.
She folded her overcoat neatly over the armchair.
cn: 他穿着一件厚大衣以抵御冬日的寒风。
侦探的大衣遮掩了他别在腰间的枪。
她将大衣整齐地搭在扶手椅上。

en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.
The team overcame many obstacles to win the championship.
He was overcome with joy when he heard the news.
cn: 她努力克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。
这支队伍战胜了重重障碍，最终赢得冠军。
听到消息时，他喜极而泣。

definitions.definition: 企业日常开支（如租金、水电等）

en: The birds circled overhead, searching for prey.
The company reduced overhead by switching to remote work.
An overhead projector displayed the slides during the lecture.
cn: 鸟儿在头顶盘旋，寻找猎物。
公司通过远程办公降低了运营成本。
讲座中使用了一台高架投影仪展示幻灯片。

en: The hotel room overlooks the bay, offering stunning sunset views.
She tends to overlook minor mistakes in her enthusiasm for the project.
The detective overlooked a crucial clue in the initial investigation.
cn: 酒店房间俯瞰海湾，可欣赏壮丽的日落景色。
她对项目的热情使她常常忽略小错误。
侦探在初步调查中忽视了一条关键线索。

en: The package will be delivered overnight.
She became an overnight success after her viral video.
We took an overnight train to Paris.
cn: 包裹将在夜间送达。
她的视频走红后，她一夜间成名。
我们乘夜班火车去了巴黎。

en: She works for an overseas company.
Many students choose to study overseas.
The product is popular both domestically and overseas.
cn: 她在一家海外公司工作。
许多学生选择去海外留学。
该产品在国内外都很受欢迎。

en: The blue car accelerated to overtake the truck.
A sudden wave of fatigue overtook him after the meeting.
Renewable energy may overtake fossil fuels by 2050.
cn: 蓝色轿车加速超过了卡车。
会议结束后，一阵突如其来的疲惫感压倒了他。
可再生能源或将在2050年前超越化石燃料。

en: She worked overtime to finish the project before the deadline.
The company pays double for overtime on holidays.
The game went into overtime due to a tied score.
cn: 她加班赶在截止日期前完成项目。
公司节假日加班支付双倍工资。
比赛因平局进入加时赛。

definitions.definition: 欠（债务、人情等）；应给予（感激、义务等）

en: I owe you twenty dollars for the concert ticket.
She owes her success to hard work and persistence.
We owe our grandparents a visit this weekend.
cn: 我欠你二十美元的音乐会门票钱。
她的成功归功于努力和坚持。
这周末我们该去看看祖父母了。

definitions.definition: 猫头鹰；惯于夜间活动的人

en: The owl hunts small rodents at night.
Her wisdom was compared to that of an owl.
We heard an owl hooting in the woods.
cn: 猫头鹰在夜间捕食小型啮齿动物。
她的智慧被比作猫头鹰（象征智慧）。
我们听到树林里传来猫头鹰的叫声。

en: She has her own business.
He refused to own his mistakes.
The house is owned by a retired couple.
cn: 她拥有自己的事业。
他拒绝承认错误。
这栋房子归一对退休夫妇所有。

en: The owner of the bookstore is very knowledgeable.
She became the proud owner of a vintage car.
The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner.
cn: 书店老板学识渊博。
她成为了一辆古董车的自豪主人。
狗狗见到主人时摇起了尾巴。

definitions.definition: 拥有感；自主权（抽象意义）

en: The dispute was about the ownership of the land.
She takes great pride in home ownership.
Employee ownership can boost company loyalty.
cn: 争议的焦点是这块土地的所有权。
她对拥有自己的房子感到非常自豪。
员工持股能增强对公司的忠诚度。

definitions.definition: 公牛（尤指阉割后的成年雄性牛）

en: The farmer used an ox to plow the field.
Oxen were vital to medieval agriculture.
A team of oxen pulled the heavy cart.
cn: 农夫用一头公牛耕地。
公牛对中世纪农业至关重要。
一群公牛拉着沉重的货车。

en: She quickened her pace to catch the bus.
The professor paced the room while lecturing.
The project progressed at a steady pace.
cn: 她加快步伐去赶公交车。
教授一边讲课一边在房间里踱步。
项目以稳定的节奏推进。

en: The pacific tone of the negotiation helped resolve the conflict.
They adopted a pacific approach to settle the dispute.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.
cn: 谈判中平和的语气有助于解决冲突。
他们采取了和平的方式来解决争端。
太平洋是地球上最大最深的海洋。

en: She carried a heavy pack on her back during the hike.
The wolves hunt in a pack to increase their success rate.
We need to pack our bags before the trip.
cn: 徒步时她背着一个沉重的包裹。
狼群通过集体狩猎提高成功率。
我们必须在出发前打包好行李。

definitions.definition: 包裹；包装；成套服务或产品
打包；包装；将…组合成整体

en: The courier delivered a small package to my doorstep.
This software package includes tools for data analysis.
She carefully packaged the fragile items with bubble wrap.
cn: 快递员将一个小包裹送到我家门口。
该软件包包含数据分析工具。
她用气泡膜仔细包装易碎物品。

en: She received a packet of seeds in the mail.
The data is split into multiple packets for transmission.
He packed his lunch into a paper packet.
cn: 她收到邮寄来的一小包种子。
数据被分割成多个数据包传输。
他把午餐装进了一个纸袋。

definitions.definition: 用软物填充；虚报（账目等）

en: She wrote her phone number on the pad by the telephone.
The shoulders of the jacket were padded to make them look broader.
The cat padded silently across the room.
cn: 她在电话旁的便签本上写下了自己的号码。
夹克的肩部加了衬垫，使其看起来更宽。
猫咪轻悄地走过房间。

definitions.definition: 页（书籍、文件的单面）；页面（网页）
标记页码；用传呼机呼叫

en: Turn to page 50 for the exercise answers.
The knight was accompanied by a young page.
She paged the doctor urgently during the emergency.
cn: 练习答案请翻到第50页。
骑士由一名年轻的侍从陪同。
紧急情况下，她立即用传呼机呼叫了医生。

definitions.definition: 桶，提桶（通常指金属或塑料制，带有手柄的容器）

en: She carried water from the well in a rusty pail.
The child filled his pail with sand at the beach.
A milk pail is essential for traditional dairy farming.
cn: 她用一个生锈的提桶从井里打水。
孩子在沙滩上用桶装满了沙子。
挤奶桶是传统乳业养殖的必备工具。

en: She felt a sharp pain in her knee after the fall.
It pains me to see you so unhappy.
The memory of his loss brought her great pain.
cn: 她在摔倒后感到膝盖一阵剧痛。
看到你如此不快乐让我很难过。
失去他的记忆给她带来巨大痛苦。

en: The wound was still painful after a week.
It was a painful decision to leave her hometown.
Learning a new language can be painful but rewarding.
cn: 伤口一周后仍然疼痛。
离开家乡对她来说是个痛苦的决定。
学习新语言可能很费力，但值得。

en: She used bright colors to paint the mural.
The walls were painted white to reflect more light.
His words painted a vivid picture of the ancient city.
cn: 她用鲜艳的颜料绘制了这幅壁画。
墙面被漆成白色以反射更多光线。
他的描述生动勾勒出古城的景象。

en: Van Gogh is one of the most famous painters in history.
The painter finished coating the walls with white latex.
She hired a painter to create a mural in her café.
cn: 梵高是历史上最著名的画家之一。
油漆工用白色乳胶漆完成了墙面粉刷。
她雇了一位画家在咖啡馆创作壁画。

en: Her painting won first prize in the art competition.
The old house needs a fresh coat of painting.
He studied oil painting techniques in Florence.
cn: 她的画作在艺术比赛中获得一等奖。
这栋老房子需要重新粉刷。
他在佛罗伦萨学习了油画技法。

definitions.definition: 一对，一双（相同或相关联的两个事物）

en: She bought a new pair of shoes for the party.
The teacher paired the students for the group activity.
These earrings are sold as a pair.
cn: 她为派对买了一双新鞋。
老师将学生两两分组进行活动。
这对耳环是成套出售的。

definitions.definition: 宫殿；豪华住宅；大型公共建筑

en: The royal family resides in the grand palace.
The concert was held at the city's cultural palace.
Her mansion was so luxurious that it resembled a palace.
cn: 皇室成员居住在这座宏伟的宫殿中。
音乐会在市文化宫举行。
她的豪宅奢华得宛如宫殿。

en: Her face turned pale when she heard the news.
The pale moonlight barely lit the path.
Even his best work pales beside her masterpiece.
cn: 听到消息时，她的脸色变得苍白。
暗淡的月光几乎照不亮小路。
即使是他最好的作品，在她的杰作前也黯然失色。

definitions.definition: 将某物藏于手中（如变魔术）

en: She pressed the coin into his palm.
Coconut palms swayed in the tropical breeze.
The magician palmed the card skillfully.
cn: 她将硬币按进他的掌心。
椰子树在热带微风中摇曳。
魔术师灵巧地将牌藏于手中。

en: She fried eggs in a stainless steel pan.
The camera panned slowly across the battlefield.
Critics panned the director's latest film.
cn: 她在不锈钢平底锅里煎蛋。
摄像机缓缓摇摄过战场全景。
评论家们严厉批评了这位导演的新片。

en: The giant panda is native to central China.
Red pandas are sometimes called lesser pandas.
Pandas spend up to 12 hours a day eating bamboo.
cn: 大熊猫原产于中国中部。
小熊猫有时被称为“小火熊猫”。
熊猫每天花费多达12小时进食竹子。

en: The frost formed intricate patterns on the window pane.
Adjust the split panes to view both documents side by side.
A bird accidentally flew into the pane, mistaking it for open space.
cn: 冰霜在窗格玻璃上形成了复杂的图案。
调整分栏窗格以并排查看两份文档。
一只鸟误将玻璃窗格当作开阔空间而撞了上去。

definitions.definition: 镶嵌（面板）；选任（小组成员）

en: The control panel lights up when you press the button.
A panel of experts will discuss climate change solutions.
The door was paneled with oak wood.
cn: 按下按钮时，控制面板会亮起。
专家小组将讨论气候变化解决方案。
这扇门镶有橡木板。

en: The dog panted heavily after running in the park.
She panted out the news, too excited to speak clearly.
His breath came in quick pants as he reached the mountaintop.
cn: 狗狗在公园奔跑后剧烈喘息。
她气喘吁吁地说出消息，激动得语无伦次。
到达山顶时，他的呼吸变得短促急促。

en: She wrote her notes on a piece of paper.
The scientist published a groundbreaking paper.
We decided to paper the bedroom walls with floral patterns.
cn: 她把笔记写在了一张纸上。
这位科学家发表了一篇开创性论文。
我们决定用花卉图案的壁纸装饰卧室墙壁。

en: The victory parade marched through the city center.
She paraded her new dress at the party.
The soldiers paraded in front of the general.
cn: 胜利游行队伍穿过市中心。
她在派对上炫耀自己的新裙子。
士兵们在将军面前列队行进。

en: The island was a tropical paradise with white sandy beaches.
In the painting, Adam and Eve are depicted in the Garden of Paradise.
After a long hike, the shaded spring felt like paradise.
cn: 这座岛屿是拥有白色沙滩的热带乐园。
画中描绘了亚当和夏娃在伊甸园的场景。
长途徒步后，阴凉的泉水边宛如天堂。

definitions.definition: 段落（文章中的独立部分）
短篇报道（尤指新闻中的简讯）

en: Each paragraph should focus on a single main idea.
The editor asked me to shorten the opening paragraph.
A small paragraph in the newspaper mentioned the event.
cn: 每个段落应围绕一个核心观点展开。
编辑要求我缩短开篇段落。
报纸上的一则简讯提到了该事件。

en: The two roads run parallel to each other.
Her career path parallels that of her mentor.
Draw a parallel between the two historical events.
cn: 这两条道路彼此平行。
她的职业轨迹与她的导师相似。
在这两起历史事件间找出相似之处。

en: The parcel arrived with a damaged corner.
She parcelled out the candies to the children.
They own a small parcel of land by the river.
cn: 包裹到达时角落已损坏。
她把糖果分发给孩子们。
他们在河边拥有一小块土地。

en: She begged him to pardon her thoughtless remark.
The governor issued a pardon to the wrongfully convicted man.
"Pardon?" he said, not catching her whisper.
cn: 她请求他原谅她轻率的言论。
州长赦免了那名被误判的男子。
“请再说一遍？”他说道，没听清她的低语。

en: Both parents attended the school meeting.
The plant’s parent species originates from South America.
She balances her career with being a supportive parent.
cn: 父母双方都参加了学校会议。
这种植物的亲本物种源自南美洲。
她在事业和支持孩子之间取得了平衡。

en: The children are playing in the central park.
Don't forget to park your car in the designated area.
Hyde Park is famous for its Speaker's Corner.
cn: 孩子们在中央公园玩耍。
别忘了把车停在指定区域。
海德公园以其“演讲者之角”闻名。

definitions.definition: 议会，国会（最高立法机构）

en: The bill was debated in parliament for three days.
The British Parliament consists of the House of Commons and the House of Lords.
She became the youngest member of parliament in the country's history.
cn: 该法案在议会中辩论了三天。
英国议会由下议院和上议院组成。
她成为该国历史上最年轻的议会成员。

en: She played a key part in the project.
The mechanic replaced the damaged part of the engine.
They had to part ways after graduation.
cn: 她在项目中扮演了关键角色。
机械师更换了发动机的损坏零件。
毕业后他们不得不分道扬镳。

en: The report gives only a partial view of the situation.
Judges must not be partial towards either side.
She has a partial solution to the problem.
cn: 这份报告仅提供了对局部的看法。
法官不得偏袒任何一方。
她对这个问题有一个不完全的解决方案。

en: The project was only partially completed by the deadline.
She partially agreed with his opinion but had some reservations.
The sun was partially obscured by clouds during the eclipse.
cn: 该项目在截止日期前仅部分完成。
她部分同意他的观点，但有所保留。
日食期间，太阳被云层部分遮挡。

en: She actively participates in community events.
All members are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
He refused to participate in the risky venture.
cn: 她积极参与社区活动。
鼓励所有成员参与讨论。
他拒绝参与这项高风险投资。

definitions.definition: 微粒，粒子（物理或化学中的极小单位）

en: Dust particles floated in the sunlight.
There's not a particle of truth in his statement.
Electrons are subatomic particles with a negative charge.
cn: 阳光中漂浮着尘埃微粒。
他的陈述没有丝毫真实性。
电子是带负电的亚原子粒子。

en: She has a particular preference for organic food.
Pay attention to the particulars in the contract.
He’s very particular about his workspace cleanliness.
cn: 她对有机食品有特别的偏好。
注意合同中的细节条款。
他对工作区域的整洁度非常挑剔。

en: She loves all flowers, particularly roses.
The report describes the process particularly well.
He didn't seem particularly interested in the topic.
cn: 她喜欢所有花，尤其是玫瑰。
这份报告特别详细地描述了该过程。
他似乎对这个话题不太感兴趣。

en: The success was partly due to her efforts.
The door was partly open, letting in a sliver of light.
His answer was partly correct, but missed key details.
cn: 成功部分归功于她的努力。
门半开着，透进一线光。
他的答案部分正确，但遗漏了关键细节。

en: She is my business partner in the new startup.
The two companies partnered to develop the technology.
He has been a loyal partner for over 20 years.
cn: 她是我的新创业项目中的商业伙伴。
两家公司合作开发这项技术。
他作为忠诚的伴侣已超过20年。

en: She hosted a birthday party for her daughter.
The two parties finally reached an agreement.
He joined the political party last year.
cn: 她为女儿举办了一场生日派对。
双方最终达成了协议。
他去年加入了该政党。

en: She passed the exam with flying colors.
The hikers finally passed the mountain ridge at dawn.
He made a quick pass to his teammate during the game.
cn: 她以优异成绩通过了考试。
徒步者终于在黎明时分翻过了山脊。
比赛中他快速将球传给了队友。

en: The secret passage led to a hidden garden.
The passage of time healed her wounds.
The bill’s passage was celebrated by supporters.
cn: 秘密通道通向一座隐蔽的花园。
时间的流逝治愈了她的伤痛。
法案的通过赢得了支持者的欢呼。

en: The train can carry up to 300 passengers.
He was merely a passenger in the project, contributing little.
Airlines must ensure passenger safety during flights.
cn: 这列火车最多可搭载300名乘客。
他在项目中只是个被动参与者，贡献甚微。
航空公司必须确保飞行途中乘客的安全。

definitions.definition: 强烈的情感（尤指爱、愤怒或热情）

en: She spoke with passion about human rights.
Music has always been his greatest passion.
The team played with passion and determination.
cn: 她充满激情地谈论人权。
音乐一直是他最大的热爱。
这支队伍以热情和决心投入比赛。

en: His passive attitude towards problems often leads to delays.
The sentence is written in the passive voice.
She remained passive during the argument.
cn: 他对问题的消极态度常导致拖延。
这个句子是用被动语态写的。
她在争论中保持沉默。

definitions.definition: 护照（官方身份证明文件，用于国际旅行）
通行证；保障（比喻意义，指获得机会或认可的途径）

en: She renewed her passport before the trip.
Education is often seen as a passport to success.
The officer stamped my passport at immigration.
cn: 她在旅行前更新了护照。
教育常被视为成功的通行证。
移民官员在我的护照上盖了章。

en: The past decade has seen rapid technological advancements.
She walked past the store without noticing it.
It's half past two in the afternoon.
cn: 过去十年见证了技术的飞速发展。
她走过商店却没有注意到它。
现在是下午两点半。

en: She mixed flour and water to make a thick paste.
Paste the poster on the wall with glue.
Toothpaste helps clean your teeth effectively.
cn: 她将面粉和水混合成稠糊状。
用胶水把海报贴在墙上。
牙膏能有效清洁牙齿。

definitions.definition: 消遣，娱乐（一种打发时间的活动）

en: Reading is her favorite pastime on rainy days.
Gardening became a peaceful pastime after retirement.
The festival offers various pastimes for visitors.
cn: 雨天读书是她最爱的消遣。
园艺成了退休后宁静的消遣。
节日为游客提供了多种娱乐活动。

definitions.definition: 过于简单的；生硬的（如 a pat answer）

en: She patted the dog gently on the head.
The answer sounded too pat to be believable.
He spread a pat of butter on the toast.
cn: 她轻轻拍了拍狗的脑袋。
这个回答听起来太敷衍，难以令人信服。
他在吐司上抹了一小块黄油。

definitions.definition: 补丁；小块土地；临时修复

en: She sewed a patch over the hole in her jeans.
The garden has a small patch of strawberries.
The developer released a patch to fix the bug.
cn: 她在牛仔裤的破洞上缝了一块补丁。
花园里有一小块草莓地。
开发者发布了修复漏洞的补丁程序。

en: The mountain path was narrow and steep.
She chose a career path in medicine.
The hurricane left a path of destruction.
cn: 这条山路狭窄而陡峭。
她选择了医学职业道路。
飓风过后留下一片狼藉。

en: Teaching children requires great patience.
She played a game of patience to relax.
His patience with noisy neighbors finally ran out.
cn: 教育孩子需要极大的耐心。
她玩了一局单人纸牌来放松。
他对吵闹邻居的忍耐终于到了极限。

en: She was patient with the noisy children.
The doctor examined the patient carefully.
Learning a language requires a patient attitude.
cn: 她对吵闹的孩子们很有耐心。
医生仔细检查了病人。
学习语言需要耐心的态度。

en: The fabric has a floral pattern.
Her behavior follows a predictable pattern.
Architects often pattern their designs after nature.
cn: 这块布料有花卉图案。
她的行为遵循可预测的模式。
建筑师常模仿自然进行设计。

en: She pressed the pause button to stop the video.
There was a brief pause in the conversation.
Let’s pause to consider the implications.
cn: 她按下暂停键停止了视频播放。
对话中出现了短暂的停顿。
我们暂停一下，思考其中的影响。

en: The city plans to pave the dirt road next year.
Ancient Romans paved their highways with stone blocks.
Her success was paved by years of hard work.
cn: 该市计划明年铺设这条土路。
古罗马人用石块铺设他们的主干道。
她的成功源于多年的辛勤付出。

en: The children drew colorful chalk art on the pavement.
Cyclists should avoid riding on the pavement for pedestrian safety.
The old pavement cracked after years of heavy traffic.
cn: 孩子们在人行道上画了五彩缤纷的粉笔画。
为行人安全着想，骑行者应避免在人行道上骑车。
多年的重压使老旧的路面开裂了。

en: The cat gently tapped my knee with its paw.
He pawed through the drawer looking for his keys.
Keep your paws off my phone!
cn: 猫用爪子轻轻拍了拍我的膝盖。
他笨手笨脚地翻抽屉找钥匙。
别用你的脏手碰我手机！（非正式表达）

en: She pays her bills on time every month.
Hard work will pay off in the long run.
His pay was increased after the promotion.
cn: 她每月按时支付账单。
长期来看，努力终有回报。
升职后，他的工资涨了。

en: The payment is due by the end of the month.
She received a payment for her freelance work.
Online payments have become more secure.
cn: 款项需在月底前支付。
她收到了自由职业工作的报酬。
在线支付已变得更加安全。

en: She planted peas and carrots in her garden.
Split pea soup is a traditional dish in many cultures.
The princess couldn't sleep because of a pea under the mattresses.
cn: 她在花园里种了豌豆和胡萝卜。
豌豆汤是许多文化中的传统菜肴。
因为床垫下的一粒豌豆，公主无法入睡。

en: The treaty brought peace to the region after decades of conflict.
She meditates to find inner peace.
The neighbors lived in peace for generations.
cn: 这份条约结束了该地区数十年的冲突，带来了和平。
她通过冥想寻求内心的平静。
这些邻居世代和睦相处。

en: The village was peaceful at dawn.
She has a peaceful temperament.
They advocated for a peaceful resolution.
cn: 黎明时分的村庄一片宁静。
她的性情温和。
他们主张通过和平方式解决问题。

en: She bit into a ripe peach, and the juice dripped down her chin.
The walls were painted a soft peach color.
He didn’t want to peach on his friends, but the police pressured him.
cn: 她咬了一口熟透的桃子，汁水顺着下巴滴落。
墙面刷成了柔和的桃红色。
他不想告发朋友，但警方施压逼迫。

en: The climbers reached the mountain peak at dawn.
Sales tend to peak during the holiday season.
Her career peaked with the Nobel Prize win.
cn: 登山者在黎明时分抵达山顶。
销售额通常在假日季达到顶峰。
她的职业生涯因诺贝尔奖而达到巅峰。

en: She packed a ripe pear in her lunchbox.
The pear tree in our garden blossoms every spring.
This juice is made from pressed pears.
cn: 她在午餐盒里装了一个熟梨。
我们花园里的梨树每年春天开花。
这种果汁由压榨的梨制成。

en: She wore a necklace of exquisite pearls.
The morning dew lay like pearls on the grass.
His words were pearls of wisdom.
cn: 她戴着一串精美的珍珠项链。
晨露如珍珠般点缀在草叶上。
他的话是智慧的结晶。

definitions.definition: 农民（尤指封建社会或经济落后地区的务农者）
乡下人（含贬义，指粗俗无知的人）

en: The peasant toiled in the fields from dawn till dusk.
Medieval peasants paid heavy taxes to the lords.
He dismissed her ideas as "peasant superstitions".
cn: 农民从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。
中世纪的农民向领主缴纳重税。
他将她的观点贬为“乡下人的迷信”。

en: The beach was covered with smooth pebbles.
She skipped a pebble across the pond.
Pebbles rattled under our feet as we walked.
cn: 海滩上铺满了光滑的鹅卵石。
她打水漂让石子掠过池塘。
我们行走时，脚下的小石子嘎嘎作响。

en: The dish had a peculiar taste, unlike anything I'd tried before.
Each culture has its own peculiar traditions.
He gave me a peculiar look when I mentioned her name.
cn: 这道菜有一种奇特的味道，与我以前尝过的任何东西都不同。
每种文化都有其独特的传统。
当我提到她的名字时，他奇怪地看了我一眼。

en: She carefully peeled the apple with a knife.
The paint on the wall has started to peel.
Orange peel can be used to make zest for cooking.
cn: 她用小刀仔细地削苹果皮。
墙上的油漆开始剥落了。
橙子皮可制成烹饪用的橙皮屑。

definitions.definition: 瞥见；微弱的声音（如鸟鸣）

en: The child peeped through the keyhole to see the presents.
I heard a peep from the nest—the baby birds were hungry.
She didn't even peep when I asked about the surprise party.
cn: 孩子透过钥匙孔偷看礼物。
我听到鸟巢里传来微弱的叫声——雏鸟饿了。
我问起惊喜派对时，她连一点风声都没透露。

en: She signed the document with a fountain pen.
The farmer penned the sheep before the storm.
His pen glided smoothly across the paper.
cn: 她用钢笔签署了文件。
农夫在暴风雨前把羊关进围栏。
他的笔在纸上流畅地滑动。

en: She sketched the portrait with a sharp pencil.
Please pencil your notes in the margin.
The artist's pencil case was filled with different grades of lead.
cn: 她用削尖的铅笔勾勒肖像。
请用铅笔在页边做笔记。
艺术家的笔盒里装满了不同硬度的铅笔。

en: The bullet can penetrate steel plates.
Sunlight barely penetrates the dense forest.
She struggled to penetrate the meaning of the poem.
cn: 子弹能穿透钢板。
阳光几乎无法穿透茂密的森林。
她努力理解这首诗的深意。

en: The Korean Peninsula is located in East Asia.
They built a lighthouse at the tip of the peninsula.
Florida is a well-known peninsula in the southeastern United States.
cn: 朝鲜半岛位于东亚。
他们在半岛的顶端建造了一座灯塔。
佛罗里达是美国东南部著名的半岛。

definitions.definition: 便士（英国货币单位，1英镑的1/100）

en: He found a shiny penny on the sidewalk.
In medieval England, a penny could buy a loaf of bread.
She saved every penny she earned for her trip.
cn: 他在人行道上发现了一枚闪闪发光的一分硬币。
在中世纪的英格兰，一便士可以买一条面包。
她为了旅行存下了赚的每一分钱。

en: She receives a monthly pension after retiring.
We stayed at a charming pension in the French countryside.
The company pensions its employees at age 65.
cn: 她退休后每月领取养老金。
我们住在法国乡村一家迷人的小旅馆。
该公司为员工在65岁时发放退休金。

en: The park was full of people enjoying the sunshine.
The indigenous peoples of this region have a rich cultural heritage.
The island is thinly peopled, with only a few small villages.
cn: 公园里挤满了享受阳光的人们。
该地区的原住民拥有丰富的文化遗产。
这座岛上人烟稀少，只有几个小村庄。

en: Freshly ground pepper enhances the flavor of the soup.
The report was peppered with technical jargon.
She prefers mild peppers in her salad.
cn: 现磨胡椒能提升汤的风味。
报告中充斥着技术术语。
她喜欢在沙拉里放温和的辣椒。

definitions.definition: 每，每一（用于表示比率或分配）
经由，通过（拉丁语借义，用于法律或正式文本）

en: The car consumes 5 liters of fuel per 100 kilometers.
The document was sent per express mail.
He works 8 hours per day on average.
cn: 这辆车每百公里消耗5升燃油。
文件通过快递寄出。
他平均每天工作8小时。

definitions.definition: 感知；察觉（通过感官或直觉）

en: Humans perceive colors differently under varying light conditions.
She quickly perceived the hidden meaning behind his words.
The device helps robots perceive obstacles in their environment.
cn: 人类在不同光线条件下对颜色的感知不同。
她迅速察觉到他话语中的隐含意义。
该装置帮助机器人感知环境中的障碍物。

en: About 60 percent of the students passed the exam.
The interest rate increased by two percent.
She scored in the top ten percent of her class.
cn: 约60%的学生通过了考试。
利率上涨了百分之二。
她的成绩排在班级前10%。

en: The percentage of students who passed the exam increased by 10%.
He takes a percentage of every sale made by his team.
What percentage of the Earth's surface is covered by water?
cn: 通过考试的学生比例增加了10%。
他从团队的每笔销售中抽取一定比例的提成。
地球表面有多大比例被水覆盖？

en: She practiced for years to perfect her piano skills.
The weather was perfect for a picnic.
His attention to detail made the project perfect.
cn: 她多年练习以使钢琴技艺臻于完美。
天气非常适合野餐。
他对细节的关注使这个项目无可挑剔。

en: The plan worked perfectly.
He was perfectly calm during the crisis.
This dress fits you perfectly.
cn: 计划进行得完美无缺。
他在危机中表现得极其镇定。
这条裙子你穿非常合身。

en: The surgeon will perform the operation tomorrow.
She performed a classical piano piece at the concert.
The new engine performs well under extreme conditions.
cn: 外科医生将于明天进行手术。
她在音乐会上演奏了一首古典钢琴曲。
这款新引擎在极端条件下表现优异。

en: Her piano performance moved the audience to tears.
The company evaluates employees based on their performance.
This car has excellent fuel performance.
cn: 她的钢琴演奏让观众感动落泪。
公司根据员工表现进行评估。
这辆车的燃油性能极佳。

en: She wore a delicate perfume that reminded him of spring.
The flowers perfumed the entire room.
This perfume is made from rare essential oils.
cn: 她身上淡淡的香水味让他想起春天。
花朵的芬芳弥漫了整个房间。
这款香水由珍稀精油制成。

definitions.definition: 或许，可能（表示不确定或推测）

en: Perhaps we should leave early to avoid traffic.
She will arrive tomorrow, or perhaps the day after.
"Will it rain?" "Perhaps, but the forecast is unclear."
cn: 或许我们应该早点出发避开拥堵。
她明天会到，也可能是后天。
“会下雨吗？”“也许，但天气预报不确定。”

en: The Jurassic period lasted about 56 million years.
Always end a declarative sentence with a period.
She tracks her period using a mobile app.
cn: 侏罗纪时期持续了约5600万年。
陈述句末尾必须使用句号。
她用手机应用记录月经周期。

en: The tattoo is a permanent reminder of her journey.
He moved from temporary to permanent employment.
She got a permanent to curl her hair.
cn: 纹身是她旅程的永久纪念。
他从临时工转为了正式员工。
她烫了头发让卷度持久。

en: The tattoo is drawn permanently on her skin.
He decided to settle down permanently in the countryside.
The damage caused by the storm may not be permanently fixed.
cn: 这个纹身永久地留在她的皮肤上。
他决定永久定居在乡村。
风暴造成的破坏可能无法被永久修复。

en: You need written permission to access these files.
The teacher granted permission to leave early.
Building without planning permission is illegal.
cn: 你需要书面许可才能访问这些文件。
老师批准了提前离开的请求。
未经规划许可的施工是违法的。

en: The teacher did not permit talking during the exam.
You need a permit to park in this area.
The law permits citizens to protest peacefully.
cn: 考试期间老师不允许交谈。
在此区域停车需持有许可证。
法律允许公民和平抗议。

en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor immediately.
She persisted in her efforts to reform the education system.
The rumor persisted despite official denials.
cn: 如果症状持续，请立即就医。
她坚持不懈地推动教育改革。
尽管官方否认，谣言仍持续流传。

definitions.definition: （法律或正式用语）自然人，法人

en: Every person has the right to freedom of expression.
She is the most creative person I've ever met.
The contract must be signed by a legal person.
cn: 每个人都有表达自由的权利。
她是我见过最有创造力的人。
合同必须由法人签署。

en: She keeps her personal life separate from her work.
The CEO made a personal visit to the factory.
Personal hygiene is essential for health.
cn: 她将私生活与工作分开。
首席执行官亲自参观了工厂。
个人卫生对健康至关重要。

definitions.definition: （组织或公司的）全体人员，员工

en: The company is cutting its personnel to reduce costs.
Military personnel were deployed to the disaster area.
All personnel must attend the safety training.
cn: 公司正在裁员以降低成本。
军事人员被派往灾区。
全体员工必须参加安全培训。

definitions.definition: 视角；观点（观察事物的特定方式）
透视法（绘画中的空间表现技法）
透视的（与透视法相关的）

en: The documentary offers a fresh perspective on climate change.
Renaissance artists mastered linear perspective in their paintings.
Try to see the issue from his perspective before judging.
cn: 这部纪录片为气候变化提供了新的视角。
文艺复兴时期的艺术家精通绘画中的线性透视法。
在评判前，先试着从他的角度理解问题。

en: She tried to persuade him to quit smoking.
The data persuaded scientists to reconsider the theory.
His calm tone persuaded the crowd to disperse peacefully.
cn: 她试图说服他戒烟。
这些数据使科学家们重新审视该理论。
他平静的语气劝服人群和平散去。

en: His pessimistic outlook made him expect failure in every endeavor.
Despite the setbacks, she refused to become pessimistic.
The report presented a pessimistic view of the economic recovery.
cn: 他悲观的态度让他对每件事都预期失败。
尽管遭遇挫折，她拒绝变得悲观。
这份报告对经济复苏持悲观看法。

en: She has a pet rabbit that she adores.
He petted the dog gently while watching TV.
This novel is my pet project for the year.
cn: 她养了一只心爱的宠物兔。
他看电视时轻轻抚摸着狗。
这本小说是我今年最重视的项目。

definitions.definition: 汽油（英国英语，等同于美式英语中的 "gasoline"）

en: The car's tank was filled with unleaded petrol.
Petrol prices have risen sharply this year.
In the UK, "petrol" is used instead of "gasoline".
cn: 这辆车的油箱加满了无铅汽油。
今年汽油价格大幅上涨。
在英国，人们用 "petrol" 而非 "gasoline"。

definitions.definition: 石油（天然形成的液态碳氢化合物，用于燃料和化工原料）

en: The country's economy heavily relies on petroleum exports.
Scientists are developing alternatives to reduce petroleum dependency.
Petroleum refining produces various byproducts used in plastics and chemicals.
cn: 该国的经济严重依赖石油出口。
科学家正在开发替代品以减少对石油的依赖。
石油精炼会产生用于塑料和化工的多种副产品。

en: The project is in its final phase.
The moon's phases affect tidal patterns.
We will phase the new policies gradually.
cn: 该项目处于最后阶段。
月相影响潮汐模式。
我们将逐步分阶段实施新政策。

definitions.definition: 现象（可观察的事件或事实）
非凡的人或事物（引申义）

en: The northern lights are a natural phenomenon that attracts many tourists.
Her talent for music is truly a phenomenon.
Scientists studied the phenomenon of climate change extensively.
cn: 北极光是一种吸引众多游客的自然现象。
她的音乐才华堪称非凡。
科学家们广泛研究气候变化现象。

en: Socrates was a philosopher who questioned everything.
She approaches life like a philosopher, calm and analytical.
Ancient Greek philosophers laid the foundation of Western thought.
cn: 苏格拉底是一位质疑一切的哲学家。
她以哲学家的方式对待生活，冷静而善于分析。
古希腊哲学家奠定了西方思想的基础。

definitions.definition: 哲学（对知识、存在、价值的理性研究）

en: She studied philosophy at Oxford to explore ethical questions.
His philosophy of life is to embrace simplicity.
Ancient Greek philosophy laid the foundation for Western thought.
cn: 她在牛津攻读哲学，以探索伦理问题。
他的人生哲学是崇尚简单。
古希腊哲学为西方思想奠定了基础。

en: She answered the phone on the first ring.
