Linguists study how phones form meaningful speech.
I'll phone you when I arrive at the station.
cn: 她第一时间接起了电话。
语言学家研究音素如何构成有意义的语音。
我到车站后会给你打电话。

en: She took a photograph of the sunset.
The museum exhibits early photographs of the city.
He photographed the rare bird with a telephoto lens.
cn: 她拍了一张日落的照片。
博物馆展出了该城市的早期照片。
他用长焦镜头拍下了这种稀有鸟类。

en: The exhibition features photographic works from the 1920s.
Her memory of the event was photographic in detail.
This lens is designed for photographic precision.
cn: 展览展出了20世纪20年代的摄影作品。
她对事件的记忆如照片般细致入微。
这款镜头专为摄影级精度设计。

en: She carefully phrased her apology to avoid misunderstanding.
"Break a leg" is an idiomatic phrase in English.
The first phrase of the symphony repeats in the finale.
cn: 她谨慎措辞道歉，以免引起误解。
“Break a leg”是英语中的习语短语。
交响乐开篇的乐句在终章重现。

definitions.definition: 身体的；物质的；物理学的

en: Regular exercise improves physical and mental health.
The scientist studied the physical properties of the material.
You need a physical before joining the sports team.
cn: 定期锻炼有益身心健康。
科学家研究了该材料的物理特性。
加入运动队前需进行体格检查。

definitions.definition: （古义）自然哲学家；精通自然科学者

en: The physician prescribed a course of antibiotics for the infection.
In medieval Europe, physicians often studied astrology alongside medicine.
She trained for years to become a licensed physician.
cn: 医师为感染开了一疗程的抗生素。
在中世纪的欧洲，医师常兼修占星术与医学。
她经过多年训练成为执业医师。

en: Marie Curie was a pioneering physicist who won two Nobel Prizes.
The physicist explained quantum mechanics with vivid analogies.
Modern physicists often collaborate across disciplines.
cn: 居里夫人是开创性的物理学家，曾两次获得诺贝尔奖。
这位物理学家用生动的类比解释了量子力学。
现代物理学家常进行跨学科合作。

definitions.definition: 物理学（自然科学分支，研究物质、能量及其相互作用）
物理现象（泛指自然界的物质运动规律）

en: Newton's laws laid the foundation for classical physics.
Quantum physics challenges our understanding of reality.
The physics of ocean waves is complex yet fascinating.
cn: 牛顿定律为经典物理学奠定了基础。
量子物理学挑战我们对现实的认知。
海浪的物理现象复杂却迷人。

en: She played the piano with remarkable emotion.
The passage should be performed piano, as marked.
The antique piano was the centerpiece of the room.
cn: 她弹奏钢琴时充满动人的情感。
该乐段应按标记以弱奏方式演奏。
那架古董钢琴是房间的焦点。

en: She picked the red apple from the tree.
He used a pick to break the ice.
Don't pick at your food; it's impolite.
cn: 她从树上摘下了那个红苹果。
他用镐破冰。
不要挑食，这样不礼貌。

en: We packed sandwiches and fruit for a picnic in the park.
The project was no picnic, but we finished it on time.
They picnicked by the lake every Sunday in summer.
cn: 我们准备了三明治和水果去公园野餐。
这个项目并不轻松，但我们按时完成了。
夏天他们每周日在湖边野餐。

en: She drew a vivid picture of the sunset.
The book pictures life in medieval Europe.
Can you picture yourself living on Mars?
cn: 她画了一幅生动的日落图。
这本书描绘了中世纪欧洲的生活。
你能想象自己在火星上生活吗？

definitions.definition: 馅饼（一种烘焙食品，通常含甜或咸的馅料）
杂乱的事物；混杂体（非正式用法）

en: She baked an apple pie for dessert.
The report was a pie of unrelated facts.
He prefers savory pies like chicken pot pie.
cn: 她烤了一个苹果派当甜点。
这份报告是一堆无关事实的杂烩。
他更喜欢咸味馅饼，比如鸡肉派。

en: She cut the cake into six equal pieces.
This ancient vase was carefully pieced back together.
He wrote a brilliant piece of music for the event.
cn: 她把蛋糕切成六等份。
这个古花瓶被仔细拼接复原。
他为活动创作了一首精彩的乐曲。

en: The arrow pierced his armor.
Her scream pierced the night air.
Sunlight pierced through the thick curtains.
cn: 箭矢刺穿了他的铠甲。
她的尖叫声划破了夜空。
阳光穿透了厚重的窗帘。

definitions.definition: 猪（一种家养或野生的哺乳动物）

en: The farmer raised pigs for their meat.
Don't eat like a pig at the dinner party.
The children laughed at the muddy pig in the pen.
cn: 这位农民养猪以获取猪肉。
在晚宴上别像猪一样贪吃。
孩子们围栏里那只泥乎乎的猪逗笑了。

en: The pigeon cooed softly on the windowsill.
He’s such a pigeon—he believed that obvious scam.
Pigeons are common in urban areas worldwide.
cn: 鸽子在窗台上轻声咕咕叫。
他真是个傻瓜，居然相信那种明显的骗局。
鸽子在全球城市中都很常见。

en: She stacked the books in a neat pile on the desk.
The construction workers drove piles into the ground for the foundation.
He has a pile of work to finish by Friday.
cn: 她把书整齐地堆在桌上。
建筑工人将桩子打入地基。
他有一大堆工作要在周五前完成。

en: She takes a vitamin pill every morning.
The new policy was a bitter pill to swallow.
Don't be such a pill—join the fun!
cn: 她每天早晨服用一粒维生素药丸。
新政策令人难以接受。
别这么扫兴，一起来玩吧！

definitions.definition: 核心人物，中坚力量（比喻意义）

en: The ancient temple was supported by massive marble pillars.
She has been a pillar of strength for her family during the crisis.
Education is one of the pillars of a civilized society.
cn: 这座古庙由巨大的大理石柱支撑。
在危机中，她一直是家庭的坚强支柱。
教育是文明社会的基石之一。

en: She buried her face in the soft pillow.
He pillowed his head on a stack of books.
The clouds pillow the mountain peaks like cotton.
cn: 她把脸埋进柔软的枕头里。
他把头枕在一摞书上。
云朵如棉花般垫在山峰周围。

definitions.definition: 驾驶（飞机/船只）；引导；试验性推行

en: The pilot skillfully landed the plane during the storm.
We need an experienced guide to pilot us through the negotiations.
The government will pilot the new policy in three cities.
cn: 飞行员在暴风雨中熟练地降落了飞机。
我们需要一位经验丰富的向导来引导我们完成谈判。
政府将在三个城市试点推行新政策。

en: She fastened the fabric with a small pin.
The wrestler pinned his opponent to the mat.
The notice was attached to the board with a red pin.
cn: 她用一根小别针固定布料。
摔跤手将对手按在垫子上无法动弹。
通知用红色图钉钉在布告板上。

en: She pinched her brother’s arm playfully.
Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
He got pinched for shoplifting.
cn: 她开玩笑地捏了弟弟的手臂。
往汤里加一小撮盐。
他因入店行窃被抓。

definitions.definition: 渴望；憔悴（常与 for/after 连用）

en: The cabin was built from sturdy pine.
She pined for her homeland during the long winter.
Ancient pines stood like silent guardians on the mountain.
cn: 小木屋由结实的松木建造。
漫长冬日里，她思念着故乡。
古松如沉默的守卫矗立在山间。

en: She wore a dress in pale pink.
The garden was full of blooming pinks.
He pinked his opponent with a quick thrust of the foil.
cn: 她穿了一件淡粉色的连衣裙。
花园里开满了石竹花。
他用花剑迅速刺中了对手。

definitions.definition: 品脱（液量或干量单位，英制约568毫升，美制约473毫升）

en: He ordered a pint of beer at the pub.
The recipe calls for half a pint of cream.
In the UK, milk is often sold in pint bottles.
cn: 他在酒吧点了一品脱啤酒。
食谱需要半品脱奶油。
在英国，牛奶常按品脱瓶装销售。

en: She was a pioneer in the field of genetic research.
The company pioneered the use of solar energy in urban design.
Early settlers pioneered routes through the mountains.
cn: 她是基因研究领域的先驱。
这家公司率先将太阳能应用于城市设计。
早期移民开辟了穿越山脉的路线。

en: The water flows through a metal pipe under the street.
He filled his pipe with tobacco and lit it slowly.
The shepherd played a tune on his wooden pipe.
cn: 水通过街道下方的金属管道流动。
他往烟斗里装满烟草，缓缓点燃。
牧羊人用木笛吹奏了一首曲子。

definitions.definition: 管道（用于输送液体、气体或数据）
生产线；流水线（比喻性用法）

en: The oil pipeline stretches across three countries.
The new software optimizes the data pipeline for faster analysis.
Our production pipeline was disrupted by a shortage of materials.
cn: 这条输油管道横跨三个国家。
新软件优化了数据处理流水线以加速分析。
我们的生产线因材料短缺而中断。

en: He drew a pistol from his coat pocket.
The detective pistoled the lock to break in.
Early pistols were notoriously inaccurate.
cn: 他从大衣口袋掏出一把手枪。
侦探用手枪击碎门锁闯入。
早期手枪以精度极差著称。

en: They dug a deep pit to bury the treasure.
The surface of the moon is covered with pits caused by meteor impacts.
The competition pitted two rival companies against each other.
cn: 他们挖了一个深坑埋藏宝藏。
月球表面布满陨石撞击形成的凹坑。
这场比赛使两家敌对公司直接竞争。

definitions.definition: 音高；投掷；沥青；推销用语

en: The singer’s pitch was perfect during the performance.
He used a shovel to spread hot pitch on the roof.
The startup founder pitched her idea to the investors.
cn: 歌手在演出中的音高非常准确。
他用铲子将热沥青涂在屋顶上。
初创公司创始人向投资者推销她的创意。

en: She looked at the stray dog with pity.
It's a pity you can't attend the event.
He pitied the refugees and donated generously.
cn: 她怜悯地看着那只流浪狗。
真遗憾你不能参加这个活动。
他同情难民，慷慨解囊。

en: This city has many historical places worth visiting.
She placed the book carefully on the shelf.
I can't quite place where I've seen him before.
cn: 这座城市有许多值得参观的历史场所。
她小心翼翼地把书放在书架上。
我想不起来之前在哪里见过他。

en: The plain truth is that we need more time.
She wore a plain black dress to the party.
The vast plain stretched as far as the eye could see.
cn: 简单的事实是我们需要更多时间。
她穿了一条朴素的黑色连衣裙去参加派对。
广阔的平原一望无际。

en: She presented a detailed plan for the project.
We need to plan our budget carefully.
The city plans to build a new park next year.
cn: 她提交了一份详细的项目计划。
我们需要仔细规划预算。
该市计划明年新建一座公园。

en: The mathematician drew a plane intersecting the cube.
The plane will take off at 3 PM.
He used a plane to smooth the wooden board.
cn: 数学家画了一个与立方体相交的平面。
飞机将于下午3点起飞。
他用刨子刨平了木板。

definitions.definition: 行星（围绕恒星运行的天体）
（占星学中的）星体（传统上指肉眼可见的七颗天体，包括太阳和月亮）

en: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
Ancient astronomers studied the movements of planets.
In astrology, the position of planets is believed to influence human affairs.
cn: 地球是太阳系第三颗行星。
古代天文学家研究行星的运行轨迹。
占星学中，行星的位置被认为会影响人事。

en: The plant grows well in sunlight.
They plan to plant trees in the park.
The new car plant will open next year.
cn: 这种植物在阳光下生长良好。
他们计划在公园里种植树木。
新汽车工厂将于明年开业。

definitions.definition: 种植园（大规模农业用地，尤指热带地区的经济作物农场）
造林地（人工种植的树林）

en: The coffee plantation stretched across the hillside.
Early American plantations relied heavily on enslaved labor.
The government promoted tree plantations to combat deforestation.
cn: 这片咖啡种植园延伸至山坡。
早期美洲种植园极度依赖奴隶劳动。
政府推广人工造林以应对森林砍伐。

en: The workers plastered the walls smoothly.
She applied a plaster to the small cut.
His hair was plastered to his forehead by the rain.
cn: 工人将墙面抹得平整光滑。
她给伤口贴了一张创可贴。
雨水把他的头发紧贴在额头上。

definitions.definition: 可塑的；塑性的；人造的；不自然的

en: The toy is made of recycled plastic.
Her smile seemed stiff and plastic.
Clay is a highly plastic material.
cn: 这个玩具是用再生塑料制成的。
她的笑容显得僵硬而不自然。
黏土是一种可塑性极强的材料。

en: She carefully arranged the food on the porcelain plate.
The bridge is reinforced with steel plates.
The jeweler will plate the ring with gold.
cn: 她将食物精心摆放在瓷盘上。
这座桥用钢板加固。
珠宝匠将为戒指镀金。

definitions.definition: （政治纲领或政策的）宣言，政纲

en: The speaker stood on the platform to address the crowd.
The new policy is part of the party's election platform.
Social media platforms have changed how we communicate.
cn: 演讲者站在讲台上向人群发表讲话。
这项新政策是该党选举政纲的一部分。
社交媒体平台改变了我们的交流方式。

en: The children play in the park every afternoon.
She will play the piano at the concert.
His play on words impressed the audience.
cn: 孩子们每天下午在公园玩耍。
她将在音乐会上演奏钢琴。
他的双关语运用令观众印象深刻。

en: He is a talented player in the orchestra.
The team signed a new player for the season.
She’s a key player in the company’s success.
cn: 他是乐团中才华横溢的演奏者。
球队为本赛季签下了一名新运动员。
她是公司成功的关键参与者。

en: The children ran to the playground after school.
Silicon Valley is a playground for tech entrepreneurs.
The park includes a playground with swings and slides.
cn: 放学后孩子们跑向游乐场。
硅谷是科技创业者的乐园。
公园里有一个带秋千和滑梯的游乐场。

en: The garden has a pleasant aroma in spring.
She has a pleasant manner that puts people at ease.
The hotel offers pleasant accommodations at reasonable prices.
cn: 春天时这座花园散发着宜人的香气。
她友善的举止让人感到放松。
这家旅馆以合理的价格提供舒适的住宿。

en: Your generosity will please the guests.
Please pass me the salt.
She smiled, pleased with the result.
cn: 你的慷慨会让客人们高兴。
请把盐递给我。
她笑了，对结果感到满意。

en: Reading poetry is one of her greatest pleasures.
The child’s laughter brought pure pleasure to the room.
cn: 阅读诗歌是她最大的乐趣之一。
孩子的笑声为房间带来了纯粹的快乐。

en: The harvest was plentiful this year, with fields overflowing with grain.
She offered plentiful evidence to support her theory.
The region is known for its plentiful natural resources.
cn: 今年丰收，田里谷物满溢。
她提供了大量证据支持自己的理论。
该地区以丰富的自然资源闻名。

en: There is plenty of time to finish the project.
The garden has plenty of flowers in spring.
She gave us plenty of advice before the trip.
cn: 有充足的时间完成这个项目。
春天时花园里有许多花。
她在旅行前给了我们大量建议。

definitions.definition: 密谋；绘制（图表）；设计情节

en: The novel has a complex plot with unexpected twists.
They were accused of plotting against the government.
He planted vegetables in a small plot behind his house.
cn: 这部小说情节复杂，充满意外转折。
他们被指控密谋推翻政府。
他在屋后的小块土地上种植蔬菜。

en: The farmer used a horse to pull the plough through the field.
They continued to plough through the paperwork despite their fatigue.
The ship ploughed across the ocean, leaving a white wake behind.
cn: 农民用马拉着犁穿过田地。
尽管疲惫，他们仍坚持处理大量文书工作。
轮船破浪驶过海洋，身后留下一道白色航迹。

definitions.definition: 拔（羽毛、毛发等）；采摘（植物）；鼓起（勇气）

en: She plucked a rose from the garden.
He finally plucked up the courage to speak.
The chef plucked the feathers off the chicken.
cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵玫瑰。
他终于鼓起勇气开口。
厨师拔掉了鸡毛。

en: She pulled the plug to drain the water from the sink.
Don’t forget to plug your phone charger into the outlet.
The host kept plugging his new book during the interview.
cn: 她拔掉塞子排空水槽里的水。
别忘了把手机充电器插进插座。
主持人在采访中不断宣传他的新书。

en: The diver plunged into the crystal-clear water.
Stock prices plunged after the economic report.
She decided to take the plunge and start her own business.
cn: 跳水者扎入清澈的水中。
经济报告发布后股价暴跌。
她决定冒险一试，开始创业。

en: The word "children" is the plural form of "child".
The committee holds plural opinions on this issue.
Some languages have complex plural rules.
cn: “children”是“child”的复数形式。
委员会对此问题持有多种意见。
某些语言的复数规则很复杂。

en: Two plus two equals four.
The job offers a salary plus benefits.
Her experience is a definite plus for the team.
cn: 二加二等于四。
这份工作提供薪水外加福利。
她的经验对团队绝对是加分项。

en: She slipped the letter into her pocket.
He was accused of pocketing company funds.
This pocket dictionary is perfect for travelers.
cn: 她把信塞进了口袋。
他被指控侵吞公司资金。
这本袖珍词典非常适合旅行者。

en: She wrote a beautiful poem about the sea.
The poem captures the fleeting beauty of cherry blossoms.
Ancient epic poems often blend history with mythology.
cn: 她写了一首关于大海的优美诗篇。
这首诗捕捉了樱花转瞬即逝的美。
古代史诗常将历史与神话交融。

en: She is regarded as one of the greatest poets of the 20th century.
The poet recited his latest work at the literary festival.
Ancient poets often used nature as a metaphor for human emotions.
cn: 她被视作20世纪最伟大的诗人之一。
诗人在文学节上朗诵了他的新作。
古代诗人常以自然隐喻人类情感。

en: She finds solace in writing poetry.
The imagery in his poetry is strikingly vivid.
There’s a subtle poetry in the way light filters through the leaves.
cn: 她在写诗中找到慰藉。
他诗中的意象鲜明生动。
光线穿过树叶的方式有一种微妙的诗意。

en: She pointed at the map to show the location.
The professor emphasized the key points of the lecture.
The needle has a very sharp point.
cn: 她指着地图标明位置。
教授强调了演讲的关键要点。
这根针有一个非常尖锐的尖端。

en: The hunter used poison to kill the wolves.
Industrial waste is poisoning the river.
Jealousy can poison even the strongest friendships.
cn: 猎人用毒药杀死了狼群。
工业废水正在污染这条河流。
嫉妒甚至能毒害最牢固的友谊。

en: Some mushrooms are highly poisonous and can cause death if eaten.
She gave him a poisonous look after the argument.
The factory released poisonous gases into the atmosphere.
cn: 某些蘑菇有剧毒，食用可能导致死亡。
争吵后，她恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。
这家工厂向大气排放有毒气体。

en: The flag was mounted on a tall wooden pole.
The Earth's magnetic poles are shifting gradually.
Their opinions represent two opposite poles of the debate.
cn: 旗帜挂在一根高大的木杆上。
地球的磁极正在逐渐偏移。
他们的观点代表了辩论中对立的两极。

en: The police are investigating the robbery.
Community programs help police the neighborhood effectively.
His job is to police environmental regulations.
cn: 警方正在调查这起抢劫案。
社区项目有助于有效维持邻里治安。
他的职责是监督环保法规的执行。

definitions.definition: 男警察（尤指穿制服的警务人员）

en: The policeman directed traffic at the busy intersection.
A young policeman helped the lost child find his parents.
The policeman wore a badge and carried a radio.
cn: 这名警察在繁忙的十字路口指挥交通。
一位年轻的警察帮助迷路的孩子找到了父母。
这名警察佩戴着警徽并携带对讲机。

definitions.definition: 政策；方针（政府或组织的行动准则）

en: The government introduced a new policy to reduce carbon emissions.
Always read the terms of your insurance policy carefully.
Their company policy prohibits working from home.
cn: 政府出台了一项减少碳排放的新政策。
务必仔细阅读保险单的条款。
他们的公司政策禁止远程办公。

en: She polished the silverware until it shone.
His essay needs some polish before submission.
The furniture has a deep polish from years of care.
cn: 她将银器擦得闪闪发亮。
他的论文还需稍加润色才能提交。
多年的保养让家具表面光泽深邃。

en: She gave a polite nod to the stranger.
It's polite to say "thank you" when receiving help.
The debate remained surprisingly polite despite strong disagreements.
cn: 她向陌生人礼貌地点了点头。
接受帮助时说“谢谢”是得体的。
尽管存在严重分歧，辩论仍出人意料地保持文明。

definitions.definition: 政治的；政党的；对政治感兴趣的

en: She has always been deeply interested in political affairs.
The decision was purely political, not economic.
His speech addressed key political issues of our time.
cn: 她对政治事务一直有浓厚兴趣。
这一决定纯粹是政治性的，与经济无关。
他的演讲探讨了我们这个时代的核心政治问题。

en: The politician promised to lower taxes if elected.
Many voters distrust career politicians.
She was the first politician to address the issue openly.
cn: 这位政治家承诺当选后降低税收。
许多选民不信任职业政客。
她是首位公开讨论该问题的政界人士。

en: She decided to study politics at university.
Local politics can be just as complex as national affairs.
His sudden resignation was seen as a move in office politics.
cn: 她决定在大学攻读政治学。
地方政治可能和国家级事务一样复杂。
他的突然辞职被视为办公室权术的一步棋。

en: Factories must not pollute rivers with chemical waste.
Corrupt leaders pollute the trust of their people.
Air pollution continues to pollute major cities worldwide.
cn: 工厂不得用化学废物污染河流。
腐败的领导人会玷污人民的信任。
空气污染持续影响着全球主要城市。

definitions.definition: 污染（有害物质对环境或健康的侵害）
玷污，败坏（道德或精神的腐化）

en: Air pollution in cities harms respiratory health.
The novel explores the moral pollution of greed.
Plastic pollution in oceans threatens marine life.
cn: 城市空气污染危害呼吸健康。
这部小说探讨贪婪导致的道德败坏。
海洋塑料污染威胁生物生存。

en: The ducks swam peacefully in the village pond.
She skipped stones across the glassy surface of the pond.
The garden features a small ornamental pond with koi fish.
cn: 鸭子在村庄的池塘里安静地游动。
她掠过池塘如镜的水面打水漂。
花园里有一个养着锦鲤的装饰性小水池。

definitions.definition: 水池；池塘；共用资源（如资金、人才等）

en: The children swam in the hotel pool.
We pooled our money to buy a gift.
The company has a large talent pool.
cn: 孩子们在酒店的泳池里游泳。
我们凑钱合买了一份礼物。
该公司拥有庞大的人才库。

en: Many families were too poor to afford medical care.
The poor quality of the materials led to frequent repairs.
She gave a poor excuse for being late.
cn: 许多家庭穷得负担不起医疗费用。
材料质量低劣导致频繁维修。
她为迟到找了个蹩脚的借口。

definitions.definition: 流行音乐；汽水；砰的一声
发出砰的一声；突然出现

en: The balloon popped loudly.
She loves listening to pop music.
He popped the question during dinner.
cn: 气球砰的一声爆了。
她喜欢听流行音乐。
他在晚餐时突然求婚。

en: The café is popular among students for its affordable prices.
She has a talent for making complex topics popular science.
Social media trends change rapidly in popular culture.
cn: 这家咖啡馆因价格实惠而受学生欢迎。
她擅长将复杂话题转化为通俗科学。
大众文化中的社交媒体趋势瞬息万变。

definitions.definition: 人口（特定地区的居民总数）

en: The population of Tokyo exceeds 14 million people.
Scientists studied the wolf population in Yellowstone National Park.
A random sample was drawn from the target population.
cn: 东京人口超过1400万。
科学家研究了黄石公园的狼群数量。
从目标总体中抽取了随机样本。

definitions.definition: 门廊（建筑物入口处有顶的开放式空间）
（美式）阳台（房屋外侧的开放式平台）

en: She sat on the porch, sipping tea and watching the sunset.
The old house has a wraparound porch with wooden rocking chairs.
In summer, we often eat dinner on the screened porch to avoid mosquitoes.
cn: 她坐在门廊上，喝着茶看日落。
这栋老房子有一个带摇椅的环绕式门廊。
夏天我们常在纱窗阳台上吃晚饭以防蚊子。

en: Roast pork with apples is a traditional dish in this region.
The supermarket sells fresh pork every morning.
She avoids eating pork for religious reasons.
cn: 苹果烤猪肉是该地区的传统菜肴。
这家超市每天早晨出售新鲜猪肉。
她因宗教原因避免食用猪肉。

definitions.definition: 粥（尤指燕麦或谷物煮成的稠软食物）

en: Scottish porridge is traditionally served with a pinch of salt.
She stirred the porridge slowly to prevent it from sticking to the pot.
A bowl of hot porridge is perfect for cold winter mornings.
cn: 苏格兰传统燕麦粥会加一小撮盐食用。
她慢慢搅拌粥以防粘锅。
一碗热粥是寒冷冬日早晨的完美选择。

en: The ship arrived at the port at dawn.
Connect the cable to the USB port.
The app was ported to Android last year.
cn: 船只于黎明时分抵达港口。
将数据线插入USB端口。
该应用去年被移植到安卓系统。

en: This portable charger fits easily in your pocket.
The museum offers portable audio guides for visitors.
Her job requires a portable computer for frequent travel.
cn: 这款便携充电器可轻松放入口袋。
博物馆为游客提供便携式语音导览器。
她的工作需要一台便于频繁出差的便携电脑。

definitions.definition: 波特啤酒（一种深色啤酒）

en: The hotel porter helped us with our luggage.
She works as a porter in the local hospital.
He ordered a pint of porter at the pub.
cn: 酒店门房帮我们搬运行李。
她在当地医院担任护工。
他在酒吧点了一杯波特啤酒。

en: She only ate a small portion of the cake.
The inheritance was portioned equally among the siblings.
A significant portion of the budget is allocated to education.
cn: 她只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
遗产被平均分配给兄弟姐妹。
预算的很大一部分拨给了教育。

en: The artist painted a portrait of the queen.
Her novel is a vivid portrait of life in the 19th century.
The documentary offers a complex portrait of the politician.
cn: 艺术家为女王绘制了一幅肖像。
她的小说生动刻画了19世纪的生活图景。
这部纪录片展现了这位政治家的多面性。

definitions.definition: 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的

en: She is fluent in Portuguese and Spanish.
Portuguese explorers played a key role in the Age of Discovery.
This restaurant serves authentic Portuguese cuisine.
cn: 她精通葡萄牙语和西班牙语。
葡萄牙探险家在大航海时代发挥了关键作用。
这家餐厅提供地道的葡萄牙菜。

en: The telescope is in a fixed position to observe the stars.
She holds a senior position in the company.
The coach positioned the players strategically.
cn: 望远镜固定在观测星星的位置。
她在公司担任高级职位。
教练战略性地部署了球员的位置。

en: She has a positive attitude toward life.
The test results came back positive.
He gave positive feedback on the project.
cn: 她对生活抱有积极的态度。
检测结果呈阳性。
他对项目给予了肯定的反馈。

en: She possesses a rare collection of medieval manuscripts.
Fear possessed him when he entered the abandoned house.
The law states that citizens possess the right to free speech.
cn: 她拥有一批珍贵的中世纪手稿。
当他走进废弃房屋时，恐惧支配了他。
法律规定公民享有言论自由权。

en: The keys are in his possession.
She lost all her possessions in the fire.
The story tells of a man under the possession of evil spirits.
cn: 钥匙在他手中。
火灾中她失去了全部财产。
这个故事讲述了一个被恶灵附身的男人。

en: There is a strong possibility of rain tomorrow.
We need to explore every possibility before making a decision.
The invention opened up new possibilities for renewable energy.
cn: 明天很有可能下雨。
我们需要在决策前穷尽所有可能性。
这项发明为可再生能源开辟了新的可能性。

en: It is possible to finish the project by Friday.
She considered all possible options before deciding.
The weather forecast says rain is possible tomorrow.
cn: 有可能在周五前完成这个项目。
她在做决定前考虑了所有可能的选择。
天气预报说明天可能会下雨。

definitions.definition: 可能地（表示不确定或可能性）
或许（用于委婉表达或让步）

en: Can you possibly finish the report by noon?
This is possibly the best solution we have.
She might possibly agree if we explain the benefits.
cn: 你有可能在中午前完成报告吗？
这或许是我们现有的最佳解决方案。
如果我们解释好处，她可能会同意。

en: She works as a post office clerk.
Please post this letter before noon.
The professor was appointed to a prestigious academic post.
cn: 她在邮局担任职员。
请在中午前寄出这封信。
这位教授被任命到一个享有盛誉的学术职位。

en: The postage for international letters has increased this year.
She collects vintage postage stamps as a hobby.
Don’t forget to include the return postage with your package.
cn: 今年国际信件的邮资上涨了。
她以收集复古邮票为爱好。
别忘了在包裹里附上回邮邮资。

en: The postman delivers letters to our house every morning.
I left a package for the postman to pick up.
Becoming a postman requires good knowledge of the local area.
cn: 邮递员每天早晨把信件投递到我们家。
我留了一个包裹让邮递员取走。
成为一名邮递员需要熟悉当地区域。

en: The meeting was postponed due to the heavy snow.
She decided to postpone her trip until next month.
Never postpone what you can do today to tomorrow.
cn: 会议因大雪被推迟。
她决定将旅行推迟到下个月。
今日事今日毕。

en: She boiled water in a large pot.
He accidentally broke the clay pot.
The hunter potted a rabbit with a clean shot.
cn: 她在锅里煮水。
他不小心打碎了陶罐。
猎人一枪射中了兔子。

en: She planted potatoes in her backyard garden.
The dish is made with mashed potatoes and butter.
Don't worry about his opinion—he's just a small potato.
cn: 她在后院菜园里种了土豆。
这道菜用土豆泥和黄油制成。
别在意他的看法，他不过是个小人物。

en: She has the potential to become a great leader.
The drug has potential side effects.
We are exploring the potential of renewable energy.
cn: 她有潜力成为一名伟大的领导者。
这种药物可能有副作用。
我们正在探索可再生能源的潜力。

definitions.definition: 磅（重量单位）；英镑（货币单位）
猛烈敲打；（心脏）剧烈跳动

en: The package weighs about five pounds.
He pounded the table angrily during the argument.
My heart was pounding after running up the stairs.
cn: 这个包裹重约五磅。
争论中他愤怒地捶打桌子。
跑上楼梯后，我的心跳得厉害。

definitions.definition: 倾倒（液体或颗粒物）；大量涌出

en: She poured the tea into delicate china cups.
Rain poured down all night, flooding the streets.
The crowd poured out of the stadium after the concert.
cn: 她将茶倒入精致的瓷杯中。
大雨倾盆整夜，街道被淹没。
音乐会结束后，人群涌出体育场。

en: Millions of people still live in extreme poverty.
The poverty of her imagination made the story dull.
His research focuses on reducing child poverty.
cn: 仍有数百万人生活在极端贫困中。
她想象力的匮乏使得故事索然无味。
他的研究致力于减少儿童贫困问题。

en: She dusted her face with translucent powder.
The ancient recipe used crushed herbs as healing powder.
Gunpowder revolutionized warfare in medieval Europe.
cn: 她在脸上扑了一层透明散粉。
这个古老配方将草药碾碎用作治疗药粉。
火药彻底改变了中世纪欧洲的战争形态。

en: Knowledge is power.
The engine powers the entire factory.
She has the power to influence decisions.
cn: 知识就是力量。
这台发动机为整个工厂提供动力。
她拥有影响决策的权力。

definitions.definition: （药物或饮料）效力强的，作用大的

en: The powerful engine roared to life.
She gave a powerful speech that moved the audience.
This medicine is too powerful for children.
cn: 强劲的引擎轰鸣着启动。
她发表了一场震撼人心的演讲。
这种药对儿童来说药效过强。

definitions.definition: 实际的；实用的（与理论相对）

en: She has a practical approach to problem-solving.
This tool is practical for everyday use.
His suggestion was practical but lacked creativity.
cn: 她解决问题的方式很务实。
这个工具适合日常使用。
他的建议可行但缺乏创意。

definitions.definition: 实际地；实用地（强调可行性）

en: The project is practically finished, just needing final adjustments.
She approaches problems practically, focusing on solutions.
It's practically impossible to predict the weather a month in advance.
cn: 这个项目几乎完成了，只需最后调整。
她实际地处理问题，专注于解决方案。
提前一个月预测天气几乎是不可能的。

en: Regular practice improves your skills.
She practices law in New York.
This theory is hard to put into practice.
cn: 定期练习能提升你的技能。
她在纽约从事法律工作。
这一理论难以付诸实践。

definitions.definition: 练习；实践；实行（英式拼写，美式拼写为 "practice"）
练习；惯例（英式拼写，用法较少，通常用 "practice" 作名词）

en: She practises the piano for two hours every day.
Lawyers must practise honesty in all professional matters.
The theory sounds easy, but it’s hard to practise in real life.
cn: 她每天练习钢琴两小时。
律师必须在所有职业事务中践行诚信。
这个理论听起来简单，但在现实生活中很难实践。

en: She received high praise for her innovative design.
The teacher praised the student's honesty.
His work is beyond praise.
cn: 她因创新的设计受到高度赞扬。
老师表扬了学生的诚实。
他的工作令人赞不绝口。

definitions.definition: 恳求，请求（正式或宗教语境）

en: She knelt to pray for her family's safety.
I pray you to reconsider this decision.
The villagers pray for rain during the drought.
cn: 她跪下为家人的安全祈祷。
我恳求你重新考虑这个决定。
干旱期间，村民们祈求降雨。

en: She knelt in silent prayer.
The priest recited a traditional prayer.
His prayer for peace moved the audience.
cn: 她跪地默祷。
神父诵念了一篇传统祷文。
他为和平的祈祷打动了听众。

definitions.definition: 预先警告或采取防护措施（罕见用法）

en: Wearing a helmet is a simple precaution against head injuries.
The government issued a precaution about the approaching storm.
She took the precaution of locking her valuables in a safe.
cn: 佩戴头盔是预防头部受伤的简单措施。
政府发布了关于即将来临的暴风雨的预警。
她采取了将贵重物品锁进保险箱的预防措施。

en: The preceding chapter explains the basic concepts.
Check the preceding paragraph for more details.
His preceding achievements set a high standard.
cn: 前一章节解释了基本概念。
详情请查看前一段落。
他先前的成就设定了高标准。

en: She kept her precious jewels in a safe.
Time is the most precious resource we have.
His grandmother's advice was precious to him.
cn: 她将珍贵的珠宝存放在保险箱中。
时间是我们拥有的最宝贵资源。
祖母的忠告对他来说无比珍贵。

en: The scientist took precise measurements to ensure the experiment's accuracy.
Her instructions were clear and precise, leaving no room for confusion.
The watch is known for its precise timekeeping.
cn: 科学家进行了精确测量以确保实验的准确性。
她的指示清晰而严谨，不容任何混淆。
这款手表以走时精准著称。

en: The surgeon performed the operation with remarkable precision.
This instrument measures time with atomic precision.
Her report lacked precision in key details.
cn: 外科医生以极高的精确度完成了手术。
该仪器以原子级精度测量时间。
她的报告在关键细节上缺乏准确性。

en: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain tomorrow.
Ancient astrologers tried to predict events by studying stars.
No one could have predicted the sudden market crash.
cn: 天气预报预测明天有大雨。
古代占星家试图通过观测星象来预言事件。
没人能预料到市场的突然崩溃。

definitions.definition: 序言，前言（书籍开头的介绍性文字）

en: The author wrote a heartfelt preface to the new edition.
She prefaced her speech with a quote from Shakespeare.
A brief historical context prefaced the scientific report.
cn: 作者为新版撰写了一篇真挚的序言。
她以一句莎士比亚的引言作为演讲的开场。
一篇简史背景作为这份科学报告的开篇。

en: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
The prosecutor decided to prefer charges against the suspect.
She prefers working remotely for better productivity.
cn: 早晨我更喜欢喝茶而非咖啡。
检察官决定对嫌疑人提出控告。
她更喜欢远程工作以提高效率。

en: A dark suit is preferable to a light one for evening wear.
It would be preferable to postpone the meeting.
Fresh ingredients are always preferable to canned ones.
cn: 深色西装比浅色更适合晚间穿着。
推迟会议会是更可取的做法。
新鲜食材总比罐装的更胜一筹。

en: She has a strong preference for tea over coffee.
The committee gave preference to candidates with practical experience.
Personal preference should not influence professional decisions.
cn: 她比起咖啡更偏爱茶。
委员会优先考虑有实践经验的候选人。
个人偏好不应影响专业决策。

en: The study aims to reduce racial prejudice in schools.
His honesty prejudiced the jury in his favor.
Don’t let gossip prejudice you against her.
cn: 这项研究旨在减少学校中的种族偏见。
他的诚实让陪审团对他产生了有利的偏见。
别让流言蜚语让你对她产生偏见。

en: The team conducted a preliminary analysis of the data.
The first round is just a preliminary to the main competition.
We need to complete some preliminary paperwork before starting the project.
cn: 团队对数据进行了初步分析。
第一轮仅是主赛事的预赛。
项目启动前需完成一些预备文件工作。

en: She holds the premier position in the company.
The premier announced new economic policies.
This museum houses the premier collection of Renaissance art.
cn: 她在公司担任最高职位。
总理宣布了新的经济政策。
该博物馆拥有最顶尖的文艺复兴艺术藏品。

en: The team began preparation for the upcoming conference months in advance.
This medicinal preparation contains extracts of three herbs.
Mental preparation is as important as physical training for athletes.
cn: 团队提前数月开始筹备即将召开的会议。
这种药剂含有三种草本提取物。
对运动员而言，心理准备和体能训练同样重要。

en: She needs to prepare a speech for the conference.
The chef is preparing a special dish for the guests.
We should prepare for unexpected challenges.
cn: 她需要为会议准备一篇演讲。
厨师正在为客人准备一道特色菜。
我们应该为意外挑战做好准备。

definitions.definition: 介词（语法中表示名词与其他词关系的词）
前置（逻辑或数学中的位置关系）

en: The word "on" is a preposition indicating location.
In logic, prepositions define relationships between elements.
She struggled with the use of prepositions in German.
cn: 单词“on”是表示位置的介词。
在逻辑学中，前置词定义元素间的关系。
她在德语介词的使用上遇到困难。

en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
The law prescribes strict penalties for fraud.
Always follow the dosage prescribed by your physician.
cn: 医生为感染开了抗生素。
法律规定对欺诈行为处以严厉惩罚。
务必遵循医生处方的用药剂量。

en: Her presence at the meeting was essential for the decision-making process.
The actor commanded the stage with a powerful presence.
There was a strange presence in the old house, as if someone was watching.
cn: 她的出席会议对决策过程至关重要。
这位演员以强大的气场掌控了舞台。
老宅里有一种诡异的氛围，仿佛有人在注视。

en: She wrapped the present carefully.
All members were present at the meeting.
The professor will present his research tomorrow.
cn: 她仔细地包装了礼物。
所有成员都出席了会议。
教授将于明天展示他的研究成果。

en: She is presently working on a new project.
The guests will arrive presently.
Presently, the company focuses on sustainable development.
cn: 她目前正在做一个新项目。
客人们马上就到。
目前，该公司专注于可持续发展。

definitions.definition: 保护，保存（免受损害或变化）

en: We must preserve these ancient forests for future generations.
Grandmother used to preserve peaches in honey.
The wildlife preserve is home to endangered species.
cn: 我们必须为后代保护这些原始森林。
祖母过去常用蜂蜜腌制桃子。
这片野生动物保护区是濒危物种的家园。

en: The president delivered a speech on national unity.
She was elected president of the student council.
The board appointed a new company president.
cn: 总统发表了关于国家团结的演讲。
她当选为学生委员会主席。
董事会任命了一位新的公司总裁。

en: She pressed the button to start the machine.
The press criticized the government's new policy.
Time is pressing, so we need to make a decision quickly.
cn: 她按下按钮启动机器。
新闻界批评了政府的新政策。
时间紧迫，我们需要尽快做出决定。

en: The water pressure in the pipes is too high.
She felt pressure to succeed from her family.
The government pressured the company to reduce emissions.
cn: 管道中的水压过高。
她感受到来自家庭的成功压力。
政府施压该公司减少排放。

definitions.definition: 自称，声称（常含虚假意味）

en: She pretended not to hear the rude comment.
He pretended to be an expert, but his advice was useless.
Children often pretend that cardboard boxes are spaceships.
cn: 她假装没听到那句粗鲁的评论。
他自称专家，但他的建议毫无用处。
孩子们常把纸箱假装成太空船。

en: She wore a pretty dress to the party.
The solution is pretty simple once you understand it.
The garden looks pretty in spring with all the flowers blooming.
cn: 她穿了一条漂亮的裙子去参加派对。
一旦理解，解决方法就相当简单。
春天花园里鲜花盛开，看起来非常美丽。

definitions.definition: 说服（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: Justice will prevail in the end.
The custom of wearing hats indoors still prevails in some regions.
She prevailed upon her father to lend her the car.
cn: 正义终将获胜。
室内戴帽的习俗仍在某些地区盛行。
她说服父亲把车借给了她。

en: Vaccination helps prevent serious diseases.
The rain prevented us from going hiking.
Early intervention can prevent problems from escalating.
cn: 疫苗接种有助于预防严重疾病。
大雨阻碍了我们徒步旅行。
早期干预能防止问题升级。

en: She showed no interest in previous discussions.
The previous owner left the house in good condition.
Check the previous chapter for background information.
cn: 她对先前的讨论毫无兴趣。
前主人将房子保持得完好。
背景信息请查阅前一章节。

en: The document was previously reviewed by the committee.
She had previously worked as a teacher before switching careers.
The building was previously owned by a famous artist.
cn: 这份文件此前已由委员会审核。
她在转行前曾是一名教师。
这栋建筑曾为一位著名艺术家所有。

en: The price of gasoline has risen sharply this year.
She priced the necklace at $200.
Winning the competition came at a high price—months of exhausting training.
cn: 今年汽油价格大幅上涨。
她给这条项链定价为200美元。
赢得比赛的代价是数月的高强度训练。

en: She felt a surge of pride when her son won the competition.
His pride prevented him from asking for help.
A pride of lions rested under the acacia tree.
cn: 当儿子赢得比赛时，她涌起一阵自豪。
他的自尊心让他不愿求助。
一群狮子在金合欢树下休息。

definitions.definition: 神父，牧师（基督教或其他宗教的圣职人员）

en: The priest delivered a sermon on kindness.
In ancient Egypt, priests performed rituals in temples.
She decided to confide in the local priest about her struggles.
cn: 这位神父布道关于仁慈的主题。
在古埃及，祭司们在神庙中执行仪式。
她决定向当地牧师倾诉她的困境。

en: The study is primarily focused on climate change.
She works primarily as a consultant but also teaches part-time.
The damage was primarily caused by human error.
cn: 这项研究主要关注气候变化。
她主要从事顾问工作，但也兼职教学。
损坏主要由人为错误导致。

en: The primary goal of education is to foster critical thinking.
She attended a primary school in the countryside.
He won the Democratic primary in New Hampshire.
cn: 教育的主要目标是培养批判性思维。
她曾就读于乡村的一所小学。
他在新罕布什尔州赢得了民主党初选。

en: She is in the prime of her career.
The coach primed the team before the final match.
cn: 她正处于事业的巅峰期。
教练在决赛前为团队做了充分准备。

en: The archaeologists discovered primitive tools made of stone.
His painting style is deliberately primitive, with bold colors and rough shapes.
Some tribes still live a primitive lifestyle in the rainforest.
cn: 考古学家发现了石器时代的原始工具。
他的绘画风格刻意追求原始感，色彩浓烈，线条粗犷。
一些部落仍在雨林中过着原始的生活。

definitions.definition: 王子；亲王（君主制国家中男性皇室成员的头衔）
（喻）杰出人物，领域权威（如 "a prince of poets"）

en: The young prince will inherit the throne after his father's abdication.
Shakespeare is often called the prince of dramatists.
The charity gala was attended by princes of industry and finance.
cn: 这位年轻的王子将在父亲退位后继承王位。
莎士比亚常被称为戏剧家的王者。
慈善晚宴吸引了工商业与金融界的巨头们参加。

definitions.definition: 公主（国王或女王的女儿）

en: The little girl dressed up as a princess for the school play.
Princess Diana was beloved for her humanitarian work.
The princess waved to the crowd from the palace balcony.
cn: 这个小女孩在学校话剧里扮演公主。
戴安娜王妃因其人道主义工作而深受爱戴。
公主从宫殿阳台上向人群挥手致意。

en: The principal announced new school policies during assembly.
The principal amount of the loan must be repaid within five years.
She played the principal role in the theater production.
cn: 校长在集会上宣布了新校规。
贷款本金需在五年内偿还。
她在戏剧中担任主角。

en: The experiment confirmed a basic principle of physics.
She refused to compromise her principles.
Democracy operates on the principle of majority rule.
cn: 这个实验验证了物理学的一项基本原理。
她拒绝违背自己的原则。
民主制度遵循多数决原则运作。

en: The book was printed in bold font.
Her footsteps left prints in the sand.
We need to print 100 copies for the meeting.
cn: 这本书用粗体字印刷。
她的脚印留在了沙滩上。
我们需要为会议打印100份材料。

en: This task must be given prior attention.
He had no prior experience in teaching.
The prior of the monastery welcomed the visitors.
cn: 这项任务必须优先处理。
他之前没有教学经验。
修道院的副院长接待了访客。

en: He was sent to prison for theft.
The castle was used as a prison during the war.
She felt trapped in a prison of her own making.
cn: 他因盗窃罪入狱。
这座城堡在战争期间被用作监狱。
她感觉自己困在了自我制造的牢笼中。

en: The prisoner escaped through a tunnel.
She felt like a prisoner in her own home.
The lawyer demanded fair treatment for the political prisoners.
cn: 囚犯通过地道逃脱了。
她觉得自己像被困在家中的囚徒。
律师要求公平对待政治犯。

definitions.definition: 私人的；私有的；非公开的
士兵；列兵（军队最低军衔）

en: She values her private time to read and reflect.
The meeting was held in a private room.
He enlisted as a private in the army.
cn: 她珍惜私人时间用于阅读和思考。
会议在一间私密房间内举行。
他以列兵身份参军。

en: Education should be a right, not a privilege.
He was privileged to attend the private conference.
Wealth often brings social privileges.
cn: 教育应是权利，而非特权。
他获准参加这场内部会议。
财富常带来社会特权。

definitions.definition: 奖品；奖赏；值得追求的东西

en: She won first prize in the science competition.
He prizes his grandfather’s watch above all other possessions.
The real prize is the knowledge gained through hard work.
cn: 她在科学竞赛中赢得一等奖。
他珍视祖父的手表胜过其他所有财物。
真正的奖赏是通过努力获得的知识。

en: The probability of rain tomorrow is 70%.
In quantum physics, probability determines particle behavior.
There's a high probability he'll win the election.
cn: 明天降雨的概率是70%。
在量子物理学中，概率决定粒子行为。
他赢得选举的可能性很高。

en: It is probable that the meeting will be postponed.
The probable cause of the accident was engine failure.
His explanation sounds probable, but we need more evidence.
cn: 会议很可能会推迟。
事故的可能原因是引擎故障。
他的解释听起来合理，但我们需要更多证据。

en: She will probably arrive by noon.
This is probably the best solution.
He probably forgot about the meeting.
cn: 她很可能中午前到达。
这大概是最佳解决方案。
他大概忘了开会的事。

en: The main problem is lack of funding.
She solved the math problem in five minutes.
Climate change poses a serious problem for humanity.
cn: 主要问题是资金不足。
她在五分钟内解出了这道数学题。
气候变化对人类构成严峻挑战。

definitions.definition: 程序，步骤（正式或官方的操作流程）
手术（医学领域特定用法）

en: The company has strict procedures for handling complaints.
The surgical procedure took less than an hour.
Follow the correct procedure to reset your password.
cn: 公司有严格的投诉处理流程。
这台手术用时不到一小时。
按照正确步骤重置密码。

en: The team decided to proceed with the project despite the risks.
Legal action may proceed if no agreement is reached.
After the interruption, the speaker proceeded calmly.
cn: 尽管有风险，团队决定继续推进项目。
若无法达成协议，可能会提起诉讼。
被打断后，演讲者平静地继续了下去。

en: The manufacturing process requires strict quality control.
She learned how to process raw data into meaningful reports.
Grief is a natural process that takes time.
cn: 制造过程需要严格的质量控制。
她学会了如何将原始数据处理成有意义的报告。
悲伤是一个需要时间的自然过程。

en: The wedding procession moved slowly down the aisle.
Thousands attended the candlelight procession to honor the victims.
The festival begins with a colorful procession through the town.
cn: 婚礼队伍缓缓走过通道。
数千人参加烛光游行以纪念遇难者。
节日以穿过城镇的彩色游行队伍拉开序幕。

en: The king proclaimed a national holiday.
Her confident tone proclaimed her authority.
The poster proclaimed the arrival of the circus.
cn: 国王宣布全国放假一天。
她自信的语气彰显了她的权威。
海报宣告了马戏团的到来。

en: The factory produces 500 cars daily.
Fresh produce is essential for a healthy diet.
Her speech produced a strong reaction from the audience.
cn: 这家工厂每天生产500辆汽车。
新鲜农产品是健康饮食的关键。
她的演讲引发了观众的强烈反响。

definitions.definition: 产品；制品（通过劳动或制造产生的物品）
结果；产物（自然或抽象过程的产出）

en: This company specializes in organic skincare products.
The novel was the product of years of research.
The product of 5 and 3 is 15.
cn: 这家公司专营有机护肤品。
这部小说是多年研究的成果。
5和3的乘积是15。

en: The factory increased its production by 20% last year.
The film's production took over two years due to complex special effects.
Her latest art production explores themes of identity.
cn: 该工厂去年产量增加了20%。
由于复杂的特效，这部电影的制作耗时两年多。
她的最新艺术作品探讨了身份主题。

en: She transformed her small garden into a productive vegetable patch.
The meeting was highly productive, with three key decisions made.
His creative block ended, and he entered a productive phase.
cn: 她将小花园改造成高产菜地。
会议效率极高，达成了三项关键决议。
创作瓶颈结束后，他进入了高产阶段。

definitions.definition: 职业，专业（需专门知识或培训的领域）
公开声明，宣称（尤指信仰或立场）

en: Teaching is a rewarding profession that requires patience and dedication.
She made a profession of her political beliefs during the rally.
The medical profession has seen significant advancements in recent years.
cn: 教学是一项需要耐心和奉献的有意义的职业。
她在集会上公开表明了自己的政治信仰。
近年来，医学领域取得了重大进展。

en: She is a professional photographer with over 10 years of experience.
His professional attitude impressed the clients.
The tennis tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.
cn: 她是一名拥有10年以上经验的职业摄影师。
他的专业态度给客户留下了深刻印象。
这场网球比赛对业余选手和职业选手均开放。

definitions.definition: 教授（大学或学院的高级教师职称）
（非正式）专家；公开宣称某种信仰的人

en: She is a professor of astrophysics at Harvard.
He professed his love for classical music.
The professor’s lecture challenged traditional theories.
cn: 她是哈佛大学的天体物理学教授。
他公开表达了对古典音乐的热爱。
这位教授的讲座挑战了传统理论。

en: The company reported a significant profit this quarter.
She profited greatly from her overseas experience.
Non-profit organizations focus on social impact rather than financial gain.
cn: 该公司本季度报告了显著利润。
她的海外经历让她受益匪浅。
非营利组织关注社会影响而非财务收益。

en: She is learning to program in Python.
The conference program includes three keynote speeches.
Check the TV program guide for tonight's shows.
cn: 她正在学习用Python编写程序。
会议日程包含三场主题演讲。
查看电视节目表了解今晚的播出内容。

en: The project is making steady progress.
Technology has progressed rapidly in the past decade.
Her language skills progressed significantly after studying abroad.
cn: 该项目正在稳步推进。
过去十年间，技术飞速进步。
留学后，她的语言能力显著提升。

en: The company adopted a progressive approach to employee benefits.
She is a vocal advocate for progressive environmental policies.
The disease causes progressive loss of muscle control.
cn: 该公司采取了渐进式的员工福利政策。
她是环保进步政策的积极倡导者。
这种疾病会导致肌肉控制能力逐渐丧失。

en: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
Smoking is strictly prohibited in this area.
High costs prohibit many people from accessing healthcare.
cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
此区域严禁吸烟。
高昂费用使许多人无法获得医疗服务。

en: The team completed the research project on time.
The tree projects a long shadow in the evening sun.
She projected confidence during her presentation.
cn: 团队按时完成了该研究项目。
树木在夕阳下投下长长的影子。
她在演讲中展现出了自信。

en: The church tower was the most prominent feature of the skyline.
She played a prominent role in the scientific breakthrough.
His prominent cheekbones gave his face a distinctive look.
cn: 教堂的塔楼是天际线上最醒目的特征。
她在这项科学突破中发挥了重要作用。
他高耸的颧骨让他的面容独具特色。

en: She made a promise to return the book by Friday.
The clear sky promises a sunny day tomorrow.
His talent promises great success in the future.
cn: 她承诺周五前归还这本书。
晴朗的天空预示明天会是晴天。
他的天赋预示未来可能取得巨大成功。

definitions.definition: 表现出未来成功潜力的

en: She is a promising young scientist with groundbreaking ideas.
The early test results look promising for the new drug.
His promising career was cut short by the accident.
cn: 她是一位有前途的年轻科学家，拥有突破性的想法。
这种新药的早期测试结果看起来很有希望。
一场事故中断了他本应光明的事业。

en: She worked hard and was promoted to manager within a year.
This campaign aims to promote environmental awareness.
The company spends millions to promote its new smartphone.
cn: 她努力工作，一年内就被晋升为经理。
该活动旨在提升环保意识。
公司花费数百万推广新款智能手机。

en: Her prompt response saved the project.
The teacher prompted the student with a hint.
Type your command after the prompt.
cn: 她的迅速回应拯救了项目。
老师用提示引导学生。
在提示符后输入你的命令。

definitions.definition: 代词（用于替代名词或名词短语的词）

en: "She" is a pronoun that refers to a female person.
In the sentence "They love their dog," "they" is a pronoun.
Some languages have no distinct pronouns for gender.
cn: “She”是一个指代女性人物的代词。
在句子“They love their dog”中，“they”是代词。
某些语言中没有区分性别的代词。

en: She pronounced the word with perfect clarity.
The judge will pronounce the verdict tomorrow.
I hesitate to pronounce on such a complex issue.
cn: 她以极其清晰的发音读出这个词。
法官将于明日宣布判决。
我对如此复杂的问题不敢妄加评论。

definitions.definition: 发音（指单词或语言的读音方式）
发音法（指发音的技巧或规则）

en: Her pronunciation of French words is impeccable.
The app helps improve your English pronunciation.
Mispronunciation can lead to misunderstandings.
cn: 她的法语发音无可挑剔。
这款应用能帮助你改善英语发音。
发音错误可能导致误解。

en: The scientist presented conclusive proof of the theory.
Please check the printer's proof before mass production.
This fabric is water-resistant but not fully waterproof.
cn: 科学家提出了该理论的确凿证据。
批量印刷前请核对校样。
这种面料防水但不完全耐水。

en: Wear proper attire for the interview.
The proper name of this compound is "hydrogen peroxide".
The city proper has a population of two million.
cn: 面试请穿着得体。
这种化合物的正确名称是“过氧化氢”。
该市市区人口为两百万。

en: Please ensure the documents are properly filed.
The engine wasn’t working properly until he fixed it.
She was properly exhausted after the marathon.
cn: 请确保文件正确归档。
在他修理之前，引擎一直无法正常运转。
马拉松后，她彻底精疲力竭。

en: The house is now her legal property.
Scientists studied the chemical properties of the substance.
Respect for intellectual property is crucial in research.
cn: 这栋房子现在是她的合法财产。
科学家研究了该物质的化学特性。
尊重知识产权在研究中至关重要。

en: The proportion of water to flour should be 2:1.
Her head is in perfect proportion to her body.
We need to allocate resources in proportion to the project's needs.
cn: 水与面粉的比例应为2:1。
她的头部与身体比例完美。
我们需要按项目需求的比例分配资源。

en: The salary increase is proportional to years of service.
The graph shows a proportional relationship between variables.
In art, proportional balance creates visual harmony.
cn: 薪资涨幅与工作年限成正比。
图表显示了变量间的比例关系。
艺术中，比例均衡能营造视觉和谐。

definitions.definition: 提议，建议（正式提出的计划或方案）
求婚（特指婚姻的正式请求）

en: The committee rejected his proposal to cut the budget.
She was surprised by his sudden marriage proposal.
The research proposal must be submitted by Friday.
cn: 委员会拒绝了他削减预算的提议。
他突然的求婚让她措手不及。
研究计划书必须在周五前提交。

en: She proposed a new strategy at the meeting.
He proposed to her under the Eiffel Tower.
They propose to start the project next month.
cn: 她在会议上提出了一项新策略。
他在埃菲尔铁塔下向她求婚。
他们计划下个月启动该项目。

en: The job offers excellent career prospects.
They are prospecting for gold in the mountains.
The prospect of rain ruined our picnic plans.
cn: 这份工作提供良好的职业前景。
他们正在山区勘探金矿。
下雨的可能性破坏了我们的野餐计划。

en: The city's prosperity was built on trade and innovation.
Education is often seen as a key to economic prosperity.
After years of hard work, they finally achieved prosperity.
cn: 这座城市的繁荣建立在贸易与创新之上。
教育常被视为经济繁荣的关键。
历经多年努力，他们终于获得了成功。

en: The city became prosperous through trade and innovation.
She comes from a prosperous family with a long history.
The prosperous economy attracted many investors.
cn: 这座城市通过贸易和创新变得繁荣。
她出身于一个历史悠久的富裕家庭。
繁荣的经济吸引了众多投资者。

en: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from UV rays.
The law protects consumers from fraudulent advertising.
Endangered species are protected by international treaties.
cn: 涂抹防晒霜以保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。
该法律保障消费者免受虚假广告侵害。
濒危物种受国际条约保护。

en: Wearing sunscreen is essential for skin protection against UV rays.
The new law aims to strengthen data protection for consumers.
The turtle's hard shell provides natural protection from predators.
cn: 涂抹防晒霜是对抗紫外线保护皮肤的关键。
新法律旨在加强消费者的数据保护。
海龟的硬壳为其提供抵御天敌的天然防护。

en: She wore protective gloves while handling chemicals.
His protective attitude toward his younger sister sometimes annoyed her.
The vaccine provides protective immunity against the virus.
cn: 她处理化学品时戴着防护手套。
他对妹妹过度保护的态度有时会惹恼她。
这种疫苗能提供针对该病毒的保护性免疫。

definitions.definition: 蛋白质（生物体内的重要有机化合物，由氨基酸组成）

en: Egg whites are rich in protein.
Athletes need more protein to repair muscles.
This plant-based protein powder is easy to digest.
cn: 蛋清富含蛋白质。
运动员需要更多蛋白质修复肌肉。
这种植物蛋白粉易于消化。

en: The citizens organized a protest against the new law.
She protested her innocence in front of the jury.
The workers threatened to protest if wages were cut.
cn: 市民们组织抗议反对新法律。
她在陪审团面前申明自己的清白。
工人威胁若降薪将发起抗议。

definitions.definition: 自豪的；骄傲的（含褒义或贬义）
辉煌的；壮丽的（古义或文学用法）

en: She was proud of her daughter's academic achievements.
The peacock spread its proud feathers in the sunlight.
His proud attitude made it hard for others to approach him.
cn: 她为女儿的学术成就感到自豪。
孔雀在阳光下展开它华丽的羽毛。
他傲慢的态度让人难以接近。

en: The experiment failed to prove the theory.
Her advice proved invaluable during the crisis.
He must prove his innocence in court.
cn: 该实验未能证明该理论。
她的建议在危机中显现出无可估量的价值。
他必须在法庭上证明自己的清白。

en: The company will provide training for new employees.
The contract provides that payments must be made monthly.
She worked hard to provide for her family.
cn: 该公司将为新员工提供培训。
合同规定款项必须按月支付。
她努力工作以供养家庭。

definitions.definition: provide 的过去式/过去分词：提供

en: You can borrow the car, provided you return it by 5 PM.
The materials were provided free of charge.
Provided no one objects, we’ll postpone the meeting.
cn: 只要你在下午5点前归还，就可以借这辆车。
这些材料是免费提供的。
倘若无人反对，我们将推迟会议。

en: Quebec is a French-speaking province of Canada.
Theoretical physics is outside my province of expertise.
The emperor appointed governors to rule distant provinces.
cn: 魁北克是加拿大一个讲法语的省份。
理论物理学超出了我的专业领域。
皇帝任命总督管理偏远行省。

definitions.definition: 条款；规定（法律或合同中的）

en: The government ensured the provision of clean water to the disaster-stricken area.
Article 5 of the contract contains a provision about termination.
The ship was provisioned for a six-month voyage.
cn: 政府确保向灾区供应清洁用水。
合同第5条包含一项关于终止的条款。
这艘船配备了六个月的航行物资。

en: The study examines the psychological effects of social media on teenagers.
She provided psychological support to disaster survivors.
His fear of heights has a psychological rather than physical cause.
cn: 这项研究探讨了社交媒体对青少年的心理影响。
她为灾难幸存者提供了心理支持。
他的恐高症源于心理而非生理原因。

en: The park is open to the public.
She avoided public scrutiny by keeping a low profile.
Public opinion strongly supports the new policy.
cn: 公园对公众开放。
她保持低调以避开公众审视。
民意强烈支持这项新政策。

en: The journal publishes a monthly publication on climate research.
Her research gained fame after its publication in a top-tier journal.
The publication of the new law caused widespread debate.
cn: 这本期刊每月出版一期关于气候研究的出版物。
她的研究在顶级期刊发表后获得了广泛关注。
新法律的公布引发了广泛争论。

en: The university will publish the research findings next month.
The government published a new policy on environmental protection.
She dreams of publishing her first novel before turning 30.
cn: 该校将于下月发表这项研究成果。
政府公开了一项新的环保政策。
她梦想在30岁前出版自己的第一部小说。

definitions.definition: 布丁（一种甜点，通常由牛奶、糖、蛋等制成，质地柔软）

en: She made a chocolate pudding for dessert.
In the UK, "pudding" can sometimes mean any dessert.
He’s always thinking about his next pudding.
cn: 她做了一份巧克力布丁当甜点。
在英国，“pudding”有时可泛指任何甜点。
他总在惦记下一顿饭。（俚语用法）

definitions.definition: 一阵（气体、烟雾等）；蓬松物；吹嘘

en: A puff of wind scattered the petals.
She took a puff of her cigarette and sighed.
The pastry puffed up in the oven.
cn: 一阵风吹散了花瓣。
她吸了一口烟，叹了口气。
油酥面团在烤箱里膨胀起来。

en: She pulled the door open with all her strength.
The dentist had to pull out my damaged tooth.
His latest movie is pulling huge audiences.
cn: 她用尽全力拉开门。
牙医不得不拔掉我损坏的牙齿。
他的新电影吸引了大量观众。

en: The doctor checked her pulse and confirmed it was steady.
Electronic pulses control the machine’s operations.
Music pulsed through the crowded dance floor.
cn: 医生检查了她的脉搏，确认其平稳。
电子脉冲控制机器的运转。
音乐在拥挤的舞池中律动。

definitions.definition: 用泵抽送；打气；灌输（信息）
剧烈上下晃动；快速运动

en: The farmer used a hand pump to draw water from the well.
She pumped air into the flat tire with a portable pump.
The teacher kept pumping facts into the students before the exam.
cn: 农民用手动泵从井里抽水。
她用便携打气筒给瘪掉的轮胎充气。
考试前，老师不断向学生灌输知识点。

definitions.definition: 拳击；冲压机；潘趣酒（一种饮料）

en: He gave the bully a hard punch in the face.
The machine punches holes in metal sheets.
We served tropical fruit punch at the party.
cn: 他朝那个霸凌者脸上狠狠打了一拳。
这台机器在金属板上冲压出孔洞。
我们在派对上提供了热带水果潘趣酒。

en: She is always punctual for meetings, never keeping anyone waiting.
The punctual arrival of the train surprised the passengers accustomed to delays.
His punctual submission of the report impressed his supervisor.
cn: 她开会总是很准时，从不让任何人等待。
火车准点到达，让习惯延误的乘客感到惊讶。
他准时提交报告，给上司留下了深刻印象。

definitions.definition: （非正式）严厉对待（如过度使用或批评）

en: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
My knees are punishing me for running without stretching.
Harsh laws punish minor offenses disproportionately.
cn: 老师将惩罚考试作弊的学生。
我的膝盖因跑步未拉伸而“惩罚”我（疼痛）。
严苛的法律对轻微罪行惩罚过重。

en: The punishment should fit the crime.
Excessive punishment may lead to resentment.
Some argue that capital punishment is unethical.
cn: 惩罚应与罪行相称。
过度惩罚可能引发怨恨。
有人认为死刑是不道德的。

en: The teacher praised her pupil for solving the math problem.
His pupils dilated in the dark room.
She was once a pupil of the famous pianist.
cn: 老师表扬她的学生解出了那道数学题。
在暗室里，他的瞳孔放大了。
她曾是那位著名钢琴家的学生。

definitions.definition: 木偶；傀儡（受他人控制的人或组织）

en: The children laughed as the puppet danced on the strings.
He was merely a puppet of the political elite.
The puppet show taught moral lessons through humor.
cn: 孩子们看着木偶随线舞动，哈哈大笑。
他不过是政治精英的傀儡。
这场木偶戏通过幽默传递道德教育。

en: She purchased a vintage dress at the flea market.
The company made a large purchase of new equipment.
He kept a firm purchase on the rope during the climb.
cn: 她在跳蚤市场买了一条复古连衣裙。
公司大批购置了新设备。
他在攀爬时紧紧抓住绳子。

definitions.definition: 纯粹的；完全的（抽象概念）

en: The water in this mountain spring is remarkably pure.
She has a pure heart and always helps others.
The scientist needed pure alcohol for the experiment.
cn: 这座山泉的水极为纯净。
她心地纯洁，总是乐于助人。
科学家需要纯酒精进行实验。

en: The decoration is purely functional, with no artistic intent.
She agreed purely out of kindness.
This theory is purely speculative at this stage.
cn: 装饰纯粹是功能性的，毫无艺术意图。
她完全是出于善意才同意的。
该理论现阶段仅为推测。

en: The water filter can purify contaminated water.
Ancient rituals were believed to purify the soul.
Plants help purify the air by absorbing toxins.
cn: 这款滤水器能净化受污染的水。
古人相信仪式能涤净灵魂。
植物通过吸收毒素净化空气。

en: The purity of the mountain air is refreshing.
She was admired for the purity of her character.
The lab tests confirmed the 99.9% purity of the gold.
cn: 山间空气的纯净令人神清气爽。
她因品性纯洁而受人尊敬。
实验室检测证实黄金纯度为99.9%。

en: She wore a dress in deep purple.
The emperor's robe was dyed with Tyrian purple.
His prose is full of purple patches.
cn: 她穿了一条深紫色的裙子。
皇帝的长袍用提尔紫染料染成。
他的散文充斥着华丽辞藻。

en: Her purpose in studying abroad was to broaden her horizons.
He spoke with a sense of purpose during the meeting.
The machine was purposed for recycling waste materials.
cn: 她留学的目的是开阔视野。
他在会议中发言时带着坚定的决心。
这台机器最初被设计用于回收废料。（古用法）

definitions.definition: 钱包（尤指女性用的小型钱袋）

en: She rummaged through her purse for loose change.
The project was funded by the public purse.
The child pursed her lips in disapproval.
cn: 她在钱包里翻找零钱。
该项目由公共财政资助。
小孩撅起嘴表示不满。

en: She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
The police pursued the suspect through the alley.
He continues to pursue his passion for photography.
cn: 她决定从事医学事业。
警察在小巷中追捕嫌疑人。
他继续追求对摄影的热爱。

en: His pursuit of knowledge led him to study abroad.
The police are in pursuit of the escaped prisoner.
Fishing is her favorite outdoor pursuit.
cn: 他对知识的追求促使他出国留学。
警方正在追捕逃犯。
钓鱼是她最喜爱的户外活动。

en: She pushed the door open with her shoulder.
The company is pushing for more sustainable practices.
His relentless push for perfection inspired the team.
cn: 她用肩膀推开了门。
该公司正努力推行更可持续的做法。
他对完美的执着追求激励了整个团队。

en: She put the book on the table.
He couldn't put his feelings into words.
The decision puts us in a difficult position.
cn: 她把书放在桌上。
他无法用语言表达自己的感受。
这一决定使我们陷入困境。

en: The crossword puzzle took her hours to solve.
His strange behavior puzzled the detectives.
She stared at the jigsaw puzzle, unsure where to begin.
cn: 这张填字游戏花了她数小时才完成。
他的怪异行为让侦探们感到困惑。
她盯着拼图，不知从何下手。

en: She worked hard to qualify for the Olympic team.
This certificate qualifies you to teach English abroad.
His experience qualifies him as an expert in the field.
cn: 她努力训练以获得奥运代表队的参赛资格。
这份证书使你有资格在国外教授英语。
他的经验使他成为该领域的专家。

en: The quality of this product exceeds industry standards.
Patience is a quality that many leaders possess.
They specialize in quality handmade furniture.
cn: 这款产品的质量超越了行业标准。
耐心是许多领导者具备的特质。
他们专营优质手工家具。

en: The recipe requires a small quantity of sugar.
In physics, mass and energy are related quantities.
We prioritize quality over quantity in production.
cn: 这份食谱需要少量糖。
在物理学中，质量和能量是相关的量。
在生产中，我们优先考虑质量而非数量。

en: The couple had a quarrel about household chores.
It's pointless to quarrel over minor differences.
Their political quarrel escalated into a public scandal.
cn: 这对夫妻因家务琐事发生了争吵。
为细微分歧争吵毫无意义。
他们的政治争执升级成了公开丑闻。

definitions.definition: 夸脱（液体或干量单位，约等于0.946升或1.101升）

en: She poured a quart of milk into the mixing bowl.
The engine requires two quarts of oil for a full change.
A quart of strawberries is enough for the recipe.
cn: 她将一夸脱牛奶倒入搅拌碗中。
这台发动机需要两夸脱机油进行彻底更换。
一夸脱草莓足够做这道甜点。

definitions.definition: 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区（城市中的分区）
将…四等分；供…住宿（尤指士兵）

en: Cut the apple into quarters for the kids.
The company reports its earnings every quarter.
The historic quarter of the city is full of cobblestone streets.
cn: 把苹果切成四瓣给孩子们。
该公司每季度汇报收益。
这座城市的历史街区铺满了鹅卵石街道。

en: The magazine is published quarterly.
She receives quarterly reports from the finance team.
The company pays dividends quarterly.
cn: 这本杂志每季度出版一期。
她定期收到财务团队的季度报告。
该公司按季度支付股息。

en: Elizabeth II was the queen of the United Kingdom for 70 years.
The queen bee is the most important member of the hive.
He drew the queen of hearts from the deck.
cn: 伊丽莎白二世担任英国女王长达70年。
蜂王是蜂巢中最重要的成员。
他从牌堆中抽出了红桃皇后。

en: The old house had a queer atmosphere, as if time stood still.
Don’t queer the deal by mentioning the budget too early.
cn: 这座老房子有一种怪异的气氛，仿佛时间静止了。
别过早提预算，搞砸了这笔交易。

en: She raised an important question during the meeting.
The lawyer questioned the witness for hours.
His loyalty to the company was never in question.
cn: 她在会议上提出了一个重要问题。
律师盘问了证人数小时。
他对公司的忠诚从未被质疑过。

en: The queue for the concert stretched around the block.
She tied her hair into a long queue.
Tasks are executed in the order they enter the queue.
cn: 音乐会的排队队伍绕过了整个街区。
她把头发扎成了一条长辫子。
任务按进入队列的顺序执行。

en: She gave a quick reply to the question.
Be quick, or we'll miss the train!
His quick thinking saved the child from danger.
cn: 她迅速回答了问题。
快点，否则我们要错过火车了！
他的敏捷思维让孩子脱离了危险。

en: The new software will quicken the data processing speed.
Her pulse began to quicken as the race started.
Spring rains quicken the growth of plants.
cn: 新软件将加快数据处理速度。
比赛开始时，她的脉搏开始加快。
春雨加速了植物的生长。

en: She finished her homework quickly and went out to play.
The rabbit ran quickly into the bushes.
He quickly adapted to the new environment.
cn: 她迅速做完作业出去玩了。
兔子飞快地跑进了灌木丛。
他很快适应了新环境。

en: The library was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
She has a quiet confidence that inspires others.
The teacher quieted the noisy class with a single glance.
cn: 图书馆安静得连针掉在地上都能听见。
她有一种沉静的自信，能激励他人。
老师一个眼神就让吵闹的班级安静下来。

definitions.definition: 缝制（被子）；用填充物缝合

en: She stitched a floral pattern on the quilt.
In winter, we snuggle under a thick quilt.
The community quilt project celebrates local history.
cn: 她在被子上绣了花卉图案。
冬天时，我们蜷缩在厚被子下。
这场社区拼布计划颂扬了本地历史。

en: She decided to quit her job and travel the world.
It's hard to quit smoking without support.
After paying the debt, he finally felt quit of all obligations.
cn: 她决定辞职去环游世界。
没有支持很难戒烟。
还清债务后，他终于感到解脱了所有责任。

definitions.definition: 相当，颇（表示适度或强调）

en: The project is quite finished.
She was quite surprised by the news.
It's quite cold today, but not unbearable.
cn: 这个项目已经完全完成了。
她对这消息感到相当惊讶。
今天挺冷的，但还能忍受。

en: The teacher gave us a pop quiz on vocabulary.
She quizzed me about my travel plans.
He won the TV quiz show by answering all questions correctly.
cn: 老师给我们做了一个词汇突击测验。
她详细询问了我的旅行计划。
他因答对所有问题而赢得电视问答比赛。

en: The article included a quotation from Shakespeare.
Please provide a written quotation for the repair work.
Her speech was full of witty quotations.
cn: 这篇文章引用了莎士比亚的一句话。
请为维修工作提供书面报价。
她的演讲充满了机智的引语。

en: She quoted a famous line from Shakespeare in her speech.
Can you give me a quote for repairing the roof?
The article quotes several experts on climate change.
cn: 她在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的一句名言。
你能给我报个修理屋顶的价格吗？
这篇文章引用了多位气候专家的观点。

definitions.definition: 兔子（小型哺乳动物，长耳短尾）

en: The rabbit darted into its burrow when it saw the fox.
She keeps two rabbits as pets in her backyard.
Stop rabbiting on about your weekend—we have work to do!
cn: 兔子看到狐狸时迅速钻进了地洞。
她在后院养了两只兔子当宠物。
别没完没了讲周末的事了——我们还有工作要做！

en: She won the 100-meter race with ease.
The documentary explores the history of human races.
His heart began to race as the deadline approached.
cn: 她轻松赢得了百米赛跑。
这部纪录片探讨了人类种族的历史。
随着截止日期临近，他的心跳开始加速。

en: The study examines racial disparities in healthcare access.
Racial equality remains a global challenge.
Her artwork explores racial identity in multicultural societies.
cn: 这项研究探讨了医疗资源获取中的种族差异。
种族平等仍是全球性挑战。
她的艺术作品探讨多元文化社会中的种族身份认同。

en: She placed the books on the wooden rack.
The disease racked his body with pain.
Don't rack your brain over trivial details.
cn: 她把书放在木架上。
疾病使他全身剧痛。
别为琐事过度耗费脑力。

definitions.definition: 球拍（网球、羽毛球等运动器材）

en: She swung the tennis racket with perfect form.
The children made a terrible racket while playing upstairs.
He was arrested for running a drug racket.
cn: 她以标准的姿势挥动网球拍。
孩子们在楼上玩耍时吵闹不堪。
他因经营毒品非法交易被捕。

definitions.definition: 雷达（无线电探测与定位系统）
雷达般的探测能力（比喻用法）

en: The ship's radar detected an iceberg two miles ahead.
Bats use biological radar to navigate in darkness.
She has a radar for spotting talented designers.
cn: 船只雷达探测到前方两英里处的冰山。
蝙蝠通过生物雷达在黑暗中导航。
她拥有发现设计人才的敏锐嗅觉。

en: The sun radiates heat and light to the planets.
Her smile radiated confidence and warmth.
The city's design makes streets radiate from a central square.
cn: 太阳向行星辐射热和光。
她的笑容散发着自信与温暖。
城市设计使街道从中央广场向外辐射延伸。

definitions.definition: 辐射（能量或粒子的发射与传播）

en: The sun emits ultraviolet radiation.
Excessive radiation exposure can harm living cells.
Scientists measure background radiation levels in the environment.
cn: 太阳发出紫外线辐射。
过量的辐射暴露会损害活细胞。
科学家测量环境中的本底辐射水平。

en: She listens to the news on the radio every morning.
The ship radioed for help when the storm hit.
Radio waves are invisible but essential for modern communication.
cn: 她每天早晨用收音机听新闻。
暴风雨来袭时，船只用无线电求救。
无线电波不可见，但对现代通信至关重要。

definitions.definition: 放射性的；由放射性物质引起的

en: Uranium is a highly radioactive element.
The lab stored radioactive waste in shielded containers.
Marie Curie's research pioneered the study of radioactive materials.
cn: 铀是一种强放射性元素。
实验室将放射性废料存放在屏蔽容器中。
居里夫人的研究开创了放射性物质研究的先河。

definitions.definition: 放射性（物质自发释放辐射的性质或现象）

en: The discovery of radioactivity revolutionized our understanding of atomic structure.
Strict safety measures are required when handling materials with high radioactivity.
Radon gas is a natural source of radioactivity in some geological areas.
cn: 放射性现象的发现彻底改变了人类对原子结构的认知。
处理高放射性物质时需要严格的安全措施。
氡气是某些地质区域中天然的放射性来源。

definitions.definition: 萝卜（尤指小萝卜，可生食）

en: She added sliced radishes to the salad for extra crunch.
Radishes are often eaten raw as a spicy snack.
The farmer harvested a basket of fresh radishes from the garden.
cn: 她在沙拉中加入萝卜片以增添爽脆口感。
小萝卜常作为辛辣零食生食。
农夫从菜园里采了一篮新鲜萝卜。

definitions.definition: 镭（一种具有强放射性的金属化学元素）

en: Marie Curie and Pierre Curie discovered the element radium in 1898.
Radium was once used in luminous paints for watch dials.
The radioactivity of radium poses significant health risks if not handled properly.
cn: 玛丽·居里和皮埃尔·居里于1898年发现了元素镭。
镭曾被用于手表表盘的发光涂料中。
如果不妥善处理，镭的放射性会带来重大的健康风险。

definitions.definition: 半径（几何学中从圆心到圆周的直线距离）
桡骨（解剖学中前臂的两根骨头之一）

en: The radius of the circle is 5 centimeters.
He fractured his radius while skating.
The explosion affected everything within a 10-mile radius.
cn: 这个圆的半径是5厘米。
他滑冰时摔断了桡骨。
爆炸波及方圆10英里内的所有事物。

en: She cleaned the spill with an old rag.
That newspaper is just a cheap rag.
The kids ragged him about his funny haircut.
cn: 她用一块旧抹布清理了洒出的液体。
那份报纸不过是份低劣的小报。
孩子们拿他的滑稽发型开玩笑。

definitions.definition: 发怒；（风暴、火灾等）猛烈持续

en: He was trembling with rage after the insult.
The wildfire raged for days across the mountains.
Her sudden rage surprised everyone in the room.
cn: 他因受辱而愤怒得发抖。
山火肆虐数日，席卷整片山脉。
她突然爆发的怒火让房间里所有人都吃了一惊。

en: The police conducted a dawn raid on the suspect's house.
Viking raids were feared throughout medieval Europe.
The hackers launched a raid on the company's database.
cn: 警方在黎明时分突击搜查了嫌疑人的住所。
维京人的劫掠令整个中世纪欧洲闻风丧胆。
黑客对公司数据库发起突袭攻击。

en: She leaned against the wooden rail of the balcony.
The train sped along the rails through the countryside.
He railed at his team for their poor performance.
cn: 她倚靠在阳台的木栏杆上。
火车沿着铁轨飞速穿过乡村。
他严厉斥责了团队的糟糕表现。

definitions.definition: 迫使（某人）仓促做某事；用铁路运输

en: The transcontinental railroad transformed American commerce.
They tried to railroad the bill through Congress without debate.
Coal was railroaded to the industrial centers.
cn: 横贯大陆的铁路改变了美国的商业格局。
他们试图强行让法案未经辩论就在国会通过。
煤炭通过铁路运往工业中心。

en: The new railway connects three major cities.
She works as an engineer on the underground railway.
The old railway was converted into a cycling path.
cn: 这条新铁路连接了三座主要城市。
她在地铁系统担任工程师。
这条旧铁路被改造成了自行车道。

en: The rain continued all night, flooding the streets.
It rarely rains in the desert during summer.
She stood under the awning to avoid the heavy rain.
cn: 雨水整夜未停，淹没了街道。
沙漠夏季极少下雨。
她站在雨篷下躲避大雨。

definitions.definition: 彩虹（雨后天空中出现的弧形彩色光带）
五彩缤纷的排列或组合

en: The children gasped at the vibrant rainbow arching over the field.
Her dress was a rainbow of silk patches stitched together.
After the storm, a faint rainbow appeared behind the retreating clouds.
cn: 孩子们惊叹地望着田野上空绚丽的彩虹。
她的裙子由五彩丝绸拼缝而成，宛如彩虹。
暴风雨后，渐散的云层后浮现出一道淡淡的彩虹。

en: The forecast predicts a rainy weekend.
She loves the smell of the earth on a rainy morning.
Rainy seasons are crucial for agriculture in this region.
cn: 天气预报显示周末多雨。
她喜欢雨后清晨的泥土气息。
雨季对该地区的农业至关重要。

en: She raised her hand to ask a question.
The company raised salaries by 5% this year.
He was raised in a multicultural environment.
cn: 她举手提问。
公司今年加薪5%。
他在多元文化环境中长大。

en: He used a rake to gather the fallen leaves.
The police raked the area for clues.
The old mansion had a noticeable rake to its roof.
cn: 他用耙子收集落叶。
警方彻底搜查了该区域以寻找线索。
那座老宅的屋顶有明显倾斜。

en: The Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.
Her interests range from painting to astrophysics.
The store ranges its products by price for easy comparison.
cn: 喜马拉雅山脉是世界上最高的山脉。
她的兴趣广泛，从绘画到天体物理学。
商店按价格排列商品以便比较。

en: He holds a high rank in the military.
The garden was rank with weeds after the rain.
The judge ranked the contestants by skill.
cn: 他在军队中拥有高级军衔。
雨后花园里杂草丛生。
裁判按技能为参赛者划分等级。

en: The rapid growth of technology has changed our lives.
We navigated the rapids with expert guidance.
Her rapid response saved the project from failure.
cn: 技术的快速发展改变了我们的生活。
在专业指导下，我们穿过了急流。
她的迅速反应挽救了项目。

en: The river flows rapidly after the heavy rain.
She typed rapidly to finish the report before the deadline.
Technology is advancing rapidly in the 21st century.
cn: 大雨过后，河水湍急奔流。
她飞快地打字，以便在截止日期前完成报告。
21世纪科技发展迅猛。

en: This species of orchid is very rare in the wild.
He prefers his steak rare, with a cool red center.
Rare earth elements are crucial for modern technology.
cn: 这种兰花在野外极为罕见。
他喜欢半熟的牛排，中心略带凉红色。
稀土元素对现代科技至关重要。

en: She rarely eats fast food because she prefers home-cooked meals.
Such historical artifacts are rarely found in such good condition.
He rarely speaks during meetings, but his ideas are always insightful.
cn: 她很少吃快餐，因为她更喜欢家常菜。
这类历史文物很少能以如此完好的状态被发现。
他在会议上很少发言，但他的想法总是很有见地。

en: The lab uses rats for scientific experiments.
He felt like a rat after betraying his friend.
She refused to rat on her colleagues.
cn: 实验室用老鼠进行科学实验。
背叛朋友后，他觉得自己像个卑鄙小人。
她拒绝告发同事。

en: The unemployment rate has dropped to 5%.
She rated the movie as one of the best this year.
The car was traveling at a high rate of speed.
cn: 失业率已降至5%。
她将这部电影评为今年最佳之一。
汽车正以高速行驶。

en: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
The movie was rather boring after the first half.
She’s not lazy; rather, she’s just very efficient.
cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿冒雨出门。
这部电影在后半部分相当无聊。
她不是懒惰，更确切地说，她只是效率很高。

en: The ratio of students to teachers is 20:1 in this school.
Mix the paint in a ratio of two parts red to one part blue.
The investment has a high risk-to-reward ratio.
cn: 这所学校的学生与教师比例为20:1。
按两份红漆对一份蓝漆的比例混合。
这项投资的风险回报率很高。

en: She made a rational decision after carefully analyzing the data.
His argument sounded rational but lacked emotional appeal.
cn: 她在仔细分析数据后做出了理性决定。
他的论点听起来合理，但缺乏情感共鸣。

definitions.definition: 原始的；未经处理的（材料、数据）

en: The sushi contains raw fish and seasoned rice.
The report was based on raw data from the experiment.
Her knees were raw after falling on the pavement.
cn: 这份寿司包含生鱼和调味米饭。
该报告基于实验中的原始数据。
她的膝盖在路面摔倒后擦破了皮。

en: A ray of sunlight filtered through the curtains.
The X-ray revealed a fracture in his wrist.
Stingrays use their venomous rays for defense.
cn: 一束阳光透过窗帘照射进来。
X光显示他的手腕有骨折。
黄貂鱼用带毒的鳍刺自卫。

en: He carefully shaved with a straight razor.
The razor blade needs replacement.
She razored off the damaged hair ends.
cn: 他用直剃刀小心刮脸。
剃须刀片需要更换了。
她用剃刀修掉了分叉的发梢。

definitions.definition: 延伸；达到（某范围或程度）

en: She reached for the book on the top shelf.
The news reached every corner of the world.
His influence extends beyond the reach of politics.
cn: 她伸手去够书架顶层的书。
消息传遍了世界每个角落。
他的影响力超出了政治范畴。

en: How did she react to the news?
Iron reacts with oxygen to form rust.
The audience reacted warmly to the performance.
cn: 她对这个消息有何反应？
铁与氧气反应生成铁锈。
观众对演出报以热烈的回应。

definitions.definition: 反应（对刺激或事件的回应）

en: Her reaction to the news was surprisingly calm.
The chemical reaction produced a bright blue light.
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
cn: 她对这消息的反应出奇地平静。
该化学反应产生了明亮的蓝光。
每个作用力都有大小相等、方向相反的反作用力。

en: She loves to read novels in her free time.
The teacher asked the students to read aloud.
His letter was hard to read due to messy handwriting.
cn: 她闲暇时喜欢读小说。
老师让学生们大声朗读。
他的字迹潦草，信件难以辨认。

en: She is an avid reader of historical novels.
The library installed new e-readers for public use.
This textbook includes a glossary for the reader’s convenience.
cn: 她是一位历史小说的狂热读者。
图书馆安装了新的电子阅读器供公众使用。
这本教科书为方便读者附上了术语表。

en: She readily agreed to help with the project.
The information is readily available online.
The chemical dissolves readily in water.
cn: 她欣然同意协助这个项目。
这些信息可轻松在网上获取。
这种化学物质易溶于水。

definitions.definition: 解读；解释（如数据、文本的解析）
朗诵；宣读（如公开场合的朗读）

en: She enjoys reading science fiction in her free time.
The meter gave a faulty reading due to low battery.
His reading of the poem moved the audience to tears.
cn: 她闲暇时喜欢读科幻小说。
由于电量不足，仪表显示的数据有误。
他对这首诗的朗诵让听众感动落泪。

en: Breakfast is ready on the table.
She's always ready to lend a hand.
Keep your passport ready for inspection.
cn: 早餐已准备好放在桌上。
她总是乐于伸出援手。
准备好护照以备检查。

definitions.definition: （经济学）实际的，扣除通胀因素的

en: The documentary shows the real lives of farmers.
Is this bag made of real leather?
Real wages have decreased due to inflation.
cn: 这部纪录片展现了农民的真实生活。
这个包是真皮的吗？
扣除通胀因素后，实际工资下降了。

en: Virtual reality technology blurs the line between imagination and reality.
The harsh reality is that resources are limited.
Philosophers have debated the nature of reality for centuries.
cn: 虚拟现实技术模糊了想象与现实的界限。
残酷的现实是资源有限。
几个世纪以来，哲学家们一直在争论实在的本质。

en: She didn't realize her mistake until it was too late.
He worked hard to realize his dream of becoming a doctor.
The project aims to realize sustainable energy solutions.
cn: 她直到为时已晚才意识到自己的错误。
他努力学习以实现成为医生的梦想。
该项目旨在实现可持续的能源解决方案。

definitions.definition: 真正地，确实地（强调真实性）

en: She was really surprised by the gift.
Do you really believe his story?
The coffee is really hot; be careful.
cn: 她对这个礼物感到非常惊喜。
你真的相信他的说法吗？
咖啡非常烫，小心点。

en: The king's realm extended across three continents.
Quantum physics is a realm few fully understand.
Her imagination created realms of fantasy.
cn: 国王的疆域横跨三大洲。
量子物理学是少数人能完全理解的领域。
她的想象力构筑了奇幻的国度。

en: Farmers reap wheat in autumn.
She reaped the benefits of years of hard work.
You will reap what you sow.
cn: 农民在秋季收割小麦。
她收获了多年辛勤工作的成果。
种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

en: The garden is at the rear of the house.
She reared three children on her own.
The horse reared up in fright.
cn: 花园在房子的后部。
她独自抚养了三个孩子。
马受惊后扬起了前蹄。

en: There is no reason to panic.
She reasoned that the plan would fail.
Human beings possess the faculty of reason.
cn: 没有理由恐慌。
她推断该计划会失败。
人类拥有理性能力。

en: It's reasonable to assume he'll arrive by noon.
The restaurant offers reasonable prices for high-quality food.
She made a reasonable argument during the debate.
cn: 假设他中午前到是合理的。
这家餐厅以公道的价格提供高质量食物。
她在辩论中提出了一个合理的论点。

en: The rebel group fought against the government for years.
Teenagers often rebel against their parents' rules.
She was labeled a rebel for challenging traditional norms.
cn: 反叛组织与政府对抗多年。
青少年常抵触父母的管束。
她因挑战传统规范被称为叛逆者。

definitions.definition: 叛乱，反抗（针对权威或统治的公开抵抗）
叛逆行为（对常规或约束的抵制）

en: The peasant rebellion was brutally suppressed by the king’s army.
Her punk hairstyle was a quiet act of rebellion against school rules.
The colony’s rebellion led to its independence after decades of struggle.
cn: 农民起义被国王的军队残酷镇压。
她的朋克发型是对校规的无声反抗。
殖民地的叛乱经过数十年斗争后赢得了独立。

en: She couldn't recall where she left her keys.
The company issued a recall of defective products.
The mayor recalled his earlier statement after public criticism.
cn: 她记不起钥匙放在哪里了。
公司发布了缺陷产品的召回令。
市长在公众批评后撤回了先前的声明。

en: The store emailed me a digital receipt after the purchase.
Please sign this form to acknowledge receipt of the package.
The waiter forgot to receipt our payment, so we requested a copy.
cn: 商店在购买后给我发送了电子收据。
请签署这份表格以确认收到包裹。
服务员忘记给我们收据，因此我们索要了一份副本。

definitions.definition: 遭受，经历（如伤害、待遇等）

en: She received a letter from her friend.
The team received harsh criticism after the match.
The hotel receives guests from all over the world.
cn: 她收到了朋友的一封信。
队伍在比赛后遭到了严厉的批评。
这家酒店接待来自世界各地的客人。

definitions.definition: 接收者；接收器（如电话听筒、无线电设备）

en: The receiver of the award thanked her team for their support.
He picked up the telephone receiver and dialed the number.
The court appointed a receiver to manage the bankrupt company’s assets.
cn: 奖项的获得者感谢了她的团队的支持。
他拿起电话听筒，拨打了号码。
法院指定了一名破产管理人来处理该公司的资产。

en: The study analyzed recent trends in climate change.
Her most recent novel won a literary award.
Recent updates improved the app's performance.
cn: 这项研究分析了气候变化的最新趋势。
她最新出版的小说获得了文学奖项。
最近的更新提升了该应用的性能。

en: She recently moved to a new apartment.
The book was published quite recently.
Have you seen any good movies recently?
cn: 她最近搬到了新公寓。
这本书是最近才出版的。
你最近看过什么好电影吗？

en: The hotel reception is open 24 hours a day.
Her speech got a warm reception from the audience.
My phone has poor reception in the basement.
cn: 酒店前台24小时开放。
她的演讲受到观众热烈欢迎。
我的手机在地下室信号很差。

en: She can recite all the poems from memory.
The lawyer recited the facts of the case.
Students were asked to recite the alphabet backwards.
cn: 她能背诵所有诗歌。
律师详细陈述了案件事实。
学生被要求倒背字母表。

definitions.definition: 承认；认可（如成就或地位）
识别；辨认（如面孔或声音）

en: Her work finally gained international recognition.
Facial recognition technology is widely used in security systems.
He nodded in recognition when he saw his old friend.
cn: 她的工作最终获得了国际认可。
人脸识别技术被广泛应用于安防系统。
他看到老朋友时点头示意认出了对方。

en: I barely recognized her after ten years.
The government refused to recognize the new regime.
He was recognized for his contributions to science.
cn: 十年后我几乎认不出她了。
政府拒绝承认新政权。
他因科学贡献受到表彰。

en: She paused to recollect her thoughts before answering.
I can't recollect where we first met.
cn: 她停下来整理思绪后才回答。
我想不起我们初次见面的地方了。

en: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
The teacher recommended this book for further reading.
His honesty recommends him as a reliable partner.
cn: 你能推荐附近一家不错的餐厅吗？
老师推荐这本书作为延伸阅读。
他的诚实使他成为值得信赖的合作伙伴。

en: She wrote me a glowing recommendation for the job.
The committee accepted his recommendation to reduce costs.
Personal recommendations often carry more weight than online reviews.
cn: 她为我写了一封热情洋溢的工作推荐信。
委员会采纳了他关于降低成本的建议。
个人推荐通常比在线评价更有分量。

en: She keeps a detailed record of her expenses.
The band will record their new album next month.
This vinyl record is a collector’s item.
cn: 她详细记录了自己的开支。
乐队下个月将录制新专辑。
这张黑胶唱片是收藏家的珍品。

definitions.definition: 记录员（法律或官方职位）

en: She used a recorder to capture the bird's song.
The judge asked the court recorder to read the testimony.
He plays the recorder in the school orchestra.
cn: 她用录音机录下了鸟鸣声。
法官要求法庭记录员宣读证词。
他在学校乐团演奏竖笛。

definitions.definition: 恢复（健康、意识等）；重新获得

en: She needed time to recover from the surgery.
The team recovered the stolen artifacts.
The economy is slowly recovering.
cn: 她需要时间从手术中恢复。
团队找回了被盗的文物。
经济正在缓慢复苏。

en: She made a full recovery after the surgery.
The police announced the recovery of the stolen artwork.
Economic recovery depends on consumer confidence.
cn: 她在手术后完全康复了。
警方宣布追回了被盗的艺术品。
经济复苏取决于消费者信心。

en: She wore a stunning red dress to the party.
The sunset painted the sky in shades of red and orange.
His face turned red with embarrassment.
cn: 她穿了一件惊艳的红色礼服参加派对。
夕阳将天空染成红橙交织的色调。
他因尴尬而涨红了脸。

definitions.definition: 使降级，使沦为（某种状态）

en: The company plans to reduce carbon emissions by 30% by 2030.
Overuse of antibiotics can reduce their effectiveness.
The chemist used hydrogen to reduce the metal oxide to pure metal.
cn: 该公司计划到2030年将碳排放减少30%。
过度使用抗生素会降低其有效性。
化学家用氢气将金属氧化物还原为纯金属。

en: The company announced a 20% reduction in staff.
Iron ore undergoes reduction in a blast furnace.
The teacher explained the reduction of fractions to their simplest form.
cn: 公司宣布裁员20%。
铁矿石在高炉中发生还原反应。
老师讲解了分数约简至最简形式的方法。

definitions.definition: 簧片（乐器中的振动部件）

en: The wind rustled through the reeds by the river.
Clarinet reeds need to be replaced regularly for optimal sound.
Ancient Egyptians used reeds to make paper.
cn: 微风拂过河边的芦苇，沙沙作响。
单簧管的簧片需定期更换以保持最佳音色。
古埃及人用芦苇制作纸张。

en: She wound the thread onto the reel carefully.
The boxer reeled from the heavy blow.
The room seemed to reel after he stood up too quickly.
cn: 她小心地把线绕到卷轴上。
拳击手因重击而踉跄后退。
他起身太快后，房间仿佛在旋转。

definitions.definition: 提到，涉及；将…提交（给权威机构）

en: The professor referred to a recent study during the lecture.
Please refer to the manual if you encounter any issues.
The case was referred to the Supreme Court.
cn: 教授在讲座中引用了一项近期研究。
如有问题，请查阅手册。
该案件被提交至最高法院审理。

en: She included a reference to the latest research in her paper.
The librarian helped me find reference materials.
He made a vague reference to his past achievements.
cn: 她在论文中引用了最新研究。
图书管理员帮我找到了参考资料。
他含糊地提到了过去的成就。

en: The factory uses advanced technology to refine crude oil into gasoline.
She continues to refine her presentation skills through practice.
Over time, his taste in art refined significantly.
cn: 工厂用先进技术将原油精炼成汽油。
她通过练习不断完善自己的演讲技巧。
随着时间的推移，他的艺术品味变得极为高雅。

definitions.definition: 反射（光、热、声音等）；反映，体现

en: The lake reflects the surrounding mountains.
Her actions reflect her values.
He took a moment to reflect on his decisions.
cn: 湖面倒映着周围的群山。
她的行为体现了她的价值观。
他花时间反思了自己的决定。

en: The reflection of the mountains in the lake was breathtaking.
She stared at her reflection in the mirror, lost in thought.
His essay is a reflection on the meaning of justice.
cn: 湖中群山的倒影令人叹为观止。
她凝视镜中的自己，陷入沉思。
他的文章是对正义含义的深刻反思。

en: The government plans to reform the education system.
He reformed his lifestyle after the health warning.
Social reforms often face resistance from conservative groups.
cn: 政府计划改革教育体系。
健康警告后，他彻底改变了生活方式。
社会改革常遭遇保守群体的阻力。

definitions.definition: 使恢复精力；刷新（页面/数据）

en: She drank lemonade to refresh herself after the long walk.
Press F5 to refresh the webpage for updated results.
The rain refreshed the dry soil overnight.
cn: 长途步行后，她喝了柠檬水恢复精神。
按 F5 刷新网页以获取更新结果。
雨水一夜之间让干涸的土壤恢复了生机。

definitions.definition: 茶点；点心（尤指休息时的小食或饮料）

en: The hotel offers free refreshments in the lobby every afternoon.
A short walk in nature is the perfect refreshment for a tired mind.
Volunteers served refreshments to the marathon runners at the checkpoint.
cn: 酒店每天下午在大堂提供免费茶点。
在自然中短暂散步是疲惫心灵的完美恢复。
志愿者在检查站为马拉松选手提供点心。

en: The milk will spoil if you leave it outside the refrigerator.
Modern refrigerators are more energy-efficient than older models.
She organized the refrigerator by food category.
cn: 牛奶不放冰箱会变质。
现代冰箱比旧款更节能。
她按食物类别整理冰箱。

en: The mountain village became a refuge for war survivors.
Books were her refuge from loneliness.
Wildlife refuges protect endangered species.
cn: 这座山村成了战争幸存者的避难所。
书籍是她逃离孤独的慰藉。
野生动物保护区保护濒危物种。

en: His refusal to cooperate surprised everyone.
She has the first refusal on the apartment if the sale falls through.
The refusal of the proposal led to further negotiations.
cn: 他拒绝合作让所有人感到意外。
如果交易失败，她拥有这套公寓的优先购买权。
提案被拒后，双方展开了进一步谈判。

en: She refused to accept the apology.
The city collects refuse every Monday.
They refused him entry to the club.
cn: 她拒绝接受道歉。
该市每周一收垃圾。
他们拒绝让他进入俱乐部。

en: The scientist refuted the theory with solid experimental data.
He refuted the accusation by presenting an alibi.
Her essay effectively refutes common misconceptions about climate change.
cn: 科学家用扎实的实验数据驳斥了这一理论。
他通过提供不在场证明否认了指控。
她的文章有力反驳了关于气候变化的常见误解。

en: She has high regard for her teacher’s opinion.
The law regards environmental protection as a priority.
In this regard, we need more data to proceed.
cn: 她非常重视老师的意见。
这项法律将环境保护视为优先事项。
在这方面，我们需要更多数据才能继续。

en: She wrote a letter regarding the upcoming meeting.
