No changes were made regarding the original plan.
Questions regarding payment should be directed to the finance department.
cn: 她写了一封关于即将召开的会议的信。
关于原计划，未作任何改动。
付款相关问题请咨询财务部门。

en: He rushed forward, regardless of the danger.
She decided to pursue her dream, regardless of others' opinions.
The policy applies to everyone, regardless of age or gender.
cn: 他不顾危险冲向前去。
她决定不顾他人意见，追求自己的梦想。
该政策适用于所有人，无论年龄或性别。

definitions.definition: 地区，区域（指地理或行政划分）

en: The Amazon rainforest is a vital region for biodiversity.
She felt pain in the abdominal region after the surgery.
His research focuses on the region of artificial intelligence ethics.
cn: 亚马逊雨林是生物多样性的关键区域。
手术后她的腹部区域感到疼痛。
他的研究专注于人工智能伦理领域。

en: Please register your details at the front desk.
The thermometer registered a sudden drop in temperature.
Her name was struck off the electoral register.
cn: 请在前台登记您的信息。
温度计显示温度骤降。
她的名字被从选民名册中删除。

en: She expressed deep regret for her actions.
I regret not studying harder for the exam.
His only regret was missing the chance to say goodbye.
cn: 她对她的行为深感懊悔。
我后悔没有更努力备考。
他唯一的遗憾是错过了道别的机会。

en: She maintains a regular exercise routine.
The cafe offers discounts to its regulars.
The soldiers were part of the regular army.
cn: 她保持着规律的运动习惯。
这家咖啡馆为常客提供折扣。
这些士兵属于正规军。

en: She exercises regularly to stay healthy.
The bus arrives regularly every 15 minutes.
He regularly volunteers at the local shelter.
cn: 她定期锻炼以保持健康。
公交车每15分钟一班，非常准时。
他经常在本地收容所做志愿者。

definitions.definition: 调节，控制（通过规则或系统）
校准，调整（机械或生物过程）

en: The thermostat regulates the room temperature automatically.
Strict laws regulate the use of pesticides in agriculture.
Hormones help regulate metabolism in the human body.
cn: 恒温器自动调节室内温度。
严格的法律规范农业中农药的使用。
激素帮助调节人体的新陈代谢。

definitions.definition: 规则，规章（官方制定的管理条款）
调节，控制（保持系统稳定的过程）

en: The new regulation prohibits smoking in public areas.
Automatic temperature regulation ensures energy efficiency.
Financial regulations aim to prevent market manipulation.
cn: 新规禁止在公共场所吸烟。
自动温度调节能确保能源效率。
金融法规旨在防止市场操纵。

definitions.definition: 排练，彩排（戏剧、音乐等表演前的练习）
复述，重复（事件或陈述的详细叙述）

en: The cast had a final rehearsal before the opening night.
Her rehearsal of the accident details helped the police.
Life is not a rehearsal—every moment counts.
cn: 剧组在首演前进行了最后一次彩排。
她对事故细节的复述帮助了警方调查。
人生不是彩排，每一刻都至关重要。

en: The king's reign lasted for over 50 years.
Chaos reigned in the city after the earthquake.
Her reign as CEO transformed the company.
cn: 这位国王的统治持续了50多年。
地震后，城市陷入混乱。
她担任CEO期间彻底改变了公司。

en: She pulled gently on the reins to slow the horse.
The government tightened the reins on public spending.
He gave free rein to his imagination while writing the novel.
cn: 她轻轻拉动缰绳让马减速。
政府加强了对公共开支的控制。
他在写小说时放任自己的想象力自由驰骋。

definitions.definition: 加强；增强（结构、力量或效果）

en: The walls were reinforced with steel beams.
The general decided to reinforce the troops at the frontline.
Positive feedback can reinforce good behavior in children.
cn: 墙壁用钢梁加固。
将军决定增援前线的部队。
正面反馈能强化孩子的良好行为。

en: The committee rejected his proposal due to insufficient evidence.
Her body rejected the transplanted kidney.
These shoes are factory rejects with minor flaws.
cn: 委员会因证据不足驳回他的提案。
她的身体排斥了移植的肾脏。
这些鞋是带有微小瑕疵的工厂淘汰品。

en: The whole city rejoiced when the war ended.
She rejoiced at her son's success.
"Rejoice!" shouted the priest to the crowd.
cn: 战争结束时，整座城市欢欣鼓舞。
她为儿子的成功感到欣喜。
“欢呼吧！”牧师向人群喊道。

en: She related the events of her journey in vivid detail.
The study relates sleep quality to overall health.
His ideas don’t relate to our current project.
cn: 她生动详细地讲述了旅途中的经历。
这项研究将睡眠质量与整体健康联系起来。
他的想法与我们当前的项目无关。

en: The relation between diet and health is well-documented.
She introduced me to a distant relation at the family reunion.
His answer had no relation to the question asked.
cn: 饮食与健康的关系有充分记录。
她在家庭聚会上向我介绍了一位远亲。
他的回答与所提问题毫无关联。

definitions.definition: 关系；关联（人与人、事物之间的联系）
亲属关系（血缘或婚姻联系）

en: Their relationship grew stronger over the years.
The study explores the relationship between diet and health.
She has a close relationship with her grandparents.
cn: 他们的关系随着岁月流逝愈发牢固。
这项研究探讨了饮食与健康的关系。
她与祖父母关系亲密。

en: She is a close relative of mine.
The speed is relative to the observer's position.
Happiness is a relative concept.
cn: 她是我的近亲。
速度与观察者的位置相对。
幸福是一个相对的概念。

definitions.definition: 相当地（用于修饰形容词或副词，表示程度）

en: The cost of living is relatively low in this area.
She performed relatively well in the competition.
Relatively speaking, this solution is more sustainable.
cn: 该地区的生活成本相对较低。
她在比赛中表现得相当不错。
相对而言，这一方案更具可持续性。

definitions.definition: 相对性（物理学术语，指现象或测量结果依赖于观察者参照系的性质）
相关性（广义上指事物之间的相互依存关系）

en: Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized our understanding of space and time.
The relativity of cultural values makes cross-cultural communication challenging.
In physics, relativity implies that measurements depend on the observer's frame of reference.
cn: 爱因斯坦的相对论彻底改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。
文化价值的相对性使得跨文化交流充满挑战。
在物理学中，相对性意味着测量结果依赖于观察者的参照系。

en: She leaned back to relax her tense muscles.
The rules were relaxed to attract more participants.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
cn: 她向后靠，放松紧绷的肌肉。
规定被放宽以吸引更多参与者。
听音乐帮助我下班后放松。

en: The government decided to release the political prisoners.
The band's new album will be released next month.
She sighed with release after finishing the final exam.
cn: 政府决定释放政治犯。
乐队的新专辑将于下月发行。
期末考试结束后，她如释重负地叹了口气。

en: The judge ruled the evidence was not relevant to the case.
Her research focuses on issues relevant to climate change.
Keep your comments relevant to the topic of discussion.
cn: 法官裁定该证据与案件无关。
她的研究聚焦于与气候变化相关的议题。
请让你的评论紧扣讨论主题。

en: The reliability of this software has been proven through extensive testing.
Her reliability as a team leader earned her the trust of her colleagues.
Engineers prioritize reliability when designing critical infrastructure.
cn: 该软件的可靠性已通过大量测试验证。
她作为团队领导的可靠性赢得了同事的信任。
工程师在设计关键基础设施时优先考虑可靠性。

en: She is a reliable colleague who always meets deadlines.
This old car is surprisingly reliable despite its age.
For accurate data, choose a reliable source.
cn: 她是一位可靠的同事，总能按时完成任务。
这辆旧车虽然年头久，但出人意料地可靠。
要获取准确数据，请选择可信的来源。

en: His reliance on technology made him helpless during the blackout.
The project's success was a heavy reliance on teamwork.
Blind reliance on authority can hinder critical thinking.
cn: 他对科技的依赖使他在停电时束手无策。
该项目的成功极大依赖于团队合作。
对权威的盲目信赖会阻碍批判性思维。

definitions.definition: （痛苦、压力等的）缓解；救济；浮雕

en: The medicine brought immediate relief from pain.
The government provided relief to flood victims.
The sculptor carved the figures in high relief.
cn: 药物迅速缓解了疼痛。
政府向洪水灾民提供了救济。
雕刻家用高浮雕技法塑造了人像。

definitions.definition: 接替（某人职责）；解除（职务）

en: The medicine helped relieve her headache.
The guard will be relieved at midnight.
His apology relieved my anger.
cn: 药物缓解了她的头痛。
卫兵将在午夜换岗。
他的道歉平息了我的怒火。

definitions.definition: 宗教（一种对超自然力量或神灵的信仰与崇拜体系）
宗教信仰（个人或群体的精神实践与价值观）

en: She studies comparative religion to understand different cultural beliefs.
Freedom of religion is a fundamental human right.
Ancient Egyptians practiced a polytheistic religion.
cn: 她研究比较宗教学以理解不同的文化信仰。
宗教信仰自由是一项基本人权。
古埃及人信奉多神教。

definitions.definition: 严谨的，一丝不苟的（引申义）

en: She has a deeply religious faith.
He follows the schedule with religious precision.
The festival is important to many religious communities.
cn: 她有着虔诚的宗教信仰。
他以一丝不苟的精确性遵循日程。
这个节日对许多宗教群体至关重要。

en: She gave a reluctant nod when asked to help.
The cat was reluctant to leave its warm spot by the fireplace.
He was reluctant to admit his mistake in front of the team.
cn: 当她被要求帮忙时，勉强点了点头。
那只猫不情愿离开壁炉旁温暖的角落。
他勉强在团队面前承认了自己的错误。

en: You can rely on her to keep your secrets.
The project relies heavily on government funding.
Don't rely solely on luck to succeed.
cn: 你可以信赖她保守你的秘密。
该项目极大依赖政府资金。
别仅靠运气成功。

definitions.definition: 剩余；停留；保持（某种状态）
(常用复数 remains) 残余；遗迹

en: Only a few apples remain on the tree.
She chose to remain silent during the meeting.
The remains of the ancient temple attract many tourists.
cn: 树上只剩几个苹果了。
会议期间她选择保持沉默。
古庙的遗迹吸引了许多游客。

en: The remains of the ancient temple attract archaeologists worldwide.
Only charred remains of the documents were found after the fire.
Her remains were buried in the family cemetery.
cn: 这座古庙的遗迹吸引了全球考古学家。
火灾后仅找到文件的焦黑残片。
她的遗骸安葬在家族墓地。

en: She made a witty remark about the weather.
Did you remark the subtle change in his tone?
He remarked that the project was ahead of schedule.
cn: 她对天气作了一句机智的评论。
你注意到他语气中的微妙变化了吗？
他评论说项目进度超前了。

en: Her remarkable achievements inspired the whole team.
The building is remarkable for its unique architecture.
He showed remarkable courage during the crisis.
cn: 她的非凡成就激励了整个团队。
这座建筑因其独特的结构而引人注目。
他在危机中表现出惊人的勇气。

en: Honey is a natural remedy for sore throats.
The new policy aims to remedy social inequality.
Time alone will not remedy the situation.
cn: 蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的自然疗法。
新政策旨在纠正社会不平等。
仅靠时间无法扭转局面。

en: I can't remember where I put my keys.
We gather today to remember those who sacrificed their lives.
She suddenly remembered her promise.
cn: 我想不起钥匙放哪儿了。
今天我们聚集在此，纪念那些献出生命的人。
她突然想起了自己的承诺。

en: Can you remind me to call my mom tomorrow?
The smell of fresh bread reminded him of his childhood.
She set an alarm to remind herself of the meeting.
cn: 你能提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话吗？
新鲜面包的气味让他想起了童年。
她设了闹钟提醒自己开会。

en: The village is so remote that it has no internet access.
There's a remote chance of rain tomorrow.
She pressed a button on the remote to turn off the TV.
cn: 这个村庄非常偏远，甚至没有网络。
明天下雨的可能性很小。
她按下遥控器的按钮关闭了电视。

en: The removal of old furniture made the room look spacious.
His removal from the team shocked everyone.
The company offers free removal services for new customers.
cn: 移除旧家具后，房间显得宽敞。
他被团队免职的消息震惊了所有人。
该公司为新客户提供免费搬迁服务。

en: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
The stain was difficult to remove from the fabric.
There's a noticeable remove between his words and actions.
cn: 进屋前请脱鞋。
这个污渍很难从布料上清除。
他的言行之间有明显的差距。

definitions.definition: 使成为；提供（服务等）；递交

en: The artist rendered the landscape in vivid colors.
The jury rendered a verdict of not guilty.
The software renders 3D models in real time.
cn: 艺术家用鲜艳的色彩描绘了这片风景。
陪审团作出了无罪判决。
该软件能实时渲染3D模型。

en: She decided to renew her passport before the trip.
The company renewed its commitment to environmental sustainability.
After a short break, he renewed his efforts to finish the project.
cn: 她在旅行前决定更新护照。
该公司重申了对环境可持续性的承诺。
短暂休息后，他重新投入精力完成项目。

en: She pays a high rent for her apartment in the city.
The earthquake rent the ground apart.
He rented a car for the weekend trip.
cn: 她在市区租公寓的租金很高。
地震将地面撕裂。
他为周末旅行租了一辆车。

en: It took him three hours to repair the broken bicycle.
The bridge is under repair after the storm.
Trust is hard to repair once broken.
cn: 他花了三个小时修理那辆坏掉的自行车。
暴风雨后，这座桥正在维修中。
信任一旦破裂，很难修复。

en: Please repeat the sentence after me.
The TV show is a repeat from last year.
History often repeats itself.
cn: 请跟我重复这个句子。
这个电视节目是去年的重播。
历史常常重演。

en: He knocked on the door repeatedly but got no response.
The experiment was repeatedly conducted to ensure accuracy.
She checked her phone repeatedly, anxious for the news.
cn: 他反复敲门，但无人应答。
为确保准确性，该实验被多次重复进行。
她反复查看手机，焦急等待消息。

definitions.definition: 对（行为或决定）感到懊悔

en: He repented of his harsh words and apologized.
It’s never too late to repent and change your ways.
She repented ignoring her friend’s advice.
cn: 他后悔自己言辞苛刻并道了歉。
悔过自新永远为时不晚。
她懊悔没有听从朋友的建议。

en: Repetition is key to mastering a new skill.
The poem uses repetition to create rhythm.
Avoid unnecessary repetition in your writing.
cn: 重复是掌握新技能的关键。
这首诗通过重复营造韵律。
写作中避免不必要的重复。

en: Please replace the book on the shelf after reading.
The company plans to replace all old computers with new models.
Some argue that robots will eventually replace human workers in many fields.
cn: 阅读后请将书放回书架。
公司计划用新电脑替换所有旧机型。
有人认为机器人终将在许多领域取代人类工人。

en: She didn't reply to my email for three days.
His reply was brief but thoughtful.
The system automatically replies with a confirmation code.
cn: 她三天没回复我的邮件。
他的回答简短但深思熟虑。
系统自动回复了确认码。

en: She submitted a detailed report on the project.
The journalist reported the event live.
Students must report to the office by 9 AM.
cn: 她提交了一份关于该项目的详细报告。
记者对事件进行了现场报道。
学生必须在上午9点前到办公室报到。

en: The reporter interviewed the mayor about the new policy.
She works as a court reporter, transcribing legal proceedings.
The investigative reporter uncovered corruption in the government.
cn: 记者就新政策采访了市长。
她是一名法庭笔录员，负责记录法律诉讼。
调查记者揭露了政府内部的腐败。

en: The dove represents peace in many cultures.
She was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
The graph represents the data clearly.
cn: 鸽子在许多文化中象征和平。
她被选为代表公司出席会议。
图表清晰地呈现了数据。

en: She was elected as the representative of her district.
This painting is representative of the artist's early style.
The survey included a representative sample of all age groups.
cn: 她被选为所在地区的代表。
这幅画代表了艺术家早期的风格。
调查涵盖了所有年龄段的代表性样本。

en: She reproached him for forgetting their anniversary.
His failure was a reproach to the family.
The teacher’s gentle reproach made the student reflect.
cn: 她责备他忘记了他们的纪念日。
他的失败是家族的耻辱。
老师温和的批评让学生开始反思。

en: Some animals can reproduce asexually.
The machine reproduces documents in seconds.
Artists often reproduce famous paintings for study.
cn: 某些动物能无性繁殖。
这台机器几秒钟就能复制文件。
艺术家常临摹名画以供学习。

definitions.definition: 共和国（一种国家形式，权力由公民或选举代表掌握）

en: France became a republic after the revolution.
The ancient Roman republic lasted for centuries.
In a republic, power is held by elected representatives.
cn: 法国大革命后成为共和国。
古罗马共和政体延续了数百年。
共和制中，权力由选举产生的代表掌握。

definitions.definition: 共和国的；共和政体的；支持共和制的
共和主义者；（美国）共和党党员

en: The republican system emphasizes elected representatives rather than a monarch.
She has been a staunch Republican for decades.
Roman republican ideals influenced many modern democracies.
cn: 共和制强调选举代表而非君主统治。
几十年来，她一直是共和党的坚定支持者。
罗马共和理念影响了众多现代民主国家。

en: His reputation as a fair judge is well deserved.
The company’s reputation suffered after the scandal.
She has a reputation for being strict but kind.
cn: 他作为公正法官的名声实至名归。
丑闻发生后，公司的声誉受损。
她以严格但善良著称。

en: She submitted a request for additional funding.
The audience requested an encore from the performer.
All requests must be made in writing.
cn: 她提交了一份追加资金的请求。
观众要求表演者返场。
所有请求必须以书面形式提出。

en: The job requires excellent communication skills.
The law requires all citizens to pay taxes.
This recipe requires three eggs and a cup of flour.
cn: 这份工作需要出色的沟通能力。
法律规定所有公民必须纳税。
这份食谱需要三个鸡蛋和一杯面粉。

en: The job has strict educational requirements.
Meeting the legal requirements is essential for the project.
Patience is a key requirement for teaching young children.
cn: 这份工作有严格的学历要求。
满足法律要求对该项目至关重要。
耐心是教育幼儿的关键条件。

en: The firefighters rescued three children from the burning building.
A rescue team was sent to the earthquake zone immediately.
The new policy aims to rescue small businesses from bankruptcy.
cn: 消防员从燃烧的大楼中救出了三名儿童。
一支救援队被立即派往地震灾区。
新政策旨在挽救小型企业免于破产。

en: She conducted extensive research on climate change.
The team is researching new treatments for the disease.
Historical research often requires analyzing primary sources.
cn: 她对气候变化进行了广泛研究。
该团队正在研究这种疾病的新疗法。
历史研究常需分析原始资料。

en: The researcher published a groundbreaking paper on climate change.
As a medical researcher, she spends long hours in the lab.
The team of researchers discovered a new species in the Amazon.
cn: 这位研究者发表了一篇关于气候变化的开创性论文。
作为医学研究者，她长期泡在实验室里。
研究团队在亚马逊雨林中发现了一个新物种。

en: The twins resemble each other so much that even their parents sometimes confuse them.
The artificial flavor doesn’t resemble the taste of real strawberries at all.
Her paintings resemble Van Gogh’s style in their bold use of color.
cn: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，连父母有时都会认错。
这种人工香精完全不像真正的草莓味道。
她的画作色彩运用大胆，与梵高的风格相似。

en: The hotel requires guests to reserve rooms in advance.
She spoke with reserve, carefully choosing her words.
The country's oil reserves are running low.
cn: 酒店要求客人提前预订房间。
她说话克制，措辞谨慎。
该国的石油储备正在减少。

en: The city gets its water from a large reservoir in the mountains.
She has a vast reservoir of patience when teaching children.
The library is a reservoir of human knowledge.
cn: 这座城市的水源来自山间的一座大型水库。
她在教导孩子时拥有极大的耐心储备。
图书馆是人类知识的宝库。

en: She took up residence in a small village after retirement.
The president's official residence is the White House.
Proof of residence is required to open a bank account.
cn: 她退休后定居在一个小村庄。
总统的正式官邸是白宫。
开设银行账户需提供居住证明。

en: The city has over a million residents.
She is the resident expert on climate change.
The hospital’s residents work long shifts.
cn: 这座城市有一百多万居民。
她是常驻的气候变化专家。
这家医院的住院医生轮班时间很长。

definitions.definition: 使顺从；听任（常与 to 连用）

en: She decided to resign from her position after ten years of service.
He resigned himself to the fact that he couldn’t change the outcome.
The CEO resigned amid the company’s financial scandal.
cn: 她决定在任职十年后辞去职务。
他无奈接受了无法改变结果的事实。
首席执行官在公司财务丑闻中辞职。

definitions.definition: 顺从，听任（尤指对命运的安排）

en: She handed in her resignation after ten years with the company.
He accepted his fate with quiet resignation.
The manager’s resignation shocked the entire team.
cn: 她在公司工作十年后提交了辞呈。
他默默顺从地接受了命运。
经理的辞职震惊了整个团队。

en: The material resists heat and corrosion.
She couldn't resist laughing at the joke.
Protesters resisted the new policy peacefully.
cn: 这种材料耐热抗腐蚀。
她忍不住被这个笑话逗笑了。
抗议者以和平方式抵制新政策。

definitions.definition: 抵抗，反抗（对压迫或变化的抵制）
阻力（物理或机械中的阻碍力）

en: The protesters showed strong resistance to the new law.
Air resistance affects the speed of falling objects.
Copper has lower electrical resistance than iron.
cn: 抗议者对新法律表现出强烈抵抗。
空气阻力影响下落物体的速度。
铜的电阻比铁低。

definitions.definition: 抵抗者；防染剂（化学术语）

en: This fabric is resistant to water and stains.
Some bacteria have become resistant to antibiotics.
She remained resistant to his persuasive arguments.
cn: 这种面料防水防污。
某些细菌对抗生素产生了耐药性。
她始终抵制他的说服性论点。

en: She made a resolution to exercise daily.
The council passed a resolution to reduce plastic waste.
This monitor has a high resolution for sharper images.
cn: 她下定决心每天锻炼。
委员会通过了一项减少塑料废物的决议。
这台显示器分辨率高，图像更清晰。

en: The committee met to resolve the dispute.
Light can be resolved into a spectrum of colors.
She faced the challenge with unwavering resolve.
cn: 委员会召开会议以解决争端。
光可被分解为一系列颜色光谱。
她以坚定的决心应对挑战。

en: The island is a popular resort for honeymooners.
He resorted to stealing when he ran out of money.
Violence should never be the first resort in a conflict.
cn: 这座岛是蜜月旅行者的热门度假胜地。
他没钱时选择了偷窃。
暴力绝不应该是冲突中的首选手段。

definitions.definition: 资源（如自然资源、人力资源）

en: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
She showed great resource in handling the crisis.
The library is a valuable resource for researchers.
cn: 太阳能是一种可再生资源。
她在应对危机时展现了非凡的才智。
图书馆是研究者的宝贵资源库。

en: She earned the respect of her colleagues through hard work.
We must respect the rules of the competition.
The report covers every respect of the issue.
cn: 她通过努力赢得了同事的尊敬。
我们必须遵守比赛规则。
这份报告涵盖了问题的每个方面。

en: She gave a respectful nod to the elderly professor.
The audience remained respectful during the solemn ceremony.
His respectful tone made the conversation more pleasant.
cn: 她向年长的教授恭敬地点头致意。
观众在庄严的仪式中始终保持敬意。
他恭敬的语气让谈话更愉快。

en: The team members returned to their respective offices after the meeting.
The scholarships were awarded based on the students' respective achievements.
The two groups discussed their respective plans for the project.
cn: 会议结束后，团队成员回到了各自的办公室。
奖学金根据学生各自的成就颁发。
两组分别讨论了各自的项目计划。

definitions.definition: 分别地；各自地（用于描述列表中事物按顺序对应）

en: The winners were Alice, Bob, and Carol, who received gold, silver, and bronze medals respectively.
The temperatures in January, February, and March were 5°C, 8°C, and 12°C respectively.
The books cost $10, $15, and $20 respectively.
cn: 获胜者是爱丽丝、鲍勃和卡罗尔，他们分别获得了金牌、银牌和铜牌。
1月、2月和3月的温度分别为5°C、8°C和12°C。
这些书的价格分别为10美元、15美元和20美元。

en: She didn't respond to my email.
The patient is responding well to the treatment.
Firefighters responded immediately to the emergency call.
cn: 她没有回复我的邮件。
患者对治疗反应良好。
消防员立即响应了紧急呼叫。

en: She nodded in response to his question.
The vaccine triggers an immune response.
The machine’s response time is under 0.1 seconds.
cn: 她点头回应了他的问题。
疫苗会引发免疫反应。
该机器的响应时间低于0.1秒。

definitions.definition: 责任（需承担的义务或职责）
责任感（可靠或尽责的品质）

en: Taking care of a pet teaches children responsibility.
The manager accepted full responsibility for the project's failure.
With great power comes great responsibility.
cn: 照顾宠物能教会孩子们责任感。
经理承担了项目失败的全部责任。
能力越大，责任越大。

definitions.definition: 需承担责任的；有责任感的
（职位或角色）重要的，责任重大的

en: She is responsible for managing the team.
A responsible citizen follows traffic rules.
This is a highly responsible position in the company.
cn: 她负责管理团队。
有责任感的公民会遵守交通规则。
这是公司里一个责任重大的职位。

en: She needed to rest after the long journey.
The book rests on the table.
Only the tip of the iceberg is visible; the rest is underwater.
cn: 长途旅行后，她需要休息。
书放在桌子上。
冰山的顶端可见，其余部分在水下。

en: This restaurant is famous for its authentic Italian pasta.
We booked a table at the waterfront restaurant for dinner.
The restaurant offers a vegan menu upon request.
cn: 这家餐厅以地道的意大利面闻名。
我们在海滨餐厅预订了晚餐座位。
该餐厅可根据要求提供纯素食菜单。

definitions.definition: 焦躁不安的；无法休息的
持续活动的；永不停息的

en: The restless child kept tossing and turning in bed.
She felt restless after hearing the unsettling news.
The restless waves crashed against the shore all night.
cn: 那个焦躁不安的孩子在床上翻来覆去。
听到令人不安的消息后，她感到心神不宁。
汹涌的海浪整夜拍打着海岸。

en: The government plans to restore the historic monument.
A good night's sleep can restore your energy.
The software can restore deleted files.
cn: 政府计划修复这座历史纪念碑。
充足的睡眠能恢复体力。
该软件可恢复被删除的文件。

en: She had to restrain her laughter during the serious meeting.
The police used handcuffs to restrain the suspect.
His strict upbringing restrained him from taking risks.
cn: 在严肃的会议中，她不得不忍住笑声。
警察用手铐制服了嫌疑人。
严格的成长环境使他不敢冒险。

en: She exercised great restraint in not responding to the insult.
The new safety restraints in cars have reduced injuries.
His artistic restraint gives the painting a minimalist elegance.
cn: 她表现出极大克制，没有回应侮辱。
汽车的新型安全约束装置降低了伤害率。
他的艺术克制赋予画作极简的优雅。

en: The law restricts smoking in public places.
Her visa restricts her to working only 20 hours per week.
The tight deadline restricted our creativity.
cn: 法律限制在公共场所吸烟。
她的签证限定她每周只能工作20小时。
紧迫的截止日期限制了我们的创造力。

en: The government imposed travel restrictions during the pandemic.
There are no restrictions on how much you can invest.
The new law places restrictions on alcohol sales.
cn: 疫情期间政府实施了旅行限制。
对你的投资金额没有任何限制。
新法律对酒精销售设置了限制性规定。

en: The experiment produced unexpected results.
His carelessness resulted in a major error.
We are still waiting for the election results.
cn: 实验得出了意想不到的结果。
他的粗心导致了一个重大错误。
我们仍在等待选举结果。

definitions.definition: 简历（美式用法，源自法语 résumé）

en: She decided to resume her studies after a year off.
Please submit your resume by email.
The meeting will resume at 2 PM.
cn: 她决定休息一年后继续学业。
请通过邮件提交你的简历。
会议将于下午两点继续。

en: The jar can retain freshness for up to six months.
She struggled to retain the information before the exam.
The company aims to retain its best employees.
cn: 这个罐子能保持新鲜度长达六个月。
她考前拼命记住这些信息。
公司致力于留住最优秀的员工。

en: The teacher asked the students to retell the story in their own words.
He can retell every detail of that event with astonishing accuracy.
Many cultures have their own versions that retell ancient myths.
cn: 老师要求学生用自己的话复述这个故事。
他能以惊人的准确度重述那起事件的每一个细节。
许多文化都有自己复述古代神话的版本。

en: He plans to retire at 60 and travel the world.
The general ordered the troops to retire from the battlefield.
After retiring, she volunteered at a local school.
cn: 他计划60岁退休后环游世界。
将军命令军队从战场撤退。
退休后，她在当地学校做志愿者。

en: The army was forced to retreat after heavy losses.
She goes on a silent retreat every summer.
The tide began to retreat, leaving shells on the sand.
cn: 军队在遭受重创后被迫撤退。
她每年夏季都会参加一次静默禅修。
潮水开始退去，在沙滩上留下贝壳。

en: She will return to London next week.
The store allows returns within 30 days.
The investment yielded a high return.
cn: 她将于下周返回伦敦。
该商店允许30天内退货。
这项投资带来了高回报。

en: The documentary reveals the truth behind the event.
Her smile revealed a hint of nervousness.
The report accidentally revealed confidential data.
cn: 这部纪录片揭示了事件背后的真相。
她的笑容透出一丝紧张。
报告意外泄露了机密数据。

en: He swore to take revenge on his enemies.
The movie explores the theme of revenge and redemption.
She revenged her brother's death by exposing the truth.
cn: 他发誓要向敌人复仇。
这部电影探讨了复仇与救赎的主题。
她通过揭露真相为弟弟的死报仇。

en: She reversed the car into the parking space.
The experiment produced the reverse effect of what we expected.
The court reversed its earlier decision due to new evidence.
cn: 她将车倒进停车位。
实验产生了与我们预期相反的效果。
因新证据出现，法院撤销了先前的判决。

en: The teacher asked us to review Chapter 5 before the test.
The film received mixed reviews from critics.
He reviewed the contract carefully before signing.
cn: 老师要求我们在考试前复习第五章。
这部电影获得了评论家褒贬不一的评价。
他在签字前仔细复查了合同。

en: The author decided to revise the manuscript before publication.
She spent the weekend revising for her final exams.
The treaty was revised to reflect new political realities.
cn: 作者决定在出版前修订手稿。
她整个周末都在为期末考试复习。
条约经过修改以反映新的政治现实。

en: The peasants' revolt against the king was brutally suppressed.
Such cruelty would revolt any sane person.
Her stomach revolted at the sight of the rotting food.
cn: 农民对国王的反叛被残酷镇压。
这种残忍行为会让任何理智的人感到厌恶。
看到腐烂的食物，她的胃一阵翻腾（生理性反感）。

definitions.definition: 革命（政治或社会制度的彻底变革）
旋转，绕转（天体或物体的圆周运动）

en: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in communication.
The Earth completes one revolution around the Sun in 365 days.
The French Revolution radically changed European politics.
cn: 互联网的发明引发了通信领域的革命。
地球绕太阳公转一周需365天。
法国大革命彻底改变了欧洲政治格局。

en: The invention of the internet was a revolutionary breakthrough.
She joined a group of revolutionaries fighting for independence.
His revolutionary ideas challenged traditional education systems.
cn: 互联网的发明是一项革命性突破。
她加入了一群为独立而战的革命者。
他的革新理念挑战了传统教育体系。

en: She received a cash reward for her outstanding performance.
Kindness is its own reward.
The company rewards employees who propose innovative ideas.
cn: 她因表现优异获得一笔现金奖励。
善意本身就是回报。
公司奖励提出创新想法的员工。

en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the song.
She has a natural sense of rhythm when dancing.
The rhythm of the seasons influences agricultural practices.
cn: 鼓手在整个歌曲中保持着稳定的节奏。
她跳舞时有一种天生的节奏感。
四季的规律循环影响着农业活动。

en: He broke a rib in the car accident.
The umbrella is reinforced with metal ribs.
Stop ribbing me about my new haircut!
cn: 他在车祸中折断了一根肋骨。
这把伞用金属肋条加固。
别再拿我的新发型开玩笑啦！

definitions.definition: 缎带，丝带（用于装饰或绑扎）

en: She tied her hair with a red ribbon.
The medal hung from a blue and gold ribbon.
Replace the printer ribbon when the ink fades.
cn: 她用红色丝带扎起头发。
奖章悬挂在蓝金相间的绶带上。
墨水变淡时请更换打印机色带。

en: Rice is the staple food for half of the world's population.
She measured two cups of rice into the pot.
The fields were flooded to prepare for planting rice.
cn: 大米是全球半数人口的主食。
她往锅里量了两杯米。
田地已灌水，准备种植水稻。

en: She grew up in a rich family but chose a simple lifestyle.
The sauce is too rich for my taste.
The region is rich in biodiversity.
cn: 她出身富裕家庭，却选择了朴素的生活方式。
这酱汁对我的口味来说太腻了。
该地区生物多样性丰富。

en: She finally rid her garden of weeds.
The new law aims to rid the city of pollution.
It took months to rid the house of ants.
cn: 她终于清除了花园里的杂草。
新法律旨在消除城市污染。
花了几个月才彻底消灭屋里的蚂蚁。

definitions.definition: 用筛子过滤；使布满窟窿

en: She told a riddle that no one could solve.
The sunlight riddled the leaves with tiny holes.
His speech was a riddle of contradictions.
cn: 她出了一个没人能解的谜语。
阳光在树叶上留下细密的光斑。
他的演讲充满矛盾的谜团。

definitions.definition: 骑（马、自行车等）；乘坐（交通工具）
骑乘；乘坐；交通工具的行程

en: She loves to ride her bicycle along the river.
We rode the subway to downtown.
The amusement park offers a thrilling roller coaster ride.
cn: 她喜欢沿着河边骑自行车。
我们乘地铁去市中心。
游乐园提供刺激的过山车乘坐体验。

en: The rider gracefully jumped over the fence.
She added a rider to the contract about delivery timelines.
Bike riders must wear helmets in this city.
cn: 骑手优雅地跃过栅栏。
她在合同中添加了关于交付时间的附加条款。
该城市的自行车骑行者必须佩戴头盔。

en: The hikers reached the ridge at sunset.
The roof was designed with a steep ridge to shed snow.
The plow ridged the soil into neat rows.
cn: 徒步者在日落时分抵达山脊。
屋顶设计成陡峭的屋脊以排雪。
犁将土壤翻成整齐的垄沟。

en: The idea that pigs can fly is absolutely ridiculous.
She looked ridiculous in that oversized hat.
His excuse for being late was so ridiculous that no one believed it.
cn: 认为猪会飞的想法简直荒谬至极。
她戴着那顶过大的帽子，看起来滑稽可笑。
他迟到的借口太离谱，没人相信。

en: The soldier cleaned his rifle before the mission.
The museum displays a 19th-century hunting rifle.
cn: 士兵在任务前擦拭了他的步枪。
博物馆展出一把19世纪的猎枪。

en: You have the right to remain silent.
Turn right at the next intersection.
She tried to right the wrongs of the past.
cn: 你有权保持沉默。
在下一个路口向右转。
她试图纠正过去的错误。

en: The rigid metal bar did not bend under pressure.
She follows a rigid daily routine.
His rigid attitude made compromise impossible.
cn: 这根坚硬的金属杆在压力下没有弯曲。
她遵循严格的日常作息。
他固执的态度使得妥协无法实现。

definitions.definition: 环形物；戒指；铃声；拳击台

en: She wore a silver ring on her finger.
The church bells ring every hour.
Please ring the doorbell before entering.
cn: 她手指上戴着一枚银戒指。
教堂的钟声每小时响起一次。
进入前请先按门铃。

en: The tomatoes are finally ripe and ready to pick.
The time is ripe for a change in leadership.
Her voice carried the ripe wisdom of experience.
cn: 番茄终于成熟，可以采摘了。
领导层更迭的时机已经成熟。
她的声音透着经验淬炼出的成熟智慧。

en: The tomatoes will ripen faster if placed in sunlight.
Time had ripened his artistic skills.
These bananas were picked green and ripened during shipping.
cn: 西红柿放在阳光下会更快成熟。
时间使他的艺术技巧趋于成熟。
这些香蕉采摘时未熟，在运输过程中催熟的。

en: The sun rises in the east.
Housing prices continue to rise this year.
Her voice rose in anger.
cn: 太阳从东方升起。
今年房价持续上涨。
她的声音因愤怒而提高。

en: Investing in startups carries a high risk of failure.
She risked her life to save the drowning child.
The project's success outweighed the potential risks.
cn: 投资初创企业有很高的失败风险。
她冒着生命危险救起溺水儿童。
项目的成功盖过了潜在风险。

en: The two companies are fierce rivals in the tech industry.
Her talent rivals that of a professional musician.
The siblings have always been rivals for their parents' attention.
cn: 这两家公司在科技行业是激烈的竞争对手。
她的才华堪比专业音乐家。
这对兄妹一直为争夺父母的关注而竞争。

en: The Amazon River is the largest by discharge volume of water in the world.
We camped by a small river in the valley.
Ancient civilizations often flourished along major rivers.
cn: 亚马孙河是世界上流量最大的河流。
我们在山谷中的一条小河旁扎营。
古文明常沿大河繁荣发展。

en: The road winds through the mountains.
They're building a new road to the airport.
Hard work is the road to success.
cn: 这条道路蜿蜒穿过群山。
他们正在修建一条通往机场的新路。
努力是通往成功之路。

en: The lion let out a mighty roar.
The engine roared to life.
We could hear the roar of the waterfall from afar.
cn: 狮子发出一声巨大的咆哮。
引擎轰鸣着启动。
我们从远处就能听到瀑布的轰鸣声。

en: She roasted the chicken with herbs and garlic.
Sunday roast is a tradition in many British households.
The smell of roast coffee filled the café.
cn: 她用香草和大蒜烤鸡。
周日烤肉是许多英国家庭的传统。
咖啡馆里弥漫着烘焙咖啡的香气。

en: The masked man tried to rob the bank at gunpoint.
Poor sanitation robs children of their right to a healthy life.
He was accused of robbing an elderly couple last year.
cn: 蒙面男子持枪企图抢劫银行。
恶劣的卫生条件剥夺了儿童健康生活的权利。
他被指控去年抢劫了一对老年夫妇。

en: The robber stole jewelry from the store.
Police arrested the robber after a chase.
Witnesses described the robber as tall and masked.
cn: 强盗从商店偷走了珠宝。
警方追捕后逮捕了劫匪。
目击者称劫匪身材高大且戴面具。

definitions.definition: 抢劫（非法夺取他人财物的行为）
掠夺；盗取（广义的非法占有行为）

en: The bank robbery was captured on security cameras.
He was sentenced to ten years for armed robbery.
Colonial history often involves stories of cultural robbery.
cn: 银行抢劫案被监控摄像头拍下。
他因持械抢劫被判十年监禁。
殖民历史常伴随文化掠夺的故事。

en: The judge wore a black robe during the trial.
She robed herself in silk for the ceremony.
After the shower, he wrapped himself in a soft robe.
cn: 法官在审判时穿着黑色长袍。
她为典礼穿上丝质礼服。
沐浴后，他裹上柔软的浴袍。

definitions.definition: 机器人（可编程的自动化机械装置）

en: The factory replaced human workers with robots to increase efficiency.
He moved like a robot, without any emotion.
Modern robots can perform complex surgeries with precision.
cn: 工厂用机器人取代工人以提高效率。
他像机器人一样行动，毫无情感。
现代机器人能精准完成复杂手术。

en: The hikers climbed the steep rock.
She loves listening to classic rock.
The earthquake rocked the entire city.
cn: 徒步者攀爬了陡峭的岩石。
她喜欢听经典摇滚乐。
地震震动了整座城市。

en: The SpaceX rocket successfully launched into orbit.
Housing prices rocketed after the policy change.
She lit a small rocket during the festival.
cn: SpaceX火箭成功发射进入轨道。
政策变动后房价飞速上涨。
节日期间她点燃了一支小烟花。

definitions.definition: 鞭子（用于惩罚或钓鱼的工具）

en: He measured the depth of the river with a wooden rod.
The angler cast his rod into the lake.
Discipline was maintained with the threat of the rod.
cn: 他用木杆测量了河水的深度。
垂钓者将钓竿抛向湖中。
纪律通过鞭子的威慑得以维持。

definitions.definition: 角色（戏剧、社会中的职能）

en: She played the role of Juliet in the school play.
Teachers have an important role in shaping students' values.
The committee assigned him a leadership role.
cn: 她在学校话剧里扮演朱丽叶。
教师在塑造学生价值观方面起着重要作用。
委员会赋予了他领导职责。

en: The ball started to roll down the hill.
She carefully rolled the parchment.
The teacher called names from the roll.
cn: 球开始向山下滚动。
她小心地卷起羊皮纸。
老师照着名单点名。

en: The worker pushed the heavy barrel using a wooden roller.
She curled her hair with heated rollers before the party.
Surfers waited for the perfect roller to ride.
cn: 工人用木制滚轮推动沉重的桶。
派对前，她用加热卷发器卷了头发。
冲浪者等待完美的卷浪来骑行。

definitions.definition: 罗马的；罗马人的；罗马字体的

en: The Roman Empire once ruled vast territories.
She prefers reading books printed in roman type.
Roman architecture influenced many later styles.
cn: 罗马帝国曾统治过广袤的领土。
她更喜欢用罗马字体印刷的书籍。
罗马建筑影响了后来的许多风格。

definitions.definition: 浪漫的人；浪漫主义艺术家

en: The candlelit dinner created a romantic atmosphere.
She has a romantic view of life, always dreaming of adventures.
The poet was a true romantic who found beauty in nature.
cn: 烛光晚餐营造了浪漫的氛围。
她对生活抱有浪漫的幻想，总梦想着冒险。
这位诗人是真正的浪漫主义者，在自然中发现了美。

en: The cat climbed onto the roof of the house.
They decided to roof the patio with transparent panels.
Heavy snow collapsed the factory roof last winter.
cn: 猫爬到了房子的屋顶上。
他们决定用透明面板给露台加盖顶棚。
去年冬天，大雪压垮了工厂的屋顶。

en: She booked a room at the hotel for the weekend.
There's no room for error in this experiment.
Plants need room to grow.
cn: 她为周末在酒店预订了一个房间。
这次实验不容许任何差错。
植物需要生长空间。

en: The tree's roots spread deep into the soil.
Her fear of water roots in a childhood accident.
He rooted through the files to find the document.
cn: 树的根深深扎入土壤中。
她对水的恐惧源于童年的一次事故。
他在文件中翻找那份文档。

en: He tied the boat to the dock with a thick rope.
The climbers secured themselves with nylon ropes.
She roped the boxes together for easy transport.
cn: 他用一根粗绳将船系在码头上。
登山者用尼龙绳固定身体。
她把箱子用绳子捆好以便运输。

en: She received a bouquet of red roses on her birthday.
The sky turned a delicate rose at sunset.
He rose early to watch the sunrise.
cn: 她在生日时收到一束红玫瑰。
日落时天空泛起淡淡的粉红色。
他早早起床看日出。

en: The wood began to rot after years of rain.
Don't talk such rot!
Without proper care, teeth can rot.
cn: 木材在多年雨水侵蚀后开始腐烂。
别说这种废话！
缺乏适当护理，牙齿会蛀坏。

definitions.definition: 旋转式机器；环形交叉路（英式英语中称 roundabout）

en: The rotary blade of the fan cuts through the air smoothly.
She works for a rotary printing press company.
Take the third exit at the rotary.
cn: 风扇的旋转叶片平稳地切割空气。
她在一家轮转印刷机公司工作。
在环形交叉路口走第三个出口。

en: The Earth rotates on its axis every 24 hours.
Farmers rotate crops to maintain soil fertility.
The interns will rotate through different departments.
cn: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。
农民轮作农作物以保持土壤肥力。
实习生将在不同部门轮岗。

en: The Earth completes one rotation every 24 hours.
Crop rotation helps maintain soil fertility.
The team uses a rotation system to ensure fair playtime.
cn: 地球每24小时完成一次自转。
农作物轮作有助于保持土壤肥力。
该团队采用轮换制度以确保公平的上场时间。

en: The apple turned rotten after weeks in the damp cellar.
His behavior revealed a rotten character.
The team's performance was absolutely rotten.
cn: 苹果在潮湿的地窖里放了几周后腐烂了。
他的行为暴露了堕落的品性。
这支队伍的表现糟糕透顶。

en: The surface of the rock was rough to the touch.
He gave a rough estimate of the project cost.
The team had a rough time during the mountain expedition.
cn: 岩石表面摸起来很粗糙。
他对项目成本做了粗略估算。
团队在登山探险期间经历了艰难时期。

en: The project will cost roughly $10,000.
He handled the fragile package roughly.
The map shows roughly where the treasure is buried.
cn: 该项目将花费大约1万美元。
他粗暴地对待那个易碎的包裹。
地图大致标出了宝藏的埋藏位置。

definitions.definition: 圆形物；一轮（比赛、谈判等）

en: The moon appears round in the night sky.
She won every round of the debate.
The ship rounded the cape at dawn.
cn: 月亮在夜空中呈现圆形。
她赢得了辩论的每一轮。
船只于黎明时分绕过了海角。

en: The loud noise roused the sleeping dog.
His speech roused the crowd to action.
She finally roused from her deep thought.
cn: 巨大的声响惊醒了睡着的狗。
他的演讲激发了人群的行动。
她终于从沉思中回过神来。

definitions.definition: 按特定路线发送或安排

en: The scenic route along the coast is perfect for cycling.
The software routes incoming calls to available agents.
Their escape route was blocked by heavy snow.
cn: 沿海的风景路线非常适合骑行。
该软件将来电转接给空闲的客服。
他们的逃生路线被大雪阻断。

definitions.definition: 常规；例行公事；固定程序

en: Morning exercise is part of her daily routine.
The audit revealed no issues with routine procedures.
He longed to escape the routine of office life.
cn: 晨练是她日常惯例的一部分。
审计显示常规流程没有问题。
他渴望逃离办公室生活的单调。

en: The children sat in a straight row.
He taught me how to row a boat.
They had a huge row about money.
cn: 孩子们坐成笔直的一排。
他教我如何划船。
他们为钱大吵了一架。

en: The royal family attended the ceremony.
She received a royal welcome at the event.
This hotel is known for its royal treatment of guests.
cn: 王室成员出席了典礼。
她在活动中受到了隆重的欢迎。
这家酒店以对客人的尊贵服务闻名。

en: She rubbed her eyes tiredly after hours of reading.
Apply sunscreen by rubbing it gently on your skin.
The only rub is that we don't have enough funding.
cn: 长时间阅读后，她疲惫地揉了揉眼睛。
将防晒霜轻轻涂抹在皮肤上。
唯一的障碍是我们资金不足。

definitions.definition: 橡胶（天然或合成的高弹性材料）
橡皮擦（用于擦除铅笔痕迹的工具）

en: Tires are made of synthetic rubber.
Can I borrow your rubber? I made a mistake in my sketch.
The invention of vulcanized rubber revolutionized industries.
cn: 轮胎由合成橡胶制成。
能借你的橡皮吗？我草图画错了。
硫化橡胶的发明彻底改变了工业。

definitions.definition: 垃圾；废物；无价值的东西

en: The alley was full of rotting rubbish.
Critics rubbished the new policy as impractical.
Don't talk rubbish – we need factual evidence.
cn: 巷子里堆满了腐烂的垃圾。
评论家们抨击这项新政策不切实际。
别胡说八道，我们需要事实依据。

en: It's rude to interrupt people when they're speaking.
The settlers built rude shelters from branches.
His rude manners shocked the guests at the party.
cn: 打断别人说话是无礼的。
定居者用树枝搭了简陋的棚屋。
他粗鲁的举止让派对上的宾客震惊。

en: She placed a colorful rug beside the bed.
The cat curled up on the rug near the fireplace.
This handmade rug is woven from natural wool.
cn: 她在床边铺了一块色彩鲜艳的小地毯。
猫蜷缩在壁炉旁的毯子上。
这块手工编织的地毯采用天然羊毛制成。

en: The earthquake left the city in ruins.
Gambling ruined his financial stability.
The castle is now a picturesque ruin.
cn: 地震使城市沦为废墟。
赌博毁了他的经济稳定。
这座城堡如今是一片风景如画的废墟。

en: The school has strict rules about punctuality.
The king ruled the country for over 50 years.
The judge ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
cn: 学校对守时有严格规定。
这位国王统治国家长达50余年。
法官判决原告胜诉。

en: The ruler of the ancient empire was both feared and respected.
She drew a straight line using a plastic ruler.
A good leader is not just a ruler, but a servant of the people.
cn: 这位古代帝国的统治者令人敬畏又受人尊敬。
她用一把塑料尺子画了一条直线。
优秀的领导者不仅是统治者，更是人民的公仆。

en: The rumour about the company's bankruptcy spread quickly.
She was rumoured to be dating a famous actor.
Don't believe every rumour you hear.
cn: 关于公司破产的谣言迅速传开。
据传她正在与一位著名演员交往。
不要轻信你听到的每一个传闻。

en: She runs every morning to stay healthy.
The engine runs smoothly after maintenance.
The play had a successful run on Broadway.
cn: 她每天早晨跑步以保持健康。
保养后发动机运转顺畅。
这部戏剧在百老汇连续上演多场。

definitions.definition: （机器的）运转部件；（植物的）匍匐茎
（走私或递送秘密物品的）信使

en: She is a dedicated marathon runner.
The mechanic checked the runner of the conveyor belt.
Strawberries spread by sending out runners.
cn: 她是一名专注的马拉松跑者。
机械师检查了传送带的滑轨部分。
草莓通过匍匐茎蔓延生长。

en: She prefers the quiet life in a rural village.
Rural areas often lack high-speed internet access.
The artist drew inspiration from rural landscapes.
cn: 她更喜欢乡村的宁静生活。
农村地区通常缺乏高速互联网接入。
这位艺术家从乡村风景中汲取灵感。

en: She had to rush to catch the last train.
The sudden rush of wind knocked over the chairs.
This is a rush order and needs to be delivered today.
cn: 她不得不匆忙赶最后一班火车。
突然的一阵风吹倒了椅子。
这是加急订单，需今天送达。

en: She is studying Russian literature at university.
The Russian delegation arrived in Moscow yesterday.
Do you speak Russian?
cn: 她在大学学习俄罗斯文学。
俄罗斯代表团昨日抵达莫斯科。
你会说俄语吗？

en: The old bicycle chain was covered in rust.
cn: 那辆旧自行车的链条上布满了锈迹。

definitions.definition: 生锈的（覆盖或受锈蚀影响）

en: The old bicycle chain was too rusty to move smoothly.
My Spanish is a bit rusty after years of not practicing.
He gave a rusty laugh, as if unused to joy.
cn: 生锈的旧自行车链条卡得无法顺畅转动。
多年未练习，我的西班牙语有点生疏了。
他发出一声生涩的笑，仿佛不习惯快乐。

en: The farmer filled the sack with potatoes.
He got the sack for being late three times.
She sacked the groceries quickly.
cn: 农夫将麻袋装满了土豆。
他因迟到三次被解雇。
她迅速将食品杂货装进袋子。

definitions.definition: 神圣的（与宗教或神相关，不可侵犯的）
庄严的（因神圣性而受敬畏的）

en: The temple is a sacred place for worship.
She made a sacred promise to protect the secret.
In many cultures, cows are considered sacred animals.
cn: 这座寺庙是神圣的礼拜场所。
她庄严承诺会保守这个秘密。
在许多文化中，牛被视为神圣的动物。

en: She made many sacrifices to send her children to college.
The ancient ritual involved the sacrifice of a goat.
He sacrificed his career to care for his family.
cn: 她为送孩子上大学做出了许多牺牲。
这一古老仪式包含献祭一只山羊。
他牺牲事业来照顾家庭。

definitions.definition: 糟糕的，令人遗憾的（口语）

en: She felt sad after hearing the news.
It's a sad fact that many species are endangered.
His sad expression revealed his disappointment.
cn: 听到消息后，她感到难过。
许多物种濒临灭绝，这是令人遗憾的事实。
他悲伤的表情透露出失望。

en: The cowboy adjusted the saddle before mounting his horse.
This project will saddle the company with huge debts.
The mountain pass forms a natural saddle between two peaks.
cn: 牛仔上马前调整了马鞍。
该项目将使公司背负巨额债务。
山口在两座山峰间形成天然的鞍状地形。

en: She smiled sadly and turned away.
Sadly, the project was canceled due to lack of funding.
The dog whined sadly at the empty food bowl.
cn: 她悲伤地笑了笑，转身离开。
遗憾的是，该项目因资金不足被取消。
狗对着空碗哀伤地呜咽着。

en: Her eyes were full of sadness when she heard the news.
The sadness in his voice was unmistakable.
Time may lessen the sadness, but the memories remain.
cn: 听到消息时，她眼中充满悲伤。
他声音里的悲伤显而易见。
时间或会冲淡悲伤，但记忆永存。

en: The children were safe at home during the storm.
Always keep your passport in a hotel safe.
It's safe to assume the meeting will be postponed.
cn: 孩子们在暴风雨期间安全地待在家里。
请始终将护照存放在酒店保险箱内。
可以稳妥地假设会议将推迟。

en: The package arrived safely despite the storm.
She navigated the dark alley safely by staying alert.
The pilot landed the plane safely after engine failure.
cn: 包裹在暴风雨中仍安全送达。
她保持警惕，安全地穿过了黑暗的小巷。
飞行员在引擎故障后安全降落了飞机。

definitions.definition: 安全设备（如安全带、保险装置）

en: The safety of passengers is the airline's top priority.
Always wear a helmet for safety when riding a bike.
The new regulations aim to improve workplace safety.
cn: 乘客安全是航空公司的首要任务。
骑自行车时务必戴头盔以确保安全。
新规旨在提升工作场所的安全性。

en: The ship's sail caught the wind and moved swiftly.
They plan to sail across the Atlantic next year.
The yacht had a torn sail after the storm.
cn: 船帆迎风鼓起，迅速前进。
他们计划明年横渡大西洋。
风暴过后，游艇的帆破了。

en: The old sailor told stories of storms in the Atlantic.
She became a skilled sailor after years of practice.
The bar was filled with off-duty sailors.
cn: 这位老水手讲述了大西洋风暴的故事。
经过多年练习，她成为了一名熟练的航海者。
酒吧里挤满了休假的水手。

definitions.definition: 圣人；圣徒（被教会正式认可为神圣的人）
神圣的（用于地名或头衔，如 Saint John）

en: Joan of Arc was canonized as a saint in 1920.
He may not be a saint, but he’s always kind to others.
St. Patrick’s Day is celebrated worldwide.
cn: 圣女贞德于1920年被封圣。
他或许不是圣人，但待人一贯友善。
圣帕特里克节在全球范围内庆祝。

en: She quit her job for the sake of her mental health.
He enjoys drinking warm sake in winter.
Do it for my sake, if not for your own.
cn: 她为了心理健康辞去了工作。
他喜欢在冬天喝温热的清酒。
就算不为你自己，也看在我的份上做这件事吧。

definitions.definition: 沙拉（凉拌蔬菜或水果为主的菜肴）
混合杂烩（比喻杂乱的事物）

en: She ordered a Greek salad with feta cheese.
The documentary was a salad of historical clips and interviews.
Always toss the salad gently to keep the leaves crisp.
cn: 她点了一份希腊沙拉，配羊乳酪。
这部纪录片是历史片段和采访的杂烩。
轻轻搅拌沙拉以保持蔬菜脆嫩。

definitions.definition: 薪水，工资（固定周期支付的劳动报酬）

en: Her monthly salary is enough to cover all living expenses.
The company offers competitive salaries to attract talent.
Negotiating a higher salary requires preparation and confidence.
cn: 她的月薪足以支付所有生活开销。
该公司提供有竞争力的薪资以吸引人才。
谈判更高的薪水需要准备和信心。

en: The house is priced for a quick sale.
Black Friday sales attract millions of shoppers.
She works in car sales at the local dealership.
cn: 这栋房子定价以便快速出售。
黑色星期五促销吸引了数百万消费者。
她在本地经销商处从事汽车销售工作。

en: The salesman demonstrated the new product to potential customers.
He worked as a traveling salesman for over a decade.
A good salesman understands the needs of his clients.
cn: 推销员向潜在客户展示了新产品。
他做了十多年的巡回推销员。
优秀的推销员懂得客户的需求。

definitions.definition: 用盐腌制；撒盐；使更有趣

en: She sprinkled salt on her fries.
His jokes added salt to the conversation.
They salted the meat to preserve it.
cn: 她在薯条上撒了盐。
他的玩笑为谈话增添了趣味。
他们用盐腌制肉类以保存。

en: The soldier raised his hand to salute the officer.
We salute the brave healthcare workers during the pandemic.
In some cultures, a bow is used to salute instead of a hand gesture.
cn: 士兵举手向军官敬礼。
我们向疫情期间勇敢的医护人员致敬。
在某些文化中，人们用鞠躬代替手势致意。

en: We grew up in the same neighborhood.
"Happy New Year!" "Same to you!"
All the houses on this street look the same.
cn: 我们在同一个街区长大。
“新年快乐！” “你也一样！”
这条街上的所有房子看起来一模一样。

en: The doctor took a blood sample for testing.
This free cookie is a sample of our new product.
She sampled several courses before choosing her major.
cn: 医生采集了血液样本进行检测。
这块免费饼干是我们新产品的试吃样品。
她体验了几门课程后才选定专业。

en: The children built a castle out of wet sand.
Be sure to sand the wooden surface before painting.
The desert stretched endlessly, a sea of golden sand.
cn: 孩子们用湿沙子堆了一座城堡。
刷漆前务必用砂纸打磨木制表面。
沙漠无边无际，宛如一片金色沙海。

definitions.definition: 三明治（两片面包夹馅料的食物）

en: She packed a turkey sandwich for lunch.
The tiny house was sandwiched between two skyscrapers.
He sandwiched the meeting between two flights.
cn: 她打包了一个火鸡三明治当午餐。
这小房子被挤在两座摩天大楼之间。
他在两趟航班之间插入了会议。

en: The children played on the sandy beach all afternoon.
Her hair was a sandy blonde, matching the desert landscape.
Avoid wearing shoes in sandy areas to prevent damage.
cn: 孩子们整个下午都在沙质海滩上玩耍。
她的头发是沙金色，与沙漠景色相映。
在沙地避免穿鞋，以防损坏。

en: The moon is Earth's natural satellite.
The company launched a communication satellite last year.
He was merely a satellite of the famous philosopher, echoing his ideas.
cn: 月球是地球的天然卫星。
该公司去年发射了一颗通信卫星。
他只是那位著名哲学家的追随者，重复其观点。

definitions.definition: 赔偿，补偿（法律或正式用语）

en: She smiled with satisfaction after finishing the marathon.
The company offered financial satisfaction to the affected customers.
True satisfaction comes from helping others.
cn: 她在完成马拉松后满意地笑了。
公司向受影响的顾客提供了经济补偿。
真正的满足感源于帮助他人。

definitions.definition: 令人满意的；符合要求的

en: The test results were satisfactory, meeting all the required standards.
Her performance was deemed satisfactory by the evaluation committee.
The hotel provided satisfactory service, though not exceptional.
cn: 测试结果令人满意，符合所有要求标准。
评估委员会认为她的表现符合要求。
酒店服务令人满意，虽非卓越。

en: The meal satisfied his hunger after a long day.
Her performance satisfied all the criteria for promotion.
He sold his car to satisfy his debts.
cn: 这顿饭满足了他一天的饥饿。
她的表现符合晋升的所有标准。
他卖掉汽车以清偿债务。

en: We’re having a picnic this Saturday.
Saturday is my favorite day of the week.
The store closes early on Saturdays.
cn: 我们这周六要去野餐。
星期六是我一周中最喜欢的一天。
这家店每周六提前关门。

en: The pasta was served with a rich tomato sauce.
She sauced the dish with a hint of lemon.
His stories are always sauced with humor.
cn: 意大利面配了浓郁的番茄酱。
她用少许柠檬为菜肴提味。
他的故事总带着幽默感。

en: She placed the teacup on the matching saucer.
UFO enthusiasts often describe alien crafts as flying saucers.
The waiter brought a saucer of lemon slices with the fish.
cn: 她将茶杯放在配套的茶托上。
UFO爱好者常将外星飞船描述为飞碟。
服务员端上一碟配鱼的柠檬片。

en: She grilled sausages for breakfast.
This German sausage is flavored with herbs.
The recipe calls for spicy Italian sausage.
cn: 她早餐烤了香肠。
这种德国香肠用香草调味。
食谱需要意大利辣香肠。

en: The firefighter saved the child from the burning building.
Remember to save your work before closing the computer.
His brilliant save kept the team in the game.
cn: 消防员从燃烧的建筑物中救出了孩子。
关闭电脑前记得保存你的工作。
他精彩的扑救让球队得以继续比赛。

en: She opened a savings account to manage her money better.
The new policy aims at saving energy in public buildings.
His quick action was the saving factor in the emergency.
cn: 她开了一个储蓄账户来更好地管理资金。
新政策旨在节约公共建筑的能源。
他的迅速行动是紧急情况中的挽救因素。

definitions.definition: /vi. 锯；用锯切割；拉锯般移动

en: He sawed the wooden plank in half with a rusty saw.
The sound of a saw cutting through metal echoed in the workshop.
She saws the violin bow back and forth with perfect rhythm.
cn: 他用一把生锈的锯子将木板锯成两半。
锯子切割金属的声音在车间里回荡。
她以完美的节奏来回拉动着小提琴弓。

en: She didn't say a word during the meeting.
The clock says it's already midnight.
Everyone should have a say in this decision.
cn: 会议期间她一言不发。
时钟显示已是午夜。
每个人都应对此决定有发言权。

en: The map has a scale of 1:50,000.
Salmon lose their scales when they swim upstream.
She scaled the mountain in record time.
cn: 这张地图的比例尺是1:5万。
鲑鱼溯流而上时会脱落鳞片。
她以破纪录的速度登上了山顶。

en: The doctor will scan your brain for abnormalities.
She quickly scanned the newspaper for weather updates.
The radar scan detected an unknown object.
cn: 医生将扫描你的大脑以检查异常。
她快速浏览报纸寻找天气信息。
雷达扫描发现了一个未知物体。

definitions.definition: 疤痕；伤痕；（精神上的）创伤

en: The surgery left a small scar on her knee.
Childhood trauma can scar a person for life.
The volcanic eruption scarred the landscape permanently.
cn: 手术在她的膝盖上留下了一道小疤痕。
童年创伤可能给人留下终身的心理阴影。
火山喷发永久性地改变了地貌的样貌。

en: Fresh water is scarce in some desert regions.
Jobs were scarce during the economic crisis.
This rare stamp is becoming increasingly scarce.
cn: 某些沙漠地区的淡水资源匮乏。
经济危机期间工作机会稀少。
这枚稀有邮票正变得越来越难觅。

definitions.definition: 几乎不；勉强地（表示数量或程度极小）
刚刚；才（表示时间或动作的紧急性）

en: She scarcely had time to eat breakfast before rushing to work.
The village was scarcely visible through the thick fog.
He had scarcely finished speaking when the phone rang.
cn: 她几乎没时间吃早餐就匆忙去上班了。
村庄在浓雾中几乎看不见。
他刚说完话，电话就响了。

en: The loud noise scared the birds away.
She had a scare when she saw the shadow in the dark.
Don't scare me like that!
cn: 巨大的声响把鸟群吓飞了。
看到黑暗中的影子时，她吓了一跳。
别那样吓我！

definitions.definition: 用围巾围；狼吞虎咽地吃

en: She wrapped a silk scarf around her neck to keep warm.
He scarfed down his lunch in five minutes.
The vintage scarf added a pop of color to her outfit.
cn: 她围了一条丝巾保暖。
他五分钟内狼吞虎咽地吃完了午餐。
这条复古围巾为她的穿搭增添了一抹亮色。

en: The wind will scatter the leaves across the yard.
Birds scattered as the dog ran toward them.
She scattered rose petals along the aisle.
cn: 风会把树叶吹散到院子里。
狗跑向鸟群时，鸟儿四散飞走。
她将玫瑰花瓣撒在过道上。

definitions.definition: 场景（戏剧、电影中的片段）
场面（事件发生的现场或景象）
领域（特定活动或文化的范围，如 "music scene"）

en: The opening scene of the play was breathtaking.
Police arrived at the scene of the accident within minutes.
She's a prominent figure in the local art scene.
cn: 戏剧的开场场景令人惊叹。
警方几分钟内抵达了事故现场。
她是当地艺术圈的重要人物。

definitions.definition: 风景，景色（自然或人造的视觉环境）
舞台布景（戏剧或电影中的背景布置）

en: The mountain scenery took our breath away.
The play’s scenery was designed by a famous artist.
She paints scenery inspired by rural landscapes.
cn: 山景让我们惊叹不已。
这部剧的布景由一位著名艺术家设计。
她绘制受乡村风光启发的风景画。

en: The scent of roses filled the garden.
The dog quickly picked up the scent of the fox.
She scented trouble when he avoided her questions.
cn: 玫瑰的香气弥漫花园。
狗迅速捕捉到狐狸的气味。
当他回避问题时，她察觉到了麻烦。

en: The project is behind schedule due to unexpected delays.
Please schedule a meeting for next Monday.
Check the train schedule before you leave.
cn: 该项目因意外延误而落后于计划进度。
请为下周一安排一次会议。
出发前查好火车时刻表。

en: The government launched a new housing scheme.
He was accused of scheming to overthrow the management.
Her scheme to avoid taxes was eventually discovered.
cn: 政府推出了一项新的住房计划。
他被指控密谋推翻管理层。
她避税的阴谋最终被揭露。

en: She is a renowned scholar of medieval literature.
The foundation offers grants to young scholars.
His argument reflects a true scholar's depth.
cn: 她是研究中世纪文学的著名学者。
该基金会为年轻学者提供资助。
他的论点展现了一位真正学者的深度。

definitions.definition: 学问，学术成就（知识领域）

en: She won a full scholarship to Harvard.
His scholarship on medieval history is widely respected.
The foundation offers scholarships to underprivileged students.
cn: 她获得了哈佛大学的全额奖学金。
他在中世纪历史方面的学术成就备受尊敬。
该基金会为贫困学生提供奖学金。

en: She attends a prestigious school in London.
The artist belonged to the Impressionist school.
Dolphins school their young in hunting techniques.
cn: 她在伦敦一所名校就读。
这位艺术家属于印象派。
海豚会教导幼崽狩猎技巧。

definitions.definition: 科学（系统性知识或研究领域）
自然科学（如物理、化学等）

en: Modern science has greatly improved our understanding of the universe.
She decided to pursue a career in computer science.
The study was published in a prestigious science journal.
cn: 现代科学极大提升了我们对宇宙的认知。
她决定从事计算机科学领域的工作。
这项研究发表在知名科学期刊上。

definitions.definition: 科学的；基于科学方法的

en: The study followed a strictly scientific approach.
She has a very scientific mind, always analyzing details.
This theory lacks scientific evidence.
cn: 这项研究遵循了严格的科学方法。
她思维非常科学化，总是分析细节。
该理论缺乏科学依据。

definitions.definition: 科学家（从事科学研究的人）

en: Marie Curie was a pioneering scientist in radioactivity research.
Modern scientists often collaborate across disciplines.
The young scientist published her findings in a top journal.
cn: 居里夫人是放射性研究领域的先驱科学家。
现代科学家常进行跨学科合作。
这位年轻科学家将研究成果发表在顶级期刊上。

definitions.definition: 剪刀（复数形式，常作单数使用）

en: She carefully trimmed the paper with a pair of scissors.
These scissors are too dull to cut fabric.
The child held the scissors incorrectly, causing safety concerns.
cn: 她用剪刀仔细修剪纸张。
这把剪刀太钝，剪不了布料。
孩子拿剪刀的姿势不对，引发了安全顾虑。

en: She scolded the child for breaking the vase.
The old man was known as the neighborhood scold.
Don’t scold him too harshly; he didn’t mean to offend you.
cn: 她因孩子打碎花瓶而责骂了他。
这位老人是街坊里有名的爱训斥人的家伙。
别太严厉地责备他，他不是有意冒犯你的。

en: The investigation widened the scope of the research.
This telescope has a narrow field of scope.
She scoped the room before entering.
cn: 这次调查扩大了研究的范围。
这台望远镜的视野较窄。
她在进入前仔细查看了房间。

en: The final score was 3-2.
He scored a goal in the last minute.
She made a score on the tree to mark the trail.
cn: 最终比分为3比2。
他在最后一分钟进了一球。
她在树上刻了一道痕迹以标记路线。

en: She looked at him with cold scorn.
He scorned all offers of help.
Their scorn for the proposal was evident.
cn: 她以冰冷的轻蔑目光看着他。
他不屑地拒绝了所有帮助提议。
他们对这一提议的鄙夷显而易见。

en: The scout reported enemy movements to the commander.
She was scouted by a top modeling agency at age 16.
The boys joined the local scout troop to learn survival skills.
cn: 侦察员向指挥官汇报了敌军的动向。
她16岁时被一家顶级模特经纪公司相中。
男孩们加入当地童子军学习生存技能。

en: She fell and scraped her knee on the pavement.
The branches scraped against the window in the wind.
He managed to scrape together enough money for the trip.
cn: 她摔倒时膝盖在人行道上擦伤了。
树枝在风中刮擦着窗户。
他勉强凑够了旅行的钱。

en: The cat will scratch you if you pull its tail.
He heard a scratch on the window and turned around.
I’ll just jot down a few scratch notes before the meeting.
cn: 如果你拉猫的尾巴，它会抓你。
他听到窗户上有刮擦声，于是转过身。
我会在会议前草草记下几条笔记。

en: She screamed when she saw the spider.
The scream of the brakes made everyone turn their heads.
Fans screamed with excitement at the concert.
cn: 她看到蜘蛛时尖叫起来。
刹车的刺耳声让所有人转头。
粉丝们在演唱会上兴奋地尖叫。

en: She adjusted the screen to block the sunlight.
The app screens inappropriate content automatically.
The movie premiered on screens worldwide last week.
cn: 她调整屏风以遮挡阳光。
该应用自动筛选不当内容。
这部电影上周在全球银幕上映。

definitions.definition: 用螺丝固定；拧紧；扭曲（比喻义）

en: Tighten the screw with a screwdriver.
He screwed the lid onto the jar.
The scandal screwed up his reputation.
cn: 用螺丝刀拧紧螺丝。
他把盖子拧到罐子上。
丑闻彻底毁了他的名声。

en: The ship disappeared into the vast sea.
She faced a sea of unfamiliar faces at the conference.
Ancient traders crossed the Mediterranean Sea for commerce.
cn: 船只消失在浩瀚的大海中。
她在会议上面对一片陌生的面孔。
古代商人穿越地中海进行贸易。

en: The document carries the royal seal.
Scientists observed the seal diving under the ice.
Make sure to seal the envelope properly.
cn: 文件盖有王室印章。
科学家观察到海豹潜入冰下。
务必妥善密封信封。

en: The old seaman told stories of storms in the Atlantic.
She trained hard to become a certified seaman.
The seaman checked the ropes before the ship departed.
cn: 这位老水手讲述了大西洋风暴的故事。
她刻苦训练成为了一名持证海员。
水手在船只离港前检查了绳索。

en: The city grew into a bustling seaport during the 19th century.
Many seaports were closed due to the severe storm.
Rotterdam is one of the largest seaports in Europe.
cn: 这座城市在19世纪发展成为一个繁忙的海港。
许多海港因暴风雨而关闭。
鹿特丹是欧洲最大的海港之一。

en: She searched the entire house for her missing keys.
The police conducted a search of the suspect's belongings.
Search engines help us find information quickly.
cn: 她翻遍整个房子寻找丢失的钥匙。
警方对嫌疑人的物品进行了搜查。
搜索引擎帮助我们快速检索信息。

en: The rainy season lasts from June to September.
She seasoned the soup with fresh herbs.
Holiday sales peak during the Christmas season.
cn: 雨季从六月持续到九月。
她用新鲜香草给汤调味。
假日销售额在圣诞季达到顶峰。

en: Please take a seat and wait for your name to be called.
The theater can seat over 500 people.
She won a seat in the Senate last year.
cn: 请就座并等待叫到您的名字。
这个剧院可容纳500余人。
她去年赢得了参议院的一个席位。

en: She finished the race in second place.
Can you second my proposal during the meeting?
Wait a second, I need to check my notes.
cn: 她以第二名完成了比赛。
你能在会议上附议我的提案吗？
稍等，我需要查看笔记。

definitions.definition: 中等教育的（如 secondary school）

en: Safety is always secondary to efficiency in this factory.
She teaches history at a local secondary school.
The debate focused on primary issues, leaving secondaries unresolved.
cn: 在这家工厂，安全总是效率的次要考虑。
她在当地一所中学教历史。
辩论聚焦主要问题，次要问题悬而未决。

definitions.definition: 其次；第二（用于列举或排序）

en: Firstly, we need data; secondly, we must analyze it.
The method is cheap, and secondly, it’s efficient.
She arrived late, firstly due to traffic, and secondly because her alarm didn’t go off.
cn: 首先我们需要数据，其次必须对其进行分析。
这种方法成本低，其次效率高。
她迟到了，第一是因为堵车，第二是闹钟没响。

en: She whispered the secret to her best friend.
The documents were marked as secret.
He has a secret talent for painting.
cn: 她悄悄把秘密告诉了她最好的朋友。
这些文件被标记为机密。
他有一项不为人知的绘画天赋。

definitions.definition: 秘书（负责文书或行政工作的人员）
（政府部门的）部长、大臣（如 Secretary of State）

en: She works as a secretary in a law firm.
The UN Secretary-General called for global cooperation.
He was appointed Secretary of the Treasury.
cn: 她在一家律师事务所担任秘书。
联合国秘书长呼吁全球合作。
他被任命为财政部长。

en: The report is divided into three sections.
She carefully sectioned the cake into equal pieces.
The biology class studied a cross-section of a plant stem.
cn: 报告分为三个部分。
她将蛋糕仔细切成等份。
生物课研究了植物茎的横断面。

definitions.definition: 安全的；稳固的；无忧虑的

en: The vault is designed to keep valuables secure.
She secured a scholarship with her outstanding grades.
Make sure the ladder is secure before climbing.
cn: 这个金库的设计是为了安全保管贵重物品。
她以优异的成绩获得了奖学金。
爬梯子前确保它稳固。

en: The new software enhances data security.
She works in airport security.
Government bonds are considered low-risk securities.
cn: 新软件提升了数据安全性。
她在机场安保部门工作。
国债被视为低风险证券。

en: I can see the mountains from my window.
Do you see the difference between these two colors?
Let's meet and discuss this further – I'll see you at the café.
cn: 我能从窗户看到群山。
你能看出这两种颜色的区别吗？
我们见面详谈吧，咖啡馆见。

en: The farmer planted the seed in fertile soil.
Her idea was the seed of our project’s success.
These plants will seed themselves naturally.
cn: 农民将种子播撒在肥沃的土壤中。
她的想法是我们项目成功的起因。
这些植物会自然结籽繁殖。

en: She seeks advice from her mentor before making decisions.
The company is seeking new opportunities in the Asian market.
Wisdom is not found by chance; you must seek it earnestly.
cn: 她在做决定前向导师寻求建议。
该公司正在亚洲市场寻找新机遇。
智慧不会偶然获得，你必须认真追求。

en: She seems happy with the results.
The task seems easier than expected.
It seems that no one noticed the error.
cn: 她似乎对结果很满意。
这项任务看起来比预期简单。
似乎没有人注意到这个错误。

definitions.definition: 抓住，夺取（强调突然或强力）

en: The police seized the stolen goods in the raid.
She finally seized the meaning of the poem after reading it twice.
The government has the power to seize assets linked to criminal activity.
cn: 警方在突袭中查获了赃物。
读完两遍后，她终于领悟了这首诗的含义。
政府有权没收与犯罪活动相关的资产。

en: She seldom eats fast food due to health concerns.
Heavy snowfalls are seldom seen in this coastal city.
He seldom speaks during meetings, but his ideas are always insightful.
cn: 她因健康问题很少吃快餐。
这座沿海城市很少见到大雪。
他开会时很少发言，但观点总是很有见地。

en: Please select a password for your account.
This store sells select wines from around the world.
The committee will select three candidates for the final interview.
cn: 请为您的账户选择一个密码。
这家店售卖全球精选葡萄酒。
委员会将筛选三名候选人进入最终面试。

definitions.definition: 被选中的人或物；精选品

en: The selection process for the scholarship is highly competitive.
This bookstore has a wide selection of science fiction novels.
Natural selection plays a key role in biological evolution.
cn: 这项奖学金的选拔过程竞争非常激烈。
这家书店有丰富的科幻小说可供选择。
自然选择在生物进化中起关键作用。

definitions.definition: 同一的；纯净的（如 self-sealing 自密封的）

en: She found her true self through meditation.
The machine has a self-cleaning function.
He built a self-sustaining ecosystem in his garden.
cn: 她通过冥想找到了真实的自我。
这台机器具有自动清洁功能。
他在花园里建立了一个自给自足的生态系统。

definitions.definition: 自私的，只顾自身利益的

en: His selfish behavior made him lose many friends.
It's selfish to ignore others' needs for your own gain.
She realized her mistake and apologized for being selfish.
cn: 他的自私行为让他失去了许多朋友。
为自身利益忽视他人需求是自私的。
她意识到错误，并为自己的自私道歉。

definitions.definition: 出售；推销；说服某人接受（观点等）

en: She sells handmade jewelry at the local market.
The new model sells well in Asian countries.
He tried to sell me on his investment plan.
cn: 她在本地市场出售手工珠宝。
这款新机型在亚洲国家销路很好。
他试图说服我接受他的投资计划。

en: She is a successful seller of handmade jewelry.
This novel became a best seller within a month.
The seller agreed to lower the price by 10%.
cn: 她是一位成功的手工珠宝卖家。
这本小说在一个月内成为畅销书。
卖方同意降价10%。

definitions.definition: 学期（通常指大学或学校一年中分为两部分的半学年）

en: The fall semester starts in September.
She took five courses last semester.
The final exams mark the end of the semester.
cn: 秋季学期从九月开始。
她上学期修了五门课。
期末考试标志着学期结束。

definitions.definition: 半导体（一种导电性介于导体和绝缘体之间的材料，广泛应用于电子设备）

en: Silicon is the most widely used material in semiconductor devices.
The semiconductor industry drives innovation in modern electronics.
This chip uses advanced semiconductor technology to improve efficiency.
cn: 硅是半导体器件中最常用的材料。
半导体行业推动了现代电子技术的创新。
该芯片采用先进的半导体技术以提高效率。

definitions.definition: 参议院（立法机构的上议院或古罗马元老院）

en: The bill was passed by the senate after a long debate.
The Roman senate played a key role in ancient governance.
The university senate approved the new curriculum.
cn: 这项法案经参议院长时间辩论后通过。
古罗马元老院在治理中起关键作用。
大学理事会批准了新课程。

en: She will send the package tomorrow.
The company sent him to manage the new branch.
Can you send me the details via email?
cn: 她明天会寄出包裹。
公司派他去管理新分部。
你能通过邮件把详情发给我吗？

definitions.definition: 年长者；高年级学生；上司

en: She holds a senior position in the company.
The senior students organized the graduation ceremony.
He is ten years senior to his wife.
cn: 她在公司担任高级职位。
高年级学生组织了毕业典礼。
他比妻子年长十岁。

definitions.definition: 感觉；感官功能（如视觉、听觉）

en: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
Her business sense helped the company succeed.
I could sense his hesitation from his tone.
cn: 狗的嗅觉非常灵敏。
她的商业头脑帮助公司取得成功。
我从他的语气中察觉到了犹豫。

en: It's sensible to save money for emergencies.
She gave me some sensible advice.
The patient was sensible of a sharp pain.
cn: 为紧急情况存钱是明智之举。
她给了我一些合理的建议。
病人感觉到一阵剧痛。（古义用法）

en: She is very sensitive to criticism.
The device is highly sensitive to temperature changes.
He gave a sensitive performance as the grieving father.
cn: 她对批评非常敏感。
该设备对温度变化高度灵敏。
他饰演悲恸的父亲，表演细腻动人。

en: The judge will announce the sentence next week.
This sentence is grammatically incorrect.
He was sentenced to three years in prison.
cn: 法官将于下周宣布判决。
这个句子在语法上是错误的。
他被判处三年监禁。

en: Please separate the recyclables from the trash.
They live in separate apartments.
Oil and water naturally separate.
cn: 请将可回收物与垃圾分开。
他们住在不同的公寓里。
油和水天然分离。

en: The twins were dressed separately for the event.
Each item is priced separately on the menu.
The issues should be discussed separately to avoid confusion.
cn: 这对双胞胎为活动分别着装。
菜单上每样物品单独标价。
为避免混淆，这些问题应分开讨论。

en: The separation of the two continents took millions of years.
Their separation was amicable, with shared custody of the children.
Chemical separation techniques are essential in laboratory research.
cn: 两大洲的分离经历了数百万年。
他们的分居很友好，共同抚养孩子。
化学分离技术在实验室研究中至关重要。

en: Schools usually reopen in September.
September marks the beginning of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere.
The September issue of the magazine features fall fashion trends.
cn: 学校通常在九月开学。
九月是北半球秋季的开始。
该杂志的九月刊主打秋季时尚趋势。

definitions.definition: 按顺序排列；测定（DNA等的）序列

en: The teacher asked us to arrange the events in chronological sequence.
Scientists sequenced the genome of the rare plant.
A sudden sequence of loud noises startled the crowd.
cn: 老师让我们按时间顺序排列这些事件。
科学家们对这种稀有植物的基因组进行了测序。
一连串突然的巨响吓到了人群。

definitions.definition: 系列（按顺序排列的相似事物）

en: The lecture series covers topics from ancient to modern art.
She owns the complete series of detective novels.
A series of errors led to the system failure.
cn: 该系列讲座涵盖从古代到现代的艺术主题。
她拥有这套侦探小说的完整系列。
一连串错误导致了系统故障。

en: She gave me a serious look before answering.
The situation requires serious attention.
He is serious about learning Chinese.
cn: 她在回答前严肃地看了我一眼。
这一情况需要高度重视。
他对学习中文非常认真。

en: She nodded seriously when asked about the decision.
This movie is seriously good.
Are you seriously considering quitting your job?
cn: 被问及这个决定时，她严肃地点了点头。
这部电影真的好极了。
你真的在考虑辞职吗？

definitions.definition: （政府或机构的）雇员，公职人员

en: The loyal servant prepared dinner before the family returned.
Civil servants are required to take an oath of confidentiality.
She treated her employees not as servants but as partners.
cn: 忠心的仆人在家人回来前准备好了晚餐。
公务员需宣誓保密。
她对待员工如伙伴而非仆人。

en: She has served the company for over a decade.
He served an ace in the final match.
All citizens must serve in the military for two years.
cn: 她已为公司服务超过十年。
他在决赛中发了一记ace球。
所有公民必须服兵役两年。

en: The hotel offers excellent room service.
He served in the military for five years.
Regular maintenance services can extend the life of your car.
cn: 这家酒店提供优质的客房服务。
他在军队服役了五年。
定期维修服务能延长汽车寿命。

definitions.definition: 会议；会期；（法庭的）开庭；（某项活动的）一段时间

en: The committee held a session to discuss the new policy.
Her therapy session lasted for an hour.
The court is now in session.
cn: 委员会召开会议讨论新政策。
她的治疗课程持续了一小时。
法庭现在开庭中。

en: She set the vase on the table carefully.
The scientist used a set of tools for the experiment.
Are you all set for the trip?
cn: 她小心地把花瓶放在桌上。
科学家用了一套工具做实验。
你准备好出发了吗？

en: The novel's setting is a small coastal village.
Adjust the temperature setting on the thermostat.
The diamond was held in a gold setting.
cn: 这部小说的背景是一个海滨小村庄。
调节恒温器上的温度设置。
钻石镶嵌在一个黄金底座中。

en: They decided to settle the dispute peacefully.
Dust particles will settle at the bottom of the container.
After years of traveling, she finally settled in a small village.
cn: 他们决定和平解决争端。
尘埃颗粒会沉淀在容器底部。
多年漂泊后，她最终在一个小村庄定居。

en: The Vikings established a settlement in Greenland.
The two companies reached a settlement out of court.
The bank requires immediate settlement of the debt.
cn: 维京人在格陵兰建立了定居点。
两家公司达成了庭外和解。
银行要求立即结清债务。

en: There are seven days in a week.
She counted to seven before opening her eyes.
The recipe requires seven ingredients.
cn: 一周有七天。
她数到七才睁开眼睛。
这道食谱需要七种食材。

en: She celebrated her seventeenth birthday with a trip to Paris.
The book is divided into seventeen short chapters.
Seventeen students volunteered for the science project.
cn: 她以一场巴黎之旅庆祝了自己的十七岁生日。
这本书分为十七个简短的章节。
十七名学生自愿参加了这个科学项目。

en: She finished in seventh place in the race.
One seventh of the students chose art as their elective.
July is the seventh month of the year.
cn: 她在比赛中获得了第七名。
七分之一的学生选修了艺术课。
七月是一年中的第七个月份。

en: She lived to be seventy years old.
The book costs seventy dollars.
Seventy percent of the students passed the exam.
cn: 她活到了七十岁。
这本书售价七十美元。
百分之七十的学生通过了考试。

en: She bought several books at the store.
The team members went their several ways after the meeting.
Several of the applicants were highly qualified.
cn: 她在店里买了几本书。
会议结束后，团队成员各自离开。
申请者中有几位非常优秀。

en: The judge imposed a severe sentence on the criminal.
She suffered from severe headaches after the accident.
The building's design is severe, with no unnecessary decorations.
cn: 法官对罪犯判处了严厉的刑罚。
事故后她患上了严重的头痛。
这座建筑的设计非常朴素，没有任何多余的装饰。

en: The patient was severely injured in the accident.
The teacher spoke severely to the cheating student.
Climate change has severely affected coastal ecosystems.
cn: 患者在事故中严重受伤。
老师严厉批评了作弊的学生。
气候变化严重影响了沿海生态系统。

en: She learned to sew her own dresses to save money.
The surgeon skillfully sewed the wound with fine stitches.
My grandmother used to sew by the fireplace every evening.
cn: 她学会自己缝制裙子以节省开支。
外科医生用细密的针脚熟练地缝合了伤口。
我祖母过去常在壁炉旁做针线活。

en: The study focuses on differences between the sexes.
Sex education is essential for teenagers.
Some species can change sex during their lifetime.
cn: 这项研究关注两性之间的差异。
性教育对青少年至关重要。
某些物种在生命周期中会改变性别。

en: She sat under the shade of a willow tree.
These sunglasses can shade your eyes from UV rays.
The artist used different shades of blue in the painting.
cn: 她坐在柳树的树荫下。
这副太阳镜能遮蔽紫外线保护眼睛。
画家在作品中运用了不同深浅的蓝色。

en: The tree cast a long shadow on the grass.
She felt someone shadowing her in the alley.
His smile was shadowed by sadness.
cn: 树木在草地上投下长长的影子。
她感觉到有人在巷子里跟踪她。
他的笑容蒙上了一层悲伤的阴影。

en: We sat under a shady oak tree to escape the midday sun.
The deal seemed shady, so I decided not to invest.
His shady past made it hard for him to find a job.
cn: 我们坐在一棵阴凉的橡树下躲避正午的阳光。
这笔交易看起来不靠谱，所以我决定不投资。
他不光彩的过去让他很难找到工作。

en: She shook the bottle vigorously before opening it.
His voice shook with emotion during the speech.
I’ll have a chocolate shake, please.
cn: 她打开瓶子前用力摇晃了它。
演讲时他的声音因情绪激动而颤抖。
请给我一杯巧克力奶昔。

definitions.definition: 表示未来动作（第一人称）
表示命令、承诺或必然性

en: I shall return before sunset.
Shall we dance?
The contract shall take effect immediately.
cn: 我将在日落前回来。
我们跳舞好吗？
本合同应立即生效。

definitions.definition: 浅的（指水深或程度不深）
肤浅的，浅薄的（指思想或内容）

en: The children played in the shallow end of the pool.
His argument was too shallow to convince anyone.
The boat ran aground on a shallow near the coast.
cn: 孩子们在泳池的浅水区玩耍。
他的论点太肤浅，无法说服任何人。
小船在近岸的浅滩上搁浅了。

definitions.definition: 羞耻，羞愧；可耻的人或事

en: His actions brought shame upon his family.
She felt a deep sense of shame after lying to her friend.
They tried to shame him into apologizing.
cn: 他的行为让家族蒙羞。
她对朋友撒谎后感到深深的羞愧。
他们试图用羞辱迫使他道歉。

en: She bought a bottle of herbal shampoo.
Can you shampoo the dog while I prepare its bath towel?
This shampoo lathers well even in hard water.
cn: 她买了一瓶草本洗发水。
你能给狗洗澡吗？我去准备它的浴巾。
这款洗发水即使在硬水中也能起丰富泡沫。

en: The artist shaped the clay into a graceful vase.
Childhood experiences often shape a person's character.
The clouds took on the shape of a dragon.
cn: 艺术家将黏土塑造成一个优雅的花瓶。
童年经历常常塑造一个人的性格。
云朵呈现出龙的形状。

en: She offered to share her lunch with me.
Each partner holds a 30% share in the business.
We encourage children to learn to share toys.
cn: 她主动提出与我分享她的午餐。
每位合伙人持有企业30%的股份。
我们鼓励孩子们学会分享玩具。

en: Be careful with that knife—it's very sharp.
She has a sharp mind for solving puzzles.
The stock price took a sharp drop yesterday.
cn: 小心那把刀，它非常锋利。
她头脑敏锐，擅长解谜。
昨日股价急剧下跌。

en: He used a whetstone to sharpen the knife.
The debate helped sharpen her argument.
The image will sharpen if you adjust the focus.
cn: 他用磨刀石磨利了刀子。
这场辩论让她的论点更犀利。
调整焦距后，图像会变清晰。

en: The road turns sharply to the left.
Prices rose sharply during the crisis.
She spoke sharply to correct the mistake.
cn: 道路突然向左急转。
危机期间价格急剧上涨。
她严厉地指出错误。

en: He shaves his beard every morning.
The carpenter shaved the wood to make it smooth.
The plane barely shaved the treetops during landing.
cn: 他每天早晨刮胡子。
木匠刨平木头使其光滑。
飞机降落时险些擦过树梢。

definitions.definition: 她（第三人称女性单数主格代词）

en: She is reading a book under the oak tree.
When she arrived, the audience applauded.
The scientist said she had completed the experiment.
cn: 她正在橡树下读书。
当她到达时，观众鼓掌致意。
这位科学家表示她已完成实验。

en: The farmer shears the sheep every spring.
Engineers calculated the shear strength of the bridge.
These garden shears need sharpening.
cn: 农民每年春天给绵羊剪毛。
工程师计算了桥梁的抗剪强度。
这把园艺剪刀需要磨锋利了。

definitions.definition: 脱落（毛发、皮肤等）；流出（眼泪）；摆脱（负担）

en: The gardener stored tools in the wooden shed.
Snakes shed their skin as they grow.
She shed tears of joy at the news.
cn: 园丁把工具存放在木棚里。
蛇在生长过程中会蜕皮。
听到消息后，她流下了喜悦的泪水。

en: The shepherd counted his sheep before nightfall.
She felt like a sheep in a crowd of wolves at the meeting.
Wild sheep can climb steep mountain slopes with ease.
cn: 牧羊人在天黑前清点了他的羊群。
她在会议上感觉自己像狼群中的一只羊。
野生绵羊能轻松攀爬陡峭的山坡。

en: She spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
The lake was covered with a sheet of ice.
Please fill out this application sheet.
cn: 她在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。
湖面覆盖着一层冰。
请填写这份申请表。

en: She placed the books back on the shelf.
The continental shelf is rich in marine life.
This shelf can hold up to 20 kilograms.
cn: 她把书放回了架子上。
大陆架富含海洋生物。
这个搁板最多可承重20公斤。

en: She collected colorful shells on the beach.
The artillery shell exploded with a deafening roar.
He carefully shelled the peanuts before eating them.
cn: 她在海滩上收集了五彩斑斓的贝壳。
炮弹伴随着震耳欲聋的爆炸声炸开。
他仔细地剥去花生壳后才食用。

en: The tree provided shelter from the rain.
They sheltered the refugees in a temporary camp.
Everyone deserves access to safe shelter.
cn: 这棵树为人们遮雨。
他们将难民安置在临时营地庇护。
每个人都应享有安全的居所。

en: The shepherd led his flock through the valley.
Teachers often shepherd students toward critical thinking.
The pastor is seen as a spiritual shepherd in the community.
cn: 牧羊人带领羊群穿过山谷。
教师常引导学生培养批判性思维。
这位牧师被视为社区的精神指引者。

en: The knight raised his shield to block the arrow.
Sunglasses shield your eyes from UV rays.
She acted as a shield between the protesters and the police.
cn: 骑士举起盾牌挡住了箭。
太阳镜能保护眼睛免受紫外线伤害。
她在抗议者和警察之间充当了保护者的角色。

en: She shifted the vase to the left to avoid sunlight.
The night shift workers start at 10 PM.
His tone shifted suddenly when mentioning the incident.
cn: 她把花瓶向左移动以避开阳光。
夜班工人晚上10点开始工作。
提到那件事时，他的语气突然变了。

definitions.definition: 先令（1971年以前的英国货币单位，价值12便士，1/20英镑）
先令（肯尼亚、乌干达、坦桑尼亚等国的现行货币单位）

en: Before decimalization in 1971, there were twenty shillings in a British pound.
The old book was priced at five shillings and sixpence.
The exchange rate for the Kenyan shilling has been relatively stable.
cn: 在1971年十进制改革之前，一英镑等于二十先令。
这本旧书的标价是五先令六便士。
肯尼亚先令的汇率一直相对稳定。

en: The sun shines brightly over the ocean.
She shined her shoes before the interview.
His performance had a brilliant shine.
cn: 阳光在海面上闪耀。
面试前她擦亮了皮鞋。
他的表演充满光彩。

en: The ship sailed across the Atlantic in two weeks.
We need to ship these goods to Japan by Friday.
The spaceship entered orbit successfully.
cn: 这艘船用两周时间横渡了大西洋。
我们需在周五前将这批货物运往日本。
宇宙飞船成功进入轨道。

en: He wore a crisp white shirt to the interview.
This shirt is made of organic cotton.
She rolled up her sleeves to wash the dishes.
cn: 他面试时穿了一件挺括的白衬衫。
这件衬衫由有机棉制成。
她卷起衬衫袖子洗碗。

en: She shivered in the icy wind.
A shiver ran down his spine when he heard the noise.
The leaves shivered in the breeze.
cn: 她在寒风中瑟瑟发抖。
听到那声音，他脊背一阵发凉。
树叶在微风中轻轻颤动。

definitions.definition: 令人震惊的（如 shock news）

en: The news of his death shocked the whole community.
She got an electric shock from the faulty wire.
The earthquake sent a shock through the building.
cn: 他的死讯震惊了整个社区。
她被漏电的电线电到了。
地震使整栋建筑剧烈震动。

en: She tied the laces of her running shoes tightly.
The blacksmith will shoe the horse tomorrow.
These shoes are designed for mountain hiking.
cn: 她系紧了跑鞋的鞋带。
铁匠明天会给这匹马钉蹄铁。
这双鞋专为山地徒步设计。

en: The hunter decided to shoot the arrow at dawn.
She shoots documentary films about endangered species.
New green shoots appeared after the rain.
cn: 猎人决定在黎明时分射箭。
她拍摄关于濒危物种的纪录片。
雨后冒出了新的绿色嫩芽。

en: She runs a small flower shop in the neighborhood.
I need to shop for groceries this afternoon.
The mechanic is working in the repair shop.
cn: 她在附近经营一家小花店。
今天下午我得去采购食品杂货。
机械师正在维修车间工作。

en: The shopkeeper greets every customer with a smile.
A good shopkeeper knows the preferences of regular clients.
The shopkeeper stayed late to restock the shelves.
cn: 店主微笑着迎接每一位顾客。
优秀的店主熟识常客的喜好。
店主熬夜补货上架。

en: She enjoys weekend shopping at the mall.
Online shopping has become increasingly popular.
The shopping bags were filled with groceries.
cn: 她喜欢周末在商场购物。
网购已越来越流行。
购物袋里装满了食品杂货。

definitions.definition: 海岸，海滨（陆地与水域的交界处）
用支柱支撑（如防止坍塌）

en: The children collected shells along the sandy shore.
The workers shored up the tunnel to prevent collapse.
A lighthouse stood at the northern shore of the island.
cn: 孩子们在沙滩海岸上捡贝壳。
工人们用支柱加固隧道以防坍塌。
一座灯塔矗立在岛屿的北岸。

en: She wore a short dress to the party.
The meeting was unexpectedly short.
He is short of money this month.
cn: 她穿了一条短裙参加派对。
会议出乎意料地简短。
他这个月缺钱。

en: The city faces a severe water shortage due to the drought.
A shortage of skilled workers is slowing down the project.
The hospital reported a shortage of medical supplies during the crisis.
cn: 干旱导致该市面临严重的水资源短缺。
技术工人不足拖慢了项目进度。
医院报告称危机期间医疗物资短缺。

en: His inability to listen is a major shortcoming in leadership.
The report highlights the system's technical shortcomings.
She acknowledged her shortcomings and vowed to improve.
cn: 他缺乏倾听能力是领导力的一大缺陷。
报告指出了该系统的技术短板。
她承认了自己的不足并决心改进。

en: She will arrive shortly after the meeting starts.
He explained the rules shortly and clearly.
The document will be published shortly.
cn: 会议开始后不久她就会到达。
他简短清晰地解释了规则。
文件即将发布。

en: He took a shot at the target but missed.
Let me have a shot of whiskey before we go.
Her patience was completely shot after the long meeting.
cn: 他朝目标开了一枪，但未击中。
出发前让我喝一小杯威士忌。
漫长会议后，她的耐心彻底耗尽了。

definitions.definition: 应当（表示义务、建议或预期）
可能（表示推测或逻辑必然性）

en: You should apologize for your mistake.
The package should arrive by tomorrow.
Should you need any help, feel free to ask.
cn: 你应该为你的错误道歉。
包裹明天应该能到。
如需帮助，请随时提出。

en: She rested her head on his shoulder.
He shouldered the responsibility for the project.
The crowd pushed forward, shoulders brushing against each other.
cn: 她将头靠在他的肩上。
他承担了该项目的责任。
人群向前挤，肩膀互相摩擦。

en: She shouted for help when she saw the fire.
The coach shouted instructions from the sidelines.
A sudden shout broke the silence of the night.
cn: 她看到火情时大声呼救。
教练在场边高声指挥。
一声突然的叫喊打破了夜晚的寂静。

en: She will show her paintings at the gallery next month.
The data shows a significant increase in sales.
His calmness under pressure really shows his professionalism.
cn: 她下个月将在画廊展示她的画作。
数据显示销售额显著增长。
他在压力下的冷静充分展现了专业性。

definitions.definition: 淋浴；阵雨；一阵（如礼物、赞美等）

en: She took a quick shower before breakfast.
The weather forecast predicts scattered showers tomorrow.
They showered the hero with gifts and applause.
cn: 她早餐前快速冲了个澡。
天气预报说明天有零星阵雨。
他们向英雄赠送了大量礼物和掌声。

en: She shrieked when she saw the spider.
The shriek of the brakes made everyone turn their heads.
Children shrieked with laughter in the playground.
cn: 她看到蜘蛛时尖叫起来。
刹车的尖啸声让所有人转过头去。
孩子们在操场上笑得尖叫。

en: The wool sweater shrank in the wash.
He shrank back in fear when he saw the snake.
She visits her shrink every Thursday.
cn: 这件羊毛衫洗后缩水了。
他看到蛇时害怕地退缩了。
她每周四去看心理医生。

en: Please shut the window before the storm comes.
The store shuts at 9 PM every day.
Her eyes shut tightly against the bright light.
cn: 暴风雨来临前请关上窗户。
这家商店每晚9点停止营业。
她紧闭双眼以避开强光。

en: She was too shy to speak in front of the crowd.
The horse shied away from the sudden noise.
Don't be shy about asking questions.
cn: 她害羞得不敢在人群前讲话。
马匹因突如其来的声响受惊后退。
提问时不必胆怯。

definitions.definition: （俚语）极好的；酷的（反语或非正式用法）

en: She called in sick because of a high fever.
The roller coaster made him feel sick.
That skateboard flip was totally sick!
cn: 她因高烧请了病假。
过山车让他感到恶心。
那个滑板空翻太酷了！

definitions.definition: 恶心（尤指晕动或怀孕引起的）

en: Her sickness kept her in bed for a week.
Morning sickness is common during pregnancy.
The sudden sickness of the pilot alarmed the passengers.
cn: 她的病让她卧床一周。
晨吐在怀孕期间很常见。
飞行员突然不适，令乘客们惊慌。

en: She sat on the left side of the room.
The government sided with the protesters.
A cube has six equal sides.
cn: 她坐在房间的左侧。
政府支持抗议者一方。
立方体有六个相等的面。

en: The crab moved sideways across the sand.
She gave him a sideways glance, hiding her amusement.
The economic impact was a sideways shift rather than growth.
cn: 螃蟹横向爬过沙滩。
她斜睨了他一眼，掩饰着笑意。
经济影响是横向波动而非增长。

en: She let out a deep sigh of relief.
He sighed and shook his head in disappointment.
The wind sighed through the trees.
cn: 她深深地松了一口气。
他叹了口气，失望地摇了摇头。
风穿过树林，发出叹息般的声响。

en: The sunset over the mountains was a breathtaking sight.
Eagles have exceptional sight, allowing them to spot prey from great distances.
She sighted a rare bird through her binoculars.
cn: 群山上的日落景象令人叹为观止。
鹰拥有卓越的视力，能从远处发现猎物。
她通过双筒望远镜观测到一只稀有鸟类。

en: We spent the afternoon sightseeing in Paris.
Sightseeing buses offer a convenient way to explore the city.
Her favorite part of traveling is sightseeing and taking photos.
cn: 我们在巴黎观光了一下午。
观光巴士为探索城市提供了便捷的方式。
她旅行中最喜欢的部分是观光和拍照。

en: The dark clouds are a sign of rain.
Please sign your name on the dotted line.
She gave me a sign to follow her.
cn: 乌云是下雨的征兆。
请在虚线处签名。
她示意我跟她走。

en: The lighthouse sends a bright signal to guide ships at night.
Her sudden silence was a signal that something was wrong.
The treaty is seen as a signal achievement in diplomatic history.
cn: 灯塔在夜间发出明亮的信号引导船只。
她突然的沉默预示着出了问题。
