该条约被视为外交史上的显著成就。

definitions.definition: 签名；署名（个人书写标记）
特征，标志（独特的表现形式）

en: Please put your signature at the bottom of the contract.
The dish has all the signature flavors of Mediterranean cuisine.
His messy handwriting became his unintentional signature.
cn: 请在合同底部签名。
这道菜具备地中海料理的所有标志性风味。
他潦草的字迹成了他无意间的个人标志。

en: The discovery has great significance for modern science.
The results showed statistical significance at p < 0.05.
She paused, as if waiting for him to grasp the significance of her words.
cn: 这一发现对现代科学具有重大意义。
结果显示统计学显著性（p值<0.05）。
她停顿了一下，仿佛在等他领会她话语的分量。

en: The discovery of penicillin was a significant breakthrough in medicine.
There is a significant difference between the two experimental results.
She made significant contributions to the project.
cn: 青霉素的发现是医学领域的重大突破。
两组实验结果存在显著差异。
她为该项目作出了相当大的贡献。

definitions.definition: 使安静；压制（声音或意见）

en: The silence of the forest was broken only by the rustling of leaves.
She chose to silence her critics with outstanding performance.
There was an awkward silence after his controversial remark.
cn: 森林的寂静只被树叶的沙沙声打破。
她用出色的表现让批评者哑口无言。
他发表争议言论后，现场陷入尴尬的沉默。

en: The forest was completely silent at dawn.
She remained silent during the entire meeting.
The silent film era revolutionized visual storytelling.
cn: 黎明时分的森林一片寂静。
她在整个会议期间保持沉默。
默片时代革新了视觉叙事方式。

en: The dress is made of pure silk.
She has a collection of silk scarves from different countries.
The silkworms spin cocoons to produce silk.
cn: 这条裙子是用纯丝绸制成的。
她收藏了来自不同国家的丝巾。
蚕吐丝结茧以制造丝绸。

en: Don't be silly—that's not a real spider!
The silly puppy chased its own tail for hours.
cn: 别犯傻了，那不是真蜘蛛！
那只傻小狗追着自己的尾巴转了好几个小时。

definitions.definition: 银（金属元素）；银器；银币；银色

en: The necklace is made of pure silver.
Her hair turned silver with age.
Ancient civilizations used silver for trade.
cn: 这条项链由纯银制成。
她的头发随着年岁渐长变成了银白色。
古代文明曾用银作为交易货币。

en: The two paintings are strikingly similar in style.
Her opinion is similar to mine on this issue.
The experiment yielded results similar to previous studies.
cn: 这两幅画的风格惊人地相似。
在这个问题上，她的观点与我的类似。
实验得出的结果与先前研究相似。

en: The twins dress similarly, often confusing their teachers.
The two experiments were conducted similarly to ensure fair comparison.
Similarly, all participants must follow the same rules.
cn: 这对双胞胎穿得很像，经常让老师认错。
两项实验以相似的方式进行，以确保公平对比。
同样地，所有参与者必须遵守相同规则。

en: The instructions were written in simple language.
She wore a simple white dress to the party.
His simple approach solved the complex problem.
cn: 说明书用简单的语言写成。
她穿了一条朴素的白裙参加聚会。
他单纯的方法解决了这个复杂问题。

en: The beauty of the design lies in its simplicity.
She lived a life of simplicity and contentment.
The instructions were written with clarity and simplicity.
cn: 设计的魅力在于其简洁性。
她过着朴素而满足的生活。
说明书写得清晰简明。

en: The manual aims to simplify the installation process.
Teachers often use diagrams to simplify complex theories.
The new software simplifies data analysis for beginners.
cn: 这份手册旨在简化安装流程。
教师常用图表来简化复杂理论。
这款新软件为初学者简化了数据分析。

en: She dressed simply for the occasion.
The instructions are simply written for beginners.
It's not simply a matter of time, but of effort.
cn: 她为这场合穿得很朴素。
这些说明是为初学者简单编写的。
这不仅仅是时间问题，更是努力问题。

en: Pride is considered the deadliest of the seven sins.
He repented for having sinned against his own conscience.
The preacher warned against the sin of greed.
cn: 傲慢被视为七宗罪中最严重的一项。
他为违背自己的良知而忏悔。
传教士告诫人们警惕贪婪之罪。

en: She has lived here since 2010.
Since you're busy, I'll help you.
He left and hasn't returned since.
cn: 她自2010年起居住于此。
既然你忙，我来帮你。
他离开后至今未归。

en: She gave a sincere apology for her mistake.
His sincere smile made everyone feel welcome.
The letter expressed her sincere gratitude.
cn: 她为自己的错误真诚道歉。
他真挚的笑容让每个人都感到宾至如归。
这封信表达了她由衷的感激。

en: She loves to sing in the shower.
The birds began to sing at dawn.
He sang a lullaby to the baby.
cn: 她喜欢在淋浴时唱歌。
鸟儿们在黎明时分开始鸣叫。
他给宝宝唱了一首摇篮曲。

en: She is a famous jazz singer.
The singer performed a new song at the concert.
As a child, he dreamed of becoming a professional singer.
cn: 她是一位著名的爵士歌手。
歌手在音乐会上演唱了一首新歌。
童年时，他梦想成为职业歌手。

en: She booked a single room for her trip.
He remained single all his life.
The band released their new single last week.
cn: 她为旅行预订了一间单人房。
他终生未婚。
乐队上周发布了新单曲。

en: The word "child" becomes "children" in the plural, but remains "child" in the singular.
Her singular focus on the project led to its success.
The artist’s singular style made her work instantly recognizable.
cn: 单词“child”的复数形式是“children”，但单数形式仍为“child”。
她对项目的专注是其成功的关键。
这位艺术家独特的风格使她的作品一目了然。

en: The ship began to sink rapidly after hitting the iceberg.
She washed the vegetables in the stainless steel sink.
His spirits sank when he heard the bad news.
cn: 船只撞击冰山后开始迅速下沉。
她在不锈钢水槽里清洗蔬菜。
听到坏消息时，他的情绪低落下来。

definitions.definition: 先生（对男性的尊称，尤用于正式场合或称呼上级）
爵士（英国授予男性的荣誉头衔，用于姓名前）

en: Excuse me, sir, your table is ready.
Sir David Attenborough is a famous naturalist.
"Yes, sir!" the soldier replied promptly.
cn: 先生，您的餐桌已准备好。
大卫·爱登堡爵士是著名的博物学家。
“是，长官！”士兵迅速回应。

definitions.definition: 姐妹；修女；女性同事或朋友（亲密称呼）

en: My sister teaches biology at a university.
The nuns refer to each other as "sister".
We've been through tough times together, like true sisters.
cn: 我的姐姐在大学教生物。
修女们彼此以“姐妹”相称。
我们像亲姐妹一样共度难关。

en: Please sit on the chair.
The cat likes to sit by the window.
She sat the toddler on the high chair.
cn: 请坐在椅子上。
这只猫喜欢坐在窗边。
她让幼儿坐在高脚椅上。

en: The construction site was bustling with workers.
They chose to site the new school near the park.
This app helps you find the best camping sites.
cn: 建筑工地上工人们忙碌不停。
他们决定将新学校选址在公园附近。
这款应用能帮你找到最佳露营地点。

en: The current economic situation requires careful analysis.
The hotel’s situation by the lake makes it very popular.
She handled the awkward situation with grace.
cn: 当前经济形势需要仔细分析。
酒店位于湖畔的位置使其备受欢迎。
她优雅地处理了尴尬的局面。

en: She has six cats in her apartment.
The meeting starts at six o'clock sharp.
Roll the dice and hope for a six.
cn: 她的公寓里有六只猫。
会议将在六点整开始。
掷骰子，希望能掷出六点。

en: She celebrated her sixteenth birthday with a trip to Paris.
The recipe requires sixteen ounces of flour.
Sixteen students volunteered for the science project.
cn: 她以一场巴黎之旅庆祝自己的十六岁生日。
这份食谱需要十六盎司面粉。
十六名学生自愿参与该科学项目。

en: She finished in sixth place in the race.
Cut the cake into sixths so everyone gets an equal share.
The sixth chapter of the book discusses climate change.
cn: 她在比赛中获得了第六名。
将蛋糕切成六分之一，每人分得均等的一份。
书的第六章讨论了气候变化。

en: She celebrated her sixty birthday with a trip to Paris.
The temperature reached sixty degrees Celsius in the desert.
Sixty students participated in the science competition.
cn: 她以巴黎之旅庆祝六十岁生日。
沙漠中的温度达到了六十摄氏度。
六十名学生参加了科学竞赛。

en: The size of the room makes it perfect for meetings.
She sized the apples before packing them.
We need to size up the competition before launching the product.
cn: 这个房间的大小非常适合开会。
她在包装前按大小分拣了苹果。
在产品发布前，我们需要评估竞争对手的规模。

definitions.definition: 滑冰鞋；冰鞋；鳐鱼（一种扁平鱼类）

en: She gracefully glided across the ice on her new skates.
The biologist studied a rare species of skate in the deep ocean.
We used to skate on the frozen pond every winter.
cn: 她穿着新冰鞋优雅地滑过冰面。
生物学家研究了一种深海中罕见的鳐鱼。
我们过去每年冬天都在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

en: She made a quick sketch of the landscape.
The author sketched the plot in just two pages.
His speech was more of a sketch than a detailed plan.
cn: 她快速画了一幅风景草图。
作者用两页纸概述了剧情。
他的演讲更像提纲而非详细计划。

en: She bought a new pair of skis for her trip to the Alps.
We skied down the mountain at sunrise.
Skiing requires balance and coordination.
cn: 她为去阿尔卑斯山旅行买了一副新滑雪板。
我们在日出时滑雪下山。
滑雪需要平衡感和协调性。

en: She plays the piano with remarkable skill.
Learning a new language requires time and skill.
His negotiation skills helped close the deal.
cn: 她以非凡的技巧弹奏钢琴。
学习一门新语言需要时间和技巧。
他的谈判技巧促成了这笔交易。

definitions.definition: 需要技能的（如 skilled work）

en: She is highly skilled in graphic design.
The job requires skilled labor.
He became skilled at solving complex problems.
cn: 她精通平面设计。
这份工作需要熟练工人。
他变得擅长解决复杂问题。

en: She is a skillful surgeon with years of experience.
The artisan crafted a skillful replica of the ancient vase.
His skillful negotiation saved the company millions.
cn: 她是一位经验丰富、技术娴熟的外科医生。
工匠制作了一个工艺精湛的古花瓶复制品。
他娴熟的谈判技巧为公司节省了数百万。

definitions.definition: 撇去（液体表面的浮物）；快速浏览

en: She skimmed the cream off the milk.
He skimmed through the report before the meeting.
The swallows skimmed over the lake.
cn: 她撇去了牛奶表面的奶油。
他在会议前快速浏览了报告。
燕子掠过湖面。

en: She has sensitive skin that burns easily in the sun.
Hunters used to skin animals for fur and leather.
The banana skin is slippery when stepped on.
cn: 她的皮肤敏感，容易被晒伤。
猎人过去常剥取动物的毛皮和皮革。
香蕉皮被踩到时很滑。

en: She wore a red skirt to the party.
The road skirts the edge of the forest.
His answer skillfully skirted the controversial issue.
cn: 她穿了一条红裙子去参加派对。
这条路沿着森林边缘延伸。
他的回答巧妙地避开了争议性问题。

definitions.definition: 天空（地球大气层外的空间）
天气或气候（如 "a clear sky"）

en: The stars twinkled in the night sky.
Pilots rely on clear skies for safe flights.
She painted the sky with shades of pink at sunset.
cn: 夜空中繁星闪烁。
飞行员依赖晴朗的天气保障飞行安全。
她用粉色调描绘了日落的天空。

en: He slammed the door in anger.
The book hit the floor with a loud slam.
The politician was slammed by the media for his remarks.
cn: 他愤怒地摔上门。
书砰的一声重重摔在地上。
这位政客因言论遭到媒体猛烈抨击。

en: The ancient Romans relied heavily on slave labor.
She felt like a slave to her demanding job.
He slaved away for years to pay off his debts.
cn: 古罗马人极度依赖奴隶劳动。
她觉得自己像被繁重工作奴役的人。
他拼命工作多年以偿还债务。

definitions.definition: 受支配或束缚的状态（比喻义）

en: The abolition of slavery marked a turning point in human rights history.
Many people still struggle with the slavery of addiction.
Ancient Rome’s economy heavily relied on slavery.
cn: 废除奴隶制是人权历史上的转折点。
许多人仍在与成瘾的奴役作斗争。
古罗马的经济严重依赖奴隶制度。

en: She needs eight hours of sleep to function well.
The device automatically sleeps after 10 minutes of inactivity.
The valley slept under a blanket of snow.
cn: 她需要八小时睡眠才能保持良好状态。
该设备闲置10分钟后会自动休眠。
山谷在雪毯覆盖下静谧沉睡。

definitions.definition: （地方或活动）使人昏昏欲睡的

en: The warm room made me feel sleepy.
She rubbed her sleepy eyes and yawned.
It's a sleepy little town with nothing much to do.
cn: 温暖的房间让我昏昏欲睡。
她揉了揉惺忪的睡眼，打了个哈欠。
这是个沉闷的小镇，没什么可做的。

en: She rolled up her sleeves before washing the dishes.
The record was hidden inside the album sleeve.
The cable passes through a protective plastic sleeve.
cn: 她洗碗前卷起了袖子。
唱片藏在专辑封套里。
电缆穿过一个保护性塑料套筒。

definitions.definition: 纤细的，苗条的（形容身材或物体）
微薄的，不足的（形容数量或可能性）

en: She has a slender figure that looks elegant in any dress.
The evidence supporting his theory is slender at best.
A slender ray of sunlight slipped through the curtains.
cn: 她身材纤细，穿任何裙子都显得优雅。
支持他理论的证据充其量是薄弱的。
一缕细弱的阳光透过窗帘照进来。

en: She cut a thin slice of bread for the sandwich.
The pizza was divided into eight equal slices.
He sliced the apple with a sharp knife.
cn: 她为三明治切了一片薄面包。
披萨被均分成八块。
他用锋利的刀把苹果切成片。

en: The children love to slide down the snowy hill.
She slid the document across the table silently.
The professor showed a slide of ancient artifacts.
cn: 孩子们喜欢从雪坡上滑下来。
她悄悄把文件滑过桌面。
教授展示了一张古代文物的幻灯片。

definitions.definition: 轻微的；纤细的；不重要的

en: She felt a slight breeze on her face.
He slighted her by ignoring her question.
The difference between the two versions is very slight.
cn: 她感到脸上有一丝微风。
他无视她的问题，以示轻蔑。
两个版本之间的差异微乎其微。

definitions.definition: 纤细地；苗条地（古义，现较少用）

en: The temperature dropped slightly in the evening.
She smiled slightly at the compliment.
The table wobbles slightly because one leg is shorter.
cn: 傍晚气温略微下降。
她对赞美报以浅浅一笑。
桌子因一条腿稍短而轻微晃动。

en: She slipped on the icy pavement and fell.
Don’t let the opportunity slip through your fingers.
He wrote his phone number on a slip of paper.
cn: 她在结冰的路面上滑倒了。
别让机会从指间溜走。
他把电话号码写在一张纸条上。

en: She padded across the room in her fluffy slippers.
The hotel provides complimentary slippers for guests.
cn: 她穿着毛绒拖鞋轻轻走过房间。
酒店为客人提供免费拖鞋。

en: The floor was slippery after the rain.
He gave a slippery answer to avoid responsibility.
Be careful—the rocks near the river are slippery.
cn: 雨后地板很滑。
他给出一个狡猾的回答以逃避责任。
小心，河边的岩石很滑。

en: She carefully slit the envelope with a knife.
A narrow slit in the wall allowed light to enter.
The tailor slit the fabric to adjust the length.
cn: 她用刀小心地裁开信封。
墙上的狭缝透进一丝光亮。
裁缝剪开布料以调整长度。

en: The protesters chanted slogans demanding justice.
"Just Do It" is one of the most famous advertising slogans.
The campaign slogan resonated with young voters.
cn: 抗议者高呼要求正义的口号。
“Just Do It”是最著名的广告标语之一。
这场竞选口号引起了年轻选民的共鸣。

en: The skiers raced down the steep slope.
The roof slopes at a 30-degree angle.
Her handwriting slopes slightly to the right.
cn: 滑雪者们沿着陡坡疾驰而下。
屋顶以30度角倾斜。
她的笔迹微微向右倾斜。

en: The tortoise is a slow but steady creature.
Heavy traffic slowed our progress.
The engine slows as it overheats.
cn: 乌龟是一种缓慢但稳健的生物。
拥堵的交通拖慢了我们的进度。
引擎因过热而减速。

en: She walked slowly down the path, enjoying the autumn leaves.
The old computer processes data slowly.
He spoke slowly to make sure everyone understood.
cn: 她沿着小路慢慢走着，欣赏秋叶。
这台旧电脑处理数据很慢。
他语速缓慢，以确保所有人都能听懂。

definitions.definition: 贫民窟（指城市中拥挤、破败的贫困区域）
访问或探访贫民窟（旧用法）

en: The documentary exposed the harsh living conditions in the urban slum.
Victorian writers often slummed to gather material for their novels.
Efforts to renovate the slum faced resistance from local residents.
cn: 这部纪录片揭露了城市贫民窟的恶劣生活条件。
维多利亚时代的作家常探访贫民窟为小说搜集素材。
贫民窟改造计划遭到了当地居民的抵制。

en: The sly fox outwitted the hunters again.
She gave me a sly wink across the room.
His sly humor always lightens the mood.
cn: 狡猾的狐狸再次智胜了猎人。
她在房间那头对我俏皮地眨了眨眼。
他狡黠的幽默总能让气氛轻松起来。

en: She lives in a small village near the mountains.
The difference between the two methods is small but significant.
He made a small mistake in the calculation.
cn: 她住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
这两种方法的差异很小但很重要。
他在计算中犯了一个小错误。

en: She gave a smart answer to the tricky question.
He always wears smart suits to business meetings.
My eyes smarted from the smoke.
cn: 她对刁钻问题给出了机智的回答。
他总穿着时髦的西装参加商务会议。
烟雾熏得我眼睛刺痛。

en: The smell of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
Dogs can smell fear in humans.
Something smells fishy about this deal.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个厨房。
狗能嗅出人类的恐惧。
这笔交易有点可疑（直译：闻起来有鱼腥味）。

en: She gave me a warm smile when I entered the room.
Babies often smile in their sleep.
His smile faded as he read the bad news.
cn: 我走进房间时，她对我报以温暖的微笑。
婴儿常在睡梦中微笑。
读到坏消息时，他的笑容消失了。

definitions.definition: 烟雾（由烟和雾混合而成的空气污染物）

en: The heavy smog made it difficult to see beyond a few meters.
Air quality alerts are issued when smog levels rise dangerously.
Many cities have implemented measures to reduce smog.
cn: 浓重的烟雾使人难以看清几米外的景物。
当烟雾浓度危险升高时，会发布空气质量警报。
许多城市已采取措施减少烟雾污染。

en: The chimney emitted thick black smoke.
He prefers to smoke cigars after dinner.
The fish was smoked over oak wood for flavor.
cn: 烟囱冒出浓密的黑烟。
他喜欢晚餐后抽雪茄。
鱼用橡木熏制以增添风味。

definitions.definition: 使光滑；消除（困难或问题）

en: The marble table feels incredibly smooth.
She smoothed her dress before the interview.
His smooth talking convinced the investors.
cn: 这张大理石桌子摸起来异常光滑。
面试前她抚平了裙子。
他流畅的谈吐说服了投资者。

en: The car moved smoothly along the highway.
She transitioned smoothly between different topics in her speech.
The project progressed smoothly thanks to good teamwork.
cn: 汽车在高速公路上平稳行驶。
她在演讲中流畅地切换不同话题。
由于团队合作良好，项目进展顺利。

en: The snake slithered through the grass.
He snaked his way through the crowded room.
Don't trust him—he's a snake in the grass.
cn: 蛇在草丛中蜿蜒滑行。
他在拥挤的房间里迂回穿行。
别相信他，他是个暗藏的阴险之徒。

definitions.definition: 用雪覆盖；用花言巧语欺骗（非正式用法）

en: The children built a fort out of snow.
It rarely snows in this coastal city.
He tried to snow his boss with excuses.
cn: 孩子们用雪搭了一座堡垒。
这座沿海城市很少下雪。
他试图用借口糊弄老板。

definitions.definition: 暴风雪（强降雪伴随强风的天气现象）

en: The mountain pass was closed due to a severe snowstorm.
She got stranded in the snowstorm on her way home.
Weather forecasts warn of an approaching snowstorm this weekend.
cn: 山口因严重暴风雪关闭。
她在回家途中遭遇暴风雪被困。
天气预报警告本周末将有暴风雪来袭。

en: The children played happily in the snowy garden.
Her dress was a snowy white, matching the winter landscape.
We drove through the snowy countryside at dawn.
cn: 孩子们在积雪的花园里快乐地玩耍。
她的裙子如雪般洁白，与冬日景色相映。
黎明时分，我们驾车穿过白雪皑皑的乡野。

definitions.definition: 如此，这么（表示程度或方式）
因此，所以（表示结果或目的）
真实的（古旧用法，现罕见）

en: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
"Is that really so?" the old man asked quietly.
cn: 这个箱子太重了，我抬不起来。
她努力学习，因此通过了考试。
"真是如此吗？"老人轻声问道。

en: Soak the beans overnight before cooking.
The rain soaked through his jacket.
A long soak in the bath helps me relax.
cn: 烹饪前将豆子浸泡一夜。
雨水浸透了他的夹克。
长时间泡澡有助于我放松。

en: She washed her hands with lavender-scented soap.
The actor got his start in daytime soaps.
He soaped the car thoroughly before rinsing.
cn: 她用薰衣草香皂洗手。
这位演员从日间肥皂剧起步。
他给车全身打满肥皂后再冲洗。

en: She couldn't speak and could only sob quietly.
A sob escaped his throat when he heard the news.
The child's soft sobs broke my heart.
cn: 她无法说话，只能轻声啜泣。
听到消息时，他喉咙里漏出一声呜咽。
孩子轻轻的抽泣声让我心碎。

en: He stayed sober despite the party's temptations.
Her sober analysis of the crisis impressed everyone.
The bad news sobered him instantly.
cn: 他在聚会上抵住诱惑，保持清醒。
她对危机的冷静分析令众人印象深刻。
这个坏消息立刻让他清醒过来。

definitions.definition: 所谓的（常含怀疑或讽刺意味）

en: The so-called expert knew nothing about the topic.
They live in a so-called "eco-friendly" house.
His so-called apology was just an excuse.
cn: 这位所谓的专家对此话题一无所知。
他们住在一栋所谓的“环保”房子里。
他所谓的道歉只是个借口。

definitions.definition: 足球（英式足球，区别于美式橄榄球）

en: He plays soccer every weekend.
The soccer match ended in a draw.
Soccer is the most popular sport in the world.
cn: 他每周末踢足球。
足球比赛以平局收场。
足球是全球最受欢迎的运动。

en: She has a busy social life.
Bees are highly social insects.
The company organized a social for new employees.
cn: 她的社交生活很繁忙。
蜜蜂是高度群居的昆虫。
公司为新员工举办了一场社交聚会。

definitions.definition: 社会主义（以生产资料公有制和平等分配为核心的政治经济体系）

en: Socialism emphasizes collective ownership of resources.
Many European countries incorporate elements of socialism into their welfare systems.
The debate between capitalism and socialism continues to evolve.
cn: 社会主义强调资源的集体所有制。
许多欧洲国家将社会主义元素融入福利体系。
资本主义与社会主义的争论持续发展。

definitions.definition: 社会主义者；社会党党员

en: She has been a committed socialist all her life.
The party promotes socialist policies to reduce inequality.
His socialist views often clash with free-market advocates.
cn: 她一生都是一位坚定的社会主义者。
该政党推行社会主义政策以减少不平等。
他的社会主义观点常与自由市场支持者冲突。

definitions.definition: 社会（广义的人类群体及其组织）
社团、协会（特定目的的群体）
上流社会（特定社会阶层）

en: Technology has transformed modern society.
She joined the local horticultural society.
Victorian society valued strict social codes.
cn: 科技改变了现代社会。
她加入了当地的园艺协会。
维多利亚时代的上流社会重视严格的社交准则。

en: She wore mismatched socks to school.
He socked the bully in the jaw.
The dryer ate one of my favorite socks.
cn: 她穿着不成对的袜子去上学。
他狠狠一拳打在霸凌者的下巴上。
烘干机“吃掉”了我一只最喜欢的袜子。

en: She added a pinch of soda to the dough to make it rise.
I prefer sparkling soda over plain water.
The lab uses soda ash in glass production.
cn: 她在面团里加了一撮苏打粉使其发酵。
比起普通水，我更喜欢有气泡的苏打水。
实验室在玻璃制造中使用纯碱。

en: The kitten's fur was incredibly soft.
She spoke in a soft voice to avoid waking the baby.
The company has a soft policy on remote work.
cn: 小猫的毛发异常柔软。
她用轻柔的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
公司对远程工作采取宽松政策。

en: She spoke softly to avoid waking the baby.
The petals fell softly onto the grass.
He closed the door softly behind him.
cn: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
花瓣轻轻飘落在草地上。
他轻轻关上了身后的门。

en: The fertile soil yielded a bountiful harvest.
Don't soil your hands with grease.
White clothes soil easily.
cn: 肥沃的土壤带来了丰收。
别让油污弄脏你的手。
白色衣物容易脏。

en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
The solar system consists of eight planets.
Ancient cultures worshipped solar deities.
cn: 太阳能板将阳光转化为电能。
太阳系由八大行星组成。
古代文化崇拜太阳神。

definitions.definition: 当兵；坚持从事（非正式用法）

en: The soldier stood guard at the gate.
She decided to soldier on despite the difficulties.
Medieval soldiers were often paid in silver coins.
cn: 士兵在大门前站岗。
尽管困难重重，她决定坚持下去。
中世纪的士兵常以银币支付军饷。

en: She is the sole survivor of the accident.
The leather sole of his shoe wore out after months of hiking.
The cobbler will sole these boots with rubber for better grip.
cn: 她是事故的唯一幸存者。
徒步数月后，他鞋子的皮革鞋底磨破了。
鞋匠将为这双靴子换上橡胶鞋底以增强防滑性。

en: The decision was based solely on financial considerations.
She is solely responsible for the project's success.
This feature is available solely to premium members.
cn: 这一决定完全基于财务考量。
项目的成功完全归功于她。
此功能仅限高级会员使用。

en: The judge entered the courtroom with a solemn expression.
They exchanged solemn vows at the wedding.
The memorial service was a solemn occasion.
cn: 法官神情严肃地走进法庭。
他们在婚礼上交换了庄严的誓言。
这场纪念仪式氛围庄重。

en: Ice is water in its solid state.
She provided solid arguments to support her theory.
The architect designed a building with clean, solid lines.
cn: 冰是水的固态形式。
她提出了坚实的论据来支持自己的理论。
建筑师设计了一座轮廓简洁而稳固的建筑。

en: Sugar is soluble in water.
The conflict proved to be soluble through diplomacy.
This chemical compound is only soluble under high pressure.
cn: 糖可溶于水。
这场冲突可通过外交手段解决。
这种化合物仅在高压下可溶解。

en: The solution to this math problem requires creative thinking.
Salt forms a clear solution in water.
Both parties are working toward a peaceful solution.
cn: 这道数学题的解答需要创造性思维。
盐在水中形成透明的溶液。
双方正在寻求和平解决方案。

en: Scientists are working hard to solve the climate crisis.
Can you solve this riddle in 30 seconds?
The software helps solve complex equations automatically.
cn: 科学家们正努力解决气候危机。
你能在30秒内解开这个谜语吗？
该软件可自动求解复杂方程。

en: Would you like some coffee?
Some people prefer tea over coffee.
The event lasted some three hours.
cn: 要喝点咖啡吗？
有些人更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
活动持续了大约三小时。

en: Somebody left their umbrella in the office.
She wants to be somebody in the fashion industry.
If you don’t speak up, nobody will know you’re somebody.
cn: 有人把伞忘在办公室了。
她想成为时尚界的风云人物。
若不发声，无人知晓你的价值。

definitions.definition: 以某种方式；不知怎么地

en: She somehow managed to finish the project alone.
The keys were somehow lost during the trip.
Somehow, I always forget his birthday.
cn: 她不知怎么独自完成了项目。
钥匙在旅途中莫名其妙地丢了。
不知为何，我总忘记他的生日。

definitions.definition: 某人，有人（指不确定或未具体说明的人）

en: Someone left their umbrella in the office.
Can someone help me with this heavy box?
I heard someone knocking at the door.
cn: 有人把伞忘在办公室了。
谁能帮我搬这个重箱子？
我听到有人在敲门。

definitions.definition: 稍微，大约（用于修饰形容词或副词，如 "something like"）

en: She said something important before leaving.
The cake tastes something like vanilla.
He’s something of a genius in physics.
cn: 她离开前说了些重要的事。
这蛋糕尝起来有点像香草味。
他在物理方面可算是个天才。

definitions.definition: 在某个时候；将来某个时候

en: Let's meet up sometime next week.
She was a sometime collaborator on the project.
Sometime I wonder if I made the right choice.
cn: 我们下周找个时间见面吧。
她曾是该项目的临时合作者。
有时我会怀疑自己是否做了正确的选择。

en: She sometimes takes the bus to work.
Sometimes it's better to stay silent.
The wifi connection is unstable sometimes.
cn: 她有时乘公交上班。
偶尔沉默是更好的选择。
无线网络有时不稳定。

en: The results were somewhat disappointing.
She felt somewhat relieved after the talk.
Somewhat of the mystery remains unsolved.
cn: 结果有点令人失望。
谈话后她感到稍微轻松了些。
这个谜题仍有某些部分未解开。

en: She left her keys somewhere in the house.
We need to find somewhere to stay tonight.
Happiness is somewhere between reality and expectation.
cn: 她把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
我们需要找个地方过夜。
幸福存在于现实与期望之间的某处。

en: His eldest son will inherit the family business.
The scientist worked alongside his son on the research project.
Many folk tales feature a hero who must prove himself worthy to his father's son.
cn: 他的长子将继承家族企业。
这位科学家与儿子共同参与了该研究项目。
许多民间故事的主人公都需要向父亲的儿子（即自己）证明价值。

en: She wrote a beautiful song for her mother.
The morning song of birds woke me up gently.
This folk song has been passed down for generations.
cn: 她为母亲创作了一首动人的歌曲。
清晨的鸟鸣轻轻唤醒了我。
这首民谣已传承了数代人。

en: The meeting will begin soon.
She arrived sooner than expected.
Call me as soon as you finish.
cn: 会议即将开始。
她比预期到得更早。
你一完成就立刻联系我。

definitions.definition: 复杂的；精密的（指技术、系统等）
老练的；见多识广的（指人）

en: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to analyze DNA.
She has a sophisticated taste in art.
His argument was too sophisticated for the audience to follow.
cn: 实验室使用精密设备分析DNA。
她对艺术有着老练的鉴赏力。
他的论点过于复杂，听众难以理解。

en: My legs are sore after the marathon.
She had a sore on her lip from the cold weather.
His harsh words left a sore spot in her heart.
cn: 马拉松后我的腿酸痛不已。
寒冷天气让她嘴唇长了冻疮。
他刻薄的话语在她心中留下了伤痛。

en: Her eyes were full of sorrow after the farewell.
The old man sorrowed silently for his lost youth.
Shared sorrow is half sorrow.
cn: 告别后，她眼中满是哀伤。
老人为逝去的青春默默哀叹。
分担悲伤，痛苦减半。

definitions.definition: 可怜的，糟糕的（非正式用法）

en: She felt deeply sorry for her mistake.
The weather was so sorry that we canceled the picnic.
He gave a sorry excuse for being late.
cn: 她对自己的错误深感抱歉。
天气太糟糕了，我们取消了野餐。
他为迟到找了个蹩脚的借口。

en: This sort of behavior is unacceptable.
She sorted the books by genre.
What sort of music do you like?
cn: 这种行为是不可接受的。
她按体裁将书籍分类。
你喜欢哪种音乐？

definitions.definition: （某种特质的）化身，典范（如：the soul of honesty）

en: She believed her soul would live on after death.
His music has a depth that touches the soul.
He was the soul of discretion in handling the sensitive matter.
cn: 她相信自己的灵魂死后仍会存在。
他的音乐有一种触及灵魂的深度。
他在处理这一敏感问题时堪称谨慎的典范。

en: The sound of rain on the roof is soothing.
Her argument was logically sound.
The captain ordered to sound the seabed.
cn: 雨打屋顶的声音令人放松。
她的论点逻辑严谨。
船长下令测量海底深度。

definitions.definition: 汤（液体食物，通常由肉类、蔬菜等煮制而成）

en: She made a delicious chicken soup for dinner.
On cold days, nothing beats a hot bowl of soup.
The chef specializes in traditional Japanese miso soup.
cn: 她为晚餐做了一碗美味的鸡汤。
寒冷的日子里，没有什么比一碗热汤更治愈了。
这位厨师擅长制作传统的日式味噌汤。

en: The milk turned sour after being left out overnight.
She gave him a sour look when he interrupted her.
The economic situation has soured relations between the two countries.
cn: 牛奶放置一夜后变酸了。
他打断她时，她投来一个不悦的眼神。
经济状况恶化了两国关系。

definitions.definition: 来源；源头（事物或信息的起始点）
水源；发源地（自然资源的起始处）
从特定来源获取（如数据、材料）

en: The river's source is a glacier in the mountains.
Always verify the source of your news before sharing it.
The company sources materials from sustainable farms.
cn: 这条河的源头是山中的冰川。
分享新闻前务必核实其来源。
该公司从可持续农场采购原料。

en: The birds migrate south for the winter.
She lives in the south of France.
The wind is blowing from the south.
cn: 鸟类冬季向南方迁徙。
她住在法国南部。
风从南方吹来。

en: The storm is moving toward the southeast.
She lives in the southeast corner of the city.
A warm southeast wind brought rain yesterday.
cn: 风暴正向东南方向移动。
她住在城市的东南角。
昨天温暖的东南风带来了降雨。

en: The southern region of the country is known for its warm climate.
A southern breeze brought relief from the summer heat.
She has a distinct southern accent.
cn: 该国南部地区以温暖的气候闻名。
南风为炎热的夏日带来了清凉。
她带有明显的南方口音。

en: The wind is blowing from the southwest today.
They traveled through the arid landscapes of the southwest.
The southwest corner of the map shows a mountain range.
cn: 今天的风从西南方向吹来。
他们穿越了西南部的干旱地貌。
地图的西南角显示了一片山脉。

definitions.definition: 苏维埃（苏联时期的政治组织或代表会议）

en: The local soviet voted to approve the new policy.
Soviet technology made significant advances during the Space Race.
The word "soviet" originally meant a council of workers and peasants.
cn: 当地苏维埃投票通过了新政策。
苏联技术在太空竞赛期间取得重大进展。
“苏维埃”一词最初指工农代表会议。

en: Farmers sow wheat seeds in autumn.
The sow nursed her piglets in the pen.
He tried to sow discord among the team members.
cn: 农民在秋季播种小麦。
母猪在圈里哺育小猪。
他试图在团队成员间散布不和。

en: The rocket launched into outer space.
Leave some space between the paragraphs.
She spaced the plants two meters apart.
cn: 火箭发射进入外太空。
在段落之间留些空白。
她将植物间隔两米栽种。

definitions.definition: 航天器（用于太空探索的载人或无人飞行器）

en: The spacecraft entered Mars' orbit after a seven-month journey.
NASA's Voyager 1 is the farthest human-made spacecraft from Earth.
Modern spacecraft are equipped with advanced solar panels.
cn: 这艘航天器经过七个月飞行后进入火星轨道。
美国宇航局的“旅行者1号”是距离地球最远的人造航天器。
现代航天器配备先进的太阳能电池板。

en: The spaceship orbited Mars for six months.
Children built a model spaceship from cardboard.
Scientists are designing a faster spaceship for deep-space exploration.
cn: 这艘宇宙飞船绕火星运行了六个月。
孩子们用纸板制作了一个宇宙飞船模型。
科学家正在设计更快的航天器以探索深空。

en: He dug a deep hole with a spade.
The ace of spades is often considered the highest card.
She planted the seedlings using a small garden spade.
cn: 他用铲子挖了个深坑。
黑桃A通常被视为最大的牌。
她用一把小园艺铲栽种幼苗。

en: The bridge spans the river with a single arch.
Her career spanned three decades.
The eagle's wingspan measured over two meters.
cn: 这座桥以单拱结构横跨河流。
她的职业生涯跨越了三十年。
这只鹰的翼展超过两米。

definitions.definition: 西班牙的；西班牙人的；西班牙语的
西班牙语；西班牙人（集体称）

en: She is fluent in Spanish and often travels to Madrid.
Spanish cuisine is famous for its tapas and paella.
The Spanish team won the championship last year.
cn: 她西班牙语流利，常去马德里旅行。
西班牙美食以塔帕斯和海鲜饭闻名。
西班牙队去年赢得了冠军。

en: Could you spare a few minutes to help me?
He keeps a spare key in his wallet.
The judge decided to spare the prisoner’s life.
cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
他在钱包里放了一把备用钥匙。
法官决定饶恕这名囚犯的性命。

definitions.definition: 发出火花；引发（情感或事件）

en: A spark from the campfire ignited the dry leaves.
Her speech sparked a wave of protests across the country.
There's a creative spark in his latest painting.
cn: 篝火迸出的火星点燃了枯叶。
她的演讲在全国引发抗议浪潮。
他最新的画作中有一丝灵动的火花。

en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement.
The diamond sparkled under the spotlight.
He always adds sparkle to our meetings with his humor.
cn: 她的双眼因兴奋而闪闪发亮。
钻石在聚光灯下熠熠生辉。
他的幽默总为我们的会议注入活力。

en: A sparrow built its nest under our roof.
Sparrows are common in urban areas.
The child fed crumbs to the sparrows in the park.
cn: 一只麻雀在我们的屋檐下筑巢。
麻雀在城市地区很常见。
孩子在公园里给麻雀喂面包屑。

en: She speaks three languages fluently.
The baby is learning to speak.
He didn’t speak during the entire meeting.
cn: 她能流利地说三种语言。
这个婴儿正在学说话。
整个会议期间他一句话也没说。

en: The speaker at the conference captivated the audience.
Bluetooth speakers are popular for outdoor activities.
She is a native English speaker.
cn: 会议上的演讲者吸引了全场听众。
蓝牙扬声器在户外活动中很受欢迎。
她是以英语为母语的人。

en: The warrior hurled a spear at his enemy.
Fishermen spear salmon in the river during spawning season.
The museum displayed a collection of ancient bronze spears.
cn: 战士向敌人投掷长矛。
渔民在鲑鱼产卵季用鱼叉捕鱼。
博物馆展出了一组古代青铜矛。

definitions.definition: 特别的事物（如特价商品、特别节目等）

en: This is a special occasion, so let's celebrate!
She has a special talent for painting.
Today's special is grilled salmon with lemon sauce.
cn: 这是一个特殊的场合，所以我们庆祝吧！
她在绘画方面有特殊的天赋。
今日特价菜是柠檬酱烤三文鱼。

en: She is a specialist in ancient Greek history.
You should consult a heart specialist for this condition.
The company hired a cybersecurity specialist to protect its data.
cn: 她是古希腊历史领域的专家。
这种情况你应该咨询心脏专科医生。
公司聘请了一位网络安全专家来保护数据。

definitions.definition: 特产；特色食品（尤用于英式英语）

en: Her speciality is neurosurgery.
This restaurant’s speciality is fresh seafood pasta.
The region is known for its culinary specialities.
cn: 她的专业是神经外科。
这家餐厅的特色菜是新鲜海鲜意面。
该地区以其烹饪特产而闻名。

en: She decided to specialize in pediatric medicine after medical school.
The company specializes in eco-friendly packaging solutions.
The course allows students to specialize in their area of interest.
cn: 她在医学院毕业后决定专攻儿科医学。
这家公司专门研究环保包装解决方案。
该课程让学生能在自己感兴趣的领域深入专研。

en: This tool was specially designed for left-handed users.
She dressed specially for the occasion.
The cake was made specially to celebrate her birthday.
cn: 这款工具是专为左撇子设计的。
她为这个场合特意打扮。
这个蛋糕是专门为庆祝她的生日制作的。

en: The doctor gave specific instructions for the medication.
This tool is specific to woodworking.
Can you be more specific about your requirements?
cn: 医生给出了具体的用药说明。
这种工具专用于木工。
你能更明确地说明你的需求吗？

en: The contract must specify the delivery date.
Can you specify which colors you prefer?
The instructions do not specify how to assemble the parts.
cn: 合同必须明确交货日期。
能否具体说明你偏好的颜色？
说明书未详细说明如何组装零件。

definitions.definition: 样本，标本（用于研究或展示的典型实例）
范例，实例（代表某一类别的典型例子）

en: The museum displayed a fossil specimen of a dinosaur.
This interview is a specimen of her excellent communication skills.
Scientists collected water specimens to test for pollution.
cn: 博物馆展出了一具恐龙化石标本。
这次访谈是她出色沟通能力的范例。
科学家采集了水样以检测污染情况。

en: The sunset over the mountains was a breathtaking spectacle.
He adjusted his spectacles before reading the newspaper.
The parade turned the city streets into a vibrant spectacle.
cn: 山间的日落是一场令人屏息的奇观。
他戴上眼镜调整位置，开始读报。
游行将城市街道变成了活力四射的盛景。

definitions.definition: 言语，说话能力；正式讲话，演说

en: His speech at the conference inspired many young researchers.
Children develop speech skills at different rates.
The politician's speech was interrupted by protesters.
cn: 他在会议上的演讲激励了许多年轻研究者。
儿童语言能力的发展速度各不相同。
政治家的演说被抗议者打断。

en: The car reached a speed of 120 km/h on the highway.
She sped through the book in one night.
Speed is crucial in emergency situations.
cn: 这辆车在高速公路上达到了每小时120公里的速度。
她一夜之间快速读完了这本书。
在紧急情况下，速度至关重要。

en: Can you spell your name for me?
The wizard cast a powerful spell.
She stayed with us for a brief spell.
cn: 你能拼写一下你的名字吗？
巫师施了一个强大的咒语。
她和我们短暂相处了一段时间。

en: English spelling can be tricky for learners.
She won the school spelling bee competition.
Check the spelling of this word in the dictionary.
cn: 英语拼写对学习者可能很棘手。
她赢得了学校拼字比赛冠军。
在词典里查查这个词的正确拼写。

en: She spends a lot on organic food.
Don’t spend all your energy on trivial matters.
The battery spends quickly if you overuse the flashlight.
cn: 她花很多钱购买有机食品。
别把精力全消耗在琐事上。
过度使用手电筒会很快耗尽电池。

en: The Earth is not a perfect sphere.
Her work falls within the sphere of environmental science.
Ancient astronomers believed celestial bodies moved in crystalline spheres.
cn: 地球并非完美的球体。
她的研究属于环境科学领域。
古代天文学家认为天体在水晶球体中运行。

en: The spider spun an intricate web between the branches.
Some spiders use venom to paralyze their prey.
Search engines rely on spiders to index web pages.
cn: 蜘蛛在树枝间织了一张复杂的网。
部分蜘蛛用毒液麻痹猎物。
搜索引擎依赖网络爬虫抓取网页内容。

en: She accidentally spilled coffee on her keyboard.
The oil spill caused severe environmental damage.
Don’t cry over spilled milk—it’s already happened.
cn: 她不小心把咖啡洒在了键盘上。
石油泄漏造成了严重的环境破坏。
不要为打翻的牛奶哭泣（覆水难收）。

en: The dancer spun gracefully across the stage.
She spins wool into yarn using a traditional wheel.
The politician tried to spin the scandal in his favor.
cn: 舞者在舞台上优雅地旋转。
她用传统纺车将羊毛纺成纱线。
政客试图将丑闻导向对自己有利的方向。

en: She has a strong fighting spirit.
The ancient Greeks believed in the spirit of the forest.
Whisky is a type of distilled spirit.
cn: 她拥有强烈的斗志。
古希腊人信奉森林之灵。
威士忌是一种蒸馏烈酒。

definitions.definition: 精神的；心灵的（与宗教或灵魂相关）

en: She found spiritual comfort in meditation.
The song has a deep spiritual meaning.
His paintings reflect a spiritual connection to nature.
cn: 她在冥想中找到了精神慰藉。
这首歌具有深刻的灵性意义。
他的画作展现了与自然的精神联结。

en: He spat on the ground to show his contempt.
The meat was roasted on a spit over the fire.
Spitting in public is considered rude in many cultures.
cn: 他朝地上吐口水以示轻蔑。
肉串在烤肉叉上置于火中炙烤。
在许多文化中，当众吐痰被视为粗鲁行为。

en: The kids laughed as they splashed in the puddles.
A splash of milk lightened the color of her coffee.
We heard the splash of a fish jumping in the lake.
cn: 孩子们踩水坑嬉戏，水花四溅，笑声不断。
几滴牛奶让她的咖啡颜色变浅了。
我们听见湖里有鱼跃出水面的扑通声。

en: The palace looked absolutely splendid in the sunset.
She did a splendid job on the project.
What a splendid idea to celebrate outdoors!
cn: 宫殿在夕阳下显得无比壮丽。
她在这个项目上表现极佳。
在户外庆祝真是个绝妙的主意！

en: The lightning split the old oak tree in half.
There was a split in the committee over the budget proposal.
She wore a split skirt for easier movement.
cn: 闪电将那棵老橡树劈成两半。
委员会在预算提案上出现了分歧。
她穿着一条开衩裙以便活动。

en: The rain spoiled our picnic plans.
Too much sugar can spoil your appetite.
The archaeologists found spoils from ancient battles.
cn: 雨水破坏了我们的野餐计划。
过量糖分会败坏你的食欲。
考古学家发现了古代战争的战利品。

definitions.definition: 海绵（动物或材料）；vt. 用海绵擦拭；vi. 寄生，揩油

en: She used a sponge to clean the spilled juice.
The coral reef is home to various sponges and fish.
He always sponges off his friends instead of getting a job.
cn: 她用海绵擦拭洒出的果汁。
珊瑚礁是多种海绵和鱼类的栖息地。
他总靠朋友接济，而不是找份工作。

en: The company agreed to sponsor the local football team.
She was the sponsor of the new environmental bill.
The event needs a financial sponsor to cover costs.
cn: 该公司同意赞助本地足球队。
她是这项新环保法案的发起人。
该活动需要一位资金赞助方来承担费用。

definitions.definition: 自发的；自然的；无意识的

en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
Many wildflowers grow in spontaneous clusters.
Her laughter was completely spontaneous.
cn: 观众自发地鼓起掌来。
许多野花自然成簇生长。
她的笑声全然发自内心。

definitions.definition: 用勺舀；亲密地搂抱（俚语）

en: She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
The baby was spooning puree into his mouth clumsily.
They lay spooning under the blanket, laughing softly.
cn: 她用木勺搅拌汤。
婴儿笨拙地用勺子把果泥送进嘴里。
他们亲密地相拥躺在毯子下，轻声笑着。

en: Football is the most popular sport in the world.
She sported a new diamond ring at the party.
The puppies sported in the garden all afternoon.
cn: 足球是世界上最受欢迎的运动。
她在派对上炫耀了一枚新钻戒。
小狗们在花园里嬉戏了一下午。

definitions.definition: 运动员；爱好运动的人（尤指男性）

en: He was voted Sportsman of the Year for his fair play.
A true sportsman respects the rules of the game.
The sportsman trained daily for the upcoming marathon.
cn: 他因公平竞赛被评为年度最佳运动员。
真正的运动员尊重比赛规则。
这位运动员为即将到来的马拉松每日训练。

en: She used a spray bottle to water the plants.
The ocean spray cooled our faces.
The artist sprayed paint onto the canvas.
cn: 她用喷雾瓶给植物浇水。
海水的飞沫让我们感到凉爽。
艺术家将颜料喷在画布上。

definitions.definition: 传播；范围；涂抹食品（如果酱）

en: She spread the map on the table to plan the route.
The news spread quickly through social media.
He spread butter evenly on his toast.
cn: 她展开地图放在桌上规划路线。
消息通过社交媒体迅速传播。
他将黄油均匀地涂在吐司上。

en: The cat sprang onto the windowsill.
Hot springs are popular tourist attractions.
She sprang the news on us at the last minute.
cn: 猫跳上了窗台。
温泉是受欢迎的旅游景点。
她在最后一刻突然向我们宣布了这个消息。

definitions.definition: 春季，春天（尤指气候宜人的时段）

en: The garden is full of blossoms in springtime.
Springtime always brings a sense of renewal.
We planned a picnic to enjoy the mild springtime weather.
cn: 春天里，花园开满了花朵。
春季总让人感到焕然一新。
我们计划了一次野餐，享受温和的春日天气。

en: She sprinkled sugar over the cake.
A sprinkle of rain cooled the air.
Sprinkle the seeds evenly in the soil.
cn: 她在蛋糕上撒了糖。
零星小雨让空气凉爽起来。
将种子均匀地撒在土壤里。

en: The rider used spurs to make the horse gallop faster.
Her success was a spur to others in the team.
The government plans to spur economic growth with new policies.
cn: 骑手用马刺让马跑得更快。
她的成功激励了团队中的其他人。
政府计划通过新政策刺激经济增长。

en: The spy infiltrated the enemy base undetected.
She likes to spy on her neighbors through the curtains.
The device can spy on conversations from 50 meters away.
cn: 这名间谍未被发现地潜入了敌方基地。
她喜欢透过窗帘暗中观察邻居。
这个装置能窃听50米外的对话。

definitions.definition: 正方形的；直角的；结清的

en: The room has four square corners.
Meet me at the town square at noon.
She squared her shoulders and faced the challenge.
cn: 房间有四个直角角落。
中午在镇广场见我。
她挺直肩膀，直面挑战。

en: She squeezed the juice from the orange.
He managed to squeeze through the narrow gap.
The new tax policy put a squeeze on small businesses.
cn: 她挤出了橙子的汁。
他设法挤过了狭窄的缝隙。
新税收政策让小企业陷入拮据。

definitions.definition: 松鼠（小型啮齿动物，以蓬松尾巴和储存食物习性闻名）
（非正式）贮藏，囤积（如 squirreling away money）

en: The squirrel darted up the tree with an acorn in its mouth.
She squirreled away her savings in a secret bank account.
Urban squirrels have adapted to foraging in trash bins.
cn: 松鼠叼着橡果飞快爬上了树。
她把积蓄偷偷存进一个秘密银行账户。
城市松鼠已学会在垃圾桶中觅食。

en: He stabbed the knife into the table angrily.
Her betrayal felt like a stab in the heart.
The victim suffered multiple stab wounds.
cn: 他愤怒地将刀刺进桌子。
她的背叛如同一把刺入心脏的刀。
受害者身中多刀。

definitions.definition: （化学/物理）结构或性质的持久性

en: The political stability of the country attracted foreign investors.
Engineers tested the bridge's stability under extreme weather conditions.
Emotional stability is crucial for long-term mental health.
cn: 该国的政治稳定性吸引了外国投资者。
工程师测试了桥梁在极端天气下的稳定性。
情绪稳定对长期心理健康至关重要。

en: The economy remained stable despite global crises.
She keeps her horse in a wooden stable behind the farmhouse.
His calm personality provides a stable influence on the team.
cn: 尽管全球危机，经济仍保持稳定。
她把马养在农舍后的木制马厩里。
他沉稳的性格为团队提供了稳定的影响。

en: She stacked the books neatly on the shelf.
A stack of papers awaited his signature.
The server crashed due to a stack overflow.
cn: 她把书整齐地堆放在书架上。
一摞文件等着他签字。
服务器因堆栈溢出而崩溃。

definitions.definition: 体育场；运动场（大型露天场地，用于体育赛事或音乐会）
（古罗马）斯塔德（长度单位，约185米）

en: The new stadium can hold over 50,000 spectators.
In ancient Greece, runners competed in a stadium that was one stade long.
The concert turned the stadium into a sea of lights.
cn: 这座新体育场可容纳超过5万名观众。
在古希腊，赛跑者们在长度为一斯塔德的跑道上比赛。
演唱会令体育场化作一片灯海。

en: The hospital staff worked tirelessly during the pandemic.
He leaned on his wooden staff while hiking.
The melody was written on a four-line staff in medieval notation.
cn: 疫情期间，医院全体员工不懈工作。
徒步时，他倚靠木杖行走。
这段旋律以中世纪记谱法写在四线谱上。

en: The actor stepped onto the stage with confidence.
The project is still in its early stages.
They staged a protest outside the government building.
cn: 演员自信地走上舞台。
该项目仍处于早期阶段。
他们在政府大楼外组织了一场抗议活动。

en: The coffee stain on her shirt was hard to remove.
He used walnut juice to stain the wood a darker color.
A criminal record can stain a person's reputation forever.
cn: 她衬衫上的咖啡渍很难清除。
他用胡桃汁将木头染成更深的颜色。
犯罪记录可能永远玷污一个人的名誉。

en: She sat on the bottom stair, tying her shoelaces.
The wooden stairs creaked under his weight.
Climbing these steep stairs feels like a workout.
cn: 她坐在最下面一级楼梯上系鞋带。
木制楼梯在他的重量下吱呀作响。
爬这些陡峭的楼梯像在健身。

en: The spiral staircase led to a hidden tower.
She tripped on the marble staircase and dropped her books.
The fire escape includes an external metal staircase.
cn: 螺旋楼梯通向一座隐秘的塔楼。
她在大理石楼梯上绊倒，书散落一地。
紧急逃生通道包含一部外部金属楼梯。

en: They marked the property line with wooden stakes.
He has a high stake in the success of this project.
She staked her entire savings on the new business venture.
cn: 他们用木桩标出了地产边界。
该项目的成功与他有重大利害关系。
她把全部积蓄押在了这次新创业上。

en: The bread tastes stale after two days.
Their marriage grew stale over the years.
Open the window – the air in here is stale.
cn: 面包放两天后就不新鲜了。
他们的婚姻随着时间变得乏味。
开窗吧，这里的空气不流通。

en: She collected foreign stamps as a hobby.
The official stamped my passport with an exit visa.
He stamped his foot in frustration.
cn: 她以收集外国邮票为爱好。
官员在我的护照上盖了出境签证章。
他沮丧地跺了跺脚。

en: She could hardly stand after the long hike.
This material can stand high temperatures.
The speaker took a stand against corruption.
cn: 长途徒步后，她几乎站不稳了。
这种材料能耐受高温。
演讲者表明了反对腐败的立场。

en: This product meets the international safety standards.
She holds a high standard for her work.
The king’s standard flew above the castle.
cn: 该产品符合国际安全标准。
她对工作抱有高标准。
国王的旗帜飘扬在城堡上方。

en: From a scientific standpoint, the theory lacks empirical evidence.
Her feminist standpoint shapes her analysis of the novel.
The report examines the issue from multiple standpoints.
cn: 从科学角度来看，该理论缺乏实证依据。
她的女性主义立场影响了她对这部小说的分析。
报告从多个角度审视了这一问题。

en: The North Star guided sailors for centuries.
She will star in the new Broadway musical.
His performance earned him a gold star.
cn: 北极星为水手导航了数个世纪。
她将主演这部新的百老汇音乐剧。
他的表现为他赢得了一颗金星（荣誉标志）。

en: She stared at the painting, lost in thought.
His cold stare made me uncomfortable.
Don't stare at strangers; it's impolite.
cn: 她凝视着画作，陷入沉思。
他冰冷的注视让我不自在。
不要盯着陌生人看，这不礼貌。

en: She took a deep breath before starting her speech.
The race will start at 9 AM sharp.
His sudden success marked the start of a new career.
cn: 她深吸一口气，开始了演讲。
比赛将于上午9点整开始。
他的突然成功标志着一份新事业的开始。

en: The loud noise startled the sleeping cat.
She startled at the sight of a shadow in the dark.
His sudden appearance startled everyone in the room.
cn: 巨大的声响惊醒了睡梦中的猫。
她被黑暗中的人影吓了一跳。
他的突然出现让房间里所有人都大吃一惊。

en: Many animals starve during harsh winters.
The dictator used food blockades to starve the rebels.
Without sunlight, plants will eventually starve.
cn: 许多动物在严冬中挨饿。
独裁者用食物封锁使叛乱者陷入饥荒。
没有阳光，植物最终会因缺乏养分而枯萎。

en: The patient's state improved after treatment.
California is the most populous state in the US.
The witness stated the facts clearly in court.
cn: 患者的状况在治疗后有所好转。
加利福尼亚是美国人口最多的州。
证人在法庭上清晰地陈述了事实。

definitions.definition: 陈述；声明（正式的口头或书面表达）
财务报表（银行或商业记录）

en: The witness gave a detailed statement to the police.
Please check your bank statement for any errors.
Her bold statement sparked a heated debate.
cn: 目击者向警方提供了详细陈述。
请核对银行账单是否有误。
她大胆的声明引发了激烈争论。

definitions.definition: 政治家（尤指睿智、公正的领导者）

en: Abraham Lincoln is remembered as a great statesman who preserved the Union.
The conference brought together statesmen from over 50 countries.
True statesmen prioritize long-term public good over short-term gains.
cn: 亚伯拉罕·林肯被誉为维护联邦统一的伟大政治家。
此次会议汇聚了来自50多个国家的政治家。
真正的政治家会将长远公共利益置于短期利益之上。

en: The radio signal was full of static due to the storm.
In programming, static variables retain their values between function calls.
The pond water was static, reflecting the sky like a mirror.
cn: 由于暴风雨，无线电信号充满静电干扰。
编程中，静态变量在函数调用间保留其值。
池塘的水静止如镜，倒映着天空。

en: The train will arrive at platform 3 of the central station.
Soldiers were stationed at the border to maintain security.
She holds a high station in the academic community.
cn: 火车将抵达中央车站的3号站台。
士兵被派驻边境以维护安全。
她在学术界拥有很高的地位。

en: The report provides a statistical analysis of population growth.
Statistical evidence supports the new theory.
She has a strong background in statistical modeling.
cn: 这份报告提供了人口增长的统计分析。
统计证据支持这一新理论。
她在统计建模方面有深厚背景。

en: The statue of liberty symbolizes freedom.
He carved a marble statue of a lion.
Ancient statues often depict gods and heroes.
cn: 自由女神像象征自由。
他雕刻了一座大理石狮子像。
古代雕像常描绘神与英雄。

en: Her status as a CEO gives her significant influence in the industry.
The project’s current status is under review.
Social media often reflects one’s perceived status in society.
cn: 她作为首席执行官的身份使她在行业中具有重要影响力。
该项目目前的状态正在审核中。
社交媒体常反映一个人在社会中的 perceived 地位。

en: She decided to stay in Paris for a week.
Stay calm no matter what happens.
The ship's stay broke during the storm.
cn: 她决定在巴黎停留一周。
无论发生什么都要保持冷静。
船的支撑杆在风暴中折断了。

en: The company's profits have grown steadily over the past decade.
She breathed steadily to calm her nerves before the speech.
The old man walked steadily with the help of his cane.
cn: 该公司利润在过去十年间稳步增长。
她在演讲前平稳呼吸以放松紧张情绪。
老人借助手杖步伐稳健地行走。

en: She held the ladder steady while he climbed.
His steady hands made him an excellent surgeon.
The company aims to steady its growth in the next quarter.
cn: 她稳稳扶住梯子让他攀爬。
他双手稳健，成为了一名出色的外科医生。
公司计划在下一季度稳定增长。

en: He was caught trying to steal a wallet.
The cat stole across the moonlit yard.
This designer bag at half price is a real steal!
cn: 他试图偷钱包时被当场抓住。
猫咪悄无声息地溜过月光下的院子。
这个半价的设计师包真是捡了大便宜！

en: The kettle whistled as steam rose from its spout.
She steamed the vegetables to retain their nutrients.
Ancient Romans used steam baths for relaxation.
cn: 水壶鸣笛时，蒸汽从壶嘴冒出。
她蒸蔬菜以保留营养。
古罗马人用蒸汽浴来放松。

en: The historic steamer chugged along the Mississippi River.
She cooked the dumplings in a bamboo steamer.
Early steamers revolutionized transatlantic travel.
cn: 这艘历史悠久的汽船沿着密西西比河缓缓航行。
她用竹蒸锅蒸了饺子。
早期的蒸汽船彻底改变了跨大西洋旅行方式。

en: The bridge is reinforced with steel beams.
She steeled herself before delivering the bad news.
Stainless steel resists corrosion.
cn: 这座桥梁用钢梁加固。
她在宣布坏消息前让自己坚强起来。
不锈钢耐腐蚀。

definitions.definition: 陡峭的；急剧的（上升或下降）
（价格或要求）过高的，不合理的

en: The trail became too steep for bicycles.
She steeped the tea leaves for five minutes.
The company faced steep competition in the market.
cn: 小路变得过于陡峭，无法骑自行车。
她将茶叶浸泡了五分钟。
该公司面临市场的激烈竞争。

en: She steered the boat skillfully through the narrow canal.
The teacher steered the discussion toward climate change.
The farmer raised a herd of steers for beef production.
cn: 她熟练地驾驶小船穿过狭窄的运河。
老师将讨论引导至气候变化话题。
农夫饲养了一群阉牛用于牛肉生产。

definitions.definition: 起源于（常与 from 连用）

en: The rose stem has sharp thorns.
"Run" is the stem of "running" and "runner".
The government tried to stem the spread of misinformation.
cn: 玫瑰茎上有尖锐的刺。
"Run" 是 "running" 和 "runner" 的词干。
政府试图遏制错误信息的传播。

en: She took a careful step forward on the icy path.
The recipe has five simple steps.
Don't step on the freshly painted floor.
cn: 她在结冰的小路上小心翼翼地迈了一步。
这个食谱有五个简单的步骤。
别踩刚漆好的地板。

en: The teacher gave us a stern warning about cheating.
His stern expression made everyone nervous.
Waves crashed against the stern of the ship.
cn: 老师就作弊问题给了我们严厉的警告。
他严峻的表情让所有人都紧张起来。
海浪猛烈拍打着船尾。

en: The steward ensured all guests were comfortably seated.
She works as a flight steward for an international airline.
He was appointed to steward the charity funds responsibly.
cn: 管家确保所有客人都被妥善安排就座。
她在一家国际航空公司担任空乘人员。
他被委派负责管理慈善资金。

definitions.definition: 女乘务员；女管家；女服务员

en: The stewardess demonstrated the safety procedures with clarity and poise.
She had a long and fulfilling career as a stewardess for a major international airline.
The term "stewardess" is increasingly being replaced by the gender-neutral "flight attendant".
cn: 这位女乘务员清晰而镇定地演示了安全程序。
她曾在一家大型国际航空公司担任女乘务员，拥有漫长而充实的职业生涯。
“stewardess”一词正逐渐被中性的“flight attendant”（航班乘务员）所取代。

en: He picked up a stick to draw in the sand.
Please stick the poster on the wall with tape.
If you stick to your goals, you’ll succeed eventually.
cn: 他捡起一根棍子在沙地上画画。
请用胶带把海报贴在墙上。
如果你坚持目标，终会成功。

en: The tape is too sticky to remove cleanly.
The weather was hot and sticky all week.
They found themselves in a sticky situation.
cn: 胶带太黏，无法干净地撕下。
整个星期天气又热又闷。
他们陷入了棘手的境地。

en: The cardboard was too stiff to fold easily.
She gave a stiff smile at the awkward joke.
cn: 硬纸板太僵硬，不易折叠。
她对尴尬的笑话报以生硬的微笑。

en: The fabric will stiffen after applying starch.
His posture stiffened when he heard the news.
Cold temperatures can stiffen the joints.
cn: 布料上浆后会变硬。
听到消息时，他的姿势突然僵硬了。
低温会使关节僵硬。

en: The lake was still in the morning light.
She still remembers her first day at school.
They use copper pots to still brandy.
cn: 晨光中的湖面一片寂静。
她仍然记得上学第一天的情景。
他们用铜壶蒸馏白兰地。

definitions.definition: 刺激；激发（生理或心理活动）

en: The caffeine in coffee can stimulate the central nervous system.
Teachers use questions to stimulate students' critical thinking.
The government plans to stimulate economic growth with tax cuts.
cn: 咖啡中的咖啡因能刺激中枢神经系统。
教师通过提问激发学生的批判性思维。
政府计划通过减税促进经济增长。

en: The bee's sting left a red mark on her arm.
His harsh words stung her deeply.
The antiseptic may sting a little when applied.
cn: 蜜蜂的蜇刺在她手臂上留下了一个红印。
他刻薄的话语深深刺痛了她。
消毒剂涂抹时可能会有轻微刺痛感。

definitions.definition: 搅拌；轻轻移动；激发（情感或行动）

en: She used a spoon to stir the soup gently.
The speech stirred strong emotions in the audience.
There was a stir of excitement as the celebrity entered.
cn: 她用勺子轻轻搅拌汤。
演讲激起了听众强烈的情绪。
名人入场时引起一阵骚动。

en: She sewed the button with tiny, even stitches.
The surgeon stitched the wound carefully.
I laughed so hard it gave me a stitch in my side.
cn: 她用细小均匀的针脚缝上了纽扣。
外科医生小心地缝合了伤口。
我笑得太厉害，肋骨附近疼得像针扎一样。

definitions.definition: 库存；存货；股票；家畜；血统

en: The store has a large stock of winter coats.
She invested in tech stocks last year.
This joke is a stock example of British humor.
cn: 商店有大量冬季外套的库存。
她去年投资了科技股。
这个笑话是英式幽默的典型例子。

en: She wore a pair of black silk stockings to the party.
In the 18th century, men's stockings were often made of wool.
The baby kicked off her tiny stocking while sleeping.
cn: 她穿了一双黑色丝质长袜参加派对。
18世纪时，男式长袜常用羊毛制成。
宝宝睡觉时踢掉了她的小袜子。

en: The doctor examined his stomach for signs of infection.
She couldn't stomach the idea of eating raw fish.
A butterfly landed lightly on his stomach.
cn: 医生检查了他的胃是否有感染迹象。
她无法忍受吃生鱼的想法。
一只蝴蝶轻轻落在他的腹部。

en: The path was paved with smooth stones.
She was stoned by the angry crowd.
Remove the stone from the peach before eating.
cn: 小路铺着光滑的石头。
她被愤怒的人群用石头砸。
吃桃子前先去核。

en: The path was stony and difficult to walk on.
She gave him a stony look and turned away.
The soil here is too stony for farming.
cn: 小路布满石子，难以行走。
她冷冷地看了他一眼，转身离开。
这里的土壤石质太多，不适合耕种。

definitions.definition: （植物的）新芽或分枝（古义/专业用法）

en: She perched on a wooden stool by the counter.
The gardener trimmed the stool of the rose bush.
His studio had only a stool and an easel.
cn: 她坐在柜台边的木凳上。
园丁修剪了玫瑰丛的新枝。
他的画室里只有一把凳子和一个画架。

definitions.definition: 门廊；台阶（尤指房屋入口处的）

en: She had to stoop to pick up the coin.
The old man sat on the stoop, watching the sunset.
The doorway was so low that visitors had to stoop to enter.
cn: 她弯腰捡起硬币。
老人坐在门廊台阶上，望着日落。
门框太低，访客必须弯腰才能进入。

en: The bus will stop at the next station.
She stopped talking when the teacher entered.
Use the emergency stop button in case of danger.
cn: 公交车将在下一站停靠。
老师进来时，她停止了说话。
遇到危险时使用紧急停止按钮。

en: The company rented additional storage for their archives.
Cloud storage has revolutionized data accessibility.
Proper food storage prevents spoilage.
cn: 该公司为档案租用了额外的仓库。
云存储彻底改变了数据的可访问性。
正确的食物储存能防止变质。

en: She stored the winter clothes in a wooden chest.
This grocery store is open 24 hours.
Squirrels store nuts for the cold months.
cn: 她把冬装存放在一个木箱里。
这家杂货店24小时营业。
松鼠为寒冷月份储存坚果。

en: The building has five storeys, with a café on the top floor.
Each storey of the tower was designed in a different architectural style.
The fire started on the lower storeys and spread rapidly.
cn: 这座建筑有五层，顶层有一家咖啡馆。
塔楼的每一层都采用不同的建筑风格设计。
火灾从低层开始并迅速蔓延。

en: The ship sank during the violent storm.
Protesters stormed the government building.
She stormed out of the room after the argument.
cn: 那艘船在猛烈的暴风雨中沉没了。
抗议者冲进了政府大楼。
争吵后，她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

en: The sailors avoided the stormy seas.
Their marriage was stormy but passionate.
The politician’s speech reflected the stormy mood of the era.
cn: 水手们避开了波涛汹涌的海域。
他们的婚姻充满争吵但激情四溢。
这位政治家的演讲反映了那个时代的动荡情绪。

definitions.definition: （建筑物的）楼层（主要用于美式英语）

en: She told a fascinating story about her travels in Japan.
The news story was published on the front page.
The building has five stories.
cn: 她讲述了一个关于她在日本旅行的迷人故事。
这篇新闻报道刊登在头版。
这栋楼有五层。

en: She cooked soup on the gas stove.
The antique stove warmed the entire cabin.
Modern stoves often have energy-saving features.
cn: 她在燃气灶上煮了汤。
老式火炉温暖了整个小屋。
现代炉具常配备节能功能。

en: Draw a straight line from point A to point B.
She gave me a straight answer without hesitation.
Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic light.
cn: 从A点到B点画一条直线。
她毫不犹豫地给了我一个直截了当的回答。
直行，然后在红绿灯处左转。

en: The rope snapped under the strain.
She strained her voice by shouting too much.
He strained to hear the distant conversation.
cn: 绳子在拉力下断裂了。
她因过度喊叫而伤了嗓子。
他努力去听远处的谈话。

en: The village seemed strange to her after years abroad.
Scientists observed a strange phenomenon in the experiment.
His strange behavior raised suspicions among colleagues.
cn: 多年海外生活后，这个村庄对她来说很陌生。
科学家在实验中观察到一个奇特现象。
他古怪的行为引起了同事的怀疑。

definitions.definition: 不熟悉某事物的人（如：a stranger to fear 不知恐惧为何物的人）

en: She felt like a stranger in her own hometown after years abroad.
The kind stranger helped him carry the heavy luggage.
He is no stranger to adversity, having grown up in poverty.
cn: 多年海外生活后，她在故乡竟感到陌生。
那位好心的陌生人帮他提了沉重的行李。
他自幼贫困，对逆境并不陌生。

en: She tightened the strap of her backpack.
The boxes were strapped together for transport.
His watch strap broke after years of use.
cn: 她拉紧了背包的带子。
箱子被捆扎在一起以便运输。
他的表带在使用多年后断裂了。

definitions.definition: 策略，战略（为实现目标制定的长期计划）

en: The company's marketing strategy focuses on social media engagement.
Sun Tzu's The Art of War is a classic text on military strategy.
She devised a clever strategy to win the chess game.
cn: 这家公司的营销策略侧重于社交媒体互动。
孙武的《孙子兵法》是军事战略的经典著作。
她设计了一个聪明的策略来赢得棋局。

en: The farmer piled the straw in the barn.
She sipped her drink through a paper straw.
His argument was just a straw man.
cn: 农夫将稻草堆在谷仓里。
她用纸吸管喝饮料。
他的论点不过是个稻草人谬误（无实质内容）。

en: She picked a ripe strawberry from the garden.
Strawberry shortcake is a popular summer dessert.
The field was covered with wild strawberry plants.
cn: 她从花园里摘了一颗熟透的草莓。
草莓松饼是夏季受欢迎的甜点。
田野里长满了野草莓植株。

definitions.definition: 溪流；流动的液体或气体；连续的数据流

en: The children played by the babbling stream.
Tears began to stream down her face.
The concert was streamed live to millions of viewers.
cn: 孩子们在潺潺的小溪边玩耍。
泪水开始顺着她的脸颊流下。
音乐会向数百万观众实时直播。

definitions.definition: 街道，马路；特定类型的道路（如商业街）

en: The bookstore is on the main street.
She walked down a narrow cobbled street.
The street was lined with cherry trees.
cn: 书店位于主街上。
她沿着一条狭窄的鹅卵石街道行走。
街道两旁种满了樱花树。

en: Regular exercise builds both physical and mental strength.
The strength of the bridge was tested by engineers.
Her strength of character helped her overcome the crisis.
cn: 定期锻炼能增强体力和意志力。
工程师测试了这座桥的强度。
她性格的坚韧帮助她渡过了危机。

en: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
The new policy aims to strengthen economic ties.
Her confidence strengthened after the success.
cn: 锻炼能增强你的肌肉。
新政策旨在加强经济联系。
成功之后，她的信心增强了。

en: Chronic stress can harm your health.
She stressed the importance of teamwork.
The word "record" has stress on the first syllable.
cn: 长期压力可能损害健康。
她强调了团队合作的重要性。
单词“record”的重音在第一个音节。

definitions.definition: 一段连续的时间或空间

en: She stretched her arms after hours of typing.
The desert stretches for hundreds of miles.
We need to stretch our budget to cover unexpected costs.
cn: 打字几小时后，她伸展了一下手臂。
这片沙漠绵延数百英里。
我们需要延长预算以应对意外开支。

en: The teacher is very strict about deadlines.
The law imposes strict limits on pollution.
He follows a strict diet for health reasons.
cn: 这位老师对截止日期要求非常严格。
这项法律对污染制定了严格的限制。
出于健康原因，他遵循严格的饮食计划。

en: The rules must be strictly followed.
He spoke strictly in technical terms.
The area is strictly off-limits to tourists.
cn: 这些规则必须严格遵守。
他严格使用专业术语表述。
该区域绝对禁止游客进入。

en: The lightning struck the tree.
Workers decided to strike for better pay.
His words struck me as profound.
cn: 闪电击中了那棵树。
工人们决定罢工以争取更高薪资。
他的话让我觉得深刻。

en: She tied the package with a piece of string.
The necklace was strung with tiny pearls.
A string of accidents disrupted the event.
cn: 她用一根细绳捆扎包裹。
这条项链串着小珍珠。
一连串意外事件扰乱了活动。

definitions.definition: 条状物；带状地带；脱衣舞

en: The workers stripped the old paint from the wall.
She stripped down to her swimsuit and jumped into the pool.
The airport is located near a commercial strip.
cn: 工人们铲除了墙上的旧油漆。
她脱到只剩泳衣，跳进了泳池。
机场靠近一片商业区。

definitions.definition: 条纹；线条；类型（如性格或职业的类别）

en: The tiger's orange fur has bold black stripes.
She wore a shirt with vertical stripes.
His actions revealed a ruthless stripe in his character.
cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有醒目的黑色条纹。
她穿了一件竖条纹衬衫。
他的行为显露出性格中冷酷的一面。

definitions.definition: 击打；中风；（游泳的）划水动作；（书写或绘画的）一笔

en: She painted the final stroke with a steady hand.
The cat purred when he stroked its fur.
A stroke can cause sudden paralysis.
cn: 她稳稳地画下最后一笔。
他抚摸猫咪的毛时，它发出呼噜声。
中风可能导致突发性瘫痪。

definitions.definition: 坚定的；强有力的（如观点、政策）

en: She has a strong personality that inspires others.
The bridge is built to withstand strong winds.
His argument was strong enough to convince the committee.
cn: 她性格坚强，能激励他人。
这座桥的设计能抵御强风。
他的论点有力，足以说服委员会。

en: She strongly disagreed with the decision.
The rope was strongly tied to the post.
He strongly believes in equal rights.
cn: 她强烈反对这一决定。
绳子被牢牢地绑在柱子上。
他坚定地相信平等权利。

en: The bridge's structural integrity was compromised after the earthquake.
The report analyzes the structural inequalities in the education system.
Proteins have complex structural patterns that determine their function.
cn: 地震后，这座桥的结构完整性受到了破坏。
该报告分析了教育体系中的结构性不平等。
蛋白质具有决定其功能的复杂结构模式。

en: The Eiffel Tower's steel structure weighs 7,300 tons.
She structured her essay with clear subheadings.
DNA is a double-helix structure that encodes genetic information.
cn: 埃菲尔铁塔的钢结构重达7300吨。
她用清晰的小标题系统组织了论文。
DNA是编码遗传信息的双螺旋结构。

en: The refugees struggled to find food and shelter.
She never gave up the struggle for equal rights.
The fish struggled violently on the hook.
cn: 难民们艰难地寻找食物和住所。
她从未放弃争取平等权利的斗争。
鱼在鱼钩上剧烈挣扎。

definitions.definition: 学生（尤指中学或大学学习者）

en: She is a diligent student who always completes assignments on time.
As a student of history, he spends hours in the archives.
The workshop is open to both students and professionals.
cn: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。
作为历史研究者，他常泡在档案馆里。
该研讨会对学生和专业人士开放。

en: She spends three hours a day studying French.
The team conducted a study on climate change.
His favorite place at home is the quiet study.
cn: 她每天花三小时学习法语。
该团队开展了一项关于气候变化的研究。
家里他最喜欢的地方是安静的书房。

en: The box was full of old stuff.
She stuffed the turkey with herbs.
He has a lot of stuff to deal with.
cn: 箱子里装满了旧东西。
她把火鸡塞满了香草。
他有一堆事情要处理。

en: He stumbled over a rock and fell.
She stumbled through her speech nervously.
The team's stumble in the final round cost them the victory.
cn: 他被石头绊倒了。
她紧张地结结巴巴完成了演讲。
团队在最后一轮的失误使他们输掉了比赛。

en: That was a stupid mistake.
The movie’s plot was stupid and predictable.
Don’t act stupid—you know what I mean!
cn: 那是个愚蠢的错误。
这部电影的情节无聊且老套。
别装傻，你懂我的意思！

definitions.definition: 设计；称呼；使符合特定风格

en: Her painting style is influenced by Impressionism.
The magazine covers the latest styles in fashion.
He styled himself as a visionary leader.
cn: 她的绘画风格受印象派影响。
这本杂志涵盖了最新的时尚潮流。
他自称为富有远见的领导者。

en: The subject of the lecture was climate change.
She was subjected to unfair treatment.
This area is subject to earthquakes.
cn: 讲座的主题是气候变化。
她遭受了不公正的对待。
该地区易发生地震。

en: The submarine descended to explore the ocean floor.
Marine biologists study submarine ecosystems.
Submarine cables connect continents for internet communication.
cn: 潜水艇下潜以探索海底。
海洋生物学家研究海底生态系统。
海底电缆连接各大洲以实现互联网通信。

en: The submarine can submerge to a depth of 500 meters.
Heavy rains submerged the streets of the city.
Her personal struggles were submerged by her professional success.
cn: 潜艇可下潜至500米深。
暴雨淹没了城市的街道。
她的个人困境被职业成就所掩盖。

en: Please submit your report by Friday.
He refused to submit to their demands.
The warrior chose death rather than submit.
cn: 请于周五前提交你的报告。
他拒绝屈服于他们的要求。
这名战士宁死不屈。

en: The first round of talks failed, but subsequent negotiations succeeded.
Subsequent events proved her theory correct.
Each subsequent chapter builds on the previous one.
cn: 首轮谈判失败，但随后的协商取得了成功。
后续事件证明了她的理论是正确的。
每一章都承接前一章的内容展开。

en: The substance of his argument was convincing, though his delivery was poor.
Water is a substance essential for all known forms of life.
Her research lacks substance and relies too heavily on speculation.
cn: 他的论点实质很有说服力，尽管表达方式欠佳。
水是所有已知生命形式必需的物质。
她的研究缺乏实质性内容，过度依赖推测。

en: The project requires a substantial amount of funding.
She made substantial contributions to scientific research.
The house is built with substantial materials to withstand storms.
cn: 该项目需要大量资金支持。
她对科学研究作出了重要贡献。
房屋采用坚固材料建造，以抵御风暴。

en: Honey can substitute sugar in some recipes.
The coach sent a substitute player onto the field.
No artificial flavoring can substitute for real vanilla.
cn: 蜂蜜在某些食谱中可以替代糖。
教练派了一名替补球员上场。
任何人工香料都无法替代真正的香草。

en: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
The bank will subtract the fee automatically.
Children learn to add before they learn to subtract.
cn: 从10中减去5，得到5。
银行将自动扣除手续费。
儿童先学加法，再学减法。

definitions.definition: 郊区，城郊（城市边缘的住宅区）

en: They moved to a quiet suburb to escape the noise of downtown.
The school serves children from both the city and its suburbs.
Suburb life often involves longer commutes but more space.
cn: 他们搬到了安静的郊区，以躲避市中心的喧嚣。
这所学校接收来自城市和郊区的孩子。
郊区生活通常意味着更长的通勤时间，但更宽敞的居住空间。

en: The subway is the fastest way to avoid traffic in New York.
They built a pedestrian subway under the busy intersection.
I grabbed a sandwich at Subway before catching the train.
cn: 纽约地铁是避开路面交通最快的方式。
他们在繁忙的十字路口下修建了一条人行地下通道。
我在赶火车前去了赛百味买三明治。

en: She worked hard to succeed in her career.
The prince will succeed his father as king.
Without perseverance, it's difficult to succeed.
cn: 她努力工作，事业有成。
王子将继承父亲的王位。
缺乏毅力，难以成功。

en: Her success was the result of years of hard work.
The company celebrated its latest business success.
Success often depends on perseverance.
cn: 她的成功是多年努力的结果。
公司庆祝其最新的商业成就。
成功往往取决于坚持。

definitions.definition: 有成就的；获得财富或声誉的

en: She runs a successful business in downtown.
His successful experiment proved the theory.
To be successful, one must learn from failures.
cn: 她在市中心经营着一家成功的企业。
他成功的实验验证了该理论。
要想成功，必须从失败中学习。

en: She successfully completed the project ahead of schedule.
The team worked collaboratively to successfully launch the product.
Despite the challenges, he successfully adapted to the new environment.
cn: 她提前成功完成了项目。
团队协作成功推出了产品。
尽管面临挑战，他成功适应了新环境。

en: The succession of rainy days ruined our travel plans.
The king's sudden death caused a crisis of succession.
Ecological succession gradually transforms barren land into a forest.
cn: 连绵雨天破坏了我们的旅行计划。
国王猝死引发了继任危机。
生态演替逐渐将荒地转化为森林。

en: The team celebrated three successive victories.
Successive governments failed to solve the issue.
Her successive attempts finally led to a breakthrough.
cn: 该队庆祝了连续三场胜利。
历届政府均未能解决该问题。
她接连的尝试最终带来了突破。

definitions.definition: 这样的，如此的（用于指代前文提及的事物）

en: She had never seen such a beautiful sunset.
Such behavior is unacceptable in this school.
If you need help, ask someone such as a teacher.
cn: 她从未见过如此美丽的日落。
这种行为在学校是不可接受的。
如果需要帮助，可以找老师这样的人。

definitions.definition: 吸吮的动作；令人失望的事物（俚语）

en: The baby sucks milk from a bottle.
This vacuum cleaner sucks up dirt efficiently.
The plot of the film sucks, but the special effects are amazing.
cn: 婴儿从奶瓶中吸吮牛奶。
这台吸尘器能高效吸除灰尘。
这部电影剧情很烂，但特效很棒。

en: A sudden noise made everyone turn around.
Her sudden departure left us in confusion.
The storm caused a sudden drop in temperature.
cn: 突然的响声让所有人都转过身去。
她的突然离开让我们不知所措。
暴风雨导致气温骤降。

en: The lights went out suddenly during the storm.
She suddenly realized she had left her keys at home.
The car stopped suddenly to avoid hitting the dog.
cn: 暴风雨中，灯突然熄灭了。
她突然意识到把钥匙忘在家里了。
汽车突然停下，以免撞到那只狗。

definitions.definition: 容许；允许（古义或正式用法）

en: Many people suffer from anxiety during stressful times.
The city suffered heavy damage in the earthquake.
He could not suffer such insults in silence.
cn: 许多人在压力时期会遭受焦虑困扰。
这座城市在地震中遭受了严重破坏。
他无法默默忍受这样的侮辱。

en: The food supplies are sufficient for the entire winter.
Her explanation was not sufficient to convince the committee.
A light jacket is sufficient for this mild weather.
cn: 食物储备足够支撑整个冬季。
她的解释不足以说服委员会。
这种温和天气，一件薄外套就足够了。

en: The evidence is sufficiently strong to support the theory.
She practiced sufficiently to perform flawlessly.
The room was sufficiently lit for reading.
cn: 证据足够有力，可以支持这一理论。
她练习得足够充分，表演毫无瑕疵。
房间光线充足，适合阅读。

en: She added a spoonful of sugar to her tea.
The recipe calls for brown sugar instead of white sugar.
He tried to sugar his criticism with compliments.
cn: 她在茶里加了一勺糖。
这个食谱要求用红糖而非白糖。
他试图用赞美来缓和批评的尖锐。

en: She suggested a new approach to the problem.
The data suggests a link between the two phenomena.
His tone suggested he was not convinced.
cn: 她针对这个问题提出了一种新的解决方式。
数据表明这两种现象之间存在关联。
他的语气暗示他并未被说服。

en: She made a helpful suggestion to improve the project.
His tone carried a suggestion of disapproval.
The painting evokes suggestions of loneliness.
cn: 她提出了一个有益的建议来改进项目。
他的语气带着一丝不赞同的暗示。
这幅画让人联想到孤独。

en: He wore a formal suit to the interview.
The job suits her skills perfectly.
They filed a suit against the company for breach of contract.
cn: 他穿着正式套装去面试。
这份工作完全适合她的技能。
他们以违约为起诉该公司。

en: This dress is suitable for a formal occasion.
The teacher found a suitable method to explain the concept.
Is the hotel suitable for wheelchair users?
cn: 这条裙子适合正式场合。
老师找到了合适的方法来解释这个概念。
这家酒店适合轮椅使用者吗？

en: Sulphur is used in the production of sulfuric acid.
The volcano emitted clouds of sulphur dioxide.
The smell of rotten eggs is often caused by sulphur compounds.
cn: 硫用于生产硫酸。
火山喷发出二氧化硫云。
臭鸡蛋气味通常由硫化合物引起。

en: The sum of 5 and 7 is 12.
She summed up the meeting in three points.
A large sum of money was donated to the charity.
cn: 5 加 7 的和是 12。
她用三点总结了会议内容。
一大笔钱被捐给了慈善机构。

en: Please summarize the article in three sentences.
The report summarizes the key findings of the research.
He summarized his argument with a powerful quote.
cn: 请用三句话概括这篇文章。
报告总结了这项研究的关键发现。
他用一句有力的引语总结了自己的论点。

en: She wrote a summary of the research paper.
The report provides a summary of the main findings.
His explanation was summary but accurate.
cn: 她为这篇研究论文写了摘要。
报告提供了主要发现的概要。
他的解释简短但准确。

en: The birds migrate north in summer.
She spent her summer volunteering at a marine sanctuary.
The Renaissance was the summer of Italian art.
cn: 夏季鸟类向北迁徙。
她在海洋保护区做志愿者度过夏天。
文艺复兴是意大利艺术的鼎盛时期。

en: The sun rises in the east.
She sat in the garden, enjoying the warm sun.
Too much exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
cn: 太阳从东方升起。
她坐在花园里，享受着温暖的阳光。
过度暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

definitions.definition: 星期日（一周的第七天，基督教传统中的安息日）

en: We'll meet next Sunday for brunch.
Sunday is my only day off.
The store closes early on Sundays.
cn: 我们下周日早午餐时见面。
星期日是我唯一的休息日。
这家店每逢周日提早打烊。

en: The sunlight filtered through the leaves, painting patterns on the ground.
Morning sunlight is essential for regulating our circadian rhythm.
She drew the curtains to block the harsh midday sunlight.
cn: 阳光透过树叶，在地面上投下斑驳的光影。
晨光对调节人体生物钟至关重要。
她拉上窗帘以遮挡正午刺眼的阳光。

en: It's a sunny day, perfect for a picnic.
Her sunny smile brightened the room.
We moved to a sunny apartment with large windows.
cn: 今天是晴朗的一天，非常适合野餐。
她开朗的笑容照亮了整个房间。
我们搬进了一间阳光充足、窗户宽敞的公寓。

definitions.definition: 日出（太阳从地平线升起的自然现象）
黎明时分（日出的时间段）

en: We climbed the hill to watch the sunrise.
The sunrise painted the sky in shades of pink and gold.
Farmers start working before sunrise during harvest season.
cn: 我们爬上小山观看日出。
日出的霞光将天空染成粉金交织的色彩。
收获季节，农民们在日出前就开始劳作。

en: The sky turns orange during sunset.
He enjoyed painting sunsets by the beach.
The company is now in the sunset of its dominance.
cn: 日落时天空会变成橙色。
他喜欢在海边画日落。
这家公司正处于统治地位的衰退期。

en: The cat stretched lazily in the warm sunshine.
Her smile brought sunshine to everyone around her.
Solar panels convert sunshine into electricity.
cn: 猫咪在温暖的阳光中慵懒地伸展身体。
她的笑容为周围的人带来了快乐。
太阳能板将阳光转化为电能。

en: She did a super job on the project.
This car is super fast.
He worked as a super in a Broadway show.
cn: 她在这个项目上表现极佳。
这辆车速度非常快。
他在一部百老汇剧里当临时演员。

en: His knowledge of the subject is purely superficial.
The wound is only superficial and doesn’t require stitches.
She smiled, but it was a superficial gesture hiding her frustration.
cn: 他对这门学科的了解非常肤浅。
伤口只是表皮伤，无需缝合。
她笑了，但这只是掩饰沮丧的表面姿态。

en: This product is clearly superior to its competitors in terms of durability.
She reported the issue to her superior immediately.
His superior attitude often alienates his colleagues.
cn: 这款产品在耐用性上明显优于竞争对手。
她立即向她的上级汇报了该问题。
他高高在上的态度常常疏远同事。

definitions.definition: 大型零售商店，销售多种食品和日用品

en: She buys fresh vegetables at the supermarket every weekend.
The new supermarket offers a wide range of organic products.
Supermarkets have replaced many small local shops in urban areas.
cn: 她每周末在超市购买新鲜蔬菜。
这家新超市提供多种有机产品。
在城市地区，超市已取代了许多小型本地商店。

definitions.definition: 晚餐（尤指非正式的家常晚餐）

en: We had a light supper of soup and bread.
She invited friends over for supper after the movie.
In some regions, "supper" refers to a late-evening meal.
cn: 我们吃了一顿简单的晚餐，只有汤和面包。
她邀请朋友们看完电影后来自家用晚餐。
在某些地区，“supper”指深夜的一餐。

en: The magazine includes a free supplement on travel tips.
She takes vitamin D to supplement her diet.
The data was used to supplement the research findings.
cn: 这本杂志附赠一份旅游指南增刊。
她服用维生素D来补充饮食营养。
这些数据被用来补充研究结果。

en: The company will supply fresh vegetables to local markets.
Water supply was cut off during the storm.
She supplied the answer without hesitation.
cn: 该公司将向当地市场供应新鲜蔬菜。
暴风雨期间供水被切断。
她毫不犹豫地给出了答案。

en: The beams support the weight of the roof.
She always supports her friends in difficult times.
The charity provides financial support to local schools.
cn: 横梁支撑着屋顶的重量。
她总是在朋友困难时给予支持。
该慈善机构为当地学校提供资金援助。

definitions.definition: 推测（常与 that 从句连用）

en: Let us suppose for a moment that the theory is correct.
I suppose you're right, but I still have doubts.
What do you suppose will happen next?
cn: 我们暂且假设这个理论是正确的。
我认为你是对的，但我仍有疑虑。
你推测接下来会发生什么？

en: The Supreme Court has the final authority on constitutional matters.
She handled the crisis with supreme calmness.
This dish requires supreme skill to prepare.
cn: 美国最高法院对宪法事务拥有最终裁决权。
她以极度冷静的态度处理了危机。
这道菜需要极高的技巧来烹制。

en: Are you sure about the meeting time?
This is a sure way to solve the problem.
"Can you help me?" "Sure!"
cn: 你确定会议时间吗？
这是解决问题的稳妥方法。
“能帮我吗？”“当然！”

en: She will surely succeed with such dedication.
Surely you can't be serious about quitting?
The project will surely be completed by Friday.
cn: 她如此努力，肯定会成功。
你不会真要辞职吧？（表强调质疑）
这个项目周五前一定能完成。

en: The submarine finally surfaced after a long dive.
She carefully polished the surface of the wooden table.
His calm demeanor hides the turmoil beneath the surface.
cn: 潜艇在长时间潜水后终于浮出水面。
她仔细打磨了木桌的表面。
他平静的外表下隐藏着内心的动荡。

en: The surgeon performed a life-saving operation.
He trained for years to become a skilled surgeon.
Military surgeons often work in challenging conditions.
cn: 这位外科医生完成了一场挽救生命的手术。
他经过多年训练成为了一名技术娴熟的外科医生。
军医常在充满挑战的环境中工作。

en: The patient underwent surgery to remove the tumor.
She works in the surgery at the local hospital.
The doctor’s surgery is closed on weekends.
cn: 患者接受了肿瘤切除手术。
她在当地医院的手术室工作。
这位医生的诊所周六日休息。

en: Her surname is inherited from her father's family.
In some cultures, the surname comes before the given name.
The actor changed his surname to sound more memorable.
cn: 她的姓氏继承自父亲的家族。
在某些文化中，姓氏排在名字之前。
这位演员改了姓氏，为了让人们更容易记住。

en: Her sudden arrival gave me a pleasant surprise.
The news surprised everyone in the room.
He planned a surprise party for his wife’s birthday.
cn: 她的突然到访给了我一个愉快的惊喜。
这消息让房间里所有人都感到惊讶。
他为妻子的生日策划了一场惊喜派对。

definitions.definition: 令人惊讶的；出乎意料的

en: The results were surprisingly positive.
She gave him a surprising answer.
It's surprising how fast time flies.
cn: 结果出乎意料地好。
她给了他一个令人惊讶的回答。
时间飞逝的速度令人惊讶。

definitions.definition: 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地

en: Surprisingly, the experiment succeeded on the first attempt.
She was surprisingly calm during the crisis.
The results were surprisingly consistent across all tests.
cn: 出乎意料的是，实验首次尝试就成功了。
她在危机中异常冷静。
所有测试的结果出奇地一致。

en: The soldiers refused to surrender despite being surrounded.
She surrendered her passport to the immigration officer.
Surrendering to fear will only limit your potential.
cn: 尽管被包围，士兵们拒绝投降。
她将护照交给移民官员。
向恐惧屈服只会限制你的潜力。

en: The mountains surround the valley like a natural fortress.
She used a fence to surround her garden.
The sound system creates an immersive surround experience.
cn: 群山如天然堡垒般环绕着山谷。
她用篱笆围住了花园。
音响系统营造出沉浸式的环绕音效。

en: The hotel blends perfectly with its natural surroundings.
She grew up in comfortable urban surroundings.
Noise pollution can disrupt the tranquility of your surroundings.
cn: 这家酒店与周围的自然环境完美融合。
她在舒适的城市环境中长大。
噪音污染会破坏周围环境的宁静。

en: The team conducted a survey to assess customer satisfaction.
From the hill, we could survey the entire valley.
The geological survey revealed rich mineral deposits.
cn: 团队开展了一项调查以评估客户满意度。
从山顶上，我们可以俯瞰整个山谷。
地质勘测发现了丰富的矿藏。

en: Few animals can survive in the desert without water.
She survived the accident but lost her memory.
This tradition has survived for centuries.
cn: 没有水，很少有动物能在沙漠中生存。
她在事故中幸存，但失去了记忆。
这一传统已延续了数百年。

en: The police suspect him of stealing the jewels.
She gave a suspect answer during the interview.
The main suspect was released due to lack of evidence.
cn: 警方怀疑他盗窃了珠宝。
她在面试中给出了一个可疑的回答。
由于证据不足，主要嫌疑人被释放。

en: The construction project was suspended due to budget cuts.
A lantern was suspended from the ceiling, casting a warm glow.
The athlete received a suspended sentence for violating the rules.
cn: 该建设项目因预算削减被暂停。
一盏灯笼从天花板垂下，投下温暖的光晕。
该运动员因违规被处以缓刑。

definitions.definition: 少许，微量（如 a suspicion of salt）

en: She regarded his offer with suspicion.
There was a suspicion of sadness in her voice.
His actions aroused no suspicion among the guards.
cn: 她对他的提议心存怀疑。
她的声音里有一丝悲伤。
他的行为没有引起守卫的怀疑。

definitions.definition: 维持；支撑（如生命、系统等）
遭受；经受（如损伤、压力等）
确认；支持（如理论、主张等）

en: The pillars are designed to sustain the weight of the roof.
She sustained a serious injury during the match.
The evidence is insufficient to sustain his argument.
cn: 这些柱子用于支撑屋顶的重量。
她在比赛中受了重伤。
证据不足以支持他的论点。

en: She swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
Swallows return to build nests in spring.
He had to swallow his disappointment and congratulate her.
cn: 她用水吞下了药片。
燕子春天归来筑巢。
他不得不压下失望向她祝贺。

definitions.definition: 沼泽（低洼潮湿的软土地）

en: The explorers got lost in the dense swamp.
Heavy rain swamped the coastal town.
She felt swamped by work deadlines.
cn: 探险者在茂密的沼泽中迷路了。
暴雨淹没了沿海小镇。
她被工作截止日期压得喘不过气。

definitions.definition: 天鹅（大型水鸟，象征优雅或纯洁）
闲荡；悠然游荡（非正式用法）

en: The swan glided gracefully across the lake.
She spent the afternoon swanning around the boutique.
In mythology, the swan is often a symbol of transformation.
cn: 天鹅优雅地滑过湖面。
她整个下午在精品店里闲逛。
神话中，天鹅常象征蜕变。

definitions.definition: 一大群（昆虫、鸟类等）；蜂群

en: A swarm of bees descended on the flowering tree.
Tourists began to swarm the square as the festival started.
The data center was swarming with technicians during the upgrade.
cn: 一大群蜜蜂落在开花的树上。
节日开始时，游客们涌向广场。
升级期间，数据中心挤满了技术人员。

definitions.definition: 使摇摆；影响（观点或决定）

en: The trees sway gently in the breeze.
Her speech swayed the audience's opinion.
The king held sway over the region for decades.
cn: 树木在微风中轻轻摇曳。
她的演讲影响了听众的观点。
国王统治该地区长达数十年。

en: He swore to tell the truth in court.
She angrily swore at the broken printer.
They swore allegiance to the new leader.
cn: 他在法庭上发誓说实话。
她对着坏掉的打印机愤怒咒骂。
他们宣誓效忠新领袖。

en: After the workout, his shirt was soaked with sweat.
She sweated for hours to finish the project before the deadline.
The chef sweated the onions to bring out their sweetness.
cn: 训练后，他的衬衫被汗水浸透了。
她拼命工作数小时，赶在截止日期前完成项目。
厨师煸炒洋葱以激发其甜味。

definitions.definition: （非正式）发汗者（如运动时大量出汗的人）

en: She knitted a cozy sweater for her grandson.
This wool sweater keeps me warm in winter.
After the marathon, he was such a sweater that his shirt was soaked.
cn: 她为孙子织了一件舒适的毛衣。
这件羊毛毛衣让我在冬天保持温暖。
马拉松后，他出汗严重，衬衫都湿透了。

en: She sweeps the floor every morning.
The storm swept across the coastal town.
His eyes swept over the crowd, searching for a familiar face.
cn: 她每天早晨扫地。
风暴席卷了沿海小镇。
他的目光扫过人群，寻找一张熟悉的面孔。

en: The tea is too sweet for my taste.
She has a sweet voice that calms everyone.
He offered her a box of assorted sweets.
cn: 这茶对我来说太甜了。
她甜美的嗓音能让所有人平静下来。
他送给她一盒什锦糖果。

en: The river swells after heavy rain.
Her ankle began to swell from the injury.
The crowd’s cheers swelled as the team scored.
cn: 大雨后河水上涨。
她的脚踝因受伤开始肿胀。
球队得分时，人群欢呼声高涨。

definitions.definition: 雨燕（一种快速飞行的鸟）

Swifts are known for their incredible aerial speed.
She gave him a swift glance before turning away.
cn: 团队的迅速反应节省了宝贵时间。
雨燕以惊人的飞行速度闻名。
她迅速瞥了他一眼，然后转身离开。

en: She swims every morning to stay fit.
The room began to swim before his eyes.
They swam the horses across the river.
cn: 她每天早晨游泳保持健康。
房间在他眼前开始旋转。
他们让马匹游过了河。

en: The children love to swing on the playground.
His mood can swing from joy to anger in seconds.
The jazz band played with a strong swing rhythm.
cn: 孩子们喜欢在游乐场荡秋千。
他的情绪几秒内就能从开心转为愤怒。
爵士乐队以强烈的摇摆节奏演奏。

en: She bought a Swiss watch as a souvenir.
The Swiss are known for their precision in craftsmanship.
This cheese has a distinct Swiss flavor.
cn: 她买了一块瑞士手表作为纪念品。
瑞士人以精湛的工艺闻名。
这种奶酪具有独特的瑞士风味。

en: She flipped the switch to turn on the light.
The train switched tracks at the junction.
He made a sudden switch from anger to laughter.
cn: 她按下开关打开了灯。
火车在枢纽处切换了轨道。
他的情绪突然从愤怒转为大笑。

definitions.definition: 剑；刀（尤指长而锋利的武器）

en: The knight drew his sword and charged at the enemy.
Legends say this magical sword can cut through anything.
He trained for years to master the art of the sword.
cn: 骑士拔出剑，冲向敌人。
传说这把魔法剑能斩断一切。
他经过多年训练，掌握了剑术。

The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
Her red scarf became a symbol of rebellion.
cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
金的化学符号是Au。
她的红围巾成了反抗的标志。

The government is sympathetic to environmental concerns.
The sympathetic nervous system prepares the body for stress responses.
cn: 当我讲述我的损失时，她向我投以同情的微笑。
政府对环境问题表示支持。
交感神经系统使身体为应激反应做好准备。

definitions.definition: 赞同；支持（与 with 连用）

en: She could sympathize with his struggles after experiencing similar hardships.
Many voters sympathize with the candidate’s environmental policies.
It’s hard not to sympathize when you see someone in genuine distress.
cn: 她经历过类似的困境，因此能同情他的挣扎。
许多选民赞同该候选人的环保政策。
当看到有人真正陷入痛苦时，很难不产生同情。

definitions.definition: 同情（对他人的痛苦或困境的理解与共鸣）
赞同（对观点或行动的支持）

en: She expressed deep sympathy for the victims of the earthquake.
His ideas are in sympathy with the environmental movement.
A good leader should have the ability to show sympathy.
cn: 她对地震受害者表达了深切的同情。
他的观点与环保运动的理念一致。
优秀的领导者应具备共情能力。

en: The jacket is made of synthetic fabric.
His argument was a synthetic analysis of multiple theories.
Scientists developed a synthetic version of the natural compound.
cn: 这件夹克由合成纤维制成。
他的论点是对多种理论的综合分析。
科学家研制出该天然化合物的合成版本。

The company implemented a new filing system to improve efficiency.
His immune system was weakened after the illness.
cn: 太阳系由太阳及其环绕的行星组成。
该公司实施了新的文件归档系统以提高效率。
他的免疫系统在病后变得脆弱。

Her systematic organization of files saved hours of work.
Systematic errors in the experiment were carefully analyzed.
cn: 研究者们采用系统化的方法收集数据。
她对文件的有条理整理节省了大量工作时间。
实验中的系统性误差被仔细分析。

en: She placed the books on the wooden table.
The report includes a table of statistics.
The committee decided to table the proposal for further discussion.
cn: 她把书放在了木桌上。
报告中含有一张统计表格。
委员会决定暂缓提案以进一步讨论。

definitions.definition: 药片；小块固体（如肥皂、巧克力）
古代书写用的刻字板（如黏土板、石板）

She scribbled notes on her digital tablet.
Archaeologists found cuneiform tablets in Mesopotamia.
cn: 医生建议每日服用两片药。
她在平板电脑上快速记笔记。

The scientist tagged the birds to track their migration.

The tail of the comet was visible for weeks.
The detective decided to tail the suspect.
cn: 那只狗开心地摇着尾巴。

侦探决定跟踪嫌疑人。

cn: 裁缝为我量体定制了一套新西装。

The professor gave a talk on climate change.

cn: 她喜欢谈论她的旅行。
