The skyscraper stands tall against the city skyline.
He told a tall story about catching a fish as big as a car.
cn: 她是班上最高的女孩。

It took years to tame the wild horse.
Her adventurous spirit could never be tamed.
cn: 这只狮子在圈养环境中出生，非常温顺。
驯服这匹野马花了数年时间。

The leather is tanned using natural vegetable extracts.
His arms were tanned from working outdoors all summer.
cn: 她在西班牙度假后晒得黝黑。
这种皮革用天然植物提取物鞣制。

The factory tanks crude oil for processing.

He tapped his fingers nervously on the table.
The company plans to tap into new markets.
cn: 她关掉水龙头以节约用水。
他紧张地用手指轻敲桌子。
该公司计划开发新市场。

cn: 她用胶带封住了箱子。

cn: 箭射中了靶心。
该活动以年轻选民为目标群体。

The manager tasked him with organizing the event.

cn: 她提前完成了任务。
经理指派他负责活动筹备。

en: The soup has a salty taste.

Taste the sauce and tell me if it needs more salt.
cn: 这汤尝起来很咸。
她对音乐有极佳的品味。

Filing taxes can be a complex process.
cn: 政府计划明年提高所得税。
人口过剩给城市基础设施带来负担。

en: She took a taxi to the airport.
The plane was taxiing to the runway.
Taxi drivers in London must pass a rigorous test.
cn: 她乘出租车去了机场。
飞机正滑行至跑道。
伦敦的出租车司机必须通过严格考试。

en: She prefers green tea to black tea.
We met for tea at the new café.
The tea from this region has a unique floral aroma.
cn: 她喜欢绿茶胜过红茶。
我们在新咖啡馆喝了下午茶。
这个地区的茶叶带有独特的花香。

Experience taught him to be cautious.
The robot is programmed to teach children basic coding.
cn: 她在当地一所高中教数学。
经历教会了他谨慎。
这款机器人被编程用于教授儿童基础编程。

en: She is a dedicated teacher who inspires her students.
The teacher explained the concept with simple examples.
Every great teacher possesses patience and creativity.
cn: 她是一位激励学生的敬业教师。
老师用简单的例子解释了这个概念。
每位优秀的教师都具备耐心与创造力。

en: Her passion for teaching inspires her students.
The school focuses on innovative teaching methods.
He has over 10 years of teaching experience.
cn: 她对教学的热情激励着她的学生。
这所学校注重创新教学法。
他拥有超过10年的教学经验。

cn: 她加入了一个研究气候变化的科学家团队。

Be careful not to tear the paper when unwrapping the gift.
The athlete tore across the finish line with incredible speed.
cn: 她听着悲伤的故事，一滴泪水滑落脸颊。

运动员以惊人速度冲过终点线。

definitions.definition: 技术的；与工艺或科学相关的
专业的；需要特殊知识的

en: The manual provides technical details about the software.
Her report was too technical for most readers.
He faced technical difficulties during the experiment.
cn: 手册提供了关于该软件的技术细节。
她的报告对大多数读者来说过于专业。
他在实验中遇到了技术性难题。

cn: 实验室技师仔细校准了显微镜。

cn: 她通过多年练习掌握了油画技巧。

cn: 这场讲座冗长乏味，半数听众都睡着了。
填写这些表格是项枯燥但必要的工作。

The invention of the telegraph revolutionized communication.
cn: 消息通过电报传送。
他的表情暴露了他的失望。
电报的发明彻底改变了通信方式。

en: She answered the telephone on the first ring.
He telephoned his boss to report the issue.
The invention of the telephone revolutionized communication.
cn: 她电话铃一响就接了起来。
他打电话向老板汇报了问题。
电话的发明彻底改变了通信方式。

definitions.definition: 望远镜（用于观测远处物体的光学仪器）
压缩；套叠（如将多节式物体缩短）

en: He pointed the telescope at the distant galaxy.
The car antenna telescopes into a compact size.
Her research telescopes centuries of cultural evolution.
cn: 他用望远镜对准了遥远的星系。
这根汽车天线可缩叠为紧凑尺寸。
她的研究浓缩了数个世纪的文化演变。

definitions.definition: 电视（指设备或节目内容）

en: She works in television as a news producer.
The invention of television revolutionized entertainment.
We watched the live concert on television last night.
cn: 她在电视台担任新闻制片人。
电视的发明彻底改变了娱乐方式。
昨晚我们在电视上观看了现场音乐会。

definitions.definition: 产生明显影响（如 Time will tell）

en: Can you tell me the time?
The twins are so alike that even their mother can't tell them apart.
Her smile told me everything I needed to know.
cn: 你能告诉我时间吗？
这对双胞胎太像了，连他们的母亲都分不清。
她的微笑告诉了我一切。

en: She struggled to control her temper during the argument.
The blacksmith tempers steel to make it stronger.
A good leader knows how to temper justice with mercy.
cn: 她在争论中努力控制脾气。
铁匠锻钢以增强其硬度。
优秀的领袖懂得刚柔并济。

en: The nurse checked the patient's temperature every hour.
The temperature in the desert can drop sharply at night.
There was a noticeable rise in political temperature during the debate.
cn: 护士每小时检查一次病人的体温。
沙漠中的温度夜间会急剧下降。
辩论期间，政治氛围明显升温。

en: The ancient temple was carved into the mountainside.
She felt a throbbing pain in her left temple.
The temple complex attracts thousands of pilgrims annually.
cn: 这座古庙凿刻在山坡上。
她的左太阳穴感到阵阵抽痛。
这座寺庙建筑群每年吸引数千名朝圣者。

en: The office is in a temporary location during renovations.
She found a temporary job to pay her bills.
The solution is only temporary, not permanent.
cn: 翻修期间，办公室暂设在一个临时地点。
她找到一份临时工作来支付账单。
这个解决方案只是暂时的，并非永久性的。

en: The smell of fresh bread tempted him to break his diet.
She was tempted by the job offer but decided to stay loyal to her current company.
Don’t tempt fate by ignoring safety rules.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气诱使他打破了节食计划。
她虽被那份工作邀请吸引，但最终决定忠于现在的公司。
别无视安全规则去冒险试探命运。

en: The smell of fresh bread was a constant temptation.
He resisted the temptation to check his phone during the meeting.
Money can be a great temptation for some people.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气是一种持续的诱惑。
他忍住了在会上查看手机的冲动。
对某些人而言，金钱可能是巨大的诱惑。

en: She counted from one to ten slowly.
The team scored ten goals in the match.
Ten years is a significant milestone.
cn: 她慢慢地从一数到十。
这支队伍在比赛中进了十个球。
十年是一个重要的里程碑。

en: The tenant pays rent to the landlord on the first of each month.
This law protects the rights of both tenants and property owners.
She decided to tenant the apartment for another year.
cn: 每月1日，租户向房东支付租金。
该法律保护租户和房产主的权利。
她决定续租这套公寓一年。

en: Plants tend to grow towards sunlight.
She tends her garden with great care.
People tend to forget details over time.
cn: 植物倾向于朝阳光生长。
她精心照料自己的花园。
随着时间的推移，人们容易忘记细节。

en: There is a growing tendency to work remotely.
His tendency to procrastinate caused problems.
The market shows a downward tendency this quarter.
cn: 远程工作的趋势日益增长。
他拖延的癖好引发了问题。
本季度市场呈现下行趋势。

en: The meat was so tender it melted in my mouth.
She submitted a tender for the construction project.
He spoke in a tender voice to comfort the child.
cn: 这块肉柔软得入口即化。
她为该建设项目提交了投标书。
他用温柔的声音安慰孩子。

en: She plays tennis every weekend to stay fit.
Wimbledon is the most prestigious tennis tournament in the world.
The tennis court was reserved for the championship match.
cn: 她每周末打网球以保持健康。
温网是全球最负盛名的网球赛事。
网球场被预留作锦标赛使用。

en: She felt tense before the interview.
The verb "ran" is in the past tense.
He tensed his muscles to lift the weight.
cn: 她在面试前感到紧张。
动词“ran”是过去时态。
他绷紧肌肉以举起重物。

en: We pitched a tent near the lake for our camping trip.
The soldiers were tented in the field during the exercise.
The circus tents were brightly colored and easy to spot.
cn: 我们在湖边搭了帐篷准备露营。
演习期间士兵们在野外住帐篷。
马戏团的帐篷颜色鲜艳，远远就能看见。

en: She finished in tenth place in the race.
A tenth of the profits will be donated to charity.
The tenth chapter of the book explores advanced theories.
cn: 她在比赛中获得了第十名。
利润的十分之一将捐赠给慈善机构。
书的第十章探讨了高级理论。

en: The president's term of office is four years.
"Algorithm" is a technical term in computer science.
The contract terms were negotiated carefully.
cn: 总统的任期是四年。
“算法”是计算机科学中的专业术语。
合同条款经过仔细协商。

definitions.definition: 终点站；终端；计算机终端

en: The bus stops at the terminal before heading back.
She was diagnosed with terminal illness.
Open a new terminal to run the command.
cn: 公交车在终点站停靠后返程。
她被诊断出患有晚期疾病。
打开新终端运行该命令。

definitions.definition: 极度的，严重的（非正式用法，如 "terrible cold"）

en: The earthquake was a terrible disaster.
She has a terrible headache after working all night.
The movie's special effects were terribly realistic.
cn: 这场地震是一场可怕的灾难。
她通宵工作后头痛欲裂。
这部电影的特效真实得吓人。

definitions.definition: 极好的，惊人的（现代常用义）
可怕的，令人恐惧的（古旧义）

en: The view from the mountaintop was terrific.
She gave a terrific performance in the play.
cn: 山顶的景色美得惊人。
她在剧中表现极为出色。

en: The wolves marked their territory by howling at the full moon.
Neuroscience is uncharted territory for many biologists.
The dispute over the maritime territory lasted for decades.
cn: 狼群通过对着满月嚎叫来标记领地。
神经科学对许多生物学家来说是未知领域。
这片海域领土的争端持续了数十年。

en: The villagers lived in terror of the dragon.
The explosion was a terror to witness.
She has a terror of spiders.
cn: 村民生活在对巨龙的恐惧中。
爆炸的场景令人毛骨悚然。
她对蜘蛛有极度的恐惧。

en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check for infections.
This new software is still under test.
Hard times test true friendship.
cn: 医生要求验血以检查感染。
这款新软件仍在测试中。
患难见真情。

en: The book contains both original text and annotations.
She texted me the address this morning.
Students analyzed a historical text in class.
cn: 这本书包含原文和注释。
她今早把地址发短信给我了。
学生们在课上分析了一篇历史文献。

en: She forgot her biology textbook at school.
His reaction was a textbook example of panic.
This manual reads like a textbook on engineering.
cn: 她把生物课本忘在学校了。
他的反应是恐慌的典型范例。
这本手册读起来像工程学教科书。

en: The museum exhibits ancient Peruvian textiles.
She works in the textile industry.
This fabric has a unique textile pattern.
cn: 博物馆展出了古秘鲁的纺织品。
她在纺织行业工作。
这种面料有独特的纺织纹样。

definitions.definition: 用于比较结构中，表示“比”或“与其…不如…”

en: She is taller than her brother.
I would rather walk than take the bus.
Nothing is more important than health.
cn: 她比她的兄弟更高。
我宁愿走路也不坐公交车。
没有什么比健康更重要。

en: She thanked him for his help.
A simple "thank you" can make someone's day.
Thanks are due to all the volunteers.
cn: 她感谢他的帮助。
一句简单的“谢谢”能让人开心一整天。
应向所有志愿者致谢。

definitions.definition: 那个（指代特定的人或事物）
引导从句（如宾语从句、定语从句）

en: That is my favorite painting.
She said that she would come.
Look at that bird on the branch!
cn: 那是我最喜欢的画。
她说她会来。
看树枝上的那只鸟！

definitions.definition: 定冠词，用于特指已知或唯一的事物

en: The sun rises in the east.
She is the CEO of the company.
Pass me the blue book, please.
cn: 太阳从东方升起。
她是这家公司的首席执行官。
请递给我那本蓝色的书。

definitions.definition: 戏剧艺术（泛指表演艺术）
（事件发生的）场所（如手术室、战场等比喻用法）

en: The Globe Theatre premiered many of Shakespeare's plays.
She studied theatre at university before becoming an actress.
The Pacific became a major theatre of war during WWII.
cn: 环球剧院首演了莎士比亚的多部戏剧。
她在成为演员前于大学攻读戏剧艺术。
太平洋在二战期间成为主要战场。

definitions.definition: 他们的；她们的；它们的（第三人称复数所有格形式）

en: Their house is near the park.
The students forgot their textbooks.
Birds build their nests in trees.
cn: 他们的房子在公园附近。
学生们忘了带课本。
鸟儿在树上筑巢。

definitions.definition: 他们的（所有物）；他/她/它们的（所有物）

en: The decision is ultimately theirs to make.
These keys are theirs, not ours.
The victory was rightly theirs after months of effort.
cn: 最终决定权在他们手中。
这些钥匙是他们的，不是我们的。
经过数月的努力，胜利理应属于他们。

en: I gave them the books yesterday.
The teacher praised them for their hard work.
Let's invite them to the party.
cn: 我昨天把书给了他们。
老师表扬了他们努力学习。
我们邀请他们来参加派对吧。

definitions.definition: 他们自己（第三人称复数反身代词）

en: They finished the project by themselves.
The scientists themselves doubted the results.
Children should learn to organize themselves.
cn: 他们独立完成了这个项目。
科学家们亲自质疑了这些结果。
孩子们应学会自我管理。

definitions.definition: 那时；当时（指过去或未来的某个时间点）
然后；接着（表示时间或顺序）
那么；因此（用于逻辑推论）

en: She was living in Paris then.
Finish your homework, then you can play.
If it rains, then we’ll stay indoors.
cn: 她那时住在巴黎。
做完作业，然后你才能玩。
如果下雨，那我们就待在室内。

en: His argument was purely theoretical, with no experimental evidence.
The course covers both practical skills and theoretical knowledge.
In theoretical physics, many ideas remain unproven.
cn: 他的论点纯属理论，缺乏实验证据。
该课程涵盖实践技能与理论知识。
在理论物理学中，许多想法尚未被证实。

en: Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized physics.
Her theory about the crime proved to be correct.
In theory, the plan should work, but practical challenges remain.
cn: 爱因斯坦的相对论彻底改变了物理学。
她对案件的推测被证明是正确的。
理论上这个计划可行，但实际挑战依然存在。

en: She lives there with her family.
There are many possibilities to explore.
Put the book there on the shelf.
cn: 她与家人居住在那里。
存在许多值得探索的可能性。
把书放在那边的架子上。

definitions.definition: 因此，从而（表示结果或方式）

en: She improved her skills, thereby increasing her chances of promotion.
The treaty was signed, thereby ending the conflict.
He saved costs by automating the process, thereby boosting efficiency.
cn: 她提升了技能，从而增加了晋升机会。
条约签署，因此结束了冲突。
他通过流程自动化节省了成本，从而提高了效率。

definitions.definition: 因此，所以（表示因果逻辑）

en: The experiment failed; therefore, we need to revise the hypothesis.
He was late, therefore he missed the keynote speech.
The data shows a clear trend, therefore further analysis is justified.
cn: 实验失败了，因此我们需要修改假设。
他迟到了，所以错过了主题演讲。
数据显示明确趋势，因此进一步分析是合理的。

en: The doctor used a digital thermometer to check my fever.
A mercury thermometer is less common now due to safety concerns.
Place the outdoor thermometer in the shade for accurate readings.
cn: 医生用电子体温计测量我的发烧情况。
出于安全考虑，水银温度计现已较少使用。
将户外温度计置于阴凉处以获得准确读数。

en: These books belong to the library.
I prefer these colors to those.
Are these your keys on the table?
cn: 这些书属于图书馆。
比起那些颜色，我更喜欢这些。
桌上的这些钥匙是你的吗？

definitions.definition: 他们/她们/它们（第三人称复数主格）

en: They are arriving at 3 PM.
They say laughter is the best medicine.
If a student is late, they should apologize.
cn: 他们将在下午三点到达。
人们说笑是最好的良药。
如果有学生迟到，他们应该道歉。（中性单数用法）

definitions.definition: 最拥挤部分；最活跃部分

en: The fog was so thick that we could barely see the road.
She spread a thick layer of jam on the toast.
The audience was packed thick in the concert hall.
cn: 雾太浓了，我们几乎看不清路。
她在吐司上涂了厚厚一层果酱。
音乐厅里的观众挤得水泄不通。

en: The thickness of the ice determines its safety for skating.
Adjust the sauce thickness by adding more water or flour.
His accent has a noticeable thickness that reveals his regional origin.
cn: 冰层厚度决定了其是否适合滑冰。
通过加水或面粉调整酱汁的稠度。
他口音浓重，明显透露出他的地域背景。

en: The thief stole my wallet on the crowded train.
Security cameras helped police identify the thief.
She felt a pang of guilt after realizing she’d been a thief of joy.
cn: 小偷在拥挤的列车上偷走了我的钱包。
监控摄像头帮助警方辨认出了窃贼。
当她意识到自己成了剥夺他人快乐的人时，内心一阵愧疚。

en: The ice is too thin to skate on.
She sliced the cucumber into thin strips.
The fog began to thin as the sun rose.
cn: 冰层太薄，不能滑冰。
她把黄瓜切成细条。
太阳升起时，雾渐渐变淡。

definitions.definition: 物体；东西（泛指具体或抽象的事物）
事情；事件（指行为或情况）

en: She picked up a shiny thing from the ground.
The most important thing is to stay calm.
Strange things happened in that old house.
cn: 她从地上捡起一个闪亮的东西。
最重要的是保持冷静。
那栋老房子里发生过奇怪的事。

en: I need time to think about your proposal.
Do you think it will rain tomorrow?
She thinks of herself as a talented artist.
cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
你觉得明天会下雨吗？
她认为自己是个有才华的艺术家。

definitions.definition: 第三；三分之一；第三档（变速器）

en: She finished third in the race.
Cut the cake into thirds.
Shift to third gear when accelerating.
cn: 她在比赛中获得第三名。
将蛋糕切成三份。
加速时换到三档。

definitions.definition: 第三（用于列举条目或论点）

en: The plan has three main advantages: firstly, it is cost-effective; secondly, it is easy to implement; and thirdly, it is sustainable.
Firstly, I would like to thank our hosts. Secondly, I will outline the agenda. Thirdly, we will open the floor for discussion.
To apply, you must firstly complete the form, secondly provide two references, and thirdly submit a writing sample.
cn: 该计划有三个主要优点：第一，它具有成本效益；第二，它易于实施；第三，它是可持续的。
首先，我要感谢我们的主办方。其次，我将概述议程。第三，我们将开放讨论。
要申请，你必须首先填写表格，其次提供两份推荐信，第三提交一份写作样本。

en: The explorers died of thirst in the desert.
She thirsts for knowledge like a sponge.
His speech ignited a thirst for change in the crowd.
cn: 探险者们在沙漠中因口渴而死。
她如海绵般渴求知识。
他的演讲点燃了人群对变革的渴望。

en: The marathon runners were extremely thirsty after the race.
She is thirsty for adventure and new experiences.
The plants look thirsty; they need watering.
cn: 马拉松选手赛后极度口渴。
她渴望冒险与新的体验。
这些植物看起来缺水，需要浇水。

en: She celebrated her thirteenth birthday last week.
The ancient text mentions thirteen sacred trees.
Thirteen is considered unlucky in some cultures.
cn: 她上周庆祝了她的十三岁生日。
古籍中提到了十三棵圣树。
在某些文化中，十三被视为不吉利的数字。

en: She celebrated her thirtieth birthday last week.
The book has thirty chapters in total.
Thirty students participated in the science fair.
cn: 她上周庆祝了三十岁生日。
这本书共有三十章。
三十名学生参加了科学展览会。

definitions.definition: 这，这个（指代近处或刚提及的事物）

en: This is my favorite book.
Look at this beautiful painting!
I can't believe this happened.
cn: 这是我最喜欢的书。
看这幅美丽的画！
我不敢相信这件事发生了。

en: The rose bush is covered with sharp thorns.
He pricked his finger on a hawthorn thorn.
In folklore, the thorn symbolizes both protection and pain.
cn: 玫瑰丛长满了尖刺。
他的手指被山楂刺扎伤了。
在民间传说中，荆棘既象征保护，也代表痛苦。

en: She gave the room a thorough cleaning before the guests arrived.
The report was thorough in its analysis of the economic crisis.
His thorough approach to research earned him academic recognition.
cn: 她在客人到来前彻底打扫了房间。
这份报告对经济危机的分析非常全面。
他严谨的研究方法为他赢得了学术认可。

definitions.definition: 那些的（用于修饰复数名词）

en: Those books on the shelf are mine.
I prefer these flowers to those in the vase.
Can you pass me those papers?
cn: 书架上的那些书是我的。
比起花瓶里的那些花，我更喜欢这些。
你能把那些文件递给我吗？

definitions.definition: 然而，不过（非正式用法，多用于句尾）

en: Though it was raining, we went hiking.
She promised to call. She didn't, though.
I'll finish the report tonight, though I may need coffee.
cn: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去徒步了。
她答应会打电话，不过最终没打。
我会今晚完成报告，虽然可能需要咖啡提神。

en: She paused, lost in thought.
Ancient Greek thought influenced Western philosophy.
His first thought was to call for help.
cn: 她停下来，陷入沉思。
古希腊思想影响了西方哲学。
他的第一个念头是呼救。

definitions.definition: 富有思想的（如文学作品）

en: She gave a thoughtful answer after a long silence.
It was thoughtful of you to bring her favorite flowers.
His essay is both critical and thoughtful.
cn: 她在长时间沉默后给出了深思熟虑的回答。
你带了她最喜欢的花，真是体贴。
他的论文既有批判性又富有见地。

en: The ancient temple is over a thousand years old.
She has a thousand reasons to smile today.
The crowd numbered in the thousands at the concert.
cn: 这座古庙有一千多年的历史。
她今天有无数个微笑的理由。
音乐会上聚集了数千人。

definitions.definition: 线；细丝；线索；线程（计算机术语）
穿线于；穿过；将（珠子等）串起来

en: She carefully threaded the needle with a thin blue thread.
The detective followed the thread of evidence to solve the case.
Each thread in the program runs independently.
cn: 她小心地用一根细蓝线穿针。
侦探循着证据的线索破案。
程序中的每个线程独立运行。

en: The hurricane poses a serious threat to coastal areas.
She ignored his threats and stood her ground.
Climate change is an existential threat to humanity.

Divide the cake into three equal parts.
cn: 她养了三只猫和两只狗。

这个瓶子的颈部很窄。

This is a through train to Paris.

这是一班直达巴黎的列车。

She remained calm throughout the crisis.
The theme is evident throughout his work.
cn: 消息传遍了整座城市。
她在整个危机期间保持冷静。

The engine generates enough thrust to lift the spacecraft.

发动机产生足以推动航天器的推力。

definitions.definition: 拇指；拇指部分（如手套的）
用拇指翻动（书页等）；竖起拇指搭便车

He thumbed through the pages of the old book carefully.
We hitched a ride by thumbing on the highway.

他用拇指小心地翻动旧书的书页。
我们在公路上竖起拇指搭便车。

His voice thundered across the room.
She could hear distant thunder on the horizon.
cn: 暴风雨临近时，雷声轰鸣。

cn: 我们计划在周四下午开会。
周四常被称为“小周五”，因为周末临近。
包裹最迟下周四送达。

definitions.definition: 因此，于是（表示结果或推论）
如此，这样（表示方式或程度）

definitions.definition: 票（如车票、门票）；罚款单；候选人名单

警察因超速给他开了罚单。

cn: 船只随潮水漂入。
我们必须逆舆论潮流而行。

cn: 她始终保持书桌整洁。
他在客人到来前整理了房间。

她像猛虎一样为保护家人而战。

She kept a tight grip on the rope during the climb.
The company has tight security measures.
cn: 这个罐子盖太紧了，我打不开。
她在攀爬时紧紧抓住绳子。
该公司有严格的安全措施。

The cashier opened the till to give change.
Farmers till the soil before planting crops.
cn: 在这里等到我回来。
收银员打开钱柜找零。
农民在种植前翻耕土地。

definitions.definition: （伐木工警示用语）倒啦！（树木倒下时的警告喊声）

cn: 欢乐时光总是过得飞快。
她精准把控了演讲时长。

cn: 学校课程表显示了周一到周五的所有课程。

cn: 医生在显微镜下检查肌肉组织。
她递给我一张纸巾擦眼泪。
艺术家用薄纸在拼贴画中营造层次感。

cn: 这本书在书架的最上层。

This train runs on a single track.
Scientists track the migration patterns of birds.
cn: 猎人追踪雪地上动物的足迹。
这列火车在单轨上行驶。
科学家追踪鸟类的迁徙模式。

en: The farmer used a tractor to plow the field.
The airport tractor pulled the cargo to the runway.
Modern tractors are equipped with GPS technology.
cn: 农民用拖拉机耕地。
机场牵引车将货物拖至跑道。
现代拖拉机配备了GPS技术。

en: International trade boosts economic growth.
She traded her old books for a new laptop.
He works in the construction trade.
cn: 国际贸易促进经济增长。
她用旧书换了一台新笔记本电脑。
他从事建筑行业。

definitions.definition: 传统（指长期沿袭的习俗、信仰或行为方式）
惯例（特定群体中代代相传的做法）

en: The festival is part of our local tradition.
She broke with tradition by choosing a modern wedding dress.
Oral traditions preserve histories before written records existed.
cn: 这个节日是我们当地传统的一部分。
她打破惯例，选择了一件现代婚纱。
口头传统保存了文字记录出现之前的历史。

en: The festival celebrates traditional dances passed down for generations.
His views on education are quite traditional.
Some criticize the method as being too traditional and inflexible.
cn: 这个节日庆祝世代相传的传统舞蹈。
他的教育观念非常传统。
有人批评这种方法过于因循守旧且缺乏灵活性。

en: The city plans to reduce traffic congestion by building more bike lanes.
Illegal wildlife traffic is a serious global issue.
Many websites traffic in user data without consent.
cn: 该市计划通过修建更多自行车道来缓解交通拥堵。
非法野生动物贸易是一个严重的全球问题。
许多网站在未经同意的情况下交易用户数据。

en: Shakespeare's Hamlet is one of the greatest tragedies in literature.
The earthquake was a tragedy that claimed thousands of lives.
Her life turned into a tragedy after losing her family.
cn: 莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》是文学史上最伟大的悲剧之一。
这场地震是一场夺走数千人生命的灾难。
失去家人后，她的人生沦为一场悲剧。

en: The hikers followed a narrow trail through the forest.
Her long dress trailed behind her as she walked.
The detective trailed the suspect for days.
cn: 徒步者沿着森林中的狭窄小径前行。
她走路时，长裙拖在身后。
侦探追踪嫌疑人多日。

definitions.definition: 火车；行列；一系列相关事件

en: The train to Paris departs at 9 AM.
She trained hard for the marathon.
A train of events led to his resignation.
cn: 前往巴黎的火车上午9点发车。
她为马拉松刻苦训练。
一连串事件导致了他的辞职。

definitions.definition: 训练，培训（系统性学习或练习的过程）
锻炼（身体或技能的常规练习）

en: She underwent rigorous training for the marathon.
The company provides on-the-job training for new employees.
His daily training routine includes weightlifting and cardio.
cn: 她为马拉松接受了严格的训练。
该公司为新员工提供在职培训。
他的日常锻炼包括举重和有氧运动。

en: He was branded a traitor for leaking classified documents.
The spy lived in fear of being exposed as a traitor.
History remembers her not as a hero, but as a traitor to the cause.
cn: 他因泄露机密文件被斥为叛徒。
这名间谍终日害怕被揭穿为叛徒。
历史没有将她铭记为英雄，而是事业的叛徒。

definitions.definition: 矿车（尤指煤矿用轨道运输车）

en: The old tram clattered along the cobbled streets.
Miners loaded coal onto the tram underground.
Edinburgh's tram system is popular with tourists.
cn: 老旧的有轨电车在鹅卵石街道上哐当作响。
矿工将煤炭装入地下的矿车。
爱丁堡的有轨电车系统深受游客欢迎。

en: The soldiers tramped through the muddy field.
He lived as a tramp for years, traveling by train.
The old tramp steamer carried cargo across the Atlantic.
cn: 士兵们踩着泥泞的田野艰难行进。
他多年以流浪为生，乘火车四处漂泊。
那艘老旧的货运船载着货物穿越大西洋。

en: She transferred the files to a new folder.
The player requested a transfer to another club.
The course credits are not transferable to other universities.
cn: 她将文件转移到了新文件夹。
这名球员要求转会到另一家俱乐部。
这些课程学分不能转到其他大学。

definitions.definition: 使完全改变（形态、性质或功能）

en: The caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.
Technology has transformed how we communicate.
The old factory was transformed into a modern art gallery.
cn: 毛毛虫会蜕变成蝴蝶。
科技彻底改变了我们的交流方式。
这座旧工厂被改造成了一座现代艺术画廊。

definitions.definition: 转变；转化（形态、性质或结构的根本性改变）

en: The transformation of the old factory into a modern art space amazed everyone.
Digital transformation has become essential for businesses to stay competitive.
In biology, gene transfer can lead to the transformation of cell characteristics.
cn: 这座旧工厂转型为现代艺术空间的过程令人惊叹。
数字化转型已成为企业保持竞争力的关键。
生物学中，基因转移可能导致细胞特性的转化。

definitions.definition: 变形者；使改变形态的人或物

en: The power station uses a transformer to adjust voltage levels.
A caterpillar is a natural transformer, turning into a butterfly.
The film features robots that can transform into vehicles.
cn: 电站用变压器调节电压等级。
毛毛虫是天然的变形者，会蜕变成蝴蝶。
这部电影中的机器人能变形为车辆。

definitions.definition: 晶体管（一种半导体器件，用于放大或切换电子信号）

en: The invention of the transistor revolutionized modern electronics.
This amplifier uses silicon transistors for better performance.
Early computers relied on vacuum tubes before transistors were developed.
cn: 晶体管的发明彻底改变了现代电子技术。
该放大器使用硅晶体管以获得更佳性能。
在晶体管发明前，早期计算机依赖真空管运作。

en: She can translate French novels into English with remarkable accuracy.
The app instantly translates spoken words into text.
His anger was translated into aggressive behavior.
cn: 她能以极高的准确度将法语小说翻译成英文。
这款应用能将语音实时转化为文字。
他的愤怒转化为攻击性行为。

en: The translation of this poem captures its emotional depth.
Machine translation has improved significantly in recent years.
His work is a translation of scientific concepts into everyday language.
cn: 这首诗的翻译捕捉到了其情感深度。
近年来，机器翻译有了显著进步。
他的工作是将科学概念转化为日常语言。

definitions.definition: 传输（如能量、信号、疾病等）

en: The transmission of data through fiber optics is extremely fast.
The car's automatic transmission makes driving smoother.
Mosquitoes are vectors for the transmission of malaria.
cn: 通过光纤传输数据速度极快。
这辆车的自动变速器让驾驶更顺畅。
蚊子是疟疾传播的媒介。

definitions.definition: 传输（信号、信息等）；传送（热量、疾病等）

en: Fiber optics can transmit data at the speed of light.
Mosquitoes are known to transmit diseases like malaria.
The radio station will transmit the concert live tonight.
cn: 光纤能以光速传输数据。
蚊子以传播疟疾等疾病而闻名。
电台将于今晚直播这场音乐会。

en: The glass is so transparent that it looks invisible.
Her transparent honesty earned everyone’s trust.
The company aims for transparent communication with its clients.
cn: 这块玻璃透明得仿佛隐形。
她坦率的真诚赢得了所有人的信任。
该公司致力于与客户保持透明的沟通。

en: The goods will be transported by train.
Public transport is essential in urban areas.
The virus can be transported through water.
cn: 货物将通过火车运输。
公共交通在城市中至关重要。
病毒可能通过水源传播。

en: Public transportation reduces traffic congestion in cities.
The transportation of hazardous materials requires special permits.
High-speed rail is a sustainable form of transportation.
cn: 公共交通减轻了城市交通拥堵。
危险品的运输需要特殊许可。
高铁是一种可持续的交通方式。

definitions.definition: 设陷阱捕捉；使陷入困境

en: The hunter set a trap for the fox.
She felt trapped in her job.
The debate question was a trap to expose his bias.
cn: 猎人设下陷阱捕捉狐狸。
她觉得自己被工作困住了。
这个辩论问题是个揭露他偏见的圈套。

en: She loves to travel solo across Europe.
Air travel has become more affordable.
His travel diaries inspired many adventurers.
cn: 她喜欢独自在欧洲旅行。
航空旅行已变得更平价。
他的旅行日记激励了许多探险者。

en: She carried the tea cups on a silver tray.
Please leave your documents in the outgoing tray.
The waiter dropped a tray full of glasses.
cn: 她用一个银托盘端着茶杯。
请将文件放入待发文件盒中。
服务员打翻了一个装满玻璃杯的托盘。

definitions.definition: 叛国罪（蓄意背叛国家或君主的行为）
背信弃义（广义的背叛行为）

en: He was executed for treason after leaking military secrets.
Forgery of official documents is considered an act of treason in some countries.
She felt his silence was a personal treason against their friendship.
cn: 他因泄露军事机密而被判处叛国罪死刑。
伪造官方文件在某些国家被视为叛国行为。
她认为他的沉默是对两人友谊的背叛。

en: The pirate hid his treasure on a deserted island.
She treasures the handwritten letter from her grandmother.
The museum’s greatest treasure is a 500-year-old painting.
cn: 海盗将财宝藏在荒岛上。
她珍藏着祖母的手写信。
该博物馆的镇馆之宝是一幅有五百年历史的画作。

en: The doctor will treat your injury with care.
She treated her friends to a fancy dinner.
This new policy treats all employees equally.
cn: 医生会小心处理你的伤口。
她请朋友们吃了一顿豪华晚餐。
这项新政策平等对待所有员工。

en: The new treatment shows promising results for cancer patients.
His harsh treatment of employees led to high turnover.
The film’s treatment of historical events sparked controversy.
cn: 这种新疗法对癌症患者显示出良好的效果。
他对员工的苛刻对待导致高离职率。
这部电影对历史事件的表现手法引发了争议。

en: The two nations signed a peace treaty after years of conflict.
The treaty aims to reduce carbon emissions globally.
Medieval treaties often involved complex diplomatic rituals.
cn: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平条约。
该条约旨在全球范围内减少碳排放。
中世纪的条约常涉及复杂的外交仪式。

en: The oak tree in our backyard is over 100 years old.
This algorithm organizes data in a binary tree structure.
She carved their initials into the bark of the pine tree.
cn: 我们后院的橡树已有100多年树龄。
该算法用二叉树结构组织数据。
她把两人名字的首字母刻在松树树皮上。

en: Her voice trembled as she spoke about the accident.
The leaves trembled in the cold wind.
He felt a tremble of excitement before the performance.
cn: 她谈起事故时声音颤抖。
树叶在寒风中颤动。
表演前他因兴奋而微微发抖。

definitions.definition: 巨大的，极大的（指规模或程度）
极好的，惊人的（口语化褒义）

en: The earthquake caused tremendous damage to the city.
She has a tremendous talent for music.
We had a tremendous time at the concert last night.
cn: 地震对城市造成了巨大的破坏。
她在音乐方面有惊人的天赋。
昨晚我们在音乐会上玩得极其尽兴。

en: The trend towards remote work is accelerating globally.
Her designs always follow the latest fashion trends.
Interest rates are trending downward this quarter.
cn: 全球远程办公的趋势正在加速。
她的设计总是紧跟最新时尚潮流。
本季度利率呈下降趋势。

en: The new drug is undergoing clinical trials.
He faced trial for theft last year.
The trial version of the software has limited features.
cn: 这种新药正在进行临床试验。
他去年因盗窃罪受审。
该软件的试用版功能有限。

en: The teacher drew an equilateral triangle on the board.
She played the triangle in the school orchestra.
The Bermuda Triangle is famous for its mysterious disappearances.
cn: 老师在黑板上画了一个等边三角形。
她在学校乐团中演奏三角铁。
百慕大三角以神秘失踪事件闻名。

en: The Maasai tribe is known for its distinctive customs and red clothing.
Biologists classify lions and tigers under the same feline tribe.
She felt a strong connection to her tribe during the cultural festival.
cn: 马赛部落以其独特的习俗和红色服饰闻名。
生物学家将狮子和老虎归为同一猫科族。
在文化节期间，她感受到与族群的强烈联结。

en: The magician's trick amazed the audience.
Don't try to trick me into signing the contract.
She taught me a useful trick for remembering names.
cn: 魔术师的戏法让观众惊叹不已。
别想骗我签那份合同。
她教了我一个记住名字的实用诀窍。

definitions.definition: 琐事；少量；甜点（一种英式蛋糕）

en: Don’t waste time on such trifles.
She trifled with her food, barely eating a bite.
The dessert menu featured a classic English trifle.
cn: 别把时间浪费在这种琐事上。
她拨弄着食物，几乎一口没吃。
甜点菜单上有一道经典的英式水果蛋糕。

en: She trimmed the hedge with garden shears.
The room was decorated with festive trims.
He kept his beard neatly trimmed.
cn: 她用园艺剪刀修剪树篱。
房间用节日装饰物点缀。
他的胡须修剪得整整齐齐。

definitions.definition: 短途旅行；绊倒；幻觉体验
轻快地走；绊倒；产生幻觉

en: She tripped over the loose carpet and fell.
We took a weekend trip to the mountains.
The drug caused him to experience a bad trip.
cn: 她被松散的地毯绊倒了。
我们周末去山区短途旅行。
这种药物让他产生了糟糕的幻觉体验。

en: The team's triumph was celebrated by fans worldwide.
Good will always triumph over evil in the end.
Her face lit up with triumph as she crossed the finish line.
cn: 球队的胜利赢得了全球粉丝的庆祝。
善良终将战胜邪恶。
她冲过终点线时，脸上洋溢着胜利的喜悦。

en: A troop of monkeys was playing in the trees.
The soldiers trooped into the square for inspection.
She leads a Girl Scout troop every weekend.
cn: 一群猴子在树上玩耍。
士兵们列队进入广场接受检阅。
她每周末带领一支女童子军小队。

en: The tropical rainforest is home to diverse species.
She wore a bright tropical dress to the party.
His tropical enthusiasm infected everyone around him.
cn: 热带雨林是多种物种的家园。
她穿了一件鲜艳的热带风格连衣裙参加派对。
他如热带般的热情感染了周围的每个人。

en: She didn't want to trouble her parents with her financial problems.
The engine trouble delayed our flight by three hours.
Don't trouble yourself over such trivial matters.
cn: 她不想因财务问题打扰父母。
发动机故障使我们的航班延误了三小时。
别为这种琐事费心。

en: The software update caused a troublesome bug.
His knee injury proved troublesome during the match.
The instructions were unclear and troublesome to follow.
cn: 这次软件更新引发了一个棘手的漏洞。
他的膝盖伤势在比赛中成了大麻烦。
说明含糊不清，执行起来很费劲。

definitions.definition: 长裤，裤子（通常指两条裤腿的服装）

en: He rolled up his trousers to wade across the stream.
These trousers are too tight around the waist.
She prefers wearing trousers rather than skirts for hiking.
cn: 他卷起裤腿蹚过小溪。
这条裤子的腰部太紧了。
她徒步时更喜欢穿长裤而非裙子。

en: The truck delivered fresh produce to the market.
He trucks goods across the country every week.
The old truck broke down on the highway.
cn: 卡车将新鲜农产品运送到市场。
他每周用卡车在全国各地运输货物。
那辆旧卡车在高速公路上抛锚了。

en: Her story turned out to be true.
He remained true to his principles despite the pressure.
The arrow flew straight and true to its target.
cn: 她的故事后来被证实是真实的。
尽管面临压力，他仍忠于自己的原则。
箭笔直地飞向目标，分毫不差。

en: She truly believes in equality for all.
This is truly the best cake I've ever tasted.
He spoke truly about his experiences.
cn: 她真诚地相信人人平等。
这确实是我吃过最好吃的蛋糕。
他真实地讲述了自己的经历。

definitions.definition: 小号（铜管乐器）；喇叭状物

en: He played a triumphant fanfare on the trumpet.
The company trumpeted its new product as a breakthrough.
Elephants trumpeted loudly in the distance.
cn: 他用小号吹奏了一段胜利的号角。
该公司大肆宣扬其新产品是突破性成果。
远处传来大象响亮的吼叫声。

en: The squirrel ran up the trunk of the oak tree.
She packed her luggage into the trunk of the car.
The elephant used its trunk to pick up the peanut.
cn: 松鼠沿着橡树的树干跑上去。
她把行李装进了汽车后备箱。
大象用鼻子捡起了花生。

en: Children need to feel trust in their parents.
She trusted him with her secret.
Trust is the foundation of any relationship.
cn: 孩子需要对父母产生信任感。
她将秘密托付给他。
信任是一切关系的基础。

en: She always strives to tell the truth, even when it's difficult.
Scientific research aims to uncover the truth about natural phenomena.
There's a grain of truth in his exaggerated story.
cn: 她始终努力说出真相，即使这很困难。
科学研究旨在揭示自然现象背后的真理。
他夸张的故事里有一丝真实性。

en: She decided to try a new approach to solve the problem.
If at first you don't succeed, try again.
The judge will try the case next week.
cn: 她决定尝试一种新方法来解决这个问题。
如果最初没有成功，就再试一次。
法官将于下周审理此案。

en: She soaked her feet in a plastic tub of warm water.
The old fisherman rowed his tub across the lake.
The baby splashed happily in the tub during bath time.
cn: 她将双脚浸泡在装满温水的塑料盆中。
老渔夫划着他那艘笨拙的小船穿过湖泊。
洗澡时，婴儿在浴缸里开心地拍水嬉戏。

definitions.definition: 管状物；筒；地铁（英式英语）

en: She carefully placed the specimen in a glass tube.
The London Underground is often called "the Tube".
Old radios used vacuum tubes to amplify signals.
cn: 她将样本小心地放入玻璃管中。
伦敦地铁常被称作“the Tube”。
老式收音机用真空电子管放大信号。

definitions.definition: （衣服的）褶；食物（尤指糖果或蛋糕）

en: She tucked the letter under her pillow.
The dress has elegant tucks at the waist.
He bought a bag of tuck for the school trip.
cn: 她把信塞到了枕头下面。
这条裙子的腰部有精致的褶裥。
他为学校郊游买了一袋糖果。

en: We have a meeting scheduled for Tuesday morning.
Tuesday is often considered the most productive day of the week.
The event was postponed from Monday to Tuesday due to bad weather.
cn: 我们计划在周二上午开会。
周二常被视为一周中效率最高的一天。
由于天气恶劣，活动从周一推迟到周二。

en: The university raised tuition fees by 5% this year.
Private tuition helped her improve her math skills.
Tuition includes access to all campus facilities.
cn: 这所大学今年学费上涨了5%。
私人辅导帮助她提升了数学能力。
学费包含使用所有校园设施的费用。

en: The child tripped and tumbled down the hill.
Stock prices tumbled after the news broke.
She tumbled the clothes into the washing machine.
cn: 孩子绊了一跤，滚下了山坡。
消息传出后，股价暴跌。
她把衣服胡乱塞进洗衣机。

en: She hummed a familiar tune.
He tuned the guitar before the concert.
The engine needs to be tuned regularly.
cn: 她哼着一首熟悉的曲子。
他在音乐会前给吉他调了音。
发动机需要定期调试。

en: The train sped through the mountain tunnel.
Workers tunneled under the river to lay cables.
The rabbit escaped into a narrow tunnel.
cn: 火车飞速穿过山体隧道。
工人们在河底挖掘隧道铺设电缆。
兔子钻进了狭窄的地道。

definitions.definition: 涡轮机（一种通过流体冲击叶片旋转产生动力的机械装置）

en: The power plant uses a steam turbine to generate electricity.
Wind turbines convert kinetic energy into clean power.
The jet engine's turbine spins at over 10,000 RPM.
cn: 发电厂使用蒸汽涡轮机发电。
风力涡轮机将动能转化为清洁能源。
喷气发动机的涡轮转速超过每分钟1万转。

definitions.definition: 动荡的，混乱的（形容局势、气流等）
狂暴的，汹涌的（形容液体或气体运动）

en: The plane encountered turbulent air over the mountains.
His turbulent emotions made it hard to think clearly.
The 1960s were a turbulent period in American history.
cn: 飞机在山区遭遇了湍流。
他混乱的情绪让人难以清醒思考。
20世纪60年代是美国历史上动荡的时期。

definitions.definition: （非正式）失败或愚蠢的事物（俚语）

en: We roasted a turkey for Thanksgiving.
The project was a complete turkey.
Wild turkeys are native to North America.
cn: 我们为感恩节烤了一只火鸡。
这个项目彻底失败了。
野生火鸡原产于北美洲。

en: She turned the key slowly in the lock.
The conversation turned to climate change.
It's your turn to wash the dishes.
cn: 她慢慢转动锁里的钥匙。
话题转向了气候变化。
轮到你洗碗了。

en: The car slowed down at the sharp turning.
He specializes in the turning of wooden bowls.
The turning of the seasons marks the passage of time.
cn: 汽车在急转弯处减速。
他专攻木碗的车削工艺。
四季更迭标志着时间的流逝。

en: The farmer harvested a basket of fresh turnips from the field.
Turnip soup is a traditional dish in Northern Europe.
She diced the turnip into small cubes for the stew.
cn: 农夫从田里收获了一篮子新鲜的芜菁。
芜菁汤是北欧的传统菜肴。
她将芜菁切成小块用于炖菜。

en: She works as a private tutor for high school students.
He tutored me in math during the summer break.
The university offers free tutor sessions for freshmen.
cn: 她是一名为高中生服务的私人教师。
他在暑假期间辅导我数学。
这所大学为新生提供免费辅导课程。

en: She finished twelfth in the marathon.
December is the twelfth month of the year.
Cut the cake into twelfths for equal sharing.
cn: 她在马拉松比赛中获得第十二名。
十二月是一年中的第十二个月份。
将蛋糕切成十二等份以便公平分配。

en: She has twelve colored pencils in her case.
The clock struck twelve, signaling midnight.
Twelve jurors must reach a unanimous verdict.
cn: 她的笔盒里有十二支彩色铅笔。
钟敲了十二下，标志着午夜来临。
十二名陪审员必须达成一致裁决。

definitions.definition: 第二十个（人或物）；二十分之一

en: She celebrated her twentieth birthday in Paris.
This chapter is the twentieth in the book.
Only one twentieth of the participants finished the challenge.
cn: 她在巴黎庆祝了她的二十岁生日。
这一章是书中的第二十章。
只有二十分之一的参与者完成了挑战。

en: She bought twenty apples for the party.
The book has twenty chapters.
He scored twenty points in the game.
cn: 她为聚会买了二十个苹果。
这本书有二十章。
他在比赛中得了二十分。

en: She checked the document twice before submitting it.
The price has increased twice in the past year.
He knocked twice on the door, but no one answered.
cn: 她提交前将文件检查了两遍。
过去一年里价格涨了两倍。
他敲了两次门，但无人应答。

definitions.definition: 双胞胎之一；成对的事物
使成对；与...结成姐妹城市

en: She gave birth to identical twins last year.
The twin towers were once iconic landmarks of New York.
Our city is twinned with a small town in Germany.
cn: 她去年生下了一对同卵双胞胎。
双子塔曾是纽约的标志性建筑。
我们的城市与德国一个小镇结为姐妹城市。

definitions.definition: 闪烁，闪耀（指光线快速、轻微地闪动）

en: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
Her eyes twinkled with mischief.
We saw the twinkle of a distant lighthouse.
cn: 夜空中繁星闪烁。
她眼里闪着调皮的光。
我们望见远处灯塔的微光。

definitions.definition: 扭转；螺旋状；意想不到的转折

en: She twisted the scarf around her neck.
The movie’s plot had an unexpected twist.
Don’t twist my words—I meant the opposite!
cn: 她把围巾绕在脖子上。
这部电影的情节出现了意想不到的转折。
别曲解我的话，我的意思完全相反！

en: She has two cats and a dog.
The meeting starts at two o'clock sharp.
Divide the cake into two equal parts.
cn: 她养了两只猫和一只狗。
会议两点整开始。
将蛋糕分成均等的两份。

en: This font supports multiple types of characters.
She can type 80 words per minute.
The study focused on a rare blood type.
cn: 这种字体支持多种字符类型。
她每分钟能打80个单词。
该研究关注一种罕见的血型。

en: She found an old typewriter in the attic.
Early typewriters required manual carriage return.
He worked as a typewriter for a legal firm in the 1920s.
cn: 她在阁楼发现一台老式打字机。
早期打字机需手动换行。
20世纪20年代，他曾是律师事务所的打字员。

en: The typhoon made landfall with winds of over 150 kilometers per hour.
Residents were advised to evacuate before the typhoon hit the coast.
The powerful typhoon caused widespread flooding and damage to infrastructure.
cn: 台风以超过150公里每小时的风速登陆。
居民被建议在台风袭击海岸前撤离。
强台风造成了大规模洪水和基础设施损坏。

en: This painting is typical of his early work.
She greeted me with her typical enthusiasm.
A typical day includes meetings and emails.
cn: 这幅画是他早期作品的典型代表。
她以一贯的热情向我打招呼。
平常的一天包括开会和处理邮件。

en: She worked as a typist in a law firm before becoming a paralegal.
The company hired a fast and accurate typist to handle their daily correspondence.
With the rise of computers, the role of a typist has evolved into that of a data entry specialist.
cn: 她在成为律师助理之前在一家律师事务所担任打字员。
公司雇用了一名快速而准确的打字员来处理日常信件。
随着计算机的兴起，打字员的角色已演变为数据录入专家。

definitions.definition: 轮胎（车辆轮毂外围的环形橡胶部件）

en: The car skidded on wet tyres and hit the barrier.
Always check your tyre pressure before a long journey.
This bicycle has puncture-proof tyres.
cn: 汽车因轮胎打滑而撞上护栏。
长途驾驶前务必检查轮胎气压。
这辆自行车装有防刺轮胎。

definitions.definition: 令人不快的，恶劣的（如行为、天气等）

en: The old building was ugly but full of history.
His ugly behavior ruined the party.
The sky turned an ugly gray before the storm.
cn: 这座老建筑很丑陋，但充满历史。
他恶劣的行为毁了派对。
暴风雨前，天空变成灰暗的难看颜色。

definitions.definition: 终极；极限；最好（或最伟大）的事物

en: The ultimate goal of this project is to achieve zero carbon emissions.
This diamond represents the ultimate in luxury.
He pushed himself to the ultimate limits of endurance.
cn: 该项目的最终目标是实现零碳排放。
这颗钻石是奢侈品的极致代表。
他将自己的耐力推向了极限。

en: All arguments ultimately boil down to a matter of opinion.
The technology could ultimately change how we communicate.
She knew that hard work would ultimately lead to success.
cn: 所有争论最终都可归结为观点差异。
这项技术可能从根本上改变我们的交流方式。
她明白努力终将通向成功。

en: She opened her umbrella as it began to rain.
The organization operates under the umbrella of the UN.
His research covers a broad umbrella of topics.
cn: 下雨时她撑开了伞。
该机构在联合国的保护下运作。
他的研究涵盖广泛的主题。

en: She was unable to attend the meeting due to illness.
The system is unable to process complex requests.
They were unable to hide their disappointment.
cn: 她因病无法参加会议。
该系统无法处理复杂请求。
他们无法掩饰失望之情。

definitions.definition: 难以忍受的；无法容忍的

en: The pain was unbearable after the surgery.
His arrogance made the meeting unbearable for everyone.
The heat in the desert is almost unbearable at noon.
cn: 手术后疼痛难忍。
他的傲慢让会议对所有人来说都难以忍受。
沙漠中的正午高温几乎令人无法忍受。

en: The outcome of the experiment remains uncertain.
She gave an uncertain smile when asked about her plans.
The weather forecast is uncertain for the weekend.
cn: 实验的结果仍不确定。
被问及计划时，她露出了犹豫的微笑。
周末的天气预报难以预测。

definitions.definition: 伯父；叔父；舅父；姑父；姨父

en: My uncle taught me how to fish last summer.
She inherited the antique clock from her uncle.
Uncle Jack always tells the funniest stories at family gatherings.
cn: 去年夏天，我的叔叔教我钓鱼。
她从姑父那里继承了这个古董钟。
杰克舅舅在家庭聚会上总是讲最有趣的故事。

definitions.definition: 令人不安的（处境或氛围）

en: The wooden chair was extremely uncomfortable after sitting for hours.
She felt uncomfortable discussing her salary in public.
An uncomfortable silence filled the room after his remark.
cn: 这把木椅坐了几小时后非常不舒服。
她公开讨论薪水时感到不自在。
他的话让房间里充满了令人不安的沉默。

en: He was knocked unconscious by the falling debris.
Her fear of spiders might stem from unconscious memories.
The artist tapped into his unconscious to create surreal paintings.
cn: 他被坠落的碎片击昏。
她对蜘蛛的恐惧可能源于潜意识记忆。
这位艺术家借助潜意识创作超现实主义画作。

en: The journalist worked hard to uncover the corruption scandal.
Archaeologists uncovered ancient artifacts beneath the temple.
She slowly uncovered her face, revealing a bright smile.
cn: 记者努力揭露这起腐败丑闻。
考古学家在寺庙下发现了古代文物。
她慢慢揭开脸上的遮挡，露出灿烂的笑容。

en: The cat is sleeping under the table.
Children under 12 get free admission.
The project is still under discussion.
cn: 猫正在桌子下面睡觉。
12岁以下儿童免费入场。
该项目仍在讨论中。

en: The company will undergo major restructuring next year.
Patients must undergo a series of tests before the treatment.
The bridge has undergone significant wear and tear over decades.
cn: 该公司明年将经历重大重组。
患者在接受治疗前必须进行一系列检查。
这座桥历经数十年已严重磨损。

definitions.definition: （尚未取得学位的）大学本科生

en: She is an undergraduate at Harvard University.
Undergraduate students must complete core courses.
The research team includes both undergraduates and professors.
cn: 她是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
本科生必须完成核心课程。
该研究团队包括本科生和教授。

definitions.definition: 地下空间；地铁（英式英语）

en: The fugitives hid in an underground bunker for months.
London's underground is the oldest subway system in the world.
The artist gained fame through underground music festivals.
cn: 逃犯们在地下掩体中躲藏了数月。
伦敦地铁是世界上最古老的地铁系统。
这位艺术家通过地下音乐节成名。

en: Please underline the key terms in the document.
Her speech underlined the importance of education.
The red underline indicates a spelling error.
cn: 请用下划线标出文件中的关键术语。
她的演讲强调了教育的重要性。
红色下划线表示拼写错误。

en: The cat hid underneath the bed.
She wore a silver necklace underneath her scarf.
The river flows quietly underneath the bridge.
cn: 猫躲在床底下。
她在围巾下戴了一条银项链。
河水在桥下静静流淌。

en: She couldn't understand why he left without saying goodbye.
The manual helps users understand the software's advanced features.
I understand you're interested in joining our research team?
cn: 她无法理解他为何不告而别。
这份手册帮助用户理解软件的高级功能。
我听说你有兴趣加入我们的研究团队？

en: His understanding of quantum physics is impressive.
She gave me an understanding smile when I apologized.
Mutual understanding is key to a healthy relationship.
cn: 他对量子物理的理解令人印象深刻。
我道歉时，她给了我一个谅解的微笑。
相互理解是健康关系的关键。

en: She decided to undertake the challenge of learning a new language.
The company undertakes to deliver the products within three days.
He undertook the task with great enthusiasm.
cn: 她决定承担学习一门新语言的挑战。
该公司承诺在三天内交付产品。
他满怀热情地着手这项任务。

definitions.definition: 任务；事业（需付出努力或承担责任的工作）
承诺；保证（正式或法律意义上的义务）

en: Starting a business is a risky undertaking.
The company gave an undertaking to reduce carbon emissions.
Funeral directors provide professional undertakings.
cn: 创业是一项高风险的事业。
该公司承诺减少碳排放。
殡葬从业者提供专业殡仪服务。

definitions.definition: 撤销；取消（已执行的操作）

en: Press Ctrl+Z to undo the last edit.
She carefully undid the knot in the ribbon.
The damage to the ecosystem cannot be undone.
cn: 按 Ctrl+Z 撤销上一次编辑。
她小心地解开了丝带上的结。
对生态系统的破坏无法逆转。

en: She is undoubtedly the best candidate for the job.
This discovery will undoubtedly change scientific research.
The view from the summit is undoubtedly breathtaking.
cn: 她无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。
这一发现必将改变科学研究。
山顶的景色无疑令人叹为观止。

en: She felt uneasy about the upcoming exam.
The silence in the room was uneasy.
His uneasy manner suggested he was hiding something.
cn: 她对即将到来的考试感到不安。
房间里的沉默令人不适。
他不安的举止暗示他在隐瞒什么。

en: The news came as an unexpected surprise.
His resignation was completely unexpected.
We encountered unexpected delays due to the storm.
cn: 这个消息来得出乎意料。
他的辞职完全在预料之外。
由于暴风雨，我们遇到了意外的延误。

en: The referee made an unfair decision.
It's unfair to blame her for the team's failure.
The new law was criticized as unfair to low-income families.
cn: 裁判做出了不公正的裁决。
将团队失败归咎于她是不公平的。
新法律被批评对低收入家庭不公。

en: It was an unfortunate accident that could have been avoided.
She made an unfortunate remark during the meeting.
The team's unfortunate loss disappointed their fans.
cn: 这是一场本可避免的不幸事故。
她在会议上说了一句不合时宜的话。
球队的遗憾失利让粉丝们失望了。

en: Unfortunately, the concert was canceled due to rain.
She arrived late, unfortunately missing the keynote speech.
Unfortunately, the experiment did not yield the expected results.
cn: 遗憾的是，音乐会因雨取消。
她迟到了，不幸错过了主题演讲。
不幸的是，实验未能产生预期结果。

en: She felt unhappy about the decision.
The child looked unhappy after losing the game.
An unhappy workplace can reduce productivity.
cn: 她对这一决定感到不满。
输掉比赛后，孩子看起来很不开心。
不愉快的工作环境会降低效率。

en: The students must wear school uniforms every day.
The liquid should be stirred until it has a uniform consistency.
The soldiers stood in uniform rows during the ceremony.
cn: 学生每天必须穿校服。
液体应搅拌至质地均匀。
士兵们在仪式上站成整齐划一的队列。

en: The European Union promotes economic cooperation among its members.
Their union was celebrated with a grand ceremony.
The trade union negotiated better working conditions for employees.
cn: 欧盟促进成员国间的经济合作。
他们的婚姻通过盛大仪式庆祝。
工会为员工协商了更好的工作条件。

en: Each snowflake is unique in its pattern.
Her perspective on the issue was truly unique.
The museum houses a unique collection of ancient artifacts.
cn: 每一片雪花的图案都是独一无二的。
她对这一问题的看法确实独树一帜。
该博物馆藏有一批独一无二的古代文物。

definitions.definition: 单位（用于计量或计数的标准量）
单元（整体中的独立部分）
设备，装置（具有特定功能的独立部件）

en: The meter is a unit of length.
Each apartment is a self-contained unit.
The hospital purchased a new dialysis unit.
cn: 米是长度的单位。
每间公寓都是独立的单元。
医院购置了一台新的透析设备。

en: The two companies decided to unite to compete with larger firms.
The treaty aimed to unite the warring factions under a common government.
Music has the power to unite people across cultures.
cn: 两家公司决定联合起来与更大的企业竞争。
该条约旨在将交战派系统一到一个共同的政府下。
音乐有跨越文化将人们团结起来的力量。

en: The speech emphasized the importance of national unity.
The design achieves a perfect unity of form and function.
In algebra, the number 1 is the unity for multiplication.
cn: 演讲强调了国家统一的重要性。
该设计实现了形式与功能的完美统一。
在代数中，数字1是乘法的单位元。

en: English is a universal language in science and aviation.
The theory aims to find a universal solution to the problem.
His music has a universal appeal across cultures.
cn: 英语是科学和航空领域的通用语言。
该理论旨在找到问题的通用解决方案。
他的音乐具有跨文化的普遍吸引力。

en: The telescope revealed new galaxies in the universe.
His research spans the universe of quantum physics.
Ancient myths often explain the origin of the universe.
cn: 望远镜揭示了宇宙中的新星系。
他的研究涵盖量子物理学的整个领域。
古代神话常解释宇宙的起源。

en: She graduated from Harvard University with a degree in physics.
The university offers a wide range of extracurricular activities.
Ancient universities like Oxford have a long tradition of academic excellence.
cn: 她毕业于哈佛大学，获得物理学学位。
这所大学提供丰富的课外活动。
牛津等古老大学拥有悠久的学术卓越传统。

en: The court's decision was widely criticized as unjust.
Protesters demanded an end to unjust policies.
History often remembers unjust rulers with infamy.
cn: 法院的判决被广泛批评为不公正。
抗议者要求终止不公正的政策。
历史常以恶名铭记不公正的统治者。

en: It was unkind of her to ignore his greeting.
The teacher's unkind remarks hurt the student's feelings.
Even small acts can feel unkind when someone is vulnerable.
cn: 她无视他的问候，实在不友善。
老师刻薄的言论伤害了学生的感情。
当一个人脆弱时，微小的举动也可能显得刻薄。

en: The cause of the accident remains unknown.
She ventured into the unknown territory without fear.
Unknown factors may affect the experiment's outcome.
cn: 事故原因仍未知。
她毫无畏惧地踏入未知领域。
未知因素可能影响实验结果。

en: You won't succeed unless you work hard.
Unless it rains, we'll have a picnic tomorrow.
I won't call you unless there's an emergency.
cn: 除非你努力，否则不会成功。
如果不下雨，我们明天就去野餐。
除非有紧急情况，否则我不会打电话给你。

en: Her opinion is unlike mine on this issue.
The two siblings look completely unlike each other.
Unlike his brother, he prefers quiet weekends.
cn: 在这个问题上，她的观点与我的不同。
这对兄弟姐妹长得完全不像。
与他兄弟不同，他更喜欢安静的周末。

definitions.definition: 不太可能的；未必真实的

en: It's unlikely to rain today.
His explanation seems unlikely.
They are unlikely candidates for the job.
cn: 今天不太可能下雨。
他的解释看起来不像是真的。
他们不太可能是这份工作的候选人。

en: The workers quickly unloaded the cargo from the ship.
She needed to unload her worries to a friend.
The truck will unload at the warehouse by noon.
cn: 工人们迅速从船上卸下货物。
她需要向朋友倾诉烦恼。
卡车将在中午前到仓库卸货。

en: He felt unlucky after losing his keys for the third time.
It's considered unlucky to walk under a ladder in many cultures.
She had an unlucky break when her flight was canceled.
cn: 他第三次丢钥匙后觉得自己很倒霉。
在许多文化中，从梯子下走过被认为是不吉利的。
她的航班被取消，真是倒霉透顶。

en: The meeting was canceled due to unnecessary delays.
She avoids buying unnecessary items to save money.
His harsh criticism felt completely unnecessary.
cn: 会议因不必要的延误而被取消。
她为避免浪费钱而不买多余的东西。
他严厉的批评显得毫无必要。

en: The smell from the factory was extremely unpleasant.
She had an unpleasant encounter with her rude neighbor.
The medicine left an unpleasant aftertaste.
cn: 工厂散发的气味令人极其不适。
她与粗鲁的邻居发生了不愉快的冲突。
这种药物残留了难闻的余味。

definitions.definition: 不令人满意的；不符合要求的

en: The team's performance was deemed unsatisfactory by the coach.
The product received unsatisfactory reviews due to its poor durability.
Her explanation left the committee with an unsatisfactory feeling.
cn: 教练认为团队的表现不尽如人意。
该产品因耐用性差而获得负面评价。
她的解释让委员会感到不满意。

en: The chemical compound becomes unstable at high temperatures.
His unstable mood made it difficult to work with him.
The old chair is too unstable to sit on.
cn: 这种化合物在高温下会变得不稳定。
他反复无常的情绪让人难以共事。
这把旧椅子太不稳固，不能坐了。

en: The bright red dress was unsuitable for the solemn occasion.
His lack of experience made him unsuitable for the leadership role.
The software is unsuitable for older operating systems.
cn: 这条亮红色连衣裙不适合庄重的场合。
他缺乏经验，不适合担任领导职务。
该软件不适用于旧版操作系统。

definitions.definition: /conj. 直到（某一时间或事件发生）

en: She waited until midnight for the call.
The ticket is valid until December 31st.
He didn't realize his mistake until it was too late.
cn: 她一直等到午夜的电话。
这张票的有效期截止到12月31日。
直到为时已晚，他才意识到自己的错误。

en: It's unusual to see snow in this tropical region.
She has an unusual talent for solving complex puzzles.
The artist's unusual style made his work instantly recognizable.
cn: 在这片热带地区见到雪很不寻常。
她拥有解决复杂谜题的独特天赋。
这位艺术家与众不同的风格使其作品极具辨识度。

en: She was unusually quiet at the meeting.
The weather is unusually warm for December.
He finished the task unusually quickly.
cn: 她在会议上异常安静。
十二月的天气暖和得不寻常。
他完成任务的速度快得反常。

en: He was unwilling to admit his mistake.
She gave an unwilling nod to the proposal.
Their unwilling cooperation delayed the project.
cn: 他不愿承认自己的错误。
她勉强点头同意了提议。
他们不情愿的配合延误了项目进度。

en: The balloon floated up into the sky.
She lives two floors up.
The company decided to up its production targets.
cn: 气球飘向了天空。
她住在楼上两层。
公司决定提高生产目标。

definitions.definition: 在…之上（与 on 同义，但更正式或古旧）
关于；依据（用于特定短语，如 "upon request"）

en: The cat jumped upon the table.
Upon further investigation, the truth was revealed.
She placed the crown upon his head.
cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
经过进一步调查，真相浮出水面。
她把王冠戴在了他的头上。

en: She lives in the upper floor of the building.
The upper part of the boot was made of leather.
He took an upper to stay awake during the exam.
cn: 她住在这栋楼的顶层。
靴子的上部由皮革制成。
他服用了兴奋剂以在考试期间保持清醒。

en: The old oak tree stood upright despite the strong winds.
She is known for her upright character and honesty.
Adjust the monitor to an upright position for better ergonomics.
cn: 那棵老橡树在狂风中依然挺立。
她以正直的品格和诚实著称。
将显示器调整至垂直位置以获得更佳的人体工学效果。

en: The strong wind upset the picnic table.
She felt upset after hearing the bad news.
The election result was a major upset.
cn: 强风掀翻了野餐桌。
听到坏消息后，她感到心烦意乱。
选举结果爆出大冷门。

en: The painting was hung upside-down by mistake.
She turned the bottle upside-down to empty it.
After the earthquake, everything in the room was upside-down.
cn: 这幅画被不小心挂反了。
她把瓶子倒过来清空。
地震后，房间里的一切都乱七八糟。

en: She ran upstairs to grab her jacket.
The upstairs neighbors are very quiet.
We turned the upstairs into a home office.
cn: 她跑上楼去拿夹克。
楼上的邻居非常安静。
我们把楼上改成了家庭办公室。

definitions.definition: 最新的；现代的；包含最新信息的

en: This report provides up-to-date statistics on climate change.
She always keeps her software up-to-date to avoid security risks.
The guidebook needs to be revised to stay up-to-date with local regulations.
cn: 这份报告提供了有关气候变化的最新统计数据。
她总是保持软件更新以避免安全风险。
这本指南需要修订以符合当地最新法规。

en: The balloon floated upward into the sky.
She glanced upward at the towering building.
The company shows an upward trend in profits.
cn: 气球向上飘入天空。
她抬头望向高耸的建筑物。
公司利润呈上升趋势。

en: The balloon floated upwards into the sky.
Prices have been trending upwards this year.
She tilted her head upwards to see the stars.
cn: 气球向上飘入天空。
今年价格呈上升趋势。
她仰头望向星空。

en: She urged him to reconsider his decision.
I felt an irresistible urge to laugh during the serious meeting.
The government is urging citizens to conserve water during the drought.
cn: 她敦促他重新考虑决定。
在那场严肃的会议中，我突然有种抑制不住想笑的冲动。
政府正呼吁市民在干旱期间节约用水。

en: The hospital received an urgent call for blood donations.
She spoke in an urgent whisper, warning us of the danger.
Climate change is the most urgent issue of our time.
cn: 医院接到紧急献血电话。
她急切地低声警告我们危险临近。
气候变化是我们时代最紧迫的问题。

definitions.definition: 我们（第一人称复数宾格）

en: She gave us a map of the city.
The teacher asked us to be quiet.
This gift is for all of us.
cn: 她给了我们一张城市地图。
老师要求我们保持安静。
这份礼物是给我们所有人的。

en: The manual explains the proper usage of this tool.
"Ain't" is considered non-standard usage in formal writing.
Local usage sometimes differs from textbook rules.
cn: 手册说明了该工具的正确使用方法。
“Ain't”在正式写作中被视为非标准用法。
当地用法有时与教科书规则不同。

en: She learned how to use the software quickly.
This tool has multiple uses in the kitchen.
He used his charm to win her trust.
cn: 她很快学会了使用这个软件。
这件工具在厨房有多种用途。
他用自己的魅力赢得了她的信任。

definitions.definition: 习惯的（常与to连用，如"used to"）

en: This is a used car in good condition.
She used to live in Paris before moving to Tokyo.
The bookshelf looks used but still sturdy.
cn: 这是一辆车况良好的二手车。
在搬到东京前，她曾住在巴黎。
这个书架看起来旧了，但依然结实。

en: This manual is useful for beginners.
She gave me some useful advice on job hunting.
A multi-tool is useful in outdoor activities.
cn: 这本手册对初学者很有用。
她给了我一些关于求职的有用建议。
多功能工具在户外活动中很实用。

en: The broken tool is completely useless now.
His advice proved useless in solving the problem.
Don't keep useless items just for sentimental reasons.
cn: 这把坏掉的工具现在毫无用处。
他的建议对解决问题毫无帮助。
不要仅因情感原因保留无用的物品。

definitions.definition: 使用者，用户（指使用产品或服务的人）

en: The app requires each user to create a personal account.
As a frequent user of public transport, she advocates for better accessibility.
In medieval law, a "user" referred to someone granted rights to utilize another's property.
cn: 该应用程序要求每位用户创建个人账户。
作为公共交通的频繁使用者，她倡导改善无障碍设施。
在中世纪法律中，“user”指被授予使用他人财产权利的人。

en: It's usual for him to arrive late.
The usual methods didn't work this time.
She ordered her usual coffee.
cn: 他迟到是常事。
这次常规方法失效了。
她点了惯常喝的咖啡。

en: She usually takes the bus to work.
The cafe is usually crowded in the morning.
He usually checks his emails before breakfast.
cn: 她通常乘公交上班。
这家咖啡馆早上通常很拥挤。
他通常在早餐前查看邮件。

definitions.definition: 效用，实用性；公用事业（如水电供应）

en: The utility of this tool lies in its versatility.
Gas and electricity are considered public utilities.
She designed a utility knife for outdoor enthusiasts.
cn: 该工具的实用性在于其多功能性。
天然气和电力属于公用事业。
她为户外爱好者设计了一把多功能刀。

definitions.definition: 利用，使用（尤指有效或实用地）

en: The team found a way to utilize solar energy more efficiently.
Many apps utilize AI to personalize user experiences.
We must utilize every opportunity to reduce waste.
cn: 团队找到了更高效利用太阳能的方法。
许多应用利用人工智能为用户提供个性化体验。
我们必须利用一切机会减少浪费。

en: She pushed herself to the utmost to finish the marathon.
This matter is of the utmost importance.
The hikers reached the utmost edge of the cliff.
cn: 她竭尽全力完成了马拉松。
这件事至关重要。
徒步者抵达了悬崖的最边缘。

en: The room was in utter darkness.
She didn’t utter a word during the meeting.
His performance was utter perfection.
cn: 房间一片漆黑。
她在会议中一言不发。
他的表现堪称完美。

definitions.definition: 空着的，未被占用的（如房间、座位）
（表情或眼神）茫然的，无思想的

en: The hotel has several vacant rooms this weekend.
Her vacant expression suggested she wasn’t listening.
The position has been vacant for three months.
cn: 本周末这家酒店有几间空房。
她茫然的表情表明她没在听。
该职位已空缺三个月。

en: We booked a beach house for our summer vacation.
She vacations in Europe every year.
The company offers paid vacation to all employees.
cn: 我们为暑假预订了一间海滨别墅。
她每年去欧洲度假。
公司为所有员工提供带薪假期。

en: Outer space is not a perfect vacuum.
She vacuumed the carpet before the guests arrived.
His resignation left a vacuum in the leadership.
cn: 外层空间并非绝对真空。
她在客人到来前用吸尘器清扫了地毯。
他的辞职造成了领导层的空缺。

definitions.definition: （表情或行为）茫然的，心不在焉的

en: His instructions were too vague to follow.
She gave a vague smile and looked away.
The boundaries between the two theories remain vague.
cn: 他的指示太模糊，无法遵循。
她露出茫然的微笑，移开了视线。
这两种理论之间的界限仍然不明确。

en: He made a vain attempt to fix the broken engine.
She was too vain to wear glasses in public.
Their promises proved vain when no changes occurred.
cn: 他徒劳地尝试修理坏掉的发动机。
她太虚荣，不愿在公共场合戴眼镜。
当毫无变化时，他们的承诺被证明是空谈。

definitions.definition: 有效的；具有法律效力的

en: The contract is valid for three years.
Her argument was based on valid evidence.
A passport must be valid to travel internationally.
cn: 这份合同有效期为三年。
她的论点基于可靠的证据。
护照必须在有效期内才能用于国际旅行。

en: The village is nestled in a lush green valley.
The river carved a deep valley over centuries.
Silicon Valley is a hub for tech innovation.
cn: 村庄坐落在葱翠的山谷中。
河流经数百年冲刷出深邃的峡谷。
硅谷是科技创新的中心。

en: This antique vase is highly valuable.
Her advice was valuable to the team’s success.
Time is the most valuable resource we have.
cn: 这件古董花瓶极其珍贵。
她的建议对团队的成功至关重要。
时间是我们拥有的最宝贵资源。

en: The value of this painting is estimated at over a million dollars.
She values honesty above all else in a friendship.
The company needs to assess the market value of its products.
cn: 这幅画的价值估计超过一百万美元。
在友谊中，她最重视诚实。
公司需要评估其产品的市场价值。

en: The delivery van was parked outside the supermarket.
He is considered a van of modern art movements.
The luggage van is at the end of the train.
cn: 送货的厢式货车停在超市外。
他被视为现代艺术运动的先驱。
行李车厢位于列车末端。

en: The magician made the dove vanish into thin air.
Her smile vanished when she heard the bad news.
In this equation, the variable vanishes at x=0.
cn: 魔术师让鸽子凭空消失了。
听到坏消息时，她的笑容瞬间消失了。
该方程中，变量在x=0时归零。

en: Her obsession with luxury brands revealed her vanity.
The politician's speech was full of vanity and empty promises.
He realized the vanity of chasing fame too late in life.
cn: 她对奢侈品牌的痴迷暴露了她的虚荣。
这位政客的演讲充满浮华与空头承诺。
他晚年才意识到追逐名利的虚妄。

en: Steam is a visible vapour formed when water boils.
The morning vapour hung low over the lake.
His anger seemed to vapour as soon as he heard the explanation.
cn: 水沸腾时形成的可见蒸气称为水蒸汽。
晨雾低垂在湖面上。
听到解释后，他的怒气似乎瞬间消散了。

en: The weather here is highly variable in spring.
Scientists control the experiment by adjusting the variables.
Her mood is as variable as the ocean tides.
cn: 这里的春天天气变化无常。
科学家通过调整变量来控制实验。
她的情绪如潮汐般起伏不定。

en: The genetic variation among individuals is crucial for species survival.
This melody has a beautiful variation in the second movement.
Seasonal variations in temperature affect crop growth.
cn: 个体间的遗传变异对物种生存至关重要。
这段旋律在第二乐章有一个优美的变奏。
温度的季节性变化影响作物生长。

en: The garden boasts a variety of exotic plants.
She enjoys the variety of working in different departments.
This store offers a wide variety of organic foods.
cn: 这座花园拥有多种异域植物。
她喜欢在不同部门工作的多样性。
这家商店提供种类繁多的有机食品。

en: The store offers various sizes and colors of T-shirts.
She cited various reasons for her decision.
Various artists will perform at the festival.
cn: 这家商店提供多种尺寸和颜色的T恤。
她为自己的决定列举了多方面的理由。
多位艺术家将在音乐节上表演。

en: Prices vary depending on the season.
She varies her teaching methods to engage students.
The landscape varies from rolling hills to steep cliffs.
cn: 价格随季节变化。
她变换教学方法以吸引学生。
地貌从起伏的丘陵到陡峭的悬崖各不相同。

en: She placed the fresh roses in a crystal vase.
The Ming dynasty vase was auctioned for millions.
Be careful not to knock over the vase on the table.
cn: 她将新鲜的玫瑰插在水晶花瓶里。
这只明代花瓶以数百万价格拍出。
小心别碰倒桌上的花瓶。

en: The vast desert stretched endlessly under the scorching sun.
She inherited a vast fortune from her grandfather.
The internet provides vast opportunities for learning.
cn: 灼热的阳光下，广阔的沙漠无边无际地延伸。
她从祖父那里继承了一笔巨额财富。
互联网为学习提供了海量机会。

definitions.definition: 蔬菜；植物（尤指可食用部分）

en: Carrots and broccoli are common vegetables.
She prefers a vegetable diet for health reasons.
The garden is full of lush vegetable growth.
cn: 胡萝卜和西兰花是常见蔬菜。
出于健康考虑，她偏好素食。
园子里长满了茂盛的蔬菜。

definitions.definition: 交通工具（如汽车、飞机等）
传播媒介；载体（如艺术、思想的表达手段）

en: Electric vehicles are becoming more popular worldwide.
Language is a vehicle for cultural exchange.
The rocket was the vehicle that carried the satellite into orbit.
cn: 电动汽车在全球越来越普及。
语言是文化交流的媒介。
这枚火箭是将卫星送入轨道的运载工具。

en: She wore a delicate lace veil on her wedding day.
The mountains were veiled in mist at dawn.
His polite words veiled a sharp criticism.
cn: 婚礼当天，她戴着一顶精致的蕾丝面纱。
黎明时分，群山被薄雾笼罩。
他礼貌的言辞掩饰了尖锐的批评。

definitions.definition: 速度（物理量，描述物体运动的快慢和方向）

en: The rocket reached a velocity of 25,000 miles per hour.
She typed with astonishing velocity, finishing the report in minutes.
In fluid dynamics, velocity is a vector quantity.
cn: 火箭达到了每小时25,000英里的速度。
她以惊人的速度打字，几分钟内完成了报告。
在流体动力学中，速度是一个矢量。

en: She wore a dress made of deep blue velvet.
The kitten's paws felt like velvet.
Velvet curtains blocked out the sunlight.
cn: 她穿了一条深蓝色天鹅绒连衣裙。
小猫的爪子摸起来像天鹅绒一样柔软。
天鹅绒窗帘挡住了阳光。

en: They embarked on a daring venture into the Amazon rainforest.
He decided to venture his savings in the startup.
Few people ventured to criticize the new policy openly.
cn: 他们开始了深入亚马逊雨林的大胆冒险。
他决定将积蓄投入这家初创企业。
几乎没人敢公开批评这项新政策。

definitions.definition: 动词（语法中表示动作或状态的词）

en: In the sentence "She runs quickly", "runs" is the verb.
Linking verbs like "be" connect the subject to additional information.
Ancient Greek grammarians classified words into nouns, verbs, and particles.
cn: 在句子“她跑得快”中，“跑”是动词。
系动词如“be”将主语与附加信息联系起来。
古希腊语法学家将词语分为名词、动词和虚词。

definitions.definition: 核对（数据、陈述等的真实性）

en: The lab will verify the authenticity of the ancient manuscript.
Please verify your email address by clicking the link.
Astronomers used multiple telescopes to verify the new planet's existence.
cn: 实验室将验证这份古代手稿的真伪。
请点击链接以验证您的邮箱地址。
天文学家通过多台望远镜验证了这颗新行星的存在。

definitions.definition: 版本（同一事物的不同形式或变体）
说法，描述（对事件的不同解释）

en: The software's latest version includes bug fixes.
She gave her version of the incident to the police.
The director's cut is a darker version of the film.
cn: 该软件的最新版本修复了漏洞。
她向警方陈述了自己对事件的描述。
导演剪辑版是这部电影的更黑暗版本。

en: The cliff rose in a vertical wall from the sea.
Draw a vertical line to divide the page in half.
The drone ascended vertically into the sky.
cn: 悬崖从海面拔地而起，形成一道垂直的峭壁。
画一条垂直线将页面分成两半。
无人机垂直升入空中。

definitions.definition: 非常，很（用于修饰形容词或副词）
同一的，正是的（古义或正式用法）

en: The coffee is very hot.
She was very happy with the results.
This is the very book I was looking for.
cn: 咖啡非常烫。
她对结果非常满意。
这正是我在找的那本书。

en: The ancient clay vessel was used to store olive oil.
Blood vessels carry oxygen throughout the body.
The fishing vessel returned to port before the storm.
cn: 这个古老的陶罐曾用于储存橄榄油。
血管将氧气输送到全身。
渔船在暴风雨前返回了港口。

en: He wore a formal vest under his suit jacket.
The constitution vests legislative power in Congress.
She prefers sleeveless vests in summer.
cn: 他在西装外套下穿了一件正式马甲。
宪法将立法权授予国会。
她夏天更喜欢穿无袖背心。

en: He is a Vietnam War veteran.
She is a veteran teacher with 30 years of experience.
The company values veteran employees for their expertise.
cn: 他是一名越战老兵。
她是一位有30年教学经验的资深教师。
公司重视资深员工的专业知识。

en: The constant noise began to vex the students during the exam.
Medieval scholars would often vex over the interpretation of ancient texts.
Don't vex yourself with problems that are beyond your control.
cn: 持续的噪音开始让考试中的学生们感到烦躁。
中世纪学者常为古籍的释义争论不休。
别为无法控制的问题困扰自己。

en: We sent the document via email.
The flight to Tokyo goes via Hong Kong.
She learned the news via a friend.
cn: 我们通过电子邮件发送了文件。
飞往东京的航班途经香港。
她通过一位朋友得知了这一消息。

en: The phone vibrated silently on the table.
Her voice vibrated with emotion.
Guitar strings vibrate to produce sound.
cn: 手机在桌上无声振动。
她的声音因激动而颤抖。
吉他弦通过振动发声。

en: The vibration of the engine made the whole car shake.
Her voice carried a vibration of anger that surprised everyone.
Tuning forks produce sound through vibration.
cn: 发动机的振动使整辆车都在摇晃。
她的声音带着愤怒的震颤，令所有人意外。
音叉通过振动发声。

en: Greed is a vice that can destroy relationships.
She was promoted to vice president of the company.
The sculpture’s only vice is a small crack at the base.
cn: 贪婪是一种可能摧毁人际关系的恶习。
她晋升为公司副总裁。
这座雕塑唯一的瑕疵是底部有一道小裂缝。

en: The charity provides support for victims of domestic violence.
He fell victim to an online scam and lost his savings.
In ancient times, a lamb was often chosen as the ritual victim.
cn: 该慈善机构为家庭暴力受害者提供支持。
他成为网络诈骗的受害者，失去了积蓄。
古时，羔羊常被选作仪式祭品。

en: The team felt victorious after winning the championship.
Her victorious smile showed no doubt about the outcome.
The general led his troops to a victorious battle.
cn: 球队赢得冠军后感到胜利的喜悦。
她胜利的微笑表明对结果毫无疑虑。
将军率领部队取得了战斗的胜利。

en: The team celebrated their hard-earned victory.
Her victory in the debate surprised everyone.
The treaty marked a victory for diplomacy.
cn: 球队庆祝他们来之不易的胜利。
她在辩论中的胜利让所有人惊讶。
该条约标志着外交的胜利。

en: She uploaded a video of her trip to YouTube.
Can you video the concert for me?
The video quality is surprisingly clear.
cn: 她将旅行视频上传到了YouTube。
你能帮我录一下演唱会吗？
视频画质出奇地清晰。

en: The view from the mountain top was breathtaking.
She holds a conservative view on economic policies.
Engineers viewed the blueprint carefully before construction.
cn: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。
她对经济政策持保守观点。
工程师在施工前仔细查看了蓝图。

definitions.definition: 观察点；视角（物理或比喻意义）

en: From this viewpoint, you can see the entire valley.
Her viewpoint on the issue was surprisingly optimistic.
The documentary presents multiple cultural viewpoints.
cn: 从这个观察点，你可以看到整个山谷。
她对这一问题的看法出人意料地乐观。
这部纪录片呈现了多种文化视角。

en: The vigorous young athlete completed the marathon with ease.
After the rain, the garden became a vigorous jungle of greenery.
Her vigorous defense of human rights inspired many.
cn: 这位精力充沛的年轻运动员轻松跑完了马拉松。
雨后，花园变成了茂盛的绿色丛林。
她对人权强有力的捍卫激励了许多人。

en: The small village nestled in the valley has only 200 inhabitants.
Village life is often quieter than city life.
She grew up in a fishing village on the coast.
cn: 这座坐落在山谷中的小村庄仅有200名居民。
乡村生活通常比城市生活更宁静。
她在海岸边的一个渔村长大。

definitions.definition: （比喻）蔓延的事物（如谣言、传统等）

en: The vineyard is famous for its century-old vines.
Ivy is a type of vine that climbs walls effortlessly.
Rumors spread like a vine through the small town.
cn: 这座葡萄园以百年藤蔓闻名。
常春藤是一种能轻松攀附墙壁的藤本植物。
谣言如藤蔓般在小镇蔓延。

definitions.definition: 醋（一种酸性调味品，由发酵酒精制成）

en: She sprinkled vinegar on the salad for extra flavor.
Apple cider vinegar is often used in natural remedies.
The sharp smell of vinegar filled the kitchen.
cn: 她在沙拉上撒了醋以增添风味。
苹果醋常用于天然疗法。
厨房里弥漫着醋的刺鼻气味。

en: The protest escalated into violence.
The violence of the storm destroyed coastal villages.
Domestic violence is a serious social issue.
cn: 抗议升级为暴力冲突。
风暴的肆虐摧毁了沿海村庄。
家庭暴力是严重的社会问题。

en: The violent storm destroyed several houses.
He has a violent temper when provoked.
The movie contains violent scenes unsuitable for children.
cn: 猛烈的风暴摧毁了几栋房屋。
他被激怒时会脾气暴躁。
这部电影含有不适合儿童的暴力场景。

definitions.definition: 紫罗兰（植物或花）；蓝紫色

en: She wore a dress in shades of violet.
Violets bloomed along the forest path.
The sunset painted the sky violet and gold.
cn: 她穿了一条深浅不一的蓝紫色连衣裙。
紫罗兰沿着林间小径盛开。
夕阳将天空染成紫金色。

definitions.definition: 小提琴（一种四弦弓弦乐器）

en: She practices the violin for two hours every day.
The violin solo moved the audience to tears.
This antique violin was made in 18th-century Italy.
cn: 她每天练习小提琴两小时。
小提琴独奏让观众感动落泪。
这把古董小提琴制作于18世纪的意大利。

definitions.definition: 几乎，差不多（用于强调接近完全的状态）
虚拟地（在计算机或数字环境中）

en: The project is virtually complete, with only minor adjustments left.
In the game, players can explore a virtually reconstructed ancient city.
His argument was virtually impossible to refute due to the solid evidence.
cn: 该项目已基本完成，仅剩细微调整。
游戏中，玩家能探索一座虚拟重建的古城。
由于证据确凿，他的论点几乎无法反驳。

en: Patience is a virtue that leads to inner peace.
The virtue of this material is its durability.
She was praised for her virtue and integrity.
cn: 耐心是通向内心平静的美德。
这种材料的优点是耐用性。
她因贞洁与正直受到赞扬。

en: The stars are barely visible in the city due to light pollution.
Her disappointment was visible in her expression.
The report makes visible the hidden costs of the project.
cn: 由于光污染，这些星星在城市里几乎看不见。
她的失望之情在表情中显而易见。
这份报告揭示了该项目的隐性成本。

en: Her vision deteriorated after years of working in dim light.
The leader shared a bold vision for the company's future.
The mystic claimed to have visions of ancient spirits.
cn: 多年在昏暗光线下工作后，她的视力下降了。
这位领导者分享了对公司未来的大胆展望。
那位神秘主义者自称能看到古代灵魂的幻象。

en: She will visit her grandparents this weekend.
The museum attracts thousands of visitors every day.
The doctor visits patients in the hospital at 10 a.m. daily.
cn: 她本周末将去探望祖父母。
这家博物馆每天吸引数千名参观者。
医生每天上午10点巡查住院患者。

en: The museum welcomes thousands of visitors every year.
The website tracks anonymous visitors through cookies.
She was a frequent visitor to his art studio.
cn: 这座博物馆每年接待数千名参观者。
该网站通过 cookies 追踪匿名访客。
她曾是他艺术工作室的常客。

en: The artist created stunning visual effects in the film.
This textbook uses visuals to simplify complex ideas.
Cats have excellent visual acuity in low light.
cn: 这位艺术家在电影中创造了令人惊叹的视觉效果。
这本教科书用视觉材料简化复杂概念。
猫在弱光环境下拥有极佳的视觉敏锐度。

definitions.definition: 至关重要的；维持生命所必需的

en: Water is vital for all living organisms.
She played a vital role in the project's success.
His vital energy impressed everyone at the meeting.
cn: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
她在项目成功中发挥了关键作用。
他旺盛的精力给与会者留下了深刻印象。

definitions.definition: 维生素（维持生命必需的有机化合物）

en: Citrus fruits are rich in vitamin C.
A lack of vitamin D can lead to bone disorders.
She takes a daily multivitamin to supplement her diet.
cn: 柑橘类水果富含维生素C。
缺乏维生素D可能导致骨骼疾病。
她每天服用复合维生素补充饮食营养。

en: She gave a vivid description of her journey through the rainforest.
The artist used vivid colors to capture the sunset.
My childhood memories are still vivid in my mind.
cn: 她生动地描述了穿越雨林的旅程。
艺术家用鲜艳的色彩捕捉日落。
童年的记忆在我脑海中依然鲜活。

definitions.definition: 词汇（某语言或领域的全部单词）
词汇量（个人掌握的单词范围）

en: Expanding your vocabulary requires consistent reading.
The textbook includes a glossary of scientific vocabulary.
His limited vocabulary made it hard to express complex ideas.
cn: 扩充词汇量需要持续阅读。
这本教材附有科学术语表。
他有限的词汇量使他难以表达复杂观点。

en: She has a beautiful singing voice.
The protesters voiced their demands loudly.
Everyone should have a voice in this decision.
cn: 她有一副美妙的歌喉。
抗议者们高声表达他们的诉求。
每个人都应在此决定中拥有发言权。

en: Mount Vesuvius is an active volcano in Italy.
The sudden volcano of protests shocked the government.
Scientists monitor volcanic activity to predict eruptions.
cn: 维苏威火山是意大利的活火山。
抗议活动的突然爆发令政府震惊。
科学家监测火山活动以预测喷发。

en: She spiked the volleyball over the net with incredible force.
Beach volleyball became an Olympic sport in 1996.
The volleyball team practices serves and blocks every afternoon.
cn: 她以惊人的力量将排球扣过球网。
沙滩排球于1996年成为奥运会项目。
排球队每天下午练习发球和拦网。

en: The battery provides 9 volts of power.
The horse performed a perfect volt during the dressage competition.
Most household appliances run on 220 volts in this country.
cn: 这块电池提供9伏特的电力。
盛装舞步比赛中，马匹完成了一个完美的环形动作。
该国大多数家用电器使用220伏电压。

en: The standard voltage for household outlets is 220V in many countries.
High voltage power lines require special safety precautions.
There was a palpable voltage in the air before the concert started.
cn: 许多国家的家用插座标准电压是220伏。
高压电线需要特殊的安全防护措施。
音乐会开始前，空气中弥漫着明显的紧张感。

en: The volume of this box is 2 cubic meters.
Please turn down the volume of the TV.
She published a new volume of poetry last year.
cn: 这个箱子的体积是2立方米。
请调低电视的音量。
她去年出版了一卷新诗集。

definitions.definition: （生理活动）随意的（与“不随意”相对）

en: She made a voluntary decision to donate her salary to charity.
Breathing is usually involuntary, but can become voluntary under conscious control.
The choir performed a beautiful voluntary during the wedding ceremony.
cn: 她自愿决定将工资捐给慈善机构。
呼吸通常是非自主的，但在意识控制下可变为随意行为。
合唱团在婚礼上演奏了一首优美的自愿奉献曲。

en: Citizens will vote in the national election next week.
She cast her vote for the environmental policy.
The committee voted unanimously to approve the proposal.
cn: 公民将在下周的全国选举中投票。
她为环境政策投了一票。
委员会一致投票通过了该提案。

en: The Titanic sank on its maiden voyage.
They voyaged across the Pacific in a small boat.
His book describes a voyage to the Arctic.
cn: 泰坦尼克号在首航中沉没。
他们乘小船横渡太平洋。
他的书描写了一次北极之旅。

en: The company raised the minimum wage to $15 per hour.
They waged a long campaign against environmental pollution.
His wages were barely enough to cover rent.
cn: 该公司将最低工资提高到每小时15美元。
他们发起了一场长期对抗环境污染的运动。
他的工资勉强够付房租。

definitions.definition: 四轮运货马车（英式拼写，同 wagon）

en: The farmer loaded hay onto the waggon.
A coal waggon derailed near the station.
"Waggon" is the British spelling of "wagon".
cn: 农夫将干草装上运货马车。
一辆运煤货车在车站附近脱轨。
"Waggon" 是 "wagon" 的英式拼写。

definitions.definition: 腰部（人体躯干最细的部分）

en: She tied a silk scarf around her waist.
This dress has a fitted waist.
He measured his waist to track his fitness progress.
cn: 她在腰间系了一条丝巾。
这条连衣裙的腰身很合体。
他测量腰围以追踪健身效果。

en: She decided to wait for the next train.
The long wait made everyone anxious.
Wait here until I come back.
cn: 她决定等候下一班火车。
漫长的等待让所有人焦躁不安。
在这里等到我回来。

definitions.definition: 服务员（尤指餐厅中为顾客点餐和上菜的男性）

en: The waiter brought us the menu with a smile.
She left a generous tip for the polite waiter.
The waiter recommended the chef’s special dish.
cn: 服务员微笑着为我们递上菜单。
她给那位礼貌的服务员留下了丰厚的小费。
服务员推荐了主厨的特色菜。

definitions.definition: 守夜；航迹（船或飞机后的尾流）

en: She wakes up at dawn every day.
The ship left a white wake in the blue sea.
The community held a wake to honor the deceased.
cn: 她每天黎明时分醒来。
船在蔚蓝的海面上留下一道白色航迹。
社区举行了守夜仪式以纪念逝者。

en: The sound of thunder wakened the sleeping child.
She wakened to find sunlight streaming through the window.
His speech wakened a sense of responsibility in the audience.
cn: 雷声惊醒了熟睡的孩子。
她醒来时，阳光正透过窗户洒进来。
他的演讲唤醒了听众的责任感。

definitions.definition: 步行；行走的路程或方式

en: She walks to work every morning.
The park has a scenic walk along the river.
Babies usually learn to walk around 12 months old.
cn: 她每天早晨步行上班。
公园里有一条沿河的景观步道。
婴儿通常在12个月大时学会走路。

en: The ancient city was surrounded by a massive stone wall.
She felt a wall of silence between them after the argument.
They decided to wall off the garden for more privacy.
cn: 这座古城被一道巨大的石墙环绕。
争吵后，她感到两人之间隔着一道沉默的屏障。
他们决定砌墙隔开花园以增加私密性。

en: He pulled a business card from his leather wallet.
Cryptocurrency wallets store private keys securely.
She lost her wallet on the subway yesterday.
cn: 他从皮夹里抽出一张名片。
加密货币钱包用于安全存储私钥。
她昨天在地铁上丢了钱包。

en: She loves to wander through the old streets of Lisbon.
His mind began to wander during the long lecture.
The river wanders across the valley before reaching the sea.
cn: 她喜欢在里斯本的古老街道上闲逛。
漫长的讲座中，他的思绪开始飘忽。
河流蜿蜒穿过山谷，最终汇入大海。

en: She wants to travel the world after graduation.
The project failed for want of funding.
His answer showed a want of common sense.
cn: 她毕业后想环游世界。
项目因资金不足而失败。
他的回答显得缺乏常识。

en: The two nations have been at war for decades.
cn: 这两个国家已交战数十年。

en: The sun feels warm on my skin.
She gave us a warm welcome.
He warmed his hands by the fire.
cn: 阳光照在皮肤上很温暖。
她热情地欢迎了我们。
他在火边暖手。

definitions.definition: 温暖（物理或情感上的热度）

en: The fireplace filled the room with gentle warmth.
Her smile conveyed genuine warmth.
They welcomed us with unexpected warmth.
cn: 壁炉让房间充满柔和的温暖。
她的笑容流露出真诚的亲切。
他们以出乎意料的热情迎接了我们。

en: The weather service warned residents of the approaching hurricane.
She warned him not to trust strangers online.
The label warns that this product may cause allergies.
cn: 气象部门警告居民飓风即将来临。
她告诫他不要轻信网络上的陌生人。
标签注明该产品可能引发过敏。

en: She washes her hands before every meal.
The waves washed shells onto the shore.
This fabric washes well in cold water.
cn: 她每餐前都洗手。
海浪将贝壳冲上岸。
这种面料用冷水洗涤效果很好。

en: Don't waste food; many people are starving.
The factory dumped toxic waste into the river.
After the war, the village lay in waste for decades.
cn: 不要浪费食物，许多人正在挨饿。
工厂将有毒废弃物排入河流。
战争结束后，村庄荒废了数十年。

en: She glanced at her watch and realized she was late.
The security guard watches the building at night.
Watch how I fold this paper, then try it yourself.
cn: 她瞥了一眼手表，发现自己迟到了。
保安夜间看守这栋大楼。
看我怎么折这张纸，然后你自己试试。

en: The plants need to be watered twice a week.
She dipped her feet in the cool water.
The city is surrounded by water on three sides.
cn: 这些植物需要每周浇水两次。
她把脚浸入凉爽的水中。
这座城市三面环水。

definitions.definition: （比喻）大量连续出现的事物（如信息、资金等）

en: The hikers stood in awe at the base of the towering waterfall.
The report triggered a waterfall of complaints from customers.
Niagara Falls is one of the most famous waterfalls in the world.
cn: 徒步者们敬畏地站在高耸的瀑布脚下。
这份报告引发了顾客如潮水般的投诉。
尼亚加拉瀑布是全球最著名的瀑布之一。

en: This jacket is waterproof and wind-resistant.
They waterproofed the tent before the camping trip.
The phone case claims to be fully waterproof up to 10 meters.
cn: 这件夹克防水且防风。
他们在露营前给帐篷做了防水处理。
这款手机壳宣称可完全防水至10米深度。

en: The boat rose and fell with the waves.
She waved goodbye to her friends.
The flag waved in the strong wind.
cn: 小船随着波浪起伏。
她向朋友们挥手告别。
旗帜在大风中飘扬。

definitions.definition: 波长（物理学中波的两个相邻波峰或波谷之间的距离）

en: The wavelength of violet light is shorter than that of red light.
They’ve been working together so long that they’re on the same wavelength.
Scientists measured the radio wavelengths emitted by the distant galaxy.
cn: 紫光的波长比红光短。
他们合作已久，如今已默契十足。
科学家测量了遥远星系发射的无线电波长。

en: She used beeswax to polish the wooden table.
The moon waxes to its full size in about two weeks.
His confidence began to wax as he gained experience.
cn: 她用蜂蜡给木桌抛光。
月亮约两周内渐盈至满月。
随着经验积累，他的信心逐渐增强。

en: Can you show me the way to the nearest station?
She has a unique way of teaching languages.
This car is way faster than the old one.
cn: 你能告诉我去最近车站的路吗？
她有一种独特的语言教学方法。
这辆车比旧的那辆快多了。

definitions.definition: 我们（第一人称复数主格代词）

en: We are going to the museum tomorrow.
Can we talk about this later?
We won the championship after years of effort.
cn: 我们明天要去博物馆。
我们能晚点再谈这个吗？
经过多年努力，我们赢得了冠军。

definitions.definition: （论点、信号等）不充分的；微弱的

en: She felt weak after the long illness.
His weak leadership caused the project to fail.
The Wi-Fi signal is too weak to connect.
cn: 久病后她感到虚弱。
他领导能力不足导致项目失败。
Wi-Fi信号太弱，无法连接。

en: The storm weakened as it moved inland.
Overuse can weaken the structure of the bridge.
His illness weakened his immune system significantly.
cn: 风暴向内陆移动时逐渐减弱。
过度使用会削弱桥梁的结构强度。
疾病严重削弱了他的免疫系统。

en: His illness caused prolonged physical weakness.
Overconfidence is often a hidden weakness in leaders.
She has a weakness for vintage perfume.
cn: 他的疾病导致了长期的身体虚弱。
过度自信常是领导者隐藏的弱点。
她对复古香水有种偏爱。

en: His wealth comes from decades of wise investments.
The library offers a wealth of historical documents.
True wealth includes health and happiness.
cn: 他的财富源于数十年的明智投资。
这座图书馆提供大量历史文献。
真正的财富包含健康与快乐。

en: She grew up in a wealthy family but chose a simple lifestyle.
The region is wealthy in natural resources.
His wealthy vocabulary impressed the audience.
cn: 她出身富裕家庭，却选择了朴素的生活方式。
该地区自然资源丰富。
他丰富的词汇量令听众印象深刻。

en: The soldier cleaned his weapon carefully.
Words can be a powerful weapon in debates.
The treaty banned biological weapons.
cn: 士兵仔细擦拭他的武器。
语言在辩论中能成为强大的武器。
该条约禁止生物武器。

en: She wears a red dress to parties.
The stone steps have worn smooth over centuries.
This fabric wears well even after multiple washes.
cn: 她穿红色连衣裙参加聚会。
石阶经数百年磨损已变得光滑。
这种面料即使多次洗涤仍很耐穿。

en: She gave a weary sigh after the long meeting.
His eyes grew weary from staring at the screen.
The endless paperwork wearied the entire team.
cn: 漫长会议后，她疲惫地叹了口气。
他的双眼因长时间盯着屏幕而变得疲倦。
没完没了的文书工作让整个团队感到厌烦。

definitions.definition: 经受住（风雨、困难等）；使风化

en: The weather suddenly changed from sunny to stormy.
These rocks have weathered centuries of wind and rain.
Her optimism helped her weather the difficult times.
cn: 天气突然由晴转暴风雨。
这些岩石经受住了数百年的风雨侵蚀。
她的乐观帮助她度过了艰难时期。

definitions.definition: 编织（布料、篮子等）；迂回行进

en: She learned to weave baskets from willow branches.
The driver had to weave through heavy traffic.
The fabric's tight weave makes it waterproof.
cn: 她学会了用柳枝编织篮子。
司机不得不在拥堵的车流中穿行。
这种织物因紧密的编织工艺而防水。

definitions.definition: 结婚纪念日（如 silver wedding 银婚）

en: Their wedding was held in a charming countryside church.
The couple celebrated their golden wedding anniversary last year.
Traditional weddings often involve exchanging rings and vows.
cn: 他们的婚礼在一座迷人的乡村教堂举行。
这对夫妇去年庆祝了他们的金婚纪念日。
传统婚礼通常包括交换戒指和誓言。
