en: We have a meeting scheduled for Wednesday afternoon.
She was born on a rainy Wednesday in March.
The deadline is next Wednesday, so hurry up!
cn: 我们定于周三下午开会。
她出生在三月一个阴雨的周三。
截止日期是下周三，抓紧时间！

en: The garden was full of weeds after the rainy season.
She spent the morning weeding the flower beds.
We need to weed out outdated ideas from the proposal.
cn: 雨季过后，花园里长满了杂草。
她花了一上午给花坛除草。
我们需要从提案中剔除过时的想法。

definitions.definition: 星期，周（时间单位，通常为7天）

en: She visits her grandparents twice a week.
The project deadline is in three weeks.
A typical workweek consists of five days.
cn: 她每周去看望祖父母两次。
项目截止日期在三周后。
标准工作周为五天。

en: The library is open from 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays.
Weekday traffic is always heavier than on weekends.
She wears formal clothes only on weekdays.
cn: 图书馆工作日上午9点至下午6点开放。
工作日的交通总是比周末更拥堵。
她只在工作日穿正装。

en: We’re planning a trip for the weekend.
She usually weekends at her countryside cottage.
The store is closed during the weekend.
cn: 我们计划周末去旅行。
她通常在乡间小屋度周末。
这家店周末不营业。

en: She attends a weekly meeting every Monday.
The magazine is published weekly.
He checks his progress weekly.
cn: 她每周一参加一次例会。
这本杂志每周出版一期。
他每周检查一次进展。

en: She began to weep silently at the sad news.
The willow tree seems to weep over the pond.
He wept tears of joy when reunited with his family.
cn: 听到悲伤的消息，她开始默默哭泣。
柳树仿佛在池塘上方垂泪。
与家人团聚时，他流下了喜悦的泪水。

en: The grocer weighed the apples carefully.
Her opinion weighs heavily in the decision.
You must weigh the risks before investing.
cn: 杂货商仔细称了苹果的重量。
她的意见对决策有重大影响。
投资前必须权衡风险。

en: The weight of the package exceeded the limit.
Her opinion carries great weight in the committee.
They weighted the survey to reflect regional differences.
cn: 包裹的重量超过了限制。
她的意见在委员会中举足轻重。
他们对调查数据加权以反映地区差异。

en: The host gave us a warm welcome.
You are always welcome to visit my home.
The new policy was welcomed by the public.
cn: 主人热情欢迎了我们。
随时欢迎你来我家做客。
新政策受到了公众的欢迎。

en: The blacksmith will weld the broken pieces of the gate.
A strong weld ensures the structural integrity of the bridge.
She learned to weld in a vocational training program.
cn: 铁匠将焊接大门的断裂部分。
牢固的焊点保障桥梁的结构完整性。
她通过职业培训项目学会了焊接技术。

definitions.definition: 福利（指健康、幸福或繁荣的状态）
（政府或组织提供的）社会福利

en: The government introduced new policies to improve child welfare.
Animal welfare organizations advocate for better treatment of pets.
His primary concern is the welfare of his family.
cn: 政府推出新政策以改善儿童福利。
动物福利组织倡导更好地对待宠物。
他最关心的是家人的福祉。

en: She sings well in the choir.
He feels well after recovering from the flu.
Water wells up from the ground in the valley.
cn: 她在合唱团中唱得很好。
他流感康复后感觉良好。
水从山谷的地面涌出。

en: She is a well-known author in the field of science fiction.
The restaurant is well-known for its authentic Italian cuisine.
His well-known generosity earned him many friends.
cn: 她是科幻小说领域的一位著名作家。
这家餐厅以地道的意大利菜闻名。
他出了名的慷慨为他赢得了许多朋友。

en: The sun sets in the west.
They traveled west to reach the coast.
West winds often bring rain to this region.
cn: 太阳在西方落下。
他们向西行进以抵达海岸。
西风常给该地区带来降雨。

definitions.definition: 西部片（电影类型）；西方人

en: The western part of the country is known for its deserts.
He loves watching classic westerns with cowboys and gunfights.
Western medicine often focuses on treating symptoms directly.
cn: 该国西部地区以沙漠闻名。
他喜欢看牛仔和枪战题材的经典西部片。
西医通常直接针对症状治疗。

en: The pioneers began their westward expansion in search of new land.
The river flows westward into the ocean.
She gazed westward at the setting sun.
cn: 拓荒者为寻找新土地开始向西扩张。
这条河向西流入海洋。
她向西凝视着落日。

en: The grass was wet with morning dew.
Don't touch the paint—it's still wet.
She used a towel to wet her hair before applying dye.
cn: 草地因晨露而潮湿。
别碰油漆，它还没干。
她在染发前用毛巾打湿头发。

definitions.definition: 什么（用于疑问句或从句中）

en: What is your name?
I don't know what you mean.
What! You finished the whole cake?
cn: 你叫什么名字？
我不明白你的意思。
什么！你吃完了整个蛋糕？

definitions.definition: 无论什么；任何事物（用于泛指）
不管怎样的；无所谓的（表示不关心）
随便（表示不耐烦或漠不关心）

en: You can choose whatever you like.
She shrugged and said, "Whatever."
Whatever happens, we'll face it together.
cn: 你可以选任何你喜欢的。
她耸耸肩说：“随便吧。”
无论发生什么，我们一起面对。

en: The fields were golden with ripe wheat.
Wheat is a staple crop in many countries.
Bread made from whole wheat flour is more nutritious.
cn: 田野里成熟的麦子一片金黄。
小麦是许多国家的主粮作物。
全麦面粉制作的面包更有营养。

definitions.definition: 推（或拉）带轮物体；使旋转

en: The potter shaped the clay on a spinning wheel.
cn: 陶工在旋转的拉坯轮上塑形黏土。

definitions.definition: 当……时（引导时间状语从句）

en: When will the meeting start?
She smiled when she saw the surprise.
I remember the day when we first met.
cn: 会议什么时候开始？
她看到惊喜时笑了。
我记得我们初次见面的那一天。

definitions.definition: （非正式）究竟什么时候（表示惊讶或强调）

en: You can call me whenever you need help.
Whenever I visit Paris, I feel inspired.
Whenever did you learn to play the piano so well?
cn: 你随时需要帮助都可以打电话给我。
每当我到访巴黎，都会感到灵感迸发。
你到底是什么时候学会弹钢琴弹得这么好的？

definitions.definition: 在哪里；在何种位置或情况

en: Where is the nearest bookstore?
This is the village where I grew up.
She wondered where the keys had gone.
cn: 最近的书店在哪里？
这是我长大的村庄。
她想知道钥匙去哪儿了。

en: You can sit wherever you like.
Wherever she goes, her dog follows.
We will find you, wherever you hide.
cn: 你可以坐在任何你喜欢的地方。
无论她去哪儿，她的狗都跟着。
无论你躲在哪里，我们都会找到你。

definitions.definition: 是否（引导间接疑问句或选择疑问句）
无论（与“or”连用，表示两种情况皆适用）

en: She asked whether I wanted tea or coffee.
Whether it rains or shines, the event will go on.
Scientists debate whether this theory is provable.
cn: 她问我要茶还是咖啡。
无论晴雨，活动照常举行。
科学家们争论这一理论是否可被证实。

definitions.definition: 哪一个；哪一些（用于疑问句或从句中指代特定事物）
哪一个的；哪一些的（限定名词）

en: Which book do you prefer?
She couldn't decide which dress to wear.
The house, which was built in 1900, is now a museum.
cn: 你更喜欢哪本书？
她无法决定穿哪条裙子。
这栋建于1900年的房子现在是博物馆。

definitions.definition: /adj. 无论哪一个（用于强调选择自由）
无论哪个（引导让步状语从句）

en: Choose whichever book you like.
Whichever path you take, be consistent.
She’ll support you, whichever decision you make.
cn: 选你喜欢的任何一本书。
无论你选哪条路，都要坚持。
无论你做什么决定，她都会支持你。

en: She waited for a while before the bus arrived.
While I understand your point, I disagree.
He read a book while drinking coffee.
cn: 她等了一会儿，公交车才来。
尽管我理解你的观点，但我不同意。
他一边喝咖啡一边看书。

definitions.definition: 当…时；与…同时（等同于 while，多用于英式英语）

en: She listened intently whilst taking notes.
Whilst the project is ambitious, its feasibility remains uncertain.
He prefers tea whilst his brother opts for coffee.
cn: 她一边专心听，一边记笔记。
尽管这个项目雄心勃勃，但其可行性仍不明确。
他喜欢喝茶，而他弟弟选择咖啡。

definitions.definition: 鞭打；快速移动；搅拌（奶油等）

en: He cracked the whip to urge the horses forward.
She whipped the cream until it formed soft peaks.
The flag whipped in the strong wind.
cn: 他挥动鞭子催促马匹前进。
她搅拌奶油直至形成软峰。
旗帜在强风中快速飘动。

en: The leaves began to whirl in the autumn wind.
Her mind was in a whirl after the shocking news.
The dancer whirled across the stage effortlessly.
cn: 落叶开始在秋风中旋转。
那个令人震惊的消息让她思绪纷乱。
舞者轻松地旋转着穿过舞台。

definitions.definition: 威士忌（一种由谷物发酵蒸馏制成的烈酒）

en: He ordered a glass of single malt whisky at the bar.
Scottish whisky is renowned for its smoky flavor.
She prefers bourbon whisky over other types.
cn: 他在酒吧点了一杯单一麦芽威士忌。
苏格兰威士忌以其烟熏风味闻名。
她更喜欢波本威士忌而非其他种类。

en: She whispered a secret in his ear.
The wind whispered through the leaves.
There are whispers of a possible merger.
cn: 她在他的耳边低声说了一个秘密。
风穿过树叶发出沙沙声。
有传闻称可能会发生合并。

en: The referee blew the whistle to stop the game.
She whistled a cheerful tune while walking.
The wind whistled through the cracks in the window.
cn: 裁判吹哨中止了比赛。
她边走边用口哨吹着欢快的曲调。
风从窗缝中呼啸而过。

en: She wore a elegant white dress to the party.
The walls were painted white to make the room look brighter.
In some cultures, white symbolizes purity and innocence.
cn: 她穿了一条优雅的白色连衣裙参加派对。
墙壁被刷成白色，让房间显得更明亮。
在某些文化中，白色象征纯洁与天真。

definitions.definition: 白色涂料；粉饰；掩盖真相
粉刷；粉饰；掩盖（错误或失败）

en: The fence needs a fresh coat of whitewash before the summer.
The official report was a whitewash of the corruption scandal.
They tried to whitewash their failures by blaming external factors.
cn: 夏季前栅栏需要重新粉刷一遍。
这份官方报告是对腐败丑闻的粉饰。
他们试图通过归咎于外部因素来掩盖自己的失败。

definitions.definition: 谁（用于疑问句或关系从句中指代人）

en: Who is at the door?
She is the one who helped me.
Who told you this secret?
cn: 谁在门口？
她就是帮助我的那个人。
谁告诉你这个秘密的？

definitions.definition: 无论谁，任何人（引导名词性从句或让步状语从句）
究竟是谁（加强疑问语气）

en: Whoever finishes the task first will get a bonus.
I won't trust whoever betrayed me.
Whoever told you that was lying.
cn: 最先完成任务的人将获得奖金。
我不会信任任何背叛过我的人。
告诉你这件事的人肯定在撒谎。

en: She ate the whole apple in one bite.
The whole project took three months to complete.
We need to consider the problem as a whole.
cn: 她一口吃掉了整个苹果。
整个项目耗时三个月完成。
我们需要从整体上考虑这个问题。

en: She was wholly unaware of the changes happening around her.
The project was wholly funded by private donations.
His answer was wholly unexpected, surprising everyone.
cn: 她完全没意识到周围发生的变化。
该项目全部由私人捐款资助。
他的回答完全出乎意料，让所有人惊讶。

en: To whom did you give the book?
She is the woman whom I met yesterday.
Whom should we contact in case of emergency?
cn: 你把书给了谁？
她就是我昨天遇见的那位女士。
紧急情况下我们该联系谁？

definitions.definition: （疑问代词或关系代词）谁的；那个人的，那些人的

en: Whose idea was it to start this project?
She found a dog whose collar was missing.
Do you know whose phone is ringing?
cn: 启动这个项目是谁的主意？
她发现了一只丢失项圈的狗。
你知道是谁的电话在响吗？

definitions.definition: 为什么（询问原因或目的）

en: Why did you leave the meeting early?
She explained the why behind her decision.
I wonder why the sky is blue.
cn: 你为什么提前离开会议？
她解释了自己决定的原因。
我想知道为什么天空是蓝色的。

en: The witch cast a wicked spell on the village.
That skateboard trick was wicked!
In old tales, the wicked are often punished in the end.
cn: 女巫对村庄施了邪恶的咒语。
那个滑板技巧太厉害了！
古老故事中，恶人终将受罚。

en: The river is too wide to swim across.
She has a wide knowledge of ancient history.
The door was wide open, inviting us in.
cn: 这条河太宽，无法游过去。
她对古代历史有广博的知识。
门大敞着，仿佛在邀请我们进入。

en: The theory is widely accepted in scientific circles.
Her books are widely read by teenagers.
The two versions differ widely in details.
cn: 这一理论在科学界被广泛接受。
她的书在青少年中广为流传。
两个版本在细节上差异很大。

en: The city plans to widen the road to reduce traffic congestion.
Her eyes widened in surprise when she saw the gift.
The gap between rich and poor continues to widen.
cn: 该市计划拓宽道路以缓解交通拥堵。
看到礼物时，她惊讶地睁大了眼睛。
贫富差距持续扩大。

en: The disease became widespread after the flood.
There is widespread support for the new policy.
Widespread use of smartphones has changed communication.
cn: 洪水过后，这种疾病开始广泛传播。
新政策获得了普遍支持。
智能手机的普及改变了沟通方式。

en: The widow wore black for a year after her husband's death.
Ancient laws required a widow to marry her husband's brother.
The war widowed many women in the village.
cn: 这位寡妇在丈夫去世后穿了一年的黑衣。
古代法律要求寡妇嫁给丈夫的兄弟。
战争使村里的许多妇女成了寡妇。

en: The width of the river exceeds 500 meters at its broadest point.
Measure the width of the door before buying a new sofa.
The artist played with contrasting colors to exaggerate the width of the canvas.
cn: 这条河最宽处的宽度超过500米。
买新沙发前先量一下门的宽度。
艺术家运用对比色来突出画布的广度。

en: His wife is a talented musician.
She became a wife at the age of twenty-five.
The couple celebrated their anniversary with their wives and children.
cn: 他的妻子是位才华横溢的音乐家。
她在二十五岁时成为妻子。
这对夫妇与他们的妻子和孩子们一起庆祝纪念日。

en: The wildflowers bloomed across the meadow.
His wild laughter echoed through the room.
They ventured into the wild to study wolves.
cn: 野花在草地上遍地盛开。
他狂野的笑声在房间里回荡。
他们深入荒野研究狼群。

definitions.definition: 将（表示未来时态）；愿意；立遗嘱

en: She has a strong will to succeed.
They will arrive at noon tomorrow.
He drafted his will last month.
cn: 她拥有强烈的成功意志。
他们将于明天中午到达。
他上个月起草了遗嘱。

en: She was willing to help despite her busy schedule.
A willing worker completes tasks with enthusiasm.
They found a willing audience for their innovative ideas.
cn: 尽管日程繁忙，她仍乐意帮忙。
积极的员工会热情完成任务。
他们的创新想法找到了愿意倾听的观众。

en: She worked hard to win the competition.
Their team celebrated the win with enthusiasm.
Confidence is key to winning in negotiations.
cn: 她努力赢得了比赛。
他们的队伍为胜利热情庆祝。
自信是谈判获胜的关键。

definitions.definition: 使喘不过气；缠绕（如绕线）

en: The wind howled through the trees all night.
She had to wind the yarn into a ball before knitting.
The river winds through the valley like a silver ribbon.
cn: 狂风整夜在树林间呼啸。
她必须先把毛线绕成团才能织毛衣。
河流如银色丝带般蜿蜒穿过山谷。

en: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
The cat sat on the windowsill, watching birds outside.
Minimize the browser window to see your desktop.
cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
猫坐在窗台上，望着外面的鸟。
最小化浏览器窗口以查看桌面。

definitions.definition: 深红色（因葡萄酒颜色得名）

en: She prefers red wine to white wine.
The sunset painted the sky in shades of wine.
This region is famous for its organic wine production.
cn: 她更喜欢红葡萄酒而非白葡萄酒。
夕阳将天空染成了酒红色。
该地区以有机葡萄酒生产闻名。

en: The bird spread its wings and flew into the sky.
The new aircraft has delta-shaped wings.
The castle’s north wing was added in the 18th century.
cn: 鸟儿展开翅膀飞向天空。
这架新飞机的机翼呈三角形。
城堡的北翼建于18世纪。

definitions.definition: （比喻）成功者（指在竞争中表现优异的人或事物）

en: She was the winner of the science competition.
In life, a positive attitude often makes you a winner.
The team celebrated their star player as the ultimate winner.
cn: 她是这场科学竞赛的获胜者。
在生活中，积极的态度常使你成为赢家。
队伍将他们的明星球员誉为终极胜利者。

en: The trees lose their leaves in winter.
Birds migrate to warmer places to winter.
Winter is coming, so we stocked up on firewood.
cn: 树木在冬季落叶。
鸟类迁徙到更温暖的地方过冬。
冬天将至，我们囤积了木柴。

en: She used a cloth to wipe the dust off the table.
The teacher wiped the whiteboard clean after the lesson.
These antibacterial wipes are convenient for cleaning hands.
cn: 她用布擦掉了桌子上的灰尘。
下课后，老师把白板擦干净了。
这些抗菌湿巾便于清洁双手。

definitions.definition: 用金属线连接；给…安装电线

en: The artist shaped the wire into a delicate sculpture.
Make sure to wire the circuit correctly to avoid shorting.
He received a wire transfer from overseas.
cn: 艺术家将金属线弯折成精致的雕塑。
务必正确连接电路以防短路。
他收到了一笔海外电汇。

en: Modern smartphones rely on wireless charging technology.
The conference room is equipped with a wireless microphone.
Early radio was called "wireless telegraphy" in the 1890s.
cn: 现代智能手机依赖无线充电技术。
会议室配备了无线麦克风。
19世纪90年代，早期无线电被称为“无线电报”。

en: His wisdom guided the team through the crisis.
Ancient proverbs often contain timeless wisdom.
She questioned the wisdom of his decision.
cn: 他的智慧带领团队度过了危机。
古老的谚语常蕴含永恒的智慧。
她质疑他决定的明智性。

en: She gave me some wise advice about saving money.
The old man was wise beyond his years.
cn: 她给了我一些关于省钱的明智建议。
这位老人的智慧超越了他的年龄。

en: She closed her eyes and made a wish.
I wish I could travel to Mars someday.
We send our best wishes for your recovery.
cn: 她闭上眼睛许了个愿。
我希望有一天能去火星旅行。
我们衷心祝愿你早日康复。

en: She replied with her usual wit and charm.
His sharp wit made him a popular speaker.
cn: 她以一贯的机智和魅力作答。
他犀利的幽默感使他成为受欢迎的演讲者。

en: She went to the park with her dog.
Cut the paper with scissors.
He agreed with my opinion.
cn: 她带着狗去了公园。
用剪刀剪纸。
他同意我的观点。

en: She decided to withdraw her application.
The army had to withdraw from the battlefield.
You can withdraw cash at any ATM.
cn: 她决定撤回申请。
军队不得不从战场撤退。
你可以在任何ATM机上取现。

definitions.definition: 在…内部；不超过（某时间/范围）

en: She found peace within herself.
The answer lies within the text.
Reply within 24 hours.
cn: 她在内心找到了平静。
答案隐藏在文本中。
请在24小时内回复。

en: She left without saying goodbye.
The house stood without the city walls.
He managed without any help.
cn: 她没告别就离开了。
房子矗立在城墙外。
他在没有任何帮助的情况下完成了。

definitions.definition: 经受住；抵抗；承受（压力、攻击等）

en: The bridge was designed to withstand earthquakes.
She could hardly withstand the temptation of chocolate.
Their friendship withstood years of separation.
cn: 这座桥的设计能抵御地震。
她几乎无法抵抗巧克力的诱惑。
他们的友谊经受住了多年的分离。

en: She was the only witness to the accident.
Thousands witnessed the historic event.
His smile witnessed his joy.
cn: 她是事故的唯一目击者。
数千人见证了这一历史性事件。
他的笑容证明了他的喜悦。

en: The lone wolf howled under the full moon.
He wolfed down his dinner in three minutes.
She called him a wolf for his ruthless business tactics.
cn: 孤狼在满月下嚎叫。
他三分钟就狼吞虎咽地吃完了晚餐。
她因他无情的商业手段称他为贪婪之徒。

en: She is the first woman to lead the expedition.
The book explores the role of woman in modern society.
Every woman has the right to education.
cn: 她是领导该探险队的第一位女性。
这本书探讨了女性在现代社会中的角色。
每位女性都享有受教育的权利。

en: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder.
I wonder if she will come to the party.
They stared in wonder at the northern lights.
cn: 大峡谷是一处自然奇观。
我想知道她是否会来参加派对。
他们惊奇地凝视着北极光。

en: The fireworks display was absolutely wonderful.
She has a wonderful ability to connect with people.
cn: 烟花表演简直精彩绝伦。
她拥有与人打交道的非凡能力。

en: The table is made of solid wood.
We went for a walk in the woods behind the house.
Ancient people used wood to build shelters.
cn: 这张桌子由实木制成。
我们在屋后的树林里散步。
古人用木材建造居所。

en: The table is made of wooden planks.
His acting was stiff and wooden.
She placed the wooden box on the shelf.
cn: 这张桌子由木板制成。
他的表演生硬呆板。
她把木盒放在架子上。

en: She knitted a sweater from soft Welsh wool.
The blanket is made of 100% pure wool.
Wool production is a major industry in Australia.
cn: 她用柔软的威尔士羊毛织了一件毛衣。
这条毯子由100%纯羊毛制成。
羊毛生产是澳大利亚的主要产业之一。

en: She wore a warm woollen scarf around her neck.
This factory specializes in producing high-quality woollen fabrics.
I prefer woollen socks in winter because they keep my feet warmer.
cn: 她脖子上围着一条温暖的羊毛围巾。
这家工厂专门生产高质量的毛纺面料。
冬天我更喜欢羊毛袜，因为它们让我的脚更暖和。

en: She didn't say a word during the meeting.
The word "love" carries deep emotional weight.
Can you word this email more politely?
cn: 会议期间她一言未发。
"爱"这个词承载着深厚的情感分量。
你能把这封邮件写得更礼貌些吗？

en: She works as a software engineer.
The machine doesn't work properly.
His latest work will be exhibited in Paris.
cn: 她是一名软件工程师。
这台机器运转不正常。
他的最新作品将在巴黎展出。

en: The factory employs over 500 workers.
Worker ants are responsible for gathering food.
She is a dedicated social worker.
cn: 这家工厂雇用了500多名工人。
工蚁负责采集食物。
她是一名敬业的社会工作者。

definitions.definition: 工人，工匠（尤指技术熟练的手工劳动者）

en: The skilled workman carved the statue from a single block of marble.
A good workman always takes pride in his craftsmanship.
The factory hired additional workmen to meet the production deadline.
cn: 这位熟练的工匠用一整块大理石雕刻出雕像。
优秀的工匠总以技艺为傲。
工厂额外雇佣工人以赶上生产期限。

definitions.definition: 工作坊（用于手工制作或修理的场所）
研讨会（多人参与的专题讨论或实践活动）

en: The carpenter built a custom table in his workshop.
We attended a creative writing workshop last weekend.
The factory's workshop was equipped with modern tools.
cn: 木匠在他的工作坊里制作了一张定制桌子。
上周末我们参加了一个创意写作研讨会。
工厂的车间配备了现代化工具。

definitions.definition: 领域；范围（如 "the world of art"）

en: The pandemic affected the entire world.
She is a rising star in the world of fashion.
Ancient maps depicted the world as flat.
cn: 这场疫情影响了整个世界。
她是时尚界的新星。
古地图将世界描绘成平的。

en: The bird pecked at the worm in the soil.
A computer worm can spread without user interaction.
He wormed his way through the narrow tunnel.
cn: 鸟儿啄食泥土中的蠕虫。
计算机蠕虫病毒无需用户操作即可传播。
他在狭窄的隧道中缓慢爬行。

en: Don't worry about things you can't control.
Her constant worrying affects her health.
The dog worried at the bone for hours.
cn: 别为无法控制的事情烦恼。
她持续的忧虑影响了健康。
那只狗啃咬骨头好几个小时。（保留古义用例）

definitions.definition: (bad 的比较级) 更差的，更糟的；更严重的
(badly 或 ill 的比较级) 更差地，更糟地；更严重地

en: The weather got worse as the day went on.
He performed worse in the exam than he had expected.
To make matters worse, it started to rain.
cn: 随着时间的推移，天气变得更糟了。
他在考试中的表现比预期的要差。
更糟糕的是，开始下雨了。

en: The temple is a place of worship for thousands of pilgrims.
She worships her grandfather as a hero.
In ancient cultures, people often worshipped nature gods.
cn: 这座寺庙是数千朝圣者的礼拜场所。
她像崇拜英雄一样敬仰她的祖父。
在古代文化中，人们常崇拜自然神祇。

definitions.definition: （bad 或 ill 的最高级）最差的，最坏的

en: This is the worst storm in decades.
Fear of failure is often worse than the worst outcome.
cn: 这是几十年来最严重的风暴。
对失败的恐惧常比最坏的结果更糟。

en: This necklace is worth a fortune.
His advice proved to be of great worth.
The project is worth the effort.
cn: 这条项链价值连城。
他的建议被证明极具价值。
这个项目值得付出努力。

en: The broken vase is worthless now.
He felt worthless after losing his job.
Cheating is a worthless act.
cn: 这个破碎的花瓶现在毫无价值。
失业后，他觉得自己一无是处。
作弊是可耻的行为。

definitions.definition: 值得花时间（或努力）的；有价值的

en: The research project was worthwhile despite its challenges.
Learning a new language is always worthwhile.
She felt the long hours were worthwhile when she saw the results.
cn: 这项研究项目尽管有挑战，但很有价值。
学习一门新语言总是值得的。
当她看到成果时，觉得长时间的付出是值得的。

definitions.definition: 值得的；配得上的（常接 of 或不定式）

en: She proved herself worthy of the team's trust.
This museum houses many worthy historical artifacts.
His actions were not worthy of a leader.
cn: 她证明了自己配得上团队的信任。
该博物馆收藏了许多有价值的历史文物。
他的行为与领导者的身份不相称。

definitions.definition: （will的过去式）表示过去将来的意愿或习惯性动作
用于委婉请求、假设或虚拟语气

en: She said she would call me tomorrow.
Would you mind closing the window?
If I were rich, I would travel the world.
cn: 她说她明天会给我打电话。
你介意关下窗户吗？
如果我有钱，我会环游世界。

definitions.definition: 使受伤；伤害（身体或情感）

en: The nurse carefully cleaned the soldier's gunshot wound.
His harsh words wounded her deeply.
Time heals all wounds, but some leave scars.
cn: 护士仔细清理了士兵的枪伤。
他刻薄的话语深深伤害了她。
时间能治愈所有创伤，但有些会留下疤痕。

en: She used a scarf to wrap the gift neatly.
The fog began to wrap around the mountains.
This material can wrap tightly without tearing.
cn: 她用围巾将礼物整齐地包起来。
雾气开始笼罩群山。
这种材料能紧密包裹而不破裂。

definitions.definition: 花环，花圈（用于装饰或纪念）
环状物（如烟雾、云朵等形成的圈状）

en: She placed a wreath of roses on the door during Christmas.
A wreath of smoke curled above the chimney.
The athletes received laurel wreaths as prizes in ancient Olympics.
cn: 圣诞节时，她在门上挂了一个玫瑰编成的花环。
一缕烟雾如环状盘旋在烟囱上方。
古代奥运会上，获胜运动员被授予月桂花环作为奖励。

en: The storm left a trail of wreck along the coast.
Drinking too much alcohol can wreck your health.
Archaeologists found a Viking wreck buried in the mud.
cn: 风暴在海岸线上留下一片残骸。
过量饮酒会严重损害健康。
考古学家发现了一艘埋在淤泥中的维京沉船残骸。

en: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
He sprained his wrist while playing tennis.
The watch fits snugly on my wrist.
cn: 她的手腕上戴着一只银手镯。
他打网球时扭伤了手腕。
这块手表牢牢贴合我的手腕。

en: She writes a letter every Sunday.
He enjoys writing science fiction.
Please write your name here.
cn: 她每周日写一封信。
他喜欢创作科幻小说。
请在此处写下你的名字。

en: She is a prolific writer, publishing three novels a year.
The writer of this report failed to cite key sources.
Ancient writers often recorded history through poetry.
cn: 她是一位多产作家，每年出版三本小说。
本报告的撰写人未引用关键来源。
古代作家常以诗歌形式记录历史。

definitions.definition: （特定形式的）书面材料（如法律文件、手稿）

en: Her writing captures the essence of human emotions.
Ancient writing on clay tablets revealed lost civilizations.
Legal writing requires precision and clarity.
cn: 她的写作捕捉了人类情感的精髓。
黏土板上的古代文字揭示了失落的文明。
法律文书需要精确与清晰。

en: Your answer is wrong.
It's wrong to judge people by their appearance.
She felt deeply wronged by the false accusation.
cn: 你的答案是错误的。
以貌取人是不对的。
她被诬告后感到深受冤枉。

en: The doctor ordered an x-ray to check for a fracture.
X-rays are widely used in medical diagnostics.
The luggage was x-rayed at the airport security.
cn: 医生要求拍X光片检查骨折。
X射线广泛应用于医学诊断。
行李在机场安检处接受了X光扫描。

definitions.definition: 院子；庭院（住宅周围的露天区域）

en: The children are playing in the backyard.
The fabric is sold by the yard.
He built a fence around his yard.
cn: 孩子们正在后院玩耍。
这种布料按码出售。
他在院子周围筑了一道篱笆。

en: She tried to suppress a yawn during the meeting.
His yawn was so loud that everyone turned to look at him.
Just thinking about bedtime makes me yawn.
cn: 会议上她努力忍住哈欠。
他的哈欠声太大，所有人都转头看他。
一想到睡觉时间我就打哈欠。

definitions.definition: 年（地球绕太阳公转一周的时间）
年度，年份（日历或事件周期）

en: It takes Earth one year to orbit the Sun.
The academic year starts in September.
She celebrated her 30th year with a trip abroad.
cn: 地球绕太阳公转一周需要一年时间。
学年从九月开始。
她用一次出国旅行庆祝自己的30岁。

en: The company holds a yearly meeting to review its performance.
She receives a yearly bonus based on her sales targets.
These flowers bloom yearly in early spring.
cn: 公司每年召开一次会议回顾业绩。
她根据销售目标获得年度奖金。
这些花每年早春绽放。

en: The coach yelled instructions to the players during the match.
She let out a yell when she saw the spider.
Protesters yelled slogans outside the government building.
cn: 比赛中教练向球员大声喊出指令。
她看到蜘蛛时发出一声尖叫。
抗议者在政府大楼外高喊口号。

definitions.definition: 黄色的；黄皮肤的；胆怯的

en: The fields turned yellow under the summer sun.
She wore a bright yellow dress to the party.
Old newspapers tend to yellow with age.
cn: 夏日的阳光下，田野变成了金黄色。
她穿了一条明黄色的裙子参加派对。
旧报纸随着时间推移会发黄。

definitions.definition: 表示肯定或同意（是，对的）

en: "Yes, I completely agree with your proposal."
"She gave a firm yes to the job offer."
"Is this your first time here?" "Yes, it is."
cn: （“是的，我完全同意你的提议。”）
（她对工作机会给出了明确的肯定答复。）
（“这是你第一次来吗？”“是的。”）

en: She left yesterday without saying goodbye.
Yesterday’s meeting was postponed.
I wish I could go back to yesterday.
cn: 她昨天不辞而别。
昨天的会议延期了。
真希望我能回到昨天。

definitions.definition: 还；尚（用于否定句或疑问句）

en: She hasn't finished her homework yet.
Have you eaten yet?
The plan is simple, yet effective.
cn: 她还没完成作业。
你已经吃过了吗？
这个计划简单却有效。

definitions.definition: 生产（作物、利润等）；屈服，让步

en: The orchard yields a ton of apples annually.
She refused to yield to his demands.
The bond has a high yield of 5%.
cn: 这片果园每年产出一吨苹果。
她拒绝向他的要求让步。
这只债券的收益率高达5%。

definitions.definition: 你；你们（第二人称代词主格/宾格）

en: You are my best friend.
Can I help you with this task?
You all did an excellent job!
cn: 你是我的挚友。
需要我帮你完成这项任务吗？
你们所有人都做得太棒了！

definitions.definition: 年轻人（总称，常与 "the" 连用）

en: She teaches young children with patience.
The young are more adaptable to change.
This wine is too young to drink.
cn: 她耐心地教导幼童。
年轻人更适应变化。
这酒太新，不宜饮用。

definitions.definition: 你的；你们的（第二人称所有格形式）

en: Is this your book?
Your ideas are always inspiring.
Remember to bring your passport.
cn: 这是你的书吗？
你的想法总是很有启发性。
记得带上你的护照。

en: Is this pen yours?
The decision is ultimately yours.
Their ideas are similar to yours.
cn: 这支笔是你的吗？
决定权最终在你们手中。
他们的想法和你们的相似。

definitions.definition: 你自己（反身代词，强调主语或宾语的同一性）

en: You should believe in yourself more.
The instructions say, "Do it yourself."
Look at yourself in the mirror.
cn: 你应该更相信自己。
说明书上写着："请自行完成。"
看看镜子里的你自己。

en: She spent her youth traveling the world.
The program aims to inspire the youth to pursue science.
His paintings capture the energy and hope of youth.
cn: 她的青春时光在周游世界中度过。
该项目旨在激励年轻人投身科学。
他的画作捕捉了青春的活力与希望。

definitions.definition: 年轻的；富有青春活力的

en: She maintains a youthful glow despite her age.
His youthful enthusiasm inspired the team.
The painting captures the youthful spirit of the era.
cn: 尽管年长，她仍保持着青春的光彩。
他年轻的热情激励了整个团队。
这幅画捕捉了那个时代的青春气息。

en: She tackled the project with great zeal.
His zeal for learning languages impressed everyone.
The team's zeal faded after repeated failures.
cn: 她以极大的热情投入这个项目。
他对学习语言的热情感染了所有人。
屡次失败后，团队的干劲逐渐消退。

definitions.definition: 热忱的，狂热的（尤指对事业或信仰）

en: She was a zealous supporter of environmental causes.
His zealous preaching attracted both followers and critics.
The team worked with zealous dedication to meet the deadline.
cn: 她是环保事业的狂热支持者。
他充满热忱的布道既吸引了追随者，也招致批评。
团队以狂热的专注力工作以赶上截止日期。

definitions.definition: 斑马（非洲草原上的黑白条纹马科动物）

en: The zebra grazed peacefully on the savanna.
Her dress had bold black and white stripes like a zebra.
Zebras use their stripes as camouflage against predators.
cn: 斑马在草原上安静地吃草。
她的裙子有像斑马一样的醒目黑白条纹。
斑马利用条纹作为躲避捕食者的伪装。

en: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
Her patience was at zero after hours of waiting.
The project had zero chance of success from the start.
cn: 昨夜气温降至零度。
等待数小时后，她的耐心耗尽。
该项目从一开始就毫无成功可能。

definitions.definition: 将…划为区域；使分成地带

en: The city center is a pedestrian zone.
This area is zoned for residential use only.
The tropical zone has a warm climate year-round.
cn: 市中心是步行区。
该区域被划为纯住宅用地。
热带地区全年气候温暖。

en: The children were excited to visit the zoo and see the lions.
His apartment is a zoo when his nephews come over.
Modern zoos focus on conservation and education.
cn: 孩子们兴奋地参观动物园看狮子。
他的外甥们一来，他的公寓就闹翻天。
现代动物园注重保护与教育。
